data.title: Principal Core Infrastructure Engineer
data.description:
Job Description

Leads development and begins architecting components of scalable, elastic distributed systems. Defines and enforces scalability requirements for owned components; optimizes code and data paths for high‐throughput, hyper‐scale workloads; and leverages data plane platforms for large‐scale retrieval, storage, and processing. Designs fault‐tolerant, in‐service‐upgradable systems using redundancy, replication, failover, and policies for partitions, applying load‐shedding, throttling, and rate‐limiting to handle network unreliability while meeting SLOs. Establishes KPIs and telemetry; builds proactive dashboards and alerts; and designs complex validation (fault injection, brownouts), replication, and synchronization for correctness and durability. Proactively diagnoses and resolves production issues, mentors peers, and ensures operational readiness. Implements robust security controls, executes remediation, maintains compliance documentation, and develops IaC and automation that enable safe patching, updates, and rollbacks within change‐management plans. 

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

System Design & Architecture - System Scalability: 

-Lead the development and implementation, and begin to architect, components of scalable distributed systems that support horizontal and vertical scaling to meet system demands, including leveraging distributed state management tools. 

-Optimize code and/or systems for large-scale data processing and high-throughput requirements to support hyper-scale systems. 

-Define scalability requirements for owned components and ensure design and implementation requirements are met. 

-Design systems to scale with elasticity (e. g. , effectively scaling both up and down). 

-Leverage data plane platforms to effectively handle large-scale data retrieval, storage, and processing. 

-Design performance and load testing. 

System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Design: 

-Build and design fault-tolerant components and systems capable of withstanding in-service updates by implementing redundancy, replication, and automatic failover mechanisms. 

-Design systems to effectively handle service disruptions (e. g. , network partitions) by prioritizing consistency, availability, or partition tolerance. 

-Implement and optimize approaches to handle network unreliability, including load-shedding, throttling, and rate-limiting. 

-Design components and systems that are durable and adhere to service level objectives (SLOs), setting expectations for availability and durability of other computing services within the department. 

System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Performance: 

-Define key performance indicators (KPIs) and telemetry to identify gaps or issues in running systems. 

-Build and customize moderately complex dashboards, telemetry systems, and alerting mechanisms to proactively monitor components and system health. . 

System Design & Architecture - Correctness / Availability: 

-Design and implement functional and correctness requirements for feature sets and/or systems in new or existing systems. 

-Design complex test scenarios (e. g. , fault-injection, brown-out) to evaluate system correctness. 

-Implement data replication and synchronization techniques to maintain data integrity and availability. 

Operational Troubleshooting & Incident Management: 

-Take a proactive role in diagnosing, debugging, and resolving issues in active components and systems to support ongoing operation, and mentor others in these processes. 

-Implement strategies to prevent interruptions, ensuring no maintenance windows are required for customers and users when resolving issues. 

-Maintain expertise in owned components and systems to ensure effective troubleshooting and performance. 

-Meet operational readiness expectations through design and implementation. 

-Serve in operational support rotations, providing guidance in incident response and root cause investigations. 

Compliance & Security: 

-Implement robust security measures to protect data and applications in multi-tenant environments, including encryption techniques and access controls. 

-Execute remediation plans to address identified security gaps. 

-Ensure cloud infrastructure is in compliance with industry standards and regulations and that documentation is up to date. 

Automation & Change Management: 

-Develop and maintain automation scripts and tools (e. g. , Infrastructure as Code (IaC)) to manage cloud infrastructure. 

-Create and adhere to change management plans for patching, updating, and rolling back applications, and begin designing systems and components to allow for automation of these processes. 

Core Responsibilities

Planning & Execution: 

-Manages and coordinates moderately complex tasks, monitoring timelines and deliverables to ensure timely completion and adherence to requirements for a moderately-sized project or initiative. Efficiently delegates, monitors, and prioritizes work across multiple projects, providing technical oversight and adjusting plans to address shifts in resources or timelines. 

Collaboration & Partnership: 

-Collaborates across the organization to align on expectations and achieve shared objectives. Leverages understanding of business leaders, stakeholders, and/or customers to ensure proposed solutions meet their needs. Supports inclusivity by actively seeking and listening to diverse perspectives, ensuring others feel heard and respected. 

Problem Solving: 

-Identifies and addresses moderately complex issues by analyzing a wide range of data and/or information to identify solutions in accordance with standard practices. Proactively escalates unresolved or critical issues with a thorough assessment and suggests potential solutions. Reviews, contributes to, and documents problem solving strategies. 

Continuous Learning: 

-Pursues learning opportunities to expand knowledge and skills and/or tools in new areas and stays abreast of the latest industry trends and best practices. Proactively seeks and leverages ongoing feedback and training to improve skills. Coaches and mentors junior team members, fostering continuous learning and knowledge sharing within and across teams. 

Continuous Improvement: 

-Develops ideas, recommends updates, and/or collaborates on the implementation of process improvements to increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows across teams, and evaluates the impact on key stakeholders. Solicits feedback from others on ideas for alternative approaches and methods for continued improvement. 

Performance and Development: 

-Contributes to the talent development pipeline by participating in candidate interviews, assessing candidates, and providing hiring recommendations. 

About Us

Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives. 

True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That's why we're committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We are looking for an AWS Amazon Connect QA Consultant / Sr. QA Consultant to support complex cloud contact center implementations involving Amazon Connect, IVR/self-service, omnichannel communications, Salesforce Service Cloud Voice, APIs, and conversational/Generative AI. 

This role is ideal for a QA professional with strong hands-on contact center and telephony testing experience who can independently understand complex business flows, translate technical design artifacts into comprehensive test scenarios, coordinate across multiple stakeholders, and drive testing through release readiness. 

Key Responsibilities

Amazon Connect, IVR & Telephony Testing

- Design and execute functional, integration, regression and UAT test scenarios for Amazon Connect contact centers and complex IVRs. 
 - Translate Lucidchart/Visio IVR flow diagrams and requirements into detailed test scripts, ensuring complete branch/path coverage. 
 - Test DTMF, speech/ASR, Amazon Lex, self-service journeys, authentication, ANI lookup, error/timeout handling, transfer, escalation and callback scenarios. 
 - Validate routing profiles, queues, skills, priorities, agent states, hold/transfer/whisper flows, quick connects and supervisor functionality. 
 - Test telephony fundamentals including PSTN/DID/toll-free, IVR, ACD, WebRTC, SIP, call recording and transcription. 
 - Validate Amazon Connect Agent and Supervisor workspaces and use the Amazon Connect Endpoint Test Utility where applicable. 

AWS, API & Salesforce Integration Testing

- Test integrations across AWS Lambda, DynamoDB, S3, Amazon Lex, Contact Flows, Contact Lens and CloudWatch using the AWS Console and Amazon Connect Admin workspace. 
 - Perform end-to-end API testing across Amazon Connect, Salesforce and third-party systems using Postman, SoapUI, REST-assured or similar tools. 
 - Validate REST/SOAP requests and responses, schemas, data mapping, authentication, error handling, timeouts and fallback scenarios. 
 - Test Salesforce Service Cloud Voice (SCV) integrations including CTI controls, Omni-Channel, screen pops, Voice Call records, agent states and real-time transcription. 

Chat, AI & Omnichannel Testing

- Test Amazon Connect Chat and omnichannel customer journeys. 
 - Validate conversational and Generative AI experiences using Amazon Q in Connect, Amazon Bedrock, Amazon Lex, Salesforce Agentforce or similar platforms. 
 - Test intent recognition, conversational flows, context, knowledge grounding, agent assist, generated responses, escalation/handoff and fallback scenarios. 
 - Evaluate AI responses for accuracy, relevance, hallucinations and appropriate guardrails. 

Test Data, Coordination & Delivery

- Source, prepare and map test data to individual test scenarios and maintain clear scenario-to-data traceability. 
 - Coordinate with clients, business teams, developers, architects and multiple vendors to understand E2E business processes and dependencies. 
 - Lead defect triage and track issues through closure with clear evidence, logs, recordings and reproduction steps. 
 - Prepare test execution reports, quality metrics, test evidence and release/go-no-go recommendations. 

Automation & Performance Testing

- Experience with IVR automation tools such as Cyara, Empirix Hammer, Bespoken, Operata or similar. 
 - Support API, voice and chat test automation and CI/CD-based continuous testing. 
 - Experience planning and executing load/performance testing using JMeter, LoadRunner, NeoLoad or equivalent tools is desirable. 

Must-Have Skills & Experience

- 5+ years of overall QA/testing experience, including 3+ years in contact center, CTI, IVR, telephony or cloud contact center platforms. 
 - Strong hands-on Amazon Connect testing experience, preferably with complex IVR and self-service implementations. 
 - Proven ability to read Lucidchart/Visio IVR designs and independently convert them into comprehensive functional test scripts. 
 - Strong understanding of IVR, ACD/routing, DTMF, ASR, PSTN, DID/toll-free, call recording and transcription. 
 - Hands-on experience with Amazon Connect Admin workspace and AWS Console, including Lambda, DynamoDB, S3, Lex and Contact Flows. 
 - Experience testing Amazon Connect Agent/Supervisor workspace and Chat. 
 - Experience with Amazon Q in Connect, Amazon Bedrock, Amazon Lex or other conversational/Generative AI platforms. 
 - Strong API and integration testing experience using Postman, SoapUI, REST-assured or equivalent. 
 - Experience with Salesforce Service Cloud Voice / CTI / Omni-Channel is highly desirable. 
 - Strong test planning, test case design, regression testing, defect management and release readiness experience. 
 - Experience with Jira, qTest, QMetry, TestRail, Zephyr or equivalent test management tools. 

Good-to-Have

- Experience with Cyara, Empirix Hammer or other IVR automation tools. 
 - Load, performance and/or security testing experience. 
 - Experience validating Generative AI quality, hallucinations, grounding and guardrails. 
 - Salesforce SOQL/reporting, Amazon Connect metrics, Contact Lens and CloudWatch experience. 
 - Multi-language IVR/chat testing. 
 - Experience with Genesys, Cisco, Avaya, Twilio or other contact center platforms. 

What You'll Bring

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a quality engineering mindset. 
 - Ability to work independently in complex, multi-vendor consulting environments. 
 - Strong communication and stakeholder management skills. 
 - Ability to identify gaps in requirements, test data, integrations and E2E business processes. 
 - Ability to clearly communicate quality risks and provide data-driven release readiness recommendations. 

Equal Employment Opportunity Statement

All employment decisions shall be made without regard to age, race, creed, color, religion, sex, national origin, ancestry, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, citizenship status or any other basis as protected by federal, state, or local law. 

What's it like to be a part of NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture?

- Remote & In-Person: Whether you work out of our HQ in Massachusetts, one of our regional hubs, or you're one of over half of our NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture Family who work remotely, we're focused on keeping everyone connected and unified as one team. 
 - Travel: Get ready to pack your bags and hit the road! For certain roles, travel is an exciting part of the job, with an anticipated travel commitment of up to 25%. So, if you have a passion for adventure and don't mind a little jet-setting, this opportunity could be your ticket to exploring new places while making a positive impact on clients. 
 - Flexibility: Do you have to take the dog to the vet, pick up the kids from school, or the in-laws from the airport? We know that a perfect 9-5 isn't possible. So you have to jump out to do any of those, no problem! We build a culture of trust and understanding. We value good work not the hours in which you get it done
 - Collaboration: You have a voice here! If you work with a team of smart people like we do, it's a no-brainer to take suggestions and feedback on how to keep NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture thriving. Our executive team holds town halls & company meetings where they address any suggestions or questions asked, no matter how big or small. 
 - Celebrate Often: We take our work seriously, but we don't take ourselves too seriously. Whether it is an arm wrestling contest, costume party, or ugly holiday sweaters our teams love to have fun. And while we work hard, we don't forget to slow down and celebrate the big things and the small things together.

data.description:

Key responsibilities

- Own the design and build of complex features and microservices in NestJS. 
 - Produce low-level and high-level designs that apply SOLID principles and suitable design patterns. 
 - Design event-driven flows on Kafka: topics, partitioning, consumer groups, retries and dead-letter queues. 
 - Build and maintain change data capture pipelines with Debezium from MySQL / MongoDB into Kafka. 
 - Design caching strategies with Redis (cache invalidation, distributed locks, rate limiting). Model data across MySQL and MongoDB and tune queries and indexes for scale. Contribute to Vue 3 frontend architecture where needed. 
 - Lead code reviews, set coding standards, and mentor junior engineers. Own production quality: monitoring, incident root-cause analysis and fixes. 

Must-Have Skills

- 5+ years of backend development, with 3+ years in Node. js and TypeScript. 
 - Strong NestJS experience: modules, dependency injection, guards, interceptors, microservices. 
 - Deep understanding of SOLID, design patterns and clean architecture. 
 - Advanced MySQL (query optimisation, transactions, locking) and MongoDB (aggregation, schema design). 
 - Production experience with Kafka and Redis. 
 - Experience designing distributed systems: idempotency, eventual consistency, fault tolerance. 
 - Strong testing discipline: unit, integration and contract tests

Why Join Us

- Opportunity to modernize a large-scale enterprise Retail ERP platform. 
 - Work on cloud-native, event-driven, and distributed systems. 
 - Solve challenging scalability and performance problems. 
 - Collaborate with experienced architects and product engineering teams. 
 - Play a key role in shaping the technical direction of a mission-critical product. 

Benefits

We like to think that talent grows at Ginesys and stays at Ginesys. To ensure this, we provide our employees with the best working environment, the latest technology and continuous support. We go out of our way to retain the small business feeling with which we started and stimulate innovation and collaboration through teamwork and our non-hierarchical approach. We offer competitive salary, and other fantastic perks and benefits, such as:

Comprehensive health insurance coverage

Excellent rewards and recognition policy

Transparent compensation policy with no unnecessary deduction in CTC

Annual company off-site and a variety of events, celebrations throughout the year

Quarterly Coffee with CEO and more!

Here's our story; now tell us yours

It is the largest Indian company in the retail tech industry catering to both online and offline needs. 1200 + brands including (Manyavar, V-Mart, Skechers) are accelerating their businesses with Ginesys. With a team of 400+ employees, Ginesys One plans to revolutionize retail by being a single-stop cloud-based retail suite. 

We have a pan India presence with offices in major cities including Gurgaon, Kolkata, Bangalore, Hyderabad, Mumbai, Coimbatore & Goa and are expanding rapidly. We love the challenges of retail and are busy solving them to create a great retail tech suite. 

Ginesys core mission is to continue to build world-class internal service capabilities, in a bid to deliver outstanding external service value to customers. About Position

We are seeking a highly motivated Performance Test Engineer with strong expertise in Performance Testing, Performance Engineering, SQL, and AI-assisted testing tools. The ideal candidate will be responsible for validating scalability, reliability, responsiveness, and stability of enterprise applications through comprehensive performance testing and analysis. This role requires hands-on experience with LoadRunner, performance monitoring tools, SQL-based validation, and modern AI-powered development tools such as Cursor AI. The successful candidate will work closely with development, architecture, QA, DevOps, and infrastructure teams to identify performance bottlenecks and ensure optimal application performance. 

- Role: Core Performance Test Engineer
 - Location: Pune
 - Experience: 3 to 6 Years
 - Job Type: Full-Time Employment

What You'll Do

- Design, develop, execute, and maintain performance test scripts and scenarios. 
 - Conduct load testing, stress testing, endurance testing, scalability testing, and volume testing. 
 - Analyze application behavior under varying workloads and user traffic conditions. 
 - Perform end-to-end performance validation for web applications, APIs, microservices, and distributed systems. 
 - Evaluate system performance against predefined benchmarks and service-level objectives. 
 - Conduct capacity planning assessments and provide recommendations for infrastructure optimization. 
 - Analyze application logs, system metrics, and resource utilization data. 
 - Identify performance bottlenecks and perform detailed root cause analysis. 
 - Work closely with development and infrastructure teams to resolve performance-related issues.

The mission of WWRR&S is to eliminate defects that cause returns (Zero defects), deliver Zero cost of returns for Amazon, send Zero product waste to landfill, and deliver on Amazon's commitment to deliver on the Climate Pledge (Net Zero Carbon) - "the 4 Zeros". We do this by developing groundbreaking products and driving unparalleled operational excellence to help customers keep what they buy, recover returned and damaged product value, keep thousands of tons of waste from landfills, and create the best customer returns experience in the world. data.description:
Description

Amazon's Last Mile Technology team brings new technology to the hardest problems in last mile delivery. We want a top-in-class experience, not only for the customer receiving a package but also for the transporters who deliver millions of them every day. Real innovation in this space is part of who we are. 

How Amazon speaks to its transporters is one of the most critical systems in Last Mile. The Rabbit Communications Platform owns every surface Amazon uses to reach a Delivery Partner, Delivery Associate or Flex driver: Newsfeed, push notifications, in-app messaging, automated calls and automated customer contact. It runs on Android, iOS and wearables, worldwide. When a severe-weather shelter-in-place directive has to reach a driver in their own language, or a customer's gate code needs to travel from one delivery to the next, those journeys run on what we build. And for the driver, every one of them ends on the phone in their hand. 

We are looking for talented Android and iOS Software Development Engineers to design and build the client side of these mission-critical systems. You will work on hard problems at fleet scale, on devices that are moving, often offline and running low on battery, and you will have the autonomy to deliver impactful solutions. You will develop and operate tier-1 communication surfaces in native Android (Kotlin) and iOS (Swift). 

You will learn how to build server-driven, self-service client surfaces that take app releases off the critical path for communications. You'll design driver-safe interaction patterns for people who are behind the wheel or walking to a door. You'll engineer offline-first sync and message delivery across 1-to-N broadcast and 1-to-1 push. You'll internationalize and localize an app that runs in dozens of languages, including right-to-left scripts, across global markets. You'll extend these experiences to wearables. And you'll hold the crash-free rate, startup latency, battery, data-usage and accessibility standards that a Tier-1 app must meet on a wide range of devices, while the team that builds it also runs it. 

It's always Day 1 at Amazon. Are you up for the challenge?

Key job responsibilities

As a key member of the Last Mile Delivery Technology team you will be an innovator, playing a direct role in shaping and building products that partner teams rely on and customers love on top of Amazon's technology. You will be part of a strong team in a fast-paced, start-up like environment where agile development is embraced, innovation is encouraged, large-scale projects are the norm, and work-life balance is a top priority. We aim to work smarter, not harder, and regularly iterate to maintain and improve work-life balance. As an SDE-II at Amazon, you will have the opportunity to positively impact millions of customers by identifying opportunities, designing solutions, collaborating with world-class engineers and delivering large, impactful, end-to-end projects and improvements. 

Basic Qualifications

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
 - 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
 - 3+ years of Video Games Industry (supporting title Development, Release, or Live Ops) experience
 - Experience programming with at least one software programming language

Preferred Qualifications

data.description:
Description

This organization operates within the dynamic retail sector, specializing in consumer-facing products and services. It leverages advanced digital platforms to deliver seamless e-commerce experiences to a broad customer base. The company focuses on integrating innovative technologies to enhance customer engagement and streamline online purchasing journeys. Its market position is defined by a commitment to quality offerings and a robust digital infrastructure that supports scalable operations. The enterprise continuously evolves its technological capabilities to meet changing consumer demands and maintain a competitive edge in the digital marketplace. 

Requirements

We are seeking an experienced and highly skilled Hands-on eCommerce Solution Architect to lead the architecture, design, development, and implementation of enterprise Retail and eCommerce solutions. 

The candidate must have 15+ years of overall IT experience, including at least 12+ years of hands-on eCommerce technology experience, with proven experience delivering production projects on Shopify and at least one additional eCommerce platform, such as VTEX, Salesforce Commerce Cloud, Adobe Commerce (Magento), commercetools, or SAP Commerce Cloud. 

The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in eCommerce architecture, headless commerce, API-led integrations, and retail ecosystem systems, including Payment Gateways, OMS, ERP, PIM, WMS, Loyalty, and CRM. This role requires a hands-on technical leader who can drive architecture decisions, develop proof of concepts, review implementations, mentor engineering teams, and ensure scalable, secure, and reliable solutions across the full software development lifecycle. 

Required Skills: 

- Demonstrated expert-level proficiency and extensive hands-on experience with Shopify Plus, including deep knowledge of Liquid templating language and platform customization capabilities. 
 - Mandatory expertise in the retail and e-commerce domain, with a proven track record of architecting and delivering successful digital commerce solutions. 
 - Exceptional communication skills, both written and verbal, are essential for articulating complex architectural concepts to diverse technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Advanced understanding and practical application of Clean Architecture and Layered Architectures principles in designing robust and maintainable software systems. 
 - Strong advanced knowledge of database design, optimization, and management, ensuring high performance and scalability for critical e-commerce data. 
 - Proven advanced capability in solution architecture, including the ability to translate business requirements into comprehensive technical designs and system blueprints. 
 - Advanced proficiency in HTML, with a strong ability to develop and optimize front-end structures for responsive and user-friendly e-commerce interfaces. 
 - Advanced expertise in JavaScript, including modern frameworks and libraries, for building dynamic and interactive web applications within the e-commerce ecosystem. 
 - Advanced experience with CRM systems, demonstrating the ability to integrate and leverage customer relationship management platforms to enhance business processes. 

Preferred Skills: 

Job responsibilities

Lead the architecture, design, and implementation of scalable, secure, and high-performance Retail and eCommerce solutions. 

Translate business requirements into robust, maintainable solution architectures aligned with business objectives. 

Define architecture standards, design principles, integration patterns, and technology guidelines. 

Create High-Level Designs (HLD), Low-Level Designs (LLD), solution architecture diagrams, API specifications, and integration documentation. 

Design commerce solutions using Shopify and at least one additional enterprise eCommerce platform. 

Evaluate native platform capabilities, third-party applications, extensions, and custom development requirements. 

Design headless, composable, and omnichannel commerce architectures where appropriate. 

Lead platform replatforming, modernization, migration, and phased implementation initiatives. 

Define non-functional requirements covering performance, scalability, availability, security, and operational resilience. 

eCommerce Platform Expertise

Demonstrate hands-on implementation and architecture experience with Shopify, including Shopify Plus where applicable. 

Design and implement Shopify integrations using Admin GraphQL APIs, Storefront API, REST APIs where applicable, webhooks, metafields, metaobjects, themes, app extensions, and Shopify Markets. 

Have substantial implementation experience with at least one additional eCommerce platform, such as VTEX, Salesforce Commerce Cloud, Adobe Commerce (Magento), commercetools, or SAP Commerce Cloud. 

Understand platform-specific capabilities, extensibility models, APIs, integration patterns, and architectural trade-offs. 

Lead technical assessments and recommend appropriate platform capabilities, native integrations, third-party applications, or custom solutions. 

Drive implementation strategies for multi-brand, multi-market, multi-currency, and omnichannel commerce solutions. 

Development & Integration Architecture

Remain hands-on by developing proof of concepts, validating architectural approaches, and contributing to complex technical implementations. 

Design and implement API-led integrations using GraphQL, REST, webhooks, and event-driven communication patterns. 

Architect middleware, Backend-for-Frontend (BFF), microservices, and integration orchestration layers using Node. js, . NET, Java, or equivalent technologies. 

Design secure, scalable integrations between eCommerce platforms and enterprise retail systems, including: 

Payment Gateways: Payment authorization, capture, refunds, tokenization, fraud prevention, split payments, and PCI DSS considerations. 

Order Management Systems (OMS): Order orchestration, status synchronization, order allocation, cancellations, returns, refunds, and fulfillment. 

Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP): Product, pricing, order, inventory, financial, and fulfillment data synchronization. 

Product Information Management (PIM) and Digital Asset Management (DAM): Product catalog, attributes, taxonomy, media assets, localization, and enrichment. 

Warehouse Management Systems (WMS) and Inventory Systems: Stock synchronization, reservations, availability, fulfillment, and multi-location inventory. 

Loyalty and CRM Platforms: Customer profiles, membership, points, rewards, promotions, subscriptions, and customer engagement. 

CDP and MarTech Platforms: Customer data, consent, segmentation, personalization, marketing automation, analytics, and event tracking. 

Tax, Shipping, Search, and Marketplace Systems: Tax calculation, carrier integrations, delivery estimates, product feeds, marketplace orders, and search capabilities. 

Define integration contracts, data mappings, transformation rules, error handling, retry mechanisms, idempotency, reconciliation, and rate-limiting strategies. 

Ensure reliable data synchronization across products, prices, inventory, customers, orders, payments, and fulfillment systems. 

Drive code quality through architecture reviews, code reviews, technical coaching, and implementation guidance. 

Troubleshoot complex production issues and provide architectural recommendations for reliability, performance, and scalability improvements. 

Mentorship & Team Collaboration

Mentor Solution Architects, Technical Leads, and Software Engineers across multiple delivery teams. 

Collaborate with Product Managers, Business Analysts, UX/UI, QA, DevOps, Security, Infrastructure, and business stakeholders. 

Lead architecture reviews, design workshops, technical discussions, and proof-of-concept development. 

Establish reusable architecture patterns, integration frameworks, reference implementations, and engineering standards. 

Guide teams in implementing modern software engineering practices, automated testing, CI/CD, and secure development. 

Collaborate with clients and third-party vendors to resolve integration dependencies and align technical implementation with business objectives. 

Support technical presales, solution estimation, architecture assessments, and proposal development where required. 

Scalability, Security & Performance

Design highly available, scalable, resilient, and secure eCommerce architectures. 

Define performance and scalability strategies for storefronts, commerce APIs, middleware, and downstream integrations. 

Establish observability strategies covering logging, metrics, distributed tracing, monitoring, alerting, and operational dashboards. 

Define security practices for authentication, authorization, encryption, secrets management, API protection, and secure integrations. 

Understand payment security, tokenization boundaries, and PCI DSS implications. 

Define and validate non-functional requirements, including latency, throughput, availability, disaster recovery, and platform API rate limits. 

Drive technical debt reduction, architecture modernization, operational optimization, and continuous improvement. 

What we offer

Exciting Projects: We focus on industries like High-Tech, communication, media, healthcare, retail and telecom. Our customer list is full of fantastic global brands and leaders who love what we build for them. 

Collaborative Environment: You Can expand your skills by collaborating with a diverse team of highly talented people in an open, laidback environment - or even abroad in one of our global centers or client facilities!

Work-Life Balance: GlobalLogic prioritizes work-life balance, which is why we offer flexible work schedules, opportunities to work from home, and paid time off and holidays. 

Professional Development: Our dedicated Learning & Development team regularly organizes Communication skills training(GL Vantage, Toast Master), Stress Management program, professional certifications, and technical and soft skill trainings. 

Excellent Benefits: We provide our employees with competitive salaries, family medical insurance, Group Term Life Insurance, Group Personal Accident Insurance , NPS(National Pension Scheme ), Periodic health awareness program, extended maternity leave, annual performance bonuses, and referral bonuses. 

Fun Perks: We want you to love where you work, which is why we host sports events, cultural activities, offer food on subsidies rates, Corporate parties. Our vibrant offices also include dedicated GL Zones, rooftop decks and GL Club where you can drink coffee or tea with your colleagues over a game of table and offer discounts for popular stores and restaurants!

About GlobalLogic

GlobalLogic, a Hitachi Group Company, is a trusted digital engineering partner to the world's largest and most forward-thinking companies. Since 2000, we've been at the forefront of the digital revolution - helping create some of the most innovative and widely used digital products and experiences. Today we continue to collaborate with clients in transforming businesses and redefining industries through intelligent products, platforms, and services.

About Us

We're rebuilding vertical software with AI - from the inside. 

Embrace owns the software running inside 16% of the Fortune 500, 45+ state agencies, and 450+ banks and credit unions. We acquire entrenched vertical software businesses and rebuild them around AI - products, operations, go-to-market, all of it. Our Venture Lab launches new AI-native products into those same markets, using the distribution and customer relationships our portfolio already owns. 

You'll ship AI into production against real workflows, real customers, and a P&L you can see move within a quarter. 

We hire people who want scope, speed, and ownership, and who are tired of working on AI that never reaches a customer. If you want to spend the next five years shipping into software that already runs the economy, talk to us. 

Job Description

This is a remote position. 

About Embrace Finance Group

Embrace Finance Group, the financial-services division of Embrace Software Inc. , helps every institution - from regional banks to local credit unions - deliver the speed, intelligence and experience customers now expect in a digital world. Today we serve nearly 450 financial institutions and hundreds of local government agencies. 

We are building an AI-led unified financial services platform spanning digital banking, document automation, item processing and branch modernization, engineered in partnership with the Embrace AI Group. The next generation of our online banking solution is a cornerstone of that platform - and this role will lead it. 

The Role

We are hiring a Lead Engineer/ Architect (. NET), a hands-on technical leader who will accelerate the build-out of the next generation of our online banking platform for US Banks and credit unions on ASP. NET Core and C#. You will spend a significant portion of your time writing production code and owning architecture, while also mentoring engineers and setting the technical bar. 

You will partner day-to-day with Finance Group technology leaders on product and delivery, the Embrace Technology group on shared architecture, cloud and DevOps standards and Venture Labs / the Embrace AI Group to bring emerging capabilities into the platform. 

At its core this is a forward-deployed engineering (FDE) practice with an AI-first, new-product mandate. You will embed with financial institutions and internal product partners, turn ambiguous problems into shipped product and lead a small team of highly empowered, highly skilled engineers who take ideas from conceptualization to launch in weeks - not quarters. You will go full-stack from modern UX/UI through public REST APIs down to a . NET control plane and treat large language models and agentic AI services as first-class building blocks of the platform rather than bolt-ons. 

Key Responsibilities

- Architect and hands-on build the new ASP. NET Core / C# online banking platform - system design, service boundaries, data modeling and API contracts. 
 - Design and implement critical features and platform components; lead code and design reviews, setting the technical bar. 
 - Lead and mentor a small agile team - run sprints, unblock engineers, own delivery commitments, coach through 1: 1s and pair programming. 
 - Partner with Finance Group technology leaders, product, QA and security to translate business and regulatory needs into robust solutions. 
 - Collaborate with the Embrace Technology group on shared architecture, cloud and CI/CD standards and with Venture Labs / Embrace AI Group to embed AI capabilities (AI-assisted dev, predictive insights, fraud/risk monitoring) into the platform. 
 - Drive engineering best practices - testing, CI/CD and adoption of modern AI dev tools. 
 - Operate as a forward-deployed engineer - embed with internal product partners to co-design solutions, then rapidly conceptualize, prototype and launch new products, compressing concept-to-production from quarters to weeks. 
 - Lead AI-first, new-product development end-to-end - design and ship LLM- and agent-powered capabilities using services such as Google Vertex AI / Gemini, OpenAI (and Azure OpenAI) and orchestration frameworks like LangChain, with disciplined evaluation, guardrails and cost / latency management. 
 - Build full-stack and real-time - modern, accessible UX/UI, public REST APIs and live experiences via SignalR on . NET Core / C# control plane, with event-driven services through Azure Service Bus / messaging, etc. 
 - Own the cloud and delivery foundation - infrastructure-as-code with Terraform, CI/CD on GitHub (Actions) and containerized, repeatable deployments across Azure and/or AWS. 
 - Engineer security and compliance in by design - identity and access management (OAuth2 / OIDC, SSO, MFA), secrets management and data protection aligned to PCI DSS, SOC 2 and FFIEC, with auditability from day one. 
 - Build and empower the team - recruit, coach and unblock a small squad of progressive FDEs, giving them the autonomy, tooling and technical bar to ship safely and fast. 

How We Work - Forward-Deployed & AI-First

- Small, empowered squads: highly skilled FDEs own outcomes end-to-end, from conceptualization to launch, with minimal hand-offs. 
 - AI-first by default: LLMs, RAG and agentic workflows are first-class both as design tools and as product capabilities - we prototype with AI, evaluate rigorously and ship. 
 - Fast and safe: short iteration loops, trunk-based development, automated testing, infrastructure-as-code and progressive delivery behind feature flags. 
 - Polyglot pragmatism: . NET / C# anchors the control plane; we use the best-fit language or service elsewhere and optimize for outcomes, not dogma. 

Our Stack & Tooling

- Control plane & services: . NET (ASP. NET Core, C#), public REST APIs, SignalR for real-time, Azure Service Bus for messaging and eventing. 
 - AI & LLM: Google Vertex AI / Gemini, OpenAI / Azure OpenAI, LangChain and similar orchestration; vector stores, RAG, plus evaluation and guardrail tooling. 
 - Cloud & platform: Azure and/or AWS, Terraform for IaC, GitHub + GitHub Actions for CI/CD and containers. 
 - Front-end: modern, accessible UX/UI (Angular / React). 
 - Identity, security & compliance: IAM (OAuth2 / OIDC, SSO, MFA), secrets management, PCI DSS, SOC 2 and FFIEC. 
 - Data: Microsoft SQL Server today, with modern data stores adopted as the platform evolves. 

Requirements

- 5+ years building modern, data-intensive . NET web applications, with a proven tech-lead / lead-developer track record and direct team ownership. 
 - Polyglot. Expert-level C# and . NET (Framework and modern . NET / Core); strong SQL and Microsoft SQL Server; solid REST API experience at scale. 
 - Proven experience in financial services / online banking, with strong preference for platforms serving US Banks, credit unions, or other regulated FIs. 
 - Front-end experience with modern Javascript/UI frameworks like Angular / React. Familiarity with classic frameworks like ASP. NET, Razor templates, Htmx, Bootstrap, Orchard Core, etc is a strong plus for modernizing. 
 - Experience with cloud (Azure, AWS), DevOps and CI/CD; understanding of US banking security and compliance (PCI DSS, SOC 2, FFIEC guidance). 
 - Strong communicator across engineering and business stakeholders (Finance Group, Embrace Technology, Venture Labs); excellent ownership and problem-solving. 
 - Comfortable in a highly remote, fast-paced, agile environment. Bachelor's in CS, Software Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience). 
 - Demonstrated 0→1 product delivery at speed - ideally in a forward-deployed, customer-embedded, or startup / venture environment. 
 - Hands-on AI/LLM application development - prompt and context engineering, RAG and agentic patterns on at least one major platform (Vertex AI / Gemini, OpenAI, or Azure OpenAI) with orchestration such as LangChain and a pragmatic grasp of evaluation, guardrails and cost. 
 - Real-time and event-driven experience - SignalR, Azure Service Bus or equivalent messaging - and public REST API design at scale. 
 - Strong platform / DevOps depth - Terraform (IaC), GitHub Actions CI/CD, containerization and multi-cloud (Azure and/or AWS). 
 - Identity, security and compliance depth for regulated FIs - IAM / OAuth2 / OIDC, SSO / MFA, secrets management and PCI DSS / SOC 2 / FFIEC. 

Benefits

- Competitive salary commensurate with experience; 100% remote with autonomy. 
 - Career advancement across the Embrace portfolio; the chance to shape a platform used by hundreds of US banks and credit unions with the Embrace AI Group and Venture Labs. 
 - A high-autonomy, AI-first engineering culture where small teams of empowered FDEs take ideas from concept to launch - and see them used by hundreds of US banks and credit unions.

We are looking for an SDET with strong hands-on experience in mobile test automation (Appium) combined with web, API, and backend testing. This is a hands-on automation role - you will be expected to build and maintain frameworks, not just run existing test suites. 

The primary focus is Android and iOS mobile automation using Appium with JavaScript or Python. Web automation using Playwright or Selenium is an equally important part of the role.

What We're Looking For:

data.title: Specialist Manager - Duty Officer -  Security Operations Centre
data.description:
Summary

Position Summary

Specialist Manager - Duty Officer

Do you have a sharp eye for detail and a passion for turning good work into great work? In the US India Deloitte Security Operations Center (DSOC) within the Deloitte Office of Security, we need a player-coach on our watch floor to ensure the quality and accuracy of our intelligence products. As a Duty Officer, you will manage and mentor a team of physical security Intelligence Analysts, serving as the final quality control checkpoint for the actionable information to keep Deloitte's people and assets safe. You will be a key part of an innovative team where precision and collaboration are paramount. 

Work you'll do

The Duty Officer will manage a team of Intelligence Analysts on a specific shift, acting as the primary editor of their work. You will lead service quality assurance for this team. The Duty Officer will also play a critical role in the shift handoff process by compiling, verifying, and signing off on intelligence reports, ensuring a seamless transfer of knowledge and situational awareness between shifts. 

- Manage daily responsibilities, tasking, and performance of Intelligence Analysts on an assigned shift 
 - Review, edit, and provide final quality control sign off for all intelligence products created by the team, including situation reports and daily summaries 
 - Ensure operational continuity between shifts by overseeing and signing off on all intelligence outputs and handoff documentation 
 - Act as a subject matter expert, providing guidance and on-the-job training to mentor and develop junior analysts 
 - Assist the Watch Commander to deliver high-priority alerts and messages during emerging events 
 - Perform hands-on intelligence analysis duties to support the team during peak operational tempos as needed 
 - Triage and validate incoming information and alerts, ensuring proper escalation according to established procedures 
 - Manage the development and refinement of analytical standards and reporting templates, and reinforce analytic tradecraft standards (structured analytic techniques, source evaluation, confidence language) through peer review 
 - Ensure all case details and analyst actions are accurately documented in the incident case management system 
 - Serve as an escalation point for analysts, providing initial guidance on complex or unusual incidents requiring analysis and documentation 
 - Monitor and provide analytical info to EP upon request for US and Client executives when traveling within India 
 - Lead mass communications, including bridge set-ups, in the absence of DSOC Comms Analyst; therefore, have proficiency in utilizing Emergency Notification Systems (ENS) to draft, target, and dispatch timely and accurate mass communications during critical incidents and operational disruptions 
 - Support the US India DSOC Leader with Watch Command duties in the absence of a Watch Commander 
 - Provide initial mitigation recommendations and maintain visibility of follow-up actions until handoff or closure 
 - Coordinate and facilitate shift-level training exercises and drills to validate readiness, ensure compliance with DSOC procedures, and identify areas for operational improvement

The team

The Office of Security team supports the protection of Deloitte people, workplaces, operations, and assets across US India offices. This team partners across physical security, security technology operations, resilience, crisis coordination, and business stakeholders to strengthen preparedness, response, and operational continuity

Location: Hyderabad

Shift Timings: Rotational shifts in 24/7 support

Qualifications

Required: 

- 9+ years of relevant experience in security operations, watch floor operations or intelligence analysis

A company building cloud-based energy-management software. It runs optimisation, simulation and evaluation for solar (photovoltaic) systems, battery storage and EV charging. - A Master's in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field, and 10+ years in software, including several years as a tech lead or architect.

Build and evolve scalable services, APIs, data pipelines, and analytical capabilities using modern engineering practices, cloud platforms, and data technologies such as AWS, Azure, Databricks, Spark/PySpark, and related frameworks.

Ideal Candidate Qualifications

8+ years of software engineering experience delivering scalable, high-performance, and reliable software in an agile environment. 

Strong hands-on experience designing and building distributed systems, microservices, RESTful APIs, and cloud-native applications. 

Strong experience with data-intensive applications and analytics platforms; experience with Databricks, Spark, or PySpark, ML is highly desirable. 

Proven expertise leading system architecture, high-level design, detailed design, and end-to-end technical delivery of complex software solutions. 

Experience driving technology modernization initiatives, including cloud adoption, platform transformation, and modernization of legacy applications. 

Hands-on experience with Java/Python, AWS and/or Azure, CI/CD, containerization, Kubernetes, observability, and modern software delivery practices. 

Demonstrated technical leadership as an individual contributor, influencing architecture decisions, driving technical strategy, and leading large cross-team initiatives. 

Ability to translate business and product requirements into scalable, secure, and maintainable technical solutions. 

Excellent collaboration and communication skills, with a proven ability to work effectively across engineering, product, architecture, data science, QA, and operations teams. 

Experience leading and coordinating technical initiatives across globally distributed teams spanning multiple regions and time zones. 

Passion for mentoring and developing engineers through technical guidance, design reviews, and knowledge sharing. 

Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to work through ambiguity, make sound technical decisions, and drive results through hands-on execution. 

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field; advanced degree is a plus. 

Mastercard is an equal opportunity employer that values diversity and inclusion. Applicants will be considered and treated without regard to gender, gender identity, race, color, ethnicity, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, veteran or disabled status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Operating Style

- Strong ownership mindset across the full infrastructure lifecycle

IMPACT & SCOPE

- Direct impact on core banking platforms used by Tier-1 global institutions

This role offers the autonomy, ownership, and technical depth of a startup, combined with the scale, stability, and long-term impact of FIS. data.title: Principal Site Reliability Engineer
data.description:
Job Description

Designs and architects infrastructure and service to ensure reliability and functionality. Forecasts demands and responds to capacity needs. Collaborates with software development teams to develop reliable and scalable infrastructures. Exercises judgment when performing data collection to maintain and optimize operations and reliability. Leverages advanced knowledge to perform incident response and/or maintenance tasks. Provides comprehensive health and performance reporting. Identifies and recommends opportunities for automation. Communicates comprehensive information about services and proactively anticipates and articulates the potential impact of changes. Provides comprehensive support for technology and documents incidents. Conducts advanced experiments with new tools and develops and maintains advanced knowledge of site reliability trends. 

Responsibilities

Mandatory

- 5+ years of hands-on experience across software development, site reliability engineering, monitoring, and automation, with demonstrated ownership of production platforms. 
 - Strong programming skills in Python and experience developing backend services, REST APIs, integrations, and event-driven workflows. 
 - Proven experience building monitoring and observability solutions that collect and analyze alerts, metrics, logs, and service context. 
 - Hands-on experience integrating AI/LLM capabilities into applications for incident analysis, contextual recommendations, and operational decision support. 
 - Ability to develop reusable agents that combine live monitoring data, historical incidents, and previous remediation actions to recommend next steps. 
 - Experience implementing alert correlation, deduplication, enrichment, and prioritization to reduce noise and improve incident detection. 
 - Strong experience developing automated remediation workflows with approval controls, execution validation, audit trails, and recovery safeguards. 
 - Experience integrating monitoring platforms with incident management systems, knowledge repositories, and notification or escalation services. 
 - Strong understanding of distributed systems, Linux, networking, databases, and application performance, with the ability to translate failure patterns into platform capabilities. 
 - Experience applying software engineering practices, including automated testing, code reviews, CI/CD, version control, and secure development. 
 - Ability to evaluate platform reliability and AI output quality, measure operational outcomes, and improve capabilities using engineer feedback. 
 - Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work with monitoring teams, service owners, and engineers to onboard services and define requirements. 

Good-to-Have

- Experience with agentic AI frameworks, tool calling, retrieval-augmented generation, and vector databases. 
 - Knowledge of anomaly detection, time-series analysis, and predictive techniques for identifying recurring alarm patterns. 
 - Experience building centralized notification services, automated escalation calls, and incident communication workflows. 
 - Familiarity with OCI, Kubernetes, and Infrastructure-as-Code tools such as Terraform or Ansible. 
 - Experience with observability platforms such as OCI Observability, Prometheus, Grafana or equivalent tools. 
 - Exposure to Oracle Database and Exadata monitoring, performance diagnostics, and remediation automation. 
 - Experience using AI coding assistants to improve operational scripts and validate proposed changes. 
 - Knowledge of SLOs, error budgets, and incident metrics such as detection time, recovery time, and recurrence rate. 

Key Responsibilities

Capacity Ingestion and Management: 

- Designs and architects infrastructure and/or service according to terms for reliability and functionality. 
 - Forecasts demands for infrastructure and responds to capacity needs, ensuring systems have sufficient resources to handle current and future workloads and identifying resource gaps. 
 - Collaborates with the software development team to develop infrastructures, ensuring features are reliable and scalable according to deployment requirements. 
 - Proactively identifies opportunities for prototyping and drives prototyping initiatives (e. g. , testing new applications or infrastructures, assisting in onboarding) to explore novel approaches. 

Incident and Service Lifecycle Management: 

- Exercises judgment when performing data collection, triage, technical analysis, and redirection to maintain and optimize operations and infrastructure reliability. 
 - Takes proactive steps to monitor services, maintain up-to-date knowledge of their performance, and document their condition. 
 - Leverages advanced knowledge to perform incident response, root cause analyses, and/or maintenance on assigned services (e. g. , software installs, version upgrades, security updates, backup and recovery). 
 - Provides comprehensive health and performance reporting and takes appropriate actions based on trends in data. 
 - May perform provisioning to support infrastructure, applications, and services. 
 - May experiment with new approaches for and performs decommissioning (e. g. , shutting down servers, removing data from databases) to remove objects that are no longer needed. 

Automation: 

- Identifies and recommends opportunities for automation and assesses potential benefits to enhance operational efficiency. 
 - Develops and implements design, automation tools, or scripts to provide solutions, gather metrics, monitor, analyze, mitigate, or remediate issues/defects within infrastructures. 
 - Conducts testing on moderately complex automations to ensure they perform tasks correctly and produce expected results. 

Technical Communication and Guidance: 

- Writes release notes and/or communicates comprehensive information about the scale, capacity, security, performance attributes, and requirements of services and technology with customers and immediate and related teams. 
 - Proactively anticipates and articulates the potential impact of infrastructure, feature, and tool changes, considering their impact across team operations. 
 - Serves as a resource to team members on what information to communicate and how to communicate. 

Troubleshooting and Resolution: 

- Provides comprehensive operational support for technology, serving as a key escalation point for incidents and moderately complex issues arising within Oracle services. 
 - Drives and actively participates in on-call shifts to address issues. 
 - Executes the resolution of technical issues spanning multiple services, applying advanced investigation and debugging techniques to achieve SLOs (service level objectives). 
 - Documents incidents according to reporting methods and performs root cause analyses, capturing essential information for analysis and future reference. 
 - Performs post-mortem procedures to prevent incident reoccurrence. 

Innovation and Improvement: 

- Conducts advanced experiments and evaluations of cutting-edge tools and technologies to optimize infrastructure performance and reliability, taking proactive steps to adhere to security standards. 
 - Identifies and seeks opportunities to execute improvements for performance bottlenecks and deployments, ensuring efficient resource usage, speed, and scalability. 
 - Develops and maintains advanced knowledge of site reliability trends, sharing valuable insights and information with senior team members, management, and beyond to promote innovative building, testing, deploying, and running services. 
 - Performs moderately complex analyses and provides clear data on production to drive business development decisions (e. g. , design changes). 

Core Responsibilities

Planning & Execution: 

- Manages and coordinates moderately complex tasks, monitoring timelines and deliverables to ensure timely completion and adherence to requirements for a moderately sized project or initiative. Efficiently delegates, monitors, and prioritizes work across multiple projects, providing technical oversight and adjusting plans to address shifts in resources or timelines. 

Collaboration & Partnership: 

- Collaborates across the organization to align on expectations and achieve shared objectives. Leverages understanding of business leaders, stakeholders, and/or customers to ensure proposed solutions meet their needs. Supports inclusivity by actively seeking and listening to diverse perspectives, ensuring others feel heard and respected. 

Problem Solving: 

- Identifies and addresses moderately complex issues by analyzing a wide range of data and/or information to identify solutions in accordance with standard practices. Proactively escalates unresolved or critical issues with a thorough assessment and suggests potential solutions. Reviews, contributes to, and documents problem solving strategies. 

Continuous Learning: 

- Pursues learning opportunities to expand knowledge and skills and/or tools in new areas and stays abreast of the latest industry trends and best practices. Proactively seeks and leverages ongoing feedback and training to improve skills. Coaches and mentors junior team members, fostering continuous learning and knowledge sharing within and across teams. 

Continuous Improvement: 

- Develops ideas, recommends updates, and/or collaborates on the implementation of process improvements to increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows across teams, and evaluates the impact on key stakeholders. Solicits feedback from others on ideas for alternative approaches and methods for continued improvement. 

Performance and Development: 

- Contributes to the talent development pipeline by participating in candidate interviews, assessing candidates, and providing hiring recommendations. 

About Us

Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives. 

True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That's why we're committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs. 

We're committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing accommodation-request_mb@oracle. com or by calling 1-888-404-2494 in the United States. 

Oracle is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans' status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Oracle will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law.

data.title: Senior Software Engineer
data.description:
About Crunchyroll

Founded by fans, Crunchyroll delivers the art and culture of anime to a passionate community. We super-serve over 100 million anime and manga fans across 200+ countries and territories, and help them connect with the stories and characters they crave. Whether that experience is online or in-person, streaming video, theatrical, games, merchandise, events and more, it's powered by the anime content we all love. 

Join our team, and help us shape the future of anime!

About The Role

We are hiring a Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer to join our India Operations and play a crucial role in our mission to establish a world-class data engineering team within the Center for Data and Insights (CDI). In this role, you'll play a key part in building a cutting-edge, real-time data platform, designed to deliver insights at scale and power data-driven decision-making across our organization. Responsibilities will include collaborating with the data team and working on both backend microservices & frontend interfaces, crafting solutions that ensure data is processed, analyzed, and visualized in real time. 

The ideal candidate will bring strong full-stack engineering expertise across modern frontend and backend technologies, with hands-on experience building scalable, secure, and cloud-native applications. You will leverage Java, Spring Boot, React, Next. js, TypeScript, Kubernetes, and modern DevOps practices to deliver high-quality solutions that enable data-driven decision making for our business partners. This role requires a proactive, self-driven engineer who thrives in a collaborative environment, takes ownership from design through production, and balances technical excellence with business impact. By joining the CDI team, you will play a key role in shaping the data product application, building intuitive user experiences, scalable APIs, and robust platform capabilities that empower teams worldwide with timely, actionable insights. If you are passionate about solving complex problems, delivering exceptional user experiences, and driving continuous improvement across the full technology stack, we'd love to hear from you. 

Core Areas of Responsibility

- Design, develop, and maintain end-to-end features across the product, spanning React/Next. js frontend applications and Java Spring Boot backend services. 
 - Build secure, scalable REST APIs using OpenAPI-first design principles and implement robust authentication and authorization using Okta OIDC, OAuth2, and JWT-based security. 
 - Develop intuitive, accessible, and localized user experiences, including dashboards, analytics, data tables, and visualizations, ensuring WCAG-compliant implementations. 
 - Collaborate closely with data engineers, product managers, UX designers, and stakeholders to deliver high-impact features and platform enhancements. 
 - Manage integrations with Databricks and other data platforms, optimizing API performance, database connectivity, and concurrent processing for large-scale analytics workloads. 
 - Implement comprehensive testing strategies across the stack, including unit, integration, API, and component testing, to ensure reliability and maintainability. 
 - Support cloud-native deployments using Kubernetes, Docker, GitHub Actions, and GitOps practices, while maintaining observability through Datadog and production monitoring tools. 
 - Drive engineering excellence through code reviews, architectural discussions, performance optimization, automation, and continuous improvement initiatives. 

About You

We get excited about candidates, like you, because. . . 

- 8+ years of experience building and delivering modern full-stack applications using Java and React-based technologies. 
 - Strong expertise in Java 21, Spring Boot, REST API design, and secure application development using OAuth2, OIDC, and JWT authentication. 
 - Hands-on experience with React, Next. js, TypeScript, and modern frontend frameworks, including state management, API integration, and component-driven development. 
 - Solid understanding of SQL-based data platforms and API-driven integrations, with experience optimizing application performance and scalability. 
 - Experience working with containerized and cloud-native environments, including Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud platforms such as GCP and/or AWS. 
 - Proven ability to write high-quality, maintainable code supported by automated testing frameworks and engineering best practices. 
 - Strong collaboration, communication, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment. 
 - Experience with Databricks, GitOps/Flux CD, observability platforms (Datadog), internationalization, or analytics applications is a plus. 
 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

About The Team

Center for Data and Insights (CDI) is a service oriented horizontal organization that is uniquely positioned within the company to be the trusted and unbiased source of timely data-based insights for Crunchyroll. Our vision is to inspire, support and guide our stakeholders to be data-aware and build the systems of intelligence to discover insights and act on them. We have built a highly functional organization that truly believes in being a responsive partner, with the utmost curiosity, unwavering accountability and the courage to lead with actions. 

Why you will love working at Crunchyroll

In addition to getting to work with fun, passionate and inspired colleagues, you will also enjoy the following benefits and perks: 

- Best-in class medical, dental, and vision private insurance healthcare coverage
 - Access to counseling & mental health sessions 24/7 through our Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
 - Free premium access to Crunchyroll
 - Professional Development
 - Company's Paid Parental Leave
 - up to 26 weeks for birthing parents
 - up to 12 weeks for non-birthing parents
 - Hybrid Work Schedule
 - Paid Time Off
 - Flex Time Off
 - 5 Yasumi Days
 - Half-Day Fridays during the summer
 - Winter Break

((select from the following job modalities for this role: ))

About Our Values

We want to be everything for someone rather than something for everyone and we do this by living and modeling our values in all that we do. We value

- Courage. We believe that when we overcome fear, we enable our best selves. 
 - Curiosity. We are curious, which is the gateway to empathy, inclusion, and understanding. 
 - Kaizen. We have a growth mindset committed to constant forward progress. 
 - Service. We serve our community with humility, enabling joy and belonging for others. 

Our commitment to diversity and inclusion

Our mission of helping people belong reflects our commitment to diversity & inclusion. It's just the way we do business. 

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at Crunchyroll. Pursuant to applicable law, we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. 

Crunchyroll, LLC is an independently operated joint venture between US-based Sony Pictures Entertainment, and Japan's Aniplex, a subsidiary of Sony Music Entertainment (Japan) Inc. , both subsidiaries of Tokyo-based Sony Group Corporation. 

Questions about Crunchyroll's hiring process? Please check out our Hiring FAQs: https: //help. crunchyroll. com/hc/en-us/articles/360040471712-Crunchyroll-Hiring-FAQs

Please refer to our Candidate Privacy Policy for more information about how we process your personal information, and your data protection rights: https: //tbcdn. talentbrew. com/company/22978/v1_0/docs/spe-jobs-privacy-policy-update-for-crpa-dec-21-22. pdf

Please beware of recent scams to online job seekers. Those applying to our job openings will only be contacted directly from @crunchyroll. com email account.

Job Description

Software Engineer

Location: Bangalore/Mumbai/Chennai

Department: Technology

Vacancy Type: Permanent

Job Shift: 12PM IST - 9PM IST

Mode: Hybrid

Experience Range: 3-5 years

We are looking for a skilled Full Stack Developer with 3-5 years of experience in building scalable web applications using . NET Core, ASP. NET Web API, Background Services, and React. js. The ideal candidate should also have hands-on experience with n8n for workflow automation and third-party integrations. The role involves developing high-performance backend services, responsive front-end applications, and automated workflows while collaborating with cross-functional teams. 

Key responsibilities: 

- Hands on experience in Dot Net, Dot Net Core, JavaScript, React JS, CSS3, HTML5, Entity Framework Core and LINQ. 
 - Hands on experience with C#, React. js (mandatory), NET Core, ASP. NET Core, Web API, developing background services/worker services. 
 - Hands-on experience with n8n workflow automation and API integrations. 
 - Strong experience of JavaScript (ES6+), HTML5, CSS3. 
 - Experience with React Hooks, Context API, and state management (Redux preferred), API integration and responsive UI development. 
 - Good understanding of REST API design and API security (JWT/OAuth). 
 - Solid understanding of underlying concepts such as Ajax, JSON, XML and HTTP. 
 - Knowledge of SQL Server, writing stored procedures, views and query optimization. 
 - Experience in unit testing, debugging and troubleshooting.

data.title: Jr. Quantum Product Engineer - AI and Data Science Engineer II
data.description:
Summary

Position Summary

Jr. Quantum Product Engineer, Product Engineering

Deloitte Consulting Products (USI)

About The Role

Innovation & Delivery Transformation, an organization within Deloitte Consulting, manages a portfolio of emerging-technology investments across multiple time horizons. Its mission is to accelerate the next generation of technology-driven Consulting offerings. 

Within this organization, the Quantum Computing team leads ecosystem, capability, and solution development to advance the impact of quantum technologies across industries and clients-and help establish Deloitte as a thought leader and firm of choice for transformative quantum technology. 

Deloitte is seeking a Junior Quantum Product Engineer to help build and scale its Quantum Computing offering. You'll work with quantum researchers, product engineers, data scientists, and solution teams to turn quantum algorithms, research code, and experimental prototypes into reliable software components for Deloitte products and client solutions. 

This early-career role is suited to a technically curious engineer eager to learn at the intersection of quantum computing, software engineering, and applied research. You'll help develop, test, document, and integrate quantum and quantum-inspired capabilities into applications, workflows, and cloud environments. 

Key Responsibilities

Ship as One Team

- Develop, test, and maintain quantum and quantum-inspired software components using Python and relevant software frameworks. 
 - Translate research code, algorithms, and prototypes into reusable, documented, and maintainable libraries, services, APIs, or application features. 
 - Implement and evaluate quantum circuits, data-encoding methods, feature maps, optimization approaches, simulations, and hybrid quantum-classical workflows. 
 - Support integration of quantum capabilities into enterprise applications, data pipelines, machine-learning workflows, APIs, and cloud environments. 
 - Apply software engineering practices, including version control, automated testing, documentation, code review, packaging, dependency management, and continuous integration. 

Clients & Go-to-Market

- Contribute to technical demonstrations, prototypes, client deliverables, internal showcases, and proposals that advance the Quantum Computing offering. 
 - Work with business stakeholders to understand requirements, investigate technical issues, and communicate findings and recommendations. 

Work Across the Network

- Collaborate with quantum researchers, product engineers, data scientists, and solution teams in a matrixed, cross-functional environment. 
 - Learn new technologies and contribute to the development of Deloitte's quantum capabilities and solutions. 

Reporting Relationships

Based in Hyderabad, this client-facing role reports to the Product & Engineering Manager (USI); the specific reporting line is listed as TBD in the source posting. Travel may be up to 5%, based on business needs and the clients and industries served. 

Qualifications

Required

- Location: Based in Hyderabad, India. 
 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related quantitative field, or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience. 
 - 2+ years of experience in software engineering, data science, research engineering, quantum computing, or a related technical field, including relevant internships, academic research, or project experience. 
 - Proficiency in Python, C++, SQL, CUDA, and familiarity with software development practices. 
 - Foundational understanding of quantum computing concepts, including quantum states, circuits, gates, measurement, noise, and hybrid quantum-classical workflows. 
 - Hands-on experience with at least one quantum computing or quantum-inspired framework, such as Qiskit, PennyLane, Cirq, or Quimb. 
 - Experience developing, testing, analyzing, or documenting technical prototypes, research implementations, or data-intensive workflows. 
 - Familiarity with Git-based development workflows, automated testing, code review, and package or dependency management. 
 - Ability to work with APIs, libraries, data pipelines, or cloud-based applications. 
 - Familiarity with at least one area of quantum or quantum-inspired computing, such as quantum machine learning, optimization, simulation, tensor networks, or data encoding. 
 - Strong analytical, problem-solving, written, and verbal communication skills. 
 - Ability to collaborate effectively in a matrixed, cross-functional team and learn new technologies quickly. 
 - Ability to travel up to 5%, based on business needs and the clients and industries served. 
 - Based in India, able to work virtually with US stakeholders on US-market direction and its nuances. 

Preferred

- Masters Degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related quantitative field, or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience. 
 - Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure. 
 - Experience refactoring research or proof-of-concept code into reusable software components. 
 - Familiarity with machine learning, data engineering, optimization, simulation, or operations research. 
 - Experience with tensor representations, tensor-network methods, or quantum simulation.
