data.title: Engineering Expert - Pod Lead
data.description:
About Turing: 

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world's leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L. 

Role Overview: 

We are seeking an experienced Lead AI Evaluation Engineer (Science, Engineering Simulation & Design) with proven technical leadership skills to spearhead the authoring, review, and validation of "model-breaking, " simulation-based engineering design problems. Operating across major disciplines-including Physics, Electrical, Mechanical, Control Systems, Aerospace, Systems, and Robotics-you will lead a team of subject-matter experts to create complex, multi-constraint tasks where AI agents must interpret requirements, navigate trade-offs, configure open-source simulation tools, diagnose failures, and iterate toward valid solutions. You will oversee benchmark quality standards, analyze agent execution logs, expose systemic reasoning gaps, and guide the development of automated, objective graders to elevate frontier model performance. 

Job Requirements: 

- Team Leadership & Pod Management: Lead, mentor, and manage a pod of engineering SMEs-assigning tasks, tracking sprint deliverables, resolving technical blockers, and ensuring alignment with project milestones. 

- Peer Review & Quality Calibration: Conduct rigorous technical reviews and calibration sessions on team submissions, enforcing strict standards for physical plausibility, rubric objectivity, and reproducibility across all benchmarks. 

- Model-Breaking Problem Design: Author original, self-contained engineering design tasks with competing constraints, explicit optimization targets, validated reference solutions, and objective autograders. 

- Environment & Simulation Integration: Build, run, and validate problem environments using open-source simulation tools and custom Python test benches. 

- Trajectory Analysis & Failure Mode Taxonomy: Evaluate coding agent outputs and execution logs across repeated trials to identify systemic failure modes (e. g. , misinterpreting simulator feedback, premature design convergence, physically impossible geometries). 

- Difficulty Calibration & Benchmark Refinement: Iteratively refine problem difficulty based on empirical model performance data without introducing ambiguity or missing information. 

- Cross-Functional Stakeholder Alignment: Serve as the primary technical point of contact for AI researchers and program leads, synthesizing failure insights and integrating high-rigor benchmarks into the model evaluation pipeline. 

Job Responsibilities: 

- Education & Expertise: PhD in Physics, Electrical, Mechanical, or Aerospace Engineering (or a closely related discipline), with 5+ years of hands-on engineering design experience. 

- Proven Leadership Experience: Prior experience leading engineering teams, technical pods, or peer-review workflows, with a strong track record of mentoring contributors, calibrating quality standards, and driving deadline-oriented execution. 

- Simulation Tooling: Proficiency with at least one domain-relevant open-source simulation package (e. g. , ngspice, PySpice, OpenFOAM, FEniCSx, CalculiX, python-control, CadQuery, build123d, OpenModelica, Cantera, Gmsh) combined with strong Python scripting skills. 

- AI Evaluation & Failure Diagnostics: Hands-on experience with modern LLMs/coding agents and evaluation concepts (pass@k, failure-mode analysis, nondeterministic behavior), with the ability to audit trajectory logs and isolate core reasoning or tool-use failures. 

- Evaluation & QA Background: Prior experience in AI evaluation, technical content review, quality assurance, or a related analytical leadership role. 

- Domain Rigor & Precision: Uncompromising attention to physical plausibility, unit consistency, boundary conditions, convergence criteria, and technical documentation. 

- Availability & Commitment: Must have weekend on-call availability (part-time engagement is acceptable for weekend coverage) alongside core weekday overlap. 

- Technical Infrastructure: Personal desktop/laptop equipped with a stable, high-speed internet connection in a remote setup. 

Target Domains: 

- Electrical Engineering
 - Mechanical Engineering
 - Aerospace Engineering
 - Physics

Engagement & Offer Details: 

- Commitment: Up to 40 hours per week, including 4 hours of daily overlap with PST. 
 - Engagement Type: Contractor, POD Lead
 - Engagement Length: Up to 12 weeks
 - Evaluation Process: Job Interest Form, Profile review, Technical Interview

data.description:
Job Description

Lead, manage, and coordinate QA/QC and QMS activities to support Mumbai facility repair operations. Oversee key quality functions, provide QA/QC operational support, deliver quality awareness and process training, and ensure the effective and sustainable implementation of the QMS in alignment with customer, industry, and NOV Global Quality/BPA/Standardization standards, as well as other applicable requirements. 

Collaborate closely with the Operations Team, Department Leads, and Process Owners to achieve product quality and on-time delivery objectives, while driving quality awareness, promotion, and continuous improvement initiatives across the organization. 

Responsibilities

Primary Responsibilities

- Lead and oversee daily QA/QC operations to ensure compliance with company, customer, and regulatory requirements. 
 - Review Work Orders and Sales Orders to develop Quality Plans (QP), Inspection & Test Plans (ITP), quality certificates, and data books. 
 - Plan and coordinate inspections and testing activities including receiving, in-process, and final inspections, documentation review, functional testing, and FAT witnessing at internal facilities and customer/supplier sites. 
 - Monitor inspection and testing processes to ensure adherence to applicable quality standards and procedures. 
 - Ensure proper documentation, traceability, and maintenance of quality records within the document management system. 
 - Manage NCRs, CARs/PARs, and customer feedback; lead root cause analysis (RCA), corrective action implementation, and timely closure. 
 - Lead internal quality audits (IQA), support BPA process audits, QMS certification audits, customer audits, and supplier audits as assigned. 
 - Review and update site-specific quality procedures to maintain compliance with Global Quality standards and QMS requirements. 
 - Prepare and present annual quality performance reports. 
 - Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance QA/QC effectiveness and optimize quality resources. 
 - Supervise, coach, and develop QA/QC personnel, including performance management and training. 
 - Ensure full compliance with company Quality and HSE policies. 
 - Perform other duties as assigned

Facility/Group Specific Responsibilities

- Plan and coordinate QC activities at the facility and customer-designated locations (e. g. , shipyards) to ensure project and contractual compliance. 
 - Maintain and support the site's QMS certification, ensuring effective implementation and continuous improvement of quality systems and documentation. 
 - Plan and coordinate QMS, BPA, technical, and surveillance audits with certification bodies, surveyors, customers, and Global Quality representatives. 
 - Prepare Quality Plans (QP) and Inspection & Test Plans (ITP), ensuring all drawings, engineering procedures, specifications, and SOPs align with the Repair SOW and customer requirements. 
 - Manage and document internal and external quality feedback (NCR, CAR/PAR, improvement actions), participate in root cause analysis (RCA), and ensure timely implementation and closure of corrective actions. 
 - Ensure timely issuance of quality certificates (e. g. , COC, SOF, COS) and data books in accordance with Repair WO/SO requirements. 
 - Review NDE, special process, and inspection/test reports (e. g. , coating/painting, welding, PWHT, NDE, calibration, testing) to ensure compliance with approved standards and procedures. 
 - Conduct supplier audits as assigned by SCM/SLM/SQM. 
 - Ensure all QA/QC documentation and reports are accurately recorded in DMS/Rig Office and Tracker systems, where applicable. 
 - Provide QC manhour and consumables estimates to support repair quotations. 
 - Raise purchase requisitions for quality-related materials and services through the ERP system. 
 - Safeguard QMS process and document integrity, ensuring timely follow-up with process owners and suppliers on quality matters requiring review, action, and closure (e. g. , risk assessments, MOC, procedures, CAR/PAR, RCA, reports). 

Qualifications

Qualification & Experience

- Bachelor's Degree with a minimum of 4 years' relevant experience; or Diploma with a minimum of 6 years' experience; or ITI certification with at least 8 years' experience. 
 - Prior experience in the Oil & Gas industry or engineering environment is preferred. 
 - Certified QMS Auditor or hands-on experience with API Q1 and/or ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems. 
 - Strong knowledge of applicable industry codes and standards. 
 - Good command of written and spoken English, with effective presentation skills. 
 - Demonstrated ability to lead and manage a team successfully. 
 - Proven experience in QA/QC operations and supervisory roles. 

Job Requirement

- Ability to sit or stand for extended periods in both climate-controlled and non-climate-controlled environments. 
 - Ability to lift and carry items weighing up to 25 lbs. 
 - Ability to wear required personal protective equipment (PPE), including hard hat, steel-toe boots, safety glasses, and hearing protection. 
 - Willingness and ability to travel as required for business needs. 

About Us

Every day, the oil and gas industry's best minds put more than 150 years of experience to work to help our customers achieve lasting success. 

We Power the Industry that Powers the World

Throughout every region in the world and across every area of drilling and production, our family of companies has provided the technical expertise, advanced equipment, and operational support necessary for success-now and in the future. 

Global Family

We are a global family of thousands of individuals, working as one team to create a lasting impact for ourselves, our customers, and the communities where we live and work. 

Purposeful Innovation

Through purposeful business innovation, product creation, and service delivery, we are driven to power the industry that powers the world better. 

Service Above All

This drives us to anticipate our customers' needs and work with them to deliver the finest products and services on time and on budget. 

About The Team

Corporate

Our family of companies is supported by our global Corporate teams, providing expert knowledge from functions including Human Resources, Information Technology, Compliance, Finance, QHSE, Marketing and Legal centers of expertise. We are structured to provide guidance and service above all to all our business operations.

 - Experience with Python, Robot Framework, or similar automation technologies and a strong understanding of test automation strategy. 
 - Experience with network traffic generation and validation solutions such as Ixia and Spirent. 
 - Experience with Juniper Junos/EVO platforms is highly desirable. 
 - Experience handling complex customer-facing technical engagements, escalations, and solution-validation programs. 
 - Strong understanding of test methodologies, automation architecture, defect management, RCA, and software release certification. 
 - Experience managing priorities and delivering multiple complex technical programs simultaneously.

data.title: Performance Engineer
data.description:
Job Description

Be part of something bigger. Decode the future. 

At Electrolux, as a leading global appliance company, we strive every day to shape living for the better for our consumers, our people and our planet. We share ideas and collaborate so that together, we can develop solutions that deliver enjoyable and sustainable living. 

Come join us as you are. We believe diverse perspectives make us stronger and more innovative. In our global community of people from 100+ countries, we listen to each other, actively contribute, and grow together. 

Join us in our exciting quest to build the future home. 

All About The Role

As Performance Engineer, you will report directly to the Platform Engineering and SRE Engineering Manager. 

The Performance Engineer will be part of our Cloud Native organization, will work closely with our Product teams in eCommerce, Digital Marketing and other Consumer solutions and be involved in the full Software Lifecycle. We already have a solid, modern Engineering foundation and want to continuously improve in a dynamic, iterative manner. 

You'll own how we prove that our consumer platforms perform at scale: from understanding how customers really use our systems, through designing realistic load and performance tests, to finding bottlenecks and seeing the fixes through. This is both a creative and a detail-oriented role in a very multicultural environment. We want you to be bursting with opinions and passionate about sharing, as well as executing them in a collaborative way. 

About The CDI Experience Organization

The Consumer Direct Interaction Experience Organization is a Digital Product Organization responsible for delivering tech solutions to our end-users and consumers across both pre-purchase and post-purchase journeys. We are organized in 15+ digital product areas, providing solutions ranging from Contact Center, E-commerce, Marketing, and Identity to AI. 

At CDI XO, Electrolux Group's Consumer Direct Interaction Organization, we are transforming everyday life through digital innovation. 

Our engineers help design and build solutions, big and small, to enable a range of highly connected Consumer Market solutions in a modern distributed landscape. Our new team members will be working at the cutting edge of Cloud Native technology and patterns. We strive to develop, build, deploy and run intelligently. 

What You'll Do

- Gather and analyse performance requirements and architectural dependencies with product teams, architects and business stakeholders. 
 - Build workload models from production evidence (observability data, gateway logs, real user monitoring) so that tests reflect how customers actually use our platforms. 
 - Design, develop, execute and monitor the full range of performance tests: load, stress, soak, spike and scalability, at both API and client side. 
 - Create and maintain performance testing frameworks, and integrate them into CI/CD pipelines so performance is checked continuously, not just before a release. 
 - Automate manual and repetitive performance testing activities, and treat test scripts, configuration and dashboards as code (no point and click). 
 - Analyse application, infrastructure and database performance issues, find complex bottlenecks, and drive tuning initiatives through to completion. 

Work across a stack that includes: 

- Observability platforms such as Datadog, Dynatrace, and Azure Monitor. 
 - Enterprise SaaS and PaaS systems in the eCommerce, Finance and Logistics arenas. 
 - Cloud-native architectures on Microsoft Azure, including Kubernetes and microservices. 
 - Build performance dashboards, prepare reports and give clear, evidence-based updates to technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Manage test environments and test data, and make the gaps between test and production environments visible. 
 - Work with SRE colleagues to tie performance targets to SLOs and SLIs, and use test results to protect Error Budgets. 
 - Identify risks and issues early, and give actionable recommendations. 
 - Collaborate with developers, architects, DevOps teams and business stakeholders to choose the right design solutions and make sure performance objectives are met. 
 - Mentor engineers in performance engineering practices, and stay current with tools and industry trends. 

But. . . the most important thing is that you are genuinely passionate about performance engineering and continuous improvement. 

Who Are You

- 5 to 8 years of experience in performance testing and engineering. 
 - 4+ years of hands-on experience with Apache JMeter. 
 - 2+ years of hands-on experience with BlazeMeter. 
 - Strong monitoring experience with Dynatrace and Datadog. 
 - Hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure. 
 - Proficiency in scripting with Java, Python and/or JavaScript. 
 - Strong experience automating performance testing, with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices. 
 - Good knowledge of SQL and databases such as PostgreSQL. 
 - Experience with client-side performance testing and performance monitoring dashboards. 
 - Proven ability to identify complex performance bottlenecks and give optimisation recommendations. 
 - Knowledge of Kubernetes, microservices and cloud-native architectures. 
 - Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments, including requirement gathering, stakeholder management and sprint-based delivery. 
 - Experience working with customers to understand deployment architectures and use cases. 
 - Strong analytical, troubleshooting and communication skills; self-driven, flexible and able to work independently in a fast-paced environment. 
 - Computer Science/Software Engineering related degree. 
 - Fluent English, written and spoken. 

Desirable Qualifications And Experience

- Knowledge of AWS. 
 - Heap dump and thread dump analysis. 
 - Experience with Git. 
 - Experience with SAP systems, particularly SAP Commerce Cloud. 
 - Strong understanding of Datadog RUM. 

Where you'll be

This is a full-time position, based in Bangalore, India. Immediate joiners are preferred. 

Benefits Highlights

- Flexible work hours and a hybrid work environment
 - Discounts on our award-winning Electrolux products and services
 - Family-friendly benefits
 - Extensive learning opportunities and a flexible career path

This role has been designed as 'Hybrid' with a requirement that you will work on average 2 days per week from an HPE office. 

Who We Are

Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today's complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what's next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE. 

Job Description

Validates customer-focused networking solutions through system-level testing, automation, and solution certification activities. Designs, develops, and executes test plans and automated test cases to accelerate validation cycles and ensure product quality, scalability, performance, and deployment readiness. Works closely with customers, engineering, and cross-functional teams to validate customer-specific use cases, identify product gaps, and improve overall system reliability across Service Provider and Cloud networking environments. 

Individual Contributor (IC)

Works independently on complex customer deployment and system validation projects that require strong expertise in Service Provider and Cloud networking technologies, system testing, and automation. Operates within established processes with moderate supervision while taking ownership of customer-specific test activities. Understands customer deployment architectures, develops and executes comprehensive test plans, generates customer-consumable test artifacts such as reports and logs, and certifies software releases for customer-specific deployment scenarios. Collaborates effectively with development, field engineering, and customer teams to ensure successful solution validation. 

What You'll Do

- Perform customer-focused testing, including feature, scale, migration, performance, and end-to-end solution validation. 
 - Analyze customer deployment architectures, network topologies, and technical requirements to develop comprehensive test strategies. 
 - Collaborate with Field Engineers, Sales Engineers, Customers, and Product Development teams to understand use cases and define test coverage requirements. 
 - Design, develop, and execute system-level and solution-level test plans. 
 - Build, configure, and maintain test lab environments that accurately represent customer deployments. 
 - Configure, test, and troubleshoot routers, switches, and networking devices running Junos/EVO operating systems. 
 - Develop and maintain test automation scripts using Python, Robot Framework, Perl, or similar technologies. 
 - Execute automated and manual test cases for feature validation, interoperability, performance, and scale testing. 
 - Analyze test results and identify functional, performance, scalability, and reliability issues. 
 - Perform root cause analysis (RCA) and work closely with software development teams to resolve product defects. 
 - Evaluate customer requirements and identify test coverage gaps, risks, and improvement opportunities. 
 - Utilize industry-standard traffic generation and validation tools such as Ixia and Spirent. 
 - Prepare and deliver test reports, technical documentation, status updates, and customer-facing presentations. 
 - Participate in customer design workshops and technical review meetings. 
 - Drive continuous improvement of testing methodologies, automation frameworks, and validation processes. 
 - Communicate testing status, risks, issues, and mitigation plans effectively to customers and internal stakeholders. 
 - Leverage AI-driven automation, AI agents, and emerging AI-powered testing tools to improve testing efficiency, accelerate test execution, increase test coverage, and enhance overall product quality and solution validation. 

What You Need To Bring

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Information Technology, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - Minimum 15+ years of experience in Networking Systems Engineering, System Testing, Solution Validation, or related fields. 
 - Experience working with Service Provider, Cloud, Core, or Edge networking environments. 
 - Hands-on experience with large-scale network deployments, system-level testing, and customer solution validation. 
 - Experience developing test automation solutions using Python and/or Robot Framework. 
 - Experience with network traffic generation and testing platforms such as Ixia and Spirent. 
 - Experience working in customer-facing technical roles is preferred. 
 - Prior experience with Juniper Junos/EVO platforms is highly desirable. 
 - Networking certifications such as JNCIP, JNCIE, CCNP, or equivalent are a plus. 
 - Strong knowledge of networking fundamentals and protocols, including TCP/IP, IPv4/IPv6, MPLS, BGP, OSPF, IS-IS, LDP, RSVP, L2VPN/L3VPN, VLAN, QoS, and related technologies. 
 - Hands-on experience in system testing, solution validation, test automation, and troubleshooting complex Service Provider and Cloud networking environments. 
 - Proficient in Python and automation frameworks, with working knowledge of network testing tools such as Ixia and Spirent. 
 - Demonstrated ability to analyze customer network architectures, perform root cause analysis, and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams. Strong communication, problem-solving, and customer engagement skills, with the ability to operate successfully in fast-paced and dynamic project environments. 
 - Familiarity with AI-driven automation, AI agents, and AI-powered testing tools, with the ability to leverage emerging technologies to improve test efficiency, coverage, defect detection, and overall solution quality. 

Accessibility

HPE is committed to creating an inclusive and accessible workplace and encourages applications from all qualified individuals, including those with disabilities. If you believe you require accommodation during any stage of the application or interview process, please submit your request by completing our secure form linked here. 

Note: This option is reserved for applicants needing assistance/reasonable accommodation related to a disability. 

What We Can Offer You

Health & Wellbeing

We strive to provide our team members and their loved ones with a comprehensive suite of benefits that supports their physical, financial and emotional wellbeing. 

Personal & Professional Development

We also invest in your career because the better you are, the better we all are. We have specific programs catered to helping you reach any career goals you have - whether you want to become a knowledge expert in your field or apply your skills to another division. 

Unconditional Inclusion

We are unconditionally inclusive in the way we work and celebrate individual uniqueness. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. 

Let's Stay Connected

Follow @HPECareers on Instagram to see the latest on people, culture and tech at HPE.

IND Staff Software Engineer - GCC011

We're determined to make a difference and are proud to be an insurance company that goes well beyond coverages and policies. Working here means having every opportunity to achieve your goals - and to help others accomplish theirs, too. Join our team as we help shape the future. 

Job Description: QA Automation Engineer

AI-First Quality Engineering & Test Automation

Location

Hyderabad, India

Employment Type

Full-Time

Experience Level

8+ Years

Organization

Claims & Operations IT, Customer Communications Solutions (CCS)

Role Focus

QA automation, Playwright, TypeScript/JavaScript, API automation, CI/CD quality gates, and AI-first quality engineering

AI Experience

Practical AI/LLM experience required. Google Vertex AI, Gemini, AWS AI services, Azure AI, OpenAI-based platforms, GitHub Copilot, or similar enterprise-approved tools accepted

Position Overview

We are seeking a skilled QA Automation Engineer to join our Enterprise Customer Communications Solutions team in Hyderabad, India. This role is ideal for a quality engineer who combines strong test automation fundamentals with an AI-first engineering mindset and practical experience using AI-enabled tools to improve test design, automation development, defect prevention, test intelligence, and release confidence. 

In this role, you will design, build, and maintain reliable automated tests across UI, API, integration, and end-to-end layers; embed quality checks into CI/CD pipelines; and partner closely with Engineering, Product, DevOps, and Architecture teams to prevent defects earlier in the SDLC. 

The ideal candidate has hands-on experience applying AI/LLM capabilities to quality engineering activities. Experience may include Google Vertex AI, Gemini, AWS AI services, Azure AI, OpenAI-based platforms, GitHub Copilot, agentic testing tools, or other enterprise-approved AI platforms. The candidate should be comfortable using AI to accelerate test case generation, automation development, test data strategy, failure triage, log analysis, defect clustering, documentation, and continuous improvement while following responsible AI and enterprise data protection practices. 

Mandatory AI-First QA Expectations

- Demonstrated AI-first mindset and practical AI/LLM experience applied to QA, test automation, or software engineering productivity. 
 - Ability to use approved AI tools responsibly to accelerate testing while validating AI-generated test cases, code, summaries, and recommendations. 
 - Experience may be with Google Vertex AI, Gemini, AWS AI services, Azure AI, OpenAI-based platforms, GitHub Copilot, or similar enterprise-approved AI platforms. 
 - Candidate should understand the difference between basic prompt usage and disciplined AI-assisted quality engineering. 

Key Responsibilities

Test Automation Development

- Develop and maintain automated test suites for critical business journeys, including smoke, regression, integration, end-to-end, and release readiness testing. 
 - Create maintainable UI automation using Playwright with TypeScript/JavaScript, including reusable fixtures, selectors, page abstractions, shared utilities, and scalable framework patterns. 
 - Build and enhance API automation, including request validation, response assertions, data setup/teardown, service-level validation, and basic contract testing where applicable. 
 - Partner with engineers to analyze test failures, triage defects, identify root causes, and prevent recurring regressions. 
 - Design automation that supports fast feedback, repeatability, maintainability, and high confidence in production releases. 

AI-First Quality Engineering

- Apply AI-assisted testing practices across the QA lifecycle, including test design, test case generation, automation scaffolding, script refactoring, documentation, defect analysis, test data analysis, and failure triage. 
 - Use approved AI/LLM platforms and tools to accelerate quality engineering outcomes while validating AI-generated outputs before use. 
 - Leverage AI capabilities to summarize logs, traces, screenshots, execution reports, and defect patterns to reduce manual analysis effort. 
 - Explore AI-driven approaches for flaky test detection, failure clustering, automated root cause suggestions, test coverage analysis, and release risk insights. 
 - Contribute to proofs of concept that improve test intelligence, automation resiliency, QA productivity, or release confidence. 
 - Follow responsible AI, security, privacy, and enterprise data-handling guidelines when using AI-enabled testing tools. 

Framework & CI/CD Integration

- Contribute to and continuously improve the Playwright automation framework, including structure, utilities, reporting, execution patterns, and coding standards. 
 - Implement scalable execution capabilities such as parallelization, environment orchestration, cross-browser coverage, and reliable test data management. 
 - Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines for pull request validation, scheduled regression runs, release validation, and quality gates. 
 - Improve automation reporting so engineering teams can quickly understand failures, trends, risks, and release readiness. 
 - Partner with DevOps to ensure automated tests are stable, observable, and aligned with deployment workflows. 

Quality Governance, Metrics & Release Confidence

- Define automation scope for critical business journeys and ensure appropriate coverage for new and changed features. 
 - Track and report quality metrics such as automation pass rate, stability, flakiness, defect leakage, failure patterns, and release readiness. 
 - Use AI-assisted analysis where appropriate to identify trends, recurring failures, quality risks, and improvement opportunities. 
 - Communicate test status, release risks, and quality recommendations to stakeholders in a clear and actionable manner. 
 - Support continuous improvement of QA practices, automation standards, and quality engineering maturity. 

Required Skills & Experience

- 8+ years of hands-on experience in test automation for web, API, and/or enterprise applications. 
 - Strong experience designing, building, and maintaining automation frameworks. 
 - Strong proficiency in TypeScript/JavaScript. 
 - Hands-on experience with Playwright or comparable modern UI automation frameworks. 
 - Experience building and maintaining API automation. 
 - Deep experience integrating automation into CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Practical experience using AI/LLM-based tools to improve QA or software engineering productivity. 
 - Demonstrated AI-first mindset, including the ability to identify where AI can improve test authoring, defect analysis, automation maintenance, test intelligence, and QA efficiency. 
 - Experience with at least one AI platform or AI-enabled engineering ecosystem, such as Google Vertex AI, Gemini, AWS AI services, Azure AI, OpenAI-based services, GitHub Copilot, or other approved enterprise AI platforms. 
 - Strong understanding of responsible AI usage, including validation of AI-generated outputs, protection of sensitive data, and adherence to enterprise governance standards. 
 - Experience making framework-level or architecture-level automation decisions in complex environments. 
 - Strong background in Agile, DevOps, continuous testing, and shift-left quality practices. 
 - Experience supporting cloud-native, microservices, API-driven, or distributed systems. 
 - Strong analytical, troubleshooting, communication, and collaboration skills. 
 - Ability to influence quality outcomes through pragmatic decision-making and partnership with engineering teams. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with Google Vertex AI, Gemini, AWS Bedrock, AWS SageMaker, Azure AI, OpenAI-based platforms, or similar enterprise AI services. 
 - Experience applying AI to test case generation, automation code generation, defect triage, log summarization, root cause analysis, or test coverage analysis. 
 - Familiarity with agent-based testing concepts, AI orchestration patterns, MCP, or similar integration approaches. 
 - Experience with test intelligence platforms, observability tools, analytics dashboards, or automated quality reporting. 
 - Experience in enterprise-scale or regulated environments. 
 - Prior experience driving quality transformation, automation modernization, or QA productivity improvement initiatives. 
 - Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure. 
 - Cloud, testing, automation, AI, or quality engineering certifications. 

Hiring Manager Screening Guidance

This role should target candidates who can clearly explain how they have used AI in real QA or engineering work. Strong candidates should be able to discuss how they used AI tools to accelerate test authoring or automation development, how they validated AI-generated test cases or code, how they used AI to summarize logs or failures, how they protected sensitive data, and how they integrated automated tests into CI/CD pipelines. 

A weaker candidate may only describe basic prompt usage or generic AI familiarity. A stronger candidate will demonstrate hands-on experience applying AI in the SDLC, especially in test automation, failure analysis, quality insights, and engineering productivity. 

Short Position Summary For Recruiters

We are looking for a QA Automation Engineer in Hyderabad with 8+ years of experience who has strong Playwright, TypeScript/JavaScript, API automation, and CI/CD experience, plus a demonstrated AI-first mindset. The candidate should have practical experience using AI/LLM tools or platforms such as Google Vertex AI, Gemini, AWS AI services, Azure AI, OpenAI-based platforms, GitHub Copilot, or similar tools to improve test automation, quality engineering, failure analysis, and software delivery productivity.

data.title: Software Engineer- Software Test Engineer – IOS XR | Python Automation | L0/L1 Optical Testing 8 - 10 years
data.description:
Meet the Team / Who You'll Work With

The Cisco IOS XR Routing Test Team ensures the reliability, scalability, performance, and resiliency of Cisco's carrier-grade routing platforms. We work closely with software developers, architects, product managers, and customer-facing teams to deliver comprehensive, end-to-end validation across platforms, Optics, Layer 0, Layer 1 optical, routing, subscriber-management, and network-service technologies for service providers, hyperscalers, Optical and web-scale customers operating some of the world's largest and most demanding networks. Exciting career opportunities open for enthusiastic and experienced Software professionals in India

Our team values technical depth, automation-first engineering, continuous learning, collaborative problem-solving, and responsible adoption of AI-assisted development practices. 

Your Impact

Cisco provides you an excellent opportunity to take your career aspirations forward. You will bring your unique talents to the group that works on Cisco's routing technology, which large enterprises now consider to be the transport medium of choice for critically important networks. In your role as a Software Test Engineer, you will own the quality validation of IOS XR routing - Platform infra, Optics, Layer 0, Layer 1 capabilities. You will design test strategies, develop automation, validate complex customer scenarios, investigate system-level failures, and provide data-driven release recommendations. 

Your work will help ensure that Cisco delivers stable, scalable, and production-ready networking solutions. You will also mentor junior engineers, improve test frameworks, and use modern AI-assisted tools to accelerate engineering and solving workflows. 

What You Will Do

- Design and implement functional, system, regression, scale, performance, interoperability, resiliency, and high-availability tests for IOS XR routing - Platform Infra/Optics, L0/L1 test features. 
 - Develop reusable and scalable test automation using Python and frameworks such as pyATS, Genie, or equivalent tools. 
 - Build and maintain physical, virtual, containerized, and cloud-based test environments using Linux, Docker, Kubernetes, clustering technologies, VMware, OpenStack, and network simulation platforms. 
 - Solve complex issues using IOS XR logs, protocol traces, packet captures, telemetry, RADIUS transactions, crash information, and system-resource data. 
 - Validate model-driven interfaces and telemetry using YANG, NETCONF, RESTCONF, gNMI, gRPC, OpenConfig, and native IOS XR models. 
 - Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines, code reviews, version control, and regression testing. 
 - Use approved AI coding assistants and engineering agents for test generation, automation development, log analysis, defect triage, and documentation. 
 - Apply foundational knowledge of generative AI, AI agents, MCPs, reusable AI skills, prompt and context management, and responsible validation of AI-generated output. 
 - Collaborate across engineering teams, review test designs and automation code, mentor junior engineers, and communicate product-quality risks and release readiness. 
 - Work on Network automation, algorithmic thinking and Analytics applications derived from customer use cases
 - Strong in Software engineering test methodology and process knowledge

Minimum Qualifications

- Bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Telecommunications, or a related technical field. 
 - Eight or more years of experience in software engineering, network product testing, test automation, or quality engineering. 
 - Experience configuring and solving Cisco IOS XR or another carrier-grade network operating system. 
 - Advanced Python programming skills for test automation, scripting, API interaction, data analysis, and troubleshooting. 
 - Experience developing system, scale, performance, resiliency, and high-availability test scenarios. 
 - Strong Linux or Unix skills and experience with Git, code reviews, debugging, and CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Working knowledge of cloud, containerization, virtualization, and clustering technologies, including Docker, Kubernetes, VMware, and OpenStack. 
 - Familiarity with AI coding assistants such as GitHub Copilot or equivalent tools. 
 - Basic understanding of generative AI, AI agents, MCP, reusable skills, and responsible AI practices. 
 - Strong knowledge of software development life cycle. 
 - Strong analytical, solving, communication, and multi-functional collaboration skills. 
 - Deep understanding of customer deployments, operations and the ability to translate brown field/green field deployments into test strategy with high efficacy
 - Quick learner with an open mind to "grey box" testing, bringing in strategic on-the-box, off-the-box views that reflect the state of IOS-XR systems. 
 - Experience in test engineering concepts and methodologies including test planning, test case design, test execution and test automation
 - Excellent experience in Layer-0, Layer-1 traffic generators and analysers (e. g. Viavi, Agilent, Spirent, IXIA, etc. )
 - Strong written, verbal communication, and interpersonal skills
 - Results oriented with a high degree of accountability, dedication and responsibility
 - Industry certification such as CCNA/CCNP/CCIE/JCNA/JCIE will be a huge plus

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience testing Optical and routing capabilities on Cisco IOS XR platforms such as Cisco 8000, ASR 9000, NCS 5500/5700 and NCS1K
 - Experience with traffic generators and subscriber-simulation tools such as IXIA or Spirent or Viavi or JDSU. 
 - Strong knowledge of Layer 0 , Layer 1 testing along with platform & optics test skills. 
 - Experience with Datapath, model-driven telemetry, and network programmability. 
 - Familiarity with scale and performance characterization. 

Expectations

The successful candidate will operate as an experienced individual contributor who can independently own a significant routing or BNG feature area, develop production-quality automation, lead complex technical investigations, identify product and test risks, and provide evidence-based release recommendations. 

The engineer is also expected to influence test strategy, improve engineering practices, mentor junior team members, and use AI-assisted tools responsibly while maintaining security, accuracy, and engineering accountability. 

Why Cisco

At Cisco, you will work on technologies that power some of the world's largest networks. You will collaborate with experienced engineers, solve complex technical problems, and contribute to products with global impact. 

Cisco provides an inclusive environment, opportunities for continuous learning, and the ability to grow across networking, cloud, automation, and AI technologies. 

#WeAreCisco

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we're revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era - and beyond. We've been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint. 

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you'll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere. 

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you. 

Disclaimer

About

To ensure that we hire the best talent in the right way, we follow a strict hiring process and recently, Cisco has been made aware of fraudulent recruiters claiming to be from the company. Please be advised that any communication from Cisco about careers will: 

- be in direct response to an application you have submitted through the company career site
 - begin with screening or an interview
 - originate from a Cisco email address, and
 - be conducted across email, phone, or WebEx

Cisco will never make a job offer without conducting an interview process or ask you for money in any way. If you have been requested to apply for a role or have received an offer from a site other than https: //careers. cisco. com or cisco. wd5. myworkday. com, do not provide any personal identifying information, including your Aadhaar or other personal identifying number, birth certificate, banking information, driver's license, or passport. 

If you are the target of a recruiting scam, consider filing a report with your local law enforcement authorities. Cisco bears no responsibility, and cannot be held liable, for any claims, damages, expenses, or other inconvenience resulting from or in any way connected to recruiting scams.

Your opportunity

At Charles Schwab, our purpose is simple: we champion client's goals with passion and integrity. Guided by honesty, mutual respect and a commitment to doing what's right, we bring innovation, education, and service together to help shape financial futures. Our people are the foundation of our success - they approach their work with curiosity and collaboration, coming together to create solutions that make a meaningful impact for clients and communities. As we expand into India, we are bringing this same culture of inclusion, learning, and opportunity to new talent. Joining us means becoming part of a global team where your work matters and your future can take shape. 

Our Hyderabad location is central to Schwab's growth, bringing together talented people and technology to drive innovation, scale and efficiency. Here, you will work alongside teams who create solutions that support millions of clients every day. The work you do is more than daily operations - it's a chance to experiment, learn, and build within a values-driven, supportive environment. This is a unique opportunity to be part of our early growth phase and shape something new, backed by the stability and strength of a Fortune 500 company. Your impact begins on day one, and your contributions will help define our future in the region. 

The SCS Quality Assurance (QA) team supports a wide range of functional, automated, and performance testing across a wide range of product lines. Quality Assurance in SCS covers multiple Cyber-Security Domains including Authorization, Authentication, and Data Loss Prevention supporting legacy and leading-edge solutions. Fast-paced environment with opportunities to expand your knowledge and skills as a Test Engineer. 

Key Responsibilities

- Plans, designs, develops, and executes test plans, scenarios and test cases for software systems or applications for software enhancements and new products. 
 - Acts as a subject matter expert with other teams on QA processes mentoring junior members to ensure effective and efficient delivery of QA services across Schwab Cyber Security. 
 - Conducts sophisticated technical and program analysis to support testing concepts for solving problems and/or making decisions and effectively communicates with technical and non-technical stakeholders. 

What you have

Required Qualifications

- BA/BS Degree in Computer Science or related degree
 - 7+ years of hands-on QA engineering and testing experience with progressive responsibilities/scope including but not limited to designing and executing API, UI, Scheduled Jobs, and DB test scenarios/cases. 
 - 4 + years of experience with automated testing including designing or enhancing frameworks supporting functional and non-functional testing
 - 4 + years of experience with front-end automation tools, such as Selenium, WebDriver, or something similar
 - 3+ years of QA experience with cyber related applications or functionalities such as Identity Governance, Authorization, Authentication, or Data Loss Prevention. 
 - Experience mentoring junior staff on QA processes. 
 - Ability to effectively communicate with technical and non-technical audiences, both oral and written is required. 
 - Strong interpersonal, analytical, problem-solving, influencing, prioritization, decision-making and conflict resolution skills. 
 - Self-starter: takes initiative and can work independently. 
 - Well-organized and disciplined with high attention to detail. 
 - Flexible and adaptable working with various business domains

Preferred Qualifications

- CISSP or other related certifications are preferred. 

What's in it for you

At Schwab India, you're empowered to shape your future. We support your growth through meaningful work, continuous learning, and a culture rooted in trust and collaboration - so you can build the skills to make a lasting impact. Our benefits are designed to care for your wellbeing, your family, and your long-term financial security. 

Our Base Benefits, Wellbeing, And Total Rewards Include

In this role, you will partner closely with Infrastructure, Release Engineering, and Development teams to drive high availability, build scalable test automation, and optimize CI/CD release pipelines. You will take ownership of release-based testing, system observability, and automation services to ensure that weekly software releases are delivered seamlessly and with high quality across mission-critical systems. 

Key ResponsibilitiesTest Automation & System Quality
 - Design, implement, and maintain scalable test automation frameworks for both server- and client-side systems using Java, TestNG, JUnit, and Selenium. 
 - Develop and execute comprehensive end-to-end and system test plans to validate new software changes against existing customer deployment patterns.

data.title: Senior Quality Engineer
data.description:
About StarRez

StarRez is the global leader in student housing software, providing innovative solutions for on and off-campus housing management, resident wellness and experience, and revenue generation. Trusted by 1, 400+ clients across 25+ countries, StarRez supports more than 4 million beds annually with its user-friendly, all-in-one platform, delivering seamless experiences for students and administrators. With offices in the United States, Australia, the UK, and India, StarRez blends the robust capabilities of a global organization with the personalized care and service of a trusted partner. 

Role: 

Payments is one of the highest stakes domains at StarRez. When a student pays their housing fees, or an institution reconciles a semester of revenue, the transaction must be correct, traceable, and secure, every time. There is no acceptable margin for a payment that is taken twice, refunded to the wrong account, or lost between our platform and a payment provider. As a Senior Quality Engineer on the Payments team, you will own quality for the systems that process card and bank payments, integrate with payment gateways and providers, and handle authorisation, capture, settlement, refunds, and chargebacks. You will be the person on the team with the deepest understanding of how money moves through our platform, the happy paths, the failure modes, and the states in between. This is a hands-on individual contributor role based in Hyderabad, working within a globally distributed engineering organisation spanning India, Australia, the UK and the United States. 

You will not manage people. You will set the quality bar for your team, do the work to hold it, and coach the engineers, product managers and designers around you to share ownership of it. You will report to the Director of Quality and work day-to-day with your team's Engineering Manager, Product Manager and engineers, alongside Support and Implementation Services when payment issues reach customers. 

What You Will Own: 

- Own the end-to-end test strategy within your team's area, deciding how things get tested based on the risk each change carries. 
 - Design validation for payment flows including authorisation, capture, settlement, partial and full refunds, failed and retried transactions, chargebacks, idempotency, and reconciliation between our records and the provider's. 
 - Coach and support your team to make of quality everyone's responsibility, and provide hands on support via executing testing activities when required 
 - Validate integrations with third party payment gateways and providers. 
 - Engage from discovery and refinement onward: challenge assumptions, surface missing scenarios, and make sure acceptance criteria are specific and testable before a story is picked up. 
 - Assess your team's current quality maturity honestly, build a plan to lift it over the next two to three quarters, and share what you learn with Senior QAs on other teams facing the same gaps. 
 - Coach engineers on testing principles, test design, and shared ownership of automated tests, the goal is a team that builds quality in, not a QA who inspects for it. 
 - Mentor mid-level QA engineers on risk assessment, automation, observability and shift left practice. 
 - Contribute to CI/CD pipeline health and deployment quality gates: test suite selection, environment readiness, pre and post deploy checks, and safe release strategies including feature flags and staged rollout. 
 - Own production defect triage for Payments: assess customer and financial impact, distinguish severity from priority, drive fixes at the right urgency, follow through to root cause & prevention, and provide regular updates on defect remediation. 
 - Represent Payments quality in incident reviews and, where needed, in conversations with Support and customer facing teams. 

Required Qualifications: 

- 5+ years in quality engineering or software engineering with a deep focus on quality, in complex distributed system environments. 
 - Hands on experience testing web-based SaaS products across various levels; front-end, backend, and end to end functional flows. 
 - Experience with transactional or financially sensitive systems, payments, billing, banking, e-commerce checkout, ledger or reconciliation systems, or similar. You understand why correctness, idempotency and auditability matter more here than elsewhere. 
 - Experience contributing to test automation frameworks and using and have a solid understanding of the testing pyramid. 
 - Practical experience working with CI/CD pipelines using GitHub, Build-kite, or similar platforms. 
 - Experience contributing to deployment and release quality gates, including test suite selection and environment readiness checks. 
 - Ability to translate customer needs into well-defined user stories, acceptance criteria, and risk-based test scenarios in collaboration with cross functional teams. 
 - Strong root cause analysis and problem-solving skills across complex, multi system failures. 
 - Excellent technical communication, you influence engineers, product managers and business stakeholders through evidence and expertise rather than authority. 
 - Practical experience using AI in modern software development, with sound judgement about where it helps and where it does not. 
 - Genuine curiosity about product architecture, customer workflows, and the business impact of engineering decisions. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience testing payment gateway or provider integrations (e. g. Stripe, or similar). 
 - Familiarity with payment rail nuances, ACH, SEPA, BACS, or card networks, and how timing and compliance rules affect testing. 
 - Exposure to feature flag based or staged rollout strategies for releasing payment features safely. 
 - Experience validating reconciliation between internal records and a provider's settlement data. 

Reasons to join our team: 

- Opportunity to be a part of a well-established, high-performance company that has been in business for over 30+ years
 - Full benefits including health care, paid time off, and others
 - A supportive team environment with emphasis on learning and development opportunities
 - Our Promise: You will learn, grow, and be appreciated for your impact and contributions. 
 - Z-Factor: Our most celebrated value, you will work with a team of caring, high-performing, and passionate people who have fun supporting our vision, innovation, and continuous improvement. 

Even if you don't have all of the Qualifications listed above, but feel you have what it takes to succeed in the role, we would love to hear from you!

StarRez is an equal opportunity employer.

About Us

We are a global climate technologies company engineered for sustainability. We create sustainable and efficient residential, commercial and industrial spaces through HVACR technologies. We protect temperature-sensitive goods throughout the cold chain. And we bring comfort to people globally. Best-in-class engineering, design and manufacturing combined with category-leading brands in compression, controls, software and monitoring solutions result in next-generation climate technology that is built for the needs of the world ahead. 

Whether you are a professional looking for a career change, an undergraduate student exploring your first opportunity, or recent graduate with an advanced degree, we have opportunities that will allow you to innovate, be challenged and make an impact. Join our team and start your journey today!

Join our Global Power Electronics Team in Pune as a Manager Engineering Power Electronics and lead the development of innovative variable speed drives solutions that drive our next generation products. In this role, you will combine strong technical expertise with engineering leadership to guide teams in designing, developing, and optimizing high-performance, efficient, and reliable solutions. You will play a key role in shaping technology direction, fostering collaboration, and ensuring successful execution from concept to product realization. If you are passionate about leading people, advancing technology, and making a real impact, this is an excellent opportunity for you. 

Your Tasks Will Include

- Lead the power electronics engineering team for variable speed drives, including coaching, mentoring, and team capability development. 
 - Drive the design, development, and optimization of power electronics solutions with focus on performance, efficiency, reliability, and cost. 
 - Manage technical project execution, ensuring alignment with targets for scope, timing, quality, and cost. 
 - Collaborate with global cross-functional teams to ensure robust and integrated system solutions. 
 - Ensure compliance with safety, EMC, reliability, and regulatory requirements as well as internal engineering standards. 
 - Oversee testing, validation, root cause analysis, and continuous improvement activities for power electronics systems. 
 - Take responsibility for calibration, maintenance, and investment planning of laboratory infrastructure and test equipment. 
 - Plan and manage team budgets and support performance management. 

Ideally You Will Bring

- A degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Electronics, Mechatronics, Automation Technology, Control and Drive Technology, or a comparable field. 
 - Strong expertise in designing and optimizing power electronics for variable speed drives, including component selection, thermal design, EMC, protection, and system integration. 
 - Proven leadership experience in managing and developing engineering teams in a high-performance, collaborative environment. 
 - Demonstrated experience in leading technical projects and driving execution across cross-functional and global teams, with accountability for quality, timing and cost. 
 - Experience in laboratory management, including responsibility for test equipment, calibration, maintenance, and investment planning. 
 - Strong organizational and managerial capabilities, including resource planning, budget management, performance reviews, and team development. 

Our Commitment to Our People

data.title: Director of Engineering, Commercial Services
data.description:
About Tide

At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting. 

Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, Germany and France. 

Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love. 

Tide Facts

- Tide is available for UK, German and French SMEs
 - Over 2 million members globally and rapidly growing
 - Over $300 million raised in funding
 - 3, 000 Tideans globally
 - We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg

About The Team

Tide is hiring a Director of Engineering to lead the engineering organisation behind Commercial Services. You will report to the CDTO and partner with Product and Design leadership as one leadership team accountable for the outcomes of the domain. 

Commercial Services is where Tide extends from helping members run their business to helping them grow it. You will shape how quickly every member becomes discoverable, how much of their buying and selling runs through Tide, and how far AI can turn that into a lasting advantage across every market we serve. 

Sell gives every member a live, discoverable presence, from the Tide Business Pages we are launching for 2 million members across the UK and Europe, to Own Website, catalogue, bookings, CRM and lead capture, and embedded fulfilment through Delivery as a Service. 

Buy turns that member base into a two-sided marketplace through the Tide Online Network, alongside Tide Promotions (gift cards, cashback and personalised offers), business supplies from partners, and Vendor Hub for e-procurement. 

You will be the single owner accountable for engineering delivery, architecture and people across both. 

About The Role

This role sits at the intersection of SME commerce, marketplaces and banking. Our members sit on both sides of the marketplace, our partners extend what we can offer them, and our banking platform lets us layer payments, credit, insurance and rewards into the experience at the point of need, which few commerce players can do. We need someone who can bring both streams onto one consistent engineering bar, ship quickly and build the platforms that turn Commercial Services into a material recurring revenue line for Tide. 

As Director of Engineering you will

- Set the engineering strategy and technical direction across the Sell and Buy value streams, from launch through to scale. 
 - Lead the Heads of Engineering for Sell and Buy, build the leadership bench underneath them, and own headcount planning, hiring and organisation design. 
 - Partner with Product and Design leadership on one shared plan, jointly owning delivery and outcomes, including members activated through real sales and purchases, engagement and recurring revenue. 
 - Scale the Tide Business Pages and Tide Online Network into a trusted, high-traffic marketplace, including search, listings, member-to-member leads, chat and buyer requests. 
 - Build the partner integration platform behind our website, gift card, business supply and logistics partners, enabling new partners and offers to be onboarded quickly and safely. 
 - Work with Payments, Acquiring, Credit, Insurance and Wealth to embed payments, credit, insurance and rewards into commerce journeys at the point of need. 
 - Build trust into the marketplace in partnership with Ongoing Monitoring and Risk, from verified seller status to initial and ongoing monitoring of listings and member-to-member communication. 
 - Set a consistent engineering practice and quality bar across architecture, delivery health measured through DORA metrics, reliability and security. 
 - Lead our move towards AI-assisted and agentic commerce, where a member describes what they need and Tide finds, compares and sources it. 
 - Apply our OnePlatform principles so we build once, deploy globally, and keep market-specific logic isolated. 

What We Are Looking For

- Director engineering leadership of a multi-team organisation of around 50 engineers across backend, frontend, data and analytics, led through at least one layer of engineering leaders. 
 - Domain experience in e-commerce, two-sided marketplaces, CRM or procurement platforms, including the trust and safety controls they need, with fintech or SME banking experience a plus. 
 - Strong track record of turning platform investment into measurable product and commercial outcomes. 
 - Experience building partner and third-party integration platforms at scale. 
 - Strong product and design partnership instincts. 
 - Comfortable setting direction through ambiguity and launching new products into multiple markets. 
 - Strong judgement across organisation design, delivery, architecture and technical quality. 
 - Experience bringing AI or agentic experiences into customer-facing commerce products would be a bonus. 

Our Tech Stack

- Backend: Java, Spring/Spring Boot, microservices architecture
 - Mobile/Web: Flutter / Angular
 - Infrastructure: AWS (SNS+SQS), PostgreSQL via RDS or Aurora, GCP (BigQuery, Vertex)
 - Observability: Coralogix (OpenTelemetry
 - Claude for agentic ways of working

What You'll Get In Return

Our location-specific employee benefits are designed to cater to the unique needs of Tideans: 

- Competitive Compensation - Competitive salary and share options. 
 - Time Off - Generous annual leave on top of bank holidays. 
 - Parental Leave - Paid maternity, paternity, and adoption leave to support your family journey. 
 - Sabbatical - Extended unpaid and paid leave options after completing milestone years with Tide. 
 - Health Insurance - Private family insurance with additional OPD coverage and top-up options. 
 - Life & Accident Cover - Comprehensive accidental and life insurance protection. 
 - Mental Wellbeing - Access to therapy sessions, courses, meditations, and workshops. 
 - Volunteering & Development Days - Paid days annually for volunteering or personal growth. 
 - Learning & Development - Annual budget for books, courses, coaching, and more. 
 - WOO (Work Outside the Office) - Work from abroad for up to 90 days annually. 
 - Home Office Setup - Contribution towards setting up your home office. 
 - Laptop Ownership - Keep your old laptop and get a new one when it's time for a replacement. 
 - Snacks & Meals - Office perks with snacks, coffee, tea, and lunch (location dependent). 

TIDEAN WAYS OF WORKING

At Tide, we champion a flexible workplace model that supports both in-person and remote work to cater to the specific needs of our different teams. 

While remote work is supported, we believe in the power of face-to-face interactions to foster team spirit and collaboration. Our offices are designed as hubs for innovation and team-building, where we encourage regular in-person gatherings to foster a strong sense of community. 

TIDE IS A PLACE FOR EVERYONE

At Tide, we believe that we can only succeed if we let our differences enrich our culture. Our Tideans come from a variety of backgrounds and experience levels. We consider everyone irrespective of their ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran, neurodiversity or differently-abled status. We celebrate diversity in our workforce as a cornerstone of our success. Our commitment to a broad spectrum of ideas and backgrounds is what enables us to build products that resonate with our members' diverse needs and lives. 

We are One Team and foster a transparent and inclusive environment, where everyone's voice is heard. 

At Tide, we thrive on diversity, embracing various backgrounds and experiences. We welcome all individuals regardless of ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, or disability. Our inclusive culture is key to our success, helping us build products that meet our members' diverse needs. We are One Team, committed to transparency and ensuring everyone's voice is heard. 

Disclaimer

It Has Come To Our Attention That Individuals Or Agencies Are Falsely Claiming To Represent Tide And Are Reaching Out To Candidates Regarding Job Opportunities. Please Be Aware That

- Tide does not charge any fees at any stage of the recruitment process. 
 - All official Tide job opportunities are listed exclusively on our Careers Page and applications should be submitted through this channel. 
 - Communication from Tide will only come from an official @tide. co email address. 
 - Tide does not work with agencies or recruiters without prior formal engagement, and we do not authorize third parties to make job offers on our behalf. 

If you are contacted by anyone misrepresenting Tide or requesting payment, please treat it as fraudulent and report it to us immediately at talent@tide. co

Your safety and trust are important to us, and we are committed to ensuring a fair and transparent recruitment process. 

Tide leverages AI to enhance our hiring experience. You can read more about how we use AI in our recruitment process in our AI Policy. 

Your personal data will be processed by Tide for recruitment purposes and in accordance with Tide's Recruitment Privacy Notice.

data.title: Senior Software Engineer - Open Data Platform (ODP)
data.description:
About Acceldata

At Acceldata, we are redefining how enterprises manage, observe, and optimize their data platforms. Our mission is to deliver a unified enterprise-grade data observability and modernization platform that integrates seamlessly across cloud, hybrid, and on-premises environments. 

The Acceldata Open Data Platform (ODP) brings together the best of the modern data ecosystem, including technologies such as Hadoop, Spark, Hive, Trino, Kafka, NiFi, MLFlow, Pinot and more, to help organisations run complex analytical workloads at scale while maintaining flexibility and avoiding vendor lock-in. 

Product Link : https: //www. acceldata. io/open-data-platform

About The Role

We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer with a minimum of 7 years of experience in distributed systems or data platform development. In this role, you will design, build, and scale components of the Acceldata Open Data Platform (ODP), contributing to open-source technologies and solving real-world challenges in large-scale data infrastructure. 

This is a full-time, on-site position with 5 days working from Bangalore office

Why Join Us

At Acceldata, you won't just be writing code; you'll be shaping the foundation of modern data platforms used by some of the world's largest enterprises. You'll work alongside seasoned engineers and open-source contributors who are passionate about solving complex distributed systems challenges at scale. Every project you take on will directly impact how a data platform is managed, observed, and optimised across hybrid and cloud ecosystems. 

This is your chance to build technology that truly matters, software that drives mission-critical pipelines, scales to petabytes, and influences the open-source community at large. We move fast, value creativity, and reward innovation. If you're looking for a place where your ideas can become real systems and your work can be seen, used, and respected across the data ecosystem - Acceldata is where you belong. 

Responsibilities

- Lead the design, development, and implementation of complex features for the Open Source Data Platform. 
 - Architect scalable and robust solutions, ensuring high performance and reliability. 
 - Mentor and guide junior software engineers, fostering a culture of continuous learning and growth. 
 - Drive technical discussions and provide expertise in technology selection and best practices. 
 - Contribute to the strategic direction of the Open Source Data Platform project. 
 - Perform thorough code reviews, ensuring code quality, maintainability, and adherence to standards. 
 - Work across diverse environments: Bare Metals, VM, and Kubernetes. 

Mandatory Skills & Qualifications

- Mandatory Linux proficiency for automation and efficient use of Linux shortcuts for troubleshooting. 
 - Familiarity with Kubernetes, Docker, and cloud environments. 
 - Ability to manage threads and debug issues related to deadlocks or memory leaks. 
 - Strong comprehension of garbage collection tuning and management challenges. 
 - Extensive hands-on experience with advanced Java, Scala, or Python, developed and prepared project build models associated with Maven, Gradle, or SBT. 
 - Experienced in Github & Nexus management and its use cases. 
 - Profound understanding of software engineering, database concepts, virtualisation and architectural patterns. 
 - Comprehensive knowledge and a history of significant contributions to past projects. 
 - Past experience of mentoring junior engineers in handling critical issues or tasks. 
 - Proven capability in fixing bugs and developing new features within complex software systems. 
 - Experience working with Big data stack or its ecosystem components, utilizing appropriate frameworks for application development. 
 - Demonstrated fluency in English communication. 
 - Ability to communicate effectively with senior leadership, presenting technical accomplishments and strategic insights. 
 - Strong capacity for collaboration with internal teams, external contributors, and the broader open-source community. 

Desired Skills (Bonus)

- Demonstrated history of contributions or a committer role in Apache projects (e. g. , bug fixes, feature development, documentation). 
 - Proficiency in identifying performance bottlenecks within big data applications and frameworks. 
 - Experience with the migration of applications, Hadoop-based distributions, or data streaming platforms. 
 - Familiarity with distributed systems and architectural patterns optimised for scalable data processing. 

₹1 - ₹1 a year

data.title: Staff Software Engineer, ML
data.description:
About The Team

Merchants are the supply side of Uber Eats and Delivery. Merchant ML helps them join the platform, stay reliable, and grow. We build models and GenAI systems across three areas: 

- Merchant intelligence and acquisition: lead scoring, merchant data scraping and enrichment, attribute-confidence models, and LLM-based decision systems. 
 - Merchant experience and operations: AI copilots for merchants and support agents, voice AI for automated verification such as bank and payment profile changes, and compliance automation during onboarding. 
 - Marketplace and merchant optimization: promotion and offer quality scoring, offer ranking, combos and bundles, and personalization. Reliability signals such as auto-pausing unreliable stores also feed into this work. 

The role

You will set the ML technical direction for Merchant and own the highest-impact, most ambiguous problems. You will ship production ML and GenAI systems that move merchant growth, reliability, and efficiency. You will also raise the engineering and modeling bar for the whole team. 

What You'll Do

- Own the end-to-end ML strategy for a major Merchant problem space. This covers problem framing, modeling, offline and online evaluation, launch, and long-term iteration. 
 - Design and ship production models such as ranking, scoring, classification, forecasting, and causal and uplift models. Use them to drive measurable business outcomes, and validate them through A/B tests and experimentation. 
 - Lead the architecture of LLM and agentic systems for merchants and operators. This includes retrieval, tool use, evaluation harnesses, guardrails, latency and cost management, and human-in-the-loop design. 
 - Build and evolve shared ML foundations for Merchant: feature pipelines, model serving and endpoints, evaluation frameworks, and monitoring for drift and quality, on Michelangelo and Uber's data and ML platform. 
 - Partner with Product, Design, Ops, Data Science, and Engineering to turn ambiguous merchant problems into a clear roadmap with defined success metrics. 
 - Write and review technical designs (ERDs and design docs). Set standards for model quality, reproducibility, and responsible AI. 
 - Mentor senior and mid-level engineers and scientists. Raise the technical bar through design reviews, code reviews, and hiring. 
 - Influence cross-org technical strategy by working with Marketplace, Fulfillment, Payments, Trust and Safety, and ML Platform teams. 

Required

What you'll bring

- 12+ years of industry experience building and shipping ML systems at scale (or an advanced degree plus 8+ years). 
 - A track record of leading multi-quarter, multi-team ML initiatives with clear business impact. 
 - Strong foundations in machine learning, statistics, and experimentation, including causal inference and A/B testing. 
 - Hands-on experience across the ML lifecycle: data and feature engineering, training, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring in production. 
 - Proficiency in Python and at least one of Go, Java, or Scala. Experience with PyTorch, TensorFlow, or XGBoost, and with Spark, Hive, or Presto. 
 - Strong systems judgment: low-latency serving, batch and streaming pipelines, and cost and reliability trade-offs. 
 - Excellent written and verbal communication, and the ability to influence without authority. 

Preferred

- Experience with LLMs and GenAI in production: fine-tuning, RAG, agents, evaluation, and safety. 
 - Experience in marketplace, ranking, recommendation, or promotion and pricing optimization. 
 - Experience with entity resolution, information extraction, web or data scraping, or knowledge graphs. 
 - Experience with voice and conversational AI, or merchant and enterprise tooling. 
 - Experience in fraud, risk, or compliance ML. 
 - Publications, patents, or open-source contributions in ML. 
 - MS or PhD in CS, ML, Statistics, or a related field. 

Ready to Ride?

This isn't the kind of place where you follow a playbook - it's where you help write one. If you're driven by impact, energized by challenge, and ready to shape how the world moves - we'd love to hear from you. 

You may be eligible for bonuses, equity, and other compensation, as well as a range of benefits. Explore our benefits. 

Offices remain key to collaboration and Uber's culture. Unless approved for full remote work, employees must spend at least 50% of their time in-office. Some roles, like those at greenlight hubs, require full-time in-office presence. Ask your Recruiter for details about this role's requirements.
