data.title: Principal, AI - Software Engineering (Open)
data.description:
Calling all innovators - find your future at Fiserv. 

We're Fiserv, a global leader in Fintech and payments, and we move money and information in a way that moves the world. We connect financial institutions, corporations, merchants, and consumers to one another millions of times a day - quickly, reliably, and securely. Any time you swipe your credit card, pay through a mobile app, or withdraw money from the bank, we're involved. If you want to make an impact on a global scale, come make a difference at Fiserv. 

Job Title

Principal, AI - Software Engineering (Open)

About The Role

We are looking for a Senior Principal Engineer to architect and build a next-generation enterprise data platform from the ground up. This is a hands-on platform engineering leadership role for someone who has built and scaled data platforms in production, migrated organisations off legacy data infrastructure, and delivered the data foundation that powers AI solutions, real-time pipelines, governed data products, and B2B data distribution at enterprise scale. You will set the technical direction, define engineering standards, make critical build-versus-buy decisions, and deliver a platform that the business can depend on for reliability, quality, and long-term extensibility. The tech stack is AWS and open-source. You will be expected to bring strong opinions, deep hands-on ability, and the influence to raise the engineering bar across the team. 

What You Will Do

- Architect and build a modern enterprise data platform from scratch on AWS and open-source technologies, designing for scale, resilience, and long-term maintainability from day one. 
 - Lead the migration of legacy data infrastructure to the new platform, defining the migration strategy, sequencing, cutover approach, and rollback plan with minimal disruption to production consumers. 
 - Design a lakehouse architecture combining open table formats (Apache Iceberg, Delta Lake, or Apache Hudi) on AWS S3 with a governed analytical consumption layer, enabling both raw storage and curated data product delivery. 
 - Build configurable, metadata-driven ingestion frameworks capable of onboarding new data sources rapidly without bespoke engineering per source, supporting batch, micro-batch, and real-time patterns. 
 - Design and deliver real-time and streaming data pipelines using Apache Kafka, Apache Flink, AWS Kinesis, or equivalent, with low-latency SLA guarantees and exactly-once processing semantics. 
 - Define golden pipeline standards: reusable, auditable, idempotent pipeline patterns that serve as the reference implementation for all data flows across the platform. 
 - Embed data quality, data contracts, and automated validation as first-class engineering requirements in every pipeline, not as an afterthought, using frameworks such as Great Expectations, Soda, or equivalent. 
 - Build the data governance layer covering lineage tracking, metadata management, data classification, access control, and policy enforcement using open-source tooling such as OpenMetadata, Apache Atlas, or equivalent. 
 - Design platform observability end to end: pipeline health monitoring, data SLA tracking, anomaly detection, alerting, cost dashboards, and runbooks so the platform can be operated reliably and transparently at scale. 
 - Implement platform resilience patterns including dead-letter queues, retry and backfill mechanisms, circuit breakers, and graceful degradation to meet enterprise SLA commitments under failure conditions. 
 - Own cost management across the platform: compute right-sizing, storage tiering, query optimisation, and governance guardrails that prevent cost sprawl as data volumes and consumer count grow. 
 - Design and deliver integrations with upstream source systems including REST APIs, CDC streams, event buses, and file-based feeds, as well as downstream B2B consumers requiring secure, scalable data distribution. 
 - Build the data foundation that AI and ML workloads depend on: feature engineering pipelines, curated training datasets, data quality pipelines for model inputs, and LLM-ready data products. 
 - Lead technical evaluation and selection of open-source tools and AWS managed services, making build-versus-buy decisions grounded in engineering trade-offs, total cost of ownership, and long-term platform strategy. 
 - Define and enforce engineering standards across the platform: coding conventions, automated testing, CI/CD for data pipelines, infrastructure as code using Terraform or AWS CDK, and security-by-design practices. 
 - Mentor and uplift senior and mid-level engineers through design reviews, pair engineering, technical documentation, and architecture forums. 

What You Will Need

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - Extensive hands-on experience designing, building, and operating enterprise-scale data platforms, including greenfield builds and migrations from legacy systems. 
 - Deep proficiency in Python and SQL with strong experience writing production-grade data engineering code across ingestion, transformation, and delivery layers. 
 - Strong expertise across AWS data and compute services including S3, Glue, Lambda, Kinesis, MSK, EMR, Athena, IAM, and VPC networking for data workloads. 
 - Hands-on experience with the open-source data stack: Apache Kafka, Apache Spark, Apache Flink, Apache Airflow or Prefect, dbt, and open table formats such as Iceberg, Delta Lake, or Hudi. 
 - Proven experience designing lakehouse architectures that separate scalable open storage from governed analytical consumption. 
 - Experience building configurable, metadata-driven ingestion frameworks and reusable golden pipeline patterns at scale across multiple source systems. 
 - Deep understanding of data quality frameworks, data contracts, schema evolution, and automated validation in production pipelines. 
 - Experience with streaming and real-time architectures including stateful stream processing, event-time semantics, and SLA-bound delivery guarantees. 
 - Experience designing and implementing data governance solutions covering lineage, metadata cataloguing, classification, masking, and access control. 
 - Experience building platform observability: pipeline monitoring, SLA assurance, cost governance dashboards, alerting, and incident response for data infrastructure. 
 - Strong experience with infrastructure as code (Terraform or AWS CDK), GitOps, and CI/CD for data pipeline delivery. 
 - Demonstrated ability to lead architecture decisions, influence engineering direction across teams without formal authority, and own complex outcomes from design through production. 

What Would Be Great To Have

- Experience building data foundations for AI and ML solutions: feature stores, training dataset pipelines, model monitoring data feeds, and data quality assurance for AI outputs. 
 - Experience applying GenAI or LLM-assisted practices to data engineering: code generation, automated documentation, data quality rule inference, or intelligent root cause analysis. 
 - Experience with B2B data distribution: secure data sharing APIs, Delta Sharing protocol, partner data exchange patterns, and fine-grained access control for external consumers. 
 - Experience with open-source data governance platforms such as OpenMetadata, Apache Atlas, or DataHub. 
 - Background in financial services, payments, banking, healthcare, or another regulated industry with compliance, audit, and data security requirements. 
 - Experience designing self-serve data platform capabilities that reduce central team dependency and enable downstream consumers to access certified data products independently. 
 - Active contributions to open-source data engineering projects or engagement with the broader data platform community. 

Thank You For Considering Employment With Fiserv. Please

- Apply using your legal name
 - Complete the step-by-step profile and attach your resume (either is acceptable, both are preferable). 

Our Commitment To Diversity And Inclusion

Fiserv is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, protected veteran status, or any other category protected by law. 

Note To Agencies

Fiserv does not accept resume submissions from agencies outside of existing agreements. Please do not send resumes to Fiserv associates. Fiserv is not responsible for any fees associated with unsolicited resume submissions. 

Warning About Fake Job Posts

Please be aware of fraudulent job postings that are not affiliated with Fiserv. Fraudulent job postings may be used by cyber criminals to target your personally identifiable information and/or to steal money or financial information. Any communications from a Fiserv representative will come from a legitimate Fiserv email address.

data.title: Staff Software Engineer - Marketplace
data.description:
Our Purpose

At SentinelOne, we are driven by a clear purpose: to give the advantage to those who secure our future. As AI reshapes how organizations build, operate, and innovate, the responsibility to protect them becomes more critical than ever. When you join SentinelOne, your work helps protect global enterprises, critical infrastructure, and the technologies shaping tomorrow. If you are motivated by meaningful challenges and want your impact to be real, measurable, and global, you will find purpose here. 

About Us

SentinelOne is a company at the intersection of AI and security, pioneering a new operating model for cybersecurity. Our AI-native platform unifies protection across endpoint, cloud, identity, data, and AI systems to deliver autonomous detection and response with clarity and speed. By combining real-time analytics, intelligent automation, and a unified data foundation, we reduce noise, simplify complexity, and empower security teams to focus on what truly matters. 

Our teams are builders, problem-solvers, and innovators committed to shaping the future of security. If you are excited to solve hard problems alongside talented, mission-driven people, we invite you to help us build a safer future for humanity. 

What Are We Looking For?

We're looking for people who are relentlessly curious and committed to continuous learning. AI is reshaping every function across our business, and we enable every team member, regardless of role or level, to build fluency in AI tools and concepts. Those who thrive here actively seek out new solutions, experiment thoughtfully, and apply what they learn to drive better, faster, smarter outcomes. 

As a Staff (tech-lead level) engineer you will work on Singularity Marketplace - multi-tenant, event-driven platform that enables third-party integration applications to safely deploy, execute, and stream data across our AI SIEM ecosystem. We are looking for a pragmatic platform architect who understands the messy, real-world realities of third-party vendor APIs; that context is what separates sound platform decisions from theoretical ones. However, this is fundamentally an infrastructure and core platform role. Your primary goal isn't to build individual connectors, but to design the API contracts, runtime abstractions, isolation mechanisms, and microservices that enable dozens of teams and third parties to build connectors safely at petabyte scale. 

What Will You Do?

Primary responsibilities include: 

Integration & Product Responsibilities: 

- Collaborate closely with Product Managers and engineering teams to define requirements for integrating third-party vendors with the SentinelOne platform, establishing the Singularity Marketplace / Operations Center as the central hub in the security team's toolkit 
 - Explore products from various cybersecurity vendors and widely used industry tools to determine how to ingest and correlate their data 
 - Incorporate third-party data into the SentinelOne platform so customers can correlate information across vendors, surface insights, and respond quickly to threats
 - Provide security research context on how 3rd-party data maps to the Open Cybersecurity Schema Framework (OCSF) and how it's used for triage, investigation, and response
 - Follow internal processes for communicating schema and API changes to maintain OCSF parity across the platform

Platform Engineering Responsibilities : 

- Develop and extend the Java/Kotlin (Spring Boot) integrations platform that gives customers an interactive UI for onboarding third-party products and vendors
 - Design and maintain event-driven microservices communicating over Apache Kafka that process entity activities, XDR alerts, and external triggers at scale
 - Own core infrastructure across the entire request lifecycle, spanning edge/ingress gateways, API routing layers, and high-performance relational databases (PostgreSQL/Aurora RDS) while enforcing secure JWT/OAuth authentication and shared security libraries. 
 - Participate in on-call, incident response, and troubleshooting for a multi-region, multi-cluster production platform (Kafka lag, reconciliation failures, DB connection exhaustion, ingress routing issues, etc. ) 
 - Contribute to GitOps-driven CI/CD pipelines (e. g. , Helm, ArgoCD, GitHub Actions) for building, testing, and deploying services and functions across environments

What Skills and Knowledge Will You Bring?

Ideal candidates will have: 

- Modern Java/Kotlin Ecosystem: Deep hands-on expertise in Java/Kotlin, and Spring Boot, paired with strong system design fundamentals. (Knowledge of Go or Rust is a plus)
 - Experience with event-driven architectures and messaging systems (Apache Kafka or equivalent), including topics, consumer groups, and streaming pipelines
 - Ability to research and reverse-engineer APIs from documentation and technical specifications, and model them into structured data schemas 
 - Demonstrated technical leadership experience - shaping engineering best practices and driving their adoption across a team 
 - Experience with Kubernetes and containerized deployments, including Helm charts, ingress controllers (e. g. , Traefik), and operator/reconciler patterns
 - Experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL preferred) and cloud infrastructure (AWS and/or GCP)
 - Experience developing integration or contract tests (e. g. , pytest) and working within CI/CD pipelines
 - Big Advantage would be any of: Familiarity with serverless/FaaS platforms (e. g. , AWS Lambda); Experience building data-intensive systems (ingestion, transformation, normalization, validation) and integrating complex third-party APIs; Practical engineering experience building production software utilizing LLMs or AI agents, with an emphasis on evaluation frameworks, testing, guardrails, and data pipeline integration; and Experience operating distributed, multi-region production systems (debugging Kafka consumer lag, ingress/routing issues, connection pool exhaustion, reconciliation failures)

Why SentinelOne?

AI is redefining how the world operates and rewriting the rules of security in real time, and SentinelOne was built for this moment. From day one, we architected an AI-native platform designed to operate at machine speed, not as an add-on to legacy systems but as the foundation itself. If you want to build where innovation and impact move together, this is that place. 

We invest in our Sentinels with comprehensive, competitive benefits designed to support you and your family: 

Equity & Rewards

- Restricted Stock Units (RSUs)
 - Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP)

Time Off & Wellbeing

- Competitive leave benefits
 - Gender-neutral parental leave

Insurance & Financial Security

- 
 - Medical and insurance benefits
 - Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

Work Perks & Flexibility

- Global home office allowance
 - Internet allowance
 - LinkedIn Learning license
 - Social Connect program
 - Food allowance (Bangalore office)
 - Meal vouchers (Sodexo)

Wellness & Lifestyle

- Health & wellness benefit

SentinelOne is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. 

SentinelOne participates in the E-Verify Program for all U. S. based roles. 

To learn more about how we use AI in our hiring process, please review our AI in Hiring Candidate Disclosure.

data.title: Software Development Engineer 1
data.description:
About The Team / Role

In today's software development landscape, collaboration, E2E accountability, problem solving and streamlined workflows are key to achieving efficiency and delivering high-quality solutions that solve customer problems and generate business outcomes. We believe in the power of integrated engineering, where development, quality, and agility skills blend together throughout the solution delivery pipeline. In this role, you'll be a champion for this approach, fostering a culture of shared ownership and breaking down silos to ensure a smooth and efficient flow of innovation to customers. 

How You'll Make An Impact

- Collaborate with stakeholders throughout the SDLC to translate requirements into high-quality, reliable, cost-effective, and maintainable solutions that solve customer problems and generate business outcomes. 
 - Design, develop, and implement high quality software components with a focus on Continuous Delivery principles and practices. 
 - Champion integrated engineering practices within the organization, fostering collaboration and shared ownership between development, operations, and security teams. Deliver technical and administrative support for live applications, promoting automation and proactive monitoring and self-recoverability, rapid incident response, and continuous improvement. 
 - Analyze existing systems and processes to identify bottlenecks and opportunities for improvements to flow. 
 - Full-Stack / Backend Development: Design, develop, test, and deploy clean, maintainable, and efficient code using Java and JavaScript. 
 - Database Management: Write optimized queries, design data schemas, and manage both relational (MySQL, Oracle) and NoSQL database integrations. 
 - Component Design: Apply Object-Oriented Programming (OOPS) principles and design patterns to translate functional requirements into scalable technical modules. 
 - Algorithm & Data Structure Application: Select and implement optimal data structures and algorithms to solve performance bottlenecks and ensure low-latency system behavior. 
 - Collaboration & Code Reviews: Actively participate in peer code reviews, sprint planning, and technical discussions to lift code quality and team standards. 
 - System Quality & Reliability: Write unit, integration, and functional tests to maintain high code coverage and minimize production defects. 

Core Skills

- Programming/Software Development: This skill remains the foundation. Proficiency in programming languages and development methodologies is essential for designing, developing, and implementing software components in an integrated engineering environment. A strong focus on continuous delivery practices is crucial. 
 - Testing Quality assurance is paramount. The ability to design, execute, and analyze various types of tests to ensure deployments meet established acceptance criteria remains essential. 
 - Requirements Management : Understanding requirements throughout the software delivery lifecycle is critical. This ensures alignment with business needs, avoids rework, and fosters collaboration with stakeholders. 
 - Software Design: While automation might play a larger role in integrated engineering, a combined understanding of software development practices and design principles is still valuable. This ensures creating maintainable, scalable, and secure applications. 
 - Measurement: Data-driven decision making is crucial. The ability to define and establish measurement frameworks, along with KPIs related to software delivery and performance, helps identify areas for improvement. 

Additional Valuable Skills

- Configuration Management: Managing configurations with IaC tools is essential for consistent and repeatable deployments. However, the specific emphasis on configuration management might be slightly lower since integrated engineering often emphasizes infrastructure automation. 
 - Application Support : While IT Service Support (SERV) covers some aspects of application support, this skill can be relevant if the role has a stronger focus on troubleshooting and supporting specific applications. 
 - Systems Integration: While integration activities might be streamlined, understanding system integration principles can be valuable, especially if the role involves integrating various software components. 
 - Release and Deployment Management: Effectively managing software releases and deployments is crucial. However, in an integrated engineering environment, automation tools and streamlined processes might reduce the manual effort involved compared to traditional release cycles. 
 - Methods and Tools : The right tools automate tasks, improve decision-making, and ensure consistent practices. This is crucial for efficiency, data-driven development, and staying current in a rapidly evolving field. 

Experience You Will Bring

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience). 
 - Minimum of 2 years of experience in software engineering and delivery. 
 - Strong understanding of continuous delivery principles and practices. 
 - Exposure to Cloud Infrastructure (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Proficiency in multiple programming languages and technologies (Java, JavaScript, Python). 
 - Familiarity with Java frameworks such as Spring Boot or Hibernate. 
 - Thorough understanding of Object-Oriented Programming (OOPS) concepts (Abstraction, Encapsulation, Inheritance, Polymorphism). 
 - Strong foundation in Data Structures & Algorithms (Arrays, Linked Lists, Trees, Graphs, Hashing, Sorting/Searching). 
 - Strong problem-solving and analytical skills. 
 - Excellent communication and collaboration skills. 
 - Ability to work independently and as part of a cross-functional team.

data.title: Senior Principal Platform Engineer – QA
data.description:
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems. 

Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines. 

Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges. 

Job Purpose

The Senior Principal Platform Engineer - QA will help shape and evolve the organisation's quality engineering platform, enabling teams to build, test, deploy and operate software faster, more securely, and more reliably. The QA role will set the testing and quality standards helping to build test automation that can be adopted across platform and application teams. They will also mentor the engineers around them, and treats the teams who consume the test automation as customers. The role works through infrastructure-as-code and golden paths rather than manual configuration, uses AI-assisted engineering across code generation, review and testing, and engineers reliability in by defining SLOs, instrumenting for observability and automating away toil. 

Engineering roadmap and direction sit with the Engineering Director, reference architecture and standards sit with the Platform Architect, backlog order sits with the Product Owner, and deep reliability engineering sits with the Site Reliability Engineer deployed from Reliability Engineering & Operations. 

Key Responsibilities

Quality strategy and architecture

- Define the platform quality engineering strategy, test pyramid and quality gates for all cloud platform products. 
 - Set standards for testing infrastructure-as-code: static analysis, policy-as-code, unit, integration and end-to-end tests for Terraform modules. 
 - Design ephemeral test environments that provision, validate and tear down platform stacks on every change. 

Continuous verification and automation

- Build shift-left quality into CI/CD: automated gates for security, compliance, cost and drift before merge and release. 
 - Establish contract and compatibility testing so module and API changes never break consuming business teams. 
 - Lead resilience and chaos testing for platforms. 
 - Drive performance and scale testing for self-service provisioning paths. 

GxP and computerised system assurance

- Modernise qualification from document-heavy validation to risk-based, automated Assurance. 
 - Generate qualification evidence (IQ/OQ traceability, test results, approvals) directly from pipelines. 
 - Partner with Quality, GRC and the CISO office to keep evidence audit-ready for GxP, SOX and data integrity requirements. 

Images, supply chain and security quality

- Own test frameworks for VM, OS, database and container image bakeries: CIS benchmarks, vulnerability thresholds, SBOM and signing checks. 
 - Integrate CNAPP and code scanning findings (e. g. Wiz, GitHub Advanced Security) into release gates with clear SLAs. 

AI and agentic platform quality

- Define evaluation frameworks for platform AI agents: accuracy, safety & guardrail 
 - Test agent-generated artifacts for correctness, policy compliance and blast radius before execution. 

Engineering leadership

- Set quality metrics and SLOs, report them to platform and security leadership, and drive corrective actions. 
 - Mentor engineers across platform teams; grow a quality-engineering community of practice. 
 - Evaluate and select tooling; make build-vs-buy recommendations. 

Required Experience And Skills

- 15+ years in software or platform engineering, with 3+ years leading quality or test engineering for tenant platforms at enterprise scale. 
 - Deep hands-on Terraform experience 
 - Strong policy-as-code skills around OPA/Rego 
 - Production experience on Azure and GCP; working knowledge of Kubernetes and GitOps 
 - Built CI/CD quality gates in GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps or similar. 
 - Proficient in at least one of Python, Go or TypeScript for test frameworks and tooling. 
 - Experience in a regulated industry (life sciences, pharma, finance or healthcare), including GxP or equivalent validation. 
 - Track record of setting technical direction across multiple teams without direct authority. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience testing LLM-based or agentic systems 
 - Familiarity with software supply chain standards: SLSA, SBOM (SPDX/CycloneDX), Sigstore/cosign. 
 - Chaos engineering tools such as Azure Chaos Studio, LitmusChaos or Gremlin. 
 - Experience with Red Hat Ansible Automation Platform, Azure Arc or hybrid estates. 
 - Certifications such as Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Google Professional Cloud Architect, ISTQB Advanced or CKA. 

Leadership behaviors and ways of working

- Quality as an engineering discipline: builds automation and paved roads, not manual sign-off queues. 
 - Risk-based judgement: scales testing rigour to patient, product and data-integrity impact. 
 - Influence without authority: aligns platform, security, Quality and GRC stakeholders on shared standards. 
 - Hands-on credibility: writes and reviews code, and can debug a failing pipeline alongside the team. 
 - Clear communicator: turns quality data into decisions for senior leadership and auditors alike. 

#AGTech

Skills

API Management, Automation Technology, Cloud Architectures, Cloud Financial Operations, Containerization, Database Management, DevOps, Disaster Recovery (DR), Edge Computing, Infrastructure As Code (IaC), Networking Concepts, Performance Optimizations, Scripting, Serverless Computing, Software Frameworks, Software Testing, System Monitors, Test Automation, UI Automation Testing, Virtualization

Why GSK?

Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. 

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2. 5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we're committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. data.description:
Job Summary

Serve as a senior product test specialist focusing on Oracle E Business Finance and Oracle Financials Cloud solutions designing and executing high quality test strategies that ensure robust financial platforms for global operations while collaborating in a hybrid day shift model to enhance reliability and user confidence across critical payment services. 

Responsibilities

- Design comprehensive test strategies and detailed test plans for Oracle E Business Finance and Oracle Financials Cloud modules to ensure stable and compliant financial processing across enterprise environments. 
 - Execute functional regression integration and end to end testing cycles for complex financial workflows to validate accuracy of general ledger postings subledger accounting and financial reporting. 
 - Develop reusable test cases and data sets for key finance processes such as payables receivables fixed assets and cash management to drive consistent quality across multiple product releases. 
 - Collaborate with business analysts and finance stakeholders to clarify requirements and translate nuanced financial and regulatory scenarios into testable outcomes that reflect real world usage. 
 - Analyze defects and root causes across Oracle financial solutions and provide clear actionable insights to development teams that reduce recurring issues and improve system stability. 
 - Coordinate and perform system integration testing between Oracle financial applications and surrounding payment interfaces to safeguard data integrity and timely transaction settlement. 
 - Validate configuration changes patches and upgrades in Oracle E Business Finance and Oracle Financials Cloud environments to minimize production risk and maintain business continuity. 
 - Provide detailed test execution reports defect metrics and readiness assessments to project and product teams enabling informed release decisions that align with organizational risk tolerances. 
 - Optimize test coverage in hybrid work settings by using collaborative tools and agreed communication routines to ensure seamless coordination with cross functional teams during day shift operations. 
 - Contribute to continuous improvement of test frameworks checklists and quality standards for financial applications so that the organization steadily enhances reliability and client trust in its platforms. 
 - Support user acceptance testing by preparing scenarios clarifying defects and advising on mitigation approaches ensuring finance teams experience intuitive and dependable Oracle financial systems. 
 - Apply domain understanding of cards and payments flows when available to design testing around authorization clearing settlement and reconciliation journeys that protect end users and transaction transparency. 
 - Document test outcomes lessons learned and reusable assets in shared repositories so that future projects benefit from established best practices and reduced time to validate financial changes. 

Qualifications

- Demonstrate strong hands on experience of six to seven years in testing Oracle E Business Finance modules with deep familiarity in core finance processes and configuration behaviors. 
 - Show proven expertise in Oracle Financials Cloud testing including navigation of cloud environments validation of security roles and assessment of key financial reporting features. 
 - Exhibit sound understanding of payments domain concepts including transaction lifecycles fees reconciliation and exception handling that enrich the thoroughness of test scenarios. 
 - Apply practical knowledge of cards and payments ecosystems when present to refine test coverage on card transactions dispute handling and settlement processes across financial platforms. 
 - Use structured defect management and test management tools to log issues track resolution progress and present concise summaries that help teams prioritize remediation activities. 
 - Demonstrate clear communication skills in hybrid work models by coordinating with global stakeholders documenting findings accurately and supporting remote and onsite collaboration. 
 - Maintain commitment to quality standards risk awareness and regulatory considerations in financial testing to uphold organizational reputation and contribute positively to societal trust in digital finance. 

Certifications Required

Oracle Financials Cloud Implementation Specialist or equivalent Oracle finance testing certification.

data.title: Senior Software Engineer
data.description:
About Sirion

Sirion is the world's leading AI-native Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) platform. Global enterprises use Sirion to author, negotiate, manage, and extract value from their contracts, using generative AI for extraction, conversational search, and AI-assisted negotiation. With more than 7 million contracts and close to $800B in contract value under management, Sirion is recognized as a leader by Gartner, IDC, and Spend Matters. 

Power the Future of AI & Why This Role Matters

We are looking for an AI Automation Engineer with 4-6 years of Python development experience and hands-on experience building AI-powered and agentic automation solutions. The ideal candidate combines strong Python backend skills with practical knowledge of LLMs, AI agents, RAG, tool calling, and workflow orchestration. 

As part of Sirion's Automation team, you will design, build, and deploy intelligent automations in which AI agents reason over contracts and business data, call APIs and tools, and execute multi-step processes end-to-end, with appropriate human-in-the-loop controls. 

How You'll Make an Impact

- Design, develop, and deploy agentic AI automations that use LLMs, tool/function calling, memory, and multi-step reasoning to automate business processes end-to-end. 
 - Build agent workflows using frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, CrewAI, AutoGen, or similar. 
 - Build AI agents that interact with APIs, databases, documents, web applications, and external tools. 
 - Design and implement RAG-based solutions using embeddings, vector databases, and semantic search. 
 - Integrate OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, or other LLM APIs into production systems, including prompt engineering and structured outputs. 
 - Develop scalable backend services and APIs in Python using FastAPI, Flask, or Django REST Framework. 
 - Build human-in-the-loop checkpoints, guardrails, and error-handling/retry logic so automations run reliably in production. 
 - Develop asynchronous and event-driven workflows where required. 
 - Evaluate agent quality, accuracy, latency, and cost; monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize automations in production. 
 - Work with databases such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, or Redis. 
 - Deploy and maintain solutions using Docker and CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Write clean, maintainable, testable, production-ready Python code. 
 - Collaborate with product managers, architects, business stakeholders, and engineering teams to identify automation opportunities and translate requirements into technical solutions. 
 - Stay current with developments in Generative AI and Agentic AI. 

Skills & Experience You Bring to the Table

Python & Backend Development

- 4-6 years of professional experience in Python development. 
 - Strong understanding of OOP, data structures, exception handling, and concurrency (asyncio/threading). 
 - Hands-on experience with FastAPI, Flask, Django, or Django REST Framework. 
 - Strong experience developing and consuming REST APIs. 
 - Good understanding of SQL and relational databases (PostgreSQL/MySQL); MongoDB/Redis experience preferred. 

Agentic AI / GenAI

- Hands-on experience building LLM-powered applications beyond proofs of concept. 
 - Understanding of agentic AI architecture, including planning, tool use, memory, and autonomous multi-step workflows. 
 - Experience with one or more agent frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, CrewAI, or AutoGen. 
 - Experience with tool/function calling and integrating external APIs and tools with LLMs. 
 - Understanding of RAG, embeddings, vector databases, and semantic search. 
 - Experience with LLM APIs such as OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, or equivalent. 
 - Good understanding of prompt engineering and structured LLM outputs. 
 - Experience with MCP (Model Context Protocol) and AI tool integrations. 
 - Experience building multi-agent systems. 

Cloud & DevOps

- Experience with Docker and containerized applications. 
 - Understanding of CI/CD pipelines and tools such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or GitLab CI. 
 - Exposure to AWS, Azure, or GCP. 
 - Experience with logging, monitoring, debugging, and production deployments. 

Education & Soft Skills

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics, Engineering, or a related field. 
 - Strong problem-solving and analytical skills. 
 - Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams. 
 - Strong communication and documentation skills. 

Good to Have

- Experience with RPA or workflow automation platforms such as UiPath, Automation Anywhere, Power Automate, or n8n. 
 - Experience with document AI: extracting and processing data from PDFs, contracts, or other unstructured documents. 
 - Exposure to Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) or enterprise SaaS platforms. 
 - Experience with task and message queues such as Celery, RabbitMQ, or Kafka. 
 - Experience with Kubernetes. 
 - Experience working with open-source/local LLMs and Hugging Face models. 
 - Understanding of LLM evaluation, observability, guardrails, and cost optimization. 
 - Basic understanding of frontend technologies such as React, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS. 

What We Are Looking For

The ideal candidate is strong in Python backend development and has built real AI/agentic automation solutions, not just theoretical knowledge of Generative AI. Candidates should be able to demonstrate projects that combine LLMs + tools/APIs + orchestration + backend services, preferably deployed in production.

data.title: Architect - Performance Verification and Analysis
data.description:
NVIDIA has continuously reinvented itself. Our invention of the GPU sparked the growth of the PC gaming market, redefined modern computer graphics, and revolutionized parallel computing. Today, research in artificial intelligence is booming worldwide, which calls for highly scalable and massively parallel computation horsepower that NVIDIA GPUs excel. 

The NVIDIA GPU and SoC Architecture group is seeking strong architects with great analytical skills and a deep understanding of system architecture and performance to use your skills creatively on processor and system architecture performance of full applications driving scalable improvements for all of our artificial intelligence/machine learning, automotive, geforce and high-performance computing products. This position offers you the opportunity to have a real impact on the hardware and software that underlies the most exciting trends in modern computing in the world. We are looking for someone who is passionate about and loves what you do and excited about creatively applying what you know to make a difference. 

What You'll Be Doing

- Performance analysis/ bottleneck analysis of complex, high performance GPUs and System-on-Chips (SoCs). 
 - Work on hardware models of different levels of extraction, including performance models, RTL test benches and emulators to find performance bottlenecks in the system.

What We Need To See

- BE/BTech or MS/MTech, or equivalent experience in relevant area, PhD is a plus.

 - Exposure to performance simulators, cycle accurate/approximate models or emulators for pre-silicon performance analysis is a plus.

 - Ability to work in a global team environment. 

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd

Architecture Engagement: Collaborate closely with firmware and hardware teams to understand architectural specifications, schematics, and system design, enabling high-coverage test cases early in the development lifecycle. Agile Practices: Actively participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies, including sprint planning, daily stand-ups, backlog grooming, and retrospectives. Senior SDET / SDET - II

Location: Bangalore, India

Experience: 4+ Years

Company Background

zenda is a financial technology partner to schools, colleges, and nurseries, building products exclusively for the education sector. We help institutions improve collection efficiency, digitise all payments, and offer flexibility to parents and guardians. 

Launched in 2021, zenda is present in 40% of all UAE K-12 schools and 500+ schools across markets, serving 150, 000+ parents across the Middle East and Southeast Asia, and on track to process USD 1B+ in transactions annually. We partner with leading global networks and are actively expanding across Europe and Southeast Asia. 

zenda is backed by leading VCs including the $1. 5bn Saudi Technology Venture and Global Founders Capital, and is seamlessly integrated with 70+ local, regional, and global SIS and ERP systems. 

The Role

We are looking for a highly skilled and hands-on Senior Automation Engineer / Senior SDET to build scalable automation solutions and drive quality engineering practices across enterprise applications and modern distributed systems. 

This role is ideal for someone passionate about automation, engineering excellence, developer productivity, and modern testing practices in fast-paced Agile environments. You will work closely with engineering, DevOps, product, and platform teams to ensure high-quality software delivery through automation-first and AI-assisted quality engineering approaches. 

We are a small, high-ownership engineering team. What you build here will directly shape the reliability and velocity of zenda's platform as we scale across new markets. 

Key Responsibilities

- Design and maintain scalable automation frameworks across web, mobile, APIs, and microservices
 - Drive automation coverage across functional, integration, regression, and end-to-end testing
 - Test APIs, microservices, and distributed/event-driven systems, including contract and integration validation
 - Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and troubleshoot pipeline failures
 - Support performance, load, and reliability testing for enterprise applications
 - Leverage AI-assisted testing tools to improve test effectiveness and reduce manual effort
 - Contribute to engineering best practices and mentor junior automation engineers

Requirements

- 4+ years of experience in Test Automation, Software Testing, or Quality Engineering, with strong hands-on experience building and maintaining automation frameworks
 - Strong programming skills in Java, Python, TypeScript, JavaScript, or similar languages
 - Hands-on experience with automation tools such as Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, Appium, or equivalent
 - Must have hands-on software development experience at some point in your career. 
 - Strong understanding of API testing, microservices, distributed systems, and modern application architectures
 - Experience with REST APIs, GraphQL, messaging systems, and asynchronous workflows
 - Experience integrating automation into CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or similar tools
 - Hands-on experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and cloud-native environments
 - Familiarity with Kafka/RabbitMQ, Redis, and relational/non-relational databases
 - Experience with performance testing tools such as k6, JMeter, or Gatling
 - Understanding of observability and monitoring tools such as Grafana, Datadog, Prometheus, or OpenTelemetry
 - Strong debugging, troubleshooting, and analytical skills; excellent communication and collaboration skills

What Makes Someone Successful Here

- A framework builder, not just a test writer: you design automation that scales with the platform, not brittle scripts that break every release. 
 - Systems-minded: you understand distributed systems, async workflows, and how services interact - and you test accordingly, not just at the UI layer. 
 - DevOps-fluent: you're comfortable inside CI/CD pipelines, and you troubleshoot pipeline failures as readily as test failures. 
 - Curious about AI-assisted QE: you actively look for ways automation and intelligent tooling can reduce manual effort and sharpen test effectiveness. 
 - A force multiplier: you mentor junior engineers, raise the bar on coding standards, and push an automation-first culture across the team - not just your own backlog. 

What We Offer

data.title: Principal Software Engineer
data.description:
Diligent is the AI leader in governance, risk and compliance (GRC) SaaS solutions, helping more than 1 million users and 700, 000 board members to clarify risk and elevate governance. The Diligent One Platform gives practitioners, the C-Suite and the board a consolidated view of their entire GRC practice so they can more effectively manage risk, build greater resilience and make better decisions, faster. 

At Diligent, we're building the future with people who think boldly and move fast. Whether you're designing systems that leverage large language models or part of a team reimaging workflows with AI, you'll help us unlock entirely new ways of working and thinking. Curiosity is in our DNA, we look for individuals willing to ask the big questions and experiment fearlessly - those who embrace change not as a challenge, but as an opportunity. The future belongs to those who keep learning, and we are building it together. At Diligent, you're not just building the future - you're an agent of positive change, joining a global community on a mission to make an impact. 

A Day in the Life

We're looking for a Principal Software Engineer to help shape the next generation of our enterprise SaaS platform. 

You'll combine deep hands-on engineering with technical leadership, helping teams design scalable systems, modernize our platform and solve complex engineering challenges. 

You'll work across backend, frontend, cloud and AI technologies while defining technical direction and staying close to the engineering work. 

A key part of this role will be driving the adoption of AI-native software engineering practices, including AI-PDLC (AI-enabled Product Development Lifecycle) and Spec-Driven Development, using tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot and other AI coding and agentic development tools. 

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys solving complex problems, designing systems at scale, influencing architecture, establishing modern engineering practices and mentoring experienced engineers. 

Here's a Breakdown Of What You'll Do

- Define and evolve the technical architecture of our SaaS platform and create high-level and low-level designs (HLD/LLD) for complex systems. 
 - Translate business and product requirements into scalable technical designs, implementation plans and engineering deliverables. 
 - Establish and drive Spec-Driven Development, using structured requirements, architecture specifications, API contracts, data models and acceptance criteria to guide development. 
 - Drive adoption of AI-PDLC, integrating AI across requirements, architecture, implementation, testing, code review, deployment and operations. 
 - Establish AI-assisted development workflows using Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot and similar AI coding agents, while maintaining engineering quality, security and architectural consistency. 
 - Design secure, scalable and reliable distributed, microservices and event-driven systems. 
 - Build and evolve backend services and APIs primarily using Node. js/TypeScript and Python, while remaining open to other modern technology stacks. 
 - Contribute to frontend architecture and applications using React, Angular or similar technologies. 
 - Design cloud-native solutions across AWS, Azure, GCP or other major cloud platforms. 
 - Lead platform modernization initiatives and improve scalability, performance, reliability and maintainability. 
 - Use Infrastructure as Code such as Terraform, CloudFormation, CDK or similar technologies to manage cloud infrastructure. 
 - Promote strong engineering practices around CI/CD, testing, observability, security and automation. 
 - Establish practices for AI-assisted code generation, automated testing, AI-assisted code review, code quality validation and continuous evaluation of AI-generated implementations. 
 - Define appropriate guardrails, engineering standards and human-in-the-loop practices for the responsible use of AI coding agents. 
 - Help integrate AI capabilities into our products while considering security, observability, governance and responsible use. 
 - Mentor senior engineers and influence technical decisions across multiple teams. 

What You'll Bring

- 12+ years of experience building and delivering production software. 
 - Strong experience designing and building large-scale SaaS or cloud-based applications. 
 - Strong hands-on backend experience with Node. js/TypeScript and/or Python, with the ability to work across other technology stacks when required. 
 - Strong experience with system design, including both HLD and LLD, and the ability to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions. 
 - Strong understanding of distributed systems, microservices, event-driven architecture, scalability and reliability. 
 - Experience designing and building APIs, backend services and data-intensive applications. 
 - Experience building modern frontend applications using React, Angular or similar frameworks. 
 - Strong experience with at least one major cloud platform such as AWS, Azure or GCP. 
 - Experience with Infrastructure as Code, such as Terraform, CloudFormation, CDK or similar technologies. 
 - Strong understanding of databases, SQL and performance optimization. 
 - Experience with Docker, CI/CD, observability and modern software engineering practices. 
 - Hands-on experience with AI-assisted software development tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot or equivalent AI coding agents. 
 - Experience applying Spec-Driven Development or similar specification-first engineering approaches, using structured requirements, architecture specifications, implementation plans and acceptance criteria to drive development. 
 - Understanding of AI-PDLC and experience integrating AI into multiple stages of the software development lifecycle. 
 - Experience building or integrating AI-powered applications, with an understanding of AI security, observability or governance. 
 - A track record of making architectural decisions, influencing engineering teams and solving complex technical problems. 
 - Strong communication, collaboration and mentoring skills. 

It Would Be Great If You Have

- Experience building enterprise SaaS, multi-tenant or highly distributed platforms. 
 - Experience working across multiple cloud platforms or leading cloud modernization initiatives. 
 - Experience with serverless and event-driven architectures. 
 - Experience working with LLMs, RAG or other AI application patterns. 
 - Experience scaling AI-native engineering practices, including AI-PDLC, Spec-Driven Development and AI-assisted development workflows across teams. 
 - Experience working in security, compliance or regulated environments. 

Creativity is ingrained in our culture. We are innovative collaborators by nature. We thrive in exploring how things can be differently both in our internal processes and to help our clients. We care about our people. Diligent offers a flexible work environment, global days of service, comprehensive health benefits, meeting free days, generous time off policy and wellness programs. (among others) Diversity is important to us. Growing, maintaining and promoting a diverse team is a top priority for us. We foster and encourage diversity through our Employee Resource Groups and provide access to resources and education to support the education of our team, facilitate dialogue, and foster understanding. 

Diligent created the modern governance movement. Our world-changing idea is to empower leaders with the technology, insights and connections they need to drive greater impact and accountability - to lead with purpose. Our employees are passionate, smart, and creative people who not only want to help build the software company of the future, but who want to make the world a more sustainable, equitable and better place. 

Headquartered in New York, Diligent has offices in Washington D. C. , London, Galway, Budapest, Vancouver, Bengaluru, Munich, Singapore and Sydney. To foster strong collaboration and connection, this role will follow a hybrid work model. If you are within a commuting distance to one of our Diligent office locations, you will be expected to work onsite at least 50% of the time. We believe that in-person engagement helps drive innovation, teamwork, and a strong sense of community.

data.description:
Who We Are

Addepar is a global data and AI platform empowering investment professionals to turn complex financial information into actionable intelligence. Addepar unifies portfolio, market and client data in a total portfolio view and delivers AI-powered insights within investment and client workflows. More than 1, 500 firms in 60 countries use Addepar to manage and advise on nearly $10 trillion in assets. Its open platform integrates with 650 software, data and consulting partners to power end-to-end investment operations across firms of all sizes and levels of complexity. Addepar supports clients worldwide with offices in New York City, Salt Lake City, São Paulo, London, Edinburgh, Geneva, Warsaw, Dubai, Pune and Singapore. 

The Role

As a Field Engineer you will embed directly with clients to architect and build mission-critical integrations, automations, and data solutions. Operating at the intersection of engineering and client success, you will serve as Addepar's technical vanguard - translating complex business requirements into production-grade systems while driving onboarding efficiency and operational scale. You will be the technical expert across Addepar's full solution suite - from API integrations and automation frameworks to advanced data platforms (including our white-labeled Databricks offering, ADX) and AI-driven tooling - solving our clients' most challenging problems. This role combines a forward-deployed model with deep technical expertise in modern software engineering and financial data systems. 

Applicants must have legal authorization to work in the country where this role is based on the first day of employment. Visa sponsorship is not available for this position. 

What You'll Do

- Deploy directly to client sites (virtual or in-person) to architect, build, and deliver custom integrations, automations, and data pipelines using Addepar's APIs, ADX (Databricks), and modern engineering tools
 - Design and implement production-grade solutions that dramatically improve client onboarding efficiency, reduce time-to-value, and enable operational scale
 - Build intelligent automation leveraging AI, LLMs, and machine learning to solve complex data transformation, validation, and reconciliation challenges
 - Serve as the technical owner for ADX implementations, designing robust data infrastructure within Databricks to streamline client data onboarding and analytics
 - Translate ambiguous client requirements into flexible, scalable technical solutions through deep discovery, prototyping, and iterative delivery
 - Write production-quality Python code for ETL pipelines, API integrations, data validation frameworks, and automation tooling
 - Lead technical workstreams end-to-end, from requirements gathering through production deployment, owning outcomes and client success
 - Collaborate with Product, Engineering, and Services teams to identify opportunities for productization and influence platform roadmap
 - Develop internal tools, frameworks, and best practices that accelerate delivery across the broader team
 - Effectively set, manage, and communicate technical expectations with both client stakeholders and internal cross-functional teams
 - Prioritize and context-switch effectively across simultaneous client engagements, seeing each through to successful completion
 - Act as a technical advisor and trusted partner to clients, proactively identifying opportunities to drive additional value

Who You Are

- Minimum 3+ years of experience in software engineering, data engineering, or forward-deployed technical roles
 - Advanced proficiency in Python with experience building production-grade applications, APIs, and data pipelines
 - Strong understanding of REST APIs, authentication patterns, and integration architecture
 - Hands-on experience with Databricks, Spark, and distributed data processing frameworks
 - Proficiency in SQL and experience working with large-scale datasets across relational and NoSQL databases
 - Experience designing and implementing ETL/ELT pipelines for complex data transformations
 - Familiarity with AI/ML tools and experience implementing LLM-driven automation solutions
 - Strong understanding of financial data domains including portfolio management, performance analytics, and multi-asset class portfolios
 - Exceptional problem-solving abilities with a solutions-oriented mindset and bias for action
 - Outstanding communication skills with the ability to translate technical concepts for non-technical audiences
 - Proven ability to thrive in ambiguous, fast-paced environments while maintaining high-quality standards
 - Experience with version control (Git), CI/CD pipelines, and modern software development practices
 - Independent, adaptable, and entrepreneurial mindset with a passion for client impact
 - Strong work ethic, proactive approach, and high contributing teammate

Our Values

- Act Like an Owner - Think and operate with intention, purpose and care. Own outcomes. 
 - Build Together - Collaborate to unlock the best solutions. Deliver lasting value. 
 - Champion Our Clients - Exceed client expectations. Our clients' success is our success. 
 - Drive Innovation - Be bold and unconstrained in problem solving. Transform the industry. 
 - Embrace Learning - Engage our community to broaden our perspective. Bring a growth mindset. 

In addition to our core values, Addepar is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We seek to bring together diverse ideas, experiences, skill sets, perspectives, backgrounds and identities to drive innovative solutions. We commit to promoting a welcoming environment where inclusion and belonging are held as a shared responsibility. 

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation. 

PHISHING SCAM WARNING: Addepar is among several companies recently made aware of a phishing scam involving con artists posing as hiring managers recruiting via email, text and social media. The imposters are creating misleading email accounts, conducting remote "interviews, " and making fake job offers in order to collect personal and financial information from unsuspecting individuals. Please be aware that no job offers will be made from Addepar without a formal interview process. Additionally, Addepar will not ask you to purchase equipment or supplies as part of your onboarding process. If you have any questions, please reach out to ta-operations@addepar. com.

data.title: Software Development Manager, Everyday Essentials Experiences
data.description:
Description

Lead an AI first engineering team in Bengaluru that builds the shopping and advertising experiences for Amazon's $100B+ Everyday Essentials business. You'll use brand signals to help hundreds of millions of customers find the products they trust, and to give the world's largest consumer brands new ways to grow with Amazon. 

Everyday Essentials covers the household staples, grocery, beauty, and health and personal care products customers reorder most. Our team builds the experiences that help customers choose with confidence and complete their baskets. We also build the advertising and monetization products that let brands reach those customers in useful, relevant ways. As a Software Development Manager, you'll build and grow a team of software engineers and own these systems from end to end. You'll work with scientists, product managers and designers in India and the US, and your team's ideas will reach customers in weeks, not quarters. 

Key job responsibilities

Build, hire, mentor and grow a high performing team of software engineers in Bengaluru

Lead an AI first engineering culture where your team uses generative AI tools and agents across design, coding, testing, code review and operations to ship faster with higher quality

Set clear standards for how AI is used in development, measure its impact on velocity and quality, and keep your team learning the latest tools and practices

Own the architecture, delivery and operation of shopping and advertising systems that use brand signals to improve customer and business outcomes

Partner with scientists to build AI powered experiences, such as ranking, recommendations and ad relevance, that match customers with the right products and brands

Work with product, science and design partners to define a roadmap that balances customer experience, brand value and EE profitability

Turn ambiguous business problems into simple, scalable solutions, and measure their impact on customers, ad revenue and business economics

Drive operational excellence across availability, latency, security and cost

Communicate strategy, progress and risks clearly to senior leadership and partners in other locations

A day in the life

Most days start with a customer or brand problem: how to help someone find a better everyday essentials product, how to help them fill their basket faster, or how to give a brand a more relevant way to reach the right shopper. You dig into the data with your team, look at a design together, and talk it through with product managers and scientists before anyone writes code. By the afternoon you might be reviewing a prototype your engineers built with AI tools in a day, working through a tradeoff between customer experience and ad revenue, or helping the team get to the root cause of a production issue. In the evening you might connect with partners in the US. So much here is new that your team won't just pick up tickets. You'll help decide what to build, push for the approach you believe in, and see your team's work reach customers in weeks, not quarters. 

About The Team

We build the shopping and advertising experiences for Amazon's Everyday Essentials business: the household staples, grocery, beauty, and health and personal care products customers reorder most. We use brand signals to help customers choose products they trust and fill their baskets faster. We also build the advertising and monetization products that help the world's largest consumer brands reach the right shoppers and grow with Amazon. Our goal is to make shopping for essentials effortless for customers, valuable for brands and more profitable for Amazon. We're a small, fast moving, AI first team that works closely with scientists, product managers and designers in Bengaluru and the US. Teams here own open ended problems from end to end, and good ideas reach hundreds of millions of shoppers quickly. 

Basic Qualifications

- 3+ years of engineering team management experience
 - 7+ years of engineering experience
 - 8+ years of leading the definition and development of multi tier web services experience
 - Knowledge of engineering practices and patterns for the full software/hardware/networks development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, certification, and livesite operations
 - Experience partnering with product or program management teams
 - Experience designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems
 - Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience in communicating with users, other technical teams, and senior leadership to collect requirements, describe software product features, technical designs, and product strategy
 - Experience in recruiting, hiring, mentoring/coaching and managing teams of Software Engineers to improve their skills, and make them more effective, product software engineers

data.description:
Who Are We?

Postman is the world's leading API platform, used by more than 45 million+ developers and 500, 000 organizations, including 98% of the Fortune 500. Postman is helping developers and professionals across the globe build the API-first world by simplifying each step of the API lifecycle and streamlining collaboration-enabling users to create better APIs, faster. 

The company is headquartered in San Francisco and has offices in Boston, New York, Austin, Tokyo, London, and Bangalore - where Postman was founded. Postman is privately held, with funding from Battery Ventures, BOND, Coatue, CRV, Insight Partners, and Nexus Venture Partners. Learn more at postman. com or connect with Postman on X via @getpostman. 

P. S: We highly recommend reading The "API-First World" graphic novel to understand the bigger picture and our vision at Postman. 

The Opportunity

You will be part of Postman's Test Infrastructure team, which powers quality at scale across the company. 

At Postman, we believe that quality is everyone's responsibility. Our team builds the systems, tooling, and infrastructure that enable developers to ship reliable, high-quality products efficiently. From CI/CD pipelines to test frameworks and observability, we focus on improving developer productivity and accelerating feedback loops. 

We're looking for a senior engineer who can help us scale our test infrastructure to meet the next phase of Postman's growth. 

What You'll Do

- Design and build scalable test infrastructure, frameworks, and tooling with a strong engineering-first mindset Collaborate with a small, high-impact team to improve system reliability and developer productivity Own and evolve CI/CD pipelines to optimise performance, cost, and feedback cycles Develop internal tools and frameworks that simplify testing and improve product quality Build and enhance test observability systems, including metrics, dashboards, and insights Drive improvements in test performance, stability, and execution efficiency Champion best practices in testing, reliability, and developer experience across teams Continuously explore and introduce new tools, technologies, and methodologies About You
 - 2 to 5 years of experience building large-scale JavaScript/TypeScript applications Strong fundamentals in software design, systems thinking, and test infrastructure Hands-on experience with test automation frameworks and CI/CD systems Experience building or working with test observability, analytics, or reporting systems Proven track record of owning and delivering complex engineering initiatives Comfortable working with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP Strong communication skills and the ability to influence engineering practices

What Else?

In addition to Postman's pay-on-performance philosophy, and a flexible schedule working with a fun, collaborative team, Postman offers a comprehensive set of benefits, including full medical coverage, flexible PTO, wellness reimbursement, and a monthly lunch stipend. Along with that, our wellness programs will help you stay in the best of your physical and mental health. Our frequent and fascinating team-building events will keep you connected, while our donation-matching program can support the causes you care about. We're building a long-term company with an inclusive culture where everyone can be the best version of themselves. 

At Postman we value in person collaboration. We are in office 5 days a week for all roles based out of our hubs in San Francisco Bay Area, Boston, Austin, New York City, Tokyo and London. For roles based in Bangalore, employees currently work in the office three days a week and will transition to five days per week by the end of the year. We were thoughtful in our approach which is based on collaboration and grounded in feedback from our workforce, leadership team, and peers. The benefits of our in office model will be shared knowledge, brainstorming sessions, communication, and building trust in-person that cannot be replicated via zoom. 

Our Values

At Postman, we create with the same curiosity that we see in our users. We value transparency and honest communication about not only successes, but also failures. In our work, we focus on specific goals that add up to a larger vision. Our inclusive work culture ensures that everyone is valued equally as important pieces of our final product. We are dedicated to delivering the best products we can. 

Equal Opportunity

Postman is an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status. Headhunters and recruitment agencies may not submit resumes/CVs through this website or directly to managers. Postman does not accept unsolicited headhunter and agency resumes. Postman will not pay fees to any third-party agency or company that does not have a signed agreement with Postman.

We're looking for people who put their innovation to work to advance our success - and their own. Join an organization that ensures a more secure world through connecting and protecting our customers with inventive electrical solutions. 

Proposed Role: Lead R&D Engineer

Total Exp: 10 ~ 15 Yrs

Job Description

- Design and develop scalable, modular, and optimized Test Automation Architectures tailored for embedded systems in industrial cooling and power distribution domains. 
 - Define automation standards, patterns, reusable test components, and framework guidelines. 
 - Lead end‐to‐end design of automated test suites
 - nsure comprehensive test coverage across integration, system, regression, and environmental testing. 
 - Define and monitor quality KPIs including: Defect detection efficiency, Automation execution coverage, Protocol timing/throughput metrics, Framework reliability and maintainability
 - Continuously optimize execution time, test reliability, and CI/CD pipeline integration for automated test suites. 
 - Lead by example in complex test strategy decisions and in developing technically challenging automation workflows. 
 - Drive the team toward achieving an accelerated Automation Roadmap with measurable milestones. 

Technical Skills

Required Skills & Experience

10-15 years of experience in Embedded Software Testing, including hands-on automation. 

Strong Expertise In

Python (advanced scripting and framework development), Robot Framework, Selenium for Web UI automation. 

Deep Understanding Of

BSP, bootloaders, kernel-level behavior

Low-level firmware/driver interactions

Embedded protocols (Modbus, CAN, RS485, etc. )

Experience with hardware tools & debugging instruments. 

Strong understanding of CI/CD pipelines

Leadership Skills

Ability to drive technical strategy and automation engineering vision. 

Strong mentoring and team development capabilities. 

Excellent communication, analytical thinking, and cross-functional collaboration. 

Preferred Qualifications

Master's or Bachelor's in Computer Engineering, Electronics, Embedded Systems, or related field. 

ISTQB Certification (optional but beneficial). 

Working knowledge of C/C++ for firmware comprehension. 

We Have

- A dynamic global reach with diverse operations around the world that will stretch your abilities, provide plentiful career opportunities, and allow you to make an impact every day
 - nVent is a leading global provider of electrical connection and protection solutions. We believe our inventive electrical solutions enable safer systems and ensure a more secure world. We design, manufacture, market, install and service high performance products and solutions that connect and protect some of the world's most sensitive equipment, buildings and critical processes. We offer a comprehensive range of systems protection and electrical connections solutions across industry-leading brands that are recognized globally for quality, reliability and innovation. 
 - Our principal office is in London and our management office in the United States is in Minneapolis. Our robust portfolio of leading electrical product brands dates back more than 100 years and includes nVent CADDY, ERICO, HOFFMAN, ILSCO, SCHROFF and TRACHTE. Learn more at www. nvent. com. 

- Commitment to strengthen communities where our employees live and work
 - We encourage and support the philanthropic activities of our employees worldwide
 - Through our nVent in Action matching program, we provide funds to nonprofit and educational organizations where our employees volunteer or donate money

- Core values that shape our culture and drive us to deliver the best for our employees and our customers. We're known for being: 
 - Innovative & adaptable
 - Dedicated to absolute integrity
 - Focused on the customer first
 - Respectful and team oriented
 - Optimistic and energizing
 - Accountable for performance
 - Benefits to support the lives of our employees

At nVent, we connect and protect our customers with inventive electrical solutions. People are our most valuable asset. Inclusion and diversity means that we celebrate and encourage each other's authenticity because we understand that uniqueness sparks growth.

Automation & Reporting Engineer with good experience in Python, VBA, SQL, RPA, Power Automate, Power Apps, Tableau, Power BI, MIS Reporting, and Microsoft Office automation.

The experience we're looking to add to our team:

 - Advanced proficiency in Excel / VBA, and Microsoft Office automation. 
 - Hands-on experience with RPA / Power Automate for workflow automation and business process optimization. 
 - Experience in developing Power Apps solutions, forms, and low-code business applications. 
 - Strong knowledge of SQL for database querying, data extraction, transformation, and reporting. 
 - Strong knowledge of Python programming, including automation scripting, data processing, API integration, reporting, and application development. 
 - Experience in MIS reporting, dashboard creation, and data visualization. 
 - Hands-on experience with Tableau and Power BI for analytics, dashboard development, and business intelligence reporting. 
 - Experience integrating REST APIs, JSON/XML payloads, authentication, and web services. 
 - Knowledge of. NET, SharePoint, and web-based applications is preferred. 
 - Familiarity with AI-assisted automation, OpenAI APIs, Cloud Copilots, and Large Language Models (LLMs). 
 - Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills. 
 - Day shift and flexible to work in Night shift if needed. 

Preferred Skills (Good To Have)

- Experience with MS office Automation / Business process automation, Python automation, REST APIs, JSON/XML, authentication, and integration testing. 
 - Exposure to AI-enabled solutions, cloud copilots, and OpenAI APIs. 
 - Experience in manufacturing or BPO environments is an advantage. 

Here are a few examples of what you will get for the great work you provide:
