data.title: Lead System Architect
data.description:
Meet Our Team

Our Team lives and breathes the Pega delivery vision: quickly building high-quality, outcome-driven applications that evolve with the changing needs of business. As a key member of the Pega Consulting team (GTM), you will work with a passionate and driven project team, delivering new and innovative business and technical solutions using Pega technology. 

Picture Yourself At Pega

Pega is changing the way the world builds software. In this role, you'll help us design, develop, implement and test the next generation customer centric solutions. This is your chance to get your hands-on leading technology that figures out what people really care about. At Pega, we actively explore and embrace emerging AI capabilities with curiosity, responsibility, and a drive for meaningful innovation. You will work in an environment where AI‐enabled tools are used to enhance learning, improve engineering efficiency, and support better decision‐making across the cloud platform. We expect engineers to apply critical thinking to all AI‐generated outputs-validating accuracy, quality, and relevance before applying them in production environments. We view AI maturity as a spectrum, progressing from foundational adoption toward more strategic, advocacy‐driven integration, and you will play an active role in that journey. 

What You'll Do At Pega

- Lead and drive scope definition, requirements analysis, functional and technical design, application build, product configuration, unit testing, UAT and production deployment 
 - Partner with our world leading clients to deliver high-quality technical solutions across all phases of the software development lifecycle 
 - Utilize your outstanding technical consulting skills to demonstrate new and innovative ways to implement software solutions 
 - Collaborating with a high performing Pega delivery team you will ensure the solution meets or exceeds your client's expectations. 
 - Provide support and technical governance focused on one or more projects at a single client 
 - Act as a Subject Matter Expert to the organization and pro-actively respond to adhoc questions

Who You Are

You demonstrate a strong Growth Mindset-embracing curiosity, continuous learning, and adaptability in a fast‐changing technology environment. You are comfortable speaking about AI with confidence and conviction, and you view AI as an enabler to improve outcomes rather than a substitute for sound engineering principles. You challenge assumptions, learn quickly from change, and apply critical thinking to validate outputs and make informed decisions. You bring a thoughtful, quality‐driven approach

What You've Accomplished

- Bring 12+ years of hands-on Pega experience, building and implementing model-driven, enterprise-level business solutions and applications. 
 - Hold a Pega CLSA certification, with deep technical expertise across Pega technologies. 
 - Led end-to-end delivery of medium to large components within complex enterprise solutions. 
 - Worked across application servers, programming languages, relational and non-relational databases, and integration technologies. 
 - Applied strong knowledge of Object-Oriented concepts, techniques, and principles in solution delivery. 
 - Managed multiple priorities and complex deliverables through strong planning, organization, and time-management skills. 
 - Collaborated effectively with business and IT stakeholders, translating complex technical concepts into clear and practical solutions. 
 - Demonstrated the ability to quickly learn and apply new technologies and concepts. 
 - Delivered strong customer outcomes through ownership, collaboration, and a team-oriented approach. 
 - Demonstrated a proactive mindset and the ability to lead by example and go the extra mile. 
 - Comfortable working 1: 00 PM to 10: 00 PM IST. 

Pega Offers You

- Gartner Analyst acclaimed technology leadership across our categories of products 
 - Continuous learning and development opportunities 
 - An innovative, inclusive, agile, flexible, and fun work environment 
 - Competitive global benefits program inclusive of pay and bonus incentive, employee equity in the company 
 - An opportunity to work in an organization that actively invests in AI‐enabled learning, innovation, and responsible adoption across its engineering practices

data.description:
Engineering Manager: Job description

What you'll be doing: 

This is an opportunity in which you will be responsible for overall implementation and delivery of projects and programmes, bringing new capabilities to the market, or implementing large scale change to existing products, covering the full lifecycle. You will oversee/manage the technical delivery management for a business area. You will supervise and coordinate the development teams (both internal employees and external partners) during their implementation. You will work closely with the businesses to understand their business objectives, product strategies and roadmaps and requirements so they can be continually translated into prioritised technology deliverables. 15 - 18 years of relevant Experience. 

Web development, with experience in JavaScript frameworks

Cloud Integrations, Security

ECS/EKS, API Gateways, Route53/F5, VPC/ELB, REST / SOAP frameworks

Airflow, Glue, Lambdas, Redshift - with Node/Python. 

- Liaise with business/data analysts and business stakeholders to review new requirements and enhancements and help identify the best technical solution for the data ingestion/distribution tasks
 - Design data extraction and transformation logic based on prevailing ETL/ELT technologies, languages and open-source frameworks (e. g. , Python, Airflow, AWS Data Wrangler, AWS SageMaker, AWS EMR, AWS Glue etc. )
 - Supervise, coach and monitor the development teams and vendors in the implementation of designed data pipelines and transformations
 - Ensure all the data extraction and transformation jobs are successfully scheduled and executed, to guarantee data timeliness and quality
 - Design, build and run data quality metrics for early identification of anomalies and erroneous data pipeline executions
 - Report progress, risks and issues to the line manager and other relevant stakeholders (e. g. , business users, senior management team, leadership team etc)
 - Evaluate new trends and technologies in the market and prepare suggestions and recommendations to be presented to the line manager and other members of the senior management team

- Drive a culture of collaborative reviews of designs, code and test plans. 
 - Ability to arrive at actionable insights leveraging the pro-active or pre-emptive measures and algorithms around the data driven decision. 

What we're looking for: 

- Excellent understanding of enterprise data warehousing principles and ETL/ELT solutions
 - Flexible and able to adjust to changing priorities in a fast-paced environment. 
 - Experience working on or with API's for data delivery/ingestion, e. g. , REST APIs, GraphQL, etc. 
 - Experience working on or with batch-based data delivery/ingestion paradigms, e. g. , csv files, ODBC connections, etc. 
 - Experience in Code management tools (GitHub) Build and Deployment tool (TravisCI). 
 - Excellent knowledge and working experience on data management technologies and frameworks, preferably on Python, Airflow, AWS API Gateway, SNS, SQS, Lambda
 - Good understanding of Lambda and Kappa Architecture patterns
 - Ability to work with large and complex data sets, data lakes and data warehouses
 - SQL query skills. Hands-on experience with AWS Redshift, PostgreSQL and other database technologies like MySQL, Microsoft SQL Server, etc. and ability to write complex queries to extract/inject data into those databases
 - Proven ability to manage a team of developers and to work in an objective oriented environment
 - Experience with Agile methodology including WIP management, backlog grooming/prioritisation, reporting and dashboards.

The role includes supervising quality assurance staff, conducting regular audits of raw materials and finished products, and ensuring compliance with national and international food safety regulations and certifications. data.description:
Department: Engineering

Location: Ahmedabad/GiftCity

Description

Trading Technologies is looking for a highly skilled and technically creative Senior Penetration Tester to join our internal Offensive Security (Offsec) team. Reporting directly to the Offensive Security Manager, you will be the technical tip of the spear in proactively identifying and exploiting vulnerabilities across our entire technology estate. 

In this senior technical role, you will lead complex, full-stack security assessments ranging from modern web applications and complex APIs to cloud infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, and deep-dive Active Directory environments. Beyond breaking things, you will partner closely with our engineering teams to ensure vulnerabilities are understood and effectively remediated, while also serving as a technical mentor to the broader security team. 

Key Responsibilities

- Comprehensive Penetration Testing: Lead and execute advanced, end-to-end penetration tests across TT's entire technology ecosystem, including complex web applications, microservices, REST/WebSocket APIs, internal network infrastructure, and thick-client trading applications. 
 - Cloud & DevOps Security: Conduct targeted assessments against our cloud infrastructure (e. g. , AWS, GCP) and containerized environments. Actively test and identify misconfigurations or vulnerabilities within our CI/CD pipelines to secure our software supply chain. 
 - Infrastructure & Active Directory: Execute internal network penetration tests, including advanced Active Directory abuse and exploitation (e. g. , Kerberoasting, lateral movement, privilege escalation) to identify internal structural weaknesses. 
 - Actionable Reporting: Produce comprehensive, high-quality technical reports that clearly articulate vulnerabilities, demonstrate business impact via proof-of-concepts (PoCs), and provide realistic, actionable remediation guidance for engineering teams. 
 - Remediation Support: Partner with the Offensive Security Manager and Engineering teams to validate fixes, provide technical clarity on vulnerabilities, and participate in threat modeling or architectural reviews as a subject matter expert. 
 - Tooling & Automation: Develop custom scripts, exploits, or automation tools to streamline internal penetration testing methodologies and improve the efficiency of the Offsec team. 
 - Technical Mentorship: Serve as a technical leader within the team, mentoring junior/mid-level testers, sharing cutting-edge research, and elevating the team's overall technical proficiency. 

Essential Qualifications

Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

- Extensive Experience: 7+ years of hands-on experience in penetration testing, offensive security, or red teaming. 
 - Application & API Expertise: Deep understanding of modern web application and API vulnerabilities (OWASP Top 10, CWEs), authentication protocols (OAuth, SAML), and testing methodologies. 
 - Infrastructure Mastery: Proven experience with network penetration testing, bypassing network segmentation, and conducting complex Active Directory exploitation (using tools like BloodHound, Impacket, Mimikatz, etc. ). 
 - Cloud & CI/CD Proficiency: Strong understanding of cloud-native architectures, containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and experience finding security flaws in DevOps pipelines (GitLab, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, etc. ). 
 - Tooling & Scripting: Expert-level proficiency with industry-standard offensive tools (e. g. , Burp Suite Pro, Metasploit, Cobalt Strike, Nmap). Strong programming/scripting abilities in Python, Bash, Go, or PowerShell to write custom tooling or modify exploits. 
 - Communication Skills: Exceptional ability to translate highly technical findings into clear, business-focused risks for both technical and non-technical stakeholders. 

Desirable Qualifications: 

- Industry Certifications: Highly regarded offensive security certifications such as OSCP, OSWE, OSEP, CRTO, GXPN, or equivalent. 
 - FinTech Experience: Previous experience testing high-frequency trading platforms, financial technology, or heavily regulated environments. 
 - Community Involvement: A track record of independent vulnerability research, published CVEs, active bug bounty participation, or speaking engagements at security conferences (DEFCON, Black Hat, BSides). 

Benefits

Competitive Benefits & Perks in India We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. 

- Health & Financial Security: 
 - Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage
 - Time Off & Flexibility: 
 - Enjoy the best of both worlds: the energy and collaboration of in-person work, combined with the convenience and focus of remote days. This is a hybrid position requiring three days of in-office collaboration per week, with the flexibility to work remotely for the remaining two days. Our hybrid model is designed to balance individual flexibility with the benefits of in-person collaboration, enhanced team cohesion, spontaneous innovation, hands-on mentorship opportunities and strengthens our company culture. 
 - 21 days of Paid Time Off (PTO) per year, with the option to roll over unused days. 
 - One dedicated day per year for volunteering. 
 - Two professional development days per year to allow uninterrupted professional development. 
 - An additional PTO day is added during milestone anniversary years. 
 - Robust paid holiday schedule with early dismissal. 
 - Generous parental leave for all parents (including adoptive parents). 
 - Work-Life Support & Resources: 
 - Budget for tech accessories, including monitors, headphones, keyboards, and other office equipment. 
 - Milestone anniversary bonuses. 
 - Wellness & Lifestyle Perks: 
 - Subsidy contributions toward gym memberships and health/wellness initiatives. 
 - Our Culture: 
 - Forward-thinking, culture-based organization with collaborative teams that promote diversity and inclusion. Trading Technologies (www. tradingtechnologies. com) is a global capital markets platform services company providing market-leading technology for the end-to-end trading operations of Tier 1 banks, brokerages, money managers, hedge funds, proprietary traders, Commodity Trading Advisors (CTAs), commercial hedgers, and risk managers. With its roots in listed derivatives, the Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) company delivers "multi-X" solutions, with "X" representing asset classes, functions, workflows, and geographies. This multi-X approach features trade execution services across futures and options, fixed income, foreign exchange (FX), and cryptocurrencies, augmented by solutions for data and analytics, including transaction cost analysis (TCA); quantitative trading; compliance and trade surveillance; clearing and post-trade allocation; and infrastructure services. The award-winning TT platform ecosystem also helps exchanges deliver innovative solutions to their market participants and technology companies to distribute their complementary offerings to Trading Technologies' clients. 

Trading Technologies is backed by leading global investment firms Thoma Bravo, one of the world's largest and most experienced software investors, and 7Ridge, a global growth equity firm focused on technology-enabled businesses. 

This investment supports Trading Technologies' continued focus on product innovation, platform scalability, and long-term growth for customers and partners worldwide.

And we're doing so sustainably, for today and tomorrow. 

Having opened Australia's first and largest hyperscale data centres in 2017, we set our eyes on rapid expansion and now operate a platform of hyperscale data centres across the APJ region. With backing from our investors, including Blackstone, this is just the beginning. . . 

Come join the A-Team at AirTrunk, where the cloud meets the ground. 

A Snapshot

This role should be positioned primarily as an Azure Cloud and DevOps support role, with secondary responsibility for integration coding. The ideal candidate is strong in Azure operations, DevOps pipelines, automation, monitoring, incident resolution, and production support, while also being capable of working on APIs and integration-related development when required. 

You will work within the Integration Practice, collaborating with solution architects, product owners, and application/data teams to ship secure, scalable, observable integrations, fast. 

Your Day to Day

Build & DevOps (Engineering at Scale)

- Manage, support, and troubleshoot Azure cloud environments. 
 - Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions or similar tools. 
 - Support production systems, incidents, deployments, and environment issues. 
 - Work with Azure services such as App Services, Functions, Logic Apps, Service Bus, Storage, Key Vault, Azure SQL, API Management, and Entra ID. 
 - Implement monitoring, alerting, logging, and operational dashboards. 
 - Automate infrastructure and operational tasks using scripts, IaC, or DevOps tooling. 
 - Support integration platforms, APIs, and data flows between systems. 
 - Perform root cause analysis and improve system reliability. 
 - Collaborate with developers, architects, vendors, and business teams to resolve issues. 
 - Ensure cloud environments follow security, governance, and operational best practices

Architecture & Solution Design

- Own end‐to‐end integration architecture for features and platforms (E2E flows, domain boundaries, data contracts, and runtime topologies). 
 - Design API-first solutions (REST/GraphQL/SOAP), event-driven integrations, and streaming patterns using best-fit services (e. g. , Azure API Management, Service Bus, Event Grid; or equivalent on AWS/GCP). 
 - Select patterns and standards (synchronous vs. async, choreography vs. orchestration, pub/sub, idempotency, retries, DLQs, exactly-once/at-least-once). 
 - Embed security by design (OAuth2/OIDC, mTLS, key rotation, secret management, data protection at rest/in transit). 

Integration Engineering (TypeScript-first)

- Build integration services, adapters, and APIs-primarily in TypeScript/Node. js-using modern patterns and robust error handling, resilience, and observability. 
 - Implement data transformation (JSON, XML, Avro), mapping, validation, and schema governance; ensure performance, reliability, and scalability. 

AI‐Assisted & Agentic Engineering

- Use AI coding agents to accelerate delivery (code generation, test scaffolding, PR suggestions, refactors, documentation). 
 - Apply agentic frameworks such as LangChain (or similar) for developer tooling, automation, and integration observability/ops augmentation where appropriate. 
 - Contribute patterns for responsible AI use (guardrails, review flows, IP protection, secret hygiene). 

Stakeholder Engagement (Forward‐Deployed)

- Work directly with stakeholders to refine requirements, run technical workshops, and translate business needs into architecture and executable backlogs. 
 - Produce high‐quality technical artefacts (diagrams, ADRs, sequence diagrams, API specs/Contracts, runbooks). 
 - Mentor engineers, conduct peer reviews, and uplift engineering standards across teams. 

Reliability, Security, and Operations

- Build observable services (structured logging, metrics, traces-e. g. , OpenTelemetry), dashboards, and alerts. 
 - Lead incident response and RCA; drive corrective and preventative actions. 
 - Ensure compliance with enterprise security, data privacy, and audit requirements. 

Requirements

Essential: 

- 5+ years in software/integration engineering, with extensive hands-on DevOps and technical architecture experience. 
 - Proven delivery on Azure and familiarity with AWS and/or GCP equivalents. 
 - Expert in CI/CD pipeline engineering (Azure DevOps / GitHub Actions; or CodePipeline/Cloud Build): multi-stage pipelines, approvals, environments, secrets, quality gates, artifact promotion, and progressive delivery. 
 - Strong TypeScript/Node. js engineering, including test automation (unit, integration, contract testing with Pact or equivalent), performance testing, and secure coding practices. 
 - Deep knowledge of Git (branching strategies, PR workflows), Docker, API design (REST/GraphQL/SOAP), and data formats (JSON, XML). 
 - Hands-on with event-driven architectures and messaging (Azure Service Bus/Event Grid, Kafka, or SNS/SQS). 
 - Proficient with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform/Bicep) and configuration management. 
 - Solid understanding of API Management (Azure APIM, Kong, Apigee, or equivalent), observability (logs/metrics/traces), and SRE practices (SLIs/SLOs, error budgets). 
 - Comfortable engaging directly with stakeholders (product, domain SMEs, vendors) and operating as a forward‐deployed engineer. 
 - Strong problem-solving, debugging, and performance tuning skills across distributed systems. 
 - Experience working in Agile and hybrid environments; excellent written and verbal communication. 

Desirable

- Knowledge of serverless integration patterns (Azure Functions/Lambda) and Kubernetes (AKS/EKS/GKE). 
 - Security expertise: OAuth2/OIDC, mTLS, JWT, WAF, secrets management (Key Vault/Secrets Manager), certificate lifecycle. 
 - Exposure to ERP/CRM/HRIS/data platforms (e. g. , SAP, Salesforce, Workday, Snowflake, Databricks). 
 - AI/agentic frameworks (e. g. , LangChain, Semantic Kernel, or similar) for developer productivity or integration automation. 
 - Experience with DevSecOps tooling (SonarQube, Snyk/Dependabot, OWASP ZAP, Trivy, kube-bench). 
 - Global or APAC program experience; certifications in Azure/AWS/GCP or integration platforms. 

Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT, Engineering, or related discipline (or equivalent practical experience). 
 - Global or APAC experience a benefit. 

The AirTrunk Culture

Working at AirTrunk is a once in a lifetime opportunity to fast-track your career and amplify your impact. Whilst you're helping scale our region's digital future, we'll help you Grow@Hyperscale and unleash your full potential. 

The pace in which we operate means you'll feel an electric atmosphere at AirTrunk. We are a team of challengers and collaborative problem solvers who break new ground every day. We do this by living our values, going above and beyond, and being dynamic, transparent, and responsive. 

Every AirTrunker brings their own unique background and diverse perspective to find solutions to problems that matter. We make sure you have everything you need to make your mark and thrive in a flexible and safe working environment, where everyone feels welcome. Our benefits empower AirTrunkers to stay positively charged.

Role Overview

The Cloud Platform Engineering (CPE) organization is responsible for delivering secure, scalable, resilient, and standardized enterprise data platform capabilities across multi-cloud environments. This role is a platform engineering and operations position (Officer level) focused on: 

- Platform enablement and standardization
 - Cloud infrastructure and data platform operations
 - Governance, risk, and compliance alignment
 - Automation and operational excellence

The position emphasizes run-based ownership, platform lifecycle management, and cross-functional collaboration, and is not a software development role. 

Core Responsibilities

 - Ensure high availability, resiliency, and performance of cloud-based data platforms
 - Drive standardization of platform configurations, deployment patterns, and operational controls
 - Support platform lifecycle activities: provisioning, onboarding, upgrades, patching, and decommissioning
 - Infrastructure as Code (IaC) & Automation

 - Architecture and configuration documentation
 - Standardize onboarding guides and platform usage patterns
 - Ensure operational transparency and knowledge sharing across teams
 - Stakeholder & Cross-Functional Collaboration
 - Partner with: 
 - Architecture teams
 - Security & Risk
 - Application and Data Engineering teams
 - Cloud platform providers and vendors
 - Act as a platform SME, enabling adoption across enterprise teams
 - Contribute to platform strategy and roadmap discussions

Required Qualifications

- 10+ years of experience in cloud platform engineering / data platform operations
 - Strong hands-on experience with: 
 - Microsoft Azure and/or AWS
 - Terraform (Infrastructure as Code)
 - Azure DevOps (CI/CD pipelines)
 - Strong scripting and automation expertise: 
 - Bash / PowerShell / Python / REST APIs
 - Solid understanding of: 
 - Cloud data platforms (e. g. , Snowflake, Databricks ecosystems)
 - Networking, security, and cloud architecture patterns
 - Proven experience in: 
 - Production support environments (L2/L3 support)
 - Incident management and RCA processes
 - Strong knowledge of: 
 - RBAC, IAM, encryption, governance, compliance frameworks
 - Excellent communication, documentation, and stakeholder engagement skills

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience in Financial Services / regulated environments (e. g. , FFIEC, SOC2, etc. )
 - Exposure to multi-tenant or shared enterprise platform models
 - Experience supporting SaaS-based data platforms
 - Familiarity with: 
 - Snowflake ecosystem
 - Data governance tooling
 - Observability and monitoring frameworks
 - Experience working in customer-facing or consulting roles
 - Awareness of AI/ML-driven automation and platform efficiencies
 - Experience in platform onboarding, enablement, and adoption programs

Leadership & Behavioural Competencies

- Strong ownership mindset with accountability for platform stability and outcomes
 - Ability to operate effectively in a controlled, process-driven enterprise environment
 - Strong collaboration and influencing skills across global teams
 - High attention to documentation quality, audit readiness, and governance alignment
 - Continuous focus on automation, efficiency, and operational improvement

Success Measures

- Consistent achievement of SLA/SLO targets for platform uptime and reliability
 - Measurable reduction in: 
 - Manual operational tasks
 - Sev-1 and critical incidents
 - Improved platform onboarding time and user adoption
 - Enhanced automation coverage and operational efficiency
 - Demonstrable cloud cost optimization and governance adherence
 - Strong audit outcomes with minimal compliance gaps

Additional Notes

This role is part of the Cloud Platform Engineering (CPE) organization

Core Focus Areas Include: 

Platform enablement

Governance and controls

Operational excellence

Code development is not expected; emphasis is on infrastructure, automation, and operations

CPE delivers runbooks and operational guidance (no application code reviews)

Customer

data.title: Senior Emulation Engineer
data.description:
About Axiado Corporation

Axiado is redefining how AI infrastructure gets secured and managed. Founded in 2019, we're a fast-growing, well-funded team of over 180 people worldwide, building the Trusted Control/Compute Unit (TCU), a new class of semiconductor that integrates hardware security, real-time platform management, and AI-driven optimization. Our TCU-based Platform Efficiency Controller is shipping hardware that makes AI servers measurably more efficient, more secure, and more reliable, and we're extending that foundation into a hardware-anchored management fabric that scales from a single board to the whole fleet. 

Backed by strong funding and validated by commercial programs with Tier 1 industry leaders, Axiado has earned recognition through numerous industry awards, including the 2026 AI in Cybersecurity Innovation Award from TMCnet, a Diamond award for Zero Trust Solution of the Year at the 2026 Pinnacle Awards, and Gold at the 2026 Cybersecurity Excellence Awards for AI Security Solution, as well as being a finalist for the Start-Up to Watch Award from the Global Semiconductor Alliance. We're small enough that every person's work visibly shapes the company, and we look for people who want to build, not just execute. Every employee holds equity, meaning your work directly builds your stake in the company's future, not just a paycheck. If you want to help define what comes next, let's talk. 

Job Description

The Senior Emulation Engineer position is your opportunity to join one of the industry's leading companies in platform security management and ransomware detection for cloud datacenters, 5G infrastructure and disaggregated compute ecosystems. We are looking for an emulation engineer to run and debug system-level workloads on Synopsys ZeBu emulation platforms and to own the integration and bring-up of transactors (XTORs) that connect the emulated SoC to real and virtual interfaces. Your focus is what happens once the design is running: getting the interfaces alive, executing firmware, OS, and use-case validation, triaging failures, and finding issues before silicon. This role is critical for validating the interoperability of our design with commercial AI servers, and for bridging the gap between hardware and software, as well as supporting SW development. 

Key Responsibilities

Runtime validation

- Execute and debug system-level tests, firmware, and software workloads on ZeBu emulation models
 - Bring up and validate secure boot flows (ROM, bootloader, Linux/RTOS) and platform security features such as root of trust, attestation, and firmware update on the emulated SoC
 - Develop and run use-case scenarios covering platform security management, ransomware detection workloads, and datacenter/5G traffic patterns
 - Triage failures and isolate root cause across RTL, firmware, driver, testbench, XTOR, and emulation environment; produce clear, reproducible bug reports
 - Use ZeBu runtime debug capabilities (waveform capture, triggers, memory/register access, checkpoint/restore, force/release) to debug efficiently at speed
 - Run and manage long-running regressions and soak tests; track pass rates, failure trends, and run-to-run stability
 - Perform power-aware and performance validation runs: activity capture, bandwidth/latency profiling, and use-case benchmarking

XTOR integration and bring-up

- Integrate and configure ZeBu transactors and speed adapters (PCIe, CXL, Ethernet, NVMe, DDR/LPDDR, I2C/I3C/SMBus, SPI, UART, JTAG, etc. ) at the testbench and runtime level
 - Bring up XTOR-to-DUT links from first connectivity through link training, enumeration, and stable data traffic; resolve protocol-level and configuration issues
 - Develop host-side software and drivers that control XTORs (C/C++, Python, SystemVerilog DPI, ZeBu API), including connections to real devices, virtual peripherals, or hybrid platforms
 - Debug XTOR-related failures using protocol analyzers, waveforms, and logs; determine whether the issue lies in the DUT, the XTOR, clocking/speed-adapter configuration, or the host
 - Tune XTOR configuration for throughput, latency, and emulation-frequency compatibility
 - Maintain XTOR configuration, version control, and documentation across model releases
 - Configure host servers, boot environments to interact with the emulated design
 - Integrate, develop and debug transactors, bridges and protocol adapters as needed
 - Debug and root-cause embedded HW, SW and test failures in emulation
 - Collaborate with RTL, DV and SW teams to resolve system level bugs

Qualifications

- BS or MS degrees or higher in EE, CE or related fields
 - 7+ years of hands-on experience in prototyping, emulation, SOC design and validation
 - Self-driven, good problem solving and communication skills
 - Hands-on experience running and debugging designs on Synopsys ZeBu (or comparable emulators such as Palladium or Veloce), including runtime control (NGTB or C based), waveform capture, and checkpoint/restore
 - Experience integrating and debugging high-speed and low-speed interfaces
 - Familiarity with embedded software bring-up and bootloader/kernel interactions
 - Proficiency with scripting languages (Python, Perl, TCL) for automation
 - Preferred qualifications include: experience in design verification, hardware/software co-simulation, Linux device drivers, bare-metal FW or boot loaders

Additional Information

Axiado is committed to attracting, developing, and retaining the highest caliber talent in a diverse and multifaceted environment. We are headquartered in the heart of Silicon Valley, with access to the world's leading research, technology and talent. 

We are building an exceptional team to secure every node on the internet. For us, solving real-world problems takes precedence over purely theoretical problems. As a result, we prefer individuals with persistence, intelligence and high curiosity over pedigree alone. Working hard and smart, continuous learning and mutual support are all part of who we are. 

Axiado is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Axiado does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status or any other basis covered by appropriate law. All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need.

- Design and develop lightweight, high-performance Java agents that collect data from JVMs and other systems in customer production environments, with minimal overhead. 
 - Build low-level data collection using JMX/MBeans, Java instrumentation (java. lang. instrument / bytecode instrumentation), sockets (TCP/UDP) and NIO.

 - JVM internals: class loading, memory areas, JIT. 
 - Garbage collection & memory management: GC algorithms, tuning, memory leak analysis. 
 - Socket programming & File I/O / NIO: TCP/UDP sockets, buffers, channels and selectors. 
 - JMX / MBeans for monitoring and management. 
 - Java instrumentation: Java agents, java. lang. instrument, bytecode manipulation (e. g. , ByteBuddy or ASM). 
 - Thread dump and heap dump analysis - hands-on troubleshooting experience.

 - Proven ability to work both independently and as part of a collaborative team, with strong curiosity to learn new technologies and domains quickly.

data.title: Robotics & Automation Engineer
data.description:
Job Description Summary

We are seeking a proactive and skilled Robotics & Automation Engineer to join our Power Transformer manufacturing team. In this factory-based role, you will bridge mechanical processes and digital controls, designing and deploying sophisticated automated systems to optimize production. You will be instrumental in driving the digital transformation of our facility, ensuring that robotics solutions are scalable, safe, and seamlessly integrated into our existing operational ecosystem. 

Job Description

Roles and Responsibilities

- Project Lifecycle Management: Oversee robotics and automation initiatives from conceptualization and business case development through design, testing, commissioning, and final handover. 
 - Process Optimization: Analyze manual manufacturing workflows in collaboration with cross-functional teams to identify and execute high-impact automation opportunities using Lean principles. 
 - Operational Integration: Partner with factory operators to develop intuitive, efficient solutions that meet operational needs, improve productivity, and enhance safety standards. 
 - Digital Connectivity: Serve as the primary liaison between operations and IT/OT teams to integrate robotic systems with enterprise platforms, including SAP, MES, and Windchill, using standard industrial data protocols (e. g. , OPC UA, MQTT). 
 - Strategic Contribution: Assist in the development and execution of the factory's long-term automation and digitalization roadmap, ensuring alignment with broader business and technology objectives. 
 - Vendor Management: Manage external vendors and system integrators; oversee the procurement of robotic hardware and ensure SLA compliance for post-installation support. 
 - Capability Building: Design and deliver training programs for shop-floor operators and maintenance technicians to ensure the sustainable adoption and troubleshooting of new automated systems. 
 - A job at this level is likely to be an individual contributor with proven interpersonal skills or an early people leader who can hire and develop talent. Provides informal guidance to new team members

Required Qualifications

- Education: Bachelor's degree in mechanical, Electrical, Automation, Mechatronics, or a related engineering field. 
 - Professional Experience: 5+ years of experience delivering robotics and automation projects within industrial manufacturing environments. Experience with heavy electrical equipment is highly valued. 
 - Technical Proficiency: 
 - Expertise in sophisticated PLC programming. 
 - Practical application of machine learning for robotic control and system design. 
 - Deep understanding of industrial safety standards and protocols. 
 - Methodologies: Knowledge of Lean Manufacturing principles; experience facilitating Kaizen workshops and tracking the effectiveness of continuous improvement initiatives. 
 - Communication: Strong verbal and written communication skills in English, with the ability to translate technical requirements for diverse stakeholders. 
Desired Characteristics

- Software & Coding: Proficiency in C/C++, Python, and MATLAB/Simulink. 
 - Hardware Expertise: Hands-on experience with robot controllers and tooling (e. g. , FANUC, ABB, KUKA, UR). 
 - Vision & Sensing: Familiarity with vision systems and sensor integration for precision assembly. 
 - Innovation: Demonstrated ability to translate innovative concepts into functional prototypes and full-scale deployments. 
 - Problem-Solving: Advanced analytical capabilities, including experience with Lean/Six Sigma principles to resolve complex manufacturing challenges. 
 - Industry Context: Previous experience in assembly-based, high-voltage, or heavy-duty manufacturing environments. 

Additional Information

Relocation Assistance Provided: Yes

Job Title: Senior Engineering Manager

 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with keen attention to detail. 
 - Executive-level communication and stakeholder management skills; excellent communication, collaboration and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively in cross-functional and global teams. 

Required Technical Skills

- Proven experience developing robust APIs using Microsoft . NET C#, ASP. NET MVC and . NET Core / modern . NET. 
 - Strong expertise in Entity Framework and LINQ for efficient data access and manipulation.

 - Hands-on experience with SQL Server, including performance tuning and query optimization. 
 - Solid understanding of the SDLC and familiarity with JIRA, GitHub and CI/CD pipelines.

Hands-on architect for embeddable web components - code that renders securely inside third-party sites and mobile apps you don't control. You'll set the standards and prove out the hardest embedding problems in code yourself.

- Knowledge and experience with AI, with the purpose of improving efficiency
 - Experience from a workplace that produces financial software, uses investment management software, has a global workforce, and distributed teams
 - Personal accountability and initiative. When something is unclear, you dig in rather than waiting for someone to hand you an answer. You are comfortable making decisions with incomplete information, and you follow through.

Attractive salary, bonus scheme, and pension are essential for any work agreement. However, in SimCorp we believe we can offer more. Simcorp does offer opportunities for professional development: there is never just only one route - we offer an individual approach to professional development to support the direction you want to take. 

NEXT STEPS

Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible, we process incoming applications continually. Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed. At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. Who We Are

For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world's leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 3, 000+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, educations, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds. 

SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of the Deutsche Börse Group. Following the recent merger with Axioma, we leverage the combined strength of our brands to provide an industry-leading, full, front-to-back offering for our clients. 

SimCorp is an equal opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, without regard to race, gender, age, disability, or any other protected status under applicable law. Job Description

Title: Senior Developer - Azure Full Stack / Custom Business Applications - Husky, Guindy, (Chennai)

Type: FullTime

Location: Chennai, India

We are dedicated to offering our customers the highest quality products and services and are looking for people with the inspiration and talent to develop with us as we pursue our ambitious growth strategy. We are a leader in developing state-of-the-art technology and it is this technology base that uniquely positions us to serve customers who seek differentiation through solutions that provide speed, flexibility and maximum productivity. This capability is at the core of our mission and competitive strategy. 

Husky TechnologiesTM offers a wealth of opportunity for personal growth and development. Most importantly, Husky Technologies TM offers an opportunity to work with - and be challenged by - a team of great people. Our success is possible because of the creativity, intelligence and passion of our people around the world and their desire to lead change. At the same time, we are not afraid to expect a lot and strive for leadership in all of our key markets. We are a company taking on new challenges and for the right people this means exceptional career development opportunities, the chance to be part of a team that is the best in the world at what we do and the experience that comes from working in an environment that demands constant transformation and innovation. 

Husky TechnologiesTM is an exciting company with tremendous potential. We have a great team and great expectations. If you are attracted to bold goals, believe in uncompromising honesty, support mutual respect, care about environmental responsibility, have a passion for excellence and a desire to make a positive contribution - then we want you to join the Husky TechnologiesTM team!

Job Description

Do you want to build custom business applications that directly support and improve how the company operates every day -from launching new capabilities to keeping critical systems stable and evolving?

As Senior Developer in our Custom Business Applications team, you'll work hands-on across an Azure full-stack to design, implement, and evolve applications that support core business processes. You'll own complex implementations at component and module level, ensure high quality and reliability, and help keep business-critical systems stable while they continue to evolve. 

This role is ideal for an experienced engineer who enjoys turning business requirements into robust, production-ready software, solving nontrivial technical problems, and contributing to a healthy codebase. 

If you want your work to have direct impact on real business operations, this role lets you see the results of your code every day. 

Responsibilities

Technical Implementation

- Understand and implement solutions based on the defined LLD (low level design). 
 - Own complex implementations at component/module level. 
 - Ensure correctness, performance, security, and maintainability of delivered solutions. 
 - Make sound technical decisions within assigned scope, escalating broader design concerns as needed. 

Delivery & Execution Excellence

- Translate approved requirements and designs into working software. 
 - Break down assigned features into actionable tasks. 
 - Provide reliable estimates for owned work. 
 - Deliver high-quality increments aligned with sprint goals. 
 - Proactively resolve technical issues within assigned scope. 

Quality, Standards & Engineering Practices

- Write code that is reliable, readable, and maintainable, and follow the team's agreed standards and best practices
 - Participate in meaningful code reviews. 
 - Ensure adherence to DoR (Definition of Ready) and DoD (Definition of Done) criteria. 
 - Identify and address technical debt within owned components/module. 

Incident & Operational Support

- Troubleshoot and resolve complex defects and production issues. 
 - Contribute to root cause analysis and long-term fixes. 
 - Ensure adequate logging and observability in implemented components. 

Collaboration & Mentorship

- Collaborate closely with Tech Leads, Architects, Product Owners, QA, and Platform teams. 
 - Support and mentor junior and mid-level developers. 
 - Contribute to continuous improvement within the team. 

Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, IT, or related field. 
 - 5+ years professional experience in software development. 
 - Experience with programming languages like C#, PowerShell, JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, or others relevant to Azure development. 
 - Experience using Microsoft . NET, Angular, or similar frontend frameworks. 
 - Experience working with web services / APIs (e. g. , REST). 
 - Experience with SQL or NoSQL databases, particularly those offered on Azure. 
 - Proficiency in using various Azure services like Azure App Service, Azure Functions, Azure Cosmos DB, Azure Storage, etc. 
 - Understanding and knowledge of cloud security best practices. 
 - Clean Code Development and working experience with Unit Testing, and Test-driven Development. 
 - Familiarity with source code version control, branching strategies, CI/CD pipelines and other DevSecOps practices. 
 - Working knowledge of Agile development practices. 
 - Excellent communication skills and ability to work in a team. 
 - Fluency in English (spoken and written). 
 - Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail. 
 - Ability to adjust quickly to changing assignments, and priorities. 

Assets

- Experience using AI assisted coding tools (e. g. GitHub Copilot) responsibly, with full accountability for code quality, security, and compliance. 
 - Experience working with and contributing to UX designs. 
 - Hands‐on experience designing and operating event‐driven systems using Event Sourcing and CQRS. 
 - Experience with React, Next. js, GraphQL, and TypeScript. 
 - Working experience with infrastructure as code (IaC) tools such as Terraform or ARM templates. 
 - Relevant certifications (e. g. Azure Developer Associate, Azure Cosmos DB Developer Specialty). 

Why Husky?

- Regulated Working Hours: Enjoy a structured work schedule that promotes a healthy work-life balance, allowing you to excel professionally while maintaining personal well-being. 
 - Visible Impact: Experience the satisfaction of seeing the direct outcomes of your work, as you contribute to projects that visibly enhance our company's technological capabilities and efficiency. 
 - Strategic Influence: Participate in architectural and technical reviews, contributing to the strategic direction of our cloud initiatives and making a tangible impact on our company's technological landscape. 
 - Empowered Involvement: Take an active role in decision-making processes and architectural reviews, where your expertise helps shape the future of our cloud solutions and overall business strategy. 
 - Valued Contributions: Be more than just a number in a large organization; at our company, every individual's input is valued and can lead to significant, tangible improvements in our operations and services. 
 - Impactful Role: Play a crucial part in both developing new applications and maintaining existing systems, ensuring their optimal performance and reliability. 
 - Cutting-Edge Projects: Work on innovative cloud solutions that are transforming our and our customer's business, giving you the opportunity to be at the forefront of technological advancements. 
 - Supportive Community: Work in an environment that recognizes and celebrates individual achievements, fostering a sense of community and mutual respect among team members. 
 - Collaborative Environment: Join a global team of skilled professionals around the globe where your ideas are valued, and collaboration is encouraged to solve complex challenges and drive success. 

Husky TechnologiesTM offers a competitive compensation and benefits package and excellent opportunities for growth and advancement. We are committed to equal employment opportunity and respect, value and welcome diversity in our workplace. Husky TechnologiesTM also values being a great place to work and strives to maintain a safe workplace. Accordingly, Husky TechnologiesTM conditions all offers of employment on satisfactory completion of background checks. No agency or telephone inquiries please.

data.title: Principal Engineer [T500-31015]
data.description:
About Us: 

Marriott International Inc. , headquartered in Bethesda, Maryland, USA, was founded in May 1927 by J. Willard Marriott and Alice S. Marriott with a modest nine-seat A&W root beer stand. Guided by the family's leadership and core principles, Marriott International today has grown into a global hospitality giant, operating approximately 9, 000 properties and over 30 leading brands in more than 140 countries and territories. 

From such humble beginnings to becoming the world's largest hotel company, Marriott International has never stopped searching for inventive ways to serve its customers, provide opportunities for its associates, and grow their business. At Marriott Tech Accelerator center (MTA), Hyderabad, India, Marriott is exploring the world we live in and all its possibilities. At Marriott Tech Accelerator, we are a team of passionate engineering minds dedicated to creating and building cutting-edge solutions that streamline operations and elevate guest experiences. 

Marriott Tech Accelerator center is fully owned and operated by ANSR. All associates at Marriott Tech Accelerator will be ANSR employees, delivering services exclusively to ANSR's client, Marriott International. 

Position Summary: 

- The Principal Engineer, Integrations is a hands-on technical leader focused on designing, developing, deploying and supporting enterprise integrations that connect SaaS legal technology platforms, enterprise web applications and domain services. The role requires strong engineering expertise in APIs, microservices, adapters and secure data exchange across legal, procurement, ERP, CRM and other enterprise systems. The portfolio includes cloud-based legal solutions, sell-side contract lifecycle management (CLM), legal request management, integrations, analytics, automation and related capabilities. 
 - The ideal candidate brings substantial hands-on experience delivering and supporting complex enterprise integrations, backed by strong full-stack development, data engineering and DevOps skills. Core expertise includes building APIs and microservices, implementing middleware and real-time, event-driven integrations, and managing data transformation and migration. This individual combines integration engineering depth with operational readiness and troubleshooting skills, collaborating effectively with business partners, enterprise technology teams and external stakeholders through complex delivery and support priorities. 
 - We are transforming how we collaborate with prospective hotel owners, manage legal agreements and support legal requests through new legal technology platforms, workflow automation and AI tools. This role applies integration engineering skills and experience to connect these capabilities with the broader enterprise ecosystem and enable that transformation. 

Role Title: Principal Engineer

Job Responsibilities: 

- Serve as the technical subject matter expert for legal technology platforms, with primary responsibility for the integration layer connecting legal applications to internal and external systems. 
 - Design, develop, and maintain scalable, high-performance APIs and microservices. 
 - Write efficient, well-structured, and maintainable production code. 
 - Design database schemas and optimize queries for performance, scalability, and reliability. 
 - Design, develop, and maintain real-time and event-driven integrations and middleware connecting legal SaaS platforms with the broader enterprise ecosystem. 
 - Partner with product managers and designers to translate business needs into clear technical requirements and solution designs. 
 - Collaborate with system integrators and engineers to deliver secure, reliable, and high-quality software solutions. 
 - Plan and execute data migrations from existing systems to legal SaaS platforms while maintaining data accuracy, completeness, and integrity. 
 - Configure and customize legal SaaS platforms to meet the legal organization's business and operational requirements. 
 - Coordinate across cross-functional teams to manage dependencies, resolve delivery risks, and ensure successful implementation. 
 - Provide technical leadership, guidance, and mentorship to engineering team members. 
 - Conduct code reviews and establish engineering standards that promote quality, security, and maintainability. 
 - Create reusable integration components and patterns that improve consistency and accelerate delivery. 
 - Define data models and integration mappings that support accurate, efficient exchange of information across systems. 
 - Apply appropriate integration patterns for synchronous, asynchronous, batch, and event-driven use cases. 
 - Engage stakeholders throughout the delivery lifecycle to communicate technical decisions, progress, risks, and trade-offs. 
 - Guide system integrators and engineering partners to ensure solutions align with enterprise architecture and engineering standards. 
 - Validate solution quality through design reviews, testing practices, and adherence to nonfunctional requirements. 
 - Diagnose and resolve complex technical and integration issues across applications, services, and data flows. 
 - Stay current with emerging engineering, integration, cloud, and automation technologies relevant to the platform ecosystem. . 
 - Analyze issue logs, operational metrics, and recurring incidents to identify trends and implement preventive solutions. 
 - Maintain comprehensive technical and configuration documentation and review documentation produced by other engineers. 
 - Proactively investigate incidents, perform root-cause analysis, and drive issues through resolution. 
 - Contribute to architecture discussions and help engineering teams make effective, scalable, and supportable technical decisions. 
 - Maintain deep domain and industry knowledge, and identify technology and automation trends that can improve platform capabilities. 
 - Support talent selection, provide timely peer feedback, and foster a collaborative, modern engineering culture. 
 - Participate in the on-call rotation and support timely restoration of production services. 
 - Provide technical leadership for successful platform and project implementations

Managing Priorities and Delivery:

 - Understand and meet the needs of key stakeholders

Skill and Experience:

data.title: Principal Data Platform Engineer
data.description:
Overview

Are you passionate about data platforms and tools? Are you an open-minded, structured thinker who is passionate about building systems at scale. Do you understand data platforms, know how to build them and want to help our users to make data actionable? If so, this role with our team at Atlassian is for you. 

We are looking for a Principal Software Engineer to join our Data Platform Team to build a world class data platform that powers crucial business decisions throughout the organization. 

You will partner with analytics teams, data engineers and data scientists across various initiatives and work with them to understand the gaps and bring your findings back to the team to build these capabilities. 

Working at Atlassian

Atlassians can choose where they work - whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity. 

Responsibilities

We build analytical data platforms for Atlassian that serve both Engineering and Data Engineering to help them generate valuable insights from data. 

As a Principal Engineer On This Team You Will

- Own the long term architecture and technical direction for core platform capabilities and be accountable for their reliability, cost efficiency and adoption
 - Design and build foundational platform components that other engineering teams build on top of, across areas like ingestion, transformation, orchestration, compute and consumption
 - Architect robust multi-tenant platform standards by establishing clear cross-layer contracts, tenant isolation, and SLOs to enable autonomous producers and consumers, while driving compute and storage efficiency across workloads
 - Lead cross team technical initiatives and architecture reviews, influence platform strategy with senior stakeholders and act as a technical mentor and multiplier for Senior engineers
 - Stay hands on. You will be in the code on the hardest problems, not just reviewing designs

Compensation

At Atlassian, we strive to design equitable, explainable, and competitive compensation programs. We follow consistent hiring practices and account for each candidate's skills, knowledge, and experience when setting base pay within the range. 

This role may also be eligible for benefits, bonuses, commissions, and equity. 

Qualifications

Required

- 12+ years of software or data engineering experience, with at least 6 years building data platform infrastructure
 - You have built a data platform or a significant component of one and operated it in production. For example an ingestion framework, a transformation framework, a compute or query layer, an orchestration layer, a metadata or lineage service or a data quality framework
 - You can describe the scale that component ran at in concrete numbers. Data volume, ingest throughput, number of pipelines or jobs, query concurrency and latency, number of onboarded teams or tenants and infrastructure cost. 
 - Deep understanding of big data and distributed systems challenges including partitioning, shuffle behaviour, skew, idempotency and backfills
 - Experience designing both batch and streaming architectures and clear judgement on when each is the right answer
 - Expert level programming skills in language such as Java, Kotlin or Python and built solutions on public cloud offerings such as Amazon Web Services
 - Experience with big data processing and storage technologies such as Spark, DBT and with open table formats such as Iceberg or Delta Lake
 - A track record of owning ambiguous cross team problems end to end and of influencing without authority
 - Degree in Computer Science, EE or a related STEM discipline or equivalent practical experience

Nice to have

- Experience with high performance analytical or MPP databases such as StarRocks, Druid, ClickHouse or Pinot
 - Experience with change data capture and event driven ingestion at high volume
 - Experience building a semantic layer or metrics store and governing shared metric definitions
 - Experience with the data foundations of ML platforms, such as point-in-time correct training data, online and offline feature parity or backfilling features at scale
 - Experience with data governance, access control, lineage and compliance, including regulated environments such as FedRAMP

data.description:
About Northern Trust

As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world's most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions. 

Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide. 

With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24, 000 partners, we serve the world's most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service. 

About Northern Trust And Omnium

Northern Trust provides innovative financial services and guidance to corporations, institutions, affluent families, and individuals globally. With more than 130 years of financial experience and nearly 20, 000 partners, we serve some of the world's most sophisticated clients through leading technology and exceptional service. 

The Omnium technology organization develops and supports mission-critical financial platforms serving complex investment and asset servicing needs. Omnium supports capabilities across areas including pricing, accounting, trading, financial instrument processing, and regulatory functions. The platform combines internally developed technology with best-in-class partner solutions while maintaining an integrated system of record that provides transparency, control, and operational efficiency. 

The technologists building and supporting Omnium are thought leaders who work directly with the people who use our software every day. We value engineering ownership, pragmatic innovation, collaboration, continuous learning, and high-quality delivery. Our engineers are expected to understand the business problems they are solving, take ownership of their solutions, and continuously improve the resiliency, performance, security, and maintainability of the platform. 

Role

We are looking for an experienced Senior . NET Backend Developer to join the Omnium engineering team and contribute to the continued modernization and enhancement of our platform. 

The successful candidate will bring 10+ years of software engineering experience with strong hands-on expertise in C# and . NET backend development. The individual will work on a large and complex codebase supporting critical pricing, accounting, regulatory, and financial-processing capabilities. 

The role will involve both functional development and technical modernization, including enhancements to existing services, development of new backend capabilities, framework and dependency upgrades, performance improvements, security remediation, and improvements to the overall maintainability and resiliency of the platform. 

This is a hands-on individual contributor role requiring the ability to independently own complex technical initiatives from analysis and design through implementation, testing, deployment, and production support. The candidate should be comfortable working with minimal technical supervision while collaborating effectively with cross-functional engineering, architecture, product, and business teams. 

Overall Experience: 10+ years

Required Qualifications

- 10+ years of professional software engineering experience, with significant experience developing enterprise applications and backend services. 
 - 5+ years of strong hands-on development experience using C# and modern . NET / . NET Core. 
 - Strong experience designing, building, enhancing, and maintaining backend services, REST APIs, and enterprise applications. 
 - Strong understanding of ASP. NET Core, including RESTful API development, dependency injection, configuration, middleware, authentication, and authorization. 
 - Experience with . NET technologies and frameworks such as ASP. NET Core, Entity Framework Core, and Microsoft authentication and security libraries. 
 - Strong experience with SQL Server and T-SQL, including relational data modeling, query development, troubleshooting, and performance optimization. 
 - Experience working with large, mature enterprise codebases, including modernization and enhancement of existing applications. 
 - Strong understanding of software engineering fundamentals, including object-oriented design, SOLID principles, design patterns, asynchronous programming, concurrency, error handling, and application resiliency. 
 - Experience designing and developing secure, scalable, performant, maintainable, and testable production applications. 
 - Strong experience with unit testing, debugging, code reviews, source control, automated builds, and CI/CD-based software delivery. 
 - Demonstrated ability to independently analyze complex technical problems and drive solutions through completion. 
 - Ability to understand business requirements and translate them into well-designed technical solutions. 
 - Experience collaborating effectively across engineering, architecture, product, infrastructure, and business teams. 

Key Responsibilities

- Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain backend services and APIs using C# and modern . NET technologies. 
 - Enhance and modernize existing Omnium applications supporting pricing, accounting, regulatory, and related financial-processing capabilities. 
 - Develop new backend capabilities and extend existing applications to support evolving business and client requirements. 
 - Take ownership of complex technical changes from initial analysis and solution design through implementation and production deployment. 
 - Develop reusable backend components, services, and libraries that improve engineering consistency and accelerate future development. 
 - Produce secure, efficient, maintainable, well-documented, and well-tested code consistent with enterprise engineering standards. 
 - Modernize legacy components and dependencies, including . NET framework and runtime upgrades and remediation of technical debt. 
 - Identify and address performance, scalability, reliability, security, and resiliency issues across backend applications and services. 
 - Troubleshoot complex application and production issues and perform effective root-cause analysis. 
 - Participate actively in solution design, technical discussions, code reviews, testing, and continuous improvement of engineering practices. 
 - Work closely with other Omnium and enterprise technology teams on cross-application dependencies and strategic technology initiatives. 
 - Contribute to improvements in automated testing, CI/CD, observability, application monitoring, and overall software delivery quality. 
 - Participate in production support and ensure applications meet appropriate operational, resiliency, and service-level expectations. 
 - Proactively identify opportunities to simplify the technology landscape, reduce technical debt, and improve engineering efficiency. 

Financial Services

- Experience working within financial services, capital markets, asset servicing, investment accounting, pricing, or trading platforms. 
 - Experience developing systems supporting high-volume or complex financial transactions. 
 - Understanding of financial instruments, pricing, accounting, or regulatory processing is advantageous. 

Azure and Cloud

- Hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure, particularly building, deploying, or supporting enterprise applications and backend services in Azure. 
 - Familiarity with Azure technologies such as Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), App Service, Azure Functions, Azure SQL, Storage, Key Vault, API Management, and Azure Monitor/Application Insights. 
 - Experience with cloud-native and containerized application development, including Docker and Kubernetes. 
 - Familiarity with cloud architecture principles involving scalability, resiliency, security, observability, and automated deployment. 
 - Experience with messaging or event-driven architectures using technologies such as Kafka or Azure messaging services. 

AI and Generative AI

- Exposure to Artificial Intelligence, Generative AI, and Large Language Model technologies is a plus. 
 - Experience integrating enterprise applications with LLMs, AI APIs, or AI-enabled services is advantageous. 
 - Familiarity with Azure AI services, Azure OpenAI, or similar enterprise AI platforms. 
 - Understanding of how AI capabilities can be securely integrated into existing enterprise applications and engineering workflows. 
 - Familiarity with AI engineering concepts such as prompt engineering, evaluation, observability, security, responsible AI, and production integration is desirable. 
 - Interest in identifying practical opportunities to apply AI to improve software engineering, operational processes, or financial-services workflows. 

Additional Technology

- Experience with application observability, telemetry, logging, and production monitoring. 
 - Familiarity with distributed systems, microservices, and event-driven architectures. 
 - Exposure to Go or Node. js development is a plus. 

Professional Skills

- Highly motivated, self-directed, and accountable for delivering results. 
 - Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking skills. 
 - Demonstrates the ability to investigate beyond the immediate symptoms of a problem and identify underlying technical or process issues. 
 - Able to understand complex technical and business concepts quickly. 
 - Detail-oriented while maintaining an understanding of broader architectural and business impacts. 
 - Comfortable working in a complex technology environment with changing priorities and multiple concurrent deliverables. 
 - Demonstrated ability to independently manage complex assignments and drive them through completion. 
 - Proactively identifies opportunities to improve engineering quality, operational efficiency, platform stability, and maintainability. 
 - Strong written and verbal communication skills. 
 - Able to communicate complex technical concepts and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Strong collaboration and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively across teams and organizational boundaries. 
 - Demonstrates a strong sense of ownership, accountability, engineering discipline, and commitment to quality. 

Working with Us

As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve. 

Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust's history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.

Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. The Northern Trust Bangalore office, established in 2005, is home to over 5, 600 employees. In this stunning office space, we offer fantastic amenities which include our Arrival Hub - Jungle, the GameZone, and the Employee Experience Zone that appeal to both clients and employees. Learn more.

data.title: METALLURGY -ENGINEER
data.description:
Sansera Engineering is an engineering-led integrated manufacturer of forged complex and high-precision components for the automotive, non-Automotive and Aerospace sectors. With a rich legacy spanning over three decades, Sansera Engineering is committed to delivering quality products to its global clientele. As we continue to expand our operations and workforce, As we continue to expand our operations and workforce, we are seeking talented and dedicated individuals to join our team. 

Job Description - Engineer (heat Treatment)

- PRIME FUNCTION

To manage and monitor metallurgical laboratory activities related to in-house and outsourced Heat Treatment and BOP components, ensuring timely inspection, process compliance, equipment calibration and accurate documentation. Responsible for effective utilization of resources, team management, quality assurance and continuous improvement of laboratory operations to achieve departmental objectives in line with organizational requirements. 

- JOB DESCRIPTION / RESPONSIBILITIES
 - Productivity and Laboratory Management Manage all metallurgical laboratory activities related to in-house and outsourced Heat Treatment and BOP components. Ensure timely inspection and testing of materials as per defined requirements. Monitor departmental objectives and conduct periodic performance reviews. Ensure the availability of laboratory equipment, spares and consumables, along with timely calibration of inspection equipment. Identify operational bottlenecks and implement appropriate contingency measures. Ensure optimum utilization of available manpower and resources to achieve departmental productivity targets. 
 - Quality Management Monitor and review daily non-conformances and customer complaints, ensuring appropriate corrective and preventive actions. Ensure daily updation and maintenance of relevant departmental data in SAP. Implement and maintain compliance with TS, EMS and OHSAS management systems. Maintain proper inspection records, reports and departmental documentation. Ensure adherence to applicable quality standards, procedures and inspection requirements. 
 - Cost Management Monitor and control laboratory inspection costs to achieve departmental cost objectives. Plan manpower and departmental activities effectively to minimize overtime. Identify and eliminate process waste and non-value-added activities. Ensure optimum utilization of laboratory resources, equipment and consumables to maintain operational efficiency. 
 - Delivery and Coordination Ensure timely inspection and release of materials to avoid production delays. Coordinate with Production, Machine Shop, PPC and Materials departments to ensure smooth material flow and uninterrupted production activities. Coordinate with HR for departmental manpower requirements and ensure inspection activities are completed as per the production schedule. 
 - Safety and Compliance Ensure the availability of necessary safety resources and maintain a safe and healthy working environment within the department. Ensure the safety of personnel, equipment and machinery. Conduct periodic checks to identify workplace hazards and ensure implementation of appropriate safeguards. Ensure compliance with all applicable statutory, regulatory, environmental and occupational health and safety requirements. 
 - People Management and Continuous Improvement Guide, counsel and mentor team members to improve departmental performance and maintain discipline, teamwork and a healthy working environment. Conduct performance appraisals, target setting and periodic performance reviews. Identify training needs (TNA) and coordinate employee development programmes. Maintain and update departmental skill matrices and ensure effective implementation of on-the-job training (OJT). Prepare and update Job Descriptions and departmental organizational charts. Guide new employees on laboratory activities during their induction programme. Promote continuous improvement initiatives such as 5S, Kaizen, QCC, Suggestions, Poka-Yoke and other improvement projects. Ensure effective shop-floor layout, housekeeping and employee participation in improvement activities. 
 - AUTHORITY

Authorized to take necessary decisions and initiate corrective actions related to identified non-conformances. Responsible for authorization of in-process inspection and process control reports. Authorized to conduct performance appraisals of departmental team members, review and approve departmental work instructions, and raise material indents for departmental requirements. Authorized to conduct trials and approve laboratory consumables. Can recommend manpower increase or reduction based on production requirements and is authorized to stop production whenever necessary to address quality or process-related concerns. Also empowered to exercise other necessary authorities to discharge assigned duties and responsibilities effectively. 

- JOB SPECIFICATION / COMPETENCY

Educational Qualification: Minimum Diploma or Graduation in Metallurgy. 

Experience: Minimum 2 years of relevant experience in Heat Treatment processes and Metallurgical Laboratory activities. 

Technical Competencies: Knowledge of Heat Treatment processes, metallurgical laboratory inspection activities, laboratory equipment and calibration requirements. Understanding of quality management systems, inspection documentation and process compliance. Working knowledge of SAP and departmental data management, along with an understanding of TS, EMS and OHSAS requirements. 

Behavioural Competencies: Good people management, team leadership, communication and coordination skills. Ability to plan and organize departmental activities, solve problems, take decisions and drive continuous improvement initiatives. Ability to effectively manage manpower and achieve departmental objectives. 

- PERFORMANCE MEASURES (KPI - KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS)

Performance will be measured based on timely inspection and checking of materials, effective control of consumables costs, compliance with TS, EMS and OHSAS requirements, monitoring and reduction of customer complaints and non-conformances, achievement of departmental 5S scores, participation in QCC and SGA activities, implementation of Kaizens, improvements and employee suggestions, on-time delivery of inspected materials, prevention of workplace accidents and effective training and development of departmental team members. 

- PERFORMANCE ACCOUNTABILITY

The incumbent will be accountable for ensuring effective management of metallurgical laboratory operations, timely inspection and release of materials, achievement of departmental productivity, quality, cost and delivery targets, compliance with applicable quality and safety requirements, optimum utilization of manpower and laboratory resources, and continuous improvement in departmental processes and employee capabilities.
