Role Title: Principal Engineer

Position Summary: The Principal Engineer, Integrations is a hands-on technical leader focused on designing, developing, deploying and supporting enterprise integrations that connect SaaS legal technology platforms, enterprise web applications and domain services. The role requires strong engineering expertise in APIs, microservices, adapters and secure data exchange across legal, procurement, ERP, CRM and other enterprise systems. The portfolio includes cloud-based legal solutions, sell-side contract lifecycle management (CLM), legal request management, integrations, analytics, automation and related capabilities. The ideal candidate brings substantial hands-on experience delivering and supporting complex enterprise integrations, backed by strong full-stack development, data engineering and DevOps skills. Core expertise includes building APIs and microservices, implementing middleware and real-time, event-driven integrations, and managing data transformation and migration. This individual combines integration engineering depth with operational readiness and troubleshooting skills, collaborating effectively with business partners, enterprise technology teams and external stakeholders through complex delivery and support priorities. 

Job Responsibilities: 

- Serve as the technical subject matter expert for legal technology platforms, with primary responsibility for the data orchestration and integration layer connecting legal applications to internal and external systems. 
 - Lead data and analytics engineering for legal technology, including reporting systems, dashboards, data models, data pipelines, and operational analytics capabilities. 
 - Analyze legal operations data to identify trends, patterns, and anomalies related to spend, supplier performance, cost savings, contract compliance, and process effectiveness.

 - Partner with product managers and designers to translate business needs into clear technical requirements and solution designs.

 - Plan and execute data migrations from existing systems to legal SaaS platforms while maintaining data accuracy, completeness, and integrity.

 - Define data models and integration mappings that support accurate, efficient exchange of information across systems. 
 - Apply appropriate integration patterns for synchronous, asynchronous, batch, and event-driven use cases. 
 - Engage stakeholders throughout the delivery lifecycle to communicate technical decisions, progress, risks, and trade-offs. 
 - Guide system integrators and engineering partners to ensure solutions align with enterprise architecture and engineering standards. 
 - Validate solution quality through design reviews, testing practices, and adherence to nonfunctional requirements. 
 - Diagnose and resolve complex technical and integration issues across applications, services, and data flows. 
 - Stay current with emerging engineering, integration, cloud, and automation technologies relevant to the platform ecosystem. 
 - Proactively investigate incidents, perform root-cause analysis, and drive issues through resolution. 
 - Contribute to architecture discussions and help engineering teams make effective, scalable, and supportable technical decisions.

 - Strong technical skills in data manipulation, analysis, visualization, cloud data warehousing, ETL or ELT processes, SQL, Python, and BI tools. 
 - Experience with data modeling, dimensional modeling, fact tables, dimension tables, data warehousing, and related data modeling practices.

data.title: Engineer - Information Systems
data.description:
Xperi invents, develops and delivers technologies that create extraordinary experiences at home and on the go for millions of people around the world. Powering billions of consumer electronics, connected cars and digital content titles, we make entertainment more immersive, driving more intelligent and every interaction seamlessly personalized through our renowned consumer brands: DTS®, HD RadioTM and TiVo®. 

Xperi (NYSE: XPER) is a publicly traded technology company headquartered in San Jose, CA with over 1, 500 employees across North America, Europe and Asia. Come join a thriving team where you can play an integral role in shaping the future of entertainment technology. 

About The Role

As an Engineer - Information Systems in the IT Automation and Observability team, you will work at the intersection of DevOps and Artificial Intelligence. You will design, build and own the CI/CD pipelines, automation and infrastructure that power our projects, while bringing AI capabilities into the enterprise by integrating Large Language Models with our data, systems and user interfaces. 

A key focus of the role is building interactive AI agents and integrating them with master agent (orchestrator) frameworks, so that specialized agents coordinate seamlessly to deliver intelligent, end-to-end automation. Working hands-on with Microsoft Copilot Studio, Python, REST APIs, Model Context Protocol (MCP), Microsoft Azure / AWS and Microsoft Power Platform, you will connect agents to enterprise systems through REST APIs, custom connectors, Power Automate and agent flows and develop MCP servers and tools that enable reusable integrations across AI applications. 

The automation, pipelines and AI-driven workflows you build will reduce manual effort and help create a more efficient, scalable and resilient platform. You are a collaborative team player who documents your work thoroughly and takes ownership of solutions from design through production. 

Key Responsibilities

AI Engineering

- Core Technical Expertise: Demonstrate hands-on proficiency in Microsoft Copilot Studio, Python, REST APIs, Model Context Protocol (MCP), Microsoft Azure / AWS and Microsoft Power Platform. Proven experience in direct integration with enterprise applications is essential. 
 - Application Integration: Develop and maintain MCP servers and tools where appropriate, enabling reusable integrations across compatible AI applications. 
 - Enterprise Systems Integration: Integrate agents with enterprise systems through REST APIs, custom connectors, Power Automate and agent flows. 
 - Workflow & Agent Design: Build agentic AI chatbots and multi-step automated workflows, integrated with master agent (orchestrator) frameworks. 
 - Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG): Implement RAG architectures using vector databases and embedding models to enable AI to query private or domain-specific company data. 
 - Prompt Engineering & Fine-Tuning: Craft, test and optimize prompts, in-context learning and model outputs for reliability and precision. 
 - Production & Monitoring: Test, deploy, scale and monitor AI features for latency, cost, security and accuracy. 
 - AI Security & Governance: Apply AI security and governance best practices across all AI solutions, including data privacy, access control, prompt injection mitigation and responsible AI, ensuring compliance with organizational and regulatory policies. 

DevOps & Infrastructure

- CI/CD Pipelines: Design, implement and maintain robust CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins to automate build, test and deployment processes, including for AI-enabled applications. 
 - Version Control: Manage source code using Git, following best practices for branching, merging and version control in a collaborative team environment. 
 - Automation Scripting: Develop and maintain Python scripts to automate repetitive tasks such as system configuration, deployments and data processing. 
 - Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Use Terraform to manage and provision cloud infrastructure, ensuring consistency and scalability. 
 - Configuration Management: Use tools such as Ansible to automate and standardize server and application configuration. 

Collaboration & Documentation

- Collaboration & Troubleshooting: Work alongside development and operations teams to troubleshoot issues, streamline workflows and ensure the smooth, reliable delivery of applications. 
 - Continuous Improvement: Evaluate and adopt new DevOps and AI tools and best practices, and share learnings with the team. 
 - Documentation: Create and maintain clear technical documentation so that knowledge is shared and accessible to the entire team. 

Required Skills & Qualifications

Education & Experience

- A Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, AI, Engineering or a related technical field. 
 - 5 - 7 years of overall experience, including a minimum of 3 years of relevant hands-on experience in AI and DevOps. 

Programming & Development

- Programming Languages: Strong proficiency in Python (primary), with familiarity in SQL and JavaScript. 
 - Web Technologies: Working knowledge of React JS, JavaScript and jQuery. 
 - Software Engineering Fundamentals: Git/version control (commits, branches, pull requests) and designing and consuming REST APIs. 

AI Agent Development & Integration

- Microsoft Copilot Studio: Hands-on experience designing, building and deploying AI agents in Copilot Studio, including topics, actions and agent flows. 
 - Microsoft Power Platform: Practical experience with Power Automate, custom connectors and agent flows to automate business processes and connect agents to enterprise systems. 
 - Model Context Protocol (MCP): Experience developing and maintaining MCP servers and tools to enable reusable, standardized integrations across compatible AI applications. 
 - Enterprise Application Integration: Proven, direct experience integrating with enterprise applications via REST APIs, including authentication (e. g. , OAuth 2. 0), API security and error handling. 

DevOps, Cloud & Infrastructure

- CI/CD: Hands-on experience with CI/CD principles and tools such as Jenkins. 
 - Infrastructure as Code: Experience with Terraform for provisioning and managing infrastructure. 
 - Configuration Management: Experience with tools such as Ansible. 
 - Cloud Platforms: Strong hands-on knowledge of Microsoft Azure and Amazon Web Services (AWS), including their compute, networking, storage and AI-related services. 
 - Operating Systems: Strong knowledge of Linux OS and fundamentals, including Ubuntu, RHEL and CentOS/Rocky Linux. 
 - Databases: Understanding of databases such as MariaDB, MySQL and MongoDB. 
 - Monitoring & Observability: Knowledge of monitoring platforms such as Prometheus, Grafana and Zabbix for enterprise monitoring, including metrics collection, dashboarding and alerting. 

Soft Skills

- Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to work across development and operations teams. 
 - Analytical, problem-solving mindset and a passion for using technology to solve real problems. 
 - Good documentation habits and a commitment to continuous learning. 

Life @ Xperi: 

At Xperi, we value People, Customers, Performance and Innovation. We are dedicated to creating a workplace where all employees have a voice and sense of belonging, feel safe and valued, and are acknowledged for how their unique differences contribute to organizational culture and business outcomes. 

Our employees and their families are important to us, and our comprehensive pay, stock and benefits programs reflect that. Xperi supports personal well-being, builds financial security and enables employees to share in our collective success. 

Rewards include: 

- Competitive compensation (salary, equity and bonuses) and comprehensive benefits designed to foster work-life balance, care for your health, protect your finances and help you save and invest for the future. 
 - Generous paid time away from work, including flexible time off, holidays and sick time, health and wellness initiatives, and a charitable match program to help you give back to your community. 
 - Great perks, which vary by location and can be site-specific: employee discounts, transportation reimbursements, subsidized cafes and fitness facilities. 
 - A flexible, hybrid work environment combining the best of in-office collaboration and community-building along with the benefits of working from home. 

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

data.description: Forward Deployment Engineer - Expert - 5G/6G/NTN Responsibilities The Expert Forward Deployment Engineer works inside a customer's development program as software developer, systems engineer, and deployment lead in one role, and ships production code. This person reduces broad concepts and business strategies into structured deployment projects, acts as the key technical lead and go-to person for Department or Senior Management on the most complex, high-impact engagements, diagnoses problems deep within the protocol stack (Layer 1 to Layer 3), modifies software, validates fixes, and delivers controlled releases during a customer's early development, integration, and regression cycles. This is a customer-facing software engineering role where you will embed directly within a customer environment to customize, integrate, and deploy technology into real-world production systems, solving complex, high-impact problems. Core responsibilities • Reduce broad account concepts and business strategies into structured, multi-workstream deployment projects • Act as the key technical lead and go-to person for Department or Senior Management on the most complex or highest-impact deployment engagements • Architect and own solutions to problems that require a unique or highly specialized skill set • Work onsite or closely with wireless customer development teams during major feature introductions • Analyze signaling flows, traces, timing behavior, and performance data to isolate failures across Keysight and customer implementations • Write and modify application and protocol-stack software, plus the supporting software and firmware the customer environment requires • Develop and extend Python APIs that customer teams integrate against • Build automation workflows inside the customer's workflows • Create diagnostic instrumentation when existing tools are insufficient • Develop, validate, and deploy controlled patches, feature flags, and interim releases under Keysight's release process • Run rapid prototyping loops directly with customers to test and iterate on new features based on live feedback • Act as a feedback loop to the core product and engineering teams, translating field problems into engineering requirements and defects for product management and R&D • Incorporate broadly applicable field-developed improvements into the core product • Mentor lower-level engineers and help develop the broader forward deployment engineering team Qualifications Typically requires a Bachelor's or Master's degree (or equivalent) and 8+ years of relevant software/systems engineering experience. Post-graduate study and/or relevant certification/license may be required. • Strong software-development experience across multiple software stacks • Preferred expertise in at least one domain (PHY/L1, MAC/RLC/PDCP and L2, or RRC/NAS and L3), plus working knowledge of adjacent layers and end-to-end 4G, 5G, and 5G-Advanced system behavior • Proficiency in C/C++ and Python (including API development), Linux, embedded or real-time software, and automated testing • Experience debugging protocol interactions through logs, traces, packet captures, call flows, and timing analysis • Familiarity with 3GPP specifications and the practical differences among standards compliance, interoperability, and implementation behavior • Experience in design and test instrumentation and test emulation tools • Ability to produce production-quality code that ships in a customer's build • The judgment and customer presence to operate inside confidential development programs • Excellent communication skills; able to explain technical trade-offs to both engineers and non-technical stakeholders • Willingness to relocate or travel to a specific customer site as required by the assignment • Specialized depth and/or breadth of expertise across multiple protocol layers, software stacks, and deployment domains • Demonstrated technical leadership: ability to design solutions to unusually complex problems and set direction for other engineers Travel Requirement: Up to 50% travel to local client sites. Occasional international travel may also be required.

data.description:
About Northern Trust

As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world's most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions. 

Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide. 

With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24, 000 partners, we serve the world's most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service. 

Role purpose

Design and advance enterprise-scale test automation solutions across modern and legacy platforms. The role combines hands-on coding, automation architecture, quality engineering strategy, DevOps integration, AI-assisted engineering, troubleshooting, and stakeholder leadership. 

Key Responsibilities

Automation Engineering and Framework Development

- Design, develop, and maintain scalable, reusable, and maintainable automation frameworks and shared engineering libraries. 
 - Build automation across web applications, REST APIs and microservices, databases and data pipelines, and mainframe or legacy applications. 
 - Write production-quality automation code in Java, TypeScript/JavaScript, or Python, applying object-oriented design, clean-code principles, design patterns, version control, and peer review. 
 - Create reliable test suites for functional, regression, integration, system, end-to-end, and risk-based testing. 
 - Design test data, mocks, stubs, service virtualization, and environment-independent automation where required. 
 - Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and provide clear, actionable execution results and quality gates. 

Automation Strategy, Architecture, and Roadmaps

- Define enterprise test automation strategies, reference architectures, standards, governance practices, and multi-year roadmaps aligned with product and technology priorities. 
 - Assess application portfolios and recommend the appropriate automation approach across UI, API, database, batch, mainframe, and integration layers. 
 - Apply practical quality engineering principles such as the test pyramid, shift-left testing, continuous testing, risk-based coverage, and maintainability by design. 
 - Define measurable outcomes for automation coverage, reliability, execution time, defect detection, pipeline adoption, and reduction of manual regression effort. 
 - Evaluate and recommend tools and frameworks based on application architecture, team capability, total cost, maintainability, and enterprise controls. 

Software Delivery, DevOps, Cloud, and AI-Assisted Engineering

- Apply strong understanding of the complete Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), including requirements analysis, solution design, development, code review, testing, release, production validation, and continuous improvement. 
 - Partner with engineering teams to embed quality practices throughout Agile/Scrum and DevOps delivery, including definition of ready/done, acceptance criteria, testability, and release-risk assessment. 
 - Integrate automation with GitHub Actions and LambdaTest for CI/CD execution, cross-browser and cross-device testing, and source-control workflows. 
 - Apply cloud fundamentals on Azure, including compute, storage, networking, identity and access management, secrets, containers, logging, monitoring, and cloud-native testing considerations. 
 - Use AI coding assistants and agents, such as GitHub Copilot or equivalent, for code generation, refactoring, test design, review, debugging, documentation, and productivity improvement while applying human review, security, privacy, and engineering controls. 
 - Identify practical opportunities to use AI within the quality engineering lifecycle and measure the resulting quality and productivity improvements. 

Troubleshooting, Innovation, and Collaboration

- Diagnose complex failures across automation code, application services, APIs, databases, test environments, mainframe integrations, and CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Perform structured root-cause analysis using logs, traces, database queries, network diagnostics, and application telemetry; distinguish product defects from test, data, environment, and configuration issues. 
 - Drive innovation through reusable accelerators, proof-of-concepts, framework modernization, and adoption of emerging automation and AI technologies. 
 - Collaborate with developers, architects, product owners, business analysts, DevOps teams, QE teams, and business stakeholders to align quality objectives, risks, dependencies, and delivery plans. 
 - Mentor engineers, conduct technical reviews, establish engineering standards, and communicate strategy and technical decisions clearly to both technical and leadership audiences. 

Required Qualifications And Skills

- 10-12 years of experience in software quality engineering, testing, or software development, with substantial hands-on test automation experience. 
 - Expert hands-on programming skills in at least one language: Java, TypeScript/JavaScript, or Python; capability to design, code, review, debug, and refactor complex automation solutions. 
 - Proven experience designing or significantly enhancing enterprise-grade automation frameworks using tools such as Playwright, Selenium, REST Assured, Postman, TestNG/BDD/TDD, or comparable technologies. 
 - Demonstrated automation experience across web/UI, API and microservices, and database/data validation; hands-on exposure to automating mainframe, batch, messaging, file-transfer, or other legacy integrations is strongly preferred. 
 - Strong database fundamentals, including relational database concepts, data models, tables, keys, joins, indexing, transactions, stored procedures, data integrity, SQL querying, test-data setup, and backend validation. Exposure to NoSQL or cloud databases is beneficial. 
 - Strong understanding of SDLC, Agile/Scrum, DevOps, CI/CD, branching strategies, code review, release management, defect lifecycle, and production support practices. 
 - Working knowledge of Azure and cloud-based application architectures, including microservices, containers (Kubernetes preferred), serverless services, distributed systems, observability, identity, security, and environment management. 
 - Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and implementing quality gates, execution reporting, parallelization, and failure diagnostics. 
 - Hands-on experience with AI coding assistants or agents, with the ability to evaluate generated output and apply secure, responsible engineering practices. 
 - Strong understanding of test design techniques, functional and non-functional testing, risk-based testing, test-data management, environment management, defect prevention, root-cause analysis, and quality metrics. 
 - Knowledge of performance, security, accessibility, resilience, compatibility, contract, and production-validation testing concepts; exposure to service virtualization and observability-driven testing is beneficial. 
 - Ability to define automation strategy and roadmaps and translate them into prioritized, measurable engineering initiatives. 
 - Excellent troubleshooting, analytical thinking, innovation, communication, technical leadership, mentoring, and stakeholder-collaboration skills. 
 - Good to have: experience creating shared automation platforms, reusable accelerators, testing standards, or engineering enablement programs used across multiple teams. 
 - Good to have: banking or financial-services domain knowledge, including familiarity with regulated environments, data privacy, security controls, auditability, and critical transaction workflows. 
 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience. 

Working with Us

As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve. 

Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust's history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities. 

Reasonable Accommodation

Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs. com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with. 

About Our Pune Office

The Northern Trust Pune office, established in 2016, is now home to over 3, 000 employees. The office handles various functions, including Operations for Asset Servicing and Wealth Management, as well as delivering critical technology solutions that support business operations across the globe. 

Our Pune team takes our commitment to service to heart. In 2024, they volunteered more than 10, 000+ hours into the communities where they live and work. Learn more.

data.title: Lead Architect, IoT Cloud Platform
data.description:
Founded in 1910, KONE is a global leader that provides elevators, escalators and automatic building doors, as well as solutions for maintenance and modernization that add value to buildings throughout their life cycle. Our mission is to improve the flow of urban life and make our world's cities better places to live by providing innovative solutions that help make people's journeys safe, convenient and reliable. Our operations in over 60 countries around the world have helped us achieve our position as an innovation and sustainability leader with repeated recognitions by Forbes, Corporate Knights and others. 

KONE's vision is to create the Best People Flow experience by providing ease, effectiveness and experience to our customers and users. In line with our strategy, Sustainable Success with Customers, we focus on increasing the value we create for customers with new intelligent solutions and embedding sustainability even deeper across our operations. 

KDT unit within KTI is responsible for developing Digital Services products such as KONE 24/7 Connected Services, Residential Flow and Partnership Ecosystem

Role purpose

We are seeking a Lead Architect to define and govern the end-to-end architecture of our global industrial IoT and digital platform ecosystem. 

The role connects physical equipment, gateway runtimes, device connectivity, cloud platforms, digital applications, enterprise identity, and AI-enabled capabilities into a coherent, evolvable architecture. 

The architect will establish architecture-first delivery practices in which business capabilities, quality attributes, system boundaries, contracts, security requirements, and operational models are defined before implementation. 

You will translate complex technical decisions into clear recommendations for engineering and business stakeholders, connecting choices to customer value, cost, risk, reliability, delivery timelines, and operational readiness. 

What You Will Do

- Own target architectures, system boundaries, contracts, quality requirements, and technical roadmaps. Document alternatives, assumptions, failure modes, and trade-offs before implementation. 
 - Design multi-region routing, tenant and workload isolation, data placement, replication, failover and failback. Define RTO, RPO, availability objectives, and recovery validation for each workload. 
 - Enable repeatable regional expansion through reusable infrastructure, automated onboarding, configuration-driven deployment, and application designs that avoid regional forks. 
 - Govern industrial edge connectivity, device provisioning, certificate lifecycle, offline behavior, secure OTA updates, and command handling with embedded and safety specialists. 
 - Architect cloud services, APIs, real-time integrations, messaging, and data platforms with explicit ownership, compatibility, tenant isolation, and failure behavior. 
 - Embed security, observability, capacity planning, cost management, upgrade paths, and operational readiness into every architecture. 
 - Establish practical architecture standards, ADRs, reusable platform capabilities, repository boundaries, infrastructure as code, and automated delivery checks. 
 - Communicate through clear diagrams, business-focused narratives, and decision options. Lead cross-team reviews, mentor engineers, and build trust with stakeholders. 
 - Evaluate AI-assisted engineering and AI-enabled applications with specialist teams, considering business value, privacy, permissions, security, limitations, evaluation, and human oversight. 

PKI, device identity, and cryptographic architecture

Architecture focus: PKI is a foundational device trust system, not merely a subtopic within general identity and security. The role must govern identity from factory provisioning through operational use, renewal, revocation, retirement, and long-lived hardware replacement. 

- Define hardware-backed device identity using IEEE 802. 1AR concepts, including factory identity and operational identity, with TPM 2. 0 or secure-element roots of trust. 
 - Design zero-touch enrollment and renewal using appropriate protocols such as EST, SCEP, or CMPv2, with explicit bootstrap, recovery, renewal, revocation, and offline behavior. 
 - Author X. 509 certificate profiles aligned with RFC 5280, including subject naming, SAN conventions, EKU constraints, key usage, validity periods, policy OIDs, CRL distribution points, and validation rules. 
 - Design CA hierarchies, trust domains, signing boundaries, key ceremonies, offline root protection, intermediate CA operations, HSM integration, and delegated issuance. 
 - Govern certificate rotation at fleet scale, including clock drift, intermittent connectivity, dual-certificate overlap, compromised-device recovery, factory reset, ownership transfer, and end-of-life handling. 
 - Define cryptographic agility and long-term migration strategies for algorithm changes, including assessment of post-quantum standards such as ML-KEM, ML-DSA, and SLH-DSA where appropriate. 

Standards, RFCs, and normative specifications

Establish a reference architecture and standards catalogue that distinguishes mandatory requirements from recommendations. Use RFC 2119 and RFC 8174 terminology consistently when writing normative specifications. 

- Use MUST and MUST NOT for binding requirements; use SHOULD and SHOULD NOT for strong recommendations with documented exceptions; use MAY for permitted options. 
 - Maintain versioned specifications for identity, certificate profiles, TLS, MQTT topics, API contracts, event schemas, command semantics, error handling, and regional deployment. 
 - Reference applicable standards such as RFC 5280 for X. 509 certificates, RFC 7030 for EST, RFC 8446 for TLS 1. 3, RFC 6455 for WebSockets, OAuth 2. 0 and OpenID Connect specifications, OpenAPI, and the OASIS MQTT specification. 
 - Use ADRs to record context, decision, alternatives, consequences, security impact, operational impact, and conditions for revisiting the decision. 
 - Keep C4, deployment, sequence, threat, and data-flow models versioned with the systems they describe. 

Required Experience

- 14+ years in software engineering, distributed systems, cloud platforms, or systems architecture, including 6+ years leading architecture for complex enterprise, industrial, or mission-critical systems. 
 - Proven production delivery and operational experience with multi-region systems, disaster recovery, incident response, and recovery validation. 
 - Strong system design judgment and hands-on ability to validate decisions through prototypes, code reviews, performance testing, load testing, and operational evidence. 
 - Demonstrated ability to influence multiple teams and explain technical trade-offs to engineering, product, leadership, and non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Experience creating standards and governance that enable delivery rather than introducing unnecessary process. 

Preferred Experience

- Industrial equipment, fleet management, OT cybersecurity, predictive maintenance, digital twins, or large-scale multi-tenant platforms. 
 - Platform engineering, technology modernization, and practical exposure to AI-assisted development or enterprise AI integration. 
 - Experience with long-lived devices, constrained connectivity, safety-related command paths, and supplier or partner integration. 

Certifications

Certifications are desirable but not mandatory. They do not replace demonstrated system design expertise and production experience. 

- AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Professional or AWS Certified Security - Specialty. 
 - Certified Kubernetes Administrator or Certified Kubernetes Security Specialist. 
 - TOGAF or equivalent enterprise architecture qualification. 
 - Relevant Microsoft identity, security, industrial cybersecurity, or cryptography certifications. 

What Success Looks Like

- Architecture decisions are clear, trusted, documented, and adopted by delivery teams. 
 - Multi-region applications meet agreed availability, RTO, and RPO objectives, with recovery regularly tested. 
 - Device identity and PKI operations are automated, observable, recoverable, and secure throughout the asset lifecycle. 
 - Platforms remain secure, operable, and maintainable as devices, tenants, integrations, and capabilities grow. 
 - Normative standards and reusable platform capabilities reduce duplication, incompatible changes, and operational toil. 
 - AI experimentation is practical, governed, privacy-aware, and separated from unsafe or unverified control of physical equipment. 

At KONE, we are focused on creating an innovative and collaborative working culture where we value the contribution of each individual. Employee engagement is a key focus area for us and we encourage participation and the sharing of information and ideas. Sustainability is an integral part of our culture and the daily practice. We follow ethical business practices and we seek to develop a culture of working together where co-workers trust and respect each other and good performance is recognized. In being a great place to work, we are proud to offer a range of experiences and opportunities that will help you to achieve your career and personal goals and enable you to live a healthy and balanced life. 

At KONE, we believe in fair and competitive pay that recognizes performance and supports employee engagement. Our approach covers a comprehensive total rewards package, including both financial and non-financial benefits. We are committed to fostering a culture of fairness, respect, equity, diversity, and inclusion. 

Read more on https: //kone. com/global/en/careers. html

Job Summary: The Tech Lead Application Development role is responsible for the architecture, development and sustained health of mission-critical applications in the Payments and Billing domain. The role combines hands-on engineering with technical leadership: owning system design, setting engineering standards, and leading a team to deliver resilient, secure and observable cloud-native microservices built on event streaming. The person must have a proven track record of owning and leading critical applications at scale, modernizing legacy platforms, and delivering agentic AI solutions that automate business workflows. The successful candidate will be an expert in Java, Spring Boot and cloud technologies, will influence senior stakeholders, and will raise the engineering bar of the team through mentoring and example. 

Key Responsibilities

- Lead the end-to-end design, development and maintenance of mission-critical Payments and Billing applications, owning the architecture, technical roadmap and delivery outcomes. 
 - Architect and deliver production-grade, cloud-native microservices platforms with event streaming and robust NFRs, and set the reference patterns the wider organization follows. 
 - Own the event-driven architecture on Kafka: topic and schema strategy, partitioning, ordering, idempotency and delivery guarantees, retry and dead-letter handling, replay, and multi-region resiliency. 
 - Own NFRs end to end (performance, scalability, resiliency, availability, security, observability and reliability): define SLIs, SLOs and error budgets, and validate them through load, chaos and failover testing. 
 - Drive resiliency engineering with circuit breaker, retry, bulkhead, rate limiting, timeouts, graceful degradation and disaster recovery design (for example, Resilience4j). 
 - Establish observability standards (metrics, logs and distributed tracing with OpenTelemetry, dashboards, alerting and runbooks) and lead incident response and root cause analysis for critical production issues. 
 - Embed security by design: OAuth2/JWT, secrets management, threat modelling and vulnerability scanning (SonarQube, Veracode) built into the CI/CD pipeline. 
 - Partner with business, product and architecture stakeholders to define requirements, shape solutions and influence the technology roadmap. 
 - Lead and mentor a team of engineers; own design and code review quality, set engineering standards and drive best practices. 
 - Lead the design and delivery of agentic AI applications: LLM-powered agents with tool/function calling, MCP, multi-agent orchestration, RAG grounding, guardrails, evaluation and human-in-the-loop controls, integrated with event-driven microservices to automate Payments and Billing workflows. 
 - Drive CI/CD and DevSecOps maturity, and lead legacy-to-cloud-native modernization using AI-assisted engineering (for example, GitHub Copilot agent mode) to improve team productivity and quality. 

Qualification

- Preferred bachelor's degree in computer engineering, Computer Science, Applied Science, Electrical Engineering, or Math; Developer nanodegree; or equivalent experience. 
 - Typically requires 12+ years of experience in software development. 
 - Proficiency in Java, Spring boot (Rest, Security), Spring Integration, Kafka, Kubernetes, Oracle Server. 
 - Proven experience designing and delivering event-driven microservices in production, with measurable NFR outcomes (for example, latency, availability and throughput targets met). 
 - Should be able to rewrite the legacy applications into modern Cloud Native Microservices applications independently

Experience

- 12+ years of experience in developing cloud-native microservices applications using Java/Spring Boot. 
 - Strong communication skills and fluency in English. 
 - Experience in collaborative, team-oriented environments. 
 - Solid hands-on technical experience in Java, spring boot, and cloud deployment. 
 - Hands-on experience with Docker, Kubernetes, Kafka, Github Actions, Postman and Jenkins. 
 - Experience building Kafka-based event streaming solutions and implementing NFRs (performance, resiliency, scalability, security and observability) in production microservices. 
 - Proven experience taking agentic/GenAI applications to production), including evaluation of agent quality, LLM observability (tracing, token cost, latency) and responsible-AI guardrails; uses AI coding agents such as GitHub Copilot agent mode in day-to-day engineering. 

Core Competencies

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. 
 - Flexibility to support critical releases and production issues, and ability to work independently to drive issues to closure. 
 - Effective handling of multiple and complex work assignments, consistently delivering high-quality work. 
 - Perform application analysis and propose technical solutions for enhancements. 
 - Create necessary documentation for all project deliverable phases. 
 - Handle production issues during the warranty period, ensuring SLAs are met.

CSPM, EDR, etc) that dynamically audit infrastructure and enterprise controls. Constrain the outputs of AI coding assistants with declarative machine-readable rules.

 - Mentorship: Actively mentor senior and mid-level engineers across time zones, fostering a culture of technical excellence, accountability, and continuous learning. 
 - Lead cross-functional alignment and technical discussions across a geographically dispersed team operating in an asynchronous-first culture. 

You're Our Person If. . .

 - Regulatory Frameworks: Working knowledge of regulatory standards including NIST SP 800-53, ISO/IEC 27001, and SOC 2 (Trust Services Criteria). 
 - Compliance Engineering: Direct experience building or architecting systems around continuous control monitoring, automated audit trails, or policy engine evaluation (e. g. , OPA/Rego). 

Even Better If. . .

data.description:
The Company
PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy. 

We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers. 

We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade. 

Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do - and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities. 

Job Summary: 

What You Need To Know About The Role
As an Android Software Engineer, you will build and maintain the PayPal POS app on Android phones and on Zettle Terminal hardware. You will work on features across the merchant experience, from sign-in and bootstrap to checkout, receipts, refunds and invoices, and learn how the app talks to card readers and terminals. 

Meet our team

Zettle SMB Direct is the part of PayPal that builds the native point-of-sale experience for small and medium-sized businesses: the PayPal POS app (formerly Zettle Go) and the Zettle Terminal. Merchants use it to take card and tap payments, run checkout, manage their product library and inventory, issue receipts, handle refunds and invoices, and see what they earned. 

We are a growing engineering team in Bangalore working closely with colleagues in Sweden, who built much of the platform. 

Job Description: 

Essential Responsibilities: 

- Implements tasks within the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC), receiving structure and oversight from more experienced staff
 - Follows well-established internal conventions and standard procedures
 - Understands internal standards & processes an applies them to make technical decisions
 - Collaborates with peers, manager, and project lead to gain understanding of tasks and review solutions
 - May contribute to code & design reviews

Minimum Qualifications: 

- 1+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor's degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience. 

Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications: 

Your way to impact

- Make checkout and receipts fast and reliable for merchants at the counter, on phones and on terminals. 
 - Deliver features across product library, inventory, purchase history, refunds and invoices. 
 - Help legacy Zettle merchants move onto PayPal identity with a smooth sign-in and onboarding experience in the app. 
 - Improve app stability, release quality and crash-free sessions across a wide range of devices. 

Your day to day

- Build and ship features in Kotlin and Java using Jetpack libraries, coroutines and Jetpack Compose. 
 - Integrate with backend services over REST and GraphQL; handle auth and session flows. 
 - Work with Bluetooth reader connectivity and terminal hardware integration under guidance. 
 - Write unit and instrumentation tests, and take part in code reviews, CI/CD and staged releases. 
 - Investigate crashes and production issues using analytics and monitoring, and fix root causes. 
 - Pair with Sweden engineers and write documentation and runbooks for areas you take over. 

What Do You Need To Bring-

- 1 to 3 years of Android development experience with strong Kotlin. 
 - Hands-on with Jetpack, coroutines, networking and local persistence; Jetpack Compose is a plus. 
 - Experience with unit and instrumentation testing and CI/CD pipelines for mobile apps. 
 - Understanding of secure handling of sensitive data on device. 
 - Interest in payments; experience with Bluetooth peripherals, NFC or POS hardware is a plus. 
 - Nice to have: Java, GraphQL clients, device management and app distribution tooling. 
 - Clear written and spoken English, and comfort working across time zones with teammates in Bangalore and Sweden. 
 - A habit of writing things down: runbooks, design notes and decision records. 
 - Curiosity about payments and a sense of care for the merchants and customers who depend on the product. 

Subsidiary: 

PayPal

Travel Percent: 

0

PayPal does not charge candidates any fees for courses, applications, resume reviews, interviews, background checks, or onboarding. When making an application directly, we will never ask you to share passwords, one-time passcodes (OTP), or verification codes. Any such request is a red flag and likely part of a scam. All communication regarding your application will come from official PayPal email domains. If you suspect fraudulent activity, please report it immediately. To learn more about how to identify and avoid recruitment fraud please visit https: //careers. pypl. com/contact-us. 

For the majority of employees, PayPal's balanced hybrid work model offers 3 days in the office for effective in-person collaboration and 2 days at your choice of either the PayPal office or your home workspace, ensuring that you equally have the benefits and conveniences of both locations. 

Our Benefits: 

At PayPal, we're committed to building an equitable and inclusive global economy. And we can't do this without our most important asset-you. That's why we offer comprehensive, choice-based programs, to support all aspects of personal wellbeing-physical, emotional, and financial-delivering meaningful value where it matters most. We strive to create a flexible, balanced work culture with a holistic approach to benefits, including generous paid time off, healthcare coverage for you and your family, and resources to create financial security and support your mental health. 

Who We Are: 

Click Here to learn more about our culture and community. 

Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

PayPal provides equal employment opportunity (EEO) to all persons regardless of age, color, national origin, citizenship status, physical or mental disability, race, religion, creed, gender, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, genetic information, marital status, status with regard to public assistance, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law. In addition, PayPal will provide reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities. If you are unable to submit an application because of incompatible assistive technology or a disability, please contact us at paypalglobaltalentacquisition@paypal. com. 

Belonging at PayPal: 

Our employees are central to advancing our mission, and we strive to create an environment where everyone can do their best work with a sense of purpose and belonging. Belonging at PayPal means creating a workplace with a sense of acceptance and security where all employees feel included and valued. We are proud to have a diverse workforce reflective of the merchants, consumers, and communities that we serve, and we continue to take tangible actions to cultivate inclusivity and belonging at PayPal. 

Any general requests for consideration of your skills, please Join our Talent Community. 

We know the confidence gap and imposter syndrome can get in the way of meeting spectacular candidates. Please don't hesitate to apply.

data.title: Manager, Field Engineering
data.description:
As a Manager - Field Engineering, you will serve as the voice of the customer and drive product excellence within the tyre industry. In this role, you will bridge customer insights with product development initiatives, ensuring continuous product improvement while effectively managing and controlling warranty costs. 

Key Responsibility Areas

- You will champion the Voice of the Customer by translating field insights, claims data, and customer feedback into actions that improve product quality, reliability, and performance. 
 - You will lead field engineering and product validation activities, including product trials, evaluations, OE Mileage Surveys, Scrap Tyre Surveys, and Customer Satisfaction Surveys. 
 - You will analyze product claims, market intelligence, and performance trends to identify emerging issues, provide early warnings, and drive timely corrective actions. 
 - You will strengthen warranty and field-return performance through returned-tyre audits, warranty analysis, loss monitoring, variance reviews, and recommendations that enhance cost effectiveness. 
 - You will collaborate with Quality, Production, Design, AP Region, Sales, and Service teams to integrate field intelligence into product, process, and customer-focused improvements. 
 - You will build technical capability by delivering training programs and workshops for internal teams, customers, and dealers on product performance, field issues, handling practices, and customer requirements. 
 - You will drive continuous improvement by converting insights from claims, audits, surveys, trials, and customer interactions into sustainable business and product enhancements. 

Education And Experience

- You hold a degree in Mechanical, Automobile, Production, or a related Engineering discipline. 
 - You have at least 10 years of experience in tyre field engineering, product performance, quality, technical service, warranty management, or a similar role within the automotive or manufacturing industry. 
 - You possess strong expertise in claims analysis, field investigations, product validation, root-cause analysis, and corrective-action management. 
 - You demonstrate excellent stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration skills across technical, commercial, and customer-facing teams. 
 - You are proactive, customer-focused, and driven by continuous improvement, with a strong commitment to quality and product excellence. 
 - You have deep knowledge of tyre construction, failure modes, vehicle applications, field performance, and warranty practices. 
 - You have hands-on experience leading field trials, mileage studies, scrap tyre surveys, returned-product audits, and customer satisfaction programs. 
 - You have experience working with regional or global teams and influencing stakeholders without direct authority. 
 - You have experience developing technical training content and building capabilities across internal teams, dealers, and customers. 

Goodyear is one of the world's largest tire companies. It employs about 63, 000 people and manufactures its products in 48 facilities in 19 countries around the world. Its two Innovation Centers in Akron, Ohio, and Colmar-Berg, Luxembourg, strive to develop state-of-the-art products and services that set the technology and performance standard for the industry. For more information about Goodyear and its products, go to www. goodyear. com/corporate

Goodyear is an equal employment opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to any characteristic protected by law.

 - To ensure manufacturing operations are performed in compliance with approved SOPs, BMR/BPR, specifications, validated procedures, regulatory requirements and cGMP standards. 
 - To ensure effective implementation of Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP), Good Documentation Practices (GDP), Data Integrity and ALCOA+ principles across manufacturing operations. 
 - To provide QA oversight for line clearance activities before commencement of manufacturing, filling, packing and other GMP operations. 
 - To verify and ensure appropriate area, equipment and material status identification and compliance with approved procedures. 
 - To review and approve/verify Batch Manufacturing Records, Batch Packing Records, logbooks, checklists, equipment records and other GMP documents within defined responsibilities. 
 - To monitor and ensure compliance with in-process controls (IPCs) and critical process parameters during manufacturing operations. 
 - To provide QA oversight during aseptic filling and critical manufacturing operations and ensure compliance with approved procedures and validated process parameters with contamination control requirements. 
 - To coordinate with EM/ Microbiology for appropriate monitoring and review of environmental monitoring, personnel monitoring, microbial monitoring and other microbiological controls, as applicable. 
 - To ensure compliance with the site's Contamination Control Strategy (CCS) and identify potential contamination risks during manufacturing operations. 
 - To monitor personnel gowning, hygiene, aseptic practices and behavioral compliance in classified areas and initiate appropriate actions for observed deficiencies. 
 - To conduct routine shop-floor GMP inspections, IPQA rounds and compliance audits and ensure timely closure of identified observations. 
 - To initiate/review/coordinate Deviation, Incident, OOS/OOT, CAPA and other quality investigations arising from manufacturing and IPQA activities, as applicable. 
 - To ensure investigations are scientifically sound, adequately documented, supported by appropriate evidence and completed within defined timelines for root cause analysis, impact assessment, risk assessment and CAPA determination. 
 - To monitor implementation and effectiveness of CAPAs related to manufacturing and IPQA observations. 
 - To provide QA oversight for Change Controls related to manufacturing processes, equipment, facilities, utilities, materials, procedures and other GMP-impacting changes. 
 - To review and provide QA input on risk assessments, process-related risks and quality-impacting changes. 
 - To ensure appropriate QA involvement in process validation, cleaning validation, media fills/aseptic process simulations, equipment qualification and other validation activities, as applicable. 
 - To provide QA oversight during Media Fill / Aseptic Process Simulation (APS) activities and ensure compliance with approved protocols and procedures. 
 - To ensure appropriate QA review of process simulation interventions, personnel practices, environmental conditions, support and provide QA oversight during equipment qualification, process validation and validation-related manufacturing activities. 
 - To review and evaluate manufacturing trends, recurring deviations, process observations and other quality indicators and recommend appropriate improvement actions. 
 - To monitor IPQA quality metrics and KPIs, including deviations, documentation errors, line clearance observations, GMP observations, CAPA status and other relevant parameters. 
 - To identify critical, recurring and overdue quality issues and ensure appropriate escalation to site management. 
 - To participate in internal audits, customer audits and regulatory inspections and provide support for IPQA/manufacturing-related areas. 
 - To coordinate preparation of manufacturing/IPQA documentation and evidence required for USFDA, EMA, MHRA, WHO and applicable Indian regulatory authority inspections. 
 - To support preparation, review and implementation of responses to audit and inspection observations related to manufacturing and IPQA. 
 - To ensure effective implementation and sustainability of CAPAs arising from regulatory inspections, customer audits and internal audits. 
 - To ensure appropriate training and qualification of IPQA personnel on GMP, SOPs, aseptic practices, GDP, Data Integrity and other applicable quality requirements. 
 - To mentor, guide and develop IPQA team members and promote a strong quality and compliance culture. 
 - To review IPQA observations and ensure effective communication and follow-up with Production and other concerned departments. 
 - To coordinate with Production, QC, Microbiology, Engineering, Validation, Warehouse, Regulatory Affairs and other functions for timely resolution of quality and manufacturing issues. 

Qualifications

- M. Sc. / B. Pharm/ M. Pharm with minimum 16-18 years of relevant experience. 
 - Strong experience in IPQA/ shop-floor QA operations in injectable manufacturing site. Experience in sterile/injectable/aseptic manufacturing is strongly preferred. 
 - Strong knowledge of cGMP, GDP, Data Integrity, ALCOA+ and Pharmaceutical Quality Systems. 
 - Hands-on experience in QA oversight of dispensing, compounding, filling, packing, line clearance and in-process activities. 
 - Sound knowledge of aseptic processing, contamination control and sterile manufacturing practices. 
 - Experience in reviewing BMR/BPR, logbooks, batch documentation and manufacturing records. 
 - Experience in handling Deviation, CAPA, Change Control, OOS/OOT, Incident and Quality Risk Management activities. 
 - Experience in Media Fill/APS, process validation, cleaning validation and equipment qualification will be preferred. 
 - Good understanding of Environmental Monitoring and microbiological controls in sterile manufacturing environments. 
 - Experience in handling internal audits, customer audits and regulatory inspection readiness.

data.title: Princ Engr-AI Science
data.description:
When you join Verizon

You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely - even if they're daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love - driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together - lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere & always. Want in? Join the #VTeamLife. 

What You'll Be Doing. . . 

As a Principal Engineer (Agentic & Applied AI), you will serve as a technical leader and individual performer, architecting and driving end-to-end solutions for complex AI and Agentic use cases across multiple concurrent projects. You will be hands-on in design and coding, while leading project pods with one or two junior engineers or data scientists. 

- Leading the architecture, design, and end-to-end development of complex Agentic AI and traditional AI/ML solutions across multiple concurrent initiatives. 
 - Working in a collaborative environment with global teams and managing cross-functional stakeholders across business and technical domains to deliver scalable solutions to high-impact business problems. 
 - Architecting, developing, and deploying LLM-driven applications, multi-agent workflows, autonomous agent systems, and traditional data science models into production environments. 
 - Translating complex business requirements into robust technical and system architectures, creating high-level and low-level design documents, and articulating architectural decisions and findings to leadership and stakeholders. 
 - Hands-on coding and system implementation using Python, LangChain, LangGraph, Model Context Protocol (MCP), REST/gRPC APIs, BigQuery, PostgreSQL, and event-driven architectures with Apache Kafka. 
 - Guiding, mentoring, and technical coaching of junior engineers and data scientists on project pods-conducting peer code and architecture reviews, sharing constructive feedback, and driving the team toward best-in-class technical execution
 - Designing and implementing robust testing, validation, evaluation, and observability frameworks (e. g. , LLM evals, hallucination mitigation, latency/token optimization, model governance) across the end-to-end AI lifecycle. 
 - Developing next-generation AI systems with built-in data privacy, ethical AI, bias mitigation, guardrails, and compliance with enterprise security and governance policies. 
 - Assisting in growing the AI practice by leading POCs, identifying new high-value opportunities, defining architectural blueprints, evaluating emerging tools/frameworks, and contributing to technical white papers and documentation. 
 - Staying informed on the latest advancements in Generative AI, LLMs, Agentic frameworks, and related tech stacks, finding ways to deliver business value by customizing and applying them to our specific enterprise domain. 
 - Partnering with ecosystem partners, startups, and open-source communities to explore and integrate cutting-edge AI capabilities. 

What We're Looking For. . . 

You have deep technical expertise in modern AI engineering and traditional data science, and you thrive as a hands-on technical lead who bridges architecture, coding, and stakeholder collaboration. You are energized by working in a dynamic environment, handling multiple complex projects simultaneously, and translating ambiguous business problems into reliable, production-ready AI systems. You take pride in technical excellence, enjoy mentoring junior team members, and are passionate about advancing state-of-the-art Agentic and LLM architectures within an enterprise scale. 

What we're looking for. . . ("You'll need to have. . . ")

- Bachelor's degree with six or more years of relevant experience. 
 - Five or more years of hands-on experience in software engineering, applied machine learning, or advanced data science in production environments. 
 - One or more years of hands-on experience architecting, building, and deploying Agentic AI and LLM-driven solutions (e. g. , autonomous agents, multi-agent systems, tool calling/function calling, agent workflows). 
 - Strong hands-on proficiency with modern AI orchestration and agentic frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, or equivalent agent frameworks. 
 - Deep familiarity with Model Context Protocol (MCP) architecture, tool integration standards, REST/gRPC APIs, and microservices design. 
 - Expert-level coding proficiency in Python and solid software engineering practices (OOP, design patterns, modular architecture, CI/CD, testing, code quality). 
 - Strong experience working with relational, analytical, and streaming data stores: BigQuery, PostgreSQL, and event-driven architectures using Apache Kafka. 
 - Solid foundation and working understanding of traditional data science methodologies, predictive modeling, machine learning concepts (supervised/unsupervised learning, neural networks, ensembling), and evaluation metrics. 
 - Experience with all phases of an end-to-end AI project lifecycle: data ingestion/streaming, preprocessing, prompt engineering/fine-tuning, model validation/evals, containerization, deployment, operationalization, monitoring, and tracing. 
 - Demonstrated track record of leading technical implementation across multiple simultaneous projects and collaborating effectively with cross-functional business and technical stakeholders. 
 - Experience providing technical mentorship, conducting architectural and code reviews, and giving feedback to junior engineers and data scientists. 

What we're looking for. . . ("Even better if you have. . . ")

- Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related quantitative field. 
 - Experience architecting and deploying AI/ML and Agentic solutions in the Telecommunications domain or large-scale enterprise environments. 
 - Experience with Vector Databases and advanced Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) techniques (hybrid search, reranking, contextual compression). 
 - Hands-on experience with LLM evaluation frameworks and guardrail systems
 - Experience with cloud AI platforms (GCP Vertex AI, AWS Bedrock/SageMaker, Azure OpenAI) and distributed compute/data infrastructure. 
 - Experience in optimization, simulation techniques, or operations research applied to enterprise problems. 
 - Active contributions to open-source AI projects, agent frameworks, or authoring technical white papers and publications. 
 - Exceptional presentation, communication, and executive storytelling skills with a proven ability to influence technical and non-technical leadership. 

Where you'll be working

In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes work from home and assigned office days set by your manager. 

Scheduled Weekly Hours

40

Equal Employment Opportunity

Verizon is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, gender, disability or any other legally protected characteristics.

data.title: Test Engineer
data.description:
Job Description

About TI

Texas Instruments Incorporated (TI) is a global semiconductor design and manufacturing company that develops analog ICs and embedded processors. By employing the world's brightest minds, TI creates innovations that shape the future of technology. TI is helping about 100, 000 customers transform the future, today. We're committed to building a better future - from the responsible manufacturing of our semiconductors, to caring for our employees, to giving back inside our communities and developing great minds. In TI's Power Products, we're developing breakthrough technology to power the world's future innovations as well. Put your talent to work with us - change the world, love your job!

Why HVDC

Big Data, Artificial Intelligence, and data centers are just a few of the trends driving the need for high-current multiphase switching power in the Enterprise market. The HVDC product line is focused on bringing to market the controllers and Smart Power Stage (driver plus GaN with integrated sensing) solutions for enterprise computing and other ASICs that are power hungry and require high currents. The HVDC team actively collaborates with TI's advanced technology, packaging and research and development teams to deliver the highest power density solutions for the power level. 

About The Job

At TI, Test Engineers leverage strong technical knowledge working hands-on to bring differentiated power solutions to our customers globally. Test Engineers also partner closely with Design, Test, Systems and Application engineers to ensure our power solutions are both meeting customer and market requirements and are cost-wise optimized. 

You will also own production stability end-to-end - resolving critical manufacturing, test, yield, and reliability issues with urgency while eliminating recurring problems through rigorous root-cause and permanent corrective action. You will develop and execute strategies to continuously improve yield and reduce test cost and execute platforms conversions across the product portfolio, working directly with factory teams to implement solutions and sustain gains on the production floor. 

About The Role And Team

- Work with the design team to understand design specifications and system challenges
 - Generate test plan, create test and char program, design ATE hardware interface boards
 - Debug characterizing silicon on ATE, and correlate results with bench data
 - Analyze silicon results, supporting failure analysis tasks
 - Perform statistical analysis of yield fallout, debug and fix yield issues; optimize test time
 - Work with the production team to release products to volume production
 - Test strategy definition and implementation for controller and power stage devices
 - Silicon qualification, including the qual program development
 - Comprehensive device debugging, design validation, and failure analysis
 - Drive for robust and cost-effective test solutions while being accountable for product quality
 - Work with the design and Firmware team to support customer needs, implement custom features in FW. Close collaboration with FW and validation teams to understand the device issues and bugs and find the FW level workaround for the fix. 

Qualifications

Minimum requirements: 

- Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or related field of study
 - 5+ years of relevant experience

Preferred Qualifications

- Strong fundamentals in electronics: RC networks, operational amplifiers, ADCs, DACs, GaN, etc. 
 - Experience in silicon bring-up and debug, and characterization on tester platforms such as ETS/UFlex/UFlex+. 
 - Expertise in schematic design for Hardware/Device Interface Board (HIB/DIB) 
 - Experience in writing test plan and designing test cases 
 - Should be able to lead a project from planning to production release
 - Experienced with test program and hardware offload to TI offshore manufacturing sites 
 - Demonstrated strong analytical and problem-solving skills
 - Strong verbal and written communication skills
 - Ability to work in teams and collaborate effectively with people in different functions
 - Strong time management skills that enable on-time project delivery
 - Demonstrated ability to build strong, influential relationships
 - Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced and rapidly changing environment
 - Ability to take the initiative and drive for results

About Us

Why TI?

- The future starts here. As a TIer, you'll play a critical role in defining the next era of semiconductor technology and help create the innovations that shape the world around us. 
 - Surround yourself with a team of innovators who value your unique perspective and will challenge you to bring your best self to work every day. We believe that fostering a culture of collaboration fuels both personal growth and technological breakthroughs. Explore our company culture . 
 - At TI, your success goes beyond your work. Take advantage of comprehensive benefits designed to support your total well-being at work and in life, from competitive compensation to extensive health coverage and wellness programs. Learn more about our benefits offerings . 

About Texas Instruments

Texas Instruments Incorporated (Nasdaq: TXN) is a global semiconductor company that designs, manufactures and sells analog and embedded processing chips for markets such as industrial, automotive, data center, personal electronics and communications equipment. At our core, we have a passion to create a better world by making electronics more affordable through semiconductors. This passion is alive today as each generation of innovation builds upon the last to make our technology more reliable, more affordable and lower power, making it possible for semiconductors to go into electronics everywhere. Learn more at TI. com . 

Texas Instruments is an equal opportunity employer and supports a diverse, inclusive work environment. 

If you are interested in this position, please apply to this requisition. 

About The Team

TI does not make recruiting or hiring decisions based on citizenship, immigration status or national origin. However, if TI determines that information access or export control restrictions based upon applicable laws and regulations would prohibit you from working in this position without first obtaining an export license, TI expressly reserves the right not to seek such a license for you and either offer you a different position that does not require an export license or decline to move forward with your employment.
