Company Profile

Lennox (NYSE: LII) Driven by 130 years of legacy, HVAC and refrigeration success, Lennox provides our residential and commercial customers with industry-leading climate-control solutions. At Lennox, we win as a team, aiming for excellence and delivering innovative, sustainable products and services. Our culture guides us and creates a workplace where all employees feel heard and welcomed. Lennox is a global community that values each team member's contributions and offers a supportive environment for career development. Come, stay, and grow with us. 

Job Description

The Lead Architect owns the end-to-end technical design of enterprise applications built on Java and the Spring ecosystem. The role combines hands-on architecture of cloud-ready, event-driven microservices with technical leadership across the software development lifecycle - setting standards, mentoring engineers, driving engineering excellence and ensuring solutions are scalable, secure, resilient, and aligned with business goals. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, including developers, product managers, and business stakeholders, to deliver innovative and future-proof solutions. 

Key Responsibilities

- Own the end-to-end architecture for assigned systems, from solution design through detailed component, integration, and deployment architecture. 
 - Translate business and product requirements into scalable, secure, and maintainable technical solutions while collaborating closely with business, product, and delivery teams. 
 - Define and maintain architectural standards, best practices, governance frameworks, and technical roadmaps. 
 - Ensure non-functional requirements including performance, scalability, security, availability, resilience, and fault tolerance are incorporated into all solutions. 
 - Design and oversee the development of Java-based, cloud-ready microservices using Spring Boot, REST APIs, and event-driven architectures. 
 - Provide architectural guidance to development teams and ensure implementation aligns with the approved architecture. 
 - Partners with product and delivery leads to estimate effort, sequence work, and manage architectural dependencies and technical risks. 
 - Lead the development of new features, enhancements, and modernization initiatives across the application landscape. 
 - Participate in and provide technical leadership throughout the Software Development Lifecycle (requirements, design, development, testing, deployment, and support). 
 - Conduct architecture and code reviews to ensure compliance with coding standards, security guidelines, and quality best practices. 
 - Drive engineering excellence through Agile architecture, DevSecOps practices, CI/CD automation, and cloud adoption. 
 - Optimize application performance, troubleshooting complex technical issues, and continuously improving system reliability. 
 - Mentor architects and senior developers while fostering collaboration, innovation, and technical excellence. 
 - Promote knowledge sharing through technical documentation, architecture artifacts, workshops, and training sessions. 
 - Stay current with emerging technologies and evaluate their applicability to improve business outcomes and engineering capabilities

Qualifications

- 10-12 years of experience in enterprise application development, with at least 3+ years in a Solution Architect or Technical Lead role. 
 - Proven experience designing and delivering enterprise-scale, distributed applications and microservices. 
 - Strong expertise in Java SE/EE and Spring ecosystem (Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Spring Security). 
 - Proficiency in Java as the primary language, with working knowledge of Python or JavaScript as an advantage. 
 - Experience designing RESTful APIs, microservices, event-driven architectures, and integration using SOAP where required. 
 - Experience with messaging platforms such as Kafka or RabbitMQ and API Gateway technologies. 
 - Strong knowledge of relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server) and database design principles. 
 - Familiarity with front-end technologies such as HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and frameworks like React. 
 - Experience with Git and modern software development workflows. 
 - Experience implementing DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and cloud-native deployment patterns. 
 - Hands-on experience with a major cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and experience with containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes). 
 - Familiarity with observability and monitoring tooling (e. g. , Prometheus, Grafana, ELK) and SLO/SLA definition. 
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to troubleshoot complex technical issues. 
 - Ability to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions aligned with enterprise architecture. 
 - Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with experience collaborating across engineering teams, business stakeholders, and senior leadership. 
 - Ability to influence technical decisions and drive architectural governance across multiple teams.

data.title: Senior Manager, Data Analytics Engineering
data.description:
WD is building the infrastructure behind the AI-driven data economy. 

As AI scales, so does data. Every interaction, every model, every system generates data that must be stored, managed, and made accessible over time. That's where we come in. 

We combine deep engineering expertise with global-scale manufacturing to deliver the storage systems that make AI possible, powering hyperscale data centers, cloud platforms, and enterprise infrastructure worldwide. 

This isn't theoretical work. It's real systems, at real scale, people solving some of the hardest challenges in technology today. 

We're looking for people who want to build, solve, and operate at that level. 

Join us and let's shape the future of data. 

Job Description

About the role

- Western Digital's Data Analytics Engineering team is building the Agentic Factory Data Platform. It gives factory operations, analytics, and AI-driven applications near real-time access to manufacturing data through scalable, event-driven architecture. 

- As Senior Manager, you lead the tech leads and developers who build and run this platform, and you stay close to the engineering. You review code, challenge designs, and coach engineers to build better systems. You own delivery and engineer growth across real-time ingestion, event streaming, data transformation, analytical data services, observability, and AI enablement. You work alongside the platform Tech Lead, who owns architecture decisions. 

What you will do

- Set the engineering bar. Review code and designs, and hold teams to high standards for quality, testing, and operability. Give engineers clear, specific design recommendations, and work with the Tech Lead and Staff engineers on technical direction. 

- Develop engineers and tech leads. Coach through regular feedback and individual growth plans. Hire strong engineers, run talent reviews, and sponsor promotions. Build a team culture of accountability, inclusion, and continuous improvement across 8+ engineers. 

- Deliver the platform roadmap. Own cross-team delivery, including dependencies, risks, scope, schedule, and cost. Build the roadmap with engineering, product, QA, and business partners, and show its value in ROI, risk, and productivity. 

- Keep production reliable. Make sure SLAs, latency targets, and availability commitments are defined with the Tech Lead and owned by engineering. Lead blameless post-mortems that lead to permanent fixes. Act as the escalation point for production incidents, and help engineers diagnose root causes in technical detail. 

- Own budget, cost, and risk. Manage budget, headcount, infrastructure spend, and vendors. Weigh technical debt and legacy deprecation against feature work. Build security and compliance into platform operations. 

- Scale AI-assisted engineering. Introduce AI tools for development, code review, and documentation, and measure whether they improve team productivity. 

Qualifications

Required qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience. 

- 12+ years in software or data engineering, including substantial time as a hands-on engineer building production systems. 

- Ability to review code in at least one of Python, Java, Scala, or Go, and to assess designs for distributed systems, data pipelines, and streaming or batch architecture. 

- 5+ years of people management leading multiple teams or 8+ engineers, including tech leads, with a record of coaching, promotions, and developing engineers. 

- Experience leading teams that build and run production data platforms (streaming, CDC, batch, or cloud and Kubernetes infrastructure), with accountability for SLAs and availability. 

- Record of owning cross-team delivery and resolving ambiguous problems across engineering, product, and QA. 

- Strong communication, and the ability to influence executives, peers, and partners without direct authority. 

Nice to have

- Recent hands-on coding or prototyping. 

- Production experience with Kubernetes, CI/CD, GitOps, or observability tooling. 

- Manufacturing, semiconductor, or enterprise data platform background. 

- Experience managing budgets, headcount plans, or vendor contracts. 

- Experience introducing AI-assisted development tools or enabling AI agents on enterprise data. 

Additional Information

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

data.description:
INSPIRE | EXHILARATE | DELIGHT

Chalhoub Group's Capability Hub is our technology and innovation hub set up with the vision to unite exceptional talent to build technology and capabilities that elevate luxury experiences and define the future of luxury retail. 

For over seven decades, Chalhoub Group has been a partner and creator of luxury experiences in the Middle East. In its pursuit to excel as a hybrid luxury retailer, the Group has curated a portfolio of over 10 owned brands and strengthened its distribution and marketing expertise for over 400 international names across luxury fashion, beauty, jewellery, watches, eyewear, and art de vivre categories. 

Every step at Chalhoub Group is taken to build a future where luxury dreams become reality - bridging cultures and crafting memorable experiences for our consumers. Be it by constantly reinventing itself, committing to innovation, or embracing new technologies, the Group is shaping the future of luxury retail. It delivers seamless omnichannel experiences across more than 950 stores, online platforms, and mobile apps. Driving this innovation journey is The Greenhouse - the Group's innovation hub, incubator, and accelerator for startups and emerging businesses, regionally and globally. 

Chalhoub Group fosters a people-at-heart culture rooted in diversity, equity, and inclusion, and a workplace catalysed by forward thinking and future proofing. Today, it brings together over 16, 000 talented professionals across eight countries in the Middle East, with a presence in LATAM. 

Sustainability is at the core of the Group's strategy, guided by a clear commitment to people, partners, and the planet. Chalhoub Group is proud to be a member of the United Nations Global Compact, a signatory of the Women's Empowerment Principles, and to have pledged to reach Net Zero by 2040. 

What You'll Be Doing

- Lead the Data Engineering capability across data platform engineering, data pipelines and processing, data operations, BI and reporting, and data quality engineering, delivering reliable cloud data infrastructure and trustworthy analytics for the business. 
 - Lead the Data Engineering capability, owning data platform engineering across the cloud data platform (Google BigQuery), storage, compute, and data access layers on GCP. 
 - Own data pipelines and processing, engineering robust ETL/ELT ingestion pipelines (Python, Apache Airflow, dbt, Airbyte) and batch and streaming processing from source systems into the data warehouse. 
 - Own data operations, including pipeline monitoring, job orchestration and scheduling, incident resolution, and the reliability and uptime of data ingestion (DataOps). 
 - Own BI and reporting, developing semantic layers (Looker, LookML), reporting models, and dashboards (Power BI, SQL) to deliver actionable business intelligence. 
 - Own data quality engineering, implementing automated data testing, data validation, anomaly detection, and cleansing logic to ensure accuracy and data integrity. 
 - Own engineering leadership, capability and team development, engineering practices, and continuous improvement across the data engineering team. 
 - Remain hands-on: plan, design, execute, and document data validation and automated data testing across integrated data systems for assigned scope. 
 - Use Claude Code for AI-assisted development to accelerate pipeline and query development while maintaining quality. 

What You'll Need To Succeed

- 10 years of data engineering experience, including experience leading or mentoring engineers. 
 - Strong expertise in Google BigQuery, cloud data warehousing, data access control, and GCP. 
 - Hands-on experience with ETL/ELT (Python, Apache Airflow, dbt, Airbyte), batch and streaming processing, and DataOps (pipeline monitoring, job orchestration, incident resolution). 
 - Proficiency in BI and reporting (Looker, LookML, Power BI, SQL, dashboard design) and data quality engineering (data validation, automated data testing, anomaly detection). 
 - Familiarity with Claude Code for AI-assisted development. 

What We Can Offer You

With us, you will turn your aspirations into reality. We will help shape your journey through enriching experiences, learning and development opportunities and exposure to different assignments within your role or through internal mobility. Our Group offers diverse career paths for those who are extraordinary, every day. 

We recognise the value that you bring, and we strive to provide a competitive benefits package which includes health care, child education contribution, remote and flexible working policies as well as exclusive employee discounts. 

Using GenAI in Your Application Process

To support a fair and consistent experience for all candidates, we ask that assessments and interviews are completed independently and without assistance from generative AI tools. This ensures we understand your strengths, your thinking, and how you approach real situations. 

We Invite All Applicants to Apply

It Takes Diversity Of Thought, Culture, Background, Differing Abilities and Perspectives to truly Inspire, Exhilarate and Delight our customers. At Chalhoub Group, we are committed to inclusion and diversity. 

We welcome all applicants to apply and be part of our exciting future. We ensure equal opportunity for all our applicants without regard to gender, age, race, religion, national origin or disability status.

data.title: Senior Software Engineer, Backend
data.description:
About the Team

DoorDash is building the world's most reliable on-demand logistics engine for delivery! We're looking for experienced engineers to join our fast-growing engineering team and help us develop a 24x7, global infrastructure system that powers DoorDash's three-sided marketplace of consumers, merchants and Dashers. 

About the Role

We're looking for Senior Backend Engineers to join our product engineering team in Hyderabad. Product-focused engineers work at the intersection of product and infrastructure to solve key business problems with elegant technical solutions. 

You'll work directly with product managers and cross-functional partners and move quickly from idea to experiment to production. You'll be challenged to consider the big picture, evaluating and executing on trade-offs to maximize business impact for the company. We expect Senior Engineers to be able to own projects end-to-end and mentor their junior and mid-level peers. 

This role is hybrid with some in-office time expected and will report to an Engineering Manager. 

You're excited about this opportunity because you will. . . 

- Develop, release and run large-scale web applications
 - Develop and define the backend architecture and tech stack for a product area
 - Improve performance, reliability, scalability and security for our backend systems
 - Build fast-growing products for consumers and businesses and help take them to new markets globally
 - Run rapid experiments with product partners and see your work's direct impact on customers and the business
 - Be part of a new product engineering team in India and help shape how it builds and operates

We're excited about you because. . . 

- B. S. , M. S. , or PhD. in Computer Science or equivalent
 - 5+ years of industry experience working with backend tech stacks
 - Proficiency in using AI coding tools (e. g. , Claude Code, Codex, Cursor) in the full software development lifecycle, including designing, generating code, testing, monitoring and releasing software. AI is your default way of working, not an add-on. 
 - A strong sense of ownership and a bias for action: you take unclear problems from idea to production and own the outcome
 - Product and business sense: you think about the end customer and make pragmatic trade-offs between speed and quality
 - Ability to analyze and improve the efficiency, scalability and stability of system resources
 - Experience with service-oriented architecture, writing REST or gRPC APIs, unit testing, and architectural design
 - Experience with SQL and NoSQL databases and other technologies (e. g. Postgres, Redis, Elasticsearch, RabbitMQ)
 - Clear communication with engineers, product managers and business partners across time zones

About DoorDash

At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users-from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. We are a technology and logistics company that started by enabling door-to-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known as the place you order food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods. 

DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. We're committed to supporting employees' happiness, healthiness, and overall well-being by providing comprehensive benefits and perks. 

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel. 

If you need any accommodations, please inform your recruiting contact upon initial connection.

data.description:
WD is building the infrastructure behind the AI-driven data economy. 

As AI scales, so does data. Every interaction, every model, every system generates data that must be stored, managed, and made accessible over time. That's where we come in. 

We combine deep engineering expertise with global-scale manufacturing to deliver the storage systems that make AI possible, powering hyperscale data centers, cloud platforms, and enterprise infrastructure worldwide. 

This isn't theoretical work. It's real systems, at real scale, people solving some of the hardest challenges in technology today. 

We're looking for people who want to build, solve, and operate at that level. 

Join us and let's shape the future of data. 

Job Description

Western Digital's Data Analytics Engineering team is building the Agentic Factory Data Platform. It gives factory operations, analytics, and AI-driven applications near real-time access to manufacturing data through scalable, event-driven architecture. 

This is a hands-on senior engineering role with accountability for factory data. You will own the data for a factory domain end to end, from source systems to the dashboards and data products that end users rely on. You will write and debug code every day, make design decisions that have to hold up for years, and guide the engineers around you. 

What you will do

- Own factory data end to end. Take accountability for the correctness, freshness, availability, and lineage of the data in your factory domain, across source systems, pipelines, stores, and dashboards. Define the data contracts and quality checks that make it trusted. Be the person users and other teams go to when numbers are questioned. 
 - Understand the factory. Work with factory engineers, operations, and analytics users to understand their processes, KPIs, and decisions. Turn these into data requirements, and model the relationships across manufacturing systems, equipment, and process data. 
 - Build streaming data pipeline applications. Design and build pipelines that capture changes (CDC), stream events, and process and serve data in near real time. Write production-quality Python and stream-processing code, with tests and CI/CD. 
 - Deliver dashboards and data products. Build the dashboards, KPI views, and data services that operations teams use. Make sure the numbers match factory definitions and refresh fast enough to support decisions on the floor. 
 - Make design decisions that last. Choose data models, schemas, and technologies with the long term in mind: schema evolution, scalability, operating cost, and the maintenance burden you leave the team. Record decisions and trade-offs in design documents, and revisit them as volumes and needs change. 
 - Choose the right data store. Select databases for each workload (relational, NoSQL, real-time analytics, or search) based on access patterns, scale, and cost. Tune schemas, indexes, partitioning, queries, and replication using your knowledge of database internals. 
 - Operate and debug what you build. Run your pipelines in production against defined SLOs for latency, throughput, and data quality. Debug production problems across application code, databases, and infrastructure, using logs, metrics, traces, profilers, and the source of the open-source components when needed. Handle on-call response, find root causes, and fix recurring problems permanently. 
 - Use and improve open-source technology. Evaluate, deploy, upgrade, and troubleshoot open-source data platform components in production. Tune them, and patch or contribute upstream where it helps. 
 - Raise the engineering bar. Lead design and code reviews, find failure modes and systemic risks early, and coach junior and mid-level engineers, including by pairing on hard debugging problems. Deploy your applications on Kubernetes with GitHub, CI/CD, and GitOps. 
 - Build AI readiness. Evaluate AI tools and agentic patterns, including MCP-style access to data. Use them to make factory data available to agents and to automate data engineering work. 

Qualifications

Required qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience. 
 - 8+ years in software or data engineering, delivering production-grade systems. 
 - Strong hands-on coding and debugging skills. Proficiency in Python for scalable backend services and data applications, and strong computer science fundamentals (algorithms and data structures). You can trace and fix problems in distributed, data-intensive systems, including performance, concurrency, and data-correctness issues. 
 - Hands-on experience building and operating production streaming and batch pipelines, including CDC and event streaming. 
 - Experience owning data for a business or operational domain, including quality, lineage, and accountability for availability and accuracy. This includes turning business or factory requirements into data models, KPIs, and working data products such as dashboards or reporting layers. 
 - Experience making and documenting long-term design decisions on data models and technology selection, with trade-offs in scale, cost, and maintainability. This includes SQL and NoSQL databases and big data technologies, with knowledge of internals and performance tuning (indexing, query plans, partitioning, replication). 
 - Hands-on experience running open-source data technologies in production. 
 - Experience deploying and operating applications on Kubernetes or similar platforms, with CI/CD and GitOps. 
 - Clear written and verbal communication with technical and non-technical audiences. Nice to have

- Manufacturing, semiconductor, or storage experience (MES, equipment data, SPC, yield analytics). 
 - Familiarity with agentic AI concepts: tool use, multi-step orchestration, and Model Context Protocol (MCP). 
 - Cloud platform experience (AWS, GCP, or Azure). 
 - Batch and streaming pipelines built with Spark and Kafka. 
 - Agile delivery with test-driven development.

data.title: PRINCIPAL, SOFTWARE ENGINEER
data.description:
About Team

GDF (Global Data Foundation) is part of Walmart's AI & Data organization - the team building the foundational data platforms that power AI, analytics, and decision-making across every Walmart banner and geography, from supply chain and merchandising to customer experience and enterprise AI agents. Our newly created platform team is chartered with building next-generation data infrastructure at Walmart scale: reliable, high-throughput data pipelines, distributed processing systems, and platform capabilities that downstream teams across Walmart depend on every day. 

What You'll Do

- Design, build, and operate large-scale batch and streaming data pipelines using Spark, Java, and Python, processing data at Walmart scale. 
 - Apply strong software engineering fundamentals - clean architecture, automated testing, CI/CD, code review discipline - to data engineering work; this is a software engineering role that specializes in data, not a script-writing role. 
 - Apply domain-oriented design, system design, and low-level design (LLD) rigor to ambiguous data and platform problems - evaluating dependencies, trade-offs, failure modes, scalability, cost, and long-term durability before writing a line of code. 
 - Flex into platform/software engineering work when needed: build and maintain services, APIs, and distributed systems that data pipelines depend on, contributing directly to GDF's broader platform codebase. 
 - Integrate AI, GenAI, and agentic capabilities directly into the data platform: embeddings/vector search for data discovery, LLM-assisted data quality and anomaly detection, agentic pipeline monitoring and self-healing, AI-assisted schema and lineage documentation. 
 - Partner with data scientists and ML engineers to build feature pipelines, model-serving data paths, and the data infrastructure that MLOps depends on. 
 - Own data quality, observability, and governance for the pipelines and datasets you build, with a strong Operational Excellence / Engineering Excellence discipline. 
 - Participate in and lead architecture and design reviews spanning both data engineering and platform engineering domains. 
 - As a Principal engineer, set technical direction and best practices across multiple teams and the broader GDF platform without needing a management title - mentor other engineers and influence GDF's broader data engineering standards. 
 - Continuously evaluate emerging Big Data, cloud, and AI/agentic technologies, adopting them pragmatically where they improve reliability, productivity, or business value. 

What You'll Bring

- Genuinely hands-on coding: 12+ years of professional software engineering experience with significant hands-on data engineering at scale; strong proficiency in Java and Python is required, and strong working knowledge of Spark for distributed data processing is required, not optional. Additional experience with Go, C++, or Scala is a plus. 
 - Operational Excellence (OE) and Engineering Excellence (EE) mindset is a required skill, not a nice-to-have: SLO/SLA ownership, incident management and blameless post-incident reviews, proactive reliability and quality metrics, and continuous improvement built into how you ship, not bolted on afterward. 
 - Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - Deep experience with the Big Data ecosystem - Spark, Hadoop/HDFS, Hive, Kafka, workflow orchestration (Airflow or equivalent) - including batch and streaming processing, and large-scale data transformation. 
 - Strong data platform fundamentals: data modeling, ETL/ELT pipeline design, data quality and observability, data governance, and integration with lakehouse architectures (e. g. , Delta Lake, BigQuery, Databricks).

data.description:
Senior AI Lead - CYURAE

Location: Gurugram · Work arrangement: On-site · Employment: Permanent

Experience required: 5+ years of professional experience in software or AI/ML engineering, including 3+ years in applied AI/ML and 2+ years leading AI engineers through technical leadership or engineering management. These periods may overlap. 

CYURAE is looking for a Senior AI Lead who combines strong artificial intelligence expertise with the ability to lead engineers and deliver production-ready software. 

You will be accountable for the technical quality, execution, and operational readiness of AI development. You will lead AI engineers, remain involved in important technical decisions, and coordinate with backend, frontend/mobile, QA, and infrastructure teams to deliver complete, reliable releases. 

We are looking for someone with direct experience delivering recommendation systems and virtual try-on solutions to real users. You should be able to explain your individual contribution, the engineering decisions you made, how you evaluated the results, and how you handled problems after deployment. 

Your responsibilities will include: 

- Leading AI engineering. Translate business objectives into practical technical approaches. Guide model selection, experimentation, implementation, and integration, balancing quality, development effort, maintainability, and operating cost. 

- Managing the AI team. Break work into clear assignments, establish ownership, review progress, and resolve technical blockers. Mentor engineers, provide constructive feedback, and maintain consistent standards for code, evaluation, testing, and documentation. 

- Planning and managing delivery. Prepare realistic estimates, sequence work, identify dependencies, and agree acceptance criteria. Maintain visibility of commitments, raise risks early, and recommend adjustments when requirements, capacity, or feasibility change. 

- Coordinating the wider engineering team. Work closely with backend, frontend/mobile, QA, and DevOps owners. Clarify interfaces and integration requirements, resolve shared blockers, and ensure individual components work correctly together. 

- Providing hands-on technical leadership. Review architecture and code, investigate difficult failures, and contribute to critical implementation work where needed. Help engineers make decisions they can explain and validate. 

- Establishing meaningful evaluation. Define baselines and suitable measures before promoting changes. Review model quality, data quality, failure cases, and performance across relevant conditions. Ensure reported improvements are supported by reproducible evidence. 

- Managing production readiness. Coordinate integration testing, deployment preparation, monitoring, recovery arrangements, and support ownership. Ensure limitations and failure-handling behavior are understood before release. 

- Improving reliability and efficiency. Work with backend and infrastructure engineers to investigate production issues, manage resource requirements, and improve latency, stability, and cost. Follow incidents through to corrective action. 

- Communicating decisions and progress. Give product and engineering leadership a clear view of delivery status, unresolved decisions, technical risks, and proposed next steps. 

You should bring the following experience: 

- Recommendation systems: Hands-on delivery experience covering data preparation, candidate retrieval, ranking, personalization, cold-start handling, and feedback. Be able to explain how you measured relevance and improved the system after observing real users. 

- Virtual try-on and computer vision: Direct experience building, adapting, or integrating a solution used by real users. Understand input processing, output-quality evaluation, supported conditions, common failures, and the tradeoffs between quality, latency, and cost. 

- Applied machine learning: Strong Python skills and practical experience with embeddings, model training or adaptation, experimentation, and evaluation. Be comfortable investigating poor data, leakage, and misleading metrics. 

- Backend architecture: A solid understanding of APIs, databases, authentication, authorization, caching, asynchronous processing, retries, and service contracts. Be able to reason about reliable integration between AI services and applications. 

- AWS and MLOps: Practical experience deploying or operating AI workloads, including model serving, versioning, deployment pipelines, monitoring, scaling, and recovery. Understand CPU/GPU requirements and infrastructure cost drivers. 

- Technical leadership: Experience leading AI engineers, reviewing their work, mentoring team members, and taking responsibility for delivery. Bring concrete examples of resolving technical disagreements, integration failures, or missed commitments. 

- Engineering judgment: A practical approach to testing, maintainability, data privacy, access controls, and commercial-use rights for models and datasets. 

Experience managing the complete engineering team is a strong advantage. 

We particularly value candidates who have directly managed delivery across AI, backend, and frontend/mobile teams. This includes coordinating parallel work, resolving competing priorities, guiding releases, and organizing improvements after launch. 

Success in this role means the team has clear priorities and ownership, technical decisions are documented, integration dependencies are addressed early, and releases are supported by relevant evaluation and testing. Quality, reliability, latency, and operating cost should be understood and measured, with improvements tied to observed results. 

Apply through LinkedIn with your CV or Send Email on nitin@cyurae. com with a brief delivery summary covering: 

- The number of distinct products you helped launch and substantial projects you led. 

- One recommendation-system delivery and one virtual try-on delivery. 

- Your personal technical contribution and measurable outcomes. 

- The size and functions of the teams you led or directly managed. 

Please distinguish prototypes and internal pilots from systems used by real users. Anonymized case studies are welcome where previous work is confidential.

data.title: GTM Automation Engineer- B2B SaaS.
data.description:
GTM Automation EngineerLocation: Bengaluru (Work From Office)

Employment Type: Full-time

Experience: 2+ years

Compensation: ₹5 - 8 LPA + Performance-Based Bonuses

About ZyluZylu is an AI-powered growth management platform helping salons, spas, and beauty businesses grow revenue, improve customer retention, and streamline operations. 

We serve businesses across India and international markets, including the Middle East and Southeast Asia. 

We're building an AI-driven growth engine to scale customer acquisition through intelligent automation, data, and technology. 

About the RoleWe're looking for a hands-on GTM Automation Engineer to build, integrate, and scale Zylu's inbound and outbound customer acquisition systems. 

You'll work closely with the founders and Growth team to automate prospect discovery, lead enrichment, qualification, personalized outreach, demo scheduling, trial activation, and conversion workflows. 

We don't expect you to rebuild what existing SaaS platforms already do well. We expect you to identify the right tools, integrate them effectively, build what's missing, and make the entire system work reliably. 

This is a technical, execution-focused role where success is measured by business outcomes, not the number of workflows built. 

Key Responsibilities1. Inbound GTM Automation
 - Automate lead capture, enrichment, scoring, routing, and follow-ups across websites, paid campaigns, organic channels, and trial sign-ups. 
 - Build AI-powered lead qualification, nurturing, and demo-booking workflows. 
 - Automate trial onboarding, activation, engagement, and conversion journeys. 
 - Integrate HubSpot with marketing, sales, product, and customer success systems. 
 - Improve lead response times, conversion rates, and sales productivity through automation. 

2. Outbound GTM Automation
 - Build automated prospect discovery, enrichment, segmentation, and scoring systems targeting salons, spas, and multi-location businesses. 
 - Leverage platforms such as Clay, Apollo, Instantly, and other GTM tools to identify and qualify decision-makers. 
 - Develop personalized, multichannel outreach workflows across email, WhatsApp, LinkedIn, and calling. 
 - Build signal-based prospecting workflows using new business openings, branch expansions, hiring activity, and other relevant market signals. 
 - Automate follow-ups, reply classification, lead qualification, meeting scheduling, and CRM updates. 3. AI Agents & Integrations
 - Build and deploy AI agents using n8n, LLMs, APIs, and custom code. 
 - Integrate existing SaaS platforms instead of unnecessarily developing custom solutions. 
 - Connect HubSpot, WhatsApp Cloud API, outreach platforms, and Zylu's internal systems. 
 - Implement monitoring, error handling, data validation, and workflow recovery. 
 - Ensure responsible data handling and compliance with applicable privacy laws and outreach platform policies. 4. Analytics & Optimization
 - Build dashboards tracking lead quality, qualified pipeline, demo bookings, conversion rates, and acquisition costs. 
 - Continuously experiment with automation workflows to improve acquisition efficiency and conversion. 
 - Identify manual bottlenecks across marketing and sales and eliminate them through automation. 
 - Document workflows and build repeatable systems that scale without proportional increases in headcount. Required Qualifications
 - 2+ years of hands-on experience building GTM, sales, marketing, or RevOps automation systems. 
 - Strong experience with n8n, Make, Zapier, or similar automation platforms. 
 - Practical experience with prospecting and enrichment tools such as Clay, Apollo, or equivalent platforms. 
 - Experience integrating CRMs such as HubSpot, Salesforce, or Zoho. 
 - Ability to work with REST APIs, webhooks, JSON, and Python or JavaScript. 
 - Hands-on experience using LLMs and AI agents to automate business workflows. 
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a focus on measurable outcomes. 
 - Ability to independently design, deploy, troubleshoot, and maintain production workflows. 

Preferred Skills
 - Experience with WhatsApp Business Cloud API and email outreach infrastructure. 
 - Experience with AI coding tools such as Claude Code, Codex, or Cursor. 
 - Familiarity with SQL, marketing attribution, and funnel analytics. 
 - Experience with B2B SaaS, SMB acquisition, or local-business prospecting. 
 - Exposure to India, GCC, or Southeast Asian markets. 
 - Previous experience as a growth engineer, automation engineer, or early-stage startup operator. What Success Looks Like in 60 Days
 - A functioning inbound automation engine covering lead capture, enrichment, qualification, routing, and follow-ups. 
 - An automated outbound prospecting engine that discovers, enriches, and scores qualified salon prospects. 
 - At least two live outbound campaigns generating measurable qualified pipeline. 
 - Automated demo scheduling, follow-ups, and trial activation workflows integrated with HubSpot. 
 - At least five production-ready GTM automations with monitoring and documentation. 
 - A live dashboard tracking inbound and outbound pipeline performance. 
 - Demonstrable improvements in lead response time, qualified opportunities, and sales productivity. What You'll Get
 - Direct collaboration with Zylu's founders and Growth team. 
 - Ownership of the automation infrastructure behind a growing international SaaS business. 
 - Access to modern AI, automation, and GTM platforms. 
 - High autonomy, meaningful responsibilities, and measurable business impact. 
 - Opportunity to grow into a GTM Engineering or Growth Automation leadership role. Hiring Process
 - Initial Screening: Review of experience and previous automation projects. 
 - Founder Interview: Technical discussion covering architecture, problem-solving, and business judgment. 
 - Practical Challenge: Build a working GTM automation workflow using test data. 
 - Paid Work Trial: A short, 3 to 5-day paid work trial for shortlisted candidates. How to ApplySend us your resume along with examples of automation systems you've built, such as n8n workflows, CRM integrations, AI agents, prospecting systems, or growth automation projects. 

We're more interested in what you've built, how it works, and the business results it delivered than the number of tools listed on your resume.

data.title: Software Development Engineer in Test - Manager
data.description:
Summary
Imagine what you could do here. At Apple, new ideas have a way of becoming outstanding products, services, and customer experiences very quickly. Bring passion and dedication to your job, and there's no telling what you could accomplish. 

Apple's Sales organization generates the revenue needed to fuel our ongoing development of products and services. This, in turn, enriches the lives of hundreds of millions of people around the world. We are, in many ways, the face of Apple to our largest customers. 

We're looking for a talented individual who is passionate about crafting, implementing, and operating AI solutions that have a direct and measurable impact on Apple Sales and its customers. 

We're seeking a visionary Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET)/QE Engineering Manager to own and test end-to-end application workflows using AI. This role will focus on implementing and maintaining QE frameworks, instrumentation, and workflows that help us understand how well our applications perform, where they fail, and how they improve over time. 

This role will operate in both capacities, to augment existing AI roadmap, as well as innovate and trailblazing new frontier tech projects, crafting AI experiences that reduce time to insights and catalyze decision making. 

Description
As a QE manager, you will build and lead a team of engineers as a part of a global horizontal Quality Engineering group focused on a breadth of technologies and applications including very highly scalable distributed applications, No-SQL platforms, internal search platforms, end customer facing websites and services, critical security systems, machine learning and anomaly detection systems, software-load balancing, among others. 

Build, develop, innovate, and retain a hard-working team of quality engineers and build an environment where they can thrive and succeed. Act as a role model for your team when it comes to getting things done and exceeding expectations. 

Your skills in relationship management and partnership should be outstanding as this role requires to quickly understand and respond to peer teams' needs and work with management and engineering leadership, developers, quality engineers, project managers, and multi-functional teams who take ownership in building outstanding scalable solutions. You will work in a fast-paced software development environment and continuously enhance our automation infrastructure to move towards continuous deployment where every code change is thoroughly tested and considered ready to be deployed. 

You will be the quality DRI on product features. To be successful, you will need to supervise and communicate release readiness, identify any gaps, and consistently assess new and innovative ways to improve automation solutions. While the primary role is leading/managing employees, you should have deep technical knowledge of distributed systems and cloud computing, platform as a service, and microservices architecture. We expect that you have strong experience working with short release cycles, do not hesitate to code, and actively participate in design and code reviews. 

Responsibilities

- Design robust test plans with a broad system understanding and in close collaboration with development and product management. 
 - Own regression testing for the Agile releases - defining and executing the regression suite needed before each release ships. 
 - Sign off on quality at go/no-go, acting as the final quality gate before release. 
 - Triage the Ready-for-Release defect queue, prioritizing and driving defects to closure ahead of each release. 
 - Test management: Manage a single place where test cases live, maintaining it as the one source of truth for the team's test coverage. 
 - Communicate status and quality metrics to all project status stakeholders in a timely manner. Drive issue resolution. 
 - Refine and expand existing test automation infrastructure and strategies with a focus on configurability, scalability, low complexity and reuse. 
 - Define automation best practices for the team and mentor junior team members on automation techniques and technology. Perform peer code reviews. 
 - Champion best software testing practices within the team and evangelise software development practices that improve software quality across the organisation. 
 - Be hands-on: participate in various testing activities, including manual testing, automating test cases, and troubleshooting issues. 

Minimum Qualifications

- 10+ years in Quality roles testing and automating large scale customer-facing systems with sophisticated distributed integrations
 - 3+ years managing quality engineers responsible for qualifying features through the complete software development life cycle
 - Ability to act as a leader to increase efficiency through process improvements and automation, increase test coverage through automation, reduce customer-impacting defects, make informed risk-based decisions, and improve chances of success and promote software testing standards and mentor engineers in the team
 - Ability to build, drive and support automation test strategy. Dedication to delivering great software and releasing it quickly, efficiently, and with growing quality. (white box + black box, automation, functional, performance, stress testing)
 - Excellent knowledge of QE automation architecture, methodologies, processes, and tools. 
 - Hands on in automating functional, system and integration tests. Experience in tools like Playwright, Selenium WebDriver, Cucumber-JVM, Appium for API, Web, iOS and MacOS platforms. 
 - Experience creating multiple test frameworks from scratch. Experience in Java or Python, familiar with databases, SQL, and scripting languages. 
 - Understanding of REST and RESTful services. 
 - Applied knowledge of GenAI, micro-services, recommendation systems, and context engineering.

data.description:
About Team

GDF (Global Data Foundation) is part of Walmart's AI & Data organization - the team building the foundational data platforms that power AI, analytics, and decision-making across every Walmart banner and geography, from supply chain and merchandising to customer experience and enterprise AI agents. Our newly created platform team is chartered with building next-generation data infrastructure at Walmart scale: reliable, high-throughput data pipelines, distributed processing systems, and platform capabilities that downstream teams across Walmart depend on every day. 

What You'll Do

- Design, build, and operate distributed platform services and APIs using Java and Python, applied against Kubernetes or equivalent cloud-native infrastructure. 
 - Apply system design and low-level design (LLD) rigor to platform problems - evaluating dependencies, trade-offs, failure modes, scalability, and cost before writing a line of code, with support from Staff/Principal engineers on the most ambiguous or cross-team problems. 
 - Flex into data engineering work when needed: contribute to Spark-based data pipelines and processing jobs, working directly in GDF's data engineering codebase alongside platform work. 
 - Build AI, GenAI, and agentic-powered platform capabilities: intelligent developer tooling, workflow automation, agentic services, and AI-assisted operational tooling (monitoring, incident triage, capacity planning). 
 - Own reliability, scalability, and observability for the services you build - service-level objectives, distributed tracing, alerting, and incident response - with a strong Operational Excellence / Engineering Excellence discipline. 
 - Contribute to architecture and system design decisions across microservices, event-driven systems, and enterprise integrations, with an eye toward how platform choices affect downstream data engineering workloads. 
 - Partner with data engineers, data scientists, and ML engineers to ensure the services you own expose the right primitives for data pipelines, feature stores, and model-serving paths. 
 - Participate actively in architecture reviews, design reviews, code reviews, and production readiness reviews for a team building process from scratch. 
 - As a Senior engineer, bring strong technical judgment to design and code reviews within your immediate team and area of ownership, mentor early-career engineers, and help raise the bar for engineering quality - without needing a formal management title. 
 - Stay current on emerging platform, cloud, and AI/agentic technologies, and propose where they could pragmatically improve reliability, productivity, or business value within your team's scope. 

What You'll Bring

- Genuinely hands-on coding: 5+ years of professional software engineering experience building and operating distributed platforms; strong proficiency in Java and Python is required - comfortable writing, reviewing, and debugging production code. Additional experience with Go, C++, or Scala is a plus. 
 - Operational Excellence (OE) and Engineering Excellence (EE) mindset is a required skill, not a nice-to-have: SLO/SLA ownership, incident management and blameless post-incident reviews, proactive reliability and quality metrics, and continuous improvement built into how you ship, not bolted on afterward. 
 - Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - Solid experience with microservices architectures, distributed systems, event-driven patterns, API design, service contracts, and enterprise system integration - backed by solid system design and low-level design (LLD) skills, with demonstrated ownership of production code and the judgment to evaluate trade-offs, failure modes, scalability, and cost for the components you own. 
 - Solid understanding of cloud-native engineering practices - CI/CD, containerization, Kubernetes or equivalent orchestration, infrastructure automation, and production operations. 
 - Working exposure to Big Data / data engineering technologies - Spark required at a working level, with familiarity in Hadoop/HDFS, Hive, or Kafka - enough to flex into data engineering work confidently. 
 - Full exposure to AI and Agentic technologies: hands-on experience integrating model APIs and GenAI/LLM tooling, building or operating agentic workflows (tool-calling agents, multi-step autonomous systems), working with embeddings/vector search, and applying MLOps practices (feature stores, model lifecycle, retraining pipelines) - not just conceptual awareness. 
 - Solid knowledge of reliability engineering - observability, distributed tracing, logging, metrics, alerting, incident response, capacity planning, and fault tolerance for large-scale systems. 
 - Solid grounding in security, privacy, and enterprise engineering practices, including authentication, authorization, data protection, and secure API design. 
 - Proven ability to translate reasonably well-scoped technical/business problems into clear execution plans, particularly within a newly formed team - escalating cross-team ambiguity to Staff/Principal engineers as needed. 
 - Strong ownership mindset and technical judgment; comfortable operating with autonomy within your team in a 0-to-1 environment. 

About Walmart Global Tech

Imagine working in an environment where one line of code can make life easier for hundreds of millions of people. That's what we do at Walmart Global Tech. We're a team of software engineers, data scientists, cybersecurity experts, and service professionals within the world's leading retailer who make an epic impact and are at the forefront of the next retail disruption. People are why we innovate, and people power our innovations. We are people-led and tech-empowered. 

Benefits

Beyond our great compensation package, you can receive incentive awards for your performance. Other great perks include a host of best-in-class benefits - maternity and parental leave, PTO, health benefits, and much more. Walmart's culture sets us apart, and we know being together helps us innovate, learn, and grow great careers. This role is based in our [Bangalore/Chennai] office for daily work, with the flexibility for associates to manage their personal lives. 

Belonging

We aim to create a culture where every associate feels valued for who they are, rooted in respect for the individual. Our goal is to foster a sense of belonging, to create opportunities for all our associates, customers and suppliers, and to be a Walmart for everyone. At Walmart, our vision is "everyone included. " By fostering a workplace culture where everyone is - and feels - included, everyone wins. 

Equal Opportunity Employer

4-6 years of work experience in relevant field

AON IS IN THE BUSINESS OF BETTER DECISIONS

At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world. 

As an organization, we are committed to our purpose as one firm, united through trust as one inclusive, diverse team and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed. 

General Description Of Role

About the Role

As a DevOps Engineer within the Assessment Solutions business, you will own the delivery infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, and platform operations that keep the Aon Assessment Platform running reliably at scale. The Aon Assessment Platform is the enterprise solution for accurate and fair workforce assessments used by millions of participants worldwide - the infrastructure you build and maintain is what makes that scale possible. 

You will work across multiple engineering squads (Germany and India), ensuring that every team has fast, reliable, and secure delivery pipelines, and that the platform's cloud infrastructure is observable, cost-efficient, and resilient. You are a hands-on practitioner: writing Terraform, maintaining Kubernetes configurations, building pipeline templates, and driving the automation that reduces toil and increases engineering throughput. 

Above all, this role requires strong systems thinking. Our platform is deeply interconnected, and infrastructure decisions have wide downstream effects on reliability, security, and delivery speed. You must be able to reason about those effects and design infrastructure that the whole engineering group can depend on. 

Key Responsibilities

CI/CD Pipeline Engineering

- Design, build, and maintain CI/CD pipelines in Azure DevOps that serve multiple engineering squads building on different release cadences. 
 - Own pipeline templates and shared workflow components - ensuring consistent, reusable patterns across squads rather than per-team divergence. 
 - Integrate automated testing (unit, integration, API spec validation) into pipelines so quality gates run at the right point in every delivery workflow. 
 - Maintain and improve build performance - reducing pipeline duration and queue times to keep squad delivery velocity high. 
 - Enforce API governance in delivery: pipelines validate implementations against OpenAPI specifications before merge and deployment. 

Cloud Infrastructure & Kubernetes

- Own the platform's Azure infrastructure: AKS clusters, networking, storage, identity, and supporting services - defined and managed as code using Terraform. 
 - Manage Kubernetes workloads across environments (development, staging, production): deployments, resource allocation, autoscaling, and health management. 
 - Design and maintain environment promotion workflows that give squads reliable, consistent progression from development through to production. 
 - Implement and maintain infrastructure security controls: network policies, managed identities, secret management (Azure Key Vault), and RBAC. 
 - Monitor infrastructure costs and drive efficiency improvements - right-sizing resources, identifying waste, and contributing to cloud spend targets. 

Observability & Reliability

- Build and maintain observability tooling across the platform: metrics, logging, distributed tracing, and alerting (Azure Monitor, Application Insights, or equivalent). 
 - Define and implement SLI/SLO frameworks in collaboration with Engineering Team Leads and Solution Architects, ensuring the platform can demonstrate reliability against defined targets. 
 - Own incident response for infrastructure-layer events: diagnosing, communicating, and resolving outages with clear post-incident reviews and preventive actions. 
 - Drive reliability improvements - identifying single points of failure, improving resilience patterns, and reducing mean time to recovery. 

Engineering Enablement & Standards

- Work closely with Solution Architects and Engineering Team Leads to ensure application architecture is deployable, observable, and operable - raising infrastructure requirements early in the design process, not after delivery. 
 - Define and maintain infrastructure-as-code standards: Terraform module structure, naming conventions, state management, and code review practices. 
 - Build internal documentation and runbooks that give squads and support teams the operational knowledge they need to work independently. 
 - Evaluate and introduce tooling improvements that raise engineering throughput and platform quality - with a pragmatic eye for adoption, not novelty. 

AI-Augmented Engineering

- Use AI tools in your day-to-day work - for infrastructure design, pipeline authoring, incident investigation, and documentation - and apply them effectively and responsibly. This is a core expectation, not a nice-to-have. 
 - Identify where AI-assisted tooling can reduce toil, accelerate root cause analysis, and improve infrastructure quality. 

Required Skills & Experience

- 4-6 years of hands-on DevOps or platform engineering experience on a large-scale SaaS or enterprise platform. 
 - Strong, production-proven experience with Azure: AKS, Azure DevOps, Azure Container Registry, Azure Key Vault, networking, and managed identities. 
 - Deep hands-on experience with Terraform for infrastructure-as-code: module design, state management, and code review practices at team scale. 
 - Proven experience designing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines in Azure DevOps across multiple squads or products. 
 - Solid Kubernetes expertise: workload management, autoscaling, networking, and operational troubleshooting. 
 - Strong understanding of infrastructure security: network policies, RBAC, secret management, and least-privilege access design. 
 - Experience with observability tooling and a practical understanding of SLI/SLO/SLA frameworks. 
 - Excellent analytical and systems thinking - able to reason about the downstream infrastructure impact of application architecture decisions. 
 - Strong communication skills: able to explain infrastructure constraints and tradeoffs clearly to engineering teams and non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Day-to-day use of AI tools in infrastructure and engineering work. This is a core expectation, not a nice-to-have. 

Nice to Have

- Experience with messaging and mediation frameworks relevant to the platform (e. g. , Wolverine, Azure Service Bus). 
 - Familiarity with API governance tooling - integrating OpenAPI spec validation into pipelines. 
 - Experience with contract testing or consumer-driven contract frameworks in a microservices context. 
 - Exposure to FinOps practices and cloud cost optimisation at meaningful scale. 
 - Experience supporting globally distributed engineering teams working across multiple time zones. 
 - Familiarity with . NET / ASP. NET Core application deployment patterns at the infrastructure level.

Vultr Cares

 - Professional Development Reimbursement 
 - Internet reimbursement

Join Vultr

Vultr is building its first Global Security Operations Center (GSOC) in Chennai as a 24×7 hub for physical security monitoring and incident response across its global facilities. 

We are looking for a GSOC Shift Lead to lead the floor during an assigned shift, oversee Junior and Senior GSOC Analysts, own critical escalations, manage shift performance, and serve as a key point of contact for US counterparts and cross-functional stakeholders. 

Role Overview

The GSOC Shift Lead has end-to-end operational ownership of the assigned shift, including monitoring, incident response, escalation, team performance, and shift handover. The role provides leadership during complex security and emergency events, coordinates cross-functional response, coaches GSOC analysts, and drives adherence to procedures and operational standards. 

The Shift Lead also serves as a key connection between the Chennai GSOC and global stakeholders, particularly US-based teams, providing regular reporting, KPI visibility, operational updates, and continuous improvement recommendations. 

Key Responsibilities

- Own the shift end-to-end, including real-time monitoring, alert triage, incident response, escalation, team coordination, and shift handover, with accountability for operational performance. 
 - Oversee monitoring of CCTV/VMS, access control, intrusion detection, alarms, perimeter security, visitor management, and life-safety systems across global facilities. 
 - Maintain real-time situational awareness of active incidents and operational impacts and direct the team's response based on severity and risk. 
 - Serve as the primary escalation point on shift for Sev-0/Sev-1 and other incidents beyond Senior or Junior GSOC Analyst authority. 
 - Lead and coordinate response to critical security and emergency events, including unauthorized access, forced entry, security breaches, tampering, workplace violence, fire/life-safety events, perimeter breaches, and other emergencies. 
 - Coordinate response and escalation across Global Security, Data Center Operations, Facilities, GIOC/NOC/SOC, IT Operations, PeopleOps/Legal, security vendors, and emergency services as required. 
 - Make timely, well-informed response decisions during high-pressure situations and ensure decisions and actions are accurately documented. 
 - Lead, coach, and develop Junior and Senior GSOC Analysts, providing real-time guidance, feedback, and support on monitoring, incident handling, escalation, and documentation. 
 - Support onboarding, training, shadowing, readiness assessments, and ongoing development of GSOC analysts. 
 - Maintain a strong shift culture focused on accountability, operational discipline, attention to detail, and calm decision-making. 
 - Serve as a key point of contact between the Chennai GSOC and global/US security stakeholders, maintaining regular communication and coordinating operational priorities across time zones. 
 - Prepare and deliver weekly and monthly operational reports and dashboards, covering incidents, response performance, escalations, system issues, and key GSOC metrics. 
 - Own and track shift-level KPIs, including response and escalation times, SLA adherence, documentation quality, false-alarm trends, and operational performance. 
 - Identify recurring incidents, false-alarm patterns, system issues, and process gaps and drive improvements to GSOC monitoring, response, reporting, and operational effectiveness. 
 - Coordinate with Facilities, IT, security technology teams, and vendors on security-system issues, remediation, tooling requirements, and third-party security services. 
 - Maintain and continuously improve GSOC SOPs, incident response playbooks, escalation matrices, and operational procedures. 
 - Ensure compliance with security policies, procedures, confidentiality requirements, and applicable regulatory standards. 
 - Participate in and lead security training, emergency drills, audits, exercises, and operational reviews. 
 - Ensure accurate shift handovers, incident records, logs, reports, and follow-up actions. 

Required Qualifications

- 6-9 years of experience in GSOC, SOC, security operations, NOC, or a similar 24×7 environment, with shift/team leadership experience. 
 - Strong knowledge of CCTV/VMS, access control, alarms, intrusion detection, and perimeter security. 
 - Proven experience leading security incidents, escalations, and cross-functional response. 
 - Experience coaching, mentoring, or supervising security operations teams. 
 - Strong communication, judgment, decision-making, and stakeholder management skills. 
 - Experience managing operational KPIs, reporting, and shift performance. 
 - Willingness to work 24×7×365 rotational shifts, including nights, weekends, and holidays. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience as a GSOC/SOC/NOC Shift Lead or Supervisor. 
 - Experience supporting data centers, cloud, or critical infrastructure. 
 - Familiarity with incident management and security monitoring platforms. 
 - Experience managing security vendors and third-party providers. 
 - Knowledge of security compliance, audits, or emergency response. 
 - CPP, PSP, or equivalent security certification. 

Inclusion & Privacy

We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds and experiences, and we prohibit discrimination based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected status under applicable laws. Vultr will consider qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records in accordance with applicable laws and will not conduct a background check until after an offer of employment has been extended and accepted. 

We also take your privacy seriously. We handle personal information responsibly and follow applicable laws, including U. S. privacy rules and India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023. Your data is used only for legitimate business purposes and is protected with proper security measures. 

Where allowed by law, applicants may request details about the data we collect, access or delete their information, withdraw consent for its use, and opt out of nonessential communications. For more details, please see our Privacy Policy.

This role focuses on building scalable platforms that enable sales intelligence, distribution optimization, quoting/enrollment workflows, and API-driven integrations across CRM, broker systems, and internal platforms. The Lead will design and implement AI-powered automation and agentic workflows to enhance sales processes, improve decision-making, and streamline distribution operations, while also supporting targeted capabilities such as benefits configuration and plan build automation. The role provides hands‐on technical leadership across machine learning, generative AI, RAG pipelines, and agent-based systems, ensuring seamless integration, performance, and reliability in production environments. The Lead will collaborate closely with product, sales, operations, and security teams to deliver modular solutions with minimal disruption, while ensuring compliance with enterprise AI governance and Responsible AI standards. Additionally, the role mentors offshore engineering teams, drives engineering best practices, and ensures consistent, high-quality execution with solid ownership.

data.title: Principal - SAP Infrastructure Engineer
data.description:
Business Introduction

GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems. 

Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines. 

Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges. 

Job Purpose

The SAP Infrastructure Engineer builds and runs both the Cloud and On-Prem SAP Infrastructure platform as automated, secure, self-service infrastructure. The role works through infrastructure-as-code and golden paths rather than manual configuration, uses AI-assisted engineering across code generation, review and testing, and engineers reliability in automating away toil. 

This is the senior hands-on engineering role in the platform team, insourced at the grades covered by this description while engineering at G7b and below is delivered through managed service partners, so the role integrates and assures partner components as well as building. Engineering roadmap and direction sit with the Engineering Director, reference architecture and standards sit with the Platform Architect, backlog order sits with the Product Owner, and deep reliability engineering sits with the Site Reliability Engineer deployed from Reliability Engineering & Operations. 

Key Responsibilities

- Build and automate platform infrastructure using infrastructure-as-code and golden paths, so that provisioning is repeatable rather than reconstructed each time. 
 - Use AI-assisted engineering across code generation, review and testing to accelerate delivery and raise quality, reviewing AI-generated output before it is merged. 
 - Build self-service capabilities and paved roads that reduce friction for consuming teams, so adoption does not depend on the platform team's availability. 
 - Engineer for reliability by defining SLOs, instrumenting platforms for observability and automating to reduce toil, working with the Site Reliability Engineer on standards. 
 - Adopt engineering standards, secure-by-default practices and code quality within the platform, and hold them in code review. 
 - Contribute to incident response and drive permanent automated fixes with Reliability Engineering rather than repeating manual recovery. 
 - Work with principal engineers and partner engineers, linking engineering work to platform OKRs and outcomes. 
 - Work the platform's manual task and toil backlog, converting identified candidates into automation and evidencing the effort removed. 
 - Close observability coverage gaps for the platform, so that reliability can be measured rather than inferred. 
 - Contribute engineering-led items to the platform backlog held by the Product Owner, including technical debt, upgrade and automation work, with the cost of not doing them stated. 
 - Apply the reference architectures and patterns set by the Platform Architect, and raise a case for change rather than diverging locally. 

Education & Professional Qualifications

- Degree in a technology or engineering discipline, or equivalent practical experience (e. g. , Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electronics). 
 - Relevant technical certifications desirable (e. g. , a recognised cloud certification for AWS, GCP or Azure, Certified Kubernetes Administrator, or a network vendor certification relevant to the platform). 

Related Experience Required

- Overall 10 Years and typically 5-7 years in platform, infrastructure or software engineering, including at least two years as the senior technical voice in a team. 
 - Experience in cloud infrastructure management, preferably with ERP systems. Strong knowledge of SAP hosted on either Azure or Google Cloud. Strong knowledge of SAP hosted on VMware
 - Practical experience of infrastructure-as-code, for example Terraform, applied to production estates rather than proofs of concept. 
 - Track record building self-service capability that other teams adopted without hand-holding. 
 - Experience instrumenting for observability, defining SLOs and reducing toil through automation. 
 - Experience with AI-assisted engineering tooling, including judgement about when generated output is not fit to merge. 

Skills/Background

- Automation-first instinct, treating a repeated manual task as a defect rather than as work. 
 - Code review discipline, holding quality without becoming a bottleneck. 
 - Mentoring ability with engineers of varying experience, including partner engineers outside the line. 
 - Judgement about when AI-generated code is fit to merge and when it is not. 
 - Customer mindset toward consuming teams, who can route around a platform that is hard to use. 
 - Willingness to make technical debt and its cost visible rather than absorbing it silently. 

#AGTech

Skills

API Management, Automation Technology, Cloud Architectures, Cloud Financial Operations, Containerization, Database Management, DevOps, Disaster Recovery (DR), Edge Computing, Infrastructure As Code (IaC), Kubernetes, Networking Concepts, Performance Optimizations, Platform Engineering, SAP on Azure, Serverless Computing, System Monitors, Technical Leadership, Terraform (Software), Virtualization

Why GSK?

Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. 

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2. 5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases - to impact health at scale. 

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we're committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people. 

Inclusion at GSK: 

As an employer committed to Inclusion, we encourage you to reach out if you need any adjustments during the recruitment process. 

Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN. recruitment-adjustments@gsk. com to discuss your needs. 

Important notice to Employment businesses/ Agencies

GSK does not accept referrals from employment businesses and/or employment agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. All employment businesses/agencies are required to contact GSK's commercial and general procurement/human resources department to obtain prior written authorization before referring any candidates to GSK. The obtaining of prior written authorization is a condition precedent to any agreement (verbal or written) between the employment business/ agency and GSK. In the absence of such written authorization being obtained any actions undertaken by the employment business/agency shall be deemed to have been performed without the consent or contractual agreement of GSK. GSK shall therefore not be liable for any fees arising from such actions or any fees arising from any referrals by employment businesses/agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site.

Please be advised that such advertisements and emails are not connected with the GlaxoSmithKline group in any way. 

GlaxoSmithKline does not charge any fee whatsoever for recruitment process. Please do not make payments to any individuals / entities in connection with recruitment with any GlaxoSmithKline (or GSK) group company at any worldwide location. Even if they claim that the money is refundable.
