data.title: Senior Quality Engineer - SDET
data.description:
Strength in Trust

OneTrust's mission is to enable innovation through the responsible use of data and AI. We believe that ensuring data is trusted shouldn't slow teams down-it should accelerate what's possible. This led us to develop the first technology platform for responsible data use in 2016. Today, with AI representing the latest and most impactful expansion of data yet, OneTrust is once again redefining what responsible innovation looks like. OneTrust, the AI‐Ready Governance PlatformTM, unifies regulatory intelligence, automation, and connected governance workflows so businesses can continue to move at the speed of AI while ensuring good governance to prevent data misuse at scale. Trusted by thousands of organizations worldwide, OneTrust is shaping the future where trusted data becomes a transformative force for business and society. 

The Challenge

We are looking for a Senior level SDET to support our product development teams. As the Principal SDET, you will play a crucial role in shaping and leading our software testing strategy. You will be responsible for designing, developing, and implementing robust test automation frameworks, mentoring a team of SDETs (Software Development Engineer in Test), and ensuring the overall quality and reliability of our software products. 

Your Mission

As a Senior SDET, You Will

- Provide technical leadership and guidance to the SDET team. 
 - Collaborate with development and QE (Quality Engineering) teams to integrate testing into the software development process. 
 - Design, develop, and maintain scalable and efficient test automation frameworks and test architectures. 
 - Rub shoulders with developers in writing unit and integration tests using their tools and frameworks. 
 - Ensure the frameworks support various testing types, including functional, integration, and performance testing. 
 - Mentor and guide junior SDETs, providing technical expertise and career development support. 
 - Conduct training sessions to enhance the skills of the testing team. 
 - Foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning within the team. 
 - Collaborate with cross-functional teams to develop comprehensive test plans. 
 - Execute and oversee the execution of test cases, ensuring thorough coverage of functional and non-functional requirements. 
 - Analyze test results and provide meaningful insights to improve product quality. 
 - Work closely with developers, product managers, and other stakeholders to understand requirements and user stories. 
 - Communicate effectively with team members and stakeholders, providing clear updates on testing progress and issues. 
 - Add, maintain, and update scripts in existing automation suite, helping with running the suite across various checkpoints in the release cycle. 
 - Participate in various POCs (Proof of Concept) to keep the automation framework and technology relevant and current to product offerings. 
 - Conduct peer reviews of test code and automation frameworks. 

You Are

- You are a seasoned SDET with an automate anything anywhere attitude who is looking for a challenging technical leadership role in a dynamic and innovative company. 
 - You can efficiently find the underlying cause of a failure (in an integrated environment) and alert the right team. 
 - You are consistently willing to pitch in to support a long running deployment, even after hours. 
 - You are willing to learn and pick up new skillsets to support the ever-changing technology landscape like Cloud computing & AI (Artificial Intelligence). 
 - You can understand complex product and deployment architectures and create efficient test solutions. 
 - You want to be part of a team that is passionate about delivering high-quality software solutions. 

Your Experience Includes

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related technical or business field. 
 - 4+ years of relevant experience working as a developer, automation engineer or SDET. 
 - 4+ years of experience coding in Java and must have strong practical knowledge of OOPs and Core Java principles. 
 - 4+ years of experience contributing to Test-Driven Development or BDD (Behavior Driven Development) with tools like Cucumber, Junit, Mockito, or TestNG. 
 - 3+ years of experience with CI/CD tools like Jenkins, Circle CI, or Azure DevOps with the ability to create test pipelines using Java or Groovy. 
 - 4+ years of experience with Selenium or Cypress frameworks for automating GUI (User Interface) and E2E tests of the application. 
 - 4+ years of experience with REST Assured or similar tools like Postman for automating APIs. 
 - 4+ years of experience working in a highly automated CI/CD environment. 
 - 4+ years of experience with source control tools such as Bitbucket, GitHub or GitLab. 
 - 2+ years of experience mining meaningful logs for troubleshooting using tools like Splunk, Dynatrace or Coralogix. 
 - 3+ years of experience working in a cloud shop preferably Azure with exposure to various Azure services like Gateways, Redis, Storage, VMs (virtual machines) and Kubernetes clusters. 
 - 3+ years of experience in testing mobile applications, both native and websites using Appium on both real devices and simulators either in a private farm of 3rd party vendors like Sauce Labs or BrowserStack. 
 - 4+ years of experience working with geographically distributed teams in US, Canada, and India. 
 - Strong analytical, critical thinking and problem-solving skills. 
 - Ability to work as part of a team, demonstrate initiative, solve problems independently and mentor others. 
 - Passion for high quality work and attention to detail. 
 - Strong oral and written communication skills. 

Extra Awesome

- Prior exposure to AI/ML systems and how to use them in testing thus making test pipeline more intelligent. 
 - Experience in analyzing the CPU Utilization, Memory usage, Network usage, Garbage Collection and DB Parameters and DB Reports to verify the performance of the applications. 
 - Ability to spin up scalable test architecture using Docker or Kubernetes. 
 - Experience with Kubernetes and extended usage patterns for test grids, auto scale properties. 

Where we Work

We are embracing an office-first culture, encouraging three days a week in office for most roles, with meaningful opportunities to collaborate and celebrate in person. 

Each role may have specific requirements or flexibility depending on the scope of the position, so we encourage you to verify this with your recruiter during your first interview. 

Benefits

As an employee at OneTrust, you will be part of the OneTeam. That means you'll receive support physically, mentally, and emotionally so that you can do your best work both in and out of the office. This includes comprehensive healthcare coverage, flexible PTO, equity RSUs, annual performance bonus opportunities, retirement account support, 14+ weeks of paid parental leave, career development opportunities, company-paid privacy certification exam fees, and much more. Specific benefits differ by country. For more information, talk to your recruiter or visit onetrust. com/careers. 

Resources

Check out the following to learn more about OneTrust and its people: 

- OneTrust Careers on YouTube
 - @LifeatOneTrust on Instagram

Your Data

You have the right to have your personal data updated or removed. You also have the right to have a copy of the information OneTrust holds about you. Further details about these rights are available on the website in our Privacy Overview. You can change your mind at any time and have your personal data removed from our database. In order to do this you must contact us and let us know you wish to be removed. The request should be made on the Data Subject Request Form. 

Recruitment fraud warning: OneTrust is aware of scams involving false offers of employment with our company. The fraudulent jobs, interviews and job offers use fake websites, email addresses, group chat and text messages. Be aware that we never ask candidates for personal information, IDs or bank information during the interview process. We do not interview prospective candidates via instant message or group chat, and do not require candidates to purchase products or services, or process payments on our behalf as a condition of any employment offer. Please note that any legitimate interview availability requests will come directly from a OneTrust recruiter with an "@onetrust. com" email address. You may also receive legitimate emails from "@us. greenhouse-mail. io". Recruiters will only reach out to candidates who have applied for a role through our ATS (Greenhouse) or prospects via LinkedIn InMail. Job offers will come from a recruiter and may have a "@docusign. net" email address. For more information or if you have been targeted please reach out to askrecruiting@onetrust. com. 

Our Commitment to You

When you join OneTrust you are stepping onto a launching pad - the countdown has begun. The destination? A career without boundaries working alongside a diverse and inclusive crew who is passionate about doing meaningful work. As a pioneer, your voice and expertise will help chart the direction of an entirely new category. Our commitment to putting people first starts with you. Your growth is part of the mission. Our goal is to give you the power to embark on the next phase of your uniquely, unique career. 

OneTrust provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by local laws.

data.description:
Job Description

The Technology Leader will work closely with customers, project delivery teams, product line management, pre-sales organizations, business development teams, and global customer engineering organizations to drive successful delivery of Optical Transport, Cloud Infrastructure, and Subsea networking solutions. 

The role is responsible for leading and scaling a high-performance Remote Delivery Engineering organization focused on optical transport networks, subsea connectivity solutions, and cloud-integrated network infrastructures. The individual will provide technical leadership across architecture, design, validation, deployment, optimization, and lifecycle management of customer networks while ensuring delivery excellence and superior customer experience. 

The candidate will lead a team of highly skilled engineers covering solution architecture, technical delivery, network design, interoperability validation, automation, customer acceptance, and technical consultancy across Nokia's Optical Networks portfolio, subsea transport solutions, and cloud-native infrastructure environments

How You Will Contribute And What You Will Learn

- Lead end-to-end remote delivery of Optical Transport, DWDM, OTN, ROADM, Metro, Long-Haul, and Subsea network solutions. 
 - Own architecture, design, deployment, migration, and lifecycle management of optical and transport networks. 
 - Provide technical leadership for cloud-integrated network infrastructures (cINF) supporting network modernization and cloud transformation initiatives. 
 - Lead customer engagements from solution definition through deployment and operational acceptance. 
 - Build, mentor, and develop globally distributed engineering teams. 
 - Partner with Sales, Pre-Sales, Product Management, and Customer stakeholders to drive strategic growth opportunities. 
 - Act as a trusted technical advisor to executive and senior customer stakeholders. 
 - Drive adoption of network automation, SDN-based transport architectures, cloud-native operational models, and AI-driven network assurance. 
 - Support deployment and optimization of subsea transport networks, landing station connectivity, and terrestrial extension architectures. 
 - Ensure first-time-right delivery with high-quality engineering outputs and technical governance. 
 - Establish best practices, reusable delivery frameworks, engineering standards, and solution blueprints. 
 - Drive risk management, technical escalation management, and continuous improvement initiatives. 
 - Align customer solutions with Nokia product roadmaps and future technology evolution. 

Key Skills And Experience

Optical Networks

- DWDM, CWDM, OTN, ROADM, Optical Switching
 - Metro, Regional, Long-Haul, and Ultra Long-Haul Transport Networks
 - Optical planning, design, performance engineering, and network optimization
 - Carrier-grade transport architectures and resiliency frameworks
 - Nokia Optical product portfolio (1830 PSS and related transport solutions)

Subsea Networks

- Subsea cable systems and transport technologies
 - Landing station architecture and terrestrial integration
 - Capacity planning and service provisioning across subsea infrastructures
 - Multi-domain optical network operations and service assurance

Cloud Infrastructure (cINF)

- Cloud Infrastructure platforms supporting telecom workloads
 - Kubernetes, OpenStack, VMware, and cloud-native environments
 - Infrastructure virtualization and containerized deployments
 - Network cloud integration and automation frameworks

Automation & Software Defined Networking

- SDN-controlled transport networks
 - Network automation and orchestration frameworks
 - Python, Ansible, APIs, and model-driven networking
 - Telemetry, analytics, and closed-loop assurance

Leadership & Customer Skills

- Strong customer engagement and executive relationship management. 
 - Proven ability to influence customer technology strategy and investment decisions. 
 - Demonstrated leadership in managing large, geographically distributed engineering organizations. 
 - Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and presentation skills. 
 - Strong commercial acumen with ability to support business growth and opportunity development. 
 - Strategic thinker with excellent problem-solving and decision-making capabilities

Experience

- 20+ years of experience in Telecommunications, Optical Networking, Transport Networks, or Network Infrastructure domains. 
 - 10+ years leading engineering, architecture, or delivery organizations. 
 - Proven experience in large-scale Optical Transport, Cloud Infrastructure, and Subsea network deployments. 
 - Experience managing global customer engagements and remote delivery organizations. 
 - Strong understanding of service provider, hyperscaler, enterprise, and subsea operator environments. 

Qualifications

- Bachelor's or master's degree in engineering, Telecommunications, Computer Science, or related discipline. 
 - Industry certifications in Optical Networking, Cloud Infrastructure, IP Networking, or equivalent technologies preferred. 
 - Demonstrated expertise in Optical Transport, cINF, Subsea, and Network Automation technologies.

data.title: VP Engineering (Core Platform)
data.description:
Hiring for BRAHMA AI - via Flexiple, the recruiting partner on this role. 

About the Company

BRAHMA AI is an enterprise AI content platform used by some of the world's largest media & entertainment, sports and advertising companies. It grew out of Prime Focus Technologies, the team behind CLEAR®, the cloud media asset management and content supply chain platform. BRAHMA AI now combines CLEAR with generative and visual AI, which won a 2026 Technology & Engineering Emmy®. With new funding and an AI-native content operating system in market, BRAHMA AI is scaling the core platform that every product runs on, and needs an engineering leader in Bengaluru to own it. 

About the Role

As VP Engineering for the Core Platform, you'll own end-to-end delivery of BRAHMA AI's platform, from understanding the business need to choosing the solution, testing it and rolling it out. You'll lead a global organisation of 75+ software engineers and DevOps, work with product line management on the vision and roadmap, and keep the platform AI-first, scalable and reliable for enterprise customers. The role is onsite in Bengaluru, and you'll stay close enough to the code to build with AI tools yourself. 

What you'll do

- Own delivery of the core platform end to end and turn the product roadmap into a delivery plan with product line management
 - Lead the build and launch of AI-first enterprise SaaS capabilities, including agentic AI workflows across media asset management, localisation and content operations
 - Provide technical oversight on microservices, horizontal scaling and Docker/Kubernetes across AWS, GCP and Azure
 - Direct a global team of 75+ engineers and DevOps: set KRAs, grow managers and build a high-performance culture
 - Run Agile programs for intermediate-to-large cross-functional modules, delivering on time and with high quality
 - Manage the engineering cost centre and budget, and report progress to leadership and global operations partners in weekly and monthly reviews
 - Bring AI into how software is built (AI-led SDLC) and drive technical innovation across the team

What you bring

- 15-20 years in software, now in a VP or Director-level engineering leadership role
 - 8+ years of software program management and delivery in a software product company
 - Have led an engineering and DevOps organisation of 75+ people, including managers of managers, across locations
 - Have shipped and scaled a multi-tenant enterprise SaaS product built on microservices and Kubernetes in the cloud (AWS, GCP or Azure)
 - Have delivered AI-first or agentic AI product features, and use AI coding tools hands-on
 - Strong technical grounding in Java, SQL/NoSQL databases and DevOps
 - Have owned a cost centre or engineering budget and tracked delivery with Jira, MPP and spreadsheets
 - Clear written and spoken communication, from individual contributors to senior leadership; a B. E. , B. Tech or M. Tech

Nice to have

- Experience with media operations or the media & entertainment industry (OTT, broadcast, content supply chain, media asset management)
 - A program management certification

data.description:
About The Team

Zillow's Core Technology organization empowers our people with the tools and platforms they need to thrive. ServiceNow runs IT and HR service delivery and is the foundation of the help experience at Zillow: how employees ask for help, find answers and get things done. We own our platforms end to end: production access, change ownership, on-call, configuration and development, and direct stakeholder relationships. This team works closely with teams across IT, HR, Product, and Engineering functions to configure, implement, and maintain software applications that are used by Zillow Group employees in their day-to-day job activities. This team plays a critical role in ensuring that Zillow operates efficiently and effectively, and fosters a culture of inclusion and collaboration. 

Zillow Group is a strategic, mission-driven organization focused on delivering exceptional experiences and measurable outcomes. Our work spans cross-functional partnership, scalable programs and operational excellence in support of Zillow's mission. We bring deep experience working across diverse teams in a dynamic, high-growth environment, balancing strategic thinking with hands-on execution to drive meaningful business impact. We are seeking an experienced professional to support our workforce expansion in India. 

About The Role

We are seeking an experienced Senior Manager of Engineering to lead the team that supports the ServiceNow platform, all integrations to and from ServiceNow, and the automations around it. You will lead six direct reports: one TPM and five ServiceNow developers and admins, with additional roles planned for 2027. You will own engineering delivery and operations for ServiceNow, partner with US product, engineering, IT and People leaders, and help define the future of the help experience. This role requires effectively balancing the expertise and career aspirations of your team members with the organization's objectives. A proven track record of project implementation and the ability to identify opportunities for technical enhancement and drive continuous improvement initiatives are key aspects of this position. 

What You'll Do

- Lead, coach, and develop a team of ServiceNow developers and admins and a TPM, fostering a culture of innovation, ownership, and growth. 
 - Drive execution of initiatives in support of the help experience roadmap, ensuring that projects are delivered on time and within budget
 - Own delivery and operations of the ServiceNow platform
 - Own integrations to and from ServiceNow and the automations around it, including virtual agent and AI-assisted resolution
 - Partner with the US platform and agentic engineering team on MCP integrations and agent capabilities
 - Own on-call, change management, security and availability for the platform, with a low-toil operating model
 - Discover possibilities to reduce technical debt and propel ongoing improvement initiatives, guaranteeing Zillow maintains a top-tier technology infrastructure
 - Collaborate regularly in planning and estimating activities, offering guidance and support to team members using your previous experience and understanding of the business, and actively participate in discussions about capacity and priorities
 - Establish strong connections with important individuals in the Product, IT and HR departments, serving as a reliable consultant who can provide guidance, anticipate challenges, and find innovative solutions for business issues
 - Represent Zillow's needs and best interests with third-party vendors, ensuring that they are accountable to expectations, service level agreements (SLAs), and contractual commitments
 - Constructively negotiate trade-off discussions with other senior leaders, articulating pros and cons while providing options and recommendations that align with Zillow's goals and values
 - Prioritize initiatives that balance short-term needs with long-term vision, ensuring consistent delivery of high-impact solutions
 - Be responsible for measuring the impact of the roadmap, ensuring that the changes are having the result expected, using data such as deflection, resolution time and employee satisfaction
 - Guide the team through capacity planning, agile execution, and continuous improvement of team operations
 - Identify operational opportunities and come up with a plan to implement improvements, focused on a continuous improvement philosophy
 - Lead quarterly, mid-year and annual planning for your team
 - Mentor future leaders by supporting their development in strategy, collaboration, and execution
 - Communicate key progress, risks, opportunities and alternative options to executive audiences with clarity and confidence

This role has been categorized as an Office position. "Office" employees regularly work at the Zillow India office for approximately 80 to 100 percent of their time each month. Employees must live within a reasonable commuting distance of the office. Zillow has not defined a reasonable distance, and expects employees will use judgment in determining this for themselves and understand the implications re: time commitment and cost of daily commute. 

Who you are

- 8+ years of experience in enterprise IT and HR service management technology stacks, with extensive exposure to the ServiceNow ecosystem
 - 5+ years of people leadership experience, with a proven track record of getting results through others
 - Familiar with Agile Scrum processes and associated ceremonies, and can effectively lead a team in an agile environment
 - Passionate about career development and multiplying the impact of your team members, providing mentoring and coaching to individual contributors
 - Ability to seamlessly adapt your communication style to the audience ranging from individual contributors on your team to senior leaders and executives
 - Strong commitment to operational excellence, constantly striving to uncover the underlying causes of problems, using data to guide your decision-making, and fostering a culture of ongoing improvement within your team
 - Previous experience maintaining relationships with external vendors and a solid understanding of commonly accepted approaches in the industry
 - Track record of successfully delivering projects through team members that report to you, and can collaborate effectively with partner teams
 - Willing to roll up your sleeves and dive into the details to ensure a thorough understanding of the work at hand
 - Has built and operated platforms, not only implemented them
 - Hands-on with ServiceNow integrations and automation
 - Uses AI tools in their own work and has moved AI use cases into production

Get to know us

At Zillow, we're reimagining how people move-through the real estate market and through their careers. As the most-visited real estate platform in the U. S. , we help people navigate buying, selling, financing and renting with greater ease and confidence. Whether you're working in tech, sales, operations, or design, you'll be part of a company reshaping an industry and helping more people make home a reality. 

Zillow is honored to be recognized among the best workplaces in the U. S. Zillow was named one of FORTUNE 100 Best Companies to Work For® in 2026, and included on TIME's America's Best Companies 2026 list, reflecting our commitment to creating an innovative, inclusive, and engaging culture where employees are empowered to grow. 

No matter where you sit in the organization, your work will help drive innovation, support our customers, and move the industry-and your career-forward, together. 

Zillow Group is committed to fostering an inclusive, innovative environment and to providing equal employment opportunities. We comply with applicable laws that prohibit discrimination in employment and recruitment.

data.title: Software Architect
data.description:
Hiring for SMA Solar India - via Flexiple, the recruiting partner on this role. 

About the Company

A company building cloud-based energy-management software. It runs optimisation, simulation and evaluation for solar (photovoltaic) systems, battery storage and EV charging. Its international team of engineers and energy experts is growing, and this hire will set the architecture for how its platform scales. 

About the Role

You'll be the hands-on Software Architect for the platform. You'll design cloud-native, event-driven systems, guide engineers through code reviews and prototypes, and turn business needs into scalable, secure and cost-aware architecture. You'll also stay close to the code yourself. The role is based in Bengaluru. 

What you'll do

- Design distributed, event-driven services: where each service ends, the messaging patterns between them, and how data flows. 
 - Define domain models, API contracts and event schemas that can change over time without breaking other services. 
 - Build prototypes and complex Python backend components yourself, and lead code reviews. 
 - Set the bar for performance, security, reliability and observability, and help troubleshoot production issues. 
 - Guide delivery on the cloud, preferably Azure, using Docker, Kubernetes, infrastructure-as-code and CI/CD. 
 - Work with domain experts to bring solar, battery and EV-charging optimisation into the product. 
 - Set coding, testing and documentation standards across teams. 

What you bring

- A Master's in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field, and 10+ years in software, including several years as a tech lead or architect. 
 - You've designed a microservices or event-driven platform that used asynchronous messaging (Kafka, RabbitMQ, MQTT or similar) and ran it in production. 
 - Strong Python backend skills, plus relational databases, data processing and automated testing. 
 - You've taken services to production on a major cloud with containers, Kubernetes, infrastructure-as-code and CI/CD. 
 - You can explain architectural trade-offs clearly to engineers and to non-technical stakeholders on international teams. 
 - You're used to building in iterations with cross-functional agile teams. 

Nice to have

- Experience in energy management, IoT or connected devices, time-series data, AI, or mathematical optimisation.

The Challenge

Your Mission

- Has deep knowledge of entire system and can jump into code in any component and fire fight and contribute. Makes decisions on product direction and internals based on deep subject matter knowledge.

Benefits

As an employee at OneTrust, you will be part of the OneTeam. That means you'll receive support physically, mentally, and emotionally so that you can do your best work both in and out of the office. This includes comprehensive healthcare coverage, flexible PTO, equity RSUs, annual performance bonus opportunities, retirement account support, 14+ weeks of paid parental leave, career development opportunities, company-paid privacy certification exam fees, and much more. Specific benefits differ by country. For more information, talk to your recruiter or visit onetrust. com/careers. 

Resources

Check out the following to learn more about OneTrust and its people: 

- OneTrust Careers on YouTube
 - @LifeatOneTrust on Instagram

Your Data

You have the right to have your personal data updated or removed. You also have the right to have a copy of the information OneTrust holds about you. Further details about these rights are available on the website in our Privacy Overview. You can change your mind at any time and have your personal data removed from our database. In order to do this you must contact us and let us know you wish to be removed. The request should be made on the Data Subject Request Form. 

Recruitment fraud warning: OneTrust is aware of scams involving false offers of employment with our company. The fraudulent jobs, interviews and job offers use fake websites, email addresses, group chat and text messages. Be aware that we never ask candidates for personal information, IDs or bank information during the interview process. We do not interview prospective candidates via instant message or group chat, and do not require candidates to purchase products or services, or process payments on our behalf as a condition of any employment offer. Please note that any legitimate interview availability requests will come directly from a OneTrust recruiter with an "@onetrust. com" email address. You may also receive legitimate emails from "@us. greenhouse-mail. io". Recruiters will only reach out to candidates who have applied for a role through our ATS (Greenhouse) or prospects via LinkedIn InMail. Job offers will come from a recruiter and may have a "@docusign. net" email address. For more information or if you have been targeted please reach out to askrecruiting@onetrust. com. 

Our Commitment to You

When you join OneTrust you are stepping onto a launching pad - the countdown has begun. The destination? A career without boundaries working alongside a diverse and inclusive crew who is passionate about doing meaningful work. As a pioneer, your voice and expertise will help chart the direction of an entirely new category. Our commitment to putting people first starts with you. Your growth is part of the mission. Our goal is to give you the power to embark on the next phase of your uniquely, unique career.

Join us as a Software Engineer-VP at Barclays, where you will spearhead the evolution of our infrastructure and deployment pipelines, driving innovation and operational excellence. You will harness cutting-edge technology to build and manage robust, scalable and secure infrastructure, ensuring seamless delivery of our digital solutions. 

To be a successful Software Engineer-VP, you should have experience with: 

- Design, develop, test and maintain full-stack applications using Java, Spring/Spring Boot, Microservices and React. 
 - Develop scalable and high-performance backend services with a strong focus on Java concurrency and multi-threading. 
 - Build and integrate REST-based microservices and enterprise application components. 
 - Develop responsive front-end functionality using JavaScript and React. 
 - Work with SQL databases, including query development, troubleshooting and performance analysis. 
 - Use Unix/Linux scripting for application support, automation and operational activities. 
 - Contribute to automated build and CI/CD pipelines and engineering best practices. 
 - Perform technical analysis, debugging and root-cause investigation for complex application issues. 
 - Participate in code reviews, testing and continuous improvement of application quality and maintainability. 
 - Collaborate effectively with developers, architects, QA, business analysts and other stakeholders. 

Essential Technical Skills

- Java: Strong hands-on expertise in Java development, with deep understanding of Core Java, collections, JVM concepts, exception handling, memory management and performance optimisation. 
 - Spring / Spring Boot: Strong hands-on expertise across the Spring ecosystem, particularly Spring Boot, with experience designing and developing scalable enterprise applications. 
 - Multi-threading & Concurrency: Strong practical knowledge of Java multi-threading, concurrency, asynchronous processing and performance optimisation, including diagnosing and resolving concurrency and performance issues. 
 - Microservices: Strong experience designing, developing and supporting microservices, with good understanding of API design, service decomposition, resiliency, scalability, observability and integration patterns. 
 - Unix/Linux: Strong hands-on experience with Unix/Linux, including scripting, application troubleshooting and production support. 
 - SQL & Databases: Strong knowledge of relational databases and SQL, including complex queries, data-access patterns and database performance considerations. 
 - Build & CI/CD: Strong understanding of build tools, source control and CI/CD practices, including automated build, testing, deployment and release pipelines. 
 - JavaScript & React: Hands-on development experience with JavaScript and React, with the ability to contribute across the application stack. 
 - Engineering & Architecture: Ability to make sound technical and architectural decisions, ensuring solutions meet scalability, resilience, maintainability, security and performance requirements. 

Good to Have

- Experience with React Redux or similar state-management frameworks. 
 - Knowledge of Docker and Kubernetes and modern containerisation/orchestration practices. 
 - Experience implementing and supporting automated build, deployment and release pipelines. 
 - Experience developing high-volume, low-latency or performance-sensitive enterprise applications. 
 - Exposure to observability, monitoring, production troubleshooting and performance tuning. 
 - Experience working within large-scale financial services or other complex enterprise technology environments. 

Professional & Leadership Skills

- Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to independently resolve complex technical challenges. 
 - Demonstrated end-to-end technical ownership, from solution design and development through testing, deployment and production stability. 
 - Ability to provide technical direction and engineering guidance while remaining hands-on with development. 
 - Strong focus on code quality, automated testing, maintainability, resilience and engineering best practices. 
 - Ability to conduct effective code reviews and technical/design reviews and drive engineering standards across the team. 
 - Ability to identify technical, delivery and production risks early and drive pragmatic solutions. 
 - Strong communication skills, with the ability to articulate technical concepts and trade-offs to engineering, product and business stakeholders. 
 - Ability to mentor and guide engineers, promoting knowledge sharing and continuous improvement. 
 - Strong collaboration across Engineering, Architecture, Product, QA, DevOps and Production Support. 
 - Ability to operate with a high degree of autonomy and take ownership of complex technical decisions and delivery outcomes. 

You may be assessed on key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills. 

The role is based out of Pune. 

Purpose of the role

To design, develop and improve software, utilising various engineering methodologies, that provides business, platform, and technology capabilities for our customers and colleagues. 

Accountabilities

- Development and delivery of high-quality software solutions by using industry aligned programming languages, frameworks, and tools. Ensuring that code is scalable, maintainable, and optimized for performance. 
 - Cross-functional collaboration with product managers, designers, and other engineers to define software requirements, devise solution strategies, and ensure seamless integration and alignment with business objectives. 
 - Collaboration with peers, participate in code reviews, and promote a culture of code quality and knowledge sharing. 
 - Stay informed of industry technology trends and innovations and actively contribute to the organization's technology communities to foster a culture of technical excellence and growth. 
 - Adherence to secure coding practices to mitigate vulnerabilities, protect sensitive data, and ensure secure software solutions. 
 - Implementation of effective unit testing practices to ensure proper code design, readability, and reliability. 

Vice President Expectations

- To contribute or set strategy, drive requirements and make recommendations for change. Plan resources, budgets, and policies; manage and maintain policies/ processes; deliver continuous improvements and escalate breaches of policies/procedures. . 
 - If managing a team, they define jobs and responsibilities, planning for the department's future needs and operations, counselling employees on performance and contributing to employee pay decisions/changes. They may also lead a number of specialists to influence the operations of a department, in alignment with strategic as well as tactical priorities, while balancing short and long term goals and ensuring that budgets and schedules meet corporate requirements. .

The four LEAD behaviours are: L - Listen and be authentic, E - Energise and inspire, A - Align across the enterprise, D - Develop others. .

They will lead collaborative, multi-year assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will train, guide and coach less experienced specialists and provide information affecting long term profits, organisational risks and strategic decisions. .

 - Create solutions based on sophisticated analytical thought comparing and selecting complex alternatives. In-depth analysis with interpretative thinking will be required to define problems and develop innovative solutions. 
 - Adopt and include the outcomes of extensive research in problem solving processes.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship - our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. data.title: Senior Software Engineer
data.description:
About Rippling

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system. 

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365-all within 90 seconds. 

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1. 8B+ from the world's top investors-including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock-and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes. 

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling. com addresses. 

About The AI Platform Team

The AI Platform team is one of Rippling's highest-priority engineering investments and sits at the center of the company's broader AI strategy. The team is building the foundational infrastructure that powers AI capabilities across Rippling's entire product ecosystem, including HR, Payroll, Benefits, Recruiting, IT, Finance, Compliance, and Workforce Management. Rather than building standalone chatbots or simple LLM integrations, the team focuses on creating deeply integrated AI systems that understand Rippling's rich business context, permissions model, workflows, and enterprise data. 

The team is developing core platform capabilities such as AI agents, workflow automation engines, evaluation frameworks, feedback loops, data pipelines, and self-healing systems that can identify issues, surface insights, and help automate complex enterprise workflows. These systems operate with real business context, approvals, permissions, and auditability requirements, enabling customers to safely delegate operational tasks while maintaining control and governance. 

One of the unique aspects of Rippling AI is that it is built directly on top of Rippling's unified data model and permission system. The platform can reason across HR, IT, Payroll, and Finance data while respecting access controls and providing verifiable outputs. The team is solving challenging problems around agent orchestration, workflow execution, reliability, permissions, evaluations, observability, data quality, and scalable AI infrastructure. 

This is an ideal environment for engineers who enjoy building large-scale backend and platform systems, working through ambiguity, and owning products end-to-end. Engineers on the team are highly hands-on, spend the majority of their time coding, and have the opportunity to shape how AI becomes a core part of enterprise software. The role offers significant ownership, visibility, and a strong path toward Staff-level engineering scope over time. 

What you will do: 

- Build foundational AI platform systems that support Rippling's broader AI strategy across HR, IT, Finance, payroll, benefits, recruiting, compliance, and internal workflows. 
 - Work as a deeply hands-on Senior Software Engineer, with around 60% of time expected to be spent coding, debugging, reviewing code, and owning implementation. 
 - Contribute to the design and build-out of AI platform capabilities such as background agents, automated workflows, evaluation systems, data pipelines, and model quality feedback loops. 
 - Help build systems that allow AI agents to automate repetitive enterprise workflows with the right permissions, controls, approvals, and auditability. 
 - Work on platform systems that support self-healing and self-improving workflows, where AI can detect negative product signals and help identify root causes. 
 - Partner with Staff Engineers, Product, Infra, Platform, and Engineering stakeholders to convert ambiguous product/platform problems into scalable technical solutions. 
 - Own well-defined to moderately ambiguous components end-to-end - from design and implementation to testing, launch, monitoring, and iteration. 
 - Participate actively in design discussions, code reviews, debugging, production support, and operational improvements. 
 - Build reliable, scalable, and maintainable backend/platform systems that can support Rippling's product ecosystem. 

What's exciting about this role: 

- This is not a generic chatbot or lightweight LLM wrapper role. The team is building core AI platform infrastructure that can make Rippling's product surface more autonomous, context-aware, and self-improving. 
 - Engineers will get exposure to AI agents, automated enterprise workflows, self-healing systems, and custom intelligence layers built around Rippling-specific product context. 
 - The role offers strong learning, ownership, and growth opportunities for engineers who want to work at the intersection of backend/platform engineering and AI infrastructure. 
 - This is a strong opportunity for a high-potential Senior Engineer to grow toward Staff-level scope over time. 
 - Rippling AI is a high-priority company initiative, and the team needs strong Senior Engineers who can add meaningful hands-on execution capacity. 
 - The AI Platform team is lean and supports a broad set of internal engineering and product stakeholders, creating a need for engineers who can ramp quickly and contribute with high ownership. 
 - The team needs builders who are strong in backend/platform engineering and are comfortable working on scalable production systems. 
 - The systems being built involve complex areas such as workflows, permissions, approvals, data quality, reliability, evaluations, and automation. 
 - Generic LLMs do not fully understand Rippling's proprietary workflows, policy logic, query language, company data, and permissions, so the team needs engineers who can help build AI infrastructure around Rippling's real product context. 
 - The team moves fast, and candidates need to be comfortable with ambiguity, changing priorities, and rapid iteration. 
 - Coding is a core expectation for this role; this cannot be filled by someone who is not actively hands-on. 
 - Start by owning meaningful components within AI Platform initiatives such as background agents, workflow automation, evaluations, data pipelines, or self-healing systems. 
 - Grow from owning individual components to owning larger services, workflows, or platform modules end-to-end. Build depth in Rippling's product context, AI platform systems, infrastructure, and internal engineering patterns. 
 - Partner closely with Staff Engineers and senior technical leaders to learn how larger architecture and platform decisions are made. Increase influence through high-quality coding, strong debugging, reliable execution, thoughtful design input, and ownership after launch. 
 - Over time, grow toward Staff-level expectations by taking on more ambiguous problems, mentoring other engineers, and influencing broader technical direction. 
 - Become a trusted engineer who can independently deliver scalable, reliable, production-grade systems with limited hand-holding. Ability to ramp quickly into Rippling's AI platform, codebase, product context, and internal systems. 
 - Strong hands-on coding contribution, with approximately 60% of time spent coding and implementation-focused work. 
 - Ability to independently own features, components, services, or workflows from design to production. Delivery of reliable, scalable, maintainable backend/platform systems. 
 - Strong execution quality across coding, testing, debugging, observability, and operational ownership. 
 - Ability to work well with Product, Infra, Platform, Staff Engineers, and other engineering stakeholders. 
 - Strong engineering fundamentals in APIs, databases, system design, distributed systems, concurrency, and production debugging. 
 - Demonstrated curiosity and learning agility around AI agents, LLM infrastructure, automation systems, evaluation loops, and data/ML infrastructure. 
 - Ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment. 
 - Positive contribution to team quality through code reviews, design discussions, documentation, and mentoring junior engineers where needed. 

What you need to have: 

- 5-8 years of overall software engineering experience, preferably in backend, platform, infrastructure, distributed systems, or product engineering. 
 - Strong hands-on coding ability; 60% coding is non-negotiable. Must be comfortable writing production-quality code, reviewing code, debugging issues, and owning implementation details. 
 - Strong programming knowledge in one or more backend/general-purpose languages such as Python, Java, Go/Golang, C++, Scala, Kotlin, or C#. 
 - Language should not be the only filter - coding fundamentals, system design depth, distributed systems exposure, and ability to build production-scale systems are more important. 
 - Experience building and operating scalable backend/platform systems in production. 
 - Good understanding of system design, API design, databases, data modeling, concurrency, observability, and production troubleshooting. Ability to independently own well-defined to moderately ambiguous technical problems from design to execution, launch, and iteration. 
 - Comfortable working in a fast-paced product engineering environment with changing priorities and high ownership. 
 - Strong collaboration skills with Product, Infra, Platform, and Engineering stakeholders. Good product judgment and ability to understand how engineering decisions impact customers and business outcomes. 
 - Ability to contribute to design reviews, code reviews, technical discussions, and team quality. 
 - For AI Platform specifically, practical curiosity or exposure to AI agents, LLM infrastructure, agentic workflows, ML/data infrastructure, inference pipelines, evaluations, automation systems, or adjacent AI systems is a strong plus. 

What would be nice to have: 

- Prior experience in a high-growth or hyper-growth startup / product-led technology company. 
 - Recent hands-on exposure to AI agents, LLM tooling, AI infrastructure, automation platforms, evaluation systems, or data/ML pipelines. 
 - Strong knowledge of Python for AI/ML infrastructure, automation, agents, scripting, evaluations, or data pipelines. 
 - Strong SQL knowledge for querying, data-heavy systems, analytics, workflow systems, reporting, and enterprise intelligence use cases. 
 - Experience with Go, Java, C++, or Scala in backend, platform, infrastructure, or distributed systems environments. 
 - Exposure to TypeScript / JavaScript if the role involves full-stack, internal tooling, dashboards, or product surface ownership. 
 - Experience with workflow orchestration, background automation, reliability platforms, internal tools, or developer productivity platforms. 
 - Exposure to permissions, approvals, auditability, compliance, or security-sensitive workflows. 
 - Prior exposure to fintech, HR tech, payroll, benefits, compliance, IT, enterprise SaaS, or workflow-heavy platforms. 
 - Clear evidence of learning quickly, taking ownership, and operating well in ambiguous environments. 

Technical Skills: 

- 5-8 years of strong software engineering experience Preferably in backend, platform, infrastructure, distributed systems, or product engineering. 
 - 60% hands-on coding is non-negotiable Candidate must be actively writing, reviewing, debugging, and owning production code. This is not a coordination-only or design-only role. 
 - Strong coding ability in at least one backend/general-purpose language 
 - Preferred languages: Python, Java, Go/Golang, C++, Scala, Kotlin, or C#. Scalable backend/platform systems exposure 
 - Should have worked on production systems involving APIs, databases, reliability, observability, debugging, and scale. 
 - Ownership mindset Should be able to independently own features/components end-to-end, work through moderate ambiguity, and drive execution without constant hand-holding. 
 - Strong learning agility and AI/platform curiosity For AI Platform, candidate should show practical curiosity or exposure to AI agents, LLM infrastructure, automation systems, ML/data infra, inference, evaluations, or adjacent AI systems.

A focused group of leaders in each Tech Center helps to ensure we can manage and improve each location, from investing in growth, success, and well-being of our people, to making sure colleagues from each IT division feel a sense of belonging to managing critical emergencies. And together, we must leverage the strength of our team to collaborate globally to optimize connections and share best practices across the Tech Centers. 

Position Overview

The Reliability Engineer is part of the Enterprise Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) organization responsible for improving the reliability, resilience, observability, and operational effectiveness of business-critical technology services. 

In this role, you will work across applications, platforms, cloud, infrastructure, network, and shared enterprise services. You will apply software engineering and SRE practices, use enterprise observability and AI-enabled technologies, automate operational activities, and help teams detect, diagnose, recover from, and prevent service disruptions. 

This role is suited for an engineer who has developed a foundation in software, infrastructure, cloud, operations, or observability engineering and is ready to build deeper expertise in Site Reliability Engineering. 

Key Responsibilities

Reliability Engineering

- Apply SRE principles to improve the availability, resilience, performance, and recoverability of services. 
 - Support the implementation and measurement of Service Level Indicators (SLIs), Service Level Objectives (SLOs), and other service-health measures. 
 - Analyze service behavior, failure patterns, and dependencies to identify reliability risks and opportunities for improvement. 
 - Participate in resilience, failover, recovery, and production-readiness activities. 
 - Implement reliability improvements in partnership with application, platform, and infrastructure teams. 

Observability

- Use observability platforms to analyze metrics, logs, traces, events, and service topology. 
 - Build and improve dashboards, alerts, and service-health views. 
 - Correlate telemetry across applications, infrastructure, cloud, network, and shared platforms to support end-to-end troubleshooting. 
 - Identify gaps in telemetry, monitoring, and alerting and work with engineering teams to improve observability. 
 - Develop experience with modern telemetry and instrumentation approaches such as OpenTelemetry. 

AI-Enabled Operations

- Use AI, Generative AI, and AIOps capabilities to assist with operational analysis, anomaly detection, event correlation, troubleshooting, and knowledge retrieval. 
 - Apply AI-assisted techniques to accelerate incident investigation and identify potential causes and remediation options. 
 - Help develop AI-assisted operational workflows and automation that improve reliability and reduce manual effort. 
 - Validate AI-generated insights against telemetry and authoritative operational data before acting on recommendations. 
 - Apply appropriate safeguards and human oversight when AI is used in production operations. 

Incident & Problem Engineering

- Participate in technical investigation and recovery of production incidents. 
 - Use telemetry, dependency information, and engineering analysis to diagnose service failures. 
 - Contribute to root-cause analysis, post-incident reviews, and corrective and preventive actions. 
 - Identify recurring reliability issues and help implement engineering solutions that prevent recurrence. 
 - Validate that remediation actions have resulted in measurable reliability improvements. 

Automation & Engineering

- Develop scripts, tools, and automated workflows that improve operational efficiency and reliability. 
 - Automate repetitive detection, diagnostic, remediation, and recovery activities where appropriate. 
 - Integrate systems and operational platforms using APIs and automation frameworks. 
 - Identify operational toil and replace repeated manual activities with sustainable engineering solutions. 
 - Contribute reusable automation, runbooks, and engineering patterns that can be applied across services. 

Qualifications

Required

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - Foundational experience in software engineering, cloud, infrastructure, systems engineering, production operations, or a related technical area. 
 - Working knowledge of at least one programming or scripting language such as Python, PowerShell, Java, or JavaScript. 
 - Understanding of application, infrastructure, cloud, and networking fundamentals. 
 - Basic knowledge of monitoring, logging, alerting, and troubleshooting. 
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. 
 - Ability to collaborate effectively across engineering and operational teams. 
 - Interest in developing deeper expertise in SRE, observability, automation, and AI-enabled operations. 

Preferred

Experience or exposure to one or more of the following

- Observability technologies such as Dynatrace, Splunk, Grafana, Prometheus, or equivalent. 
 - OpenTelemetry and modern application instrumentation. 
 - Cloud platforms such as AWS or Microsoft Azure. 
 - Kubernetes and container technologies. 
 - Infrastructure as Code and automation technologies such as Terraform or Ansible. 
 - ServiceNow or enterprise IT Service Management platforms. 
 - CI/CD and modern software delivery practices. 
 - SRE concepts including SLIs, SLOs, error budgets, incident management, and post-incident reviews. 
 - AI/ML, Generative AI, AIOps, or AI-assisted operational tooling. 

Level Expectations

The Reliability Engineer independently handles well-defined reliability engineering activities while receiving guidance for complex, unfamiliar, or high-impact problems. 

The engineer is expected to demonstrate growing technical independence, contribute production-quality engineering work, and build proficiency across reliability engineering, observability, automation, and AI-enabled operations. 

As experience develops, the engineer will take broader ownership of reliability improvements across services and contribute to reusable enterprise SRE practices, while senior engineers retain responsibility for enterprise reliability strategy, architecture, standards, and governance

Who We Are

We are known as Merck & Co. , Inc. , Rahway, New Jersey, USA in the United States and Canada and MSD everywhere else. For more than a century, we have been bringing forward medicines and vaccines for many of the world's most challenging diseases. Today, our company continues to be at the forefront of research to deliver innovative health solutions and advance the prevention and treatment of diseases that threaten people and animals around the world. 

What We Look For

Imagine getting up in the morning for a job as important as helping to save and improve lives around the world. Here, you have that opportunity. You can put your empathy, creativity, digital mastery, or scientific genius to work in collaboration with a diverse group of colleagues who pursue and bring hope to countless people who are battling some of the most challenging diseases of our time. Our team is constantly evolving, so if you are among the intellectually curious, join us-and start making your impact today.

Our culture guides us and creates a workplace where all employees feel heard and welcomed. Lennox is a global community that values each team member's contributions and offers a supportive environment for career development. Come, stay, and grow with us. 

Job Description

The Lead Architect owns the end-to-end technical design of enterprise applications built on Java and the Spring ecosystem. The role combines hands-on architecture of cloud-ready, event-driven microservices with technical leadership across the software development lifecycle - setting standards, mentoring engineers, driving engineering excellence and ensuring solutions are scalable, secure, resilient, and aligned with business goals. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, including developers, product managers, and business stakeholders, to deliver innovative and future-proof solutions. 

Key Responsibilities

- Own the end-to-end architecture for assigned systems, from solution design through detailed component, integration, and deployment architecture. 
 - Translate business and product requirements into scalable, secure, and maintainable technical solutions while collaborating closely with business, product, and delivery teams. 
 - Define and maintain architectural standards, best practices, governance frameworks, and technical roadmaps. 
 - Ensure non-functional requirements including performance, scalability, security, availability, resilience, and fault tolerance are incorporated into all solutions. 
 - Design and oversee the development of Java-based, cloud-ready microservices using Spring Boot, REST APIs, and event-driven architectures. 
 - Provide architectural guidance to development teams and ensure implementation aligns with the approved architecture. 
 - Partners with product and delivery leads to estimate effort, sequence work, and manage architectural dependencies and technical risks. 
 - Lead the development of new features, enhancements, and modernization initiatives across the application landscape. 
 - Participate in and provide technical leadership throughout the Software Development Lifecycle (requirements, design, development, testing, deployment, and support). 
 - Conduct architecture and code reviews to ensure compliance with coding standards, security guidelines, and quality best practices. 
 - Drive engineering excellence through Agile architecture, DevSecOps practices, CI/CD automation, and cloud adoption. 
 - Optimize application performance, troubleshooting complex technical issues, and continuously improving system reliability. 
 - Mentor architects and senior developers while fostering collaboration, innovation, and technical excellence. 
 - Promote knowledge sharing through technical documentation, architecture artifacts, workshops, and training sessions. 
 - Stay current with emerging technologies and evaluate their applicability to improve business outcomes and engineering capabilities

Qualifications

- 10-12 years of experience in enterprise application development, with at least 3+ years in a Solution Architect or Technical Lead role. 
 - Proven experience designing and delivering enterprise-scale, distributed applications and microservices. 
 - Strong expertise in Java SE/EE and Spring ecosystem (Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Spring Security). 
 - Proficiency in Java as the primary language, with working knowledge of Python or JavaScript as an advantage. 
 - Experience designing RESTful APIs, microservices, event-driven architectures, and integration using SOAP where required. 
 - Experience with messaging platforms such as Kafka or RabbitMQ and API Gateway technologies. 
 - Strong knowledge of relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server) and database design principles. 
 - Familiarity with front-end technologies such as HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and frameworks like React. 
 - Experience with Git and modern software development workflows. 
 - Experience implementing DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and cloud-native deployment patterns. 
 - Hands-on experience with a major cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and experience with containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes). 
 - Familiarity with observability and monitoring tooling (e. g. , Prometheus, Grafana, ELK) and SLO/SLA definition. 
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to troubleshoot complex technical issues. 
 - Ability to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions aligned with enterprise architecture. 
 - Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with experience collaborating across engineering teams, business stakeholders, and senior leadership. 
 - Ability to influence technical decisions and drive architectural governance across multiple teams.

Who we are?

Johnson Controls is the global leader for smart, healthy and sustainable buildings. At Johnson Controls, we've been making buildings smarter since 1885, and our capabilities, depth of innovation experience, and global reach have been growing ever since. 

Today, we offer the world's largest portfolio of building products, technologies, software, and services; we put that portfolio to work to transform the environments where people live, work, learn and play. This is where Johnson Controls comes in, helping drive the outcomes that matter most. Through a full range of systems and digital solutions, we make your buildings smarter. Sustainability is a top priority for our company. 

We committed to invest 75 percent of new product development R&D in climate-related innovation to develop sustainable products and services. We take sustainability seriously. Achieving net zero carbon emissions before 2040 is just one of our commitments to making the world a better place. 

What You Will Do

Johnson Controls Digital Solutions is looking for an experienced engineer with a deep knowledge on building technologies including BMS, VMS, and Access Control etc. 

As a member of the Global Center of excellence the Presales technical lead will help customers to make technology decisions, implement best practices for asset management and overall facilitate transforming buildings into smart connected entities. 

This role requires a blend of technical expertise, customer service, and sales skills to effectively support potential clients and the sales team in understanding, evaluating, and adopting the company's digital products and solutions. You are obsessed with driving continuous process improvements to optimize solution and deliverables in presales process. 

How You Will Do It

 - Hands-on experience in SCADA Platforms (WinCC, Iconics, Ignition or similar) and PLC programming is preferred. 
 - Experience in IoT Gateway configuration and Device Onboarding to cloud is a must have. 
 - Knowledge of different types of OT/IT network protocols like BACnet, Modbus, OPC, MQTT, SNMP, AMQP and other protocols.

Skills And Competencies

- Strong technical aptitude and ability to quickly learn new products and technologies. 
 - Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. 
 - Proficiency in using Integrated software and digital communication tools. 
 - Ability to present complex technical information in a clear and concise manner.

data.title: Director, Team Lead, Regional Engineering Group Lead
data.description:
Role Summary

Pfizer is building one Data, AI & Engineering organisation to build and run the data, artificial intelligence (AI) and digital products for International Commercial. This role leads one of the five regional engineering groups that together form the pillar's single engineering pool across data, AI and full-stack engineering. Reporting directly to the Vice President - Data, AI & Engineering and sitting on the pillar's leadership team, the Regional Engineering Group Lead manages a group of 6 to 8 engineers, including senior engineers, and is the technical lead for the products they build, from minimum viable product (MVP) through build, scale and enhance. The role decides how engineering quality, security and production readiness are met in every product the group touches, takes MVPs from the Principal Engineer, Strategic Programs and scales them into products, and holds colleagues and partner engineers to one engineering bar. Five posts share this profile across the Americas, Europe and Asia; location is the variable. This role owns the people in the group, the technical leadership of its products, their delivery quality and release readiness, and the group's craft coverage. 

Role Responsibilities

- Delivery leadership
 - Acts as technical lead for the products built by the group, or names a senior engineer as technical lead for each
 - Leads delivery from MVP to build, scale and enhance, accountable for engineering quality, security and production readiness
 - Takes MVPs from the Principal Engineer, Strategic Programs at handover and carries them into build and scale
 - Holds colleagues and partner engineers to one engineering bar
 - People management
 - Hires, develops and manages performance for a group of 6 to 8 engineers, including senior engineers
 - Assigns engineers to the pillar's highest-priority work and rotates them across products as the work moves through stages
 - Develops senior engineers as craft leaders and candidates for the Strategic Programs roles, and grows junior engineers and bench colleagues
 - Hires people who embrace change, want varied problems and move quickly
 - Engineering practice and standards
 - Keeps data, AI and full-stack engineering craft covered in the group
 - Serves as a guild steward when nominated and applies the guild standards in every build
 - Acts as acceptance owner for the group's domains, feeding the certification gate
 - Cross-region collaboration
 - Works as one engineering pool with the other four group leads, pairing and rotating engineers across regions
 - Provides engineers for the pillar's shared tooling
 - Acts as the senior engineering leader for the pillar in its region, accountable for the local hiring pipeline and partner engineers
 - Ways of working
 - Uses coding agents for routine engineering and reviews their output before it ships
 - Keeps technical ownership of the group's work when vendors and contractors are involved
This role covers a broad spectrum of skills and we encourage you to apply even if you meet partially. 

Basic Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering or a related field
 - 10 or more years of relevant experience, including 2 or more years leading teams
 - Hands-on experience in data engineering, AI or machine learning engineering or full-stack development
 - Experience with cloud platforms, modern data stacks and programming languages, including Structured Query Language (SQL)
 - Experience with continuous integration and delivery (CI/CD), infrastructure as code, automated testing and secure engineering practice
 - Experience leading agile, cross-functional engineering teams, with an AI-first approach to changing ways of working
 - Experience communicating technical decisions to product owners, business stakeholders and engineers, and working across regions and time zones
 - Experience solving complex, ambiguous engineering problems with structured analysis and clear recommendations
 - Experience leading engineers and influencing peers and stakeholders without direct authority
 - Experience evaluating engineering tools and practices and introducing them to teams

Preferred Qualifications

- Master's degree in computer science or a related field
 - Experience managing engineers and leading delivery at the same time as a tech lead inside a matrixed portfolio
 - Experience growing senior engineers and juniors while keeping sustainable spans and succession
 - Experience balancing staffing, delivery, technical debt and partner capacity across competing priorities
 - Experience keeping technical ownership when working with vendors and contractors, and comfort with change and rotation
 - A hands-on engineering craft still practised
 - Experience with cloud platforms such as Amazon Web Services (AWS), Azure or equivalent, modern data stacks such as Databricks, Snowflake or equivalent, and languages such as Python, TypeScript or equivalent
 - Experience with CI/CD and infrastructure tooling such as GitHub Actions, Terraform, Docker or equivalent
 - Experience using coding agents and AI-assisted development tools and verifying their output
 - Knowledge of commercial pharmaceutical processes and operations across field force, marketing, market access, pricing and tenders, and launch

Non-standard Work Schedule, Travel Or Environment Requirements

Ability to work non-traditional work hours interacting with global teams spanning across the different regions (eg: North America, Europe, Asia)

ORGANIZATIONAL RELATIONSHIPS

- Other teams within Data, AI & Engineering
 - Other teams within Business Transformation & Technology
 - Chief Marketing Office, Global Commercial Analytics
 - CIO platform teams

Supervision: 6 to 8 engineers, including senior engineers

Closing date for applications is November 29th. 

Pfizer is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable equal employment opportunity legislation in each jurisdiction in which it operates. 

To learn more about acceptable and prohibited uses of AI during the recruitment process, please review our candidate AI-use guidelines available on Pfizer Careers. 

Information & Business Tech

data.title: Senior Engineering Program Manager – Lifecycle.
data.description:
Position summary: 

The Head - Lifecycle Management / Engineering Program Manager - Lifecycle Management has complete end-to-end lifecycle ownership for Vision Care Solutions (VCS) products, Software solutions and the installed base. The role is accountable for lifecycle strategy, portfolio prioritization, sustaining engineering, post-market actions, release governance, serviceability, obsolescence and end-of-life execution across hardware, software and systems. 

The position is the functional manager for all Engineering Product Owners (EPOs), setting common operating mechanisms, priorities, quality expectations and leadership standards and program management for all Install base programs. The role converts customer, field, quality, regulatory, service and business signals into an integrated lifecycle roadmap, executable portfolio and measurable outcomes for product quality, customer safety, reliability, cyber resilience, cost and delivery. 

Primary duties and responsibilities: 

Lifecycle portfolio and installed-base ownership: 

- Own the VCS lifecycle portfolio from post-launch stabilization through upgrades, sustaining releases, refurbishment/service improvements, obsolescence management and end-of-life actions. 
 - Establish lifecycle strategy, multi-year roadmaps, prioritization principles, funding proposals and governance across products; balance customer safety, regulatory urgency, business value, technical risk and capacity. 
 - Drive installed-base performance through complaint and defect trends, Customer Safety Orders (CSOs)/ Customer Complaints, Field Modification Instructions (FMIs), hazardous investigations, CAPA actions and closure effectiveness. Functional leadership of Engineering Product Owners : 

- Lead, coach and develop all lifecycle EPOs; define role clarity, decision rights, objectives, performance expectations, capability development and succession plans. 
 - Ensure each EPO converts lifecycle needs into clear requirements, prioritized backlogs, acceptance criteria, milestones, dependencies, risks and measurable success criteria. 
 - Build an ownership culture centered on customer impact, technical judgment, facts-based decisions, transparent escalation, accountability and reliable delivery. Engineering program execution and release governance : 

- Direct cross-functional execution across systems, software, hardware, verification, quality, regulatory, service, manufacturing, sourcing, supply chain and external engineering partners. 
 - Govern scope, schedules, resources, budgets, risks, changes, tollgates and release readiness; resolve cross-program dependencies and escalate critical decisions early. 
 - Drive design verification, validation, design transfer, manufacturing/process readiness and documented release evidence appropriate to lifecycle changes. Quality, regulatory, cybersecurity and risk: 

- Ensure lifecycle execution complies with QMS, design controls, risk management, traceability, change control, CAPA and applicable medical-device regulations. 
 - Lead disciplined investigation, root-cause analysis, defect management and risk-benefit decisions; ensure complete, audit-ready closure documentation. 
 - Strengthen product cybersecurity through vulnerability management, secure-by-design practices, risk-based remediation and predictable cyber release governance. Cross-functional, customer and supplier leadership: 

- Act as the senior engineering interface for lifecycle topics across product management, commercial, regional, service, quality, regulatory, manufacturing and leadership stakeholders. 
 - Communicate portfolio status, customer/installed-base impact, risks, decisions and outcomes through concise dashboards and leadership reviews. 
 - Align suppliers, OEMs, contractors and engineering partners to ZEISS expectations for quality, reliability, maintainability, documentation, serviceability and lifecycle readiness. 
 - Lead service engineering for VCS product development team collaborating with VCS service team. 
 - Lead Value engineering to improve year-on-year productivity for VCS products. Operational excellence and measurable outcomes: 

- Establish standard work, decision forums, portfolio dashboards and KPIs for release predictability, field impact, complaint/hazard closure, CSO/FMI readiness, cybersecurity, QMS compliance and customer satisfaction. 
 - Use data, automation and AI-enabled analytics to identify trends, accelerate investigations, improve verification effectiveness and strengthen post-market performance. 
 - Own lifecycle resource and budget prioritization, vendor strategy and capacity planning; drive simplification and continuous improvement across the lifecycle operating model. Education, experience and job specifications: 

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Electronics, Software, Biomedical Engineering, Computer Science or a related STEM discipline; an MBA or advanced business qualification is advantageous. 
 - Typically 15+ years of relevant industry experience, including substantial engineering/product-development experience and demonstrated leadership of regulated lifecycle, sustaining or installed-base programs. 
 - Proven experience leading people and globally distributed cross-functional teams, including functional leadership, vendor management, resource planning and budget prioritization. 
 - Strong working knowledge of medical-device QMS/design controls, ISO 13485, risk management, CAPA, complaint handling, field actions, verification/validation, engineering change control and design transfer; FDA/EU MDR experience is preferred. 
 - Experience with full SDLC and release-cycle management, post-market issue resolution, cybersecurity-driven releases and executive stakeholder management. 
 - PMP, Agile/Product Owner, Scrum, Lean, DFSS, DFR or comparable engineering/program leadership certification is advantageous.
