Manufacturing Engineering Manager - Operations Management

Job Description

Partner the Best

As a Manufacturing Engineering Leader, you will oversee and mentor the local Manufacturing Engineering team, ensuring they support existing and future product lines effectively. You will provide valuable advice and guidance to support our manufacturing activities. You will mentor a team to achieve high levels of reliability and consistency on the production line. You will play a strategic role in developing and implementing continuous improvements to our processes to ensure we create quality products. 

As Manufacturing Engineering Leader, you will be responsible for: 

- Manage multiple projects at various stages simultaneously, from defining scope and developing concepts to build, testing, and implementation. 
 - Plan and lead the installation and sequencing of machines, workstations, tools, and parts to maximize production efficiency. 
 - Ensure continuous business improvement according to benchmarks and standards. 
 - Conducting frequent interactions on manager level with Engineering, Shop Floor Leader, Project Management, Quality, HSE and enabling functions about technical and organizational alignment. 
 - Handling complex manufacturing processes. Manufacturing department has to define approaches. Variety due to customization to client needs. 
 - Strong Experience as Fabrication and Welding Shop Leader is preferred with following attributes: 
 - Manage daily fabrication, joint fit-ups, and welding operations to meet production schedules, safety rules, and quality standards
 - SMAW (Shielded Metal Arc Welding), MIG/MAG, and FCAW (Flux-Cored Arc Welding), ensuring correct parameters and approved Welding Procedure Specifications (WPS) are followed. 
 - Check joint preparation, fit-up alignment, distortion control, and coordinate with QC (Quality Control) inspectors for visual checks and Non-Destructive Testing (NDT). 
 - Relevant welding or supervisory certifications (such as AWS, CWB, or ASME-aligned qualifications) will be preferred. 

Fuel your passion

To be successful in this role you will: 

- Have a bachelor's degree in mechanical with minimum 12-15 years' experience in a related field or demonstrate equivalent, professional work experience
 - Demonstrate solid experience gained within a manufacturing environment
 - Be able to show excellent problem-solving, process improvement and analytical skills

Work in a way that works for you

We recognize that everyone is different and that the way in which people want to work and deliver at their best is different for everyone too. In

this role, we can offer the following flexible working patterns: 

- Working flexible hours - flexing the times when you work in the day to help you fit everything in and work when you are the most productive

Working with us

Our people are at the heart of what we do at Baker Hughes. We know we are better when all of our people are developed, engaged, and able to bring their whole authentic selves to work. We invest in the health and well-being of our workforce, train, and reward talent, and develop leaders at all levels to bring out the best in each other. 

Working for you

Our inventions have revolutionized energy for over a century. But to keep going forward tomorrow, we know we have to push the boundaries today. We prioritize rewarding those who embrace change with a package that reflects how much we value their input. Join us, and you can expect: 

- Contemporary work-life balance policies and well-being activities
 - Comprehensive private medical care options
 - The safety net of life insurance and disability programs
 - Tailored financial programs
 - Additional elected or voluntary benefits

The Baker Hughes internal title for this role is: Manufacturing Manager - Prod Process and Equip

We are an energy technology company that provides solutions to energy and industrial customers worldwide. Built on a century of experience and conducting business in over 120 countries, our innovative technologies and services are taking energy forward - making it safer, cleaner and more efficient for people and the planet. 

Join Us: 

Are you seeking an opportunity to make a real difference in a company that values innovation and progress? Join us and become part of a team of people who will challenge and inspire you! Let's come together and take energy forward.

data.title: Principal Cyber Security Test Engineer
data.description:
Join OneAdvanced

We are looking for an experienced application security engineer who will champion a shift-left security philosophy by integrating automated security analysis into CI/CD pipelines, SAST scanning, GitHub Actions, and SCA. To ensure we embed security into the software development lifecycle (SDLC) across the organisation's . NET, Java, and Node. js technology stacks. This role is also needed to run web application security assessments or penetration tests. 

What You Will Do

- Threat Modelling 
 - Code reviews 
 - Supporting engineering teams with security related design and build issues 
 - Reviewing the results from various security code scanning tools 
 - Reviewing CI/CD pipeline configurations 
 - Create or amend code and generate pull requests for code fixes 
 - Reviewing and testing AI integrations and relevant guard rails etc 
 - Assisting other members of the team with application security related issues 
 - Completing web and desktop security assessments 
 - Carrying out risk assessments using the IRAM2 methodology 
 - Attending architecture board technical reviews

Success Measures: 

- Number of threat models completed 
 - Number of penetration tests completed 
 - Number of engagements on AI and Software Engineering Projects 
 - Number of risk assessments completed

What You Will Have

- 5+ years of experience in application security, software engineering, or DevSecOps. 
 - Proven hands-on experience securing applications built with . NET, Java, and Node. js. 
 - Demonstrable expertise administering SAST scanning at enterprise scale (multi-project, multi-language). 
 - Experience implementing and managing SCA tooling, ideally Harness, across large codebases. 
 - Strong working knowledge of GitHub Actions CI/CD pipelines and GitHub Advanced Security features. 
 - Experience configuring and using IAST and RASP technologies 
 - Deep understanding of common vulnerability classes (injection, broken access control, cryptographic failures, SSRF, etc. ). 
 - Ability to execute on web and desktop penetration tests. 
 - Demonstrable expertise securing the embedding and implementation of AI within applications

Desirable

- Relevant certifications: CSSLP, GWEB, GWAPT, CEH, OSCP or equivalent. 
 - Experience with additional SAST/DAST/IAST/RASP tools (Checkmarx, Snyk, Veracode, Contrast Security).

data.title: Quality Engineer-Test Management.SAP
data.description:
Introduction

A career in IBM Consulting is built on long-term client relationships and close collaboration worldwide. You'll work with leading companies across industries, helping them shape their hybrid cloud and AI journeys. With support from our strategic partners, robust IBM technology, and Red Hat, you'll have the tools to drive meaningful change and accelerate client impact. At IBM Consulting, curiosity fuels success. You'll be encouraged to challenge the norm, explore new ideas, and create innovative solutions that deliver real results. Our culture of growth and empathy focuses on your long-term career development while valuing your unique skills and experiences. 

Your Role And Responsibilities

As a Quality Engineer specializing in Test Management for SAP, you will play a crucial role in ensuring the quality of applications and systems implemented using SAP. Your focus will be on developing test scenarios and test cases, executing them to verify that the system meets the requirements, with a primary emphasis on functional testing. 

Your Primary Responsibilities Will Include

- Develop Test Scenarios and Cases: Create comprehensive test scenarios and test cases to ensure thorough coverage of system functionality, identifying potential issues before they impact users. 
 - Execute Test Cases: Run developed test cases to verify that the system is built according to the specified requirements, meticulously documenting outcomes and any discrepancies found. 
 - Verify System Requirements: Confirm that the system adheres to the established requirements through rigorous testing, focusing on functional aspects to guarantee compliance and quality. 
 - Identify and Report Defects: Detect defects and inconsistencies during testing, reporting them promptly to facilitate timely corrections and improvements. 
 - Ensure Functional Quality: Concentrate on the functional testing of applications, ensuring they operate as intended and meet the necessary standards. 

Preferred Education

Master's Degree

Required Technical And Professional Expertise

- SAP Testing Experience: Experience with testing applications and systems implemented using SAP, including developing test scenarios and test cases to verify system functionality. 
 - Functional Testing Knowledge: Experience in functional testing of applications, with a focus on verifying system requirements and identifying potential issues. 
 - Test Case Development: Experience with creating comprehensive test scenarios and test cases to ensure thorough coverage of system functionality. 
 - Test Execution and Analysis: Experience in executing test cases, documenting outcomes, and analyzing results to identify defects and inconsistencies. 
 - Quality Assurance Understanding: Experience with ensuring functional quality of applications, confirming system adherence to established requirements through rigorous testing. 

Preferred Technical And Professional Experience

- SAP Testing Tools Knowledge: Experience with various SAP testing tools and methodologies would be beneficial for this role, enabling more efficient test case development and execution. 
 - Automated Testing Exposure: Exposure to automated testing techniques and tools in an SAP environment would be advantageous, allowing for more comprehensive testing coverage and faster defect identification. 
 - Agile Methodologies Familiarity: Familiarity with agile development methodologies would be valuable, facilitating collaboration with development teams and ensuring testing aligns with iterative development cycles.

data.title: Senior Devops Engineer , CX
data.description:
At NiCE, we don't limit our challenges. We challenge our limits. Always. We're ambitious. We're game changers. And we play to win. We set the highest standards and execute beyond them. And if you're like us, we can offer you the ultimate career opportunity that will light a fire within you. 

What's the Role All About?

The Senior DevOps Engineer is a key member of our DevOps group in Pune, supporting the Analytics platform engineering organization. The role builds and maintains the cloud infrastructure, automation frameworks and continuous delivery pipelines behind scalable, high-quality SaaS products. It combines hands-on AWS operations, DevOps automation, Kubernetes and Jenkins platform ownership and production support, and it uses AI-driven automation to improve deployment speed, reliability and the productivity of the whole group. The Senior DevOps Engineer also acts as a technical mentor within the engineering organization. 

How Will You Make an Impact?

- Partner with the Analytics development groups to plan and deliver DevOps initiatives and user stories. 
 - Design, build and maintain AWS cloud infrastructure, including EC2, S3, Lambda, CloudWatch, RDS, Kinesis and CloudFormation or CDK. 
 - Automate AWS infrastructure with infrastructure as code, backed by lint and validation checks in GitHub Actions. 
 - Design, implement and manage CI/CD pipelines in Jenkins (Groovy and shared libraries) and GitHub Actions, across all environments up to production, for multiple language stacks. 
 - Own the Jenkins platform on EKS: Jenkins and plugin upgrades, EKS version, node and add-on lifecycle, backup, right-sizing and production readiness of dev and prod instances. 
 - Manage release engineering: manifest-based deployments, release tagging and per-product rollback. 
 - Manage Docker containers and containerized microservices environments. 
 - Design and implement automated quality gates and release validation, including regression-test pipelines and test reporting. 
 - Strengthen security and compliance: IAM user-to-role migration, security agent rollout across accounts and regions, credential remediation and audit-ready change records. 
 - Drive cost optimization and consolidation: right-sizing, shutting down unused environments, ECR and region migrations and decommissioning of legacy stacks. 
 - Plan, execute and close change requests with the NOC, including sovereign and FedRAMP environments, and troubleshoot production issues, performance bottlenecks and outages. 
 - Manage daily DevOps operations: build systems, release management, artifact repositories, and support requests from development groups. 
 - Build AI-assisted DevOps tooling: agents and skills that triage failed builds, pre-check and draft change requests, summarize incidents, and answer operational questions from runbooks and documentation. 
 - Connect AI agents to our systems (Jira, ServiceNow, Jenkins, GitHub, Grafana, Kubernetes, AWS) through MCP servers and APIs, with least-privilege access, human approval steps and audit trails. 
 - Use AI coding assistants every day for infrastructure code, pipelines and reviews, share what works, and measure the result in hours saved, failure rate, lead time and cost. 
 - Evaluate, prototype and introduce new technologies that improve automation, scalability and operational efficiency. 
 - Mentor and train DevOps and software engineers on best practices and emerging technologies, including AI-assisted engineering. 
 - Participate in occasional after-hours support, for example planned change windows, when required. . 

Have You Got What It Takes?

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Business Information Systems or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - 7+ years in DevOps, SRE or platform engineering within software development organizations, including 4+ years running production workloads on AWS. 
 - 3+ years building and managing Docker containers and containerized microservices. 
 - Strong Linux administration and troubleshooting, and proficiency in Python and Bash or Shell; a second object-oriented language, preferably Java. 
 - Hands-on AWS experience: EC2, S3, CloudWatch, Lambda, Kinesis, RDS and CloudFormation or CDK. 
 - Jenkins at administrator level (Groovy and shared libraries) and GitHub Actions; experience building, operating and securing CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Kubernetes and EKS in production, including version upgrades and add-on management. 
 - Infrastructure automation and configuration management with tools such as CloudFormation, CDK, Terraform, Chef, Puppet or Ansible. 
 - Hands-on AI engineering for DevOps: daily use of LLM coding agents (such as Claude Code) and at least one tool, agent or automation you built, with the result it delivered. 
 - Working knowledge of how LLM agents connect to systems (tool calling, MCP, prompt and context design) and of their risks: hallucination, prompt injection and data leakage. 
 - Strong understanding of DevOps, continuous delivery and automation best practices, and of cloud security basics: IAM least privilege, secrets management and audit-ready changes. 
 - Self-driven, able to manage tasks and meet deadlines in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment. 
 - Strong communication skills in English and the ability to collaborate with global groups. 

Core Technical Skills

- AWS cloud services
 - Jenkins, Groovy and GitHub Actions
 - Kubernetes and EKS
 - Infrastructure as code (CloudFormation, CDK)
 - Linux administration
 - Microservices and Docker
 - AI-assisted automation and agentic workflows
 - Production operations

Nice to Have

- Building agentic workflows with AWS Bedrock or the Anthropic API, developing MCP servers, retrieval over runbooks and wikis, and evaluating agent output. 
 - AIOps experience: log and alert summarization, automated root-cause hints, or AI-assisted change-risk checks. 
 - Guardrails for AI in regulated settings: data classification, secrets handling, human approval and audit logs (FedRAMP or similar). 
 - Experience with Docker, Kubernetes and Puppet or Ansible at scale. 
 - FinOps practice: right-sizing and automated shutdown of unused environments. 
 - Automated regression testing (for example Playwright) inside pipelines. 
 - Pipeline template libraries and internal developer platform or golden-path work. 
 - AWS certifications (Solutions Architect or DevOps Professional) or CKA. 

How We Work

- Hours: Pune working hours with overlap with Israel from morning to evening and with US mornings. Planned change windows may fall outside standard hours. 
 - Support: a shared rota for DevOps support and change execution with the NOC and colleagues in Israel and the US. No one carries it alone. 
 - Product groups: the group supports several product pods, and you will be the named DevOps contact for some of them, joining their planning and reviews. 
 - Tools: Jira, Confluence, ServiceNow, Jenkins, GitHub, Grafana, AWS, Microsoft Teams, and company-approved AI assistants. 

What's in it for you?

- Join an ever-growing, market disrupting, global company where the teams - comprised of the best of the best - work in a fast-paced, collaborative, and creative environment! As the market leader, every day at NiCE is a chance to learn and grow, and there are endless internal career opportunities across multiple roles, disciplines, domains, and locations. If you are passionate, innovative, and excited to constantly raise the bar, you may just be our next NiCEr!

Enjoy NiCE-FLEX!

- At NiCE, we work according to the NiCE-FLEX hybrid model, which enables maximum flexibility: 2 days working from the office and 3 days of remote work, each week. Naturally, office days focus on face-to-face meetings, where teamwork and collaborative thinking generate innovation, new ideas, and a vibrant, interactive atmosphere. 

About NICE

- NICE Ltd. (NASDAQ: NICE) is an innovation leader in AI, cloud, and digital solutions, serving over 25, 000 global businesses, including 85 of the Fortune 100 corporations. With over 8, 500 employees across 30+ countries, NICE software handles more than 120 million customer interactions and monitors over 3 billion financial transactions daily. NICE is committed to diversity and inclusion, ensuring equal opportunities for all candidates. 

Requisition ID: 12040

Reports to: Group Lead, DevOps

Role type: Individual contributor

About NiCE

NICE Ltd. (NASDAQ: NICE) software products are used by 25, 000+ global businesses, including 85 of the Fortune 100 corporations, to deliver extraordinary customer experiences, fight financial crime and ensure public safety. Every day, NiCE software manages more than 120 million customer interactions and monitors 3+ billion financial transactions. 

Known as an innovation powerhouse that excels in AI, cloud and digital, NiCE is consistently recognized as the market leader in its domains, with over 8, 500 employees across 30+ countries. 

NiCE is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, neurotype, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation or any other category protected by law.

data.title: Staff Engineer – AI in Embedded Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC)
data.description:
Location: Pune, India

About GF

GlobalFoundries (GF) is a leading manufacturer of essential semiconductors, enabling AI at scale from the cloud to the physical world. Through deep partnerships with customers, GF delivers differentiated, power-efficient and high-performance solutions for high-growth markets. With global manufacturing operations across the U. S. , Europe and Asia, GF is a trusted technology partner for customers around the world. GF's talented global team remains focused every day on security, longevity, and sustainability. For more information, visit www. gf. com. 

Introduction

GlobalFoundries is seeking a highly motivated Staff Engineer to lead the adoption of Artificial Intelligence across the embedded software development lifecycle. This role combines deep expertise in embedded systems with practical experience applying Large Language Models (LLMs), Small Language Models (SLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and AI-powered automation to accelerate software development, validation, and product delivery. 

The successful candidate will serve as a technical leader driving the integration of AI-enabled workflows across platform software, firmware, test, and validation teams. This position requires strong hands-on experience in embedded software development, AI/ML technologies, and engineering productivity tooling, enabling the transformation of how software is designed, implemented, tested, documented, and maintained. 

Your Job

- Define and drive the technical strategy for AI adoption across the embedded software development lifecycle, including requirements, design, coding, testing, validation, documentation, and release activities. 
 - Develop AI-powered solutions that generate embedded software components such as low-level drivers, hardware abstraction layers (HALs), BSP integrations, register-access layers, and validation utilities from specifications and hardware documentation. 
 - Design and deploy Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems utilizing source code, technical documentation, silicon specifications, issue-tracking systems, and historical validation data. 
 - Build and fine-tune Small Language Models (SLMs) and LLM-based solutions for embedded software generation, test automation, defect triage, and engineering productivity enhancement. 
 - Develop automated pipelines that convert requirements and design specifications into executable embedded test cases, validation frameworks, and simulation scripts. 
 - Create AI-based solutions for post-silicon validation, including log analysis, anomaly detection, failure clustering, regression triage, and root-cause assistance. 
 - Integrate AI-enabled tooling into engineering workflows, source control systems, code review processes, IDEs, CI/CD environments, and validation frameworks. 
 - Establish model evaluation methodologies and quality metrics focused on correctness, code quality, coverage improvements, build success rates, productivity gains, and developer adoption. 
 - Define governance, traceability, security, IP protection, and compliance controls for AI-generated software artifacts in safety-critical development environments. 
 - Provide technical leadership, mentorship, and AI enablement across software, architecture, validation, and platform engineering teams. 

Other Responsibilities

- Perform all activities in a safe and responsible manner and support all Environmental, Health, Safety & Security requirements and programs. 
 - Support engineering excellence through collaboration, knowledge sharing, and continuous process improvements. 
 - Maintain compliance with company quality standards, development processes, and product security requirements. 

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, or a related technical discipline. 
 - Minimum 4 to 8 years of industry experience in embedded software development, firmware engineering, platform software, or related fields. 
 - Strong proficiency in C/C++ and Python. 
 - Hands-on experience developing embedded software for microcontrollers, microprocessors, automotive systems, or embedded Linux platforms. 
 - Strong understanding of RTOS concepts including scheduling, interrupts, synchronization mechanisms, memory management, and low-level driver development. 
 - Experience with protocols and interfaces such as CAN, LIN, SPI, I2C, UART, Ethernet, or related embedded communication technologies. 
 - Practical experience with AI/ML frameworks including PyTorch, Hugging Face, LangChain, LlamaIndex, Haystack, or equivalent technologies. 
 - Experience developing and deploying RAG architectures, vector databases, embeddings, semantic search, and knowledge retrieval systems. 
 - Proven expertise in model fine-tuning techniques such as LoRA and QLoRA. 
 - Experience integrating AI solutions into software engineering workflows, developer tools, CI/CD pipelines, and automated validation environments. 
 - Knowledge of model serving, optimization, quantization, and deployment in on-premises environments. 
 - Experience with embedded testing, silicon bring-up, HIL validation, system debugging, and hardware/software integration. 
 - Ability to work effectively across distributed global engineering teams. 
 - Ability to travel up to 10% as required. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Master's or Ph. D. degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Electrical Engineering, or related field. 
 - Experience with RISC-V processor architectures, toolchains, and ecosystem development. 
 - Knowledge of AUTOSAR, safety-critical systems, and functional safety standards including ISO 26262. 
 - Experience developing IDE plugins, engineering productivity tools, or software developer platforms. 
 - Experience with MLOps infrastructure, GPU-based training and inference environments, and enterprise AI deployments. 
 - Exposure to static code analysis, compiler technologies, program analysis, or code intelligence platforms. 
 - Expertise in AI governance, security, model evaluation, traceability, and responsible AI practices. 
 - Experience publishing research, contributing to open-source projects, or providing technical thought leadership in AI-assisted engineering. 
 - Experience working with semiconductor product development, post-silicon validation, or firmware platform teams. 

GlobalFoundries Equal Opportunity Statement

GlobalFoundries is an equal opportunity employer, cultivating a diverse and inclusive workforce. We believe having a multicultural workplace enhances productivity, efficiency and innovation whilst our employees feel truly respected, valued and heard. As an affirmative employer, all qualified applicants are considered for employment regardless of age, ethnicity, marital status, citizenship, race, religion, political affiliation, gender, sexual orientation and medical and/or physical abilities. All offers of employment with GlobalFoundries are conditioned upon the successful completion of background checks, medical screenings as applicable and subject to the respective local laws and regulations. 

No Recruitment Fee Policy

GlobalFoundries is committed to ethical and transparent hiring practices. Candidates will not be charged any fees at any stage of the recruitment process. Any request for payment related to a GlobalFoundries employment opportunity is unauthorized and should be reported immediately. All legitimate recruitment communications are conducted exclusively through official GlobalFoundries channels. To report concerns or suspected recruitment fraud, please contact the Ethics & Compliance Office at global. compliance@globalfoundries. com. The Ethics & Compliance mailbox is not a recruitment channel. CVs/resumes submitted to this mailbox will not be reviewed, processed, or considered for employment opportunities. Please apply through the official GlobalFoundries careers site only. 

Information about our benefits you can find here: https: //gf. com/about-us/careers/opportunities-asia

The driving force behind our success has always been the people of AspenTech. The Role

The driving force behind our success has always been the people of AspenTech. Founded more than 30 years ago by the best and brightest engineers at MIT, we continue to tackle the most complex challenges in process manufacturing. Our aspenONE software enables our customers to achieve operational excellence by increasing capacity, improving margins, and reducing costs, while becoming more energy efficient, ensuring safety, and shrinking their carbon footprint. This is a place where people are fiercely passionate about technology and have a desire to make a difference through the application of engineering and software technologies to solve real business problems. As a Software Developer with focus on software packaging and deployment, you will build and maintain software deployment solutions for our aspenONE software and push the deployment technology to make it easier for our customers to adopt our latest technologies. Based in our Pune, India office you will collaborate closely with other members of geographically dispersed Products teams, coordinating closely with colleagues focused on delighting customers via delivering robust products. 

Your Impact

We are seeking an experienced Installation Developer with 7-12 years of software development experience and strong expertise in Windows and/or Linux environments to design, develop, and maintain reliable software installation and deployment solutions. 

The ideal candidate will have strong knowledge of installation technologies, demonstrated programming and scripting skills, and experience working collaboratively in an Agile development environment. The candidate should also be able to effectively leverage AI-assisted development tools to improve productivity, accelerate troubleshooting and development, enhance testing and documentation, and deliver high-quality software solutions while applying appropriate engineering judgment to validate AI-generated code and recommendations. 

- Design, develop, test, and maintain installation packages and deployment solutions for Windows and Linux platforms.

data.title: Senior Software Engineer- Cloud Infrastructure, Kubernetes, Golang/Python
data.description:
About The Job

The Red Hat Engineering team is looking for a talented and versatile Senior Software Engineer. 

Our mission is to deliver a next generation platform for building, testing and releasing artifacts to deliver Red Hat products and services using open hybrid cloud technologies while focusing on innovation and security. 

In this role, you will be instrumental in developing the next-gen productization pipeline, optimizing our systems, and ensuring a seamless user experience in a fast-paced, evolving environment. 

This position requires a proactive problem solver who is passionate about delivering high-quality solutions and continuously improving our systems. 

You will work with Red Hat's latest open source technologies, such as Kubernetes, Tekton, ArgoCD, Terraform and OpenShift. You will also work closely with Red Hat's leading product development teams, QE, SRE, product management, and other stakeholders worldwide, working with a stable team in an agile environment to deliver services for Red Hat teams and customers. 

What you will do?

- Design, develop, and implement new features based on evolving business requirements. 
 - Collaborate with product managers and stakeholders to understand user needs and translate them into technical solutions. 
 - Investigate, diagnose, and resolve software defects. 
 - Ensure that all code changes maintain or improve system stability and performance. 
 - Assist users by troubleshooting issues and providing technical support when needed. 
 - Gather user feedback and suggest improvements to enhance user experience. 
 - Monitor system performance and implement optimizations to improve efficiency and scalability. 
 - Conduct code reviews and refactor existing code to maintain code quality and performance. 
 - Deploy changes to staging and production environments following established processes and best practices. 
 - Collaborate with DevOps to ensure smooth and reliable operation of software in production. 
 - Stay updated with industry trends and technologies to bring innovative ideas to the team. 
 - Contribute to the improvement of internal processes, tools, and standards. 
 - Work with open source communities such as Tekton and Kubernetes and submitting code in these upstream communities for review
 - Work in a global team, including teams in EMEA, NA, and APAC
 - Work with developers, quality engineers, PMs, SRE and customers
 - Learn about the latest AI tools and how to apply them to solve existing problems

What you will bring?

- Ability to work with new and fast-changing technologies with a high level of uncertainty, reacting to changes in requirements quickly
 - Strong problem-solving skills, with a passion for learning and adapting to new challenges. 
 - Bachelor's degree in Computer science or equivalent working experience
 - At least 5 years of experience writing code in Golang, JAVA, or Python
 - Experience working on shared codebases using source control management (SCM) systems like GitHub or GitLab
 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English and ability to work effectively in a team-oriented environment. 
 - Experience working with Linux as a developer
 - Experience with building & debugging applications on Kubernetes clusters
 - Experience building and running containerized applications and controllers
 - Experience with cloud-based infrastructure (e. g. , AWS) and microservices architecture

The Following Is Considered a Plus

- Experience with IBM cloud
 - Experience in Terraform
 - Experience in Tekton or ArgoCD
 - Experience building CICD pipelines
 - Experience in Observability tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, Splunk
 - Experience in Open Source development
 - Experience defining requirements between application components
 - Experience in DevSecOps or Product Security 
 - Experience with Operator Lifecycle Manager (OLM)

About Red Hat

Red Hat is the world's leading provider of enterprise open source software solutions, using a community-powered approach to deliver high-performing Linux, cloud, container, and Kubernetes technologies. A scale‐up that has spent the last two years making advanced legal reasoning accessible through natural language. High autonomy: You'll own end‐to‐end QA of the product-while collaborating closely with your teammates. 

Broad technical exposure: Contribute across End-to-end QA - with a combination of manual and automation testing using Playwright, performance testing and being the last line of defense against any bugs slipping into production. Collaborative environment: Join a small, high‐trust team where your work is visible and valued. You'll work directly with the Head of Engineering and other engineers to ship features on time and to a high standard. 

Responsibilities

Manual Testing of new features including legal research casebase search, agentic workflows, practice management tools and Word integrations. 

Automation Framework setup from scratch based on Playwright framework with JS/TS along with a reliable CI-CD for continuous testing.

Experience testing RAG based AI systems. 

Competence with Automation test execution in CI-CD Pipelines. 

Ability to use AI effectively in product testing process.

Experience testing legal knowledge systems or search engines.

data.description:
To make electronics, you need chips, wafers, transistors, reticles, and. . . To make these, you must see, test and manufacture them at scale-faster and better than ever before. That's where KLA comes in. Whether you're early in your career or an experienced professional, you'll solve complex challenges, work alongside brilliant minds and help shape the future of technology. 

Group/Division

The Semiconductor Products and Customers (Semi PC) business unit designs, builds and sells KLA's product portfolio to help chip manufacturers meet high-quality standards for technologies like AI, data centers, automotive and electronic devices. Our inspection, metrology, and analytics systems detect and monitor defects across logic and memory chips, specialty semiconductors, wafers, reticles, advanced packaging, process equipment and materials. We also develop technologies for specialty processes, IC substrates, and PCB manufacturing, including etch and deposition, component inspection, and imaging and analytics. The e-Beam division plays a critical role in KLA's inspection ecosystem, with tools that deliver high-resolution, timely insights into defects and critical locations on the wafer. Used alongside KLA's patterned and bare wafer inspectors, e-Beam systems help our customers quickly identify and understand yield-impacting issues-enabling faster, more effective actions to correct the manufacturing process. 

What You'll Do

In this role, you will play a key part in advancing business priorities by delivering high-impact work across your area of expertise. 

Preferred to have a graduate or pos-graduate degree in Engineering/Science. 

The selected Software QA Engineer will join a world-class software team to plan, manage, execute, and report results for all qualification activities for the PoR/team. He/She will be trained to be an effective team player and leader that will be responsible for the quality of all released products. He/She will be a strong process advocate with an acute attention to detail and desire to continually improve the Qualification process. He/She must be able to partner with other functional teams to resolve quality issues quickly. 

Key Responsibilities Include: 

- Play role of full stack test engineer for software of KLA Products
 - Qualification of new and existing products and features (functional/requirements based, regression, performance, reliability). This includes designing and qualifying, publishing results and recommendations in the form of training material, best known methods
 - Ability to understand and develop test cases for products that use Deep Learning or machine learning Algorithms. 
 - Ability to technically interact with Algorithms, System Engineering, Application Engineering, Marketing and Manufacturing, Customer Support team for various requirements across the globe. Interact with cross locational teams. 
 - Automate the test cases and make them part of the CI pipeline for automatic execution

Travel to customer fabrication and MFG facilities to understand the system and its sub-systems, customer use cases, for deploying SW and troubleshooting. 

Minimum Qualifications

Master's Level Degree or work experience of 0-2 years , Bachelor's Level Degree or work experience of 1-3 years

We provide advanced inspection tools, metrology systems, process solutions, and computational analytics that make electronics possible, tackling complex challenges.  - You will be client-facing, responsible for the delivery of our work and making sure it meets our client's'expectations.

 - Produce design drawings & documentation for Front End Engineering Design (FEED) such as Protection Single Line Diagram (or) Key Line Diagram (KLD), Work Specification, Assessment of requirement for Auxiliary Systems etc. 
 - Complete Detailed Design Deliverables - Circuit Diagrams, Wiring Diagrams, Cable Schedules, Cable Block Diagrams, General Arrangement Diagrams, Termination Schedules etc. 
 - Interface substation auxiliary systems and other equipment with Protection & Control Systems
 - Complete design calculations - LVAC & DC System Sizing, CT & VT adequacy checks, Cable Sizing etc. 
 - You could also be working on Fault Current Calculations, Relay Settings and IED Configuration based on the skill set and project requirements. 
 - Report Writing Skills. 
 - Preparation of bid documents and bid evaluations. 
 - Ensure interdisciplinary coordination. 
 - Contribute to Tendering activities by supporting with preliminary design documentation & drawings, Bill of Quantities, Engineering Man Hour Estimates etc. 
 - Lead P&C design on a project and engage with junior engineers & graduate engineers. 
 - Mentoring other engineers and help them become better engineers. 
 - Manage the team and actively involve in finding the requirements of engineers and find ways to fulfil. 
 - Provide engineering support and solve queries during construction, testing and commissioning, attend site meetings and inspections. 

About You

Qualification

- Graduate/Post-Graduate degree in Electrical Engineering with around 15+ years of experience in Design of Protection & Control Systems. 
 - Hands-on Experience in design of protection systems applied to Busbars, Feeders, Transformers, Reactors, Bus Section, Bus Couplers, Reactors etc. on the 132kV and above systems. 
 - Appreciation for the principles of Current & Voltage Transformers, Auto Reclose, Circuit Breaker Fail & Plant Auto Switching arrangements.

Your Role at a Glance

The Manager, Digital Systems, India is responsible for the day-to-day leadership, coordination, staffing, and development of Digital Systems resources located in India. The Talents We're Seeking

Education & Experience

Location Name: Pune Corporate Office - Mantri

Job Purpose

The Senior Software Engineer / Software Delivery Manager (SDM) (Salesforce) role exists in driving the development, integration, administration, and support of our Salesforce Wheels org and associated applications in scope of the respective POD. The candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, testing, and deploying scalable solutions, code reviews, and team handling on Salesforce to support business processes and requirements. 

The position is vital for ensuring system reliability, enabling effective business processes for loan origination and underwriting, supporting multiple business teams, and delivering strategic technology projects to help Bajaj Finance achieve its business goals efficiently. 

Duties And Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities: 

- Lead the design, development, customization, and integration of Salesforce CRM and allied business-critical applications, including loan origination and underwriting systems, to achieve desired functionality and efficiency for business operations. 
 - Ensure the stability, availability, and optimal performance of the Salesforce platform by proactively monitoring system health, troubleshooting issues, and minimizing potential business disruptions. 
 - Coordinate effectively with internal cross-functional teams and external partners to drive the timely completion of project milestones, oversee change management processes, and ensure all deliverables align with organizational standards. 
 - Pull requests and code review of junior developers' team who are responsible for delivery. 
 - Provide advanced technical support (Tier 2 and Tier 3), handle incident management, and implement permanent resolutions for recurring issues to enhance the end-user experience. 
 - Maintain comprehensive and up-to-date documentation, including support processes, user guides, training materials, and knowledge base articles, to aid user enablement and knowledge transfer. 
 - Oversee and implement system integrations between Salesforce and other business-critical systems using industry-standard APIs (SOAP/REST), thus supporting data integrity and seamless process flows. 
 - Participate in full software development lifecycle (SDLC) including requirement gathering, solution design, development, testing, deployment, and support. 
 - Uphold governance by tracking delivery schedules, managing change processes, and providing regular status reports to relevant stakeholders. 

Key Decisions / Dimensions

- Selection of appropriate technical approaches and programming methodologies (including choice of Java/Apex patterns, integration strategies, and API usage) for developing and enhancing Salesforce and related business applications. 
 - Prioritization and scheduling of development tasks, support activities, and incident resolution to ensure alignment with project timelines and business priorities. 
 - Evaluation and implementation of integration techniques to connect Salesforce with other platforms (e. g. , Portals, EDW, mobile applications) while ensuring data consistency and system reliability. 
 - Identification and application of best practices for change management, version control, and deployment within the Salesforce ecosystem, in alignment with DevOps and ITIL principles. 
 - Determination of root cause solutions for recurring system issues, including whether to implement temporary workarounds or permanent fixes, while balancing risk and impact. 
 - Decisions regarding escalation or resolution of complex incidents and service requests, including coordination with cross-functional teams and external partners as appropriate. 
 - Selection and preparation of documentation, training materials, and user guides to maximize knowledge transfer and facilitate user adoption. 
 - Assessment of technological advancements and recommendations for adoption of relevant new tools, frameworks, or practices to support ongoing platform improvements. 
 - Decide how tech components can be reused across different functions to minimize development effort|
 - Direct Reports/Supervision (if applicable): [5-7 junior engineers/administrators] depending on POD size
 - Change Requests/Feature Deployments per month: 110-150 Man-days or 5-7 Man-months

Major Challenges

- Ensuring seamless integration of Salesforce CRM with diverse external and internal systems (such as portals, enterprise data warehouses, and mobile applications) while maintaining data integrity and system performance. 
 - Managing platform enhancements and multiple ongoing projects simultaneously, including the definition, execution, and timely delivery of project milestones within stringent deadlines. 
 - Addressing complex technical issues and resolving recurring incidents quickly to minimize downtime and maintain business continuity in a fast-paced financial services environment. 
 - Balancing the need for rapid delivery of new features and enhancements with stringent quality standards and regulatory compliance requirements. 
 - Coordinating effectively with cross-functional teams and external partners to align IT initiatives with evolving business requirements, while managing stakeholder expectations. 
 - Maintaining comprehensive documentation and knowledge bases despite frequent changes and updates in business processes and technology. 
 - Adapting to advancements in Salesforce technology, system integrations, and DevOps practices, and ensuring continuous skill development for sustained platform excellence. 
 - Salesforce releases updates three times a year (Winter, Spring, Summer), often introducing new features, changes, and deprecations -Need to be updated and work with business on translating broad problem statements to tangible deliverables. 

Required Qualifications And Experience

- Qualifications

Bachelor's / master's degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related field. Experience in Manual and Automation Testing. 

- Work Experience

4+ years of experience in a Salesforce Admin/Developer role within a technology or IT organization. 

Preferred Salesforce certifications: Salesforce Certified administrator, Salesforce Certified Platform Developer I & II. 

Skills and Knowledge

- Strong proficiency in Apex programming languages, with hands-on experience in object-oriented programming and development on the Salesforce platform. Visualforce, Apex Classes/Controllers, Apex Triggers, SOQL, Lightning Web Components, Process Builder, Flow, Salesforce1, App Cloud, Communities, and AppExchange/ISV solutions. 
 - In-depth understanding of Salesforce architecture, including configuration, customization, workflows, and security models. 
 - Practical experience with Salesforce APIs (SOAP/RESTful) for system integrations with internal and external platforms such as portals, data warehouses, and mobile applications. 
 - Demonstrated capability in project management: defining milestones, managing delivery schedules, monitoring progress, and facilitating status reporting with a team. 
 - Proficient in Salesforce administration, platform health monitoring, incident management, and providing Tier 2 and Tier 3 technical support. 
 - Strong analytical and diagnostic skills for troubleshooting system issues, performing root cause analysis, and implementing permanent resolutions. 
 - Ability to document technical solutions, support processes, and create training materials and user guides for varied stakeholders. 
 - Sound understanding of the loan business lifecycle, financial processes, and the operational requirements of a financial services organization. (Good to have)
 - Basic knowledge of database systems and data management principles.

data.title: Principal AI/ML Architect
data.description:
What you will do: 

● Set enterprise AI architecture and technical direction: Own the end-to-end

architecture for complex GenAI, agentic AI, and ML platforms. Define reference

architectures, reusable patterns, engineering guardrails, and technology choices

across engagements. 

● Build at the frontier - hands-on: Stay close to the code on the highest-leverage

technical work, including foundation-model and embedding fine-tuning, 

advanced RAG, semantic search, evaluation harnesses, and novel agentic

workflows using Python and Google Cloud Vertex AI. 

● Engineer AI for production: Design for latency, reliability, security, cost, 

scalability, and maintainability from day one. Apply disciplined MLOps and

LLMOps practices so systems are versioned, evaluated, monitored, deployed, 

and continuously improved. 

● Architect agentic systems at scale: Design and operate multi-step reasoning and

multi-agent workflows using ADK, LangChain, MCP, and custom agent

frameworks, with robust orchestration, state management, tool use, memory, 

human oversight, failure isolation, and verification controls. 

● Establish evaluation, observability, and responsible AI standards: Define

measurable quality criteria and production telemetry for accuracy, 

groundedness, safety, drift, latency, and cost. Embed privacy, security, 

governance, and responsible AI throughout the lifecycle. 

● Shape data and retrieval architectures: Design production-scale retrieval and

knowledge systems spanning data ingestion, chunking, metadata, embeddings, 

vector and hybrid search, re-ranking, provenance, permissions, and continuous

content refresh. 

● Advise clients and shape opportunities: Partner with client executives and

engineering leaders to translate business strategy into AI roadmaps and solution

architectures. Lead discovery, technical workshops, estimates, trade-off

discussions, and pre-sales solutioning. 

● Multiply engineering capability: Raise the technical bar through architecture

reviews, design documents, code reviews, mentoring, reusable accelerators, and

clear standards that help senior and mid-level engineers deliver with greater

confidence. 

● Own outcomes across the full lifecycle: Guide initiatives from problem framing

and experimentation through production rollout, operational readiness, 

adoption, and measurable business value. Surface risks early and drive decisions

to resolution. 

Your technical toolkit: 

● Languages and software engineering: Expert-level Python; strong shell scripting

API and service design; clean, tested, maintainable code; distributed-system

fundamentals; and full SDLC ownership. 

● Models and AI ecosystem: Deep, current expertise with Google Gemini, GPT-class

models, LLaMA and other open models; advanced prompt engineering; 

structured outputs; model selection; fine-tuning; and rigorous evaluation. 

● Agentic AI engineering: Hands-on production experience with Google Agent

Development Kit (ADK), LangChain, custom agent frameworks, tool use, Model

Context Protocol (MCP), workflow orchestration, planning, memory, state, 

guardrails, human-in-the-loop controls, and multi-agent design. 

● Retrieval and search: Advanced RAG, hybrid and semantic search, embeddings, 

re-ranking, and vector platforms such as Vertex AI Vector Search, pgvector, 

Pinecone, or equivalent technologies. 

● Cloud infrastructure and AI systems: End-to-end experience architecting highly

available, scalable AI and software environments across Google Cloud / Vertex AI, 

AWS, and Azure, including model serving, data integration, IAM, networking, 

security, observability, and cost management. 

● Frameworks: Strong command of LangChain, LlamaIndex, or equivalent

orchestration layers - together with the judgment to use simpler, more

maintainable patterns when appropriate. 

● MLOps and LLMOps: CI/CD, model and prompt versioning, experiment tracking, 

automated evaluation, observability, model monitoring, drift detection, rollback, 

and production incident response. 

● Data and ML foundations: Strong SQL and data engineering; classical machine

learning; neural networks; training, tuning, and inference; and the ability to

connect data quality to model and product outcomes.

 - Design and implement scalable cloud-native platforms using AWS, Kubernetes, and modern DevOps practices. 
 - Lead platform modernization initiatives focused on automation, self-service capabilities, and developer productivity. 
 - Architect and govern AWS EKS-based container platforms and cloud infrastructure solutions.

 - Design and implement secure, highly available, and resilient cloud platforms. 
 - Define operational standards for reliability, scalability, observability, governance, and compliance. 
 - Lead DevSecOps initiatives and ensure security is embedded throughout the software delivery lifecycle. 
 - Collaborate with customer stakeholders to define technology roadmaps and architecture strategies. 
 - Conduct architecture reviews, solution assessments, and technology governance activities. 
 - Drive cloud cost optimization, capacity management, and performance improvement initiatives. 
 - Build reusable platform accelerators, templates, and automation solutions. 
 - Mentor engineering teams and promote engineering excellence across the organization.

The individual would also lead efforts in planning, execution of all infrastructure needs which would include hardware, Servers & Tools required for efficient execution of Projects delivered by the team at MEIC. The individual must inspire, coach and mentor Associate Directors, Managers, Sr Pr/ Principal Software Engineers, Technical Leads and Engineers with diverse skills sets and technologies. This individual must lead the product innovation & champion industry best practices by applying an array of technologies, tools, and standards throughout the SW support that MEIC provides across the Surgical Robotics Team and Functional Partnerships in various stages of Product Development, RPE and support as required to ensure superior performance and value delivery. 

The ideal candidate is a technology expert as well as a critical thinker who would collaborate across the disciplines - product design, software architecture and development, software engineering process, operational performance, and customer support. The individual must be able build strong relationships across the matrix. The individual must be a self-starter and should be able to strongly influence the design of new products, processes, standards, or operational plans. The individual must improve the existing processes and systems using significant conceptualizing, reasoning and interpretation. The individual must interact with internal and external customers and vendors at various levels, including executive leadership, on significant matters.

- Agile software product development experience

Position: Senior Software Engineer II (SSE 2) - Backend Platform & Data System

Position Overview

We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer II (SSE 2) to join our Core Platform team. In this role, you will design, architect, and optimize the high-throughput real-time data pipelines, advanced polyglot storage layers, and core backend orchestration microservices that power our enterprise AI/ML Platform. 

This role is heavily focused on advanced backend software engineering and highly concurrent distributed systems. You will build the foundational software layer that enables our platform to interact dynamically with massive streaming datasets. Using a mix of Golang and Python, you will orchestrate real-time data streams through Kafka and Apache Spark, and design highly resilient distributed data layers utilizing Apache Cassandra alongside PostgreSQL. As a senior leader, you will champion modern development workflows, utilizing AI coding assistants to optimize engineering velocity across the team. You will scale these capabilities across Amazon EKS (Kubernetes) and AWS cloud infrastructure. 

Key Responsibilities

- Backend Architecture: Design, build, and optimize high-concurrency production-grade architectures and runtime engines using Golang and Python. 
 - Advanced Engineering Workflows: Lead by example in utilizing advanced AI coding interfaces to accelerate code generation, framework migrations, system debugging, and documentation standards. 
 - Polyglot Storage & System Design: 
 - Architect and optimize highly available Apache Cassandra data models, managing partition keys and CQL queries to ingest massive streaming execution logs. 
 - Design robust relational schemas, query tuning, and index optimizations in PostgreSQL to handle transactional states and analytical metadata. 
 - Streaming & Event Orchestration: Architect resilient data streaming architectures utilizing Apache Kafka for event sourcing, alongside Apache Spark for high-velocity real-time and batch data processing pipelines. 
 - Technical Leadership & Quality Control: Drive architectural reviews, establish engineering standards for platform reliability, enforce CI/CD, and mentor junior-to-mid-level engineers on scaling distributed data layers. 

Required Technical Skills & Experience

- AI Tooling (Must Have): Direct, deep hands-on experience integrating AI-powered development environments and LLM assistants (e. g. , Cursor, Claude, GitHub Copilot) into your workflow to significantly accelerate systems engineering and debugging tasks. 
 - Programming Languages: Advanced proficiency in Golang (Go) for writing highly concurrent, memory-efficient systems, and strong production experience in Python. 
 - Data Stream Technologies: Production experience implementing and managing enterprise-scale Apache Kafka topologies and distributed processing frameworks like Apache Spark. 
 - Database Management (NoSQL & Relational): Deep understanding of distributed storage trade-offs (CAP theorem) with advanced hands-on experience in Apache Cassandra and PostgreSQL. 
 - Containerization & Orchestration: Production-level experience with Docker and multi-cluster orchestration via Kubernetes / AWS EKS. 

Qualifications

- Professional Experience: 6 to 8+ years of non-internship professional backend software engineering experience. 
 - Data & Systems Background: 3+ years of experience specifically focused on distributed systems, real-time data streaming pipelines, polyglot storage design, or platform engineering for data-intensive applications. 
 - Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Distributed Systems, Software Engineering, or a highly technical related domain

 - Investigate emerging technologies, frameworks, and alternative technical approaches; contribute inputs for architectural reviews and technology evaluations. 
 - Leverage AI/GenAI tools for code generation, unit test creation, refactoring, debugging, documentation, impact analysis, and onboarding to unfamiliar codebases; evaluate AI-generated outputs for correctness, security, performance, maintainability, and architectural alignment. 

What You'll Bring

- B. Tech/M. Tech degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field with 8-10 years of hands-on software design and development experience. 
 - Strong expertise in designing and developing applications using C#/. NET; strong understanding of object-oriented analysis, design principles, SOLID principles, and common design patterns. 
 - Strong hands-on experience designing and developing enterprise-grade applications using Angular, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML5, and CSS. 
 - Deep understanding of Angular architecture, component lifecycle, reusable UI component design, routing, reactive forms, RxJS, state management, and front-end performance optimization. 
 - Experience designing and developing Web APIs and/or microservices using . NET or Node. js, with good understanding of API design, security, scalability, and integration practices. 
 - Experience working with relational and non-relational databases, ORM technologies, data modelling, and performance tuning. 
 - Familiarity with container concepts and toolsets such as Docker, with Kubernetes exposure preferred. 
 - Strong experience using Git-based version control systems with modern branching strategies and development workflows. 
 - Good understanding of cloud-based platforms, distributed systems, and modern engineering paradigms. 
 - Experience leading technical initiatives and influencing engineering decisions within Agile teams; ability to guide engineers and strengthen engineering practices across teams. 

What's In It for You

- Become a valuable member of a highly professional and international team of software engineering and quality engineering experts. 
 - Work on challenging engineering problems for a global multinational company using modern technologies and engineering practices. 
 - Contribute to end-to-end product development across architecture, software design, front-end and back-end engineering, system integration, CI/CD, and release readiness. 
 - Operate with ownership and accountability in your responsible area while collaborating with global product and engineering teams. 
 - Build your career in a dynamic environment with excellent opportunities to develop yourself to higher levels and broaden your technical knowledge. 
 - Benefit from a clearly defined career development track for every individual employee. 
 - Be part of a performance-driven culture where strong contribution and impact are recognized and rewarded. 
 - Grow within an organization where a large percentage of senior and leadership positions are filled internally. 

Why Hilti

Hilti is a global leader in construction innovation, with more than 34, 000 team members across 120 countries. Guided by our purpose, Making Construction Better, we're driven to keep learning, growing, and finding new ways to make a lasting impact. Here, you'll be empowered to use your strengths, work with a global and inclusive team, and take on meaningful challenges. At Hilti, you'll have the chance to make your ideas, achievements, and growth real through purpose, passion, and teamwork. 

Commitment to Inclusion

At Hilti, inclusion is a key focus in how we work, lead, and grow together. We are committed to embracing diversity of thought and creating an environment that is inclusive of everyone, everywhere. We continuously strive to ensure every voice is valued and every team member feels empowered to contribute. By building on this foundation, we strengthen our teams, our innovation, and our impact, making construction better together.

data.title: Software Engineer III
data.description:
About Team: 

RX Global aims to create unforgettable experiences for attendees and exhibitors through organizing events. Innovation, creativity, and collaboration drive the company to offer exceptional services to clients. 

About the role: 

A Software Engineer III is an individual contributor who delivers production-quality software for well-defined components or features within a product or service. They work with guidance from senior engineers to translate requirements into maintainable, secure, and reliable systems that support customer and business outcomes. They are developing deeper knowledge of the systems within their team and contribute to engineering quality, operational health, and team collaboration while continuing to build their technical expertise. 

Requirements

Qualifications & Experience

- Typically 3+ years of professional software engineering experience
 - Demonstrated ability to learn quickly and contribute to production software systems
 - Experience working in Agile cross-functional product development teams
 - Experience translating ambiguous requirements into scalable solutions
 - Proficiency in one modern backend stack (. NET/C# essential, Java or Node. js) plus familiarity with SQL/data skills
 - Understanding of system design and domain modelling (SOLID, design patterns, API design)
 - Experience writing unit/integration tests and CI/CD experience
 - Cloud and DevOps exposure (preferably AWS), including observability and operational readiness
 - Security-minded approach aligned to Secure SDLC practices

Responsibilities

Technical Excellence

- Produces clear technical documentation using the process for technical decision making and RX architectural principles. 
 - Builds software with foundations in performance, resilience, extensibility, and security following the Secure SDLC
 - Applies testing strategies that support deployment confidence and align with the Service & Operational Level Agreements
 - Contributes to incremental improvements to code quality, testing, or development workflows. 
 - Writes clean, maintainable code and participates actively in peer code reviews
 - Learns and applies team standards, design patterns, and engineering practices. 
 - Solves well-defined technical problems with support from more experienced engineers. 
 - Shares knowledge and learns from peers within the team. 

Operational Excellence

- Supports the operational health of services and components within their team. 
 - Uses logs, monitoring, and metrics to help diagnose issues. 
 - Builds systems with operational considerations in mind, including reliability and recoverability. 
 - Participates in incident response and post-incident reviews with guidance. 
 - Maintains runbooks, documentation, and operational knowledge for owned components. 
 - Contributes to reducing technical debt and improving maintainability in assigned areas. 
 - Ensures dependencies and security updates are applied to owned systems. 
 - Operational knowledge and awareness improve over time through hands-on experience. 

Product Delivery & Business Impact

- Implements well-defined requirements into working software features. 
 - Works with senior engineers to break down tasks and deliver incremental improvements. 
 - Delivers high-quality software with predictable cycle times and low change failure rates under guidance. 
 - Collaborates with Product and Engineering to ensure solutions align with user and business outcomes. 
 - Raises delivery risks early and seeks guidance to resolve them. 
 - Contributes to simplifying implementation and improving code maintainability. 
 - Contributions support team delivery goals and product reliability

Leadership & Collaboration

- Takes ownership of components or small features within a product or platform team. 
 - Communicates progress and technical topics clearly within the team. 
 - Seeks feedback and incorporates guidance from senior engineers and technical leads. 
 - Builds strong working relationships within the team and with close cross-team partners. 
 - Demonstrates accountability, curiosity, and a willingness to learn. 
 - Begins mentoring more junior engineers or new team members where appropriate. 

Why join us?

You'll play a key role in shaping robust, scalable platforms while influencing how technology is built at scale, engineering standards and delivery outcomes-working on systems that have measurable impact at scale. If you're excited by leading product teams, shaping technology, and delivering software that matters, we'd love to hear from you. 

Work in a way that works for you

We promote a healthy work/life balance across the organization. We offer an appealing working prospect for our people. With numerous wellbeing initiatives, shared parental leave, study assistance and sabbaticals, we will help you meet your immediate responsibilities and your long-term goals. 

Working for you

We know that your wellbeing and happiness are key to a long and successful career. These are some of the benefits we are delighted to offer: 

Comprehensive Health Insurance: Covers you, your immediate family, and parents. 

Enhanced Health Insurance Options: Competitive rates negotiated by the company. 

Group Life Insurance: Ensuring financial security for your loved ones. 

Group Accident Insurance: Extra protection for accidental death and permanent disablement. 

Flexible Working Arrangement: Achieve a harmonious work-life balance. 

Employee Assistance Program: Access support for personal and work-related challenges. 

Medical Screening: Your well-being is a top priority. 

Modern Family Benefits: Maternity, paternity, and adoption support. 

Long-Service Awards: Recognizing dedication and commitment. 

New Baby Gift: Celebrating the joy of parenthood. 

Subsidized Meals in Chennai: Enjoy delicious meals at discounted rates. 

Various Paid Time Off: Take time off with Casual Leave, Sick Leave, Privilege Leave, Compassionate Leave, Special Sick Leave, and Gazette Public Holidays. 

About Business: 

RX is a global leader in events and exhibitions, leveraging industry expertise, data, and technology to build businesses for individuals, communities, and organizations. With a presence in 25 countries across 41 industry sectors, RX hosts approximately 350 events annually. RX is committed to creating an inclusive work environment for all our people. RX empowers businesses to thrive by leveraging data-driven insights and digital solutions. RX is part of RELX, a global provider of information-based analytics and decision tools for professional and business customers. For more information, visit www. rxglobal. com. 

We know your well-being and happiness are key to a long and successful career. We are delighted to offer country specific benefits. Click here to access benefits specific to your location.

data.title: Sr Engineering Manager
data.description:
Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95, 000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first - developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact. 

A Day in the Life

Responsibilities may include the following and other duties may be assigned. 

- Plans, directs and implements all aspects of the company's design and development of new medical device products or software systems. 
 - May develop, evaluate, implement and maintain technical quality assurance and control systems or reliability systems and standards pertaining to materials, techniques, or company products. 
 - Oversees the investigation and evaluation of existing technologies. 
 - Guides the conceptualization of new methodologies, materials, machines, processes or products. 
 - Directs the development of new concepts from initial design to market release. 
 - Manages feasibility studies of the design to determine if capable of functioning as intended. 
 - Monitors documentation maintenance throughout all phases of research and development. 
 - Organizes the coordination of activities with outside suppliers and consultants to ensure timely delivery. 
 - Selects, develops and evaluates personnel to ensure the efficient operation of the function. 

PEOPLE MANAGEMENT FUNCTIONAL CAREER STREAM: Management and supervisory professionals with one or more employees who are focused on tactical, operational and some strategic activities within a specified area. Levels within the management career stream typically have six or more direct reports. The majority of time is spent overseeing their area of responsibility, managing performance, developing talent, engagement and inclusion, communicating business and operational developments, planning, prioritizing and / or directing the responsibilities of direct reports. Goal achievement is typically accomplished through performance of direct and / or indirect reports. A key responsibility of roles in this career stream is managing people. which includes: accountability for mentoring, developing and coaching staff on meeting/exceeding performance expectations and defined objectives, providing leadership to staff ensuring the prioritization of strategic and department level initiatives to include defining performance goals and targets, conducting performance reviews, and staff 1: 1s to guide performance management and employee development efforts and manage toward departmental goals. 

DIFFERENTIATING FACTORS

Autonomy: Manages large team which would typically consist of both experienced professionals and managers. Turns the department strategy into a commercial reality by developing, communicating and implementing business plans to achieve business results . Receives assignments in objective oriented terms; has latitude to reinterpret objectives. 

Organizational Impact: Initiates programs or projects based on identified business and / or tactical needs. Decisions impact projects or operations, affect the deadlines, resources, and funds, and the achievement of organizational objectives. Typically has budget or P&L accountability for a department, function or geography. 

Innovation and Complexity: Develops new objectives, new operating policies, products, processes and standards in support of the job function strategy. Problems and issues faced are complex, difficult and undefined, and require detailed information gathering, analysis and investigation to understand the problem. 

Communication and Influence: Communicates with internal and external customers and vendors concerning ongoing operations, programs or processes. Influences across functions and businesses while balancing divergent objectives to gain cooperation of other parties . May interact on issues that have externally divergent objectives.

Job Purpose

IT PMO (Partnerships): Own end-to-end solutioning, system architecture, and API-led partner integrations, driving cross-system delivery from requirement discussions to go-live across the BFL. 

Duties And Responsibilities

- Drive end-to-end solutioning for partner integrations, covering JV and co-lending journeys across 4W/TWF flows. 
 - Lead detailed requirement discussions with partner teams, translating into US/UD aligned to BFL partnership framework. 
 - Design and own integration architecture across systems: Partner MW, PMW DB, DL, HMW, BRE, Risk, 3-in-1, 3-in-1 MW, COSMOS, SFDC, Pennant LMS. 
 - Define and govern API flows including Create Application, KFS generation, Cancel, Status, Webhooks, and Additional Info APIs. 
 - Ensure correct mapping of data fields, product configurations, and BRE logic across SFDC and Middleware layers. 
 - Act as solution SPOC, coordinating with API, DB, Middleware, SFDC, BRE, and Data Lake teams for seamless delivery. 
 - Drive partner onboarding, including API specs alignment, CUG/UAT execution, webhook setup, and production readiness. 
 - Manage end-to-end delivery timelines for partners, tracking dependencies like SFDC Convert, API readiness, and partner callbacks.

- Solution Design Across Systems: Defining scalable integration architecture across partners, Partner MW, PMW DB, DL, HMW, BRE, Risk, 3-in-1, 3-in-1 MW, COSMOS, SFDC, Pennant LMS while balancing speed vs reusability. 
 - Managing Changing Requirements: Handling evolving partner/COE requirements and deciding scope freeze vs CR during UAT and delivery phases. 
 - Dependency & Timeline Control: Navigating critical dependencies (SFDC Convert, APIs, partner readiness) and deciding parallel vs sequential execution. 
 - Partner Readiness & Go-Live Calls: Driving partner integration (APIs, webhooks, mapping) and taking go-live decisions despite partial readiness.

Major Challenges

- Complex cross-system delivery & dependencies: Managing integrations across partners, Middleware, DL, 3in1, SFDC, SFDC MW and LMS with evolving requirements, partner readiness gaps, and limited control over external teams.

- Bachelor's degree in Engineering / Technology; MBA preferred. 
 - 3-4 years of experience in IT PMO / Product / Solution roles (preferably BFSI / Fintech).

 - Familiarity with RBI Digital Lending Guidelines (DLG), consent management, and compliance frameworks. 
 - Understanding of Agile methodologies, requirement documentation (US/UD/BRD). 

Work Experience

 - Hands-on involvement in API integrations (Create Application, KFS, Status, Cancel, Webhooks, Additional Info APIs). 
 - Experience in solutioning and system design for co-lending/JV journeys, preferably with BFDL or similar partners. 
 - Working knowledge of SFDC (LOS), Middleware layers (PMW/HMW), and LMS (Pennant). 
 - Exposure to BRE logic, offer generation, and credit decision workflows. 
 - Experience in partner onboarding, API integration testing (CUG/UAT), and go-live execution.

The role is responsible for designing and evolving scalable, modular, reusable, and user-friendly automation architectures that accelerate automation delivery, reduce technical complexity, and improve developer experience. The role will collaborate with automation developers, platform teams, architects, and stakeholders to ensure automation solutions are scalable, secure, maintainable, and aligned with enterprise architecture standards.
