data.description:
Job Title: Subject Matter Expert (SME) - IBMS & Structured Cabling Design (AI Data Centers)

Location: Mumbai

Department: : AI Datacenter Design Engineering & Technical Architecture Tea

Reports To: Head of Design

Position Overview

We are seeking an industry-leading Subject Matter Expert (SME) - Integrated Building Management Systems (IBMS) & Structured Cabling Design to serve as the ultimate technical authority for control automation, monitoring networks, and ultra-high-density fiber optic infrastructure across our AI data center portfolio. 

You will define global design standards for BMS architecture, DCIM integration, environmental/leak monitoring, and high-speed network cabling. This role ensures our building automation systems seamlessly control critical liquid cooling loops while our structured cabling pathways support massive East-West fabric traffic and 100 kW to 150 kW+ per rack AI cluster topologies. 

Key Responsibilities

1. IBMS, Automation & DCIM Architecture

Control System Topology: Design robust BACnet/IP, Modbus, and SNMP control architecture for real-time monitoring and automated feedback loops governing Coolant Distribution Units (CDUs), primary chillers, dry coolers, and high-voltage electrical trains. 

Liquid Cooling Control Integration: Architect high-speed automated control sequences, flow balancing algorithms, dynamic pressure differential monitoring, and emergency shut-off valves for direct-to-chip and immersion liquid cooling systems. 

DCIM & Environmental Monitoring: Lead design and integration of Data Center Infrastructure Management (DCIM) platforms, continuous thermal mapping, dynamic power metering, and high-sensitivity water/chemical leak detection networks. 

2. Structured Cabling & Optical Network Engineering

Ultra-High Density Fiber Design: Architect high-count single-mode and multi-mode optical fiber trunking networks (MPO/MTP connectors, OS2/OM5 fiber) engineered for 400G/800G/1. 6T InfiniBand and Ethernet AI fabrics. 

AI Cluster Connectivity: Design intra-hall and inter-hall cable pathways, Main Distribution Areas (MDA), Horizontal Distribution Areas (HDA), and optical patch fields optimized for ultra-dense GPU rack layouts (100 kW to 150 kW+ per rack). 

Physical Pathway Architecture: Specify overhead and underfloor cable tray systems, optical raceways, fire-stopping penetrations, and pathway segregation protocols to prevent thermal obstruction and signal degradation. 

3. Peer Review, Standards & Compliance

Design Validation: Perform deep-dive peer reviews of low-voltage drawings, IBMS network schematics, software integration logic, and telecommunications cabling layouts developed by MEP design consultants. 

Industry Compliance: Enforce strict adherence to TIA-942, ISO/IEC 11801, BICSI data center standards, and cybersecurity protocols for operational technology (OT) networks. 

Failure Analysis & Escalation: Act as the escalation lead for IBMS network latency failures, sensor calibration errors, optical insertion loss issues, or BMS/DCIM telemetry gaps during commissioning or live operations. 

Qualifications & Requirements

Experience: 12-15+ years in data center low-voltage, automation, and telecommunications engineering, with at least 5+ years as a lead designer/SME for hyperscale facilities. 

Domain Mastery: Technical authority in BMS/DCIM protocols (BACnet, Modbus, SNMP), high-density fiber optronics (MTP/MPO 400G+), liquid cooling control integration, and continuous leak detection. 

AI Workload Focus: Proven track record designing IBMS telemetry and structured cabling for 100 kW to 150 kW+ rack densities and high-density GPU fabric clusters. 

Education & Credentials: Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics & Telecommunications, or Computer Engineering (RCDD or DCDC certification highly preferred). 

Key Skills: OT network architecture, DCIM platform integration, fiber insertion loss budgeting, BMS sequence of operations (SOO) design, and optical pathway routing

data.description:
About the Team: 

Enterprise Systems is the backbone of GSK's internal operations in Digital & Tech, enabling GSK Global Functions teams such as Finance, Procurement, HR, Legal, Compliance, WREF, CGA and Corporate Secretariat to run seamlessly. This team designs and delivers cutting-edge digital platforms that power critical processes, ensuring efficiency, compliance, and scalability across the enterprise.

This team drives financial discipline, operational rigour and strategic alignment across the ES portfolio that safeguard GSK's integrity and reputation globally. By joining this team, you'll help shape systems that support thousands of employees worldwide, driving innovation and reliability in the tools that keep GSK moving forward. 

Job Purpose: 

Integration Engineer provides technical leadership for the design, implementation and lifecycle management of data integrations connecting shop-floor and laboratory systems with site, enterprise and R&D data platforms. The role focuses on ISA-95 (International Society of Automation standard 95) Levels 2, 3 and 5, enabling governed and contextualized data flow from automation and equipment through manufacturing operations systems to enterprise, analytics and scientific environments. 

The role leads integration across Manufacturing, MSAT (Manufacturing Science and Technology), Quality, Laboratory, CMC and R&D use cases, including Factory Integration Layer (FIL) capabilities, industrial connectivity, event-driven integration, canonical data models, Unified Namespace patterns, APIs and secure cloud or edge interfaces. The job holder ensures solutions preserve manufacturing context, genealogy, data integrity and semantic meaning while aligning with approved architecture, cyber security, validation and engineering standards. 

The role coordinates automation, OT, IT, data, cloud, application and scientific teams and acts as the technical lead for complex cross-layer delivery and operational issues. It develops reusable interface patterns, engineering standards, test strategies, monitoring and support documentation, and strengthens capability through coaching and knowledge transfer. 

Key Responsibilities: 

- Lead end-to-end integration design across ISA-95 Level 2 control and equipment systems, Level 3 manufacturing operations systems, and Level 5 enterprise, cloud, analytics and R&D platforms. 
 - Use approved AI tools in your day-to-day work to improve your own productivity and your team's ways of working, sharing what works and applying sound judgement, including validating outputs and following GSK's Responsible AI, privacy and security requirements 
 - Own technical quality for FIL and related integration services, including interface specifications, data contracts, mappings, configuration records, deployment artefacts, test evidence and operational acceptance criteria. 
 - Perform troubleshooting and root-cause analysis, with timely escalation where manufacturing batches, product quality, patient supply or data integrity may be affected. 
 - Design and configure secure interfaces, data pipelines, event streams, APIs and data models that integrate automation, historians, MES (Manufacturing Execution System) / Electronic Batch Record. (Manufacturing Operations Management), LIMS ( Laboratory Information Management System), LES (Laboratory Execution System), PAT (Process Analytical Technology), laboratory instruments, asset systems and enterprise or scientific data platforms. 
 - Analyse message flows, logs, traces, metrics, data-quality controls and system behaviour across edge, site and cloud components to identify defects, latency, data loss, schema drift, performance constraints and opportunities for improvement. 
 - Coach site engineers and super users and contribute to training, runbooks and knowledge articles. 
 - Lead technical design and implementation across multiple projects, releases or sites. 
 - Review and approve key technical specifications, design documents, configurations, test scripts and validation evidence. 
 - Provide technical direction during complex incidents, releases and stabilisation and coordinate internal and supplier engineering resources. 
 - Assess technical risks and ensure mitigation addresses security, compliance, resilience, data integrity and supportability. 
 - Maintain reusable integration patterns, canonical models, namespace and topic conventions, API standards, connector templates, deployment automation and engineering guardrails for manufacturing and R&D data integration. 
 - Define and implement connectivity patterns for industrial protocols and interfaces such as OPC UA(Open Platform Communications Unified Architecture) MQTT, Sparkplug B, REST APIs (Representational State Transfer Application Programming Interface), message queues, file-based exchange and database integration, selecting patterns according to criticality, latency, security and supportability requirements. 
 - Develop contextualization and semantic mapping from equipment tags and process signals to assets, materials, batches, process steps, samples, methods and products using governed metadata, master data, ontologies and knowledge-graph-ready relationships. 
 - Enable reliable movement of manufacturing and laboratory data to enterprise and R&D consumers while retaining source, timestamp, unit of measure, quality status, lineage, batch and equipment context. 
 - Partner with CMC, MSAT, Data Science and R&D teams to translate scientific and process-analysis needs into scalable integration services and consumable, well-described data products. 
 - Design for store-and-forward, buffering, retry, idempotency, ordering, reconciliation, observability and disaster recovery where connectivity or downstream services may be interrupted. 
 - Apply OT/IT security principles including network segmentation, least privilege, certificate and secrets management, encrypted transport, secure remote access and controlled change across edge, site and cloud boundaries. 
 - Lead interface risk assessments, commissioning, qualification and validation activities using a risk-based approach appropriate to GxP and data-integrity requirements. 
 - Coordinate integration cutover, data reconciliation, hypercare and transition to service, including service-level measures, alerting, runbooks, ownership boundaries and escalation paths. 
 - Support formal technical assurance, audits and inspections and ensure corrective actions are evidence based. 
 - Drive engineering lessons learned and cross-team continuous improvement. 

Key Relationships / Customers

Business and Site Stakeholders

- Manufacturing, Quality, Laboratory, Supply Chain and MSAT stakeholders 
 - Site engineers, automation teams, super users and key users 
 - Business Process Owners and operational risk owners

Digital & Technology Stakeholders

- Product Managers and Product Owners 
 - Solution and Enterprise Architects 
 - Engineering, DevOps, Data and Integration teams 
 - Service Managers, Cyber Security and Infrastructure teams 
 - Validation, Quality and technical assurance teams

Other

 - System integrators and specialist engineering partners 
 - Managed service and support providers

Area of Specialization:

 - Interfaces, workflows, recipes, data models and environment design 
 - Technical specifications, design documentation and validation evidence 
 - Testing, release, deployment and configuration management 
 - Logs, metrics, monitoring and root-cause analysis 
 - Security, data integrity, resilience and supportability 
 - Regulated manufacturing, quality or laboratory technology environments 
 - Technical leadership across products, sites or programmes 
 - Design assurance and complex technical decision making 
 - ISA-95 Levels 2, 3 and 5 integration architecture and data flows 
 - Factory Integration Layer and industrial edge integration patterns

Basic Qualifications:

 - Minimum 7+ years of hands-on technical engineering experience involving enterprise IT, manufacturing OT, automation, data, or integration environments.

data.title: Software Engineer in Test
data.description:
This is a Permanent and Employee Referral role with one of the IPO listed Fintech client of SourcingXPress. 

Job Summary: 

Payment Services Organization is hiring a Software Engineer in Test (SDET). Our POS platform moves real money for merchants every day across mobile apps, cloud services, and card readers. In this hands-on role, you'll turn designs into written risk models before code exists, build automated checks that gate real merges, and encode how the payments domain behaves so the knowledge outlives any one person. You'll help shape how test engineering works on a platform where quality is built in, not bolted on. If you'd rather build the thing than maintain it, read on - the best is yet to come!

Job Description: 

Essential Responsibilities: 

- Implements tasks within the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC), receiving structure and oversight from more experienced staff
 - Follows well-established internal conventions and standard procedures
 - Understands internal standards & processes an applies them to make technical decisions
 - Collaborates with peers, manager, and project lead to gain understanding of tasks and review solutions
 - May contribute to code & design reviews

Minimum Qualifications: 

- 2+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor's degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience. 

Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications: 

What you need to know about the role: 

Organization POS sits at the heart of how many SMBs run their businesses every day. Card payments, card readers and hardware variance, acquiring, payments SDKs, ledger and financial flows, onboarding and checkout across web and mobile. As a Test Engineer here, you won't hand down verdicts after the fact; you'll build the capability that lets verification happen without you in the room. The engineering discipline bar is the same as any software role: version control, review in both directions, CI, design before implementation, and root-cause debugging by the owner. The Test Engineer will be integral part of the team and takes pride in advocating for the quality of the Organization mobile app on Android and iOS, along with the backend and web services behind it. 

Your way to impact: 

As a Test Engineer, you will help make sure that merchants can take payments without problems on any device. You will own testing for the features you work on, from test planning to release, and you will help move our testing from manual to automated over time. Your work will reduce production defects, speed up releases, and improve the experience of small businesses that use Organization every day. You will grow toward a Senior Test Engineer role as you build your technical depth and ownership. 

In your day-to-day role you will be responsible for: 

- Understand requirements and design test cases, test scenarios, and end-to-end tests for Organization mobile app features on Android and iOS. 
 - Write and merge automated cross-service / interop tests into CI/CD pipelines that gate real merges; debug every failure to root cause. 
 - Perform manual and exploratory testing on real devices, emulators, and simulators across OS versions, screen sizes, and network conditions. 
 - Test APIs and backend services using Postman or RestAssured and validate data using SQL queries. 
 - Run tests on BrowserStack and in CI/CD pipelines (Harness) and analyze failures to find the root cause. 
 - Log clear, reproducible defects in JIRA with logs (Logcat, Xcode), screenshots, and screen recordings, and follow them through to closure. 
 - Maintain test cases and test runs in TestRail, and report test status and risks to the team. Reduce flaky tests and suggest ideas to improve test coverage, speed, and quality. 
 - Exposure to contract testing, mutation testing, or AI-assisted quality practices (AI-generated test case review, test gap analysis)

What do you need to bring: 

- 2-4 years of experience in software testing, with at least 1-2 years in mobile (Android and/or iOS) testing. 
 - Hands-on experience with Espresso and/or XCUITest, with willingness to learn the other. 
 - Good Java programming fundamentals and basic knowledge of data structures. 
 - Experience with API testing (Postman, RestAssured) and writing SQL queries. 
 - Good understanding of SDLC/STLC, test design, and defect management using JIRA and TestRail. 
 - Familiarity with Jenkins, BrowserStack, and debugging tools such as Logcat and the Xcode console. 
 - Clear written and verbal communication, and the ability to work with developers and product managers. 
 - Ownership, curiosity, and a willingness to learn. 
 - Nice to have: Appium, Kotlin or Swift reading ability, mobile performance testing (Android Profiler, Xcode Instruments), JMeter, AWS, and experience in payments or FinTech.

Role Summary : 

We are seeking a highly motivated Quality Engineer - Composite & Assembly to ensure product quality and process compliance across composite manufacturing and assembly operations. The candidate will be responsible for inspection, quality assurance, non-conformance management, and continuous improvement activities while ensuring compliance with aerospace quality standards and customer requirements. 

Key Responsibilities

- Perform in-process, final, and first article inspections of composite components and assemblies. 
 - Monitor composite manufacturing processes including prepreg handling, layup, bonding, curing, trimming, drilling, machining, and finishing operations.

 - Generate and manage NCRs (Non-Conformance Reports) and participate in Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and Corrective & Preventive Action (CAPA) activities. 
 - Support First Article Inspection (FAI) documentation and product traceability requirements. 
 - Maintain quality records, inspection reports, and related documentation. 
 - Collaborate with Manufacturing, Process Engineering, Production, and Supply Chain teams to resolve quality-related issues. 
 - Participate in internal, customer, and regulatory audits. 
 - Support continuous improvement initiatives to enhance product quality, process capability, and operational efficiency. 

Required Skills & Competencies

- Strong knowledge of composite materials, manufacturing processes, and assembly techniques. 
 - Experience in aerospace, defense, aviation, composite manufacturing, or precision engineering environments. 
 - Good understanding of AS9100, AS9102 (FAI), and aerospace quality management systems. 
 - Ability to interpret engineering drawings, specifications, and GD&T requirements. 
 - Hands-on experience with inspection and measuring equipment. 
 - Knowledge of NCR, RCA, CAPA, 8D, and problem-solving methodologies. 
 - Familiarity with quality tools such as PFMEA, Control Plan, etc. , 
 - Strong analytical, documentation, and report-preparation skills. 
 - Good communication and cross-functional coordination abilities. 

Preferred Experience

- 3-6 years of experience in Quality Assurance/Quality Control within aerospace
 - Experience with composite structures, bonded assemblies, and aerospace manufacturing processes.

data.title: Supply Chain Security Engineering, VP
data.description:
Who We Are Looking For

The State Street Cyber Security Architecture & Engineering team is seeking an accomplished professional with proven expertise in Application (AppSec) and software supply chain security implementation/governance. The ideal candidate will have previous hands-on experience in application security, build and release management, secure software development lifecycle (SSDLC), and the automation of security processes within CI/CD pipelines. Additionally, the candidate should have experience with configuring and managing artifact caches (e. g. JFrog Artifactory) and other artifact sources of truth at an enterprise scale, deep familiarity with package ecosystems like Maven Central, PyPI and familiarity with SLSA principles. 

Why This Role Is Important to Us

Software supply chain attacks have emerged as one of the most significant cybersecurity risks facing modern enterprises. As organizations increasingly rely on open-source components, third-party libraries, cloud-native platforms, CI/CD pipelines, and AI-assisted development, securing the end-to-end software development lifecycle has become critical to maintaining trust, resilience, and regulatory compliance. 

This role plays a pivotal part in ensuring that software is developed, built, tested, signed, and deployed through secure and verifiable processes. 

What You Will Be Responsible For

- Help build and execute our software supply chain security strategy to expand upon State Street's ability to deploy secure-by-default open-source artifacts, etc. , across the enterprise. 
 - Partner with Engineering teams leads to create, implement, and apply DevSecOps, and AppSec principles and processes. 
 - Assist application teams with onboarding to the adopted security tools/technologies; working with vendors to troubleshoot the platform and issues related to such integrations. 
 - Deliver and communicate reporting via dashboard, and metrics. 
 - Develop and maintain supply chain security and DevSecOps documentation. 
 - Work with teams to continuously improve DevSecOps, & Software Supply Chain Security processes and tools. 
 - Deliver tasks based on project objectives; technically support projects through to completion. 

What We Value

These skills will help you succeed in this role

- Previous experience developing software in technologies such as Java, . Net, Python, and Node. js etc. 
 - Experience in cloud technologies such as Azure and AWS.

data.title: Staff Software Engineer, dbt core
data.description:
From Fivetran's founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We're proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven. 

About Us

Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data. 

Together, we're delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data - from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on. 

Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions. 

As we bring our teams and technology together, we're building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It's an exciting time to join us: we're creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact. 

During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites. 

About The Role

Our mission is to empower data practitioners to create and disseminate organizational knowledge. dbt Core is the open-source engine at the heart of this mission, used by tens of thousands of analysts and engineers to transform data with the rigor of software engineering. We are looking for a systems-oriented engineer to join the small, expert team that builds and maintains this foundational piece of the modern data stack. This is an opportunity to work on deeply technical, high-leverage problems where your contributions will improve the daily workflow of a massive and passionate open-source community. 

About The Team

The dbt Core team are the stewards of the open-source engine that powers the modern data stack for tens of thousands of practitioners. This small, high-trust group of systems engineers tackles the most fundamental challenges in dbt: ensuring the performance, reliability, and architectural integrity of dbt itself. They not only own the core execution engine but also architect the crucial adapter framework that connects dbt to a growing ecosystem of databases and data platforms. 

As a Staff Software Engineer on the Core & Adapters team, you will be a steward of the performance, reliability, and architectural integrity of dbt. You will tackle ambiguous, open-ended problems and take ownership of critical systems. 

What You'll Do

- Dive deep into the dbt-core execution engine, using your systems expertise to identify, debug, and eliminate performance bottlenecks in our Python codebase. 
 - Architect and implement improvements to our adapter interface, the crucial layer that connects dbt to a growing ecosystem of databases and data platforms, enabling the community to build more powerful and efficient integrations. 
 - Debug complex, system-level issues that span from Linux process management and concurrency models to database query planning and network protocols. 
 - Lead technical design discussions and contribute to the long-term architectural roadmap for dbt Core, making key decisions about what, how, and when we build to ensure its scalability and reliability for years to come. 
 - Mentor other engineers and review contributions from our vibrant open-source community, upholding our high standards for code quality, testing, and design while fostering a collaborative and inclusive environment. 
 - Take strong ownership of our distributed systems, troubleshoot complex production issues, and participate in an on-call rotation to maintain high availability and deliver a resilient platform experience. 

Skills We're Looking For

We are looking for an engineer with a strong performance and debugging mindset, excellent mental models for complex systems, and a deep curiosity for infrastructure and open-source software. 

Required Qualifications: 

- 6+ years of professional software development experience, with a focus on building and operating backend systems in a production environment. 
 - Deep backend engineering experience and proficiency in Python. 
 - A systematic, first-principles approach to problem-solving, with comfort navigating and debugging in Linux environments (e. g. , understanding process scheduling, memory management, file systems). 
 - Solid grasp of database internals, such as query execution engines, storage layers, indexing strategies, and transaction management. 
 - Excellent communication skills and a sense of ownership, with the ability to balance technical depth with fast, iterative delivery. 

Preferred Qualifications: 

- A background in data warehousing, data engineering, or analytics engineering. 
 - Professional experience writing production code in Go or Rust. 
 - Experience contributing to or maintaining a popular open-source project. 
 - Experience building compilers, interpreters, or developer tooling. 
 - Familiarity with performance analysis tools like perf or strace. 

The Team & Our Culture

You will join a small, high-trust team of senior and staff-level engineers who are passionate about building robust, well-crafted, and reliable software. We operate in a remote-first, asynchronous-friendly environment that values deep work, clear written communication, and a high degree of autonomy. We are deeply connected to our users and the open-source community, and we believe that the best solutions come from a rigorous, collaborative, and empathetic engineering process. 

Perks And Benefits

100% employer-paid medical insurance
 - Generous paid time away from work, including paid vacation or flexible/unlimited vacation depending on role and country, plus paid sick time, inclusive parental leave, paid holidays, including a year-end Global Week of Rest, and volunteer days off. 
 - RSU stock grants*

*May vary by country and worker type - please reach out to your recruiter for more information

Click here to learn more about Fivetran's Benefits by Region. 

We're honored to be valued at over $5. 6 billion, but more importantly, we're proud of our core values of Get Stuck In, Do the Right Thing, and One Team, One Dream. Read about us in Forbes. 

Fivetran brings together high-quality talent across the globe to make data access as easy and reliable as electricity for our customers. We value and recognize that our customers benefit from having innovative teams made of people from many backgrounds, experiences, and identities. Fivetran promotes diversity, equity, inclusion & belonging through attracting, recruiting, developing, and retaining a diverse workforce, not only because it is the right thing to do, but because it helps us build a world-class company to better serve our customers, our people and our communities. 

To learn more about Fivetran's culture and what it's like to be part of the team, click here and enjoy our video.

The Engineering Lead will be accountable to drive engineering standards, to engineer software solutions, project delivery, process, people agenda, risk and governance of the journey. 

Key Responsibilities

Strategy

- Responsible - Awareness of SCB's group strategy and steer hive strategy to achieve group outcomes
 - Responsible - Alignment of technology strategy to business strategy
 - Accountable - Management and measurement of strategic outcomes
 - Accountable - Align NRRP activities towards Technology Strategy/ Scorecard

Business

- Accountable - Delivery of strategic technology systems and services to enable NRRP outcomes
 - Responsible - Drive effectiveness and efficiencies of NRRP to achieve business outcomes
 - Informed - Awareness of the impact of NRRP processes to the bank's business

Regulatory & Business Conduct

- Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group's Values and Code of Conduct. 
 - Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct. 
 - Embody expected conduct to achieve the outcomes set out in the Bank's Conduct Principles: [Fair Outcomes for Clients; Effective Financial Markets; Financial Crime Compliance; The Right Environment. ]
 - Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters. 

Key Stakeholders

- Head of Nostro and network Management
 - Head of Treasury Technology
 - NRRP Program Stakeholders

Other Responsibilities

- Embed Here for good and Group's brand and values in the NRRP Hive

Skills And Experience

- Information Management
 - System and Technology Integration
 - Planning: Tactical, Strategic
 - Influencing Through Expertise
 - IT Governance
 - Finance and Accounting

About Standard Chartered

We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. What We Offer

In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.

Cp/ Cpk) for given part/assembly characteristics n Conducts simple Gauge Repeatability & Reproducibility (GR&R) studies n Has basic knowledge of sampling plans and procedures

Design to cost

data.title: Senior Engineering Manager, AI Engineering – Quality Transformation
data.description:
Our Company: 

At Teradata, we believe that people thrive when empowered with better information. Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform activates enterprise intelligence by unifying data, knowledge and business context to achieve tangible outcomes. With Teradata, organizations can provide agents with full context for impact when it matters. Our solution lets businesses connect and scale on premises, in the cloud, or through a hybrid approach. Teradata delivers real business value with AI. 

Role Overview: 

We are looking for a Senior Engineering Manager to lead the transformation of Quality Engineering through AI, agentic systems, intelligent automation, and modern software engineering practices. 

This leader will build and lead an AI Engineering capability focused on fundamentally changing how software quality is engineered, moving from traditional testing toward AI-assisted and increasingly autonomous quality engineering. 

The role will drive capabilities spanning agentic test development, autonomous test execution and triage, intelligent results analysis, defect and test-gap analysis, risk-based coverage optimization, and continuous validation. 

What You'll Do

- Lead AI-driven Quality Engineering transformation, moving from traditional testing to automation-first, AI-assisted, and increasingly autonomous validation. 
 - Build and scale agentic testing capabilities for test generation, execution, failure analysis, triage, test-gap identification, and coverage optimization. 
 - Embed intelligent validation into CI/CD and developer workflows to enable shift-left quality and earlier defect detection. 
 - Apply AI to continuously identify coverage gaps, learn from defects and production issues, and improve test effectiveness. 
 - Optimize testing based on risk and customer impact, reducing redundant validation while expanding meaningful end-to-end coverage. 
 - Build and lead a high-performing AI Engineering team, while developing AI and agentic engineering capabilities across the broader Quality Engineering organization. 
 - Drive measurable outcomes in product quality, test coverage, engineering productivity, validation cycle time, and release velocity. 

What You'll Bring

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, AI/ML, or a related discipline, preferably from top-tier institutions. 
 - 12+ years of software engineering experience, including significant experience leading engineering teams and large-scale technical initiatives. 
 - Strong background in Quality Engineering, system/integration testing, test automation, or developer productivity engineering. 
 - Demonstrated experience designing or deploying production-grade solutions using GenAI/LLMs and agentic AI. 
 - Strong understanding of: 
 - LLM-based application development and prompting
 - Agentic workflows and tool-using agents
 - Retrieval/RAG and contextual grounding
 - Test generation and test intelligence
 - AI-assisted failure/root-cause analysis
 - Evaluation, observability, guardrails, and reliability of AI systems
 - Strong programming and engineering foundation, preferably with Python and modern API/service architectures. 
 - Experience with CI/CD platforms such as GitHub Actions, automated test infrastructure, cloud environments, and distributed systems. 
 - Experience improving measurable engineering outcomes such as cycle time, automation coverage, defect escape rate, triage efficiency, test effectiveness, and engineering productivity. 
 - Strong people leadership with demonstrated ability to develop engineers, influence across organizations, and lead complex transformation programs. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience building multi-agent or autonomous engineering systems. 
 - Experience applying AI to software development, testing, DevOps, observability, incident analysis, or developer productivity. 
 - Experience with cloud-native enterprise platforms and complex distributed systems. 
 - Experience building AI solutions that reason across requirements, code, tests, defects, logs, telemetry, and historical execution data. 
 - Proven experience taking AI capabilities from prototype to production-scale adoption, with measurable engineering impact. 

Why We Think You'll Love Teradata

We prioritize a people-first culture because we know our people are at the very heart of our success. We embrace a flexible work model because we trust our people to make decisions about how, when, and where they work. We focus on well-being because we care about our people and their ability to thrive both personally and professionally. We are an anti-racist company because our dedication to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion is more than a statement. It is a deep commitment to doing the work to foster an equitable environment that celebrates people for all of who they are. 

Teradata invites all identities and backgrounds in the workplace. We work with deliberation and intent to ensure we are cultivating collaboration and inclusivity across our global organization. We are proud to be an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, color, ancestry, religion, creed, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding, or related conditions), national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, medical condition, genetic information, gender identity or expression, military and veteran status, or any other legally protected status.

Job Description

Working within the FMS India team the Quality & operation Supervisor will have the responsibility of driving down the cost of non-quality and continually reduce customer escapes through the application of appropriate Quality and Continual Improvement tools & techniques, including inspection activity.

Key responsibilities

- Coordinate daily assembly and testing plans, assign work, monitor progress and balance priorities against delivery commitments and available resources. 
 - Supervise and coach assembly operators, test personnel and service engineers as assigned; set clear expectations, verify task readiness and support skills development. 
 - Ensure work is performed to approved drawings, work instructions, inspection plans, test procedures and customer requirements; verify that required records are complete and traceable. 
 - Oversee in-process and final inspections, test readiness and release documentation. Confirm equipment and measuring instruments are suitable and within calibration before use. 
 - Maintain and improve the site Quality Management System in line with ISO 9001 and applicable company procedures; support internal, customer and certification audits and close assigned findings. 
 - Lead containment, non-conformance review and root-cause problem solving for internal, supplier, test, field-service and customer issues. Use structured methods such as 8D and track corrective and preventive actions through effectiveness checks. 
 - Apply relevant quality tools, including PPAP, FAIR, FMEA, control plans, MSA and process capability methods, in coordination with Quality, Engineering, Manufacturing and suppliers. 
 - Plan and coordinate service-engineer assignments, job readiness, parts/tools availability, customer updates and service reports. Review field feedback and escalate safety, technical or customer-impacting concerns promptly. 
 - Promote safe work practices across assembly, test and service work, including risk reviews, permit or isolation requirements where applicable, PPE and incident/near-miss reporting. 
 - Track and report operational and quality performance, such as delivery attainment, rework, scrap, first-pass yield, test failures, customer complaints, service response and action closure; use trends to prioritize improvement. 
 - Identify operational risks, constraints and recurring process losses; resolve routine issues, remove barriers and escalate decisions or risks beyond delegated authority. 
 - Coordinate with Operations, Quality, Engineering, Supply Chain, Sales and service stakeholders to support smooth execution, customer commitments and consistent standards. 

Qualifications

Education and experience

- Bachelor's degree in mechanical, Industrial, Production Engineering or a related discipline; equivalent relevant experience may be considered. 
 - 5-7 years of experience in quality, manufacturing or operations within an industrial, engineering or equipment-manufacturing environment. 
 - Demonstrated experience coordinating frontline teams and supervising assembly, inspection, testing or field-service work. 
 - Practical knowledge of ISO 9001 and quality problem solving, including non-conformance control, root-cause analysis and corrective action. 

Technical And Leadership Capabilities

- Working knowledge of PPAP, FAIR, FMEA, control plans, MSA, inspection methods and structured 8D problem solving; Six Sigma or Lean training is an advantage. 
 - Ability to read engineering drawings, follow technical work instructions and interpret mechanical test results and quality records. 
 - Comfortable using ERP/MRP systems and Microsoft Office for work tracking, reporting and documentation; familiarity with SAP or similar systems is an advantage. 
 - Clear communicator with sound planning, prioritization, coaching and cross-functional coordination skills. 
 - Organized and analytical, with the judgment to contain issues, protect customers and escalate promptly when required.

We are looking for an experienced Salesforce QA Engineer to plan, design, and execute comprehensive testing strategies for complex Salesforce implementations. Key Responsibilities

Experience Cloud (Mandatory)

Sales Cloud & Service Cloud

- Strong understanding of core CRM processes, including lead-to-cash workflows and case management.

 - Functional Testing & Salesforce Platform Validation

 - Manual, Regression & UAT Testing: Perform functional, integration, smoke, regression, and UAT testing across Salesforce Sandbox environments. Manage defect logging, triage, retesting, and closure. 
 - Declarative Automation Testing: Validate Salesforce Flows (Screen, Record-Triggered, and Schedule-Triggered), validation rules, approval processes, and legacy Process Builder and Workflow Rules.

 - Security Model Testing: Validate Salesforce security configurations, including OWD, Sharing Rules, Profiles, Permission Sets, Role Hierarchy, and Field-Level Security. Perform role-based access and "Run As" user testing. 
 - Test Automation
 - Apex Test Classes & Code Coverage: Ability to review Apex test classes, understand code coverage reports, and collaborate with developers to ensure the minimum 75% code coverage requirement is met. 
 - LWC Jest Testing: Basic to intermediate understanding of Jest-based unit testing for Lightning Web Components. 
 - API, Integration & Data Testing
 - API Testing: Experience testing REST and SOAP APIs, JSON/XML payloads, and webhooks using tools such as Postman and Workbench. Understand authentication mechanisms, including OAuth, Connected Apps, and Named Credentials. 
 - Integration Testing: Validate end-to-end data flows between Salesforce, external systems, middleware, and third-party applications, including negative and failure scenarios. 
 - Data Migration & Test Data Management: Use Salesforce Data Loader, Import Wizard, and Workbench for test data creation, migration validation, and data reconciliation, including Large Data Volume (LDV) scenarios. 
 - Analytics & AI Testing
 - Reports & Dashboards: Validate custom report types, filters, dashboards, and snapshot reporting against underlying Salesforce data. 
 - Einstein Features: Test Salesforce Einstein capabilities, such as Einstein Bots, Next Best Action, and Einstein Analytics, ensuring expected recommendations and outcomes. 
 - Agentforce: Familiarity with testing autonomous AI agents and AI-driven workflows, including prompt and response validation, topics, actions, guardrails, and Agentforce testing tools. 
 - DevOps, Release Management & QA Tools
 - Release & Environment Management: Understand Salesforce release lifecycles and Sandbox strategies across Dev, QA, UAT, and Staging environments. Perform data seeding, Sandbox refresh validation, and post-deployment smoke and regression testing. 
 - Deployment Tools: Working knowledge of deployments using Change Sets, Salesforce CLI (SFDX), or Gearset. Validate deployment results and troubleshoot deployment-related issues. 
 - CI/CD & Quality Gates: Familiarity with Salesforce DevOps pipelines and tools such as Copado and Gearset, including automated testing and deployment validation as quality gates. 

Required Skills & Qualifications

- 3-5 years of hands-on experience in Salesforce QA. 
 - Strong practical knowledge of Salesforce Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and Experience Cloud. 
 - Mandatory hands-on experience in Experience Cloud testing. 
 - Strong understanding of functional, integration, regression, and UAT testing. 
 - Experience in test planning, test case preparation, defect management, and requirement traceability. 
 - Proficiency in Salesforce Flows, SOQL, security model validation, and data testing. 
 - Working knowledge of Apex test classes, code coverage, and LWC validation. 
 - Experience in REST/SOAP API testing, Postman, Workbench, and Data Loader. 
 - Familiarity with Salesforce deployment processes, Sandbox management, and DevOps tools. 

Good To Have Skills

- Apex Debug Logs and Developer Console. 
 - Security Model and Run As testing. 
 - Exploratory testing. 
 - Jest testing for Lightning Web Components. 
 - MuleSoft integration testing and OAuth 2. 0 flows. 
 - Data Cloud and CRM Analytics. 
 - Agentforce testing and AI-driven workflow validation. 
 - Salesforce CLI (SFDX), Change Sets, Gearset, and Copado. 
 - Copado Robotic Testing. 

Preferred Certifications

- Salesforce Certified Administrator - Required
 - Salesforce Certified Experience Cloud Consultant - Highly Preferred
 - Salesforce Certified Sales Cloud Consultant / Service Cloud Consultant - Highly Preferred
 - Salesforce Certified Platform App Builder - Good to Have.

data.title: Senior LLM/GenAI Engineer
data.description:
The Senior LLM/GenAI Engineer is a hands-on coding role responsible for designing, building, integrating and deploying AI-powered applications and agents for enterprise HR workflows. The engineer will develop backend services and application APIs, retrieve and process data from the Databricks data lake, Oracle databases and HRMS systems, and connect that data to grounded LLM experiences. The role combines software engineering, data integration, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and agent development to deliver secure, reliable applications for employee self-service, HR policy queries, recruitment support and workforce analytics. 

Key Responsibilities : 

• Write, test and maintain production application code using Python, FastAPI and NodeJS; build backend services and APIs for LLM/GenAI applications rather than prompt-only prototypes. 

• Build and maintain integrations that retrieve and process data from the Databricks data lake, Oracle databases and HRMS systems using SQL, APIs and approved connectors; handle authentication, data mapping, validation and integration failures. 

• Design and implement RAG pipelines that combine HR documents with authorised enterprise data, including ingestion, retrieval, context assembly, source attribution and access-aware responses. 

• Build agents using Google ADK, LangGraph or equivalent frameworks; implement tool and function calling, workflow orchestration, state management and connections to Databricks, Oracle and HRMS services. 

• Engineer and evaluate prompts, retrieval and agent behaviour using representative test cases; validate grounded answers, tool selection and task completion, and implement guardrails and human approval for sensitive actions. 

• Enforce HR data privacy, role-based access control (RBAC), PII protection and audit logging across data access, application APIs and agent tools; optimise reliability, latency, concurrency and inference cost. 

• Deliver end-to-end applications for HR policy assistance, employee self-service, recruitment support and conversational workforce analytics, from requirements and coding through integration testing, deployment and production support. 

• Maintain modular code, automated tests, technical documentation and deployment pipelines; troubleshoot production issues and mentor junior engineers through code reviews and hands-on implementation guidance. 

Required Qualifications & Experience: 

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related technical field. 

• Demonstrable hands-on coding experience building LLM applications and agents, including integrations with Databricks data lake and Oracle databases or HRMS systems. 

• 5-8 years of hands-on software and backend application development experience, with recent experience delivering production-grade LLM/GenAI applications and tool-enabled agents. 

Educational Background

• Required: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field. 

• Preferred: Advanced certifications in AI/ML, Databricks, Cloud Architecture, or Backend Application Development from recognized institutions. 

Years & Type of Experience

• 5-8 years of hands-on software engineering experience, including application coding, API development, SQL-based data access, automated testing and production deployment. 

• Proven delivery of LLM/GenAI applications and agents that use enterprise data, with practical experience integrating Databricks data lake and Oracle databases or HRMS systems; HR Tech or People Analytics experience is preferred. 

Domain Expertise

• Strong understanding of LLM application architecture, RAG, structured data retrieval, tool calling and multi-step agent workflows, including error handling and evaluation. 

• Ability to translate recruitment, onboarding, employee self-service, HR policy and workforce analytics requirements into working applications with defined data sources, access rules and human review points. 

• Practical understanding of enterprise data governance, record-level access restrictions, PII protection, auditability and secure handling of confidential employee data across applications and agents. 

Digital & Operational Tools

• LLM & Agent Engineering: Google ADK, LangGraph, LangChain, Gemini Enterprise, Vertex AI Search, prompt engineering, RAG, tool/function calling and agent evaluation. 

• Enterprise Data & Integration: Databricks data lake, Databricks Genie, SQL, Oracle databases, HRMS APIs, approved connectors, data validation and enterprise data pipelines. 

• Application Engineering: Python, FastAPI, NodeJS, RESTful APIs, backend services, Git, automated testing, deployment pipelines, logging and monitoring. 

• Retrieval & Data Access: FAISS, Pinecone, Chroma or Vertex AI Vector Search; secure SQL queries, document retrieval and access-aware context assembly. 

Leadership Capabilities

• Technical Leadership: Lead application and agent design, contribute production code, review integrations and drive secure, maintainable engineering practices. 

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work with HR stakeholders, product managers, data engineers and Oracle/HRMS system owners to define requirements, data access and integration contracts. 

• Mentorship: Coach junior engineers in application coding, SQL, enterprise integrations, RAG and agent development through code reviews and practical guidance. 

• Delivery Ownership: Own implementation from requirements through production support, balancing business value, data privacy, reliability and operating cost.

data.title: Red Team Engineer - Adversary Simulation

Hiring for Lean SuperIntelligence - via Flexiple, the recruiting partner on this role. 

ABOUT US

We are a stealth Frontier AI security startup building foundation models for security. Backed by Tier 1 venture capital firms and built by experts in sovereign AI, foundation models, and cybersecurity. 

We have built models that already outperform frontier LLMs on cybersecurity benchmarks. 

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are hiring a Founding Senior Red Team Engineer to run realistic adversary simulations, develop offensive tooling, and close the loop from successful attack to tested detection. 

You will execute full attack chains across endpoints, identity, cloud, and containers while building labs, benchmarks, and autonomous offensive agents. This is a hands-on senior individual-contributor role with a path to shape the offensive program. 

RESPONSIBILITIES

- Build and execute adversary-simulation plans mapped to real threat-actor tradecraft and critical assets. 

- Run complete attack chains across initial access, execution, persistence, privilege escalation, defense evasion, credential access, lateral movement, collection, and exfiltration. 

- Develop and extend offensive tooling, including loaders, payloads, command-and-control profiles, and modules. 

- Develop and weaponize exploits into reliable, controlled operational capabilities. 

- Build intentionally vulnerable Windows, Linux, container, identity, and cloud environments. 

- Design instrumented, multi-stage kill chains and create the datasets and benchmark environments used to train and measure offensive-security AI systems. 

- Build and evaluate agents that autonomously discover, validate, and exploit vulnerabilities. 

- Execute Active Directory and Entra ID paths including Kerberos, delegation, ACL and ADCS abuse, plus cloud/container paths such as token theft, metadata-service abuse, role chaining, privileged containers, and Kubernetes RBAC escalation. 

- Run a recurring purple-team cadence: for each technique that lands, partner with blue-team and threat-research engineers until a tested detection exists, then retest and track remaining coverage gaps. 

- Operate with disciplined scoping, reproducibility, logging, cleanup, and reporting. 

QUALIFICATIONS

- Strong hands-on experience in red teaming, penetration testing, adversary simulation, exploit development, or offensive-tool development. 

- Demonstrated tool-development ability in C, C++, C#, Go, Rust, Nim, Python, or another relevant language. 

- Working knowledge of Windows and Linux internals and the mitigations that affect offensive techniques. 

- Understanding of memory-corruption classes, exploitability, and debugging or root-cause analysis. 

- Strong Active Directory attack knowledge and familiarity with hybrid Entra ID paths. 

- Current understanding of EDR visibility, evasion, and the limitations of offensive techniques. 

- Creative attack-path reasoning and the ability to describe defensive detections for your own techniques. 

- Strong operational discipline, reproducibility, and clear written communication. 

- We value demonstrated ability over formal credentials, certifications, or a fixed number of years of experience. 

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

- Experience with AI agents, autonomous security systems, or offensive-security automation. 

- Fuzzing, vulnerability research, kernel research, reverse engineering, or exploit-development depth. 

- Cloud red teaming across AWS, Azure, or GCP. 

- Container and Kubernetes offensive-security experience. 

- Prior blue-team, detection-engineering, or purple-team experience. 

- Published research, CVEs, bug-bounty findings, open-source tooling, or advanced lab and CTF work.

data.title: DevOps Engineer
data.description:
At EY, you'll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we're counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all. 

DevOps Engineer

Opening Paragraph

As EY continues to evolve and modernize its digital platforms, we are seeking a talented DevOps Engineer to help accelerate the delivery, reliability, and scalability of our enterprise solutions. This role sits at the intersection of development, operations, automation, and cloud infrastructure, enabling teams to deliver innovative business capabilities faster and more securely. You will play a critical role in supporting modern digital experiences, driving automation, and ensuring our platforms operate efficiently and securely across a global environment. 

The Opportunity

This is an exciting opportunity to join a high-performing technology team focused on delivering business-critical services and digital capabilities. As a DevOps Engineer, you will be responsible for building and maintaining the infrastructure, automation, and deployment processes that support our applications and platforms. 

You will work closely with development, operations, architecture, and business stakeholders to implement modern DevOps practices, improve operational efficiency, and enhance platform reliability. This role offers exposure to enterprise-scale systems, cloud technologies, automation frameworks, and continuous improvement initiatives while providing opportunities to influence the future direction of our technology landscape. 

Your Key Responsibilities

As a DevOps Engineer, you will be responsible for supporting and enhancing the infrastructure, deployment pipelines, and operational processes that enable successful delivery of applications and services. 

Key responsibilities include: 

- Design, implement, and maintain infrastructure solutions that support application hosting, data processing, analytics, and enterprise services. 
 - Develop and manage Continuous Integration and Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) pipelines to streamline software delivery and improve deployment quality and consistency. 
 - Implement monitoring, alerting, and logging capabilities to ensure system health, availability, and performance visibility. 
 - Automate operational and administrative tasks to reduce manual effort, increase efficiency, and improve reliability. 
 - Collaborate with development, operations, product, and business teams to ensure solutions meet business requirements and are delivered successfully. 
 - Support software releases, deployments, and infrastructure maintenance activities as required. 
 - Ensure platforms and services comply with organizational security standards, governance requirements, and regulatory obligations. 
 - Develop and implement best practices for access management, data protection, and system security. 
 - Analyze system performance, identify bottlenecks, and implement optimization strategies to improve scalability and operational efficiency. 
 - Participate in troubleshooting and root-cause analysis of production issues, driving long-term corrective actions and continuous improvement. 

Skills And Attributes For Success

Success in this role requires a combination of technical expertise, problem-solving ability, collaboration, and a passion for automation and continuous improvement. You will be effective in a fast-paced environment where you can balance operational excellence with innovation and partnership across multiple teams. 

To Qualify for the Role, You Must Have

- Experience designing, implementing, and supporting enterprise infrastructure environments. 
 - Experience developing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation. 
 - Knowledge of monitoring, logging, and observability tools and practices. 
 - Experience automating operational processes using scripting and automation technologies. 
 - Understanding of security best practices, access controls, compliance requirements, and infrastructure governance. 
 - Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills with the ability to solve complex technical problems. 
 - Experience working collaboratively with cross-functional teams in an Agile delivery environment. 
 - Strong verbal and written communication skills. 

Ideally, You'll Also Have

- Experience with cloud platforms and modern cloud operations practices. 
 - Exposure to Infrastructure as Code (IaC) methodologies and automation frameworks. 
 - Knowledge of performance tuning, scalability planning, and system optimization. 
 - Experience supporting enterprise application deployments and release management processes. 
 - Experience working within large, globally distributed teams. 
 - Relevant DevOps, cloud, or infrastructure certifications. 

What We Look For

We are looking for individuals who are curious, collaborative, and committed to continuous learning. The ideal candidate is proactive, adaptable, and comfortable taking ownership of challenges while working across global teams. You will be someone who embraces innovation, shares knowledge openly, and consistently seeks opportunities to improve processes, technology, and outcomes. A positive attitude, strong communication skills, and the ability to balance independent work with effective teamwork will be critical for success. 

What Working At EY Offers

At EY, you'll have the opportunity to build a career as unique as you are, supported by a global scale, an inclusive culture, and technology to help you become the best version of yourself. You'll work on meaningful projects that impact our people, clients, and business while collaborating with talented professionals across diverse disciplines and geographies. 

We invest in our people through continuous learning, professional development, mentoring, and leadership opportunities. You'll be empowered to bring your ideas forward, challenge the status quo, and contribute to innovative solutions that help shape the future of our organization. 

EY | Building a better working world

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets. 

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate. 

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

data.title: Java Technical Lead - Payment Platform experience
data.description:
Role summary

You will be the senior technical owner for one or more platform domains. Working closely with Architects and Product Management, you will turn the target architecture and product requirements into clear technical specifications, then lead the team that delivers them predictably, with high quality and on schedule. You will spend roughly half your time on technical design, code and reviews, and half on people, planning and cross-team alignment. 

Key responsibilities

Delivery

- Break product goals into well-scoped epics, estimates and milestones with Product and Engineering Management. 
 - Run sprint planning and reviews, track progress and risks, and keep delivery predictable. 
 - Identify and unblock dependencies across teams and external partners early. 
 - Own release readiness: test strategy, rollout and rollback plans, and post-release monitoring. 
 - Use AI-assisted development tools responsibly to raise team throughput and code quality. 

Process and engineering practices

- Define and improve the team's delivery process: branching, code review, CI/CD, testing and definition of done. 
 - Set coding, API and data-modelling standards; review critical pull requests across backend and frontend. 
 - Write and review design documents and architecture decision records; represent the team at the Architecture Review Board. 
 - Define SLOs, observability and alerting; lead incident response and blameless post-incident reviews. 
 - Manage technical debt and keep the technical roadmap aligned with the architecture roadmap. 

Technical leadership

- Translate architecture blueprints into low-level designs, API contracts, data models, sequence diagrams and non-functional requirements. 
 - Keep implementation aligned with the approved architecture; raise deviations and trade-offs early. 
 - Champion secure design: encryption, key management, secrets handling, least-privilege access and audit trails, in line with PCI DSS and internal InfoSec policy. 

People leadership

- Mentor and grow engineers through pairing, design reviews and regular feedback. 
 - Take part in hiring: define the bar, interview and onboard new team members. 
 - Build a culture of ownership, documentation and calm, data-driven decisions. 

Technical environment

Backend: Java / Spring Boot (primary); Node. js (TypeScript) or Python for APIs, integrations and tooling

Frontend: React (TypeScript)

Architecture: Microservices, event-driven design, REST APIs, saga and outbox patterns

Data: PostgreSQL (primary), Redis; NoSQL where the workload warrants it

Cloud and DevOps: AWS (or Azure/GCP), Kubernetes, Terraform, CI/CD pipelines, feature flags

Observability: OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, centralised logging

Security: Cloud KMS/HSM, secrets management, WAF, SAST/DAST

Critical skills

- These are must-haves; candidates should show real depth in each area during interviews. 
 - Delivery leadership: turning high-level requirements into scoped work and shipping it predictably with a team of 5 or more engineers. 
 - Engineering process: code review, test automation, CI/CD, release management and incident management run as a discipline. 
 - Distributed systems: consistency, idempotency, concurrency, failure handling and high-throughput APIs. 
 - Java with Spring Boot, plus working proficiency in TypeScript/Node. js or Python and the ability to review React code. 
 - SQL: schema design, indexing, query tuning, transactions and isolation levels; zero-downtime migrations. 
 - Cloud and infrastructure: Kubernetes in a public cloud, infrastructure as code and observability. 
 - Security fundamentals: encryption, key and secrets management, least privilege and audit trails. 

Required qualifications

- 8+ years building production systems, including 2+ years as a tech lead leading a team of 5 or more engineers. 
 - Proven track record of turning architecture and product requirements into detailed specifications that teams deliver against. 
 - Deep experience with distributed systems and high-availability services. 
 - Strong command of Java and Spring Boot; working knowledge of Node. js (TypeScript) or Python, and React. 
 - Experience running services on Kubernetes in a public cloud, with CI/CD and infrastructure as code. 
 - Working knowledge of security and compliance practices such as PCI DSS; exposure to payments or fintech systems is helpful. 
 - Clear written and verbal communication; able to explain trade-offs to architects, engineers, product leaders and auditors. 
 - Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent practical experience. 

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in payments, fintech or banking technology, such as payment gateways, processor integrations, settlement and reconciliation. 
 - Built or scaled a ledger, payment switch or settlement engine handling 1M+ transactions a day. 
 - Led certification with a card network or an acquiring bank. 
 - Shipped an AI/ML or LLM-powered feature to production. 
 - Has used AI coding assistants and agentic tools within a governed SDLC.

data.title: Principal Engineer
data.description:
Principal Engineer & Architect

Role Overview

The Principal Engineer & Architect is the highest technical authority within Apollo Homecare's Engineering organization. 

This is a hands-on engineering leadership role responsible for designing, building, and scaling our technology platforms. You will solve the organization's most complex technical challenges, define enterprise architecture, establish engineering standards, mentor engineering teams, and remain an active contributor to the codebase. 

You will work across backend, frontend, mobile, cloud, data and AI to build secure, scalable and resilient healthcare technology products. 

Key Responsibilities

Engineering & Architecture

- Design and build scalable, production-grade applications across web, mobile and cloud. 
 - Define enterprise architecture, technology standards and engineering best practices. 
 - Build reusable platforms, frameworks and shared services that accelerate product development. 
 - Make architectural decisions balancing scalability, performance, security and business outcomes. 
 - Lead design reviews and contribute to critical production code. Full Stack Engineering

- Design and develop backend services, APIs, integrations and distributed systems. 
 - Build responsive web and mobile applications using modern frameworks. 
 - Design scalable databases, workflows and enterprise integrations. 
 - Solve complex production issues and optimize application performance. AI & Data Engineering

- Design and build AI-enabled products using LLMs, RAG, vector databases and agentic workflows. 
 - Build scalable data pipelines and data models supporting analytics and AI. 
 - Drive AI-assisted software development across the engineering team. 
 - Continuously evaluate emerging AI technologies and establish best practices. Cloud, Security & Platform

- Design cloud-native solutions on AWS, Azure or GCP. 
 - Establish CI/CD, observability, Infrastructure as Code and DevSecOps practices. 
 - Define security architecture and ensure compliance with healthcare security standards. 
 - Optimize platform reliability, scalability and cloud costs. Technical Leadership

- Mentor Lead Engineers and Senior Engineers. 
 - Drive engineering quality through architecture reviews and code reviews. 
 - Act as the highest technical escalation point for complex engineering challenges. 
 - Partner with Product, Design and Business teams to deliver scalable solutions. Required Qualifications

- BE/BTech from Tier 1 Engineering Colleges only - CSE /IT (Mandatory)
 - Masters is Computer science is a plus. 
 - Must have experience in a Product based company. 
 - Expert-level software engineering with strong backend, frontend and mobile development experience. 
 - Deep expertise in Node. js, Java or Python and modern frontend frameworks such as React/Next. js. 
 - Strong experience building React Native applications for Android and iOS. 
 - Deep & Proven expertise in distributed systems, REST APIs, microservices and system design. 
 - Strong knowledge of SQL, NoSQL, data modelling, and data engineering. 
 - Hands-on experience with AWS, Azure or GCP, Docker, Kubernetes and CI/CD. 
 - Practical experience building AI-powered applications using LLMs, RAG, vector databases and agentic workflows. 
 - Strong understanding of secure software development, OWASP and modern DevSecOps practices. 
 - Excellent debugging, problem-solving and architectural decision-making skills. Leadership Expectations

- Lead through technical excellence and hands-on execution. 
 - Build reusable engineering capabilities rather than one-off solutions. 
 - Establish engineering standards and promote AI-enabled development practices. 
 - Mentor engineers and cultivate a culture of ownership, quality and continuous learning. 
 - Stay current with modern engineering trends and drive adoption where they create measurable business value. Preferred Experience

- Healthcare, SaaS, Enterprise Software, Logistics or FinTech. 
 - Zero-to-one product development and platform modernization. 
 - Experience building high-scale, cloud-native systems. 
 - Exposure to regulated environments and enterprise integrations.
