data.description:
Job Description

The Developer Platform Builder Tools organization is responsible for building the next generation of developer productivity platforms, intelligent development workflows, and AI-powered engineering tools that accelerate software delivery across the enterprise. We are seeking a highly motivated Software Development Engineer (IC3) to design, build, and operate scalable platform services and developer tools that enhance engineering productivity through automation and AI-driven capabilities. 

In this role, you will design and build Agentic AI capabilities that help developers understand complex cloud systems, generate and improve code, troubleshoot failures, automate repetitive workflows, reason over logs and documentation, interact with OCI services, and safely execute multi-step development tasks. These systems will combine large language models, retrieval-augmented generation, tool use, workflow orchestration, code intelligence, cloud APIs, and enterprise-grade safety controls. 

This is an excellent opportunity for engineers who are passionate about building large-scale distributed systems, developer platforms, and AI-enabled engineering solutions that improve how thousands of engineers build, deploy, and operate software. 

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

- Design, build, and operate Agentic AI-powered developer tools for the OCI Developer Tools organization. 
 - Develop AI agents that assist with code authoring, debugging, test generation, build failure analysis, deployment guidance, infrastructure automation, cloud diagnostics, and developer workflow optimization. 
 - Build systems that combine LLMs, retrieval-augmented generation, tool calling, workflow orchestration, code intelligence, structured outputs, and OCI service APIs. 
 - Create agent workflows that can reason across source code, SDKs, APIs, CLI commands, documentation, build logs, telemetry, repositories, deployment artifacts, and cloud resource metadata. 
 - Design safe and reliable agent execution patterns, including human-in-the-loop approval, guardrails, access control, audit logging, tool-use constraints, error recovery, and policy-aware automation. 
 - Partner with product managers, UX designers, developer relations, cloud service teams, security, and infrastructure teams to translate developer pain points into scalable AI product capabilities. 
 - Build evaluation frameworks for developer-facing AI systems, including task success, code correctness, grounding quality, tool-call accuracy, hallucination detection, latency, cost, safety, and regression metrics. 
 - Contribute to platform architecture for AI-assisted development, including agent runtimes, context management, prompt orchestration, model routing, evaluation pipelines, telemetry, and feedback loops. 
 - Ensure AI-powered developer tools meet OCI standards for security, privacy, reliability, compliance, operational readiness, scalability, and enterprise-grade quality. 
 - Provide technical leadership through design documents, architecture reviews, code reviews, mentoring, prototyping, and cross-team technical alignment. 
 - Stay current with advances in Agentic AI, LLM application design, AI coding assistants, developer productivity tools, cloud-native development, and responsible AI, and apply them pragmatically to OCI products. 

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, or a related technical field, with 5+ years experience. 
 - Strong professional experience designing and building large-scale distributed systems, developer platforms, cloud services, or enterprise software products. 
 - Hands-on experience building applications using large language models, including prompt design, structured outputs, function calling, tool use, retrieval-augmented generation, or AI workflow orchestration. 
 - Practical understanding of Agentic AI patterns, including planning, reasoning loops, task decomposition, tool invocation, memory, context management, agent state, and autonomous or semi-autonomous execution. 
 - Strong programming experience in one or more languages such as Java, Python, Go, or similar. 
 - Experience building developer-facing tools such as CLIs, SDKs, APIs, IDE extensions, build systems, CI/CD platforms, testing frameworks, observability tools, infrastructure-as-code tooling, or cloud development platforms. 
 - Strong understanding of modern software development workflows, including source control, code review, testing, build automation, deployment pipelines, release management, and production operations. 
 - Experience with cloud-native architecture, including microservices, APIs, containers, distributed systems, asynchronous workflows, authentication, authorization, and service observability. 
 - Familiarity with AI/ML infrastructure components such as embedding models, vector databases, model serving, model evaluation, telemetry, and experimentation frameworks. 
 - Ability to reason about risks in AI-powered developer tools, including incorrect code generation, hallucinated APIs, prompt injection, unsafe tool execution, data leakage, permission misuse, and unreliable automation. 
 - Demonstrated ability to lead complex technical projects independently, influence architecture across teams, and deliver high-quality production systems. 
 - Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical decisions to engineering, product, and leadership audiences. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience building AI coding assistants, developer copilots, autonomous debugging agents, test generation systems, build failure analyzers, cloud troubleshooting agents, or AI-powered DevOps tools. 
 - Experience with agent frameworks or orchestration technologies such as LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, AutoGen, CrewAI, or custom agent runtimes. 
 - Experience with commercial or open-source LLM ecosystems such as OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, Cohere, Meta Llama, Mistral, or enterprise-hosted models. 
 - Experience designing systems that reason over large codebases, dependency graphs, APIs, SDKs, cloud service documentation, build artifacts, logs, metrics, traces, and runtime telemetry. 
 - Deep understanding of developer experience, developer productivity, software engineering workflows, and cloud application development. 
 - Experience with OCI, especially in areas such as developer tools, DevOps, cloud automation, identity, observability, infrastructure provisioning, networking, compute, storage, or managed AI services. 
 - Experience with Kubernetes, containers, Terraform, CI/CD systems, workflow engines, message queues, distributed job execution, or service deployment platforms. 
 - Knowledge of secure software supply chain practices, including artifact integrity, dependency scanning, secrets handling, policy enforcement, provenance, and deployment governance. 
 - Experience building RAG systems with semantic retrieval, hybrid search, reranking, chunking strategies, grounding validation, citation-aware responses, and access-controlled retrieval. 
 - Experience evaluating LLM and agentic systems using golden datasets, synthetic test generation, human review, automated scoring, red teaming, online experimentation, and regression testing. 
 - Experience optimizing AI-powered systems for latency, throughput, reliability, token efficiency, cost, model selection, and service availability. 
 - Track record of technical leadership through architecture ownership, patents, publications, open-source contributions, platform delivery, or high-impact developer tooling initiatives. 
 - Experience mentoring engineers and raising the engineering bar across a team, platform, or organization. 

Qualifications

Career Level - IC3

Head - Production System Automation (PSA)Company:   Srinivas Fine Arts Pvt. Ltd. (SFA)

Location:   Attibele, Bengaluru, Karnataka

Experience:   12-15 years

Industry:   Printing Technology | Workflow Automation | Digital Printing | Print-on-Demand

About the OpportunitySrinivas Fine Arts (SFA) is establishing an advanced, technology-driven Print-on-Demand (POD) facility in Bengaluru, integrating digital printing equipment, intelligent production workflows and automated finishing systems. 

We are seeking an experienced  Head - Production System Automation (PSA)  to design, implement and manage automated production workflows connecting digital files, prepress systems, printing equipment and finishing operations. 

This is a hands-on technical leadership position for a professional who understands both the software and the practical realities of industrial print production. 

Key Responsibilities
 - Workflow Automation:   Lead the implementation and optimisation of automated prepress, imposition, job batching and production release workflows. 
 - System Integration:   Coordinate the integration of production workflow software with digital printing equipment and downstream finishing systems. 
 - Automated Preflight:   Configure rules-based file validation, error detection and automated job processing. 
 - Imposition & Batching:   Develop automated imposition, ganging and batching rules based on book specifications, paper type, trim size, binding and printing requirements. 
 - Job Tracking:   Implement QR-code-based job identification, routing and production-stage tracking. 
 - Finishing Integration:   Ensure accurate job data flows to binding, trimming, folding, laminating and cutting equipment. 
 - Exception Management:   Monitor failed or interrupted workflows, resolve production bottlenecks and minimise manual intervention. 
 - Testing & Commissioning:   Work closely with equipment manufacturers, software vendors and production teams during installation, integration, acceptance testing and commissioning. 
 - Process Documentation:   Maintain workflow configurations, automation rules, change-control procedures and operating documentation. 
 - Continuous Improvement:   Identify opportunities to improve throughput, reduce production errors and automate additional stages of the manufacturing process. 
 - Team Development:   Lead and train production automation specialists and prepress automation personnel. Required Qualifications & Experience
 - 12-15 years of experience in prepress automation, printing production workflows or print technology integration. 
 - Strong understanding of automated imposition, workflow servers, preflight systems and job ticketing. 
 - Practical experience with JDF-based workflows and production data exchange. 
 - Experience implementing rules-based workflow automation in a commercial or industrial printing environment. 
 - Ability to troubleshoot software-to-equipment integration issues. 
 - Proven experience coordinating with printing equipment manufacturers, software vendors and production teams. 
 - Strong technical leadership, analytical problem-solving and documentation skills. Preferred Experience
 - Experience in digital book production, print-on-demand or high-volume short-run printing. 
 - Familiarity with industry workflow automation platforms and production integration technologies. 
 - Experience connecting prepress workflow systems with automated binding and finishing equipment. 
 - Knowledge of scripting, workflow rules configuration or production automation programming. 
 - Exposure to barcode/QR-based tracking, camera inspection systems or automated sortation. What Success Looks LikeYou will help establish a highly automated production environment where jobs move seamlessly from digital files through printing and finishing, with minimal manual handling. 

Success will be measured through automation coverage, reduced exceptions, accurate job routing, workflow reliability and production efficiency. 

Why Join SFA?This is an opportunity to play a central role in developing a next-generation Print-on-Demand manufacturing infrastructure, combining print engineering, industrial automation and digital technologies. 

You will be involved from the implementation and commissioning stages, with significant ownership of the facility's production automation strategy. 

- Interested candidates are invited to apply through LinkedIn with their updated resume.

data.title: Quantitative Developer - HFT
data.description:
C++ Engineer

Location: On-site (Hyderabad)

Type: Full-Time

Reports To: Founder

About PHNX Securities

https: //www. phnxsecurities. com/

PHNX Securities is a next-generation quantitative trading firm, focused on systematic, research-driven strategies. Our approach combines deep market understanding with robust engineering - emphasizing clean execution infrastructure, rigorous backtesting, strict risk controls, and full regulatory readiness. 

Our Mission

To combine advanced research, automation, and disciplined risk management to create scalable, repeatable, high-conviction quantitative strategies across global markets. 

Role Overview

We are looking for a strong C++ engineer with a passion for performance and low-latency systems to build and optimize the core trading infrastructure at PHNX Securities. 

This is a deeply technical engineering role - the primary focus is writing high-performance, production-grade C++ for systems where microseconds matter. You will work on order management, execution, and market data infrastructure that runs live in exchange-connected environments. A basic understanding of trading systems and market structure is expected, but elite C++ engineering is what this role demands first. 

Key Responsibilities

- Design and develop ultra-low-latency trading systems in modern C++ (C++17/20)
 - Build and optimize the Order Management System (OMS) - order routing, pre-trade risk checks, execution handling and fills
 - Profile, benchmark, and systematically reduce end-to-end latency across application, kernel, and network layers
 - Write cache-friendly, lock-free, and memory-efficient code - optimizing at the hardware level including CPU pinning, NUMA awareness, memory alignment, and cache utilization
 - Work on kernel bypass and NIC-level optimizations (DPDK, Solarflare)
 - Collaborate with quant researchers to productionize strategies and ensure system reliability, determinism, and correctness under real-time production conditions
 - Build and maintain market data infrastructure - feed parsing, normalization, and distribution to internal consumers 
 - Own the full execution pipeline - from strategy signal through OMS to order on exchange  

Required Skills & Experience

C++ Engineering

- Deep expertise in C++ (C++17/20) - lock-free data structures, concurrent programming, templates, move semantics, and RAII
 - Memory management - custom allocators, memory pools, zero-copy techniques, and avoiding dynamic allocation on hot paths
 - Low-latency fundamentals - CPU cache hierarchy, cache-friendly code, false sharing avoidance, memory alignment, CPU affinity, and thread pinning
 - SIMD/vectorization (SSE/AVX) and shared memory IPC for zero-latency inter-process communication
 - Linux systems - kernel tuning for low latency (IRQ affinity, CPU isolation, huge pages), POSIX threading, real-time scheduling (SCHED_FIFO)
 - Profiling and benchmarking - perf, valgrind, flamegraphs, and the ability to systematically identify and eliminate bottlenecksTrading & Domain Knowledge

- Strong understanding of Order Management Systems (OMS), order lifecycle, and pre-trade risk checks
 - Experience with FIX protocol and/or exchange-native APIs
 - Ability to consume, parse, and process high-frequency tick data (market data handling)
 - Familiarity with NSE trading systems, exchange connectivity, and market microstructurePreferred (Nice to Have)

- Exposure to time synchronization (PTP/PPS) and hardware timestamping
 - Experience with tick-level simulation and backtesting infrastructure
 - Knowledge of multicast market data - PIM-SM, IGMP·            Familiarity with FPGA-based acceleration for ultra-low latency execution or market data processing

Candidate Profile

- Obsessed with performance - measures everything, assumes nothing
 - Strong systems thinker who understands the full stack from hardware to application
 - Disciplined and precise - in HFT, bugs are expensive
 - Comfortable working in a small, high-ownership environment with direct impact on live trading
 - Passionate about low-latency engineering, not just tradingWhy Join PHNX Securities

- Build performance-critical systems from the ground up
 - Work directly with the Founder and core trading infrastructure team
 - High ownership and real impact on live trading systems
 - Exposure to real exchange-connected environments and live trading
 - Opportunity to shape the firm's engineering foundation

data.title: Supplier Development - Sourcing Analyst
data.description:
Supplier Development Professional - Engineer (Level 2)

About Milacron

We serve the primary market segment: Milacron Injection, Molding & Extrusion (MIME), which designs, manufactures, and sells injection and extrusion equipment, co-injection systems and related parts and services. 

THE ROLE

Milacron's global Supplier Development organization is seeking a results-oriented Supplier Development Engineer to improve supplier delivery and quality performance across an assigned portfolio of suppliers, commodities, or regions. 

The Supplier Development organization provides technical guidance in the use of core quality management tools, including FAI, PPAP, SPC, FMEA, Control Plans, constraint management, and structured problem analysis. The group coordinates supplier training to drive process consistency, works with underperforming suppliers to improve On-Time Delivery (OTD) and non-conformance rates using methods such as 8D and A3, evaluates prospective and existing suppliers, reports supplier performance, and acts proactively when quality trends warrant. It also manages safe launch initiatives for new supplier and product sourcing and serves as the liaison between Engineering, Procurement, Quality, and Operations. 

Reporting to Global Supplier Development, the Supplier Development Engineer independently leads supplier performance improvement and manages the day-to-day relationship with an assigned supplier base. The role owns supplier performance metrics for that portfolio, leads supplier corrective actions, independently conducts supplier audits, and leads medium-complexity supplier development projects. The Supplier Development Engineer serves as the team resource for assigned commodities or regions and supports coaching newer engineers in problem-solving methods and quality tools. Complex, multi-site, or strategic supplier escalations are led by the Senior Supplier Development Engineer or Manager with support from this role. 

General Characteristics

To perform this role successfully, the candidate must demonstrate the following skills, aptitudes, and abilities: 

- Process- and results-driven, with solid project management skills
 - Applies Quality Engineering principles to deliver measurable results
 - Self-starter who works independently on an assigned supply base and escalates complex or strategic issues appropriately
 - Builds effective cross-functional and supplier working relationships through sound product and process knowledge
 - Communicates and influences effectively with supplier management and internal stakeholders
 - Exercises sound technical judgment when balancing competing priorities, cost, and supply risk
 - Proficient oral and written communication skills, including clear reporting of supplier performance
 - Proficient in English, written and verbal; additional fluency in Spanish, German, or Chinese is beneficial
 - Supports leadership in achieving department and corporate goals
 - Willing and able to travel up to 50%, domestically and internationally

SPECIFIC ROLE SKILLS And RESPONSIBILITIES

- Independently lead supplier performance improvement for an assigned portfolio of suppliers, commodities, or regions
 - Own and report supplier performance metrics for the assigned supply base, including On-Time Delivery, non-conformance rate, and corrective action closure, and act when trends decline
 - Manage day-to-day supplier relationships, serving as the primary technical point of contact for assigned suppliers
 - Lead supplier corrective actions using structured problem solving (8D, A3, 5-Why); verify root cause, validate containment, and confirm that actions prevent recurrence
 - Independently plan and conduct supplier manufacturing process and quality system audits, document findings, and drive corrective actions to closure
 - Lead medium-complexity supplier development projects, including capability improvement, process capability studies, and resourcing support
 - Apply core quality tool concepts, including SPC, FMEA, Control Plans, and measurement system analysis, during supplier process reviews
 - Support safe launch activity for new suppliers and newly sourced parts so launches meet quality and delivery targets. Assist in the part qualification and certification process. 
 - Serve as the team resource for assigned commodities or regions, sharing process knowledge and lessons learned across the department
 - Support & coach the onboarding of new Supplier Development engineers and specialists in department tools, standard work, and problem-solving methods
 - Coordinate with Procurement, Engineering, Operations, and Quality to resolve systemic supplier technical issues and maintain continuity of supply, escalating complex or strategic issues to the Senior Supplier Development Engineer or Manager

Experience

- 4+ years of experience in Supplier Development, Supplier Quality, or Manufacturing Quality Engineering within a manufacturing environment, or comparable work experience
 - Demonstrated use of structured problem-solving methodology to drive supplier quality issues to closure
 - Experience in print reading and Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing (GD&T)
 - Experience conducting supplier manufacturing process and quality system audits
 - Working knowledge of quality standards such as ISO 9001 and ISO 14001
 - Familiarity with US and international measurement standards, methods, and instrumentation
 - Experience working within cross-functional teams, including Engineering and Manufacturing
 - Casting, fabrication, and machining process experience preferred
 - Experience in a high-mix, low-volume global manufacturing business preferred
 - Working knowledge of electrical, electronic, and hydraulic component applications desired

Education

- BE or BS or BA degree from an accredited four-year college or university in an engineering, technical, or supply chain related discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and experience; BS in Engineering preferred

Who We Are

Milacron is a global industrial leader in the manufacturing and distribution of highly engineered and customized injection molding and extrusion solutions, and aftermarket parts and service for the plastics processing industry. The company's 1, 900+ associates worldwide collaborate to serve a diverse range of end-markets, such as automotive, construction, medical, telecommunications, material handling, packaging, and much more. With expertise in plastics spanning nearly 60 years, Milacron holds longstanding relationships with more than 27, 000 customers around the world. The original equipment provider of plastics manufacturing solutions is the largest US-owned and globally served of its kind. Headquartered in Batavia, OH, Milacron's global footprint is also serviced through regional facilities in Asia, Europe, and South America. 

Eeo

The policy of Milacron is to extend opportunities to qualified applicants and employees on an equal basis regardless of an individual's age, race, color, sex, religion, national origin, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression or veteran status. We are committed to being an Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) Employer and offer opportunities to all job seekers including individuals with disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation to assist with your job search or application for employment, email us at recruitingaccommodations@milacron. com. In your email, please include a description of the specific accommodation you are requesting as well as the job title and requisition number of the position for which you are applying.

Position Snapshot

Position Title : Asst Director (Head) - Projects

Function: Projects & Infrastructure Development

Reports To : Chief Operating Officer

Key External Interfaces : PMC, EPC Contractor, Architects and Consultants, Government and Statutory Authorities, Industry Members

Role Purpose

The Asst Director (Head)- Projects takes charge of a live, multi-building jewellery park and Gem Bourse infrastructure projects in its construction phase. The PMC and EPC contractor are already appointed, designs are released and site work has started. The role is accountable for delivering the project on time, within approved budget, to the specified quality and in full statutory compliance. 

The incumbent will act as the owner's lead, directing the PMC and EPC contractor, closing remaining design and package gaps, and representing the organisation before government and statutory authorities. The role suits a leader who can step into a running project, assess its status quickly, and take it through to occupation certificate and handover. 

Key Responsibilities

1. Project Strategy, Planning and Governance

- Own the project master plan, phasing, master schedule and the approved budget baseline. 
 - Prepare and present periodic progress, cost and risk reports to the COO & Project Steering Committee, Governing Council and other competent bodies. 
 - Establish project governance: delegation of authority, review forums, change-control and decision logs. 2. Design Management and Change Control

- Ensure approved drawings are released to site on time, and that design queries and RFIs from the EPC and PMC are closed without holding up work. 
 - Control design changes after release through a formal change-control process, with cost, time and approval impact assessed before sign-off. 
 - Track pending design deliverables such as shop drawings, MEP coordination and fit-out guidelines with the architect and consultants. 
 - Review value engineering and constructability proposals, and keep the design aligned to the approved concept and budget. 3. PMC and EPC Performance Management

- Act as the owner's representative on the PMC and EPC contracts, holding both accountable to the approved scope, programme, budget and quality plan. 
 - Review the PMC's monthly reports independently, verify progress on site, and test bill certification for over-measurement or delay. 
 - Manage EPC contract administration: running bills, variations, extension of time, claims, retention and dispute resolution. 
 - Run weekly site reviews and monthly performance reviews with action trackers, and issue documented notices for non-performance. 
 - Check PMC team strength and deliverables against its appointment terms, and press for replacement where needed. 
 - Complete award of any balance or specialist packages (for example interiors, external development, specialised MEP, security systems) in line with procurement policy. 4. Construction Execution, Quality and Safety

- Drive site execution to the approved schedule; remove bottlenecks and run weekly and monthly site reviews. 
 - Enforce quality assurance plans, material approvals, testing and third-party inspections. 
 - Enforce HSE standards, safe working practices and labour compliance across all contractors. 
 - Oversee testing, commissioning, snagging, handover and project closure documentation. 5. Government Liaisoning and Statutory Compliance

- Lead engagement with central, state and local authorities for land, layout and building approvals, environmental clearance, fire, utilities, traffic and other NOCs. 
 - Manage the occupation certificate and completion approvals, and maintain a live compliance tracker. 
 - Represent the organisation before the nodal ministry, development authorities and civic bodies, and follow up on pending approvals and policy matters. 
 - Coordinate with utility providers for power, water, sewerage, telecom and connectivity. 6. Finance, Contracts and Procurement

- Certify bills with PMC, and oversee reconciliation, audit and statutory reporting. 
 - Ensure transparent, auditable procurement and contract documentation, with clear records for audit and vigilance purposes. 
 - Manage insurance, bank guarantees, performance securities and retention. 7. Risk, Team and Closure

- Maintain the project risk register with mitigation plans, and escalate critical risks in time. 
 - Build and lead the project team, and set KRAs and review performance of direct reports. 
 - Ensure handover to operations, with O&M manuals, as-built drawings, warranties and defect liability tracking. 

Required Education

- Essential: B. E. / B. Tech in Civil Engineering or Architecture from a recognised institution. 
 - Desirable: M. Tech (Construction Management), MBA or PGDM in Project Management; PMP / PgMP; membership of a professional body such as IIA, ICI or IEI. 

Required Experience

- 15 to 20 years in project and construction management, of which at least 8 to 10 years in a senior leadership role. 
 - Proven record of delivering at least one large project (built-up area of 10 lakh sq. ft. or more, or project value of Rs 500 crore or more) from approvals to completion, such as an industrial park, SEZ, commercial complex, convention centre or township. 
 - Hands-on experience of directing a PMC and EPC contractor under item-rate or lump-sum contracts, including FIDIC or CPWD / PWD style conditions; experience of taking over a live project mid-construction is preferred. 
 - Demonstrated experience of dealing with government and statutory bodies (development authorities, municipal corporations, MoEFCC / SEIAA, fire, electricity and water authorities). 
 - Experience in a government, PSU, trade body or public-private partnership setting is preferred. 

Required Technical Competencies

- Project planning and scheduling tools (MS Project, Primavera P6), cost control and earned-value management. 
 - Contract management: tendering, bid evaluation, variations, claims, arbitration and dispute resolution. 
 - Working knowledge of RERA, building bye-laws, DCPR, environmental and labour laws, and the BOCW Act.

data.description:
WD is building the infrastructure behind the AI-driven data economy. 

As AI scales, so does data. Every interaction, every model, every system generates data that must be stored, managed, and made accessible over time. That's where we come in. 

We combine deep engineering expertise with global-scale manufacturing to deliver the storage systems that make AI possible, powering hyperscale data centers, cloud platforms, and enterprise infrastructure worldwide. 

This isn't theoretical work. It's real systems, at real scale, people solving some of the hardest challenges in technology today. 

We're looking for people who want to build, solve, and operate at that level. 

Join us and let's shape the future of data. 

Job Description

We are looking for a technically strong and experienced AI Engineering Manager to lead an AI engineering team responsible for designing, architecting, and delivering enterprise-scale AI applications and data engineering platforms. 

The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in Data Engineering, Generative AI, Agentic AI, cloud technologies, and enterprise application development. This role combines people leadership, technical ownership, and delivery management. The individual will be responsible for building and leading the AI engineering team, defining technical direction, managing priorities and execution, mentoring team members, and ensuring successful delivery of scalable, secure, and production-ready enterprise solutions. 

The candidate should be capable of translating business requirements into technology solutions and driving initiatives from conceptualisation and proof of concept through production deployment and ongoing operations. 

Key Responsibilities

- Team Leadership & Management: Lead and manage the AI and Data Engineering team, define responsibilities, allocate resources, manage priorities, track progress, and ensure effective execution. Mentor and develop team members, provide regular feedback, and foster a culture of technical excellence and accountability. 

- Technical Leadership & Architecture: Define end-to-end architecture for enterprise AI and data solutions, establish engineering standards, drive technical decisions, and guide teams in building scalable and secure applications. 

- Data Engineering: Design and manage scalable ETL/ELT pipelines, data integration frameworks, enterprise data platforms, and batch and real-time data processing solutions. 

- Generative AI & Agentic AI: Architect and develop LLM-powered applications, RAG solutions, AI assistants, intelligent agents, and multi-agent orchestration frameworks for enterprise use cases. 

- Enterprise Application Development: Lead the development of scalable full-stack enterprise applications using Python, FastAPI, and React, including backend services, REST APIs, and microservices. 

- AI Integration & Automation: Integrate LLMs and AI agents with enterprise systems, databases, and business applications using MCP servers, APIs, and agentic frameworks. 

- Data & Knowledge Architecture: Design solutions using vector databases, graph databases, knowledge graphs, and relational/NoSQL databases to enable semantic search and intelligent information retrieval. 

- Cloud & Platform Engineering: Build and deploy cloud-native applications on AWS using Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, and GitOps practices. 

- Real-Time Data Processing: Design distributed processing and real-time streaming architectures using Apache Kafka and related technologies. 

- Stakeholder Collaboration: Partner with business stakeholders, product owners, and cross-functional teams to translate business requirements into technical solutions. Communicate technical concepts, project progress, risks, and dependencies effectively. 

- Delivery & Operational Excellence: Own end-to-end engineering delivery, manage timelines and dependencies, conduct architecture and code reviews, and ensure application quality, security, scalability, reliability, and production readiness. 

Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, with 10+ years of relevant industry experience. 

- Minimum 2 years of experience leading AI, Data Engineering, or Software Engineering teams, including people management, mentoring, technical decision-making, resource planning, and project delivery. 

- Strong understanding of computer science fundamentals, data structures, algorithms, distributed systems, and software architecture. 

- Strong programming experience in Python and hands-on expertise in FastAPI for developing enterprise applications, backend services, REST APIs, and microservices. 

- Extensive experience in Data Engineering, including ETL/ELT, data integration, batch processing, and real-time streaming pipelines. 

- Hands-on experience with AWS, Amazon Redshift, Snowflake, PostgreSQL, and SQL/NoSQL databases. 

- Practical experience building Generative AI applications using LLMs, RAG architectures, embeddings, and AI orchestration frameworks. 

- Experience with Agentic AI, AI agents, tool calling, multi-step orchestration, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers. 

- Experience with vector databases, graph databases, semantic search, and knowledge graphs. 

- Experience with distributed processing and streaming technologies such as Apache Spark and Apache Kafka. 

- Strong understanding of Docker, Kubernetes, microservices, CI/CD, and cloud-native application deployment. 

- Proven ability to take AI solutions from proof of concept to production, ensuring scalability, security, reliability, and performance. 

- Strong people management, communication, analytical, problem-solving, stakeholder management, and team leadership skills. 

Additional Information

data.title: Staff Engineer STA Methodology & Sign-off Lead
data.description:
Staff Engineer: STA Methodology & Sign-off Lead

Hybrid: 2 Days work from Office

Bangalore

EnCharge AI is a leader in advanced AI hardware and software systems for edge-to-cloud computing. EnCharge's robust and scalable next-generation in-memory computing technology provides orders-of-magnitude higher compute efficiency and density compared to today's best-in-class solutions. The high-performance architecture is coupled with seamless software integration and will enable the immense potential of AI to be accessible in power, energy, and space constrained applications. EnCharge AI launched in 2022 and is led by veteran technologists with backgrounds in semiconductor design and AI systems. 

Staff Engineer: STA Methodology & Sign-off Lead

We are seeking a high-caliber Staff or Senior Staff Engineer to architect and lead our SOC Static Timing Analysis (STA) Methodology along with execution responsibilities to eliminate the bottle-necks in STA and build bridges. 

This is a critical role for a forward-thinking engineer who excels at defining the frameworks and flows required to navigate the complexities of modern, large-scale SOC designs. Engineer will have scope to bridge Architecture, CAD, RTL, and Physical Design to establish a predictable, high-performance, and scalable path to tape-out. 

The Role As the lead for STA Methodology, you will own the sign-off architecture and the timing convergence strategy. Rather than just executing runs, you will build the "engine" that enables execution-defining flows, qualifying tools, establishing margin strategies (AOCV/LVF/POCV), and driving cross-functional alignment to meet aggressive Power, Performance, and Area (PPA) targets. 

Key Responsibilities

- Sign-off Methodology & Architecture: Define and own full-chip SOC timing sign-off criteria, including Multi-Mode Multi-Corner (MMMC) definitions, derate strategies, and operating condition mapping for functional, shift, and capture modes. 
 - Flow Development & Left-Shift Automation: Architect, deploy, and maintain advanced STA and ECO flows. Develop methodologies to proactively identify structural timing issues and predict physical design bottlenecks early in the RTL/Synthesis phases. 
 - Tool Benchmarking & Deployment: Evaluate, qualify, and deploy new EDA tool features and capabilities (with a strong emphasis on Cadence Tempus) to improve Quality of Results (QoR), optimize memory/runtime efficiency, and streamline hierarchical timing models. 
 - Custom Automation Infrastructure: Architect scalable, robust automation utilities (Tcl, Python, Perl) to standardize constraint (SDC) management, automate cross-domain timing audits, and accelerate the ECO loop across distributed design teams. 
 - Cross-Functional Enablement: Partner with Physical Design to define optimal clock tree synthesis (CTS) methodologies and floorplanning guidelines. Guide DFT and RTL teams on methodology to resolve structural bottlenecks (e. g. , NoC timing, complex CDC paths). Requirements & Qualifications

- Experience: 8 to 11 years of hands-on experience in VLSI design, with a primary focus on STA Methodology, flow development, and sign-off criteria at advanced process nodes (7nm, 5nm, or below). 
 - Technical Mastery: 
 - Deep expertise in building flows around industry-standard sign-off tools, with a strong preference for Cadence Tempus. 
 - Mastery of Multi-Mode Multi-Corner (MMMC) flow architecture, Hierarchical (ILM/ETM) vs. Flat timing strategies, and constraint (SDC) validation methodologies. 
 - Strong understanding of advanced node timing phenomena, including waveform propagation, crosstalk, and statistical margining (LVF/POCV). 
 - Critical Thinking: Proven ability to architect broad flow solutions and debug systemic tool or methodology bottlenecks, rather than just fixing isolated timing violations. 
 - Soft Skills: Strong leadership presence with the ability to define technical standards, influence cross-functional teams, and drive methodology adoption in a fast-paced, high-growth environment. 
 - Education: B. Tech/M. Tech in Electrical/Electronics Engineering or a related field.

data.title: Test & Certification Engineer
data.description:
About CynLr

Just like a baby's brain, CynLr Visual Intelligence stack makes Robots to instinctively see & pick any object under any ambience, without any training. (a demo video link). 

Today, a robot that can fit a screw into a nut without slipping a thread, doesn't exist. Imagine what it would take for a robot to assemble a Smartphone or a car by putting together 1000s of parts with varied shapes and weights, all in random orientations. Thus, factories become complex, needing heavy customization of their environment. 

CynLr-enabled visual robots intuitively learn to handle even unknown objects, on-the-fly, eliminating the need for rigid fixtures, pre-training, or environment customization. This enables an universal alternative to custom automation thus simplifying factory lines into modular LEGO-like micro-factories that can be rapidly reconfigured as products change. 

At the core of CynLr lies a fundamentally new approach to machine vision. Unlike conventional vision systems that rely on image recognition and heuristics, CynLr' s Vision and ML stacks are deeply inspired by neuroscience, modelling how biological vision understands shape, geometry, and interaction rather than appearance alone. To support this, CynLr builds its hardware, sensors, compute pipelines, and learning stacks from scratch, tightly coupling perception, decision-making, and action. 

This integration allows CynLr to operate in conditions that defeat traditional automation: variable lighting, cluttered environments, unknown objects, and high precision manipulation, unlocking automation use cases that have remained unsolved for decades. By rethinking vision as an intelligent, adaptive sense rather than a static tool, CynLr is redefining how robots perceive, reason, and interact with the physical world. 

About The Role

A robot that works in the lab is a prototype. A robot that can be sold, shipped and trusted around people is a certified product. The gap between the two is made of standards, test evidence and engineering discipline. 

CynLr's hardware spans an unusually wide range: the CLX dynamic stereo vision system with 400+ parts, the multi-arm CyRo robot, in-house robotic arms, high-power battery packs, and upcoming mobility platforms such as quadrupeds and AMRs. Each brings its own safety, EMC, battery and environmental requirements across India, EU/Switzerland and US markets. 

Certification cannot be an afterthought added at the end of design. It must shape architecture, component choices and test strategy from the first design review, so that every product reaches the market without costly redesigns. 

This role spans two broad scopes that work hand in hand. The first is Test Design: building the tests, rigs and evidence that prove our products work and are safe. The second is the Test & Certification Ecosystem: building the roadmaps, standards knowledge, and lab and regulator relationships that turn that evidence into certificates. Depending on your strengths, you may lead in one scope while contributing to the other. The Product Design, Battery & Power, and Mobility teams will be your internal customers. 

What You Will Do

Position 1 - Test Designer

- Designing DVT, PVT and end-of-line test plans derived from product requirements and standards
 - Designing and building test fixtures, automated test rigs and DAQ setups
 - Running pre-compliance tests for EMC, electrical safety and environmental stress (thermal, vibration, shock, IP)
 - Reliability testing (HALT/HASS, MTBF) and root-cause analysis of failures
 - Test rigs for battery packs and for mobile-robot safety (stability, stairs, slopes, collisions)Position 2 - Test & Certification Ecosystem: 

- Building certification roadmaps for each product and target market
 - Functional safety: risk assessments, safety requirement specifications, PL/SIL calculations, FMEA/FMEDA
 - Building and managing relationships with external labs and notified bodies (TÜV, UL, Intertek, etc. )
 - Tracking regulatory changes across India, EU/Switzerland and US
 - Owning technical files, Declarations of Conformity and certification submissionsShared by both positions: 

- Embedding compliance and testability into design from day one
 - Maintaining full traceability from requirement to test to certificate
 - Acting as the test and compliance knowledge base for design engineers across the organization

What Are We Looking For

Common to both positions

- 5-8 years in product test, certification or compliance for industrial automation, robotics, automotive, EV or similar electromechanical products. 
 - Clear technical writing for test reports, risk assessments and technical files. 
 - Working exposure to all of these standards areas: 
 - Robots and machinery: ISO 10218-1/-2, ISO/TS 15066, EU Machinery Regulation (EU) 2023/1230, IEC 60204-1, ANSI/A3 R15. 06, UL 1740
 - Functional safety: ISO 13849-1/-2, IEC 62061, IEC 61508
 - Mobile robots: ISO 3691-4, ANSI/A3 R15. 08, UL 3100
 - EMC and radio: IEC 61000-6-2/-4, CISPR 11, EU RED, FCC Part 15, India WPC/TEC
 - Batteries: IEC 62133-2, IEC 62619, UL 2271, UN 38. 3, BIS IS 16046, EU Battery Regulation 2023/1542
 - Environmental: IEC 60068, IEC 60529Position 1 - Test Designer: 

- Hands-on with oscilloscopes, power analysers, EMC pre-scan equipment and DAQ systems. 
 - Experience designing test fixtures and rigs, including basic mechanical and electrical design. 
 - Test automation in Python, LabVIEW or equivalent. 
 - Strong debugging and root-cause analysis skills. Position 2 - Test & Certification Ecosystem: 

- At least one product taken through CE, UL or equivalent certification end to end. 
 - Experience with functional safety analysis and documentation. 
 - Experience working with test labs, notified bodies and regulators, and managing certification timelines and costs. Good to Have: 

- TÜV Functional Safety Engineer certification or equivalent. 
 - Experience certifying battery packs or mobile robots. 
 - Exposure to vision or optical system testing. 

Team Structure & Growth

As mentioned earlier, this role spans two broad scopes that work hand in hand. The first is Test Design: building the tests, rigs and evidence that prove our products work and are safe. The second is the Test & Certification Ecosystem: building the roadmaps, standards knowledge, and lab and regulator relationships that turn that evidence into certificates. Depending on your strengths, you may lead in one scope while contributing to the other. The Product Design, Battery & Power, and Mobility teams will be your internal customers. 

Beyond specializing in the role of Test & Certification Engineers, this position offers growth into test, compliance and quality leadership roles as the organization scales. The Test Designer can grow into test architecture, test automation and reliability engineering; the Ecosystem engineer into functional safety, product compliance management and regulatory strategy. 

The role can also evolve into cross-functional and customer-facing opportunities such as supplier quality, customer audits, regulatory strategy for new markets and solution engineering, based on individual interests and business needs.

data.title: Head of AI Engineering & Center of Excellence (CoE)
data.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Head of AI Engineering

& Center of Excellence (CoE)

1. Role Overview

Our company is seeking a senior technology leader to establish and lead its AI Engineering Center of Excellence (CoE), driving the adoption of AI across enterprise engineering, insurance technology platforms, product development, and operational workflows. 

The Head of AI Engineering & CoE will define AI engineering strategy, establish reusable AI architectures and frameworks, enable AI-assisted software development, and deliver scalable, secure, measurable AI solutions. The role combines technical leadership, architecture governance, engineering enablement, and people development. 

A core objective is to turn individual AI experiments and isolated implementations into reusable enterprise capabilities that support Solartis's product-platform strategy. 

1. Key Responsibilities

A. AI Engineering Strategy and CoE Leadership

Establish the CoE charter, operating model, service offerings, engagement model, and delivery priorities. 

Develop an AI engineering roadmap aligned with product strategy, technology priorities, and business objectives. 

Identify opportunities to standardize AI capabilities and reduce duplicated implementations. 

Define reference architectures, reusable patterns, implementation guidelines, and approved technology frameworks. 

Partner with the CTO and engineering leadership to prioritize AI investments based on business value, feasibility, risk, and expected return. 

Establish processes to evaluate AI initiatives, productionize successful pilots, and retire ineffective or duplicated solutions. 

B. Enterprise AI Architecture and Shared Frameworks

Define scalable architectures for LLMs, SLMs, RAG, vector search, orchestration, and model integration. 

Design reusable AI services, APIs, SDKs, libraries, reference implementations, and deployment patterns. 

Establish patterns for model selection, prompt management, context engineering, embeddings, document processing, inference, and lifecycle management. 

Evaluate AI frameworks, models, infrastructure, and platforms for performance, cost, security, scalability, and maintainability. 

Define integration patterns for AI capabilities within existing platforms, services, applications, and development workflows. 

Guide build-versus-buy decisions across managed AI services, open-source models, and internally developed capabilities. 

C. AI-Assisted Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC)

Define and implement AI-assisted SDLC practices across requirements analysis, code generation, code understanding, test generation, code review, documentation, debugging, and maintenance. 

Establish standards for responsible use of AI coding assistants and developer productivity tools. 

Build reusable workflows and accelerators integrated with development environments, repositories, CI/CD pipelines, and quality processes. 

Measure impact on cycle time, defect rates, rework, code quality, and developer experience. 

Ensure AI adoption complements peer review, automated testing, security scanning, and release governance. 

Work with engineering leaders to drive adoption and develop team-level enablement plans. 

D. RAG, MCP, Agentic AI, and Reusable AI Services

Architect production-grade RAG solutions covering ingestion, parsing, chunking, metadata extraction, indexing, retrieval, reranking, and grounded generation. 

Establish reusable patterns for agents, tool orchestration, workflow automation, context management, and human-in-the-loop processing. 

Define appropriate Model Context Protocol (MCP) patterns for controlled access to enterprise tools, data, and services. 

Develop common components for model access, prompt/context management, retrieval, tool integration, evaluation, telemetry, and error handling. 

Define safeguards for permissions, data access, execution boundaries, auditability, failure recovery, and human approval. 

Apply agentic AI selectively where it delivers measurable value and avoid unnecessary complexity in deterministic workflows. 

E. AI-Assisted Insurance Content Processing and Parser Initiatives

Lead architecture for processing insurance documents, policy forms, underwriting guidelines, rating manuals, and related content. 

Guide pipelines that transform semi-structured and unstructured content into validated, structured insurance product definitions. 

Establish reusable capabilities for classification, parsing, extraction, semantic interpretation, rule identification, and structured output generation. 

Ensure extracted content is traceable to source documents and suitable for downstream product configuration and processing. 

Design human review and exception handling for ambiguous, incomplete, conflicting, or low-confidence outputs. 

Define evaluation datasets and measures for extraction precision/recall, completeness, rule interpretation, and downstream usability. 

Promote reusable parsers and validation components over isolated customer-specific implementations, in collaboration with insurance domain and platform teams. 

F. AI Engineering Standards, Quality, and Governance

Define standards for AI design, implementation, testing, deployment, monitoring, and maintenance. 

Establish evaluation frameworks for accuracy, groundedness, robustness, reliability, latency, cost, and use-case suitability. 

Implement safeguards against prompt injection, unauthorized data exposure, insecure tool execution, and other AI-specific threats. 

Define model and prompt versioning, traceability, observability, regression evaluation, and controlled production releases. 

Establish practices for sensitive data handling, access control, retention, audit logging, and external AI services. 

Partner with security, compliance, legal, and enterprise architecture stakeholders on applicable requirements. 

Ensure solutions have appropriate fallbacks, exception handling, human oversight, and production-readiness reviews. 

G. Technical Leadership, Mentoring, and Enablement

Provide technical leadership to AI architects and designated AI engineering teams, with accountability for architecture quality and capability development. 

Mentor existing architects in AI solution design, reusable architecture, model integration, evaluation, and production engineering. 

Establish architecture reviews, technical communities of practice, learning paths, workshops, and hands-on reference projects. 

Guide teams in evaluating alternatives, challenging assumptions, conducting impact analysis, and making sound technical decisions. 

Develop architecture decision records, implementation templates, reusable documentation, and engineering playbooks. 

Build internal capability so teams can implement AI solutions independently within agreed standards. 

H. Business Value, Delivery, and Continuous Improvement

Translate opportunities into prioritized initiatives with defined outcomes, milestones, resource needs, and success measures. 

Partner with product, engineering, and business teams to improve developer productivity, reduce manual effort, accelerate content processing, and strengthen platform scalability. 

Maintain visibility into AI initiative status, adoption, risks, operating costs, and realized benefits. 

Track production outcomes beyond proof-of-concept delivery and optimize duplicated capabilities, infrastructure, and model costs. 

Communicate progress, risks, decisions, and measurable outcomes to the CTO and senior leadership. 

3. Leadership and Decision-Making Expectations

Establish and execute the AI engineering roadmap within priorities agreed with the CTO. 

Own the technical direction and engineering standards of the AI CoE. 

Lead and develop AI architects and designated AI engineering resources. 

Make decisions within agreed enterprise architecture principles and delegated authority; escalate material cross-platform, security, and investment decisions as required. 

Challenge designs that introduce unnecessary customization, duplication, operational complexity, or technical risk. 

Balance innovation with engineering discipline, production readiness, maintainability, and measurable business outcomes. 

Influence teams beyond the direct reporting line and enable adoption across the organization. 

4. Required Qualifications and Experience

Bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, AI, Data Science, or a related discipline. 

Typically 15+ years of relevant software engineering, architecture, or technology experience, including substantial practical experience with AI/ML and modern AI application architectures. 

Demonstrated experience leading AI engineering initiatives, architecture practices, technical teams, or enterprise AI programs. 

Strong practical knowledge of LLM applications, RAG, embeddings, vector databases, prompt engineering, and model evaluation. 

Experience designing production-grade AI services, APIs, orchestration workflows, and reusable frameworks. 

Practical understanding of agentic AI, tool integration, workflow orchestration, and MCP where relevant. 

Experience with Python, APIs, distributed systems, CI/CD, automated testing, and cloud-based application deployment. 

Experience evaluating AI models and frameworks for quality, latency, cost, security, and operational complexity. 

Knowledge of AI application security, data protection, observability, model lifecycle management, and responsible AI practices. 

Demonstrated ability to mentor architects and engineers, influence technical direction, and establish standards across teams. 

Strong communication skills, including the ability to explain technical decisions to executives, business stakeholders, and engineering teams. 

5. Preferred Qualifications

Experience establishing an enterprise AI Engineering CoE or equivalent AI enablement function. 

Experience with comparable enterprise AI platforms and cloud-native AI services. 

Experience integrating AI-assisted software development tools into engineering workflows. 

Experience in insurance technology, policy administration, rating, product configuration, or document-intensive enterprise platforms. 

Experience with intelligent document processing, information extraction, rules extraction, or structured-content generation. 

Experience with enterprise knowledge systems, metadata-driven architectures, and reusable platform services. 

Familiarity with AI governance frameworks, evaluation methodologies, and production risk management. 

6. Leadership Profile

The ideal candidate combines deep technical credibility with the ability to establish a sustainable engineering practice. They can move between architecture design, hands-on problem solving, technical mentoring, organizational enablement, and executive communication. 

The candidate should build systems and teams that scale, establish standards without unnecessary bureaucracy, and translate emerging AI technologies into practical business capabilities. 

Ultimate expectation: Establish an AI Engineering CoE that strengthens Solartis's product-platform strategy, improves engineering effectiveness, accelerates AI adoption, and builds long-term organizational capability.

data.title: < ASIC > Physical Design Engineer
data.description:
Role: Senior ASIC PD Engineer

Own the end-to-end RTL-to-GDSII implementation for complex IP/SoC subsystems and build the backend team that scales it. You'll define the methodology, constraints, and quality metrics that the team shall adhere to. The team you lead will be responsible for synthesis, floor planning, P&R, clock tree synthesis, multi-corner STA, design for testability, and ECOs to achieve sign-off. You and your team will collaborate tightly not only with our RTL/digital team but also with our full-custom and full-custom layout team, integrating our full-custom design blocks into a digital-on-top mixed ASIC design. This is a hands-on technical leadership role, where you will not only set the flow and lead the team, but also personally de-risk and own the most challenging aspects of the design. 

What you'll do

- Methodology: Define and maintain a modern RTL-to-GDS flow, including constraint strategy, libraries/PDKs, UPF/CPF, and sign-off checks. 
 - Implementation: Run synthesis, floorplan, partitioning, P&R, CTS, routing, extraction, and closure.   
 - PPA & quality: Create predictable PPA targets and tracking, lead timing/power ECOs; correlate pre/post-layout timing
 - Integration: Integrate custom macros, SRAMs, and I/O, manage clocking strategy, CDC, and hierarchical/hard-macro integration with LEF. 
 - Low power: Own power intent (UPF/CPF), isolation/retention strategies, level shifting, and power-aware STA/simulation. 
 - DFT & test hooks: Partner with DFT on scan/MBIST insertion and test timing; ensure routes and constraints don't compromise test coverage or bring-up. 
 - Automation & CI: Industrialize the flow with Tcl/Python automation, reproducible configurations, metrics dashboards, and CI/CD for nightly builds and regression testing. 
 - Foundry interface: Engage with foundries on PDK updates, waiver handling, antenna/density rules, and reliability guidance; maintain the flow of information. 

Requirements

- Deep expertise in one complete tool chain (Synopsys or Cadence)
 - Hands-on experience in power-optimization techniques, including glitch reduction and activity-based power correlation (VCD/SAIF). 
 - Strong MCMM STA and timing-closure experience
 - Experience with grid planning, IR/EM analysis, and fixes. Proven floorplanning/partitioning and hierarchical integration (hard-macros, abstracts/LEF, feedthroughs, blockage strategy). 
 - UPF/CPF know-how for multi-voltage, power-gated designs, including isolation/retention and power-aware STA and sim. 
 - Scripting for automation (Tcl, Python) and version control (Git, Perforce, or similar)
 - Ability to work and lead the activities independently and assume responsibility for major decisions

Nice to have

- DFT exposure (scan planning, test timing, MBIST integration) and formal equivalence workflows. 
 - Package/board co-design awareness (bump/rail planning, SSO/PI, thermal assumptions). 
 - Experience at advanced nodes (≤ 7 nm FinFET) with multi-patterning/EUV constraints and variability considerations. 
 - Familiarity with sign-off for safety-/quality-critical markets (automotive-style reliability targets, waiver governance, documentation rigor).

data.title: Technology Controls Testing Manager
data.description:
A global, digitally enabled business that empowers a brighter future by connecting millions of people with their assets - safely, securely and responsibly. Through our two businesses MUFG Retirement Solutions and MUFG Corporate Markets, we partner with a diversified portfolio of global clients to provide robust, efficient and scalable services, purpose-built solutions and modern technology platforms that deliver world class outcomes and experiences. A member of MUFG, a global financial group, we help manage regulatory complexity, improve data management and connect people with their assets, through exceptional user experience that leverages the expertise of our people combined with scalable technology, digital connectivity and data insights. 

Overview

As an experienced Technology controls & assurance professional, you will lead the Technology Controls Function, overseeing controls documentation, controls testing and control effectiveness activities across Technology. 
The role is accountable for the operation, quality and continuous improvement of the Technology Controls Testing Regime, ensuring Technology controls are appropriately documented, consistently tested and aligned to regulatory, risk and business expectations. Working closely with Technology leadership, control owners, Risk stakeholders, Audit Delivery and Line 2 assurance providers, the role provides a single point of accountability for controls testing outcomes and associated governance activities. 
Leading a team comprising the Documentation & Controls Analyst and Controls Testers, you will establish consistent methodologies, quality standards and reporting practices that improve control maturity, strengthen governance outcomes and provide meaningful insight into the effectiveness of the Technology control environment. 
The role contributes to a proactive and sustainable controls capability by identifying recurring weaknesses, emerging risks and opportunities to strengthen governance, operational resilience and assurance outcomes across Technology. The role supports audit and regulatory activities by providing reliable controls documentation, testing outcomes and remediation validation results, while accountability for audit delivery and audit readiness remains with the Audit Delivery function. 
Key Accountabilities and main responsibilities
Strategic Focus  

- Lead the ongoing development and maturity of the Technology Controls Function, supporting a risk-based and repeatable approach to controls documentation and controls testing. 
 - Establish and maintain consistent methodologies, standards and quality frameworks across controls testing and documentation activities. 
 - Drive improvements in control maturity by identifying recurring control weaknesses, emerging risks and opportunities for uplift across the Technology control environment. 
 - Support regulatory compliance and assurance obligations through ongoing oversight of Technology controls across key risk domains. 
 - Promote a culture of proactive control management, continuous improvement and evidence-based decision-making across Technology. 
Operational Management  

- Develop and maintain annual and quarterly controls testing plans, ensuring coverage aligns with Technology risks, regulatory obligations, material changes and assurance requirements. 
 - Manage and oversee the activities of the Documentation & Controls Analyst and Controls Testers, ensuring delivery priorities align with Technology risk, control and governance objectives. 
 - Oversee the execution of design effectiveness and operating effectiveness testing, ensuring testing is completed consistently and in accordance with approved methodologies. 
 - Review control assessments, testing workpapers, identified exceptions and supporting evidence to ensure conclusions are accurate, evidence-based and defensible. 
 - Oversee remediation validation activities and ensure validation conclusions appropriately address the identified control deficiency and agreed corrective actions. 
 - Oversee the maintenance of the Technology control inventory and ensure control documentation remains current, complete and aligned with testing requirements. 
 - Ensure effective coordination between control documentation, evidence management, control owner engagement and controls testing activities. 
 - Provide controls testing outcomes, control effectiveness assessments, documentation insights and remediation validation results to support audit, regulatory and assurance activities across frameworks including GS007, J-SOX, CPS 230 and CPS 234. 
People Leadership  

- Lead, coach and develop the Documentation & Controls Analyst and Controls Testers, providing clear direction, technical guidance and quality oversight. 
 - Establish work priorities, delivery expectations and quality standards across the Technology Controls Function. 
 - Allocate and monitor activities across controls documentation and controls testing, ensuring appropriate coverage and timely delivery of agreed outcomes. 
 - Build effective working relationships with Technology leadership, control owners, service owners, Technology SMEs, Risk stakeholders, Audit Delivery and assurance providers. 
 - Provide constructive challenge where control design, control operation, documentation, evidence quality or remediation activities do not meet required standards. 
 - Support capability uplift across Technology by improving stakeholder understanding of control ownership, control effectiveness, documentation expectations and testing requirements. 
 - Foster collaboration between controls testing, documentation, audit delivery and risk functions while maintaining clear accountability for their respective activities. 
Governance & Risk

- Ensure controls documentation, controls testing and supporting evidence remain aligned, complete, traceable and defensible. 
 - Provide management reporting and governance insights on control effectiveness, testing outcomes, recurring weaknesses, remediation progress and emerging risks. 
 - Monitor themes across control testing results, documentation reviews, audit findings and remediation activities to identify systemic control concerns and improvement opportunities. 
 - Escalate material control weaknesses, repeated exceptions, overdue actions and significant risk exposures through appropriate management and governance channels. 
 - Ensure controls testing activities are performed objectively and consistently in accordance with approved methodologies, governance requirements and quality standards. 
 - Maintain appropriate separation between control ownership, control operation, documentation support, controls testing and independent assurance activities. 
 - Support continuous improvement of Technology governance and assurance practices through measurement, thematic analysis and practical recommendations for strengthening control effectiveness. 
The above list of key accountabilities is not an exhaustive list and may change from time-to-time based on business needs. 
Experience & Personal Attributes
Experience  

- 5-7 years' experience in Technology Risk, IT Audit, Controls Assurance, Technology Governance, Compliance or related assurance functions. 
 - Demonstrated experience leading or managing Technology controls testing, assurance, audit or risk programs within a complex Technology environment. 
 - Strong experience assessing the design and operating effectiveness of Technology controls, including walkthroughs, sampling, evidence evaluation, exception assessment and remediation validation. 
 - Strong working knowledge of Technology control domains including (but not limited to) Identity & Access Management, Privileged Access Management, Change Management, Backup & Recovery, Resilience, Asset Management and Third-Party Risk. 
 - Experience developing and implementing controls testing methodologies, testing plans, sampling approaches, quality assurance processes and governance practices. 
 - Experience overseeing or managing teams responsible for controls documentation, controls testing, Technology assurance, governance or risk activities. 
 - Strong understanding of regulatory and assurance frameworks including (but not limited to) GS007, J-SOX, CPS 234, ISO 27001, or similar control environments. 
 - Experience producing management reporting, governance insights and thematic analysis for senior leadership and governance forums. 
 - Experience engaging with senior Technology stakeholders, control owners, external auditors, Risk and Compliance functions and other assurance providers. 
 - Experience within financial services or another highly regulated industry is highly desirable. 
Personal Attributes

- Strong leadership capability, with the ability to set clear expectations, develop team capability and drive accountability for quality outcomes. 
 - Highly analytical and able to identify systemic control weaknesses, recurring themes and emerging risks across a complex Technology environment. 
 - Strong judgement and decision-making skills, with the ability to balance risk, control effectiveness and practical business outcomes. 
 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate complex control and assurance matters to technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Confident stakeholder engagement style, with the ability to provide constructive challenge while maintaining effective working relationships. 
 - Strong attention to detail combined with the ability to understand broader risk, governance and organisational implications. 
 - Results-oriented approach, with the ability to manage competing priorities and deliver high-quality outcomes within agreed timelines. 
 - Collaborative leadership style focused on coaching, knowledge sharing and developing sustainable team capability. 
 - Demonstrates integrity, professionalism and objectivity, with a commitment to evidence-based and defensible assurance outcomes. 
 - Continuous improvement mindset, with a focus on strengthening control maturity, documentation quality, testing effectiveness and governance outcomes.
