data.title: Lead Engineer
data.description:
Who We Are

Arcadia is the AI-powered energy intelligence platform for businesses. We replace fragmented tools and manual workflows with one platform to pay utility bills, buy energy, and advance sustainability - across every location, at enterprise scale. 

Trusted by Fortune 2000 companies, Arcadia combines unified data, AI-powered analytics, and expert advisory to help enterprise teams save money, mitigate risk, and cut carbon. 

We Deliver This Through Three Comprehensive Solutions

- Utility Bill Management: Automating the entire utility bill lifecycle - from data capture and validation to payment processing and auditing. 
 - Energy Procurement Advisory: Bringing together comprehensive data, AI-powered analytics, market expertise, and a strong partner network to make sophisticated procurement options accessible to all. 
 - Sustainability Reporting - Verified emissions data with seamless integration into leading sustainability platforms. 

Tackling the world's most complex energy challenges requires diverse thinking. We're building teams of people from different backgrounds, industries, and disciplines - united by a belief that energy management should be simple, intelligent, and a genuine driver of business value. 

Benefits

- Competitive compensation based on market standards
 - We are working on a hybrid model with remote first policy
 - Apart from Fixed Base Salary potential candidates are eligible for following benefits
 - 
 - Flexible Leave Policy
 - Office located in the heart of the city in case you need to step in for any purpose
 - We provide comprehensive coverage including accident policy and life insurance. 
 - Medical Insurance (1+5 Family Members)
 - Flexible Benefit Plan
 - Awards and Bonus
 - Annual performance cycle
 - Quarterly engagement activities
 - A supportive engineering culture that values diversity, empathy, teamwork, trust, and efficiency
What We're Looking For

We are seeking a Lead Engineer to be the technical anchor of our Growth & Governance (GnG) squad in India - the team that acquires utility data from thousands of unreliable third-party sources, extracts and audits it, and turns it into the trusted dataset the rest of the Arcadia platform is built on. Formats change without notice, sources fail silently, and correctness is visible to customers, so our core expertise is building systems that stay accurate against data that refuses to cooperate. 

This is a hands-on role with real ownership. You will own architecture for one or more of our services, lead projects end to end, act as a second point of technical review alongside the Engineering Manager, and mentor a team of earlier-career engineers. 

AI has moved where the hard part of engineering sits. Producing code is no longer the bottleneck; deciding whether the produced code is the right answer is. We are looking for someone already well ahead on AI-driven development who also has the architectural judgment to reject its confident wrong answers - and to teach a team of earlier-career engineers to do the same rather than defer to the model. 

What You'll Do

- Own the architecture and technical direction of one or more services in our acquisition, extraction, and audit pipeline, and lead medium-to-large projects on them end to end
 - Translate ambiguous problems into engineering-ready designs, and decompose large efforts into pieces the team can build in parallel
 - Act as a primary design and code reviewer - the second layer of judgment on AI-assisted designs and pull requests, catching architectural drift and silent correctness defects early
 - Set the bar for AI-driven development on the squad - and bring your own view of what that should look like
 - Own a category of reliability and technical-debt work end to end, without derailing roadmap commitments
 - Share in the squad's production support rotation for the services you own, and improve what pages us
 - Mentor earlier-career engineers: raise their design instincts, review quality, and independence
 - Partner with Product, Operations, our Data Analytics Engineering team, and US-based engineering counterparts to shape requirements and drive cross-team initiatives

What Will Help You Succeed

Must-Haves

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
 - 8+ years of software development experience at a SaaS or technology company, the majority building and operating backend or distributed systems in production
 - A clear track record of owning projects end to end - from design through production - not just delivering assigned components
 - Currently hands-on. You have shipped production code within the last two years
 - Experience with enterprise Java (Spring / Spring Boot preferred) and Python
 - SQL and relational data modelling at depth - you have designed schemas that survived real growth, and debugged correctness problems in the data rather than only in the code
 - Experience building and operating high-volume data pipelines and third-party integrations, where correctness matters as much as throughput
 - Experience with event-driven and asynchronous systems (streaming or queueing - Kinesis, Kafka, SQS or similar), including what goes wrong under retries and at-least-once delivery
 - Deployed and operated systems on AWS or similar, on containerised platforms (Kubernetes / ECS)
 - Production operability. You have owned services you were paged for - metrics and dashboards (Prometheus / Grafana, CloudWatch, Datadog or similar), structured logging, tracing, and alerts that fire on customer-visible symptoms rather than on every anomaly
 - Strong AI-driven development practice. You work daily in agentic coding tools and are fluent at managing context and steering them across a large, unfamiliar codebase. AI is central to how this squad works, so you should already be ahead on it - with your own view of what good looks like and the judgment to know when the output isn't
 - Architectural judgment. You can articulate the tradeoffs behind a design, choose the simpler option when it holds, and explain why you rejected the alternatives - including when the alternative came from a tool or from a more senior voice in the room
 - Technical rigor. Testing strategy across the pyramid, observability and alerting built in rather than bolted on, security and maintainability treated as requirements
 - Demonstrated mentorship. You've been the person a team goes to, and you've levelled others up
 - Clear written and verbal communication. You write designs people can act on, and you work well with a distributed team across time zones
 - Flexibility to join evening meetings up to ~8: 30 PM IST to collaborate with US-based counterparts

Nice-to-Haves

- Experience shipping AI/LLM-backed features to production - latency, accuracy, cost, evaluation, and human-in-the-loop design
 - Experience building SQL data pipelines (Snowflake + dbt preferred)
 - Experience in the energy industry, or another domain requiring deep knowledge of messy, unreliable source data

data.title: Engineering Manager - AI & Agentic Systems
data.description:
About PlumPlum is an employee insurance and health benefits platform focused on making health insurance simple, accessible and inclusive for modern organisations. 

Healthcare costs in India are rising three times faster than general inflation. Most Indians can't afford health insurance on their own, and as many as 600 million will likely depend on employer-sponsored insurance. Plum is on a mission to provide the highest-quality insurance and healthcare to 10 million lives by FY2030, through companies that care. Plum is backed by Tiger Global and Sequoia. 

About the roleAt Plum, AI isn't a side project. It's how our products work. We're building agentic workflows that read documents, reason over policies and help members get clear, dependable answers, starting with insurance claims. 

We're looking for an Engineering Manager who has built and run AI agent systems in production and can lead a team doing the same. You'll grow a team of engineers, own delivery for AI-powered products, and stay close to the architecture, the code and the production issues yourself. 

What you will own
 - Lead the team: hiring, coaching, performance and growth. Build a team that owns and operates what it ships. 

- Design and ship agentic AI workflows that are reliable in production: clear tool use, safe retries, failure handling, and a path to human review when needed. 

- Decide where AI fits: choose when to use fixed, tested code and when to use models or agents. Keep money-related calculations and policy rules in code you can trust. 

- Stay hands-on with architecture, code reviews and production debugging. 

- Own reliability and safety: safe releases, rollback, incident response, access controls and careful handling of sensitive member data. 

- Partner with product, operations and domain experts to turn real workflows, such as claims, into well-defined AI systems. 

- Champion AI-first engineering: use coding agents and AI tools in your own work and help your team do the same. 

What you'll bring
 - 8-10 years of software engineering experience. 

- Experience managing engineers and developing technical leaders: 1: 1s, hiring, performance and growth. 

- Hands-on experience shipping and operating AI or agent systems in production, beyond prototypes. You can explain what went wrong, how you found it and what you changed. 

- Strong backend and distributed-systems fundamentals: APIs, queues, state management, data contracts and recovery. 

- A hands-on approach: you still write and review code and debug production issues. 

- Day-to-day use of AI coding tools (Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot or similar). 

Nice to have
 - Experience with document pipelines: OCR, extracting data from bills or records, schema validation, deduplication and tracking where data came from. 

- Experience designing agent infrastructure: typed tool contracts, durable state, idempotent actions, timeouts. 

- Insurance, claims, fintech or healthcare experience, or working with domain experts on rules such as eligibility, limits and co-pay. 

- Experience with tracing and monitoring of AI systems: quality, latency and cost. 

Your first 90 days
 - Understand our AI workflows, starting with claims, and the biggest technical risks. 

- Set a quality baseline with product and operations. 

- Ship one well-scoped improvement with monitoring, a human fallback and a tested rollback, then plan next priorities from what you learn.

data.description:
We are looking for an experienced Senior Technical Lead - Mechanical Design to drive the design, development, analysis, qualification, and product support of high-reliability aerospace and defense mechanical/electromechanical systems. This role is ideal for a senior mechanical engineering professional who enjoys solving complex technical challenges, colloborating with cross-functional teams, and delivering robust products for demanding aerospace applications. 

The successful candidate will bring strong expertise in mechanical design, aerospace product development, CAD/CAE, GD&T, tolerance analysis, structural and thermal analysis, environmental qualification, and technical leadership. The role involves working closely with systems, electrical, power electronics, thermal, manufacturing, quality, certification, supply chain, program management, customer, and global engineering teams. 

What You Will Do

Mechanical Design & Product Development

- Lead mechanical design and development of aerospace-grade electromechanical products such as actuators, motors, starter-generators and electronic packaging systems. 
 - Own concept design, 3D modelling, detailing, assembly design, drawing release, and engineering documentation. 
 - Develop mechanical architectures that balance performance, reliability, weight, cost, manufacturability, testability, and serviceability. 
 - Design components and assemblies involving sheet metal, machined parts, castings, enclosures, sealing features, connector interfaces, and EMI/EMC shielding. 
 - Support board fitment, enclosure design, packaging optimization, vibration tolerance, and thermal management for aerospace electronic and electromechanical products. 

Analysis, Simulation & Qualification Support

- Lead structural, thermal, modal, vibration, shock, and fatigue analysis activities to support design validation and product performance. 
 - Review FEA and thermal analysis results and guide design improvements based on simulation, qualification, and test outcomes. 
 - Support environmental qualification activities covering thermal, vibration, altitude, EMI/EMC, conducted emissions, and radiated emissions requirements. 
 - Support qualification and verification processes for aerospace products, including DO-160-related test and compliance activities. 

Technical Leadership

- Provide technical leadership across the product lifecycle, from concept development through qualification, certification, production release, and field support. 
 - Mentor engineers, review technical work, establish design best practices, and promote engineering excellence across the team. 
 - Lead technical reviews including PDR, CDR, TRR, design reviews, risk reviews, and root-cause reviews. 
 - Own technical risk identification, mitigation planning, design trade studies, and engineering decision-making for mechanical product development. 
 - Drive design standardization, reuse, cost reduction, manufacturability improvement, and continuous improvement initiatives. 

Documentation, PLM & Configuration Management

- Prepare and review engineering documentation, technical reports, design justifications, analysis reports, proposals, and customer presentations. 
 - Manage BOMs, drawing releases, configuration control, and engineering change activities through PLM systems. 
 - Support Engineering Change Requests/Engineering Change Notices and product upgrade activities through PLM systems such as ARAS / Teamcenter / Windchill or equivalent. 
 - Ensure released designs meet internal engineering processes, customer requirements, quality expectations, and aerospace compliance expectations. 

Collaboration & Stakeholder Engagement

- Partner with systems, electrical, power electronics, thermal, software, manufacturing, quality, supply chain, certification, and program management teams. 
 - Represent mechanical engineering in customer discussions, technical reviews, audits, certification reviews, supplier discussions, and program reviews. 
 - Support prototype builds, first article inspection, component prove-out, manufacturing transition, and production issue resolution. 
 - Collaborate with global engineering teams to deliver projects on schedule while meeting cost, quality, reliability, and compliance targets. 

What We Are Looking For

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Mechatronics Engineering, or a related discipline. 
 - 12-16 years of relevant mechanical engineering experience in aerospace, defense, electromechanical systems, power systems, or electronic packaging domains. 
 - Strong experience in designing and developing actuators, motors, starter-generators, electronic packaging assemblies, or similar high-reliability products. 
 - Hands-on expertise in 3D modelling, detailing, tolerance analysis, drawing release, and engineering documentation. 
 - Knowledge of aerospace design and qualification requirements such as DO-160, MIL-STD-810, environmental, vibration, thermal, and reliability requirements. 
 - Experience with PLM/configuration management systems and engineering change processes. 
 - Excellent written/verbal communication skills and ability to prepare technical reports, proposals, cost estimates, and presentations. 

Preferred Experience

- Experience in aerospace or defense product development, qualification, and compliance-driven engineering environments. 
 - Experience with high-reliability design practices, redundancy considerations, thermal management, and safety-critical product development. 
 - Exposure to model-based design / model-based systems engineering tools such as MATLAB / Simulink / Dymola. 
 - Experience in working with globally distributed engineering teams, customers, suppliers, and certification stakeholders. 
 - Experience supporting technical roadmaps, innovation initiatives, risk mitigation, and design maturity improvements. 

Technical Skills

- Aerospace mechanical/electromechanical product design
 - CAD tools: SolidWorks / Inventor / Creo / UG-NX
 - PDM / Vault tools: SolidWorks PDM / Inventor Vault / Teamcenter
 - 3D modelling / detailing / assembly design / drawing release
 - GD&T / tolerance stack-up / DFM / DFA / DFC
 - Structural / thermal / modal / vibration / shock / fatigue analysis
 - Environmental qualification / aerospace compliance
 - PLM / configuration management / ECR-ECN implementation
 - Technical documentation / design reviews / stakeholder communication
 - Team mentoring / technical leadership / risk mitigation / delivery ownership

Why Join Us?

This is an opportunity to take a senior technical leadership role in the development of high-reliability aerospace and defense products. You will work on challenging engineering problems, collaborate with global teams, mentor talented engineers, and contribute to products where quality, reliability, and performance are critical. 

Compensation

Currency: INR

Salary Minimum: Market

Salary Maximum: Market

Incentive: Market

Disclaimer: Where a specific pay range is noted, it is a good faith estimate at the time of this posting. The actual salary offered will be based on experience, skills, qualifications, market / business considerations, and geographic location.

AMETEK is committed to making a safer, sustainable, and more productive world a reality. We use differentiated technology solutions to solve our customers' most complex challenges. We employ 22, 000 colleagues, in 35 countries, that are grounded by our core values: Ethics and Integrity, Respect for the Individual, Inclusion, Teamwork, and Social Responsibility. Service delivery and operational ownership

data.title: IT&D Manager - Azure DevSecOps engineer
data.description:
We are Reckitt

Home to the world's best loved and trusted hygiene, health, and nutrition brands. Join us in our fight to make access to the highest quality hygiene, wellness, and nourishment a right and not a privilege. 

Information Technology & Digital

In IT and D, you'll be a force for good, whether you're championing cyber security, defining how we harness the power of technology to improve our business, or working with data to guide the innovation of consumer loved products. 

Working globally across functions, you'll own your projects and process from start to finish, with the influence and visibility to achieve what needs to be done. And if you're willing to bring your ideas to the table, you'll get the support and investment to make them happen. 

Your potential will never be wasted. You'll get the space and support to take your development to the next level. Every day, there will be opportunities to learn from peers and leaders through working on exciting, varied projects with real impact. And because our work spans so many different businesses, from Research and Product Development to Sales, you'll keep learning exciting new approaches. 

About The Role

We are seeking an experienced IT&D Manager - Azure DevSecOps engineer to join our global Cloud Platform team. This is a senior, hands-on technical role combining responsibilities of a Senior Cloud Engineer and DevSecOps/Security Engineer, focused on the design, implementation, security, governance, and continuous improvement of enterprise Azure cloud platforms. 

The successful candidate will be responsible for developing and operating Azure platform capabilities using Infrastructure as Code (IaC), driving cloud security best practices, embedding security into the software delivery lifecycle, and ensuring governance and compliance across the Azure estate. As a senior member of the team, the role also includes mentoring colleagues, collaborating across globally distributed teams, and supporting operational excellence as part of an L4 engineering function. 

Your responsibilities

Azure Platform Engineering

- Design, build, and maintain enterprise-scale Azure cloud platforms and services.

 - Support onboarding of applications and workloads onto Azure platform services. 

DevSecOps & Cloud Security

- Embed security controls and practices across the software development and delivery lifecycle. 
 - Design and maintain security guardrails for Azure workloads and platform services. 
 - Manage and optimize Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM), and threat protection capabilities.

 - Azure Policy
 - Management Groups
 - Role-Based Access Control (RBAC)

DevOps & Automation

 - Promote Infrastructure as Code, GitOps, and automation-first operating models. 
 - Support development teams in adopting DevSecOps practices and secure engineering standards. 
 - Evaluate and introduce new tools and technologies to improve platform capabilities and developer experience. 

Operations & Service Management

Leadership & Collaboration

- Provide technical leadership and mentoring to engineers within the team. 
 - Support capability development through coaching, knowledge sharing, and best practices. 
 - Collaborate effectively with stakeholders across Europe, India, and other global locations. 
 - Participate in Agile delivery frameworks, including Scrum, Kanban, and hybrid operating models. 
 - Influence technical decisions and contribute to strategic cloud transformation initiatives. 

The experience we're looking for

Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related field. Master's degree is a plus. 

- 8+ years of experience in cloud engineering, DevOps, platform engineering, or cloud security roles. Strong hands-on expertise with Microsoft Azure. 
 - Experience with CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure as code (IaC) tools (Terraform, ARM) and Azure security best practices. 
 - Strong understanding of: Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Azure Policy, RBAC and Privileged Access Management, Cloud Governance, Secure Development Lifecycle (SDL), Security by Design principles, Vulnerability management
 - Experience implementing cloud security controls and compliance frameworks. 
 - Knowledge of cloud security benchmarks and industry standards. 
 - Microsoft Azure certifications (e. g. , AZ-305, AZ-500, AZ-400, AZ-104) - nice o have. 
 - Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. 

The skills for success

Platform Engineering, DevOps Engineering, DevSecOpsCloud Infrastructure Management, Azure Cloud Services, Azure Governance, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), Cloud Security Architecture, Cybersecurity Engineering, Security Operations (SecOps), Network Engineering, Enterprise Networking, Compute Services Management, Storage Management, Subscription & Resource Management. 

What we offer

With inclusion at the heart of everything we do, working alongside our four global Employee Resource Groups, we support our people at every step of their career journey, helping them to succeed in their own individual way. We invest in the wellbeing of our people through parental benefits, an Employee Assistance Program to promote mental health, and life insurance for all employees globally. We have a range of other benefits in line with the local market. Through our global share plans we offer the opportunity to save and share in Reckitt's potential future successes. For eligible roles, we also offer short-term incentives to recognise, appreciate and reward your work for delivering outstanding results. You will be rewarded in line with Reckitt's pay for performance philosophy. 

Equality

Even if you don't meet every point on the job description, if this role and our company feels like a good fit for you, we still want to hear from you. data.description:
Menlo Security is the leader in Browser Security for human and agentic workforces. Our mission is to enable humans and agents to connect, communicate, and collaborate securely, without compromise. The Menlo Browser Security Platform protects organizations from cyberattacks by stopping threats across the web, documents, and email before they reach the user. With Menlo Agent Runtime Security (MARS), that protection now extends to the AI agents working alongside every employee. Menlo Security is trusted by major global businesses, including Fortune 500 companies and government agencies, to protect their most valuable asset, their data, and is backed by top-tier investors. 

Summary

Menlo Security is hiring a Senior Software Engineer to join our growing Threat Protection and ShadowAI team in Bangalore. This team makes sure our users can safely browse the web through our secure cloud, protecting them from malicious sites (including those built or operated with AI) and securing access to authorized web applications. The services this team builds are a core part of Menlo's secure enterprise browser for both humans and AI agents, which means you will be working directly on one of the fastest-moving problems in security today: how organizations get visibility into and control over unsanctioned AI use without shutting it down. The team also uses AI in how it builds, from code assistants and AI-assisted test generation through to LLM-supported log and incident analysis, so you will be applying these tools as well as defending against their misuse. If you like distributed systems, deep technical problems, and work where the threat landscape changes month to month, this is a strong fit. 

Outcomes & KPIs

Key Outcome(s) Owned: 

- Reliable, performant delivery of Threat Protection and ShadowAI services that detect and control risky web and generative AI application usage for Menlo customers. 
 - End to end ownership of assigned features, from design through production operation and iteration. 

Success Metrics / KPIs: 

- Service availability and latency for owned components meet or exceed team SLOs. 
 - Features delivered on committed roadmap dates, with quality measured by post-release defect and rollback rates. 
 - Automated test coverage maintained or improved on owned code paths. 
 - Detection accuracy for AI application and malicious site coverage, measured by false positive and false negative rates. 
 - Mean time to detect and resolve production issues in owned services. 

What You'll Do

- Design, develop, and own new features and services in the Threat Protection and ShadowAI product area, contributing directly to Menlo's technical roadmap. 
 - Build highly available, scalable distributed systems and APIs, including multithreaded and asynchronous applications, with performance and security considered from the start. 
 - Build and refine the detection and policy capabilities that give customers visibility into generative AI and unsanctioned web application usage in their environments. 
 - Participate in building, deploying, and operating the Menlo Security platform in production, using dashboards, error reporting, metrics, and AI-assisted log and trace analysis to find and resolve defects quickly. 
 - Use AI code assistants and AI-assisted test generation as part of your normal workflow to move faster, while applying your own judgment on correctness, security, and maintainability before anything ships. 
 - Partner with product, security, operations, and other cross-functional stakeholders to align on requirements, tradeoffs, and schedules. 
 - Write unit and automated tests, conduct code and design reviews for peers, and evaluate emerging technologies that could improve our products. 

Functional Competencies

Required: 

- 3-5 years of professional software development experience with one or more of NodeJS, Go, or Python. 
 - 3-5 years of hands on experience with cloud services such as GCP and/or AWS. 
 - Working experience with Linux and standard development tooling such as git. 
 - Degree in Computer Science or a related field (BE, BTech, or Masters). 
 - Practical fluency with AI coding and debugging assistants, including sound judgment about when to rely on LLM output and when to verify it independently. 
 - Self-directed approach to problem solving, with the ability to pick up unfamiliar systems and technologies with limited guidance. 

Preferred / Nice to Have: 

- Experience building large scale web applications and REST APIs. 
 - Strong grounding in complex data structures and database technologies. 
 - Experience with containers, Docker, and Kubernetes. 
 - Experience with cloud infrastructure as code tooling such as Terraform. 
 - Familiarity with the Tornado web application framework and test automation. 
 - Track record of adapting and improving engineering practices such as test driven development, continuous delivery, agile ceremonies, automation, and maintainable, testable code. 
 - Interest in or exposure to security, threat detection, or AI governance and safety. 
 - Well organized and thorough, with strong attention to detail and documentation. 

MSGL-I4

Follow us on LinkedIn!

Why Menlo?

At Menlo, we don't settle for the status quo - in our technology or our culture. How we think and act is just as important as what we build. Our culture is defined by five core mindsets: Proactive Leadership, Straight Talk, United Impact, Elevated Talent, and Customer-Compelled. We take ownership and drive outcomes without waiting to be told. We communicate directly and seek hard truths. We break down silos and win together. We hold a high bar for ourselves and the people around us. And we treat every customer interaction as mission-critical. If you're someone who sees it, owns it, solves it, and does it - you'll thrive here.

Summary

Position Summary

Applied AI Platform Engineer (PEGA Systems Engineer) - Lead Software Engineer I

Role Overview: As an Applied AI Platform Engineer (PEGA Systems Engineer) , you will actively engage in your engineering craft, taking a hands-on approach to building the platforms, tooling, accelerators, and frameworks that other engineering teams build on. The ideal candidate will be a role-model leader and mentor, collaborating with cross-functional teams to design, build, and operate the enabling layer for AI engineering at scale. 

Key Responsibilities: 

- Embrace and drive a culture of accountability for engineering-leverage and adoption outcomes. Build platform capabilities that solve recurring problems once, well, for many teams-reducing per-team build and operate toil while ensuring consistency and compliance by default through high-quality, lean designs and implementations. 
 - Serve as the technical advocate for the platform as a product, ensuring capability integrity, feasibility, and alignment with the needs of the engineering teams who consume it. Lead requirement discovery with consuming teams, low-level architecture and component design of platform services, frameworks, and the AI control plane, and their development, testing, integration, and support. 
 - Maintain accountability for the integrity of the platform architecture and for the enterprise tech-stack conformance baseline that engineering teams build against. Manage platform dependencies, code design, implementation, the data and policy-as-code enforcement layers, and the OpenTelemetry-based instrumentation substrate-building capabilities that are operable, instrumented, performant, and drift-resistant by design, to the production standards set by SRE. Stay hands-on, self-driven, and continuously learn new approaches, languages, and frameworks. Create technical specifications, codify recurring patterns into reusable components and golden paths, and write high-quality, supportable, scalable code and review code of other engineers, mentoring them, to ensure all platform KPIs (adoption, reliability-by-design, and developer experience) are met or exceeded. Demonstrate collaborative skills to work effectively with diverse teams. 
 - Develop lean platform capabilities through rapid, inexpensive experimentation to solve the real needs of consuming engineering teams. Engage with those teams before, during, and after delivery to ensure the right capability is delivered at the right time-and adopted, not shelved. 
 - Adopt a mindset that favors action and evidence over extensive planning. Utilize a leaning-forward approach to navigate complexity and uncertainty, delivering platform capabilities as lean, adoption-validated increments rather than big-bang builds, and keeping them supportable and maintainable. 
 - Work collaboratively with empowered, cross-functional partners: engineering, SRE, security and risk, data governance, and engineering leadership and architecture. Integrate their constraints into the paved roads so that the secure, compliant, and reliable path is the easy path. Deliver capabilities that are admissible-by-design and submit them for admission, co-defining service-level objectives with SRE, who set production standards and own the admission decision. Foster a collaborative environment that enhances team synergy and innovation.

Be a role model, leveraging these techniques to optimize platform solutioning and delivery. Demonstrate strong understanding of the full lifecycle of platform and product development, focusing on continuous improvement and learning. 
 - Quickly acquire domain knowledge of the enterprise data estate and the AI use-case patterns the platform must serve. Translate the needs of engineering teams, reference architectures, and governance requirements into reusable frameworks, the data platform, and governance-as-code enforcement. Be a valuable, flexible, and dedicated team member, supportive of teammates, and focused on quality and tech debt payoff. 
 - Exhibit exceptional communication skills, capable of articulating complex technical concepts clearly and compellingly. Inspire and influence teammates and product teams through well-structured arguments and trade-offs supported by evidence. Create coherent narratives that align technical solutions with business objectives. 
 - Engage and collaborate with product engineering teams at all organizational levels, including customers as needed. Build and maintain constructive relationships, fostering a culture of co-creation and shared momentum towards achieving product goals. Align diverse perspectives and drive consensus to create feasible solutions. 

The team: US Deloitte Technology Product Engineering has modernized software and product delivery, creating a scalable, cost-effective model that focuses on value/outcomes that leverages a progressive and responsive talent structure. As Deloitte's primary internal development team, Product Engineering delivers innovative digital solutions to businesses, service lines, and internal operations with proven bottom-line results and outcomes. It helps power Deloitte's success. It is the engine that drives Deloitte, serving many of the world's largest, most respected companies. We develop and deploy cutting-edge internal and go-to-market solutions that help Deloitte operate effectively and lead in the market. Our reputation is built on a tradition of delivering with excellence. 

The successful candidate will possess: 

- Excellent interpersonal and organizational skills, with the ability to handle diverse situations, complex projects, and changing priorities, behaving with passion, empathy, and care. 

Required Qualifications: 

- A bachelor's degree in computer science, software engineering, data science, machine learning, or related discipline. Experience is the most relevant factor. 

Prior experience with enterprise case management & low-code workforce platforms (PEGA) is important. 

- 10 + years of software and platform engineering experience with most of the following: Angular, React, NodeJS, Python(Mandatory), , C#, . NET, Java, Rust, SQL/NoSQL, PyTorch, TensorFlow, LangChain, LangGraph, LangSmith, LangFuse, Terraform, as well as unit, integration, and end-to-end testing frameworks & tools, specifically BDD, Gherkin, Cucumber, Playwright, and Selenium. 
 - 3+ years of experience designing, building, and operating AI/ML platform or infrastructure, with hands-on experience across building tooling for MLOps/LLMOps, model serving, retrieval and vector infrastructure, and eval/observability instrumentation for LLM integration (OpenAI, Anthropic, or open-source models). 
 - 3+ years of experience with cloud-native engineering on any of the cloud hyperscalers such as Azure, AWS, or GCP-including their AI/ML services such as Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, or Vertex AI-as well as container orchestration (Kubernetes, Docker), Big Data, Databricks, CI/CD at platform scale, and distributed systems. 
 - 1+ years of experience establishing engineering standards and golden paths, including actively leading, mentoring, and guiding team members in the adoption and continuous improvement of these standards, treating the platform as a product. 
 - Prior experience with AI control-plane and agent-runtime patterns: model/LLM gateway, A2A and MCP integration, agent runtimes (e. g. , Google ADK, Amazon Bedrock AgentCore), guardrails (PII redaction, prompt-injection, content, tool permissioning/tool-RBAC), policy-as-code, and multi-tenant isolation.

 - Prior software engineering experience with the understanding of Business Context Diagrams (BCD), sequence/activity/state/entity relationship/data flow diagrams, OOP/OOD, data structures, algorithms, and code instrumentations, and AI-augmented spec-driven development. 
 - Prior experience using methodologies & tools such as XP, Lean, DevSecOps, SRE, ADO, GitHub, SonarQube, and ArgoCD to deliver high-quality platforms and products rapidly.

data.description:
Cohesity is the leader in AI-powered data security. Over 13, 600 enterprise customers, including over 85 of the Fortune 100 and nearly 70% of the Global 500, rely on Cohesity to strengthen their resilience while providing Gen AI insights into their vast amounts of data. Formed from the combination of Cohesity with Veritas' enterprise data protection business, the company's solutions secure and protect data on-premises, in the cloud, and at the edge. Backed by NVIDIA, IBM, HPE, Cisco, AWS, Google Cloud, and others, Cohesity is headquartered in Santa Clara, CA, with offices around the globe. 

We've been named a Leader by multiple analyst firms and have been globally recognized for Innovation, Product Strength, and Simplicity in Design , and our culture. 

Want to join the leader in AI-powered data security?

Staff ML Engineer

Level: Staff Software Engineer (Level 5)

Team: Gaia Emblem Engine

Location: India | Type: Full-Time

About The Role

Cohesity is looking for a Staff ML Engineer (Level 5) to help design and scale the Gaia Emblem engine, the intelligence layer powering our next-generation data platform. In this role, you will architect and build large-scale, production-grade ML/LLM systems - spanning model serving, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), GPU infrastructure, and distributed backend services. As a Staff-level engineer, you will set technical direction, mentor senior engineers, and partner closely with Product and Data Engineering to bring Gaia Emblem's roadmap to life. 

Key Responsibilities

- Architect and drive the technical roadmap for the Gaia Emblem engine, including LLM integration, RAG pipelines, and prompt-engineering frameworks. 
 - Design and operate scalable, GPU-aware infrastructure on Kubernetes (vanilla K8s, OpenShift, EKS, GKE, or equivalent), including GPU scheduling, autoscaling, and costefficient resource utilization. 
 - Build resilient, high-throughput distributed systems and microservices exposed via gRPC and REST APIs. 
 - Own data engineering pipelines feeding ML workflows, including ingestion, transformation, and storage across SQL, NoSQL, and search systems (PostgreSQL, Redis, Elasticsearch). 
 - Define and enforce engineering best practices: CI/CD, test automation, observability, and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Helm). 
 - Lead design reviews, set coding and architectural standards, and mentor engineers across the organization. 
 - Partner with Product, Applied ML, and SRE teams to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions. 
 - Drive root-cause debugging and performance optimization across distributed, GPUbacked services. 
 - Evaluate and introduce new tools, frameworks, and infrastructure patterns to keep Gaia Emblem at the forefront of applied ML engineering. 

Experience

Minimum Qualifications

- 10+ years of professional software engineering experience, including 8+ years building distributed, production-grade backend systems. 
 - 3+ years of hands-on experience with LLM-based systems, RAG architectures, or applied ML infrastructure. 
 - Demonstrated experience operating services on Kubernetes (vanilla K8s, OpenShift, EKS, GKE, or similar) at production scale, including GPU-backed workloads. 
 - Track record of technical leadership: driving architecture decisions, leading crossteam initiatives, and mentoring engineers at Staff/Senior level. 

Education

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field required. 
 - Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related field preferred. 

Required Skills

- Languages: Python, Java, Go, JavaScript
 - ML/AI: LLMs, Prompt Engineering, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
 - Infrastructure & Cloud: Kubernetes (platform-agnostic - vanilla K8s, OpenShift, EKS, GKE, or equivalent), GPU Scheduling, Docker, Helm Charts, Terraform, AWS, Cloud Computing
 - Distributed Systems & APIs: Distributed Systems, Microservices, gRPC, REST APIs
 - Data & Storage: Data Engineering, SQL, NoSQL, PostgreSQL, Redis, Elasticsearch, Databases
 - Engineering Practices: CI/CD, DevOps, Test Automation, Git, Debugging, ObjectOriented Programming (OOP)

Preferred / Nice-to-Have Skills

- Node. js, Back-End Web Development
 - Jenkins and other CI/CD tooling
 - Experience with formal verification or correctness-focused engineering practices
 - Prior experience in enterprise data protection, storage, or infrastructure software

Expectations from the Role

- Operate with Staff-level ownership: define the "what" and "how" for a major component of Gaia Emblem, not just execute tickets. 
 - Balance long-term architectural vision with pragmatic, incremental delivery. 
 - Act as a force multiplier - raise the technical bar of the team through design reviews, documentation, and mentorship. 
 - Communicate complex technical trade-offs clearly to both engineering and nonengineering stakeholders. 
 - Be hands-on: this role is expected to write and review production code regularly, not purely architect from a distance.

As a Senior Site Reliability Engineer, you will act as a technical authority across one or more Product Areas, guiding the direction of our Azure-based SaaS platform and Site Reliability strategy. You will lead complex initiatives related to platform reliability, observability, onboarding automation, and incident response across product boundaries, while advancing our overall cloud capability. 

This role goes beyond hands-on engineering. You will play a key architectural and leadership role in designing scalable systems, mentoring senior engineers, and shaping our Azure governance models. With deep expertise in SRE and ITIL practices, you will elevate platform resilience and client experience across both onboarding and ongoing operations. 

Your impact will be felt across departments, helping SimCorp become a fully cloud-native SaaS provider with high-performing, secure, and automated service delivery.

- Act as the technical lead on SRE initiatives across multiple Product Areas
 - Drive forward our strategic use of Microsoft Azure in onboarding and site reliability disciplines
 - Architect scalable, secure, and automated solutions for client onboarding and live operations

 - Solve the most complex and business-critical reliability challenges involving distributed cloud systems

 - Collaborate with Information Security, Platform Engineering, and Architecture teams on compliance and cloud controls
 - Guide the definition of SLOs, SLIs, and other reliability metrics across departments
 - Lead root cause analysis, major incident postmortems, and reliability retrospectives across teams
 - Provide thought leadership, mentoring, and coaching to senior and lead engineers

 - Represent the SRE function in executive-level planning, roadmap definition, and technical due diligence

What We Value

 - Growth and innovation - Every 6th sprint is reserved for planning and innovation. So, with regular intervals you have a chance to explore and learn new skills or improve something that you believe will be beneficial to you, your team or the application. 
 - Self-Direction - High degree of self-organization. Each team and developer have a high degree of freedom to plan, organize and design their work. 
 - Inclusive and diverse company culture 
 - Work-life balance - We believe that an equilibrium between professional responsibilities makes us all the best version of ourselves, both in private life and as colleagues in the workplace
 - Empowerment - We believe that all voices are valuable and must be heard. You will be involved in shaping our work processes

NEXT STEPS

Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible, we process incoming applications continually. Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed. At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. data.description:
Join the Future of Security at Netskope

Netskope (NASDAQ: NTSK) is a leader in modern security and networking for the cloud and AI era. We secure and accelerate cloud, data, and AI in real time, everywhere. Thousands of customers, including more than 30 of the Fortune 100, trust the Netskope One platform, its Zero Trust Engine, and the powerful NewEdge network to gain full visibility and control without performance trade-offs. 

At Netskope, our technology is driven by our greatest strength: our people. We believe that belonging powers innovation, and success is both personal and organizational. We embrace differences in gender, ethnicity, beliefs, ability, and identity, creating an environment where every voice is heard and respected. We empower our employees to bring their authentic selves to work, grow their careers through continuous education and mentorship, and lead with transparency and curiosity. Join a team where you belong, where you are encouraged to be an entrepreneur, and where together, we continue to redefine the landscape of security. 

Visit Careers at Netskope to learn more. Follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram. 

About The Role

Please note, this team is hiring across all levels and candidates are individually assessed and appropriately leveled based upon their skills and experience. 

Netskope SASE Quality Engineers ensure the delivery of high-performance, scalable WAN edge and Cloud networking solutions. Driven by an automation-first and customer-centric approach, you will design and execute comprehensive tests-from feature-specific validation to complex, system-level scale-to guarantee flawless software delivery. 

What's In It For You

In this role, you will be a key member of the SASE team, championing quality and automation for our advanced WAN edge and Cloud networking products in a fast-paced, high-impact environment. 

What You Will Be Doing

- Understand the product/feature requirement, review the design and write test plans that suits the customer use cases
 - Responsible to own a feature end to end - starting from testing, automation, script error free run in regression and customer issues handling around that
 - Thorough understanding of the product features and building the ability to debug the customer issues and suggest/implement the workarounds if applicable
 - Need to perform different types of testing that includes functional, system, performance and scale tests
 - Need to create the distributed complex test setups in various cloud platforms and hypervisors based on the requirement
 - Work closely with cross functional teams at various stages of product development to meet the feature deliverables in a release

Required Skills And Experience

- 3+ years of relevant experience in software testing, quality engineering, or automation. 
 - Strong expertise in one or more of the Windows, macOS, Linux and Android platforms, with experience testing system-level agents(VPN clients, or SASE/SSE clients ) in large-scale enterprise environments. 
 - Strong knowledge to bring up test environments, testing, automation and troubleshooting in Windows/macOS and Linux platform
 - Strong expertise in L2/L3 networking concepts, routing protocols, VPN, IPSec and WAN architecture
 - Strong expertise in python programming language and should be able to do automation driven testing
 - Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes environments
 - Familiarity with one of the major server virtualisation products (ESXi, KVM) & IaaS platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP)
 - Good working knowledge in CI/CD deployment in public clouds
 - Technical know-how of source code systems like Github
 - Experience with traffic generator tools like Spirent and Ixia
 - Experience in scale and performance validation of endpoint client deployments
 - Experience with web programming and HTTP based APIs (REST or GraphQL)

Education

- BSCS or equivalent required, MSCS or equivalent strongly preferred

data.title: Automation Engineer
data.description:
Automation Engineer - Mumbai

Turn PLCs, HMIs, servo systems and drives into working machines on real shop floors, from first demo to final handover. You will be the technical support behind Luna's automation business, working with Panasonic, Shihlin, Flexem and Fatek products and with our sales team to turn customer requirements into working solutions. 

About Luna Technologies

Luna Technologies Pvt. Ltd. provides industrial automation, robotics, motion control, mechatronics and pneumatics solutions to OEMs and manufacturers across India. It is headquartered in Navi Mumbai and has offices across the country. 

What You Will Do

• Study customer machines and processes, and recommend the right PLC, HMI, servo and VFD solution. 

• Program and configure PLCs, HMIs, servo drives and VFDs (Panasonic, Shihlin, Flexem, Fatek). 

• Commission systems at customer sites, including wiring checks, parameter setting and communication setup. 

• Run product demos, trials and proof-of-concept tests for customers. 

• Troubleshoot on site and over the phone, and resolve issues quickly to keep customer machines running. 

• Train customer engineers, operators and maintenance teams. 

• Support sales with application inputs, product selection and technical content for proposals. 

• Document every project and share field feedback that improves our solutions. 

Products You Will Work With

Panasonic, Shihlin, Flexem and Fatek PLC, HMI, servo and VFD products. 

Must Have

• BE/BTech/Diploma in Electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation, Mechatronics or Automation Engineering. 

• 2-5 years of hands-on PLC and HMI programming and commissioning (or strong project work for freshers). 

• Working knowledge of servo systems, VFDs and control panels. 

• Familiarity with industrial protocols such as Modbus, Profinet or EtherNet/IP. 

• Strong troubleshooting skills, a customer-first attitude, and willingness to travel to customer sites. 

Good to Have

• Experience with Panasonic, Shihlin, Flexem and Fatek products. 

• SCADA, motion control or multi-axis servo applications. 

• Exposure to special-purpose machines, packaging, textile, plastics or process industries. 

What We Offer

Real ownership from demo to a running machine, manufacturer certification and technical training, a clear path to senior application roles, travel allowance and reimbursement as per policy, paid leave, and statutory benefits. 

Luna Technologies Pvt. Ltd. is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

data.title: Advanced Process Control Engineer
data.description:
Job Description

In This Role, Your Responsibilities Will Be: 

- Boiler & Turbine Control Excellence - Innovate and optimize PID loops for combustion, drum level, and feedwater control, ensuring seamless and highly efficient turbine performance with intelligent load-sharing strategies. 
 - Improve Steam Temperature Control - Implement new control strategies, such as spray attemperation and reheater tuning, to maintain efficient steam conditions, minimize thermal stress, and increase plant longevity. 
 - Advanced Combustion Optimization - Drive efficiency by fine-tuning air-fuel ratios, enhancing emissions control, and optimizing burner management systems for superior heat rate and flame stability. 
 - Improving Unit Rate & Load Optimization - Developing smart load demand control strategies, fine-tuning heat rate optimization, and improving turbine governor tuning to increase fuel efficiency and grid stability. 
 - Reliable Drum Level & Feedwater Control - Engineer multi-element drum level controls with adaptive tuning, ensuring outstanding stability under fluctuating load conditions while minimizing shrink and swell effects. 
 - Implement brand new MPC strategies to minimize process variability, improve system stability, and seamlessly integrate with advanced DCS/PLC systems. 
 - DCS Commissioning (Emerson Ovation) - Lead with expertise in configuring, programming, and commissioning DCS, optimizing plant performance, and ensuring smooth power plant operations. 
 - Innovative Fuzzy Logic & Advanced Control - Harness intelligent control solutions, integrating fuzzy logic with PID and MPC for unparalleled efficiency, adaptability, and process excellence. 
 - Data-Driven Process Optimization & Performance Enhancement - Analyze critical operational data to identify growth opportunities, drive efficiency, and collaborate with plant teams to ensure a future-ready power plant.

We are looking for a proactive professional who excels in dynamic, fast-paced environments. You demonstrate exceptional initiative, confidently tackling complex challenges in power plant control and optimization. - Deep expertise in control system engineering, power plant automation, and turbine control, enabling seamless process optimization. 
 - Proven proficiency in PID tuning, boiler tuning, and process modeling, ensuring maximum efficiency and reliability. 
 - Extensive hands-on experience in Emerson Ovation DCS commissioning and fixing, driving seamless plant operations. 
 - Mastery of Model Predictive Control (MPC), multivariable control, and fuzzy logic control, enhancing automation and performance. 
 - Strong background in steam temperature optimization, combustion optimization, and unit rate optimization, leading to greater energy efficiency.

You'll contribute to this vital work while further developing your skills through our award-winning employee development programs. We are a proud corporate citizen in every city where we operate and are committed to our people, our communities, and the world at large. We take this responsibility seriously and strive to make a positive impact through every endeavor. 

At Emerson, you'll see firsthand that our people are at the center of everything we do. So, let's go. Let's think differently. Learn, collaborate, and grow. Seek opportunity. Push boundaries. Be empowered to make things better. Speed up to break through. Let's go, together.

If you have a disability and are having difficulty accessing or using this website to apply for a position, please contact: idisability. administrator@emerson. com . 

About Emerson

Emerson is a global leader in automation technology and software. Through our deep domain expertise and legacy of flawless execution, Emerson helps customers in critical industries like life sciences, energy, power and renewables, chemical and advanced factory automation operate more sustainably while improving productivity, energy security and reliability. 

With global operations and a comprehensive portfolio of software and technology, we are helping companies implement digital transformation to measurably improve their operations, conserve valuable resources and enhance their safety.

data.title: Senior Software Engineer II (Java Microservices)
data.description:
At Precisely, we're not just building software - we're shaping the future of data integrity. As a global leader in data quality, data enrichment, and location intelligence, Precisely helps thousands of the world's most trusted brands make confident decisions with data they can rely on. We're an AI-first organization, which means artificial intelligence isn't a buzzword here - it's woven into how we build products, how we work, and how we think about solving complex problems for our customers. When you join Precisely, you join a team of curious, driven innovators who believe that better data makes the world run better. If you're ready to do meaningful work at the intersection of AI and data - and help define what's possible - we'd love for you to apply!

Overview

The role will be responsible for translating product strategy and business priorities into a coherent set of features for one or more scrum teams. Take on multiple roles including Feature lead, Developer, product designer, QA, and project manager. Key member of the team strategizing and presenting the future vision of the product to business and technology stakeholders in collaboration with the Product Manager. 

What You Will Do

- Execute the product vision, roadmap, and growth opportunities. 
 - Helps conduct market and competitive analysis, defines products to serve those needs, the addressable market, ability to penetrate and sell, and overall business justification and strategic fit for products. 
 - Help execute the value proposition and business case. 
 - Provides team leadership through communication and coordination of cross functional teams at all levels of the organization. 
 - Leads architecture for all components in an investment segment. May focus on one component but must have expertise across all components. 
 - Responsible for design of systems in the investment segment. 
 - Actively supports Product Manager in the Product Planning, business performance of one or more products. 
 - Engage with customers throughout the product lifecycle to better glean product insights. 
 - Understand requirements that comes from stakeholders and helps turn them into consumable backlog items for the team. 
 - Write clear, compelling, and detailed (technical) user epics and stories with user acceptance criteria. Participate in story grooming exercises for crisp and unambiguous documentation and communication of features to be developed. 
 - Ensure the backlog is prioritized in order before the sprint. 
 - Coordinate with appropriate architects to ensure tech decisions are made and implemented. Also Identifying business process improvements and opportunities for automation. 
 - Work with the Product Manager and Engineering Leader to propose percentage of effort for different types of value in each release. 
 - Participates in technical and sales enablement. 

What We Are Looking For

- Bachelor's Degree (or higher) in business or technical field. 
 - 8+ years of industry experience in the areas of data engineering and product management. 
 - Expertise in Java for backend development. 
 - Expertise with databases, particularly Mongo Atlas, and developing/consuming REST APIs. 
 - Track record of Designing and developing data products or software products. 
 - Exposure to cloud-native technologies including Docker, Kubernetes, Kafka, and microservices architecture is a must. 
 - Basic understanding of agile and scrum methodologies is a must. 
 - Experience of AWS/Azure/GCP, Redis, Security Domain, Datadog, Code fresh
 - Working knowledge of data ETL will be preferred. 
 - Experience with data visualization tools such as Tableau, Power BI etc. 
 - Ability to communicate with various stakeholders at all levels of the organization. 
 - Excellent verbal and written communication skills. 
 - Excellent interpersonal skills and active listener. 
 - Able to set and meet time-sensitive goals. 
 - Able to handle multiple tasks simultaneously and adapt to change while providing structure to operations and go-to-market teams. 

AI Skills/Knowledge

- AI-assisted development: Experience using tools such as GitHub Copilot and Cursor to support coding, code review, documentation, and test generation. 
 - LLM and agentic workflows: Familiarity with LLM APIs and agent-based workflows, with the ability to apply them thoughtfully in software engineering use cases. 
 - Responsible AI practices: Understanding of responsible AI principles, including bias mitigation, security considerations, explainability, and appropriate use of AI-generated outputs. 

Preferred Skills (a Plus But Not Required)

- Familiarity with frontend scripting languages such as Node. js and React. js
 - Understanding of spark framework along with Snowflake and Databricks. 
 - Hands on Terraform will be advantageous. 

Application and Interview Impersonation Notice: Impersonating another individual when applying for employment, and/or participating in an interview process to assist another individual in obtaining employment, with Precisely Software Incorporated ("Precisely") is unlawful. If Precisely identifies such fraudulent conduct, then as applicable and to the extent permitted by law, the application will be rejected, an offer (if made) will be rescinded, or the employment will be terminated, and legal action may be taken against the impersonators. 

The personal data that you provide as a part of this job application will be handled in accordance with relevant laws. For more information about how Precisely handles the personal data of job applicants, please see the Precisely Candidate Privacy Notice

The Specialist - IT Senior Developer for the ServiceNow team will drive and support design, DevOps, technical strategy, and delivery of solutions for strategically aligned projects, applying best practices and pattern standards as a ServiceNow SME. Responsibilities include leading technical activities across complex business sectors, designing secure and scalable architectures, and translating functional needs into actionable results aligned with customer expectations and IT governance. The role also involves defining and presenting solutions to technology leaders and executives globally. The candidate must demonstrate strong IT process knowledge, technical acumen, and business insight, with proven ability to simplify complex technical solutions. Experience with Generative and Agentic AI is essential to enhance automation, decision-making, and intelligent service delivery within the ServiceNow ecosystem. 

Qualifications

Key responsibilities include: 

- Drives the technical delivery of solutions from initiation through development, validation, go-live and user adoption. 
 - Collaborate with the Architect, Functional Analyst and ensuring that Solution Architectures are in alignment with the overall strategy. 
 - Partnering across technical teams including Platform, FAs, and support teams to deliver business results and value through projects. 
 - Provide solution expertise and architecture guidance for ServiceNow applications across all sectors. 
 - This candidate responsible for defining the DevOps workflow and Agile for ServiceNow applications and improve efficiency and proficiency of team. 
 - Collaborate with the customer and artchitect to establish processes and advancing ServiceNow capability / usability centered on delivering solutions that balance stategic and customer driven needs. 
 - Provides guidance / support locally within the region and globally as required to guide and troubleshoot complex problems in a timely manner. 
 - Regularly communicates and reinforces status, prioritization and timing back to project, program and orgnizational leaders of critical success measures, issues, and mitigation strategies. 
 - Responsible for process, standards, governance and performance of technical environments. 

Essential Functions

- Responsible for process, standards, governance and performance of the shared structures and technical environments. 
 - Involves working in a highly matrixed organization spanning domestic and international locations. 
 - Ability to access and evaluate products/vendors. 
 - Has a good understanding of the technical platforms, applications, and tools currently utilized at Eaton
 - Ability to drive projects with broad scope of deployment, including sector and/or region
 - Drives decisions and deliverables within team
 - Negotiate small to moderate scale vendor SOW
 - Architect, design and lead solutions for global processes for various functional organizations
 - Create development standards and promote modularization and reuse of code
 - Contribute to creation of policies, of standard approaches and techniques
 - Be aware of industry automation trends, understand Eaton business and accordingly contribute in selecting business cases, develop prototypes and Proofs of Concept
 - Understand, learn and develop on different automation tools
 - Out of the box thinking, to identify and work around process design
 - Develop foundational capabilities for automation development and support at Eaton
 - Collaborate with business and development teams to drive robust testing methodologies
 - Work within operational and performance metrics to drive continuous improvement. 

Skills

- Bachelors degree in a technical discipline such as: B. E / BTech / MCA / B. S. Comp Sci / Mathematics / Engineering / Equivalent
 - 8+ years of relevant industry experience
 - 8+ years' experience in design, development, implementation and administration of ServiceNow application development. 
 - Must have knowledge in ServiceNow ITSM, Asset (HAM/SAM), Core Platform, Discovery, HRSD, SPM, CSDM, CMDB, ServiceNow scripting (Glide), ITIL, MID Servers; plus Flow Designer, IntegrationHub, ATF
 - Additionally REST APIs, Oracle/SQL, Apigee, Agile/Scrum
 - Strong programming and scripting experience with JDK, JSP, HTML, JavaScript
 - Must have experience with REST interfaces and OAuth2/JWT security
 - Experience in process consulting, problem definition, and design/detailing of processes
 - Exposure and experience implementing ServiceNow upgrade projects
 - Preferred if basic knowledge of SQL
 - Preparation of technical specification documents
 - Lead technical solution design based on engineering and business requirements related to ServiceNow
 - Hands‐on with ServiceNow Generative AI stack: Now Assist (ITSM/HRSD/CSM/Creator), Generative AI Controller, AI Search (incl. Sensitive Data Handler) and EVAM configuration; ability to ground outputs in KB/CSDM/CMDB data and enforce data minimization

data.title: Staff Streaming/Messaging Infra Engineer
data.description:
At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader - we're changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We're committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts. 

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work - every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet. 

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers - and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all. 

About the Team and the Role Join the infrastructure engineering team responsible for building, scaling, and operating eBay's core messaging and real-time streaming platforms. Our infrastructure powers mission-critical, high-throughput applications across eBay's global ecosystem. 

In this role, you will act as a core developer and architect, taking full ownership of both the control plane and data plane for our distributed streaming platforms-including Apache Flink and Apache Kafka-deployed across multiple private cloud Kubernetes clusters spanning various Availability Zones (AZs) and Data Centers (DCs). You will also play a key role in designing and evolving our next-generation streaming lakehouse storage systems. 

What You'll do

- Build a cloud-native distributed systems: Design and develop core Streaming components, supporting independent scaling, high availability, and fault tolerance. 
 - Solve distributed systems challenges: Design and implement replication, consistency, crash recovery, failover, and distributed coordination mechanisms. 
 - Build Streaming Lakehouses: Lead the design and development of our real-time streaming lakehouse storage architecture, enabling low-latency analytical workloads at massive scale. 
 - Ensure Operational Excellence: Drive high availability, automated fault recovery, and zero-downtime operations for large-scale production streaming topologies. 
 - Enhance System Observability: Advance enterprise monitoring, distributed tracing, automated alerting, and failure-diagnosis tooling to maximize platform uptime. 
 - Collaborate Globally: Partner with cross-functional architecture and platform teams worldwide to shape the future of eBay's real-time data ecosystem. 
 - Leverage AI-assisted engineering: Use modern AI coding agents to accelerate development, testing, debugging, and validation while maintaining high engineering standards. 

What We're Looking For

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - 8+ years of experience building production-grade systems software, databases, storage engines, or large-scale distributed systems, or equivalent demonstrated expertise. 
 - Core Distributed Systems Experience: Deep hands-on background in computer science fundamentals (data structures, concurrency, OS internals, and networking) with strong expertise in Java, Rust, or C++. 
 - Stream Processing Engine Expertise: Strong hands-on experience developing, tuning, and operating Apache Flink at scale (e. g. , state backend management, checkpointing tuning, custom operators, Flink Kubernetes Operator). 
 - Distributed Messaging Deep-Dive: Proven experience with Apache Kafka (or Pulsar/RocketMQ), including core broker architecture, partition strategy, and control/data plane management. 
 - Container & Multi-Cluster Orchestration: Solid experience running high-throughput stateful workloads on Kubernetes across hybrid or private cloud environments. 

Nice to Have

- Deep knowledge of embedded storage engines (RocksDB, LevelDB) and memory management. 
 - Active contributions to open-source projects in the streaming ecosystem (e. g. , Apache Flink, Apache Kafka, Apache Paimon). 

Why Join Us?

- Build at hyperscale: Solve challenging distributed systems problems that directly impact eBay's global commerce platform. 
 - Work on deep systems engineering: Go beyond application development and work on messaging internals, distributed storage, replication, and fault tolerance. 
 - Shape the architecture: Make meaningful technical contributions to a next-generation cloud-native streaming platform. 
 - Own what you build: Take projects from architecture and implementation through production deployment and operations. 
 - Innovate with AI: Explore modern AI-assisted development practices to accelerate complex systems engineering. 

Additional Details

eBay is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, and disability, or other legally protected status. If you have a need that requires accommodation, please contact us at talent@ebay. com. We will make every effort to respond to your request for accommodation as soon as possible. View our accessibility statement to learn more about eBay's commitment to ensuring digital accessibility for people with disabilities. 

We use cookies to enhance your experience and may use AI tools for administrative tasks in the hiring process. To learn how we handle your personal data and use AI responsibly, please visit our Talent Privacy Notice, Privacy Center, and AI Hiring Guidelines.

By replacing fragmented local networks and volatile pricing with accountable, professional service, MachineryFix helps plant managers reduce downtime and improve reliability. The team focuses on building a trusted ecosystem where manufacturers can access timely, high-quality maintenance support and technicians can find consistent, well-structured work opportunities. 

Role Description As an Industrial Automation Engineer at MachineryFix, you will work on-site in Hyderabad in a full-time capacity, supporting automation and control systems across a variety of manufacturing environments. You will design, implement, and optimize industrial automation solutions, including PLCs, robotics, and process control systems, to improve efficiency and reduce machine downtime. Daily responsibilities include diagnosing and troubleshooting equipment and control system failures, coordinating corrective and preventive maintenance activities, and collaborating with technicians and plant teams to ensure stable, safe operations. You will document system configurations, maintain technical records, and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives that enhance reliability, standardization, and performance of factory floor automation. 

Sharing an opening for industrial electronics engineers 🔧

MachineryFix (machineryfix. in) is hiring an Electronics Repair & Quality Engineer (Drive / PLC Cards). 

MachineryFix gets faulty drives, PLC cards and control electronics repaired for manufacturers and large industrial clients, working with specialist repair labs across India. They need a strong technical person in the middle: someone who understands what's actually wrong with a card, works it through with the repair lab, and makes sure it really works before it's approved and sent back to the client. 

📍 Hyderabad, or willing to relocate (travel to repair labs and client sites when needed)

🕒 Full-time | 4+ years of experience

What the role involves

• Inspecting incoming faulty cards (VFD power and gate driver boards, PLC and I/O cards, control PCBs), recording symptoms and doing a first-level diagnosis

• Discussing fault findings and repair scope with repair labs, and checking that the quoted work matches the actual fault

• Doing or witnessing bench and load testing of repaired cards

• Checking replaced components, soldering and overall workmanship

• Signing off a repair only once test results confirm the card works, and sending back any repair that fails

• Preparing clear test reports for clients, with photos, replaced parts and results

• Building a record of common failures by make and model to speed up future jobs

What they're looking for

• 4+ years in drive, PLC or industrial electronics card repair (a repair lab, OEM service centre or plant electronics maintenance)

• Component-level fault finding on IGBTs, gate drivers, SMPS, ICs, capacitors and optocouplers

• Confident with an oscilloscope, multimeter, IGBT and component testers, DC power supplies and SMD rework stations

• Experience with drives from ABB, Siemens, Danfoss, Yaskawa, Schneider or similar

• Can read circuit diagrams, and trace circuits on boards that come without schematics

• Honest and detail-oriented: this is the person who says no when a repair isn't good enough

• Diploma or B. E. /B. Tech in ECE, EEE, EIE or a related field

Why it's worth a look

• An early, founding-team role with real responsibility from day one

• Cards and drives from many brands and industries, including large enterprise clients

• They want someone who'll grow with the company for the long run

📩 To apply, send your CV to contact@machineryfix. in with a short note on the most difficult card you've repaired.
