Join a company that's reintroducing itself to the aviation community we've helped advance for more than a century. At Honeywell Aerospace (NASDAQ: HONA), we're launching as an independent, publicly traded aerospace and defense company built on a legacy of operational excellence and mission-focused execution. 

Our new brand identity pairs that heritage with real momentum, as we build technology that helps pilots navigate with confidence, aircraft operate more efficiently, and operators stay ahead of change. With our systems on board 90% of the world's aircraft, your work here has reach that's rare to find anywhere else. 

Focusing on our customers, investing in innovation, and building a culture of accountability and performance is how we're shaping what comes next. 

Every horizon. Every mission. Every day. 

Job Description

We are seeking a highly skilled Embedded Software verification Engineer with over 2-4 years of experience in software testing. The ideal candidate will have deep knowledge in Embedded C or C++ programming/verification skills, as well as good experience using emulators and debuggers like ICD or Lauterbach. Candidate also should possess good experience in RTOS (Including DEOS, Linux). Experience in testing tools like Vector CAST/Cover, LDRA etc. 

Responsibilities

- Develop and execute test plans, Perform Change Impact Analysis and create/Execute test cases for core platform software components. 
 - Perform Requirement Based Testing and Scenario Based Testing based on System/Software Requirements and design documents. 
 - Drive and deploy technical initiatives for continuous growth. 
 - Resolve technical issues effectively and efficiently. 
 - Communicate effectively on technical aspects and issues within the team and with upstream stakeholders. 
 - Experienced in leading technical development activities, guiding lower-level engineers, collaborating with cross functional teams and driving to objectives of quality, cost and schedule. 
 - Experienced in managing stakeholders within and outside organization demonstrate ability to identify and propose technical improvements using engineering expertise. 
 - Experience in facing technical audits (Verification, AS9100 and customer audits). 
 - Passion to explore opportunities and solutions. 

Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering (B. E/B. Tech/M. Tech)
 - 2-4 years' experience in software development/systems/software verification with minimum 3 years' experience in software verification & validation. 
 - Strong leadership skills and stake holder management. 
 - Strong understanding of software verification methods and tools currently in use as well as in industry standards and direction. 
 - Experience in C , C++ and RTOS programming/verification. 
 - Experience with emulators and debuggers like ICD or Lauterbach is an added benefit. 
 - Experience DOORS NG, JIRA, Bitbucket
 - Strong problem-solving skills and a passion for exploring opportunities and solutions.

data.title: Senior CQV Engineer
data.description:
At Jacobs, we're challenging today to reinvent tomorrow by solving the world's most critical problems for thriving cities, resilient environments, mission-critical outcomes, operational advancement, scientific discovery and cutting-edge manufacturing, turning abstract ideas into realities that transform the world for good. 

Your impact

The Sr. CQV Engineer will be responsible for leading the efforts for commissioning, qualification, and validation of equipment/ systems, and processes in the production of Drug substances/ Drug Product/ Sterile Facilities/ API/ OSDs, as well as the Utility system, HVAC system and Area. 

The role will require the leadership of an experienced, energetic, and committed Senior CQV person with broad experience in C&Q, particularly biopharmaceuticals. 

The person should have experience of leading a team of CQV engineers for a project and managing the C&Q documentation and execution lifecycle from SLIA generation through to OQ completion. The lead will work closely with cross-functional teams, including engineering, quality assurance, and manufacturing, to support the successful delivery of projects. 

Key Responsibilities

- Lead and coordinate CQV projects, ensuring timely execution and compliance with industry regulations. 
 - To prepare C&Q plans in line with the strategic goals of the client and manage timely and compliant delivery of the plan. 
 - Ensure all commissioning and qualification procedures are implemented and adhered to at office and at site level. 
 - Track progress of C&Q activities as required and provide regular project updates and status reports to stakeholders. 
 - Ensure effective resource planning, including coordinating materials, spares and consumables for commissioning and qualification activities. 
 - Identify and mitigate project risks while ensuring project deliverables meet required quality and compliance standards. 
 - Provide leadership in team meetings and facilitate problem-solving discussions to ensure project milestones are met. 
 - Act as the primary point of contact between clients, internal teams, and external vendors to drive project success. 
 - Management of Contractors and Vendors, document control, punch list management. 
 - Participate in design, constructability, and commissioning reviews to ensure technical aspects are covered in the Commissioning Plan and schedule. 
 - Well versed with risk-based approaches to C&Q (e. g. , ASTM E2500, ISPE)
 - Conduct risk assessments and gap analysis for process equipments/ systems, facilities and utilities, to identify critical process parameters and control strategies. 
 - Developing system boundaries for the system at an early stage of C&Q. 
 - Complete the development, review and execution of validation plans, URSs/DQ/TMs/FATs/SATs/IQ/OQ protocols/reports. 
 - Experienced in commissioning and qualifying CIP & SIP systems. 
 - Participate in design document reviews and ensure that quality aspects are included in design. 
 - Review vendor documents (CTOPs/ VTOPs) to support commissioning and qualification requirements. 
 - Ensures C&Q non-conformances or deviations are minimized during execution of CQV activities. For issues that do arise ensure they are closed out in a timely manner. 
 - Track and confirm closure of actions items identified through FAT, HAZOP, Design Qualification and other reviews. 
 - Perform shakedown during commissioning and qualification of systems on site. 
 - Field Walkdowns of systems as part of transfer of ownership of the system from Construction. 
 - System Startup activities

Working Conditions

- The position requires travel and/ or deputation to other sites or manufacturing facilities. 
 - Ability to work in a cleanroom environment and adhere to gowning requirements. 
 - Flexibility to work outside of regular business hours as needed to support project timelines

Here's what you'll need

- Bachelor's degree in engineering, Life Sciences, or a related field. Advanced degree preferred. B. Pharm. , M. Pharm. , B. Tech or BE or MSc. 
 - 10-15 year's experience in CQV within the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry, specifically in drug substance manufacturing. 
 - Candidates must have proven experience of carrying out commissioning and qualification activities on multiple projects. 
 - Have functioned as CQV Lead level for at least one Project. 

Technical Skills

- Experience with paperless validation software such as KNEAT and/ or Valgenesis. 
 - In-depth knowledge of cGMP, FDA, EMA, and other relevant regulatory requirements. 
 - Strong project management skills with the ability to handle multiple priorities across national and international locations. 
 - Experience with process validation and computer system validation. 
 - Experience on DCS/ PCS system such as Delta-V, 800xA, etc. 
 - Familiarity with Construction management software such as EIDA, PIMS, Aconex, is an advantage. 
 - Familiarity with paperless validation software such as KNEAT and Valgenesis is an advantage. 

Soft Skills

- Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and a results-oriented mindset. 
 - Strong project management and organizational skills. 
 - Effective communication and interpersonal skills. 
 - Ability to work independently and as part of a team. 

At Jacobs we value people. Having the right balance of belonging, career and lifestyle enables us to consistently deliver and exceed clients' expectations. 

Working alongside industry leaders, you will have the opportunity to develop your career working on key projects in an environment which encourages collaboration, knowledge sharing and innovation. To support your professional growth, Jacobs flexible working arrangements, extended leave options and a host of social, health and wellbeing events and initiatives will underpin our commitment to you. 

At Jacobs it's all about what you do, not where you are, which counts!

We value collaboration and believe that in-person interactions are crucial for both our culture and client delivery. We empower employees with our hybrid working policy, allowing them to split their work week between Jacobs offices/projects and remote locations enabling them to deliver their best work. 

Your application experience is important to us, and we're keen to adapt to make every interaction even better. If you require further support or reasonable adjustments with regards to the recruitment process (for example, you require the application form in a different format), please contact the team via Careers Support. 

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or disability.

data.description:
This is where  your work makes a difference. 

At Baxter, we believe every person-regardless of who they are or where they are from-deserves a chance to live a healthy life. It was our founding belief in 1931 and continues to be our guiding principle. We are redefining healthcare delivery to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond. 

Our Baxter colleagues are united by our Mission to Save and Sustain Lives. Together, our community is driven by a culture of courage, trust, and collaboration. Every individual is empowered to take ownership and make a meaningful impact. We strive for efficient and effective operations, and we hold each other accountable for delivering exceptional results. 

Here, you will find more than just a job-you will find purpose and pride.   

Your Role at Baxter: 

A Principal Engineer (Test) for V&V will be responsible for formulating Test Analysis, Test strategy , Automation framework, Drive Test quality improvements   Across Platforms, New Product development and sustaining engineering catering to our portfolio. The successful candidate will possess solid "hands-on" technical abilities, an excitement and energy for product development, and a passion for their work and the impact it has on meeting the needs of patients. 

What You'll Be Doing

- Lead the Verification & Validation (V&V) strategy, test architecture, and automation framework design to ensure the delivery of high-quality, compliant software products. 
 - Provide technical leadership across new product development, sustaining engineering, and field issue resolution initiatives. 
 - Oversee test planning, execution, and approval of key V&V deliverables, ensuring readiness for product releases and project milestones. 
 - Drive the adoption of test automation, TDD, BDD, CI/CD, and quality engineering best practices to improve product quality and team efficiency. 
 - Partner with cross-functional stakeholders to identify technical risks, define mitigation strategies, and ensure successful project execution. 
 - Champion customer-focused quality by ensuring robust validation processes and timely resolution of product issues. 
 - Mentor, coach, and develop V&V engineers, fostering a culture of technical excellence, innovation, and continuous improvement. 
 - Promote adherence to industry standards and development methodologies, including IEC 62304, SDLC, Agile, Software Security, and Quality Management System requirements. 
 - Represent the V&V function in product, engineering, and leadership discussions, influencing technical decisions and driving alignment across teams. 
 - Continuously enhance testing processes, automation capabilities, and quality practices to support scalable and reliable product delivery. 

  What You'll Bring

- 10-15 years of experience in Software Verification & Validation (V&V), including 3-5+ years in a Test Lead or Technical Leadership role within Medical Device or other highly regulated industries. 
 - Proven expertise in defining and leading test strategy, test architecture, automation frameworks, and quality engineering practices for complex enterprise products. 
 - Strong technical background in test automation, Python, Selenium, TDD/BDD, CI/CD, and Cloud technologies (Azure/AWS). 
 - Demonstrated success delivering compliant, high-quality software products within FDA, IEC, ISO, and other regulated environments. 
 - Deep understanding of software architecture, modern development practices, and enterprise-scale product development. 
 - Recognized leader with a track record of driving technical excellence, mentoring engineering teams, and influencing cross-functional stakeholders. 
 - Strong business acumen, strategic thinking, and problem-solving capabilities with a focus on innovation, quality, and customer outcomes. 
 - Experience leading and collaborating with global, multi-site teams in a fast-paced, matrixed organization. 
 - Excellent executive communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to drive alignment and decision-making across all levels of the organization. 

Equal Employment Opportunity

Baxter is an equal opportunity employer. Baxter evaluates qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, protected veteran status, disability/handicap status or any other legally protected characteristic.

Baxter has discovered incidents of employment scams, where fraudulent parties pose as Baxter employees, recruiters, or other agents, and engage with online job seekers in an attempt to steal personal and/or financial information. To learn how you can protect yourself, review our Recruitment Fraud Notice.

data.title: Specialist, Quality Assurance & Engineering
data.description:
About BetaNXT

BetaNXT is a leading provider of frictionless wealth management infrastructure, real-time data solutions, and an enhanced advisor experience. We invest in platforms, products, and partnerships to accelerate growth for the ecosystem we serve. Our connective approach empowers our clients to deliver a comprehensive, end-to-end advisor and investor experience. 

BetaNXT is a premier provider of technology, data, and operations as services to a rich client base of wealth managers, institutional wealth firms, and digital brokers. It is comprised of three industry-leading businesses which, combined, provide end-to-end solutions across the investment lifecycle. 

Overview Of The Specialist, Quality Assurance And Engineering

We're seeking a Specialist, Quality Assurance and Engineering to join one of our Scrum teams and help shape how quality and automation scale across customers facing financial platforms. This role goes beyond test execution, you'll influence test strategy, automation standards, and quality gates, while owning the end-to-end quality of your team's deliverables. You'll partner closely with developers, product owners, and fellow QEs to ensure our solutions are reliable, maintainable, and ready to scale. 

Reporting to the Manager, Technology Development, you will be embedded within the Maxit product team, responsible for ensuring the quality, accuracy, and reliability of Cost Basis Reporting (CBR) web applications and services. This role focuses on validating data‐intensive, API‐driven, and batch‐oriented financial systems built using modern backend and UI technologies. As part of our global Quality Engineering organization, you'll help expand and stabilize our automated testing capabilities while working in a hybrid model alongside teams based in Bangalore, India. 

Duties and Responsibilities of the Specialist, Quality Assurance and Engineering: 

Quality & Test Strategy

- Own the overall quality of your team's deliverables across functional, integration, and regression testing
 - Review product requirements and design effective test plans, scenarios, and test cases with clear traceability
 - Partner with stakeholders to define testing scope, inputs/outputs, and quality expectations
 - Apply risk-based thinking to prioritize high value test coverage and release confidence

Automation & Execution

- Design and build automated tests for UI and/or API layers with an automation first mindset. 
 - Maintain reliable, maintainable, and scalable automation suites with strong regression value. 
 - Execute and support testing activities including functional, integration, regression, and UAT support. 

Continuous Improvement

- Manage defect reporting and proactively identify systemic quality risks. 
 - Troubleshoot failures end-to-end across automation code, environments, test data, and application defects. 
 - Mentor peers and contribute to evolving automation practices and standards. 
 - Passion for staying on top of tech trends, experimenting with and learning new technologies, and participating in technology communities. 

Skills and Experience of the Specialist, Quality Assurance and Engineering

- 6+ years of experience testing complex web-based applications. 
 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related technical field
 - Strong understanding of testing methodologies including functional, regression, negative, integration, and system testing. 
 - Strong programming experience in at least one modern language used for test automation (e. g. , C#, Java, or TypeScript)
 - Experience building and maintaining UI automation using modern frameworks (e. g. , Selenium or Playwright). 
 - Experience testing APIs using industry standard tools (e. g. , Postman, ReadyAPI, or Rest API)
 - Experience using BDD style frameworks (e. g. , Cucumber). 
 - Perform integration testing involving IBM MQ/messaging queues where applicable. 
 - Familiarity with Bash/Shell scripts. 
 - Perform extensive Oracle DB validation using SQL scripting. 
 - Solid fundamentals in debugging, triage, and root cause analysis, including pipeline failures
 - Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines (GitLab, Jenkins, or similar)
 - Strong collaboration and communication skills within Agile/Scrum environments

Nice to Have

- Software testing certification. 
 - Experience across multiple automation stacks or languages. 
 - Experience with batch‐driven financial systems. 
 - Exposure to AI assisted testing or automation acceleration (e. g. , improving test design, maintenance, or failure triage using AI)
 - Understanding of brokerage or wealth‐management back‐office workflows like Cost Basis Reporting (CBR) or tax‐lot.

RESPONSIBILITIES AND DUTIES

Integration Engineers provide leadership, facilitate analysis and design tasks, and support multiple Legion teams in developing an enterprise's solution architecture. Job responsibilities are grouped across four key areas: Technical Integrations, Customer-Centric Consulting, Legion Product Expertise, and a Commitment to One Another. 

- Please note that this opportunity is an overnight shift. 
 - Expected hours: 10: 30 pm - 07: 30 am IST
 - This role involves participation in an on-call rotation. 
 - This role may require work outside of normal business hours. 
Technical Integrations

- Design and implement scalable integration architectures connecting Legion with HR, POS, Payroll, and other enterprise systems. 
 - Design, Build, and Test integrations using Workato

data.description:
Job Title: Platform Engineer - Enterprise Golden Paths & Automated Governance

GCL: D3

Introduction To Role

Do you want to build the clear routes that ensure secure delivery becomes the standard across a global enterprise? Can you turn sophisticated security and compliance controls into simple, reusable developer experiences that teams love to adopt?

In this role, you will develop the outspoken pipelines, infrastructure modules, and automation that power efficient, secure software delivery at scale. Your work will reduce friction for engineering teams, embed security-by-design from the start, and accelerate the delivery of technology that underpins life-changing science for patients worldwide. 

You will partner closely with engineering, security, architecture, and operations to shape enterprise-grade platform capabilities-hands-on and end-to-end. Expect to start by shipping high-impact, reusable assets and evolve into guiding standards and adoption across hundreds of engineers, always balancing deep technical difficulty with practical, outcome-focused delivery. 

Accountabilities

- Golden Paths & Shared GitHub Actions: Design, build, and version enterprise-grade shared GitHub Actions (Composite Actions and Reusable Workflows) and standardized delivery templates to create secure, automated "Golden Paths" across product teams. 
 - Reusable Infrastructure-as-Code: Build and maintain secure, modular Terraform modules and IaC assets, versioned and documented for broad reuse and easy consumption. 
 - Embedded DevSecOps Controls: Integrate SAST, DAST, SCA, SBOM generation, and supply chain protections into default delivery workflows, shifting security left through automation and policy-as-code guardrails. 
 - Secure CI/CD Patterns: Create scalable, resilient CI/CD patterns aligned to enterprise standards, applying least privilege and reducing configuration risk to strengthen operational reliability. 
 - Automation and Internal Tooling: Develop automation services and developer tooling in Python or Golang that enable self-service onboarding, secure defaults, and consistent quality checks. 
 - Multi-Environment Architecture: Chip in to solutions spanning cloud, serverless, containerized, compute, and hybrid environments, producing reference architectures, diagrams, and implementation guidance that accelerate adoption. 
 - Testing and Quality Engineering: Define and execute testing strategies for infrastructure code and automation (unit, integration, and environment validation) to ensure repeatable, high-quality delivery. 
 - Adoption and Continuous Improvement: Partner with product and platform consumers to drive adoption, capture feedback, and iterate on patterns and assets to enhance developer experience and business value. 
 - AI-Enabled Engineering: Apply AI tools and techniques where appropriate to improve development speed, quality, secure design, and innovation, sharing learning and elevating team practices. 

Essential Skills/Experience

- Significant 6+ years of experience in platform engineering, cloud engineering, DevSecOps, or a related technical engineering discipline. 
 - GitHub Actions Platform Development: Hands-on experience authoring, testing, and maintaining centralized, reusable GitHub Actions (Composite Actions, Reusable Workflows) across an enterprise organization. 
 - Pipeline Versioning & Security: Understanding of Semantic Versioning for GitHub Actions (@v1, @v2), supply chain pinning, and securing pipeline-to-AWS authentication using OpenID Connect (OIDC)
 - Strong experience with AWS, including services related to compute, networking, security, and serverless architectures. 
 - Advanced expertise in Terraform and reusable infrastructure-as-code design. 
 - Strong scripting or software engineering capability in Python or Golang. 
 - Strong understanding of DevSecOps principles and controls, including SAST, DAST, SCA, SBOM, and software supply chain security. 
 - Experience designing and implementing secure CI/CD pipelines within enterprise environments. 
 - Solid grasp of security-by-design, the least privilege, and secure architecture principles. 
 - Experience building scalable, reusable, modular platform solutions rather than one-off implementations. 
 - Ability to create clear and effective user documentation and architecture artefacts. 
 - Collaboration skills and ability to work optimally across engineering, security, and architecture teams. 
 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - Relevant certifications in cloud, security, infrastructure, or DevOps/DevSecOps would be advantageous. 

Desirable Skills/Experience

- Experience with Kubernetes and container orchestration technologies. 
 - Exposure to hybrid or on-premises environments. 
 - Familiarity with Azure cloud services. 
 - Knowledge of modern application stacks such as Java, . NET, or React. 
 - Experience applying AI tools to development, testing, secure design, or engineering productivity improvement. 
 - Experience with infrastructure testing frameworks such as Terratest. 

When we put unexpected teams in the same room, we unleash bold thinking with the power to inspire life-changing medicines. In-person working gives us the platform we need to connect, work at pace and challenge perceptions. That's why we work, on average, a minimum of three days per week from the office. But that doesn't mean we're not flexible. We balance the expectation of being in the office while respecting individual flexibility. Join us in our unique and bold world. 

Why AstraZeneca

Here, platform engineering meets large-scale impact: you will help put data and technology at the heart of how we discover, develop, and deliver medicines. We bring together unexpected combinations of specialists-engineers, scientists, architects, product leaders-around the same table to unlock aggressive thinking and practical outcomes. You will build from scratch as part of an inclusive group of self-starters who share ideas openly, challenge with respect, and take accountability for making things real. We value patience alongside ambition, learn fast from real-world use, and hold high ethical standards because the stakes are patients' lives. 

If you're ready to build the enterprise golden paths that make secure delivery the default and accelerate life-changing science, send us your CV and show us the platform you would create next!

Date Posted

20-Nov-2026

Closing Date

AstraZeneca embraces diversity and equality of opportunity. We are committed to building an inclusive and diverse team representing all backgrounds, with as wide a range of perspectives as possible, and harnessing industry-leading skills. We believe that the more inclusive we are, the better our work will be. We welcome and consider applications to join our team from all qualified candidates, regardless of their characteristics. We comply with all applicable laws and regulations on non-discrimination in employment (and recruitment), as well as work authorization and employment eligibility verification requirements.

Job Purpose: Lead - Projects IT will be responsible for managing and overseeing the successful installation, testing and commissioning of IT systems and technologies across all construction projects. This includes overseeing IT infrastructure deployments, construction project management systems, and ensuring the integration of advanced technology solutions to support efficient airport construction processes. The role requires collaboration with internal teams, external contractors, and stakeholders to ensure IT systems are aligned with construction objectives, safety regulations, and compliance standards. 

Responsibilities

IT Project Management: 

- Lead the planning, execution, and delivery of IT projects focused on construction, such as Building Information Modeling (BIM) integration, project management software (e. g. , SAP or Oracle), and real-time data analytics tools. 
 - Coordinate the implementation of IT systems for construction project monitoring, scheduling, resource allocation, and cost tracking.

- Identify potential IT risks related to construction projects and develop mitigation strategies.

Budget And Financial Oversight

Vendor And Contract Management

Digital Mindset

Team Leadership And Development

- Lead and mentor team members by providing constructive feedback, helping them develop their technical and project management skills.

data.title: Software Development Manager III, Seller Fulfillment Technology (International FBA Team)
data.description:
Description

Own a core part of Fulfillment by Amazon (FBA) for Amazon's fastest-growing and most strategic marketplaces - from emerging international markets to the future of FBA in Europe. International FBA builds the software that lets third-party (3P) sellers send inventory into Amazon's network, keep it in stock, and fulfill orders, and we're hiring a Software Development Manager to lead a high-impact engineering charter end to end. 

Key job responsibilities

Own the vision, multi-year roadmap, and quarterly execution for the engineering charter, translating seller and business goals into a clear, prioritized delivery plan. 

Lead, coach, and grow a team of software engineers - owning hiring, performance management, and career development, and building a strong bench of technical leaders. 

Drive the architecture and design of high-scale, low-latency, highly available distributed systems, making sound technical and build-vs-adopt decisions. 

Build Generative AI (GenAI) solutions and conversational assistants that simplify complex, multi-step seller workflows into guided experiences. 

Own operational excellence - availability, latency, and correctness - for services with direct seller and business impact; strengthen on-call, reduce operational load, and drive issues to root-cause resolution. 

Manage region-specific complexity across diverse international marketplaces, including local compliance, tax, and capacity requirements. 

Partner across Product, Applied Science, Operations, Compliance, and worldwide (WW) FBA teams to align on shared roadmaps, resolve dependencies, and deliver end to end. 

Represent your area in leadership, business, and operational reviews; communicate crisply in writing (narrative style) and in person to both technical and business audiences. 

Set and uphold a high bar for engineering quality, security, and best practices across the software development lifecycle (SDLC). 

A day in the life

You start the morning by scanning your team's operational dashboards and any overnight on-call activity - checking the health of the seller-facing systems you own and making sure nothing is blocking sellers from getting inventory into Amazon. You join your team's daily standup, unblock engineers, and dive into a design review for a new Generative AI (GenAI) conversational assistant feature that will help sellers manage their inventory. 

Midday, you meet with your Product and Applied Science partners to align on the quarterly roadmap and prioritize the next set of deliverables - balancing near-term seller impact against longer-term bets like the Europe FBA transformation. You spend focused time writing or reviewing a technical narrative, and you have a career-development one-on-one with one of your engineers. 

In the afternoon, you make a key architecture decision on a high-scale service, review a peer's design document, and represent your area in a business review with leadership. You close the day by clearing code reviews, responding to your team, and jotting down priorities for tomorrow. Throughout, you're operating as both a builder and a leader - setting technical direction, growing your people, and delivering measurable impact for sellers across International FBA's marketplaces. 

About The Team

International FBA builds the seller-facing software behind Fulfillment by Amazon (FBA) across two strategic frontiers. In Emerging Markets - India, UAE, KSA (Kingdom of Saudi Arabia), Egypt, Mexico, Brazil, Turkey, Australia, and South Africa - we own the end-to-end seller journey, building region-specific architecture where local law and network economics demand it, and pioneering Generative AI (GenAI) assistants that make selling on Amazon radically simpler. 

In Europe, we're reinventing FBA itself: transforming a fragmented, country-by-country operation into a single, unified European supply chain (the "One EU" vision) - one shipment, one inventory pool, one set of controls - so sellers reach the whole continent effortlessly. 

We're a team of builders who care equally about seller experience and engineering excellence. We work across product, science, and operations, own our systems end to end, and take real ownership of outcomes that move Amazon's international business forward. 

Basic Qualifications

- 7+ years of engineering experience
 - 3+ years of engineering team management experience
 - 8+ years of leading the definition and development of multi tier web services experience
 - Experience partnering with product or program management teams
 - Bachelor's degree

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience in communicating with users, other technical teams, and senior leadership to collect requirements, describe software product features, technical designs, and product strategy
 - Experience in recruiting, hiring, mentoring/coaching and managing teams of Software Engineers to improve their skills, and make them more effective, product software engineers

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https: //amazon. jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you're applying in isn't listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

Job Purpose: This role is responsible for driving business excellence and organization transformation through continuous improvement initiatives, while ensuring compliance with IMS, DISHA, ABEM, and other quality frameworks through regular audits, training, and process management. ABEM And AWMS Compliance

Lead preparation for audits based on communications from the business excellence team at the head office, monitor and track the sustainment of ABEM practices within the assigned zone.

Coordinate with the head office team for QC and 5S audits, acting as the SPOC for audit schedules, planning, and tracking.

data.title: QA Lead
data.description:
Instawork is on a mission to create meaningful economic opportunities for skilled hourly professionals in communities around the globe. Our AI-powered labor marketplace helps local businesses scale, and enables global technology companies to push the frontiers of robotics and AI. Backed by world-class investors like Benchmark, Spark Capital, Craft Ventures, Greylock, Y Combinator, and others, we're looking for exceptional talent to reimagine the way the world works. 

About IRL (Instawork Robotics Labs)

Researchers at UC Berkeley have identified a "100, 000-year data gap" - the gulf between what trained AI language models and what physical robots actually have to learn from. Closing that gap is the defining infrastructure challenge of the physical AI era. IRL is Instawork's answer to it. We deploy skilled workers into real commercial and residential environments - kitchens, warehouses, hotel floors, homes - to capture the high-fidelity task data that the world's leading Robotics labs use to train their foundation models. Read more here. 

What you'll do

- Lead Workforce & Operations: Drive day-to-day workforce management for Clippers, Graders, Regraders, SMEs, and ICs across shifts/sites, optimizing staffing, capacity planning, and throughput against SLA targets. 
 - Implement Quality Systems & Methods: Maintain the QMS and apply structured methods (RCA, CAPA, FMEA, 8D, SPC) to address recurring defects, calibration drift, gold-sample injections, and consensus checks. 
 - Own SOPs & Process Standards: Build, version-control, and continuously iterate SOPs for existing and new program launches, ensuring floor adoption and structured QA onboarding/re-calibration paths. 
 - Bridge Cross-Functional Teams: Translate engineering data requirements into floor-executable QA criteria, report field issues back with evidence, and represent QA in program launches and crisis calls. 
 - Drive Data-Led Quality: Monitor and analyze key QA metrics-defect/reject rates, inter-grader agreement (kappa), gold-sample pass rates, yield, and escalation volume-to root out quality degradation with data. 

What we're looking for

- Distributed QA/QC Leadership: Proven experience managing large or dispersed grading/QA teams across multiple shifts or sites. 
 - Quality Methods Depth: Strong working command and practical application of RCA, CAPA, FMEA, 8D, SPC, and QMS frameworks. 
 - Analytical & Data-Driven Mindset: Proven track record of building and interpreting quality dashboards, interrogating metrics, and quantifying operational trade-offs. 
 - Stakeholder & Communication Skills: Clear, structured communication skills across all levels-upward to leadership, cross-functionally with engineering, and directly to floor teams. 
 - Hands-on, High Ownership: A proactive problem-solver who thrives on the floor building processes and tackling operational challenges directly, rather than just administering them. 

What success looks like

- QA metrics (defect rates, inter-grader agreement/kappa, gold-sample pass rates) show clear, measurable improvement across all programs. 
 - Quality issues and calibration drifts are caught early, analyzed via structured methods (RCA/CAPA/8D), and systematically resolved. 
 - SOPs are systematically updated, version-controlled, and seamlessly adopted on the floor with full operational alignment. 
 - Engineering requirements are accurately translated into actionable floor criteria, enabling smooth program launches and rapid feedback loops. 
 - Grading and QA operations scale smoothly across teams, shifts, and locations with balanced staffing and clear role execution. 

Our Values

- Empathy, Trust & Candor We put ourselves in the shoes of our colleagues and customers and don't shy away from uncomfortable conversations, instead building trust through honest and direct feedback. 
 - Bias for Action We practice high-velocity decision-making, clear-eyed that we often operate with incomplete information. Growing quickly means it's OK to be wrong, so long as we learn from our mistakes and course correct! 
 - Always Be Learning We're a curious bunch, and with AI transforming our workplace we encourage everyone to learn from each other, compounding our knowledge and experience to help us change an entire industry. 
 - Act Like an Owner We work long, hard, and smart, building products that delight our users and drive growth. Your ability to impact Instawork is limited only by your courage and conviction, not your job description. 

About Instawork

Founded in 2015, Instawork is the nation's leading online labor marketplace for food services, hospitality, light industry, and logistics, connecting more than 7M skilled workers with local restaurants, hotels, warehouses, stadiums, and more. Our AI-powered platform serves thousands of businesses across more than 50 major markets in the United States and Canada. We're not just helping fill shifts, we're supporting local economies-and we're just getting started!

Instawork has been featured by CBS News, The Wall Street Journal, The Washington Post, and the Associated Press. Forbes included us on their Next Billion Dollar Startups list; RetailTech Breakthrough named us Workforce Hiring Solution of the Year for 2025; and Inc. 5000 recognized us as one of the country's top 10% fastest-growing companies two years in a row. But what matters most is our impact. We're solving real problems for real people, and we're doing it at scale. 

Join our team to help us build something that matters! We're looking for superstars who want to help us shape the future of work. With hubs in San Francisco, Bangalore, and Chicago, city offices in New York and Phoenix, we're back to working together in-person five days a week because we believe the best ideas happen when great people collaborate face-to-face. We also value diverse perspectives and encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds. 

Ready to make an impact? Learn more at www. instawork. com/about. 

Personnel Privacy Policy

data.description:
SPEED & SPIRIT is what we look for in our candidates, defined by some simple values that inspire us to BE DRIVEN in our performance, BE VIBRANT in our sporting legacy, BE TOGETHER in our team spirit, and BE YOU to let our individual talent and experience shine. Applying for a job at PUMA is easy and all genders are welcome. Simply click APPLY ONLINE and follow the steps to upload your application. 

YOUR MISSION: 

About the Organisation & Role: 

You will be part of the Consumer Experience Engineering organisation responsible for building fast, intuitive, accessible and premium digital experiences across web and mobile. The organisation owns the web & mobile platforms, engineering delivery for consumer-facing journeys, shared design systems, performance, accessibility and AI-native engineering practices that help product teams deliver consistent, reusable, high-quality consumer experiences across the globe. 

The Lead Engineer (Mobile) is responsible for defining mobile architecture, leading engineering execution, and delivering scalable, reliable, accessible, and high-performing consumer-facing applications across iOS and Android platforms. 

What you will do: 

- Lead the architecture, design, development, and evolution of large-scale consumer-facing mobile applications. 
 - Define mobile engineering standards, architectural principles, reusable patterns, and development best practices. 
 - Provide technical direction for React Native solutions across iOS and Android platforms.

 - Lead integration of mobile applications with commerce platforms, APIs, content platforms, analytics, and third-party services.

Support experimentation, feature flagging, A/B testing, and data-driven optimization of consumer journeys. 

YOUR TALENT: 

- 10+ years of software engineering experience with significant expertise in mobile application development. 
 - 3+ years of experience leading a technical capability, project or engineering team. 
 - Strong hands-on expertise in React Native and modern TypeScript/JavaScript development. 
 - Deep understanding of iOS and Android fundamentals, platform capabilities, and mobile application lifecycles. 
 - Strong experience with mobile build, signing, release, distribution, and application store processes. 
 - Proven expertise in frontend and mobile system design, application architecture, and engineering patterns. 
 - Strong understanding of state management, API integration, caching, offline-first, and synchronization patterns. 
 - Experience integrating native iOS and Android modules into React Native applications. 
 - Proven experience in optimizing startup time, rendering, memory utilization, network efficiency, and application responsiveness. 
 - Strong understanding of mobile asset delivery, caching, network efficiency and content delivery considerations. 
 - Understanding of consumer journeys, conversion optimization, personalization, and digital experience quality. 
 - Practical knowledge of WCAG standards, mobile accessibility, and inclusive experience engineering. 
 - Experience with experimentation platforms, feature flags and A/B testing. 
 - Strong understanding of design systems, reusable component libraries, and mobile UX engineering principles. 
 - Excellent problem-solving, communication, technical leadership, stakeholder management, and decision-making skills. 
 - Proven ability to drive architectural decisions, influence technical direction and mentor engineers. 
 - Experience using coding agents, LLMs or AI-assisted engineering tools to improve software delivery and developer productivity. 
 - Experience in eCommerce, retail, or consumer digital products is strongly preferred. 

PUMA provides equal opportunities for all job applicants, regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or disability. Equality for all is one of the core principles at PUMA and we do not tolerate any form of harassment or discrimination. 

At PUMA, every application is reviewed by real people who are committed to fairness, transparency, and equal opportunity - no matter your background, identity, or experience. To ensure our process stays true to these values, no automated systems or AI tools are used to make hiring decisions. Every decision is made by real people -with real judgment and accountability. We may use functions supported by Artificial Intelligence (AI) to carry out isolated organizational steps, such as scheduling interviews. These functions have no influence on decisions in the application process. We believe in creating spaces where everyone is welcome, celebrated, and empowered to contribute authentically. Because at PUMA, whoever wants to play, can play. 

PUMA is a global sports brand creating footwear, apparel, and accessories that inspire athletes and everyday movers. The PUMA Group owns PUMA, Cobra Golf, and stichd, operates in 120+ countries, and has around 22, 000 employees worldwide.

data.title: Engineer II Software Test
data.description:
Work Schedule

Standard (Mon-Fri)

Environmental Conditions

Office

Engineer III, Software Test At Thermo Fisher, our mission is to cure cancer with genomic data. It is a close-knit, collaborative, cross-functional setting where we believe none of us is as smart as all of us and we each have something valuable to contribute toward our goal. The software services team is tasked with applying industry best practices to the design, development, and deployment of world-class software products. We are looking to hire individuals with experience with software development and test engineering in clinical and research settings, and who can help us solve the next wave of technical challenges using the latest cloud-based, big-data, and rich analytics toolsets. We are seeking enthusiastic Leader in Software Verification and Validation who will define scope, design, for automated and manual tests for highly advanced bioinformatics software. We require strong coding skills as well as a solid understanding of Quality Assurance principles and Continuous Integration methods. You will drive writing positive and negative smoke and regression test scripts to test product functionality and integration with dependencies. You will drive strategies for test APIs, user interfaces, web services, and/or web apps and write performance, load, and stress tests. You are excited and passionate about participating in an Agile/SCRUM setting to meet and exceed customer expectations and continuously drive towards quality improvements. You like the idea of partnering with users and other team members to brainstorm the best possible approaches to validating systems. You welcome the challenge of working in a fast-paced, discovery-oriented environment and will be genuinely excited about the prospect of creatively exercising your problem-solving skills continuously to ultimately improve the human condition. Essential Functions: 

- Develop and implement software testing Strategy, Methods and Best Practices that allow high quality NGS analytics and instruments software products to be designed, developed, and released into the regulated in-vitro diagnostics/ medical device space. 
 - Effectively work on established software quality standards and KPI metrics to actively help measuring software and bioinformatics product quality. 
 - Work with Leads to implement software quality tracking tools and methodologies to provide on-going visibility and action during software product development lifecycle. 
 - Effectively work with Leads while working with external partners to deliver state of the art Software products in market. 
 - Partner with software and bioinformatics leadership, functional and project managers to identify appropriate scope of software testing, verification and validation required for a project and managing the overall testing activities for projects. 
 - Partner with internal and external stakeholders to drive the requirements for regulated assays and software. Help software development team to understand the complex informatics and visualization requirements leading into design implementation Minimum Qualifications (must have): 
 - Masters/PhD preferred or Bachelors with minimum 4-6 years of work experience and strong track record of industry productivity
 - 04+ experience performing software verification and validation testing, preferably in the medical device/ biotech space
 - Strong understanding of NGS-based regulated software, IVD assay development practices and informatics data analysis pipelines. 
 - Practical experience as a leader in the use of modern software development methodologies/ processes with an ability to direct the use of resources to meet department goals
 - Good understanding in design control for regulated products (e. g. US-IVD, IVD-D, IVD-R, China and Japan regulations) and knowledge of applicable regulations and standards used in IVD and medical device software development (e. g. ISO 13485, IEC 62304, and 21 CFR 820). 
 - Ability to work well with senior leadership.

Through our cutting-edge machine learning, data science, and anti-fraud AI, we have served over 18 million customers as of 2025 while achieving solid profitability for sustainable growth. 

  

This role

The Collections Supervisor will manage and implement PayJoy's collections operations mandate in India from launch. The role sets up the first processes, agencies and strategies, then runs day-to-day recovery to keep the portfolio healthy and support PayJoy's growth in the market. 

All collection activity must be fair, ethical and fully compliant with Indian law and regulation. This includes the Reserve Bank of India's (RBI) rules on loan recovery and the conduct of recovery agents, effective 1 January 2027, and the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023. The focus is on preventing delinquency early, recovering overdue amounts efficiently, and treating every customer with dignity. 

Responsibilities
Launch and setup

- Run the launch collections operation: Run PayJoy India's collections processes from as per approved template, including workflows, scripts, contact strategy and escalation paths

- Write the recovery policy: Implement the collections and recovery policy required by the RBI, with Legal and Compliance. This covers recovery triggers, an escalation matrix, a code of conduct, financial distress and deceased-borrower procedures, and borrower compensation

- Select and onboard recovery agencies: Run due diligence on prospective agencies, check that their agents hold IIBF Debt Recovery Agents certification, and agree contracts, performance standards and audit rights

- Manage the first strategy: Define the initial portfolio segmentation, agency allocation and control groups so results can be measured from day one

Operations

- Early delinquency: Run the contact/digital  strategy for accounts 1-30 days past due and monitor results daily

- Agency coordination: Allocate accounts to recovery agencies as directed and follow up on their activity

- Agency performance: Track agency recovery, cost and ROI, and flag underperformance

- Treatment vs control: Report monthly results for the treatment and control groups

- Recovery tests: Run approved tests and report the results

- Device restrictions: Follow the device-restriction process in line with RBI rules

- Payment channels: Help resolve customer payment issues

- Credit reporting: Prepare collections data for monthly credit bureau reporting

- Reporting: Produce daily, weekly and monthly performance reports

Requirements

- Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance or a related field

- 3-5 years' experience in collections management, team leadership and customer service, ideally in consumer lending, NBFCs or fintech

- IIBF Debt Recovery Agents certification and applicable regulatory compliance for debt recovery  

- Working knowledge of RBI fair practices and loan recovery rules, including recovery agent conduct and device-restriction requirements

- Experience managing external recovery agencies and IIBF-certified recovery agents

- Knowledge of credit reporting to Indian credit information companies and related compliance standards

- Proficiency with collection management software and Google Workspace or Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint)

- Strong analytical skills, with experience measuring performance and evaluating strategies

- SQL for data analysis and reporting is a plus

- Strong organisational and problem-solving skills, and the ability to work closely with internal teams and external agencies

- Empathy and a supportive approach with customers, plus clear, assertive communication in writing and speech

- Fluent in English and conversant in Kannada, Hindi a plus

Benefits

- 100% Company Funded : Private Health Insurance for employee and immediate family

- Company-funded employee life and disability insurance

- 20 days vacation, unlimited sick leave

- $2, 000 USD annual Co-working Travel perk

- $2, 000 USD annual Professional Development perk

- Phone Finance, headphone benefit, home office equipment allowance and wellness perks

We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. 

  

PayJoy Principles

  

Finance for the next billion * Ownership * Break Through Walls * Live Communication * Transparency & Directness * Focus on Scale * Work-Life Balance * Embrace Diversity * Speed * Active Listening

What's In It For You

 - The ability to make an impact and shape your career with a company that is passionate about growth
 - The support of an organization that believes it is vital to include and engage diverse people, perspectives and ideas to achieve our best

 - Should be able to work with Business groups to understand the functional expectations, produce technical solutions and documentation. 
 - Should be able to conceptualize and design solutions, independently estimate, lead and validate estimates by the teams for the overall delivery. 
 - Should be able to own engineering quality, people, operational stability, and alignment with business leadership. 
 - Should be able to set technical direction for technical team, ensure solutions follow Microsoft/D365 best practices, partner with Solution/Technical Architects on architecture decisions. 
 - Review and analyze business requirements and provide technical feasibility and estimates.

 - Should be able to own engineering execution against roadmap, milestones, dependencies, risks and capacity. Remove blockers and ensure predictable delivery. 
 - Should be able to oversee integrations between D365 and Azure, ERPs, Downstream and Upstream systems, Power Platform and Data platforms. 
 - Participate in the Scrum process as a developer, with activities including Program Increment Planning, Sprint Planning, Estimating, Daily Stand-ups, Sprint Demos and Sprint retrospectives. 

Minimal Qualifications

- 10+ years' experience working in an IT environment 
 - 6+ years' strong experience in MS Dynamics 365 implementation & support; extensive experience in programming languages: C#, . NET, JavaScript
 - Strong experience in Web API development and plug in's 
 - Strong experience in integration technologies including SQL Server & KingswaySoft to connect internal & third-party systems 
 - String experience using Microsoft Azure Dev Ops, MS Visual Studio and MS SQL server

Preferred Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Sciences or related area
 - Experience with Power BI, SQL Server Integration Services, ASP. net, client-side JavaScript frameworks
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
 - Experience of working in a methodical and structured manner
 - Excellent communication skills: presentation, written, and oral
 - Strong interpersonal skills to successfully team with software vendors, outsourcing partners and internal business and IT associates
 - Must be able to perform as an effective member in a team-oriented environment, maintain a positive attitude, and achieve desired results while working with minimal supervision

When you come to work at Ecolab, you get to take on some of the world's most meaningful challenges and have the opportunity to learn and grow, shape your career, make an impact and quickly see the importance of your work.

data.title: Developer Lead - WebOps - Core Maintenance
data.description:
Join Us!

At Google Operations Center we help Google users and customers solve problems and achieve their goals-all while enjoying a culture focused on improving continuously and being better together. We work hard, we play hard, and we want you to join us!

Role Overview

In this role, you will lead the front-end team in developing responsive and high-performance user interfaces while collaborating closely with UI/UX designers and product managers to ensure design feasibility. You will maintain rigorous code quality standards through code reviews, optimize application performance for scalability, and act as a mentor to junior and mid-level developers. Additionally, you will serve as a key technical resource by unblocking the team, resolving complex bugs, and contributing to the growth of the engineering team through effective hiring and onboarding processes. 

Position Responsibilities

- Develop User Interfaces: Lead the front-end team in development related activities, while addressing and resolving technical queries from the team. 
 - Collaborate on Design: Collaborate with UI/UX designers to turn visual designs into working code. 
 - Maintain Code Quality: Conduct internal code reviews and enforce the writing of clean, well-documented, and testable code adhering to Google coding standards. 
 - Optimize Performance: Employ advanced techniques to ensure applications load quickly, run seamlessly, and scale across diverse devices and web browsers. 
 - Mentoring: Guiding junior and mid-level developers, pairing with them on complex bugs, and helping them level up their skills. 
 - Unblocking: Acting as a shield for the team by removing technical hurdles, resolving access issues, or clarifying ambiguous requirements. 
 - Hiring & Onboarding: Participating in technical interviews and creating seamless onboarding processes for new engineering hires. 
 - Aligning with Product & Design: Working closely with Product Managers and UX/UI Designers to assess technical feasibility, negotiate scope, and ensure designs are practical to build. 

Minimum Requirements

- Professional Experience: A solid background with a minimum of 10+ years of professional experience working as a Developer, combined with 3-5 years of demonstrated capability in functional or direct team leadership, guiding technical initiatives, and mentoring team members. 
 - Technical Capabilities: Strong proficiency in HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript/TypeScript. 
 - Framework Expertise: Practical, hands-on experience utilizing modern frameworks, particularly Angular. 
 - Development Tools: Familiarity with modern build tools such as Webpack and Vite, Git for version control, and state management libraries. 
 - CMS Proficiency: Skilled in working with various content management systems, including both traditional/coupled and headless CMS architectures. 
 - Interpersonal Skills: A strong eye for detail, outstanding verbal and written communication abilities, a passion for crafting excellent user experiences, and exceptional leadership skills. 

Preferred Qualifications

Preferred Qualifications

Having as many of these specific qualifications is a plus, but transferable skills/experiences may be equally valuable: 

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related technical field.

The POD Lead owns end-to-end delivery of AI solutions on GCP for the client. They design the solution, lead a pod of three FDEs, and are the main technical face to the client's business and IT stakeholders. 

Key Responsibilities

- Lead the pod team: plan sprints, assign work, review code and unblock the team
 - Translate client business problems into technical solution designs and delivery plans
 - Architect AI solutions on GCP, including GenAI, LLM and agent-based workflows
 - Design voice and document management solutions: speech-to-text, text-to-speech, conversational voice agents, document extraction and classification
 - Own production quality: debugging of complex issues, root-cause analysis, monitoring and performance tuning
 - Run client workshops, demos, status reviews and steering updates
 - Manage scope, timelines, risks and escalations with the client and internal leadership
 - Set coding, security and documentation standards for the pod
 - Mentor and grow the Senior and Junior FDEs

- GCP stack: deep hands-on experience with Vertex AI, Cloud Run, Cloud Functions, BigQuery, Google ADK, Cloud Storage, Pub/Sub, IAM and networking basics

data.title: Senior Software Engineer
data.description:
Your Job

Koch Capabilities is seeking a Senior Software Engineer to design, build, and support secure, scalable data, software, and AI-enabled solutions that create measurable business value. In this role, you will combine hands-on engineering expertise with solution architecture capabilities to deliver reusable platforms, products, and AI-powered solutions across Koch. 

The ideal candidate is a technically strong engineer who enjoys solving complex business problems, influencing technical direction, leveraging emerging AI technologies, and mentoring others while delivering high-quality solutions. 

Our Team

KTDS develops reusable data products, semantic layers, ontologies, and AI-ready capabilities that help teams make better decisions, accelerate work, and unlock new opportunities across Koch. We combine business knowledge, modern engineering practices, and AI-enabled delivery approaches to build scalable solutions that drive long-term value. 

This role is based in the Koch Capabilities India office in Bengaluru and requires an in-office presence with flexibility. 

What You Will Do

- Design, build, and support AI, data, and software solutions including data pipelines, APIs, applications, automations, and AI-enabled workflows. 
 - Lead technical delivery across multiple systems while ensuring solutions are secure, scalable, supportable, and aligned with business objectives. 
 - Apply AI-enabled development practices to accelerate delivery while maintaining engineering quality and operational excellence. 
 - Partner with architects, business stakeholders, subject matter experts, and product teams to translate business needs into practical technical solutions. 
 - Design and operationalize generative AI, agentic AI, semantic layers, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) capabilities. 
 - Evaluate technical tradeoffs and make sound engineering decisions that balance delivery speed, risk, maintainability, and long-term value. 
 - Provide technical leadership through architecture discussions, code reviews, design reviews, and mentoring of other engineers. 
 - Continuously explore emerging technologies, AI models, frameworks, and engineering practices to improve solution outcomes and business impact. 

Who You Are (Basic Qualifications)

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - 5+ years of professional software engineering experience. 
 - At least 1 year of hands-on experience developing AI-enabled or Generative AI solutions. 
 - Experience designing, developing, deploying, and supporting production-grade software, data, and AI solutions. 
 - Experience leading technical design or implementation efforts across complex, cross-functional initiatives. 
 - Strong programming experience using Python and SQL in production environments. 
 - Experience with source control, automated testing, CI/CD pipelines, observability, and modern software engineering practices. 
 - Experience building cloud-native solutions on AWS, including serverless, event-driven, and containerized architectures. 
 - Ability to communicate complex technical concepts and architectural decisions to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Experience mentoring and coaching engineers through technical guidance and collaborative development practices. 

What Will Put You Ahead

- Experience building AI-enabled solutions using large language models (LLMs), embeddings, graph databases, graph query languages, semantic technologies, and RAG architectures. 
 - Experience with MCP or similar agent integration standards. 
 - Experience designing verification and evaluation frameworks for AI-generated outputs, including testing, monitoring, observability, and governance controls. 
 - Experience designing distributed systems using microservices, event-driven architecture, API-first design, and modular architecture patterns. 
 - Experience applying DevSecOps and production engineering practices, including infrastructure as code, automated security controls, secrets management, feature flags, and progressive deployment strategies. 
 - Experience with enterprise data and AI platforms such as Microsoft Fabric, Fabric IQ, Snowflake, Azure AI Foundry, or Databricks. 
 - Experience designing and deploying agentic AI solutions for conversational or action-oriented use cases. 
 - Experience working with reusable platforms, enterprise-scale data products, and AI-enabled business solutions. 
 - Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline. 

At Koch companies, we are entrepreneurs. This means we openly challenge the status quo, find new ways to create value and get rewarded for our individual contributions. Any compensation range provided for a role is an estimate determined by available market data. The actual amount may be higher or lower than the range provided considering each candidate's knowledge, skills, abilities, and geographic location. If you have questions, please speak to your recruiter about the flexibility and detail of our compensation philosophy. 

Who We Are

At Koch, employees are empowered to do what they do best to make life better. Learn how our business philosophy helps employees unleash their potential while creating value for themselves and the company. 

Additionally, everyone has individual work and personal needs. We seek to enable the best work environment that helps you and the business work together to produce superior results.

Location: Remote (India)

We work to simplify the cloud for IT professionals so they can focus on what really matters, making their customers' lives better. C2, is our complete and innovative ITSM, facilitates service management for our partners and customers. Find out how we do that here: https: //c2-itsm. com/about-us/ and www. sherweb. com/about/

 - Apply SDLC best practices and design patterns effectively. 
 - Translate the Product Owner's vision into actionable technical plans and execute them with your development team. 
 - Identify elements of technical debt within the team, help prioritize them, and drive their resolution. 
 - Participate in recruitment activities, including second-stage technical interviews, when required. 
 - Stay up to date with emerging technologies and industry best practices, sharing relevant insights with the team as part of ongoing technology watch.

 - Integrate AI and Generative AI capabilities into web applications. 
 - Develop AI-powered features such as intelligent search, summarization, recommendations, Copilot, chat interfaces, and workflow automation.

data.description:
Description

Invent the future with us. 

Ampere is a semiconductor design company for a new era, leading the future of computing with an innovative approach to CPU design focused on high-performance, energy efficient AI compute. 

As a pioneer in the new frontier of energy efficient high-performance computing, Ampere is part of the Softbank Group of companies driving sustainable computing for AI, Cloud, and edge applications. 

Join us at Ampere and work alongside a passionate and growing team - we'd love to have you apply!

About The Role

As a core member of the Ampere Debug Tools team, you will be responsible for the architecture, design, and development of Debug Tools solutions for the next generation of Ampere products. This role is distinguished by deep technical ownership, architecture leadership, and cross-team influence. 

The Debug Tools Team is part of the Ampere Software Team. Our mission is to develop a comprehensive debug strategy and roadmap for internal debug capabilities, as well as to develop and deploy debug solutions for all internal and external Ampere SoC users. 

- Internal users include Debug Tools software users from the Virtual Platform, Emulation, Platform, Design Validation (DV), Post-Silicon Validation, Design For Test (DFT), Firmware, Operating System, Software, Performance, and Application Engineering teams. 
 - External users include partners, ODMs, OEMs, datacenter, edge and embedded customers. 
 - Debug solutions include Arm Development Studio, TRACE32 PowerView, and OpenOCD debuggers, Arm Self-Hosted Trace for Linux, and utilities for invasive debug, bus trace, instruction trace, array dump, and scan dump. This role will be for the lead of the Arm Development Studio implementation. 

What You'll Achieve

- Architect, design, develop, and deploy software-based Debug Tools for custom 64-bit Armv9 SoC and other processors. 
 - Invent new debug tools and techniques for future products and technologies. 
 - Influence the architecture and design team decisions with knowledge of internal and external debug tools on Ampere SoCs. 
 - Contribute to software architecture and design documents, application notes, and other software product documentation. 
 - Develop tooling for advanced debugging techniques, such as instruction trace, bus trace, array dump, scan dump, and ATE bootstrapping. 
 - Develop open source JTAG and self-hosted trace and debugger software for internal and external use in debugging Ampere microprocessors. 
 - Develop Arm Development Studio, TRACE32, and OpenOCD utilities for internal and external use in debugging Ampere microprocessors. 
 - Perform pre-silicon bring-up of debug software on software simulators and hardware emulation platforms. 
 - Collaborate with hardware design, architecture, post-silicon validation, and platform AE teams, as necessary, to resolve critical customer issues. 

About You

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or Software Engineering or related technical field & 8 years of related experience; or MS degree & 5 years; or PhD & 3 years
 - Proficiency with Arm® architecture and ecosystem, including Armv8-a/v9-a and Armv7-m processor architectures, Arm Debug Interface Architecture, Arm CoreSightTM Architecture, Arm AMBA® APB, AXI, AHB, and CHI protocols. 
 - Proficiency in C/C++, Python, and Bash programming. 
 - Experience using Arm Development Studio, TRACE32 PowerView, OpenOCD, and GDB debuggers. 
 - Experience with instruction trace, bus trace, scan dumps, array dumps, and crash capture. 
 - Experience with version control tools such as git, and software best practices. 
 - Strong analytical, debugging, and testing methodology skills. 
 - Proven ability to own problems and drive them to a resolution. 
 - Experience with system software debugging, tracing, and analysis tools, such as perf, ftrace, etc, is recommended. 

What We'll Offer

At Ampere we believe in taking care of our employees and providing a competitive total rewards package that includes base pay, cash long-term incentive, and comprehensive benefits. 

Benefits Highlights Include

- Premium medical, dental, vision insurance, parental benefits including creche reimbursement, as well as a retirement plan, so that you can feel secure in your health, financial future and child care during work. 
 - Generous paid time off policy so that you can embrace a healthy work-life balance 
 - Fully catered lunch in our office along with a variety of healthy snacks, energizing coffee or tea, and refreshing drinks to keep you fueled and focused throughout the day. 

And there is much more than compensation and benefits. At Ampere, we foster an inclusive culture that empowers our employees to do more and grow more. We are excited to share more about our career opportunities with you through the interview process. 

DR

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us. 

Ampere is an inclusive and equal opportunity employer and welcomes applicants from all backgrounds. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, citizenship, religion, age, veteran and/or military status, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, physical or mental disability, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law.

data.title: Site Engineer, Test Capability
data.description:
Job Description

- This role is a Site Engineering position within Nokia's Product Validation & Test (PV&T) R&D organization, where you will operate as a full member of the PV&T engineering team. Your primary purpose is to serve as PV&T's direct presence and working arm at manufacturing sites, focusing on Test Station Development (TSD). You will be actively involved on the factory floor, responsible for the setup, debugging, and continuous improvement of test stations. A key aspect of the role is driving the implementation of R&D-developed hardware, software, fixture, and procedural changes directly into manufacturing operations. This is distinctly an R&D engineering role situated within the production environment, not a CM test technician, supply chain, operations, or pure program management function. The position specifically covers TSD for either coherent pluggable and/or TROSA stations, requiring deep expertise in at least one of these station families. 

NILightpath

How You Will Contribute And What You Will Learn

- Design, bring up, debug, and improve optical test stations for performance, reliability, and production readiness in PV&T manufacturing. 
 - Work on-site with manufacturing and Contract Manufacturer (CM) teams to integrate stations into the factory test flow, including fixtures, instruments, automation, and measurement procedures. 
 - Analyze station data and provide feedback for station design, test protocols, and Test Station Development (TSD)/R&D. 
 - Manage the transition of R&D changes to factory reality, including software/firmware/fixture updates, procedure changes, and confirmation of line capability. 
 - Develop and maintain test protocols to ensure accurate and repeatable results, proactively addressing compliance, safety, and measurement-integrity issues. 
 - Represent PV&T at the manufacturing site, mentoring others and ensuring visibility and resolution of station-related issues. 

Key Skills And Experience

- Bachelor's or master's in engineering, Physics, or a related field (equivalent industry experience considered). 
 - Typically, 3+ years developing test stations or automated test equipment (ATE) in optical and/or electrical test. 
 - Working knowledge of optical measurement principles and how test hardware/software produces results. 
 - Comfort working in a manufacturing environment and willingness to travel regularly to Nokia/CM sites in Thailand and Malaysia. 
 - Ability to work effectively across hardware, software, and manufacturing teams to resolve issues. 
 - Coherent pluggable / PIC test-station or ATE development, OR TROSA / photonic-assembly test-station or ATE development. 
 - Electrical design, simulation, or schematic/layout support for test hardware; fixture, thermal, or PCB work, including RF and low-frequency analog/digital signals. 
 - Source control and software-driven test infrastructure (e. g. , Git, Azure DevOps, Bitbucket), with Continuous Integration (CI) for hardware test being a plus. 
 - Production data analysis, Statistical Process Control (SPC), or yield/debug of station-limited failures. 
 - Mentoring junior engineers or leading a station bring-up across multiple teams. 

About Us

Advancing connectivity to secure a brighter world. 

Nokia is a global leader in connectivity for the AI era. With expertise across fixed, mobile and transport networks, powered by the innovation of Nokia Bell Labs, we're advancing connectivity to secure a brighter world.

If you're interested in this role but don't meet every listed requirement, we still encourage you to apply. Unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences enrich our teams, and you may be just the right candidate for this or another opportunity. 

The length of the recruitment process may vary depending on the specific role's requirements. We strive to ensure a smooth and inclusive experience for all candidates. Discover more about the recruitment process at Nokia .
