data.title: Quality Assurance Automation Engineer
data.description:
Role Description

We're looking for a QA Automation Engineer (SDET) with 3 years of experience to own quality on our multi-tenant HRMS SaaS platform, built on a microservices monorepo. This is a full-time, on-site role at our Jaipur office. 

We want someone who thinks like a tester first: you should be able to read a requirement and spot the edge cases yourself, without depending on AI tools to write your test cases. 

Key Responsibilities

• Design, build and maintain automated regression and smoke suites using Cypress, Playwright or Selenium (JavaScript/TypeScript)

• Test REST APIs against Swagger/OpenAPI specs using Postman/Newman, covering JWT auth, status codes, request validation and pagination

• Write SQL queries (PostgreSQL), including joins, to verify data after UI and API actions

• Write test scenarios, test cases and edge cases from requirements using boundary value analysis, equivalence partitioning, decision tables and state-transition testing

• Validate role-based access (RBAC): what each role (Admin, HR, Manager, Employee) can and cannot see or do

• Test multi-step approval workflows (submit → approve/reject → escalate), including negative and edge paths

• Verify tenant data isolation so that one company's data is never visible to another

• Report clear bugs in Jira with steps to reproduce, expected vs actual results, and evidence

• Work with developers and product managers in Agile/Scrum sprints, from requirement review to release sign-off

Must-have Qualifications

• 3 years of QA experience, including hands-on automation with Cypress, Playwright or Selenium (JS/TS)

• Strong API testing experience with Postman/Newman or similar

• Strong SQL skills (PostgreSQL preferred), including joins

• Strong manual testing fundamentals and test design techniques

• Experience testing RBAC and multi-step approval workflows

• Good knowledge of JavaScript ES6+, Git and Agile/Scrum

• Clear bug reporting in Jira

• Experience with microservices-based or monorepo projects

• Willing to work full-time from our Jaipur office

Good to Have

• Understanding of Server-Driven UI (SDUI), or willingness to learn it quickly

• Multi-tenant SaaS testing experience

• HRMS domain knowledge: leave, attendance, onboarding, payroll (PF, ESI, TDS)

• Basic understanding of event-driven systems (Kafka, background jobs) and testing async flows

• Running automation in CI/CD (GitHub Actions or similar) and basic Docker usage

• TypeScript experience

• Basic security testing: OWASP Top 10, IDOR, auth/session issues

• Basic performance testing with k6 or JMeter

How to Apply

Apply here on LinkedIn, or email your resume to hr@codecreatortechnology. com with the subject "Application - QA Automation Engineer (SDET)". You can also call/WhatsApp 70735 88063. 

- If you have a GitHub repo with automation work, please share the link.

data.title: Senior Staff Software Engineer
data.description:
Overview

We are building a culture of innovators, risk-takers, and imaginative thinkers. To become AI-native, we look for "builders" who use AI and emerging technologies to solve customer problems quickly and well. 

Join The Data Reliability Team As a Senior Staff Software Engineer. Our Mission Is To Make Intuit's Business-critical Data Trusted, Observable, And AI-ready. We Build The Platforms That Measure And Enforce Data Quality, Detect Data And Data Pipeline Failures Early, And Turn Them Into Actionable Alerts & Incidents. Our Work Includes

- Data Quality Monitoring : Profiling the Data and automate schema based Data Quality checks, execute and calculate Data Quality score, Maturity Score Calculation, and Data Parity validation between each hop of the data lifecycle for critical business use cases covering Lake Tables, Kafka Topics and Data Pipeline health. 
 - Data Observability and Alert 2 Incident (A2I): a self-serve detect-and-act capability. Owners onboard Tier 1 assets through a UI or an agentic experience, choose pipeline and data quality signals and thresholds, tune them during an observation period, and get paged through automated incidents before downstream users feel the impact. 1500+ Data assets are managed and monitored under this capability. 
 - Data Observability Dashboard the Intuit-wide command center that gives leaders a single view of Data health. It covers clean-data standards, availability, A2I incident effectiveness, cost and consumption, and the verified or potential business impact of unhealthy data. 

As a Senior Staff Software Engineer, you will be a technical leader and domain expert across multiple teams, responsible for multiple capabilities of a composite platform. You will apply master-level software engineering to design, build, and run backend systems that process high-volume data and operational signals reliably. This is an individual contributor role with no direct reports. You will typically drive work across multiple scrum teams (15 to 20+ engineers), influence technology and product direction, tactically strong to deal with conflicts and drive alignments to unblock technical direction of the platform capabilities and balance short-term delivery with long-term business impact. 

Responsibilities

Technical Leadership and Execution

- Spend 70-85% of your time hands-on across the full software lifecycle: design, build, test, deploy, and operate. 
 - Architect and build scalable, secure, highly available backend services and APIs that power data quality evaluation, signal detection, incident creation, and impact analysis. 
 - Drive the next phase of A2I: Lead the evolution of the Data Observability platform. This includes simplifying the overall Platform and coming up with end to end system for intelligently connecting the issues in one hop of the data lifecycle to consolidate the Incident creation and avoid noise across the entire data lifecycle causing churn for all data producers and consumers across the chain. 
 - Data Observability Dashboard: Create a technical vision for the health observability essentials (logs, traces and metrics) and how to use those to create insightful actionable KPIs for Data Producers and consumers to increase the confidence on the Data Quality and Reliability. 
 - Build reliable data and event pipelines (Spark, Databricks, Kafka) that feed health, availability, cost, and incident metrics into Data 360 and other leadership views. 
 - Define the technical strategy, design specifications, and estimates for large, cross-capability initiatives, and manage conflicts and alignments to see them through to delivery. 
 - Diagnose and resolve complex, cross-system production issues. Lead RCA and drive durable fixes that raise the platform's own reliability and cut noise and false positives. 

Domain Expertise & Engineering Excellence

- Act as the domain authority on Data quality, Observability, and Incident management. Set standards for signal design, SLO and threshold models, alerting hygiene, and detection metrics such as MTTD, MTTR, and false-positive rate. 
 - Design for the five pillars: Operational excellence, Security, Reliability, Performance efficiency, and Cost optimization. 
 - Integrate with enterprise systems such as the data catalog and lineage, pipeline platforms, incident management, and paging tools. 
 - Find opportunities to apply AI in the product, such as anomaly detection, smart threshold recommendation, automated triage, and RCA. Ship AI integrations to production and measure their impact. 

Mentorship and Cross-Functional Collaboration

- Raise the technical bar through design reviews, tech talks, and mentoring. Coach and assess engineers, and support calibrations and talent development. 
 - Partner with product managers, TPMs, designers, data stewards, and platform teams across data, pipeline, and ITSM organizations to align roadmaps and unblock delivery. 
 - Explain complex architectures and trade-offs clearly to engineers, business partners, and senior leaders, and drive decisions. 
 - Work effectively with global teams across time zones
 - Define principles for the Capability offerings (Incident Management, Platform boundaries etc) to increase the efficiency of the platform operations

Qualifications

- 12+ Years of Software Engineering experience delivering enterprise class, high scale backend systems including significant experience in Multi Tenant Data Platforms and Observability. 
 - Expert in Java and Spring/Spring Boot for building microservices and APIs. 
 - Experience in Observability Stack Prometheus/Mimir, Splunk, ELK / Grafana
 - Experience with Big data and streaming technologies: Spark (batch and streaming), Databricks, and Kafka is a plus. 
 - Deep experience and expertise with Data observability concepts: monitoring and alerting design, Golden signals, SLOs/SLAs and thresholds, anomaly detection, incident management, and paging workflows. 
 - Strong knowledge of Data quality and Data reliability: DQ checks, data Parity, Data reconciliation at scale and Data lineage. 
 - Expertise in Data Mesh concepts, Data warehousing and handling large data volumes. 
 - Experience building and operating services in the cloud (AWS preferred) using containers and Kubernetes. 
 - Solid foundation in algorithms, design patterns, and distributed systems design, including scalability, fault tolerance, and idempotency. 
 - Experience with test automation (TDD, unit, integration, functional, and performance testing) and CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Experience using or integrating AI/LLM technologies, including AI-assisted development tools, and evaluating their performance in production. 
 - Proven ability to lead complex, multi-team technical initiatives and influence without authority. 
 - Excellent communication skills, with the ability to influence engineers, product partners, and executives. 
 - Strategic mindset. Uses data to shape technology and product decisions. Comfortable entering new areas, understanding them quickly, and driving immediate impact. 

Intuit provides a competitive compensation package with a strong pay for performance rewards approach. This position may be eligible for a cash bonus, equity rewards and benefits, in accordance with our applicable plans and programs (see more about our compensation and benefits at Intuit®: Careers | Benefits). Pay offered is based on factors such as job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and work location. To drive ongoing fair pay for employees, Intuit conducts regular comparisons across categories of ethnicity and gender.

data.description:
Position Type : Full time

Type Of Hire : Experienced (relevant combo of work and education)

DevOps Engineer

Are you curious, motivated, and forward-thinking?

At FIS, you'll have the opportunity to work on some of the most challenging and relevant issues in financial services and technology. Our talented people empower us, and we believe in being part of a team that is open, collaborative, entrepreneurial, passionate, and above all fun. 

About The Team

Team designs, builds, and supports cloud-based contact-center capabilities and supports infrastructure on AWS. The team engineer's client and shared environments using Infrastructure as Code and works across Amazon Connect, IVR and serverless workloads, APIs, security, networking, and platform integrations. 

The team supports the lifecycle of contact-center environments from infrastructure discovery and solution implementation through deployment, security remediation, defect resolution, and continued operational improvement. We collaborate with engineering, QA, architecture, cybersecurity, platform, and business stakeholders in a globally distributed Agile delivery model. 

What You Will Be Doing

- Design, build, and maintain secure, scalable AWS infrastructure supporting enterprise contact-center solutions. 
 - Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code using Terraform, ensuring infrastructure is repeatable, version controlled, and consistent across development, test, and production environments. 
 - Provision and configure AWS services supporting contact-center workloads, including Amazon Connect, AWS Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB, IAM, KMS, CloudWatch, S3, VPC, subnets, and security groups. 
 - Support onboarding and implementation of new contact-center client environments, including discovery, resource inventory, infrastructure design, configuration, deployment, and validation. 
 - Engineer and support serverless and IVR integrations, including Lambda functions and layers, APIs, runtime dependencies, environment configuration, contact flows, and supporting data stores. 
 - Build, enhance, and troubleshoot Jenkins' CI/CD pipelines used to validate and deploy infrastructure and application changes. 
 - Use Git and GitHub pull-request workflows for source control, peer review, automated validation, approvals, and controlled integration of infrastructure changes. 
 - Review Terraform plans and code changes, identify unintended infrastructure modifications, and troubleshoot failed builds and deployments. 
 - Implement AWS security controls including least-privilege IAM, KMS encryption, secrets management, secure networking, resource access controls, and appropriate data classification. 
 - Investigate and remediate cloud and dependency vulnerabilities identified through Snyk, Wiz, or equivalent enterprise security tooling; rebuild, test, and rescan affected components. 
 - Use monitoring, logging, and alerting capabilities to diagnose infrastructure and application issues and improve service reliability. 
 - Investigate defects and operational issues across infrastructure, integrations, and environments; contribute to root-cause analysis and durable corrective actions. 
 - Participate in Agile ceremonies, sprint planning, daily stand-ups, and Jira-based delivery tracking; communicate progress, risks, dependencies, and impediments clearly. 
 - Create and maintain infrastructure documentation, implementation plans, validation steps, rollback procedures, troubleshooting guides, and operational runbooks. 
 - Monitor cloud-resource utilisation and cost indicators and contribute to AWS cost-optimisation activities. 
 - Coordinate and collaborate with team members and stakeholders with limited supervision across multiple workstreams. 

What You Bring

- 6+ years of professional experience of hands-on DevOps, AWS cloud engineering, platform engineering, or infrastructure automation experience. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with AWS services and cloud architecture, particularly IAM, Lambda, KMS, CloudWatch, S3, VPC, subnets, security groups, and API integrations. 
 - Strong Terraform knowledge, including modules, resources and data sources, variables, locals, providers, remote state, environment-specific configuration, plan/apply workflows, imports, and troubleshooting. 
 - Practical experience developing and supporting CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins or a comparable enterprise automation platform. 
 - Strong Git and GitHub skills, including branching, pull requests, peer review, merge controls, and release practices. 
 - Experience with Linux/Unix, Bash or Shell scripting, Python, JSON, YAML, and REST/API troubleshooting. 
 - Working knowledge of AWS security and DevSecOps practices, including least-privilege IAM, encryption, secrets management, vulnerability remediation, dependency scanning, and secure configuration. 
 - Working knowledge of networking fundamentals including DNS, routing, firewalls, TLS certificates, load balancing, private connectivity, and network troubleshooting. 
 - Experience monitoring, logging, alerting, incident investigation, defect management, and root-cause analysis. 
 - Solid understanding of SDLC, Agile/Scrum, change management, release governance, and Jira-based delivery. 
 - BE / B. Tech / MCA / M. Tech, or an equivalent degree or relevant practical experience. 
 - Excellent written and verbal communication; able to translate business and operational needs into secure technical solutions and explain technical decisions to varied stakeholders. 
 - Adaptable, team-oriented, and results-driven, with strong ownership, prioritisation, and time-management skills. 

Privacy Statement

FIS is committed to protecting the privacy and security of all personal information that we process in order to provide services to our clients. For specific information on how FIS protects personal information online, please see the Online Privacy Notice. 

Sourcing Model

Recruitment at FIS works primarily on a direct sourcing model; a relatively small portion of our hiring is through recruitment agencies. FIS does not accept resumes from recruitment agencies which are not on the preferred supplier list and is not responsible for any related fees for resumes submitted to job postings, our employees, or any other part of our company.

data.title: Senior QA Engineer – Performance & Reliability
data.description:
About Axiado Corporation

Axiado is redefining how AI infrastructure gets secured and managed. Founded in 2019, we're a fast-growing, well-funded team of over 180 people worldwide, building the Trusted Control/Compute Unit (TCU), a new class of semiconductor that integrates hardware security, real-time platform management, and AI-driven optimization. Our TCU-based Platform Efficiency Controller is shipping hardware that makes AI servers measurably more efficient, more secure, and more reliable, and we're extending that foundation into a hardware-anchored management fabric that scales from a single board to the whole fleet. 

Backed by strong funding and validated by commercial programs with Tier 1 industry leaders, Axiado has earned recognition through numerous industry awards, including the 2026 AI in Cybersecurity Innovation Award from TMCnet, a Diamond award for Zero Trust Solution of the Year at the 2026 Pinnacle Awards, and Gold at the 2026 Cybersecurity Excellence Awards for AI Security Solution, as well as being a finalist for the Start-Up to Watch Award from the Global Semiconductor Alliance. We're small enough that every person's work visibly shapes the company, and we look for people who want to build, not just execute. Every employee holds equity, meaning your work directly builds your stake in the company's future, not just a paycheck. If you want to help define what comes next, let's talk. 

Job Description

Axiado is a top-tier manufacturer of TCU (Trusted Control/Compute Unit) solutions. We are hiring a Senior QA Engineer - Performance & Reliability to lead the performance characterization and reliability validation of our Secure TCU System, ensuring it meets rigorous data center standards. 

In this role, you will own the test design, execution, and deep-dive analysis for performance and reliability, working closely with development teams to identify bottlenecks and resolve complex system-level issues. 

Key Responsibilities

Performance & Reliability Strategy

- Test Design & Execution: Design and execute comprehensive test plans for performance benchmarking, stress testing, longevity/endurance testing, and thermal/power characterization of TCU/BMC systems. 
 - Workload Analysis: Analyze system behavior under various heavy workloads to identify performance bottlenecks in throughput, latency, and resource utilization (CPU, Memory, PCIe). 
 - Reliability Validation: Conduct Mean Time Between Failures (MTBF) prediction, long-duration stability tests, and error injection campaigns to validate system robustness. 

Deep Dive & Issue Resolution

- Root Cause Analysis: Lead the deep-dive investigation of performance degradation and reliability failures. Use advanced debugging tools (oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, firmware traces) to isolate issues. 
 - Developer Collaboration: Work directly with firmware and hardware engineers to reproduce complex bugs, analyze crash dumps, and verify fixes. 
 - Infrastructure Enhancement: Develop and maintain automated performance testing frameworks and reporting dashboards to track regression and trends over time. 

Reporting & Leadership

- Reporting: Generate detailed performance assessment reports and reliability analysis metrics for stakeholders. 
 - Mentorship: Mentor junior engineers on performance testing methodologies and system debugging techniques. 

Qualifications

- Experience: 5+ years of experience in embedded system testing, with a strong focus on performance verification and reliability engineering. 
 - System Knowledge: Deep understanding of TCU, BMC, HMC, RoT (Root of Trust), Secure Boot, TPM, HSM, PCIe (Gen4/5), DDR memory, and networking protocols. 
 - Performance Tools: Proficiency with performance profiling tools, traffic generators, and standard benchmarks (e. g. , SPEC, IOzone, iperf). Experience with thermal and power measurement tools. 
 - Programming: Strong scripting skills in Python for test automation and data analysis; familiarity with C/C++ for code analysis is a plus. 
 - Operating Systems: Strong Linux/Unix skills, including kernel tuning, system monitoring, and log analysis. 
 - Tools: Experience with CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitLab CI) and version control (Git). 
 - Education: BS/MS degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field. 

Ways to Stand Out

- Experience with AI-driven log analysis or anomaly detection tools to predict reliability issues. 
 - Background in validation of high-speed interfaces (PCIe, CXL) and memory subsystems (DDR5/LPDDR5). 
 - Experience with data center server architecture and thermal management. 
 - Knowledge of industry reliability standards (e. g. , Telcordia, JEDEC). 

Note: We do not expect candidates to meet every single requirement. A strong core of these skills with a problem-solving mindset is what we value most. 

Additional Information

Axiado is committed to attracting, developing, and retaining the highest caliber talent in a diverse and multifaceted environment. We are headquartered in the heart of Silicon Valley, with access to the world's leading research, technology and talent. 

We are building an exceptional team to secure every node on the internet. For us, solving real-world problems takes precedence over purely theoretical problems. As a result, we prefer individuals with persistence, intelligence and high curiosity over pedigree alone. Working hard and smart, continuous learning and mutual support are all part of who we are. 

Axiado is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Axiado does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status or any other basis covered by appropriate law. All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need.

General Summary

As a leading technology innovator, Qualcomm pushes the boundaries of what's possible to enable next-generation experiences and drives digital transformation to help create a smarter, connected future for all. As a Qualcomm Hardware Engineer, you will plan, design, optimize, verify, and test electronic systems, bring-up yield, circuits, mechanical systems, Digital/Analog/RF/optical systems, equipment and packaging, test systems, FPGA, and/or DSP systems that launch cutting-edge, world class products. Qualcomm Hardware Engineers collaborate with cross-functional teams to develop solutions and meet performance requirements. 

Minimum Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Engineering, or related field and 6+ years of Hardware Engineering or related work experience. 

OR

Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Engineering, or related field and 5+ years of Hardware Engineering or related work experience. 

OR

PhD in Computer Science, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Engineering, or related field and 4+ years of Hardware Engineering or related work experience. 

We are looking for a Staff / Senior Staff CPU Tools, Platform & QA Engineer to drive the quality, validation, automation, and scalability of CPU engineering infrastructure across the complete product lifecycle - from testbench and emulation platforms through firmware and silicon. 

The role will have broad technical ownership across CPU tools, PnP (Power & Performance), telemetry, regression infrastructure, firmware, and platform QA (BareMetal and OS based Frameworks test execution etc. )

This is a senior technical leadership role requiring strong CPU fundamentals, software/firmware expertise, validation and automation experience, and the ability to debug complex issues spanning CPU hardware, tools, firmware, emulation, and silicon. 

Key Responsibilities

- Define and drive end-to-end QA and validation strategy for CPU tools and platforms across: 
 - Pre-silicon testbenches
 - Emulation platforms
 - Firmware / bare-metal environments
 - Silicon platforms
 - Post-silicon labs

- Own quality and validation of CPU infrastructure including: 
 - CPU firmware and low-level software
 - Platform testbenches
 - PnP infrastructure
 - Telemetry and data-collection frameworks
 - Regression and automation infrastructure

- Drive Power & Performance (PnP) framework validation, including automated execution, data collection, analysis, regression detection, and correlation across platforms. 
 - Develop and maintain telemetry regression frameworks to track CPU performance, power, functional, and system-level metrics across builds, platforms, and silicon generations. 
 - Establish automated nightly/weekly regression pipelines, including: 
 - Test execution
 - Telemetry collection
 - Golden-data comparison
 - Performance/power deviation analysis
 - Regression detection
 - Failure triage
 - Dashboards and reporting

- Build mechanisms to correlate emulation, testbench, and silicon results, enabling early identification of potential silicon issues. 
 - Define quality gates and release criteria for CPU tools, firmware, PnP infrastructure, telemetry, and platform releases. 
 - Drive root-cause analysis of failures spanning CPU architecture, firmware, tools, test infrastructure, emulation, and silicon. 
 - Identify systemic gaps in test coverage, telemetry, automation, and regression infrastructure and drive solutions across engineering organizations. 
 - Develop scalable frameworks that transition CPU validation from manual execution to automated, data-driven QA. 
 - Partner closely with CPU architecture, design, firmware, CAD, validation, performance, power, emulation, and post-silicon teams. 
 - Lead technical initiatives across multiple CPU programs and generations. 
 - Mentor engineers and provide technical direction to distributed engineering teams. 

PnP & Telemetry Responsibilities

- Define methodology for CPU power and performance characterization and regression. 
 - Build automated pipelines for collecting and analyzing: 
 - CPU performance metrics
 - Frequency / Fmax behavior
 - Power metrics
 - Performance counters / telemetry
 - Workload-level KPIs
 - Platform health metrics

- Establish golden baselines and deviation thresholds for automated regression detection. 
 - Develop correlation between pre-silicon models, emulation, and silicon telemetry. 
 - Detect performance/power regressions early and drive cross-functional debug to root cause. 
 - Build dashboards providing clear visibility into CPU quality, performance, power, and platform health. 
 - Enable scalable telemetry analysis across large regression datasets and multiple CPU programs. 

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or related field. 
 - 10+ years of relevant engineering experience, with demonstrated technical leadership at Staff/Senior Staff level. 
 - Strong understanding of CPU architecture, system architecture, and low-level software. 
 - Experience in CPU validation, post-silicon, emulation, firmware, performance, power, or system-level engineering. 
 - Strong programming skills in C/C++ and Python. 
 - Experience developing automation, regression, CI/CD, telemetry, and QA frameworks. 
 - Strong debugging skills across hardware/software boundaries. 
 - Experience analyzing large datasets and identifying performance, power, functional, or telemetry regressions. 
 - Ability to lead complex cross-functional debug and drive issues to closure. 
 - Strong written and verbal communication skills. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with ARM / ARM64 CPU architecture and ISA. 
 - Experience with CPU Power & Performance (PnP) validation. 
 - Experience with CPU performance counters, telemetry, profiling, and workload characterization. 
 - Experience with Veloce, Palladium, or equivalent emulation platforms. 
 - Experience with CPU firmware, bare-metal environments, Linux, and low-level debugging. 
 - Experience with post-silicon CPU validation and silicon debug. 
 - Experience developing large-scale regression infrastructure and data analytics. 
 - Experience establishing golden-data based regression and automated quality dashboards. 
 - Experience across multiple CPU generations or complex SoC programs. 

Staff / Senior Staff Leadership Expectations

At This Level, The Engineer Is Expected To

- Drive technical strategy and architecture, not just execute individual projects. 
 - Own quality across the Tools → Firmware → Testbench → Emulation → PnP/Telemetry → Silicon ecosystem. 
 - Identify systemic problems and develop solutions that scale across CPU programs. 
 - Influence architecture, infrastructure, and validation methodologies. 
 - Lead complex cross-functional technical investigations. 
 - Establish engineering standards for automation, regression, telemetry, and quality. 
 - Mentor engineers and raise the technical bar across the organization. 

Core Ownership Areas

CPU Tools | Firmware | Testbenches | Emulation | Silicon | PnP | Telemetry | Regression | QA | Automation

data.title: Engineering Manager, Managed Gateways
data.description:
Are you ready to unlock intelligence?

If you don't think you meet all of the criteria below but are still interested in the job, please apply. Nobody checks every box - we're looking for candidates that are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others. 

The Mission

Kong Cloud Gateways is Kong's foundational cloud-native SaaS platform, powering its managed API and AI Gateway offerings. It provides a multi-tenant control plane, automation, and platform services that enable customers to securely deploy, operate, and scale dedicated gateway infrastructure with the simplicity of a fully managed cloud service. 

At its core, building and operating this platform is a large-scale software engineering challenge, involving complex distributed systems, automation, and infrastructure orchestration. The platform must deliver 4-9s (99. 99%+) reliability while operating across multiple clouds, regions, and highly distributed customer environments. Achieving this requires deep software engineering expertise and strong distributed systems fundamentals, with a focus on scalability, resilience, performance, and multi-tenancy. 

As an engineering Manager for Managed Gateways Platform, you will take full ownership of the engineering charter, leading and growing the team while being accountable for the architecture, development, delivery, and operation of this multi-tenant SaaS platform. With Cloud Gateways growing 100% YoY and becoming increasingly central to Kong's API and AI strategy, your work will directly influence product innovation, customer experience, platform economics, and our ability to serve some of the world's largest enterprises at global scale. 

This is a highly technical Software Engineering leadership role building the software platform behind a globally distributed, multi-cloud SaaS infrastructure product, with end-to-end ownership of everything from code to production infrastructure. It sits at the intersection of hardcore software engineering, distributed systems, and large-scale infrastructure ownership. We believe in a you-build-it-you-run-it model, where engineering teams take 100% ownership of the systems they build, from architecture and implementation through deployment, reliability, and production operations. You're expected to stay close to the code and architecture, lead complex engineering challenges alongside your team, and take complete accountability for engineering outcomes. 

What You'll Do

- Own the Managed Gateways Platform engineering charter end-to-end, providing technical direction, building and growing a high-performing team, raising the engineering bar, and taking full accountability for execution and outcomes. 
 - Lead the design and development of core SaaS platform capabilities, including provisioning systems, fleet management, automation frameworks, platform services, and software lifecycle management. 
 - Architect and build highly scalable distributed systems powering a multi-tenant SaaS platform across regions and clouds, driving sound architectural decisions around isolation, scalability, fault tolerance, and blast-radius management. 
 - Drive 100% ownership across the software lifecycle, from design and development through deployment, observability, reliability, and production operations. Establish a strong you-build-it-you-run-it culture where engineering teams are fully accountable for what they build and operate. 
 - Own the reliability, scalability, and performance of the platform and its underlying infrastructure, driving 99. 99%+ availability across multi-region, multi-cloud deployments (AWS, Azure, GCP), with a focus on resilience, capacity management, and infrastructure efficiency. 
 - Stay hands-on in critical engineering challenges, contributing to architecture reviews, complex implementations, production debugging, and high-stakes technical decisions. 
 - Drive platform automation and operational excellence, building self-service capabilities and tooling while strengthening SLOs/SLIs, incident response, root cause analysis, zero-downtime upgrades, and engineering efficiency. 
 - Collaborate closely with Product, engineering, and support teams to shape the platform roadmap, influence product capabilities, and ensure engineering investments translate into customer and business outcomes. 

What You'll Bring

The Toolkit

- Proven experience leading software engineering teams building and operating large-scale software platforms in high-growth environments, with a strong track record of technical leadership and hands-on involvement. 
 - Deep expertise in designing, developing, and operating highly available distributed systems on AWS, Azure, or GCP. Comfortable writing and debugging code, troubleshooting production systems, and making architectural decisions. 
 - Extensive hands-on experience with Kubernetes and container orchestration in production. 
 - Proficiency in Golang or similar modern programming languages for building scalable platform services and distributed systems. 
 - Strong understanding of observability principles and experience with Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, or similar. 
 - Experience managing critical production incidents, performing root cause analysis, and implementing preventative measures. 
 - Familiarity with API gateway technologies, service mesh, or network proxies is a significant plus. 

The DNA

- Ownership: You take 100% responsibility for the systems, teams, and outcomes you own, driving initiatives from conception to completion without waiting for someone else to connect the dots. 
 - Urgency: You thrive in dynamic environments, prioritizing critical issues and delivering impactful solutions with speed and precision. 
 - Collaboration: You build strong relationships, foster open communication, and work effectively across global teams to achieve shared goals. 

Bonus Points

- Experience with open-source contributions or active participation in SRE/cloud-native communities. 
 - Certifications in cloud platforms (e. g. , AWS Certified DevOps Engineer) or Kubernetes (e. g. , CKA, CKAD). 
 - Background in companies focused on developer tools, infrastructure software, or API management. 

About Kong

Kong Inc. , the AI Connectivity Company, is building the connectivity layer of AI. Trusted by the Fortune 500® and AI-native startups alike, Kong's unified API and AI platform enables organizations to secure, manage, accelerate, govern, and monetize the flow of intelligence across APIs and AI traffic - on any model, any cloud. For more information, visit www. konghq. com.

 - Protection Relay Testing 
 - Primary & Secondary Injection Tests

 - Lead customer inspections, Factory Acceptance Tests (FAT), and third-party inspections. 
 - Interface confidently with customers, consultants, and inspection agencies during inspections. 
 - Prepare, review, and close inspection reports, punch points, and quality observations in a timely manner.

data.title: Senior Product Validation Engineer
data.description:
Sandisk understands how people and businesses consume data and we relentlessly innovate to deliver solutions that enable today's needs and tomorrow's next big ideas. With a rich history of groundbreaking innovations in Flash and advanced memory technologies, our solutions have become the beating heart of the digital world we're living in and that we have the power to shape. 

Sandisk meets people and businesses at the intersection of their aspirations and the moment, enabling them to keep moving and pushing possibility forward. We do this through the balance of our powerhouse manufacturing capabilities and our industry-leading portfolio of products that are recognized globally for innovation, performance and quality. 

Sandisk has two facilities recognized by the World Economic Forum as part of the Global Lighthouse Network for advanced 4IR innovations. These facilities were also recognized as Sustainability Lighthouses for breakthroughs in efficient operations. With our global reach, we ensure the global supply chain has access to the Flash memory it needs to keep our world moving forward. 

Description

About the position: 

As a Senior Product Validation Engineer, you will be part of firmware verification team that design and develop white box and grey box tests in Python to verify device firmware designs for each firmware/Product/System feature. You will be working closely with product/System architects and firmware engineers to create a comprehensive system verification test for features. In this role, you will be contributing to test strategy, test development, integrating the tests using various development platforms, deploying it on system verification lab for regression runs and perform failure analysis. The role focuses on defining and executing robust firmware/Device/system verification strategies for UCIe/AXI and custom host-device protocols across both pre‐silicon and post‐silicon environments. 

Responsibilities

- Collaborate closely with firmware engineers & architects on product architecture and designs to define the comprehensive verification plan to validate each product features
 - Design, Develop and Integrate the white box and gray box tests on products in roadmap
 - Conduct test plan reviews and code reviews to ensure the tests are scalable and meeting the requirements
 - Participate in driving failure analysis and collaborate with integration/execution engineers for test deployment. 
 - Validate designs against UCIe Specification ensuring compliance with electrical, logical, and transaction-layer requirements. 
 - Define and own firmware/System validation strategy for UCIe front-end subsystems, including resets, interrupts, Logging and error handling. 
 - Define, plan, and execute system-level validation strategies for front-end (PHY + controller) IP, back end(Controller +NAND) IP and SoC-level integration. 
 - Integrate tests into scalable automation frameworks supporting simulation, emulation, and silicon validation. 
 - Debug firmware issues, perform front-end error injection, and expose design or integration defects. 
 - Validate UCIe compliance, robustness of fault detection and recovery mechanisms. 
 - Review and verify firmware trace logs and debug telemetry for correctness and completeness. 
 - Drive validation readiness across pre‐silicon and post‐silicon platforms, ensuring alignment of firmware specs, drivers, and test collateral. 
 - Interface with cross‐functional stakeholders to ensure validation coverage meets product and customer requirements. 
 - Drive compliance and interoperability testing with various endpoints 
 - Proven expertise in defining and driving end-to-end validation strategies across simulation, emulation/FPGA, and post-silicon platforms for complex SoCs and storage systems. 
 - Strong experience validating hardware IPs in pre-silicon environments (RTL simulation, SystemC/VDK, emulation, FPGA prototyping) and post-silicon environments. 
 - Possess deep understanding of Host SoC integration, firmware-hardware interactions, subsystem interoperability, and system-level debug across the complete product stack. 
 - Proficiency in high-performance/AI compute architectures, accelerator data paths, workload scheduling, and system-level performance validation

Qualifications

Required Qualifications & Skills: 

- BE/B. Tech/ME/M. Tech degree in CSE/ ECE/ EEE/ IS or related field
 - In-depth knowledge of UCIe/AXI, flow control, ordering rules, error handling, power management
 - Proficiency with protocol analyzers/exercisers (Teledyne LeCroy, Keysight) etc. 
 - Experience with high‐performance storage, networking, or compute SoCs. 
 - Strong expertise in UCIe protocol, DMA, and ASIC front-end architecture. 
 - Strong scripting skills in Python/C/C++ based scripting API's. 
 - Hands-on experience with error injection, fault modeling, and silicon debug tools. 
 - Familiarity with pre‐silicon (simulation/emulation) and post‐silicon lab validation flows. 
 - Solid understanding of firmware-hardware interaction and system-level debugging. 
 - Demonstrated leadership in test strategy definition, technical reviews, and mentoring. 
 - Strong problem-solving skills and ability to drive issues to closure under schedule pressure. 
 - Excellent communication skills with the ability to collaborate across teams and influence technical decisions. 
 - Proficiency in scripting and automation using Python, C/C++, or Bash. 
 - Minimum 6 - 8 years of related experience in firmware verification or system level testing
 - Knowledge on Git, CI & source code management flow and agile development practices. 

Soft Skills

- Strong problem-solving skills with a focus on root cause analysis. 
 - Collaborative and proactive communication style. 
 - Attention to detail and quality assurance mindset. 
 - Ability to work effectively in a global, cross-functional team. 

Additional Information

Sandisk thrives on the power and potential of diversity. As a global company, we believe the most effective way to embrace the diversity of our customers and communities is to mirror it from within. We believe the fusion of various perspectives results in the best outcomes for our employees, our company, our customers, and the world around us. We are committed to an inclusive environment where every individual can thrive through a sense of belonging, respect and contribution. 

Sandisk is committed to offering opportunities to applicants with disabilities and ensuring all candidates can successfully navigate our careers website and our hiring process. Please contact us at jobs. accommodations@sandisk. com to advise us of your accommodation request. In your email, please include a description of the specific accommodation you are requesting as well as the job title and requisition number of the position for which you are applying.

data.title: Senior Software Engineer in Test — C#.NET Distributed Systems
data.description:
Hyderabad, India | Hybrid - 3 days onsite

Role Overview

Nasuni is expanding the DryvIQ engineering team in Hyderabad. DryvIQ brings intelligent content discovery, classification, sensitivity detection, and policy-driven governance to enterprise unstructured data across cloud and on-premises repositories. 

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer in Test (SDET) to strengthen and scale automated quality across DryvIQ's complex, Kubernetes-based distributed application environment. 

This is a hands-on senior engineering role with a primary focus on C#/. NET test automation. You will maintain, extend, and improve existing automation frameworks, build high-value automated coverage, strengthen test infrastructure, and help automation scale as the DryvIQ platform evolves. You do not need to have built an automation framework from scratch; what matters is demonstrated depth improving and scaling automation in a complex software environment. 

You'll work across APIs, integrations, distributed and asynchronous workflows, containerized deployments, and user-facing functionality. Python and PyTest experience is valuable as we expand reusable tooling and cross-team libraries, but C#/. NET is the primary technical stack for this role. 

This role is for an engineer who approaches quality as a software-engineering problem, applying strong coding, debugging, systems thinking, and test-design judgment rather than focusing only on test execution. 

What You'll Do

- Maintain, extend, and scale existing C#/. NET-based test automation frameworks supporting DryvIQ. 
 - Design and implement reliable automated validation across API, integration, system, UI, regression, and end-to-end testing layers. 
 - Improve framework architecture, reusable components, test utilities, test-data capabilities, diagnostics, reporting, and maintainability. 
 - Build automated testing for Kubernetes-based, containerized, distributed applications, including multi-service and asynchronous workflows. 
 - Identify automation gaps, product risks, flaky tests, and framework limitations and prioritize improvements based on engineering and release impact. 
 - Build automated validation for APIs, microservices, distributed processing, asynchronous jobs, cloud and on-premises repositories, connectors, and enterprise integrations. 
 - Validate installation, deployment, configuration, upgrade, recovery, and failure scenarios in containerized environments. 
 - Integrate automated validation into CI/CD pipelines and improve the speed and quality of release feedback. 
 - Diagnose complex failures using application logs, APIs, Kubernetes/container evidence, telemetry, exceptions, service behavior, and other system evidence. 
 - Partner with developers to improve testability and determine the appropriate balance of unit, API, integration, system, and end-to-end coverage. 
 - Create maintainable automation patterns and reusable libraries that can be adopted by developers and QA engineers. 
 - Contribute to Python/PyTest-based utilities, tooling, or shared libraries as cross-team automation capabilities evolve. 
 - Help QA teammates strengthen automation skills through pairing, code reviews, examples, and technical guidance. 
 - Use approved AI-assisted engineering tools where appropriate for test design, code generation, scenario discovery, debugging, and coverage analysis, while independently validating generated outputs. 
 - Develop appropriate testing and validation approaches for AI-assisted or non-deterministic functionality. 

Qualifications

Must-Have

- 6+ years of software engineering, SDET, test automation, or quality engineering experience with substantial hands-on automation development. 
 - Strong hands-on programming and test automation experience using C# and . NET. 
 - Demonstrated experience maintaining, extending, troubleshooting, and scaling an existing test automation framework. 
 - Experience improving framework reliability, maintainability, reusable components, utilities, test infrastructure, or execution efficiency. 
 - Strong hands-on experience testing Kubernetes-based, containerized, distributed applications. 
 - Strong understanding of Kubernetes, containers, distributed-system behavior, service dependencies, asynchronous processing, and failure modes. 
 - Experience building automated validation across APIs, integrations, systems, and end-to-end workflows. 
 - Experience testing microservices, asynchronous processing, or comparable distributed workflows. 
 - Experience integrating automated testing into CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Ability to diagnose complex failures using logs, APIs, application exceptions, Kubernetes/container evidence, telemetry, and system behavior. 
 - Strong judgment about what to automate, at which testing layer, and when manual or exploratory testing provides greater value. 
 - Strong collaboration skills working with software engineers, Product, DevOps, and QA peers. 

Preferred

- Hands-on experience with Python and PyTest, particularly for test utilities, reusable libraries, tooling, fixtures, or cross-team automation. 
 - Experience working in engineering environments where C#/. NET and Python-based automation coexist. 
 - Experience creating reusable automation components or shared libraries used across teams. 
 - Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, or comparable UI automation technologies. 
 - AWS and/or Azure experience. 
 - AKS, EKS, K3s, or comparable Kubernetes environments. 
 - Cloud and on-premises connectors and storage integrations. 
 - SMB/NFS, S3, Azure Blob, or comparable enterprise data technologies. 
 - Postgres, ClickHouse, Keycloak, OAuth/OIDC, or similar technologies. 
 - Performance, load, reliability, resilience, or failure-injection testing. 
 - Test-data and test-environment architecture. 
 - Practical use of AI-assisted software or test-engineering tools with disciplined validation of generated outputs. 

Ideal

- Significant experience improving automation for a complex product previously dependent on manual regression. 
 - Experience evolving an established automation framework as product scale, architecture, or engineering requirements changed. 
 - Strong experience testing distributed C#/. NET applications. 
 - Enterprise storage, content management, data governance, security, or data-infrastructure experience. 
 - Experience building reusable automation capabilities adopted across engineering or QA teams. 
 - Experience helping manual QA engineers become productive automation contributors. 
 - Experience testing large-scale distributed enterprise applications. 
 - Experience validating AI-enabled or non-deterministic functionality. 

About Nasuni

Nasuni is the unstructured data foundation for enterprise teams-and the AI that supports them. We manage, protect, and activate the world's unstructured data so organizations can work smarter, spend wisely, and create safely without limits. 

As a Vista-backed SaaS data infrastructure company, Nasuni is transforming how enterprises manage file data with a next-generation, AI-ready platform-turning massive file stores into secure, actionable, AI-ready data for intelligent automation, analytics, and global collaboration. 

Why Work at Nasuni - Hyderabad

With Vista Equity Partners' backing, our Hyderabad team benefits from access to a global ecosystem of software leaders, cross-portfolio learning, leadership programs, and AI innovation communities-combining the pace of a growing product company with the scale and resources of a global technology investor. 

In this role, you'll help evolve and scale the automation foundation for an increasingly important enterprise product. You'll work at the intersection of cloud, Kubernetes, distributed systems, AI, content intelligence, data governance, and enterprise infrastructure while collaborating with DryvIQ and Nasuni engineering teams globally. 

Benefits At Nasuni Hyderabad

As part of our commitment to your well-being and growth, Nasuni offers competitive benefits designed to support every stage of your life and career: 

- Competitive compensation programs
 - Flexible time off and leave policies
 - Comprehensive health and wellness coverage
 - Hybrid and flexible work arrangements
 - Employee referral and recognition programs
 - Professional development and learning support
 - Inclusive, collaborative team culture
 - Modern office spaces with team events and perks
 - Retirement and statutory benefits as per Indian regulations

To all recruitment agencies: Nasuni does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to our job boards, Nasuni employees or any other company location. Nasuni is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes. 

Nasuni is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and respectful workplace where every team member can thrive. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, caste, color, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, disability, age, national origin, or any other status protected by applicable laws in India or the country of employment. 

This privacy notice relates to information collected (whether online or offline) by Nasuni Corporation and our corporate affiliates (collectively, "Nasuni") from or about you in your capacity as a Nasuni employee, independent contractor/service provider or as an applicant for an employment or contractor relationship with Nasuni.

data.title: Software Engineer II - Java / TypeScript
data.description:
Description

JOB DESCRIPTION

Leverage testing expertise to automate and design innovative test procedures, enhancing quality assurance through creative solutions. 

As a Software Engineer II at JPMorgan Chase within the Commercial & Investment Bank in Global Banking Technology, your goal is to ensure that our applications work as they should and meet customers' needs. You'll draw on your testing knowledge and creativity to automate test capabilities and design test and maintenance procedures. You'll also tap our existing test frameworks to tackle specific problems. We take a collaborative approach to quality, which means you'll work with experienced developers, managers and business partners across the organization. You'll receive coaching, mentorship, and continuous feedback to help you become an even better technologist and professional. 

Job Responsibilities

- Create new Manual Test Cases and upload the same into ALM Tools. 
 - Create new test automation scripts and ensure their ongoing maintenance and execution as required. 
 - Develop automation scripts in alignment with the existing test automation framework. Incorporate or update features within the framework based on guidance from technical leads. 
 - Work closely with developers, managers, and other stakeholders to gather all necessary information for effective test case automation. 
 - Design and implement automated API test suites in Java using REST Assured
 - Maintain test cases and document test execution results using QTEST
 - Log and track defects using the ALM tool, ensuring timely resolution and communication. 
 - Conduct peer reviews of automation code developed by other engineers to uphold quality standards. 
 - Participate in coaching, mentorship, and receive ongoing feedback to support professional growth. 

Required Qualifications, Capabilities And Skills

- Formal training or certification on Quality Assurance concepts and 2+ years applied experience

It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they are doing!

We're committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business. 

Role Overview

We are looking for an experienced Lead AI Engineer - Generative AI & Agentic AI to design, build and productionize enterprise-scale AI solutions. This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who combines strong software engineering fundamentals with deep expertise in AI/ML, Generative AI, LLMs and modern AI architecture. 

The ideal candidate will be comfortable taking AI solutions from experimentation to production, working across models, data, APIs, cloud infrastructure and enterprise applications, while providing technical leadership to engineering teams. 

What You'll Do

- Architect, build and productionize AI/ML and Generative AI solutions for complex enterprise use cases. 
 - Design and develop LLM-powered applications using RAG, AI agents, tool/function calling, orchestration and multi-agent workflows. 
 - Build scalable AI services and backend applications using Python, REST APIs and modern microservices architectures. 
 - Design end-to-end RAG architectures incorporating embeddings, vector search, retrieval, reranking and enterprise knowledge sources. 
 - Develop AI applications using frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, LlamaIndex or equivalent. 
 - Work with leading LLM platforms such as OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini or equivalent. 
 - Design and implement practices around LLM evaluation, observability, guardrails, security, latency and cost optimization. 
 - Build robust AI/ML pipelines covering experimentation, deployment, monitoring and continuous improvement. 
 - Integrate AI solutions with enterprise applications, APIs, databases, data platforms and cloud services. 
 - Evaluate emerging AI models, frameworks and technologies and translate them into practical enterprise solutions. 
 - Drive technical design discussions and contribute to architecture decisions across AI platforms and products. 
 - Establish engineering best practices for building secure, scalable and maintainable AI applications. 
 - Mentor engineers and provide technical leadership across AI engineering initiatives. 
 - Partner with product managers, data scientists, architects and business stakeholders to convert business problems into scalable AI solutions. 

What We're Looking For

- 10+ years of overall experience in software engineering, AI/ML engineering or related technology roles. 
 - Strong hands-on development experience in Python, with excellent software engineering and system-design fundamentals. 
 - Strong understanding of Machine Learning, Generative AI and Large Language Models. 
 - Demonstrated experience building and deploying GenAI/LLM applications into production. 
 - Hands-on experience with RAG, embeddings, vector search, prompt engineering, LLM orchestration and AI agents. 
 - Experience designing agentic AI workflows, including tool/function calling and complex or multi-agent orchestration. 
 - Experience working with at least one major LLM ecosystem such as OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini or equivalent. 
 - Strong understanding of REST APIs, microservices, distributed systems, databases and enterprise application architecture. 
 - Hands-on experience with at least one major cloud platform: AWS, Azure or GCP. 
 - Experience with LLM evaluation, monitoring, observability, responsible AI and guardrails. 
 - Ability to independently own the technical architecture and implementation of complex AI solutions. 
 - Strong problem-solving, communication and technical leadership skills. 
 - Experience mentoring engineers and influencing engineering/architecture decisions. 

Good to Have

- Experience with knowledge graphs, ontologies, semantic layers or GraphRAG. 
 - Experience with MLOps/LLMOps, model serving, CI/CD and AI observability platforms. 
 - Experience with vector databases such as Pinecone, Weaviate, Milvus, pgvector, Redis or equivalent. 
 - Experience with fine-tuning, model adaptation and open-source LLMs. 
 - Experience with AI security, governance, privacy and enterprise AI architecture. 
 - Hands-on exposure to PyTorch, Hugging Face, LangGraph, LangChain, Semantic Kernel or similar frameworks. 
 - Experience leading small engineering teams or mentoring senior engineers. 
 - Understanding of data engineering, streaming, distributed data processing and modern cloud data platforms. 

Education

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science or a related quantitative/technical discipline. 
 - Strong academic background, preferably from a premier engineering/technology institution with a demonstrated record of academic and technical excellence. 

What Will Make You Stand Out

We are particularly interested in engineers who can demonstrate that they have personally architected and built production GenAI systems, rather than simply experimented with LLMs. 

Strong candidates will be able to discuss real-world experience around: 

- Production RAG and Agentic AI architectures
 - Building scalable Python/API-based AI services
 - LLM evaluation and observability
 - Enterprise data and application integration
 - Security and guardrails
 - Latency and inference-cost optimization
 - Taking an AI solution from prototype → production → scale

If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us!

Not the right fit? Let us know you're interested in a future opportunity by clicking Introduce Yourself in the top-right corner of the page or create an account to set up email alerts as new job postings become available that meet your interest!

data.title: Lead Engineer - Ad Tech
data.description:
About Us

As a Fortune 50 company with more than 400, 000 team members worldwide, Target is an iconic brand and one of America's leading retailers. 

Joining Target means promoting a culture of mutual care and respect and striving to make the most meaningful and positive impact. Becoming a Target team member means joining a community that values different voices and lifts each other up. Here, we believe your unique perspective is important, and you'll build relationships by being authentic and respectful. 

Overview About TII

At Target, we have a timeless purpose and a proven strategy. And that hasn't happened by accident. Some of the best minds from different backgrounds come together at Target to redefine retail in an inclusive learning environment that values people and delivers world-class outcomes. That winning formula is especially apparent in Bengaluru, where Target in India operates as a fully integrated part of Target's global team and has more than 4, 000 team members supporting the company's global strategy and operations. 

Team Overview

Roundel is Target's entry into the media business with an impact of $1B+; an advertising sell-side business built on the principles of first-party, people-based data, brand-safe content environments and proof that our marketing programs drive business results for our clients. 

We are here to drive business growth for our clients and redefine "value" in the industry by solving core industry challenges rather than simply replicating existing industry methods of operation. Roundel is a key growth initiative for Target and aims to lead the industry toward a better way of operating within the media marketplace. 

Target Tech is on a mission to offer the systems, tools and support that our clients, guests and team members need and deserve. We drive industry-leading technologies in support of every angle of the business and help ensure that Target operates smoothly, securely and reliably from the inside out. 

As part of this evolution, we are building intelligent platforms for retail media space like ad decisioning, bidding, ad explanations etc. that combine traditional software engineering with Large Language Models, retrieval systems, knowledge graphs and agentic architectures to solve complex business and engineering problems at scale. 

Role Overview

As a Lead Engineer (Ad Tech & Applied AI), you will provide technical leadership across backend platforms and emerging AI-powered capabilities. 

You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to help define the technology strategy for Ad Tech platforms, including DSP, SSP and Ad Servers, supporting self-service advertising needs. You will assess build-versus-buy decisions for new capabilities through POCs and prototypes while considering long-term architecture, scalability, reliability and operational trade-offs. 

A key part of this role will be designing and building production-grade applications powered by Large Language Models and agentic systems from experimentation through production operation and continuous evaluation. We are looking for engineers who have moved beyond conversational AI prototypes and have experience engineering LLM-powered systems that operate reliably within real business workflows. 

You will design architectures that combine deterministic software components with probabilistic AI capabilities, making deliberate decisions about where traditional code, rules and workflow engines should be used versus where LLM-driven reasoning and autonomous agents provide value. 

You will lead engineering efforts to meet functional and non-functional requirements and assist teams in solving complex business challenges through scalable technical solutions. 

You will work closely with engineering managers to build high-performing engineering teams and provide technical leadership, architecture guidance, coaching and mentoring. You will also participate in the selection of technical talent and contribute actively to Target's broader technical community. 

About You

You have 8+ years of software development experience, with experience designing, building and operating complex distributed systems through at least one complete implementation lifecycle. 

You have strong backend engineering fundamentals and are comfortable designing scalable APIs, microservices, asynchronous systems and data-intensive applications. 

You are fluent in Java / Spring and microservices architecture, with experience building highly available production systems. 

You have experience working with databases including RDBMS and NoSQL technologies such as Cassandra and MongoDB, and understand data modeling and storage trade-offs. 

You have experience building distributed event-driven architectures using technologies such as Kafka. 

You understand Ad Tech business fundamentals and how technology supports business objectives, and can translate business vision into technical strategy while understanding architectural and financial trade-offs. 

Experience building or integrating DSP, SSP or Ad Server technology platforms in support of self-service advertising is preferred. 

Applied AI & LLM Engineering

You have hands-on experience designing, building and operating production applications using LLMs, beyond chat interfaces, prompt experimentation and proof-of-concept applications. 

You have designed and optimized production-grade RAG systems, with strong understanding of data ingestion and chunking, retrieval and ranking, context and grounding, hybrid retrieval, and evaluation. 

You have experience with knowledge graphs and graph-based retrieval, and understand when to use vector search, Graph RAG, structured queries, traditional search or hybrid approaches based on the problem and data. 

You understand the engineering trade-offs of production LLM systems, including quality, latency, cost, reliability, observability, security and failure handling, and can systematically improve retrieval and overall system performance rather than relying primarily on prompt engineering. 

Agentic Systems

You have designed or built agentic applications or orchestration frameworks where LLM-powered components interact with tools, APIs, retrieval systems and other agents to accomplish multi-step tasks. 

You Understand Concepts Such As

- Tool/function calling 
 - Agent planning and execution 
 - Workflow and state management 
 - Multi-agent orchestration 
 - Agent memory and context management 
 - Routing and delegation 
 - Human-in-the-loop workflows 
 - Guardrails and policy enforcement 
 - Retry, timeout and fallback strategies 
 - Agent observability and traceability 
 - Evaluation of agent behavior and task completion

You understand the distinction between deterministic and non-deterministic execution paths and can design systems that deliberately combine both. 

You know when a business workflow should remain deterministic and testable using conventional software and when probabilistic reasoning using an LLM or agent is appropriate. 

You design AI systems assuming that model outputs can be incorrect or unpredictable and therefore incorporate appropriate validation, constraints, structured outputs, fallbacks, idempotency, observability and human intervention where required. 

AI Quality & Evaluation

You understand that production AI systems require rigorous quality and evaluation practices beyond model selection and prompting. 

You have experience establishing offline and online evaluation strategies for LLM-powered systems, covering retrieval and response quality, factual grounding, task completion, reliability, latency and cost. 

You can build evaluation harnesses and regression tests with representative datasets, metrics and quality thresholds, and integrate them into CI/CD as deployment and quality gates. 

You can use evaluation, observability and tracing to diagnose quality issues across data, retrieval, context, prompts, models and orchestration, and drive systematic improvements. 

Engineering Leadership

You can translate ambiguous business problems into clear technical architectures and incrementally deliver solutions from experimentation through production. 

You make architecture decisions based on measurable trade-offs rather than technology trends and are comfortable challenging unnecessary complexity. 

You can lead POCs and technical experiments while clearly distinguishing between what demonstrates feasibility and what is required to operate the capability reliably at enterprise scale. 

You have proven technical leadership capabilities and the ability to influence engineers, product leaders and cross-functional stakeholders. 

You enjoy mentoring engineers and raising the technical capabilities of the broader engineering team. 

You collaborate effectively with Product and domain experts and can communicate complex architecture decisions to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. 

You stay current with evolving engineering and AI technologies through formal training and self-directed learning, while applying new technologies pragmatically. 

You have experience working within CI/CD and DevOps environments and understand production engineering practices including monitoring, observability, resilience, security and operational readiness. 

Useful Links

- Life at Target: https: //india. target. com/
 - Benefits: https: //india. target. com/life-at-target/workplace/benefits
 - Culture: https: //india. target. com/life-at-target/belonging

data.description:
About Team

GDF (Global Data Foundation) is part of Walmart's AI & Data organization - the team building the foundational data platforms that power AI, analytics, and decision-making across every Walmart banner and geography, from supply chain and merchandising to customer experience and enterprise AI agents. 

Our newly created platform team is chartered with building next-generation data infrastructure at Walmart scale: reliable, high-throughput data pipelines, distributed processing systems, and platform capabilities that downstream teams across Walmart depend on every day. 

What You'll Do

- Design, build, and operate distributed platform services and APIs using Java and Python, applied

against Kubernetes or equivalent cloud-native infrastructure. 

- Apply domain-oriented design, system design, and low-level design (LLD) rigor to ambiguous platform

problems - evaluating dependencies, trade-offs, failure modes, scalability, cost, and long-term

durability before writing a line of code. 

- Flex into data engineering work when needed: contribute directly to Spark-based data pipelines and

processing jobs, working comfortably in GDF's data engineering codebase alongside platform work. 

- Build AI, GenAI, and agentic-powered platform capabilities: intelligent developer tooling, workflow

automation, agentic services, and AI-assisted operational tooling (monitoring, incident triage, capacity

planning). 

- Own platform reliability, scalability, and observability - service-level objectives, distributed tracing, 

alerting, and incident response for services you build, with a strong Operational Excellence /

Engineering Excellence discipline. 

- Guide architecture and system design decisions across microservices, event-driven systems, and

enterprise integrations, with an explicit eye toward how platform choices affect downstream data

engineering workloads. 

- Partner with data engineers, data scientists, and ML engineers to ensure platform services expose the

right primitives for data pipelines, feature stores, and model-serving paths. 

- Establish engineering standards through architecture reviews, design reviews, code reviews, and

production readiness reviews for a team building process from scratch. 

- As a Staff engineer, set technical direction and best practices within your team and technical domain

without needing a management title - mentor other engineers and influence GDF's broader platform

engineering standards. 

- Continuously evaluate emerging platform, cloud, and AI/agentic technologies, adopting them

pragmatically where they improve reliability, productivity, or business value. 

What You'll Bring

- Genuinely hands-on coding: 8+ years of professional software engineering experience building and

operating large-scale distributed platforms; strong proficiency in Java and Python is required -

comfortable writing, reviewing, and debugging production code, not just directing others. Additional

experience with Go, C++, or Scala is a plus. 

- Operational Excellence (OE) and Engineering Excellence (EE) mindset is a required skill, not a

nice-to-have: SLO/SLA ownership, incident management and blameless post-incident reviews, 

proactive reliability and quality metrics, and continuous improvement built into how you ship, not

bolted on afterward. 

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or

equivalent practical experience. 

- Deep experience with microservices architectures, distributed systems, event-driven patterns, API

design, service contracts, and enterprise system integration - backed by strong system design, 

domain-oriented design (DDD), and low-level design (LLD) skills, with demonstrated ownership of

production code and the judgment to evaluate trade-offs, failure modes, scalability, and cost. 

- Deep understanding of cloud-native engineering practices - CI/CD, containerization, Kubernetes or

equivalent orchestration, infrastructure automation, and production operations. 

- Strong exposure to Big Data / data engineering technologies - Spark required at a working level, with

familiarity in Hadoop/HDFS, Hive, or Kafka - enough to flex into data engineering work confidently, not

just integrate with it from a distance. 

- Full exposure to AI and Agentic technologies: hands-on experience integrating model APIs and

GenAI/LLM tooling, building or operating agentic workflows (tool-calling agents, multi-step

autonomous systems), working with embeddings/vector search, and applying MLOps practices

(feature stores, model lifecycle, retraining pipelines) - not just conceptual awareness. 

- Strong knowledge of reliability engineering - observability, distributed tracing, logging, metrics, 

alerting, incident response, capacity planning, and fault tolerance for large-scale systems. 

- Strong grounding in security, privacy, and enterprise engineering practices, including authentication, 

authorization, data protection, and secure API design. 

- Proven ability to translate ambiguous technical/business problems into clear execution plans, 

particularly within a newly formed team without fully established process. 

- Strong ownership mindset and technical judgment; comfortable operating with high autonomy in a

0-to-1 environment.

TTEC Digital seeks a Senior Frontend Engineer (React + Chrome Extension) to join our team. This role is a full-time and fully remote opportunity!

The work: 
We're an innovation group inside TTEC (NASDAQ: TTEC), building the next generation of AI CX tools - automated QA, conversational analytics, knowledge assist, and agentic automation - for the world's biggest brands and the millions of customers they serve. We move like an early-stage startup, backed by the scale, distribution, and enterprise client base of a company that's been obsessed with customer experience since 1982.
