Ship the right products into thousands of live enterprise deployments and you don't just move a metric - you move the trajectory of the company and the value of the stock. The leverage is real, and the work compounds. 

Who we hire - the DNA: 

- Self-starters and do-ers with grit - hackers in the best sense, with a startup mentality and a show-me bias: working software over slides, prototypes over proposals. 
 - Want to learn, love new technology. This platform is built on the latest technology, and that technology changes and advances monthly. You adapt to change quickly - new tools, new models, new priorities - without drama. 
 - Master debuggers and problem solvers. You love solving complex problems, you think outside the box, and you multitask across domains without losing the thread. 
 - AI-native. You work with AI on all levels - you understand the technology around you (LLMs, SLMs, RAG, knowledge graphs, agents, training, eval) and you use AI tools daily to exponentially increase your velocity. 
 - Distributed-systems literate. High-efficiency, event-driven, low-latency systems are our world; you understand what that demands. 
 - Innovators who ship. You demonstrate ideas easily, fail fast, and move forward. You make committed timelines and hit them. 
 - You consider yourself exceptional - and you like winning. So do we. 
 - No one will have everything in this description. We're looking for well-rounded, smart people who move fast

What You Will Do: 
The role: 

- Build the Agent UI shell, the Chrome extension, the slide-out / pill workspace, the Control UI, and the per-module panels
 - This is the product wedge - what an evaluator demos in 5 minutes and decides "yes. "
 - Real-time UI over live voice, desktop, and AI event streams, in a startup environment: 1-week sprints, Friday demos, fail fast and move forward. 

What you'll own: 

- React app + Chrome extension (Manifest V3, content scripts, injected iframe, page-overlay pill)
 - WebSocket-driven real-time UI
 - plugin / module-federation patterns
 - Screen-real-estate management
 - The design system in code
 - Your committed timelines. 

Who you are: 

- A self-starter with a show-me mentality - you move from prototype to real-world product quickly and demonstrate ideas with working UI, not mockups
 - You love new technology and adapt fast when it changes
 - Consistent by discipline: you use shared libraries and established patterns instead of reinventing per feature - consistency is what keeps a small team fast
 - You use AI tools daily to multiply your velocity
 - You consider yourself exceptional, love solving hard problems, and like winning. 

What You Will Bring: 

- 7+ years frontend; senior-level React + TypeScript mandatory. HTML5, JavaScript, and graphics skills all ++++ - 
 - You're a master of the browser platform itself, not just a framework user (canvas/SVG/WebGL, animation, rendering). 
 - Strong design/UI skills a +++ - you have taste; your UIs look and feel professional without a designer holding your hand. 
 - Real Chrome Extension experience - Manifest V3, content scripts, the messaging model, injecting UI over a host page. This is core, not a footnote. 
 - Strong API skills - you design and consume clean APIs, and you understand the backend messaging systems behind them (pub/sub, event streams, WebSocket) well enough to reason about ordering, reconnects, and state sync. 
 - Heavy WebSocket / real-time UI; you've built interfaces that update from a live event stream. 
 - Plugin / module-federation or dynamic-component-loading experience. 
 - Performance as a habit - render profiling, virtualization for dense data, sub-frame updates under a firehose event stream; the UI must never be the latency bottleneck. 
 - State management under streaming data - optimistic updates, reconnect/replay handling, conflict resolution. 
 - Extension security fluency - CSP, sandboxing, isolated worlds; we inject UI into other companies' pages and can never break or leak. 
 - Automated UI testing (Playwright-class) as part of shipping, not a QA handoff. 
 - Accessibility and keyboard-first flows as defaults - agents live in this UI 8 hours a day. 
 - A master debugger in the browser - DevTools is an extension of your hands; you see the render bug, the leak, the layout thrash. 
 - Go literacy is a plus (you'll read it).

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. JOB DESCRIPTION

This role is responsible for conducting in-process and final product quality testing and analyses in strict compliance with established standards and regulatory requirements within a global pharmaceutical manufacturing environment. The incumbent interprets and evaluates analytical results in terms of accuracy and precision against predefined specifications to ensure product integrity. Various measuring devices, testing equipment, and predetermined methods are employed to accept or reject products based on prescribed specifications. The role contributes to identifying ongoing quality issues and preventing potential production problems through proactive testing and timely escalation. data.title: Quality Assurance Executive
data.description:
About the Role: We are looking for a detail-oriented Quality Assurance Executive who will monitor operational quality, maintain accurate records, and prepare MIS reports. The role combines strong Excel and data-handling ability with clear communication and documentation discipline, supporting day-to-day operations and ensuring processes meet defined quality standards. 

Key Responsibilities: 

1. MIS & Data Reporting

- Prepare and publish daily, weekly and monthly MIS reports on quality metrics, audit findings and operational performance. 
 - Consolidate data from multiple sources, clean and validate it, and ensure accuracy before sharing with stakeholders. 
 - Build and maintain dashboards, trackers and summary views for management review. 
 - Analyze trends, identify deviations and highlight areas needing corrective action. 

2. Quality Assurance Activities

- Conduct routine quality checks and audits of processes, transactions or outputs as per defined SOPs and checklists. 
 - Log non-conformities, track corrective and preventive actions (CAPA) and follow up until closure. 
 - Support internal and external audits by preparing the required data and evidence. 
 - Assist in identifying process gaps and recommending improvements. 

3. Documentation & Record Keeping

- Create, update and maintain SOPs, work instructions, checklists, formats and audit reports. 
 - Ensure version control and proper filing of all quality and operational records. 
 - Maintain audit trails and make documents readily retrievable. 
 - Prepare clear minutes, reports and summaries of quality reviews. 

4. Operations Support

- Coordinate with operations, production/process and support teams for day-to-day quality-related activities. 
 - Track operational activities, timelines and deliverables, and escalate delays or issues in time. 
 - Support process improvement initiatives and operational reviews. 

5. Communication & Coordination

- Communicate audit findings, observations and reports clearly to team members and management. 
 - Conduct feedback and follow-up discussions with process owners. 
 - Coordinate with cross-functional teams, vendors or clients as required. 

Required Skills & Competencies: 

Technical Skills

- Basic Excel: formatting, sorting, filtering, data entry, basic formulas (SUM, IF, COUNTIF, AVERAGE). 
 - Advanced Excel: VLOOKUP / XLOOKUP, INDEX-MATCH, Pivot Tables and Pivot Charts, conditional formatting, data validation, text and date functions, charts and dashboards. Knowledge of Macros / Power Query is an added advantage. 
 - Working knowledge of MS Word and PowerPoint for reports and presentations. 

Soft Skills

- Communication: clear written and verbal communication in English and Hindi; able to explain findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Documentation: strong attention to detail, structured writing and accuracy in record keeping. 
 - Analytical mindset, problem-solving ability and ownership of deliverables. 
 - Ability to manage multiple tasks, meet deadlines and work with minimal supervision. 

Qualifications: 

- Graduate in any discipline (B. Com / BBA / B. Sc / B. Tech preferred). 
 - 1-3 years of experience in MIS, quality assurance, operations or a similar role. 
 - Certification or training in Advanced Excel, Six Sigma or ISO standards is a plus.

Job Description

At Infoblox, every breakthrough begins with a bold "what if. "

What if your ideas could ignite global innovation?

We invite you to step into the next exciting chapter of your career journey. Bring your creativity, drive, your daring spirit, and feel what it's like to thrive on a team big enough to make an impact, yet small enough to make a difference. Our cloud-first networking and security solutions already protect 70% of the Fortune 500, and we're looking for creative thinkers ready to push that influence even further. Join us and discover how far your bold "what if" can take the world, your community, and your career. 

How we empower our people is extraordinary: we're recognized as a Glassdoor Best Place to Work 2025, Great Place to Work-Certified in five countries, and honored by Cigna as a Healthy Workforce honors for three consecutive years; and what we build is world class: named CybersecAsia's Best in Critical Infrastructure 2024 - clear evidence that when first-class technology meets empowered talent, remarkable careers take shape. So, what if the next big idea, and the next great career story, comes from you? Become the force that turns every "what if" into "what's next. "

In a world where you can be anything, Be Infoblox. 

Associate Software Engineer

We have an opportunity for an Associate Software Engineer to join our Universal Asset Insights team in Bangalore, reporting to the Senior Manager, Engineering. In this role, you will help build and evolve Infoblox Universal Asset Insights, a cloud-first platform that automates discovery and analysis of IP-based and non-IP-based assets across public clouds, on-premises networks, OT/IoT environments, and third-party applications. Collaborating closely with Product Management, Architecture, and cross-functional engineering teams, you will contribute to scalable microservices, data pipelines, and AI-powered capabilities that give our customers real-time, actionable visibility into their hybrid environments-while using our agentic AI development stack to boost productivity and reliability across the software development lifecycle. 

Be a Contributor - What You'll Do

- Develop cloud-hosted microservices and data pipelines for asset ingestion, transformation, and normalization across hybrid and multi-cloud environments
 - Build extensible integrations, including low-code/no-code patterns, that onboard new asset sources quickly and securely
 - Implement containerized, event-driven services using Docker and Kubernetes that meet scalability and reliability goals
 - Design and implement APIs and data models that expose rich asset and topology data to downstream analytics and user experiences
 - Use AI-assisted tools and agentic frameworks (LLM coding assistants, agents/sub-agents, MCP-style servers) to accelerate coding, testing, and documentation
 - Contribute to architecture reviews and design discussions to keep the platform secure, observable, maintainable, and cost-efficient
 - Implement and tune data storage patterns across relational, time-series, and NoSQL databases to support performant querying and analytics
 - Partner with SRE and Operations on observability (metrics, logs, traces), SLIs/SLOs, and incident response
 - Integrate asset visibility with Infoblox core services (DNS, DHCP, IPAM) and adjacent ecosystems such as CTEM, CAASM, and ITSM
 - Stay current on trends in asset intelligence, ETL, streaming, no-code/low-code, and agentic AI, and share ideas that improve developer productivity

Be Prepared - What You Bring

- 1- 2 years of professional software development experience in Golang/Go, with exposure to backend services
 - Foundational experience with microservices or distributed systems using Docker and Kubernetes on a major cloud platform
 - Basic understanding of data modeling and schema design across relational, time-series, or NoSQL databases
 - Familiarity with event-driven architectures and streaming technologies such as Kafka is a plus
 - Interest or early hands-on experience with AI/agentic frameworks or AI-assisted development tools (code assistants, test generation, intelligent search)
 - Exposure to performance debugging and troubleshooting in test or production-like environments
 - Good understanding of core networking concepts (L2/L3, TCP/IP) and security fundamentals; familiarity with DNS, DHCP, IPAM, CTEM, CAASM, or ITSM a plus
 - Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across global, cross-functional teams
 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field

Be Successful - Your Path

First 90 Days: Immerse in our culture, connect with mentors (Blox Buddies), and map the systems and meet with key stakeholders that rely on your work. Discuss and create short/long term goals. 

Six Months: 

- Own well-scoped features or services in Universal Asset Insights, from implementation through unit testing and code reviews
 - Build solid understanding of our asset-ingestion and normalization pipelines and contribute targeted improvements to robustness and efficiency
 - Implement or extend at least one integration or connector that onboards a new asset source or improves data quality
 - Establish consistent use of AI-assisted tools in your workflow and share effective patterns with teammates

One Year: 

- Serve as a subject-matter go-to for specific components (microservice, pipeline segment, or integration module) within the Universal Asset Insights platform
 - Lead design and delivery of small-to-medium architectural improvements that enhance platform extensibility, performance, or observability
 - Drive measurable improvements in code quality or reliability (higher test coverage, reduced defect rates) using agentic/AI capabilities in the SDLC
 - Partner with senior engineers and Product Management on prototypes and feature enhancements that expand the value of asset intelligence

Belong - Your Community

Our culture thrives on inclusion, rewarding the bold ideas, curiosity, and creativity that move us forward. In a community where every voice counts, continuous learning is the norm. So, whether you code, create, sell, or care for customers, you'll grow and belong here. 

Be Rewarded - Benefits That Help You Grow, Thrive, Belong

- Comprehensive health coverage, generous PTO, and flexible work options
 - Learning opportunities, career-mobility programs, and leadership workshops
 - Sixteen paid volunteer hours each year, global employee resource groups, and a "No Jerks" policy that keeps collaboration healthy
 - Modern offices with EV charging, healthy snacks (and the occasional cupcake), plus hackathons, game nights, and culture celebrations
 - Charitable Giving Program supported by Company Match

Ready to Be the Difference?

data.title: Senior Staff Digital Methodology Engineer - Design for Testability (DFT)
data.description:
We Are

Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow. 

You Are

You have spent over a decade architecting test solutions for chips that power everything from autonomous vehicles to data centers, and you understand that DFT is not an afterthought, it is the difference between a design that ships on time and one that bleeds money in yield loss. You know the nuances of scan compression versus hierarchical DFT, not from a textbook, but from making the call on a 10-billion-gate SoC where the wrong decision costs months. 

You are the person design teams call when ATPG coverage is stuck at 97% and manufacturing is demanding 99. 5%. You have debugged IJTAG networks that span multiple chiplets, written the Tcl that automated what used to take three engineers a week, and sat in rooms with VPs explaining why their test access strategy needs to change before tapeout. You do not just know the IEEE standards, you have deployed them in production silicon and lived with the consequences. 

At Synopsys, you will work on methodologies that define how the world's most complex chips get tested. The problems are hard, the customers are sophisticated, and what you build will matter. 

What You'll Be Doing

- Define and drive DFT methodologies for next-generation ASIC and SoC designs across strategic customer programs, translating architecture decisions into deployable best practices
 - Lead deployment of advanced test solutions including scan compression, hierarchical DFT, IEEE 1500 wrappers, IJTAG instrumentation networks, and embedded test IP across multi-billion-gate designs
 - Architect scalable test access infrastructures using IEEE 1149. 1, IEEE 1149. 6, IEEE 1687, and IEEE 1500 standards for complex multi-die and chiplet-based systems
 - Develop automation frameworks, signoff criteria, and reusable methodology packages using Tcl, Python, and Perl that accelerate adoption across business units
 - Serve as technical leader and subject matter expert for Synopsys TestMAX DFT, TestMAX ATPG, diagnosis, and silicon lifecycle solutions in customer engagements and internal escalations
 - Collaborate directly with R&D teams to influence TestMAX product roadmap based on real deployment challenges and customer requirements
 - Provide technical leadership for strategic customer engagements, methodology reviews, and complex DFT architecture decisions that impact tapeout schedules and silicon success

The Impact You Will Have

- Enable successful deployment of industry-leading DFT methodologies across the world's most advanced semiconductor programs in AI, automotive, and hyperscale computing
 - Drive measurable improvements in test coverage, pattern count reduction, and manufacturing yield through methodology standardization and best-practice development
 - Influence next-generation TestMAX capabilities by translating customer deployment challenges into product requirements that shape future releases
 - Accelerate adoption of standards-based test architectures across strategic accounts, reducing time-to-market and improving silicon reliability
 - Improve engineering productivity across multiple programs through automation frameworks and reusable methodology packages that eliminate redundant work
 - Establish Synopsys as the trusted technical advisor in DFT and manufacturing test, strengthening customer relationships and competitive positioning
 - Contribute to breakthrough technologies powering autonomous vehicles, AI accelerators, and next-generation networking infrastructure

What You'll Need

- Bachelor's or Master's in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field
 - 10+ years in semiconductor or EDA industry with at least 5 years focused on DFT architecture, ATPG, and manufacturing test methodologies
 - Demonstrated expertise architecting and implementing DFT solutions for large-scale ASIC and SoC designs, including successful tapeouts
 - Hands-on experience with Synopsys TestMAX DFT and TestMAX ATPG solutions in production design environments
 - Deep technical knowledge of scan insertion, scan compression, hierarchical DFT, ATPG and diagnosis, stuck-at/transition/path-delay/bridge/cell-aware fault models, and coverage optimization techniques
 - Expertise deploying IEEE 1149. 1 (JTAG), IEEE 1149. 6 (AC JTAG), IEEE 1687 (IJTAG), and IEEE 1500 standards in complex test access architectures
 - Experience integrating DFT IP including Codec/embedded compression, OCC, LBIST, TAP controllers, JTAG and IJTAG infrastructure, TDR networks, and IEEE 1500 wrappers
 - Strong understanding of RTL-to-GDSII flows and how DFT interacts with synthesis, physical design, timing closure, and signoff
 - Proficiency with Tcl, Python, Perl, or Shell scripting for methodology automation and deployment
 - Experience defining enterprise-wide DFT standards and signoff methodologies is a strong plus
 - Background supporting advanced-node ASICs, multi-billion-gate SoCs, silicon bring-up, diagnosis, or yield improvement is highly valued
 - Knowledge of functional safety standards and automotive test requirements is a plus
 - Contributions to industry test standards, technical publications, patents, or conference presentations strengthen your candidacy

Who You Are

- You can walk into a room with a customer's design team, diagnose a coverage gap in their hierarchical DFT strategy, and sketch a solution on the whiteboard that they trust enough to implement before tapeout
 - You mentor engineers not by telling them what to do, but by asking the questions that help them see the tradeoff they missed between test time and pattern count
 - You are comfortable presenting a methodology roadmap to a VP in two slides and then diving three levels deep with an engineer debugging an IJTAG network the same afternoon
 - You push back when a proposed DFT architecture does not align with manufacturing realities, and you do it in a way that builds trust rather than friction
 - You treat automation as a first-class deliverable, not an afterthought, because you know the methodology only scales if the Tcl actually works
 - You stay current with industry trends, standards evolution, and emerging test challenges because you know that what worked on 7nm will not necessarily work on 3nm

The Team You'll Be Part Of

You will join the Digital Methodology Center of Excellence, a highly visible organization responsible for defining and advancing Synopsys' DFT methodologies, best practices, and customer deployment strategies. Working closely with R&D, product engineering, customer success, and strategic accounts, you will help shape the future of Design-for-Test and drive successful adoption of the industry's most advanced test solutions worldwide. 

Rewards and Benefits

We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process. 

At Synopsys, we want talented people of every background to feel valued and supported to do their best work. Synopsys considers all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, military veteran status, or disability.

 - Expertise in the use of scripting languages, programming tools and environments
 - Extensive experience programming in Python

 - Experience with team leadership and/or supervising junior engineers and technicians

data.title: AI Backend Engineer
data.description:
Hiring for COSO Intelligence - via Flexiple, the recruiting partner on this role. 

About Company

- COSO Intelligence is a construction intelligence platform that uses AI to help construction professionals work with project data and make decisions. 
 - Company website: https: //cosobuild. ai

Job Roles & Responsibilities

- Build production Python APIs and asynchronous workflows for reliable document-grounded AI services. 
 - Develop hybrid RAG retrieval, reranking, query rewriting, chunking and metadata filtering over production vector stores. 
 - Establish labelled AI evaluation datasets and CI/CD release checks for retrieval quality, groundedness and faithfulness. 
 - Enforce strict multi-tenant RLS and query-layer isolation across storage, retrieval, caching and background tasks. 
 - Deliver source-document/page citations and honest refusals when available evidence cannot support an answer. 
 - Build layout-aware extraction and OCR pipelines for messy documents while preserving provenance and page metadata. 

Ideal Candidate Profile

- 3-5 years of experience with hands-on production backend and AI delivery. 
 - Own production Python services using FastAPI or Django, REST APIs and async execution; PostgreSQL, Redis, Celery and Docker. Show deployed workloads, queue retries/idempotency, performance and failure handling rather than notebook-only work. 
 - Ship hybrid dense plus sparse/BM25 retrieval with reranking, query rewriting, chunking and metadata filtering. Demonstrate a production vector store such as Qdrant, pgvector, Pinecone or FAISS; these are alternatives, not cumulative requirements. 
 - Maintain labelled evaluation sets in CI/CD; use Recall@k, MRR and nDCG for retrieval and groundedness/faithfulness for answers. Explain baselines, regression thresholds, dataset versioning and failure slices. 
 - Enforce tenant isolation through RLS at the database/query layer, not prompts alone. Carry tenant context through retrieval, cache keys and Celery jobs; demonstrate negative cross-tenant tests and least-privilege service access. 
 - Return source-document and page citations tied to evidence actually retrieved; refuse or qualify unsupported answers honestly. Explain citation provenance, unsupported-query tests and failure handling. 
 - Extract messy PDFs, scanned documents and complex layouts using layout-aware extraction/OCR; example tools include Tesseract, docTR, Textract and DocLayout. Preserve page identity, reading order, tables and metadata into retrieval. 
 - Preferred, not mandatory: Agent orchestration with human-in-the-loop using LangGraph, Agno, AutoGen or CrewAI; staged actions committed by a human and no unattended database writes. 
 - Preferred, not mandatory: Quantized self-hosted model routing using vLLM or Ollama, int4/int8, data sovereignty, open-source fallbacks and cost/latency tradeoffs. 
 - Preferred, not mandatory: OpenTelemetry (OTel), structured logging, tracing and operational dashboards. 
 - Preferred, not mandatory: PySpark, Parquet and CDC-based ETL. 
 - Preferred, not mandatory: AWS or GCP cloud delivery; LoRA/QLoRA only with judgement about when fine-tuning is unnecessary. 

What We Offer

- Remote work. 
 - Hands-on ownership of backend and document-grounded AI engineering for construction intelligence.

Role Description The PLC Programmer role at ESTAR ENGINEERS PVT LTD is a full-time, on-site position based in Chennai. The PLC Programmer will be responsible for designing, programming, testing, and commissioning PLC-based control systems for automatic multi-level car and bike parking installations.  - Candidates should possess collaboration and communication skills to work effectively with mechanical, electrical, and project teams and to document programs and system configurations clearly.

data.title: Instrumentation Engineer
data.description:
Company Description PYG Lifesciences is a pharmaceutical intermediate manufacturer focused on high-consistency, cGMP-aligned intermediates supporting anti-diabetic, pain management, antipsychotic, antispasmodic, and cardiovascular APIs. The company offers integrated capabilities from R&D development through pilot-scale optimization to commercial manufacturing, enabling smooth scale-up from grams to multi-kilogram production. Reliability, batch consistency, purity, and robust documentation are central to its manufacturing approach, backed by clear COA, SDS, and impurity profiles for global buyers and Indian API manufacturers. 

Role Description The Instrumentation Engineer role at PYG Lifesciences is a full-time, on-site position based at the company's facility in Saykha GIDC. The role involves designing, selecting, and implementing instrumentation and control systems for pharmaceutical intermediate manufacturing processes. 
Day-to-day responsibilities include overseeing installation and commissioning of instruments, monitoring performance, and ensuring reliable process control across production lines. 
The Instrumentation Engineer will perform routine calibration, preventive maintenance, and troubleshooting of field instruments and control panels, working closely with production, maintenance, and quality teams to support cGMP compliance and documentation. 
The role also includes contributing to continuous improvement projects, supporting safety and compliance audits, and maintaining accurate records of instrumentation activities. 

Qualifications

- Strong knowledge of instrumentation and process control, with experience configuring and supporting control systems (e. g. , PLCs, DCS, SCADA). 
 - Hands-on experience in calibration and routine maintenance of sensors, transmitters, analyzers, and control valves. 
 - Ability to troubleshoot instrumentation and control issues, diagnose root causes, and implement corrective actions. 
 - Foundational understanding of electrical engineering principles related to power supply, wiring, and panel design for industrial instrumentation. 
 - Bachelor's degree or diploma in Instrumentation Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related discipline.

data.title: Staff Quality Assurance Engineer
data.description:
About Us: 

Versa Networks, Inc. is a vendor of a unified Secure Access Service Edge (SASE) platform. Versa's goal is to provide unprecedented business advantages through a software-based approach that allows for unmatched agility, cost savings and flexibility. We have created a platform that is feature-rich, scalable and easy to use for both enterprise and service provider use cases. 

Job Summary: 

VMS is a core component of Versa's SASE security platform. It collects user identity, authentication, device posture, IoT, UEBA and threat intelligence data and distributes it, per tenant, to Versa enforcement points for Zero Trust, identity-based firewall, micro-segmentation and SSE policies. Data sources include SCIM, passive and active authentication, RADIUS and threat intelligence feeds. We are looking for a Staff QA Engineer to lead the testing of VMS, covering functional correctness, tenant isolation, high availability, upgrades and performance. 

Educational Qualification: 

B. E. /B. Tech. or higher degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics and Communication or equivalent. 

Professional Qualification: 

8-12 years of experience in software quality engineering and test automation, including at least 3 years testing networking, security or distributed systems products. 

Job Responsibilities: 

Quality strategy

- Define the test strategy, test plans and release-readiness criteria for VMS. 
 - Provide the quality status for each release, with test results and defect data. 
 - Mentor SDETs and review their test designs and automation code. 
 - Work with developers to add unit and contract tests to every change, and add quality gates to the CI/CD pipeline. Functional and security testing

- Test that identity, posture and threat intelligence records are delivered correctly to enforcement points, including adds, updates, deletes and revocations. 
 - Measure how long it takes for a change, such as a user logout or a new threat feed entry, to take effect. 
 - Test tenant isolation, so that data for one tenant is never sent to or changed by another. 
 - Test behavior when a data source or downstream consumer is unavailable, including data aging and recovery. Test automation

- Build integration and end-to-end test frameworks for the publish/subscribe path across record types, services and tenants. 
 - Build contract and schema-evolution tests for the gRPC/Protobuf interface to keep backward compatibility with deployed clients. 
 - Build simulators for upstream data sources (SCIM, RADIUS, authentication events, threat feeds and posture data) to test at scale. Platform, high availability and performance

- Maintain the installation and upgrade test matrix: ISO and package installs, single-node and HA setups, FIPS and non-FIPS builds, upgrade, rollback and data migration. 
 - Test active/backup failover and data replication, including random failures and reboots, and measure RTO and RPO. 
 - Run performance, capacity, soak and memory-growth tests, and document the supported limits for throughput, record count and tenants. 

Essential Skills: 

- Test automation development in Go or Java, and Python or another scripting language. 
 - Experience testing distributed or stateful systems, such as messaging, streaming, data stores (for example Redis or Kafka) and HA failover. 
 - API and contract testing, preferably with gRPC/Protobuf. 
 - Good knowledge of TCP/IP, HTTP, TLS/mTLS and PKI basics. 
 - Strong Linux and shell scripting skills. 
 - Experience testing on-premises or appliance software, including installation and upgrade. 
 - Working knowledge of Docker and Kubernetes. 
 - Performance and soak testing, including load generation and profiling. 
 - Experience with CI/CD pipelines and automated quality gates (for example Jenkins). 

Desirable Skills: 

- Experience with SASE, SSE, ZTNA, NGFW, SD-WAN or micro-segmentation products. 
 - Knowledge of identity protocols such as SCIM, SAML, OAuth2/OIDC, RADIUS and LDAP. 
 - Experience with threat intelligence feeds, UEBA, endpoint posture, IoT device identification or security group tags. 
 - Experience with syslog and log analytics pipelines. 
 - Exposure to security certification testing (FIPS 140-3, STIG, Common Criteria). 
 - Deeper Kubernetes experience (cluster setup, networking, storage, operators). Experience with Prometheus and Grafana, and with public cloud platforms

- Contribute to performance, reliability, and resilience testing

Observability & Debuggability

- Leverage logs, metrics, and traces to improve test reliability
 - Support root cause analysis of failures and improve system observability

Test Data & Environment Management

- Design and manage test data strategies and datasets
 - Ensure availability of stable, production-like test environments

Incident & Operational Support

- Assist in troubleshooting defects across environments

Collaboration & Growth

- Collaborate with developers, QA, Product Owners, and Tech Leads

data.title: Maintenance Manager – Engineering & Utilities
data.description:
Fruit Formulations (FruitFM) is hiring a Maintenance Manager - Engineering & Utilities for our Jejuri plant. You will keep the fruit processing and pulping lines, utilities and facilities safe, reliable and ready for production, especially through the peak fruit season. You will control maintenance cost and build a skilled, responsible maintenance team. 

What you'll do

- Plan and carry out preventive, predictive and breakdown maintenance for fruit receiving, washing, destoning, pulping, finishing, evaporation, pasteurisation/sterilisation, and aseptic and hot-fill packing lines
 - Run utilities reliably: boiler (IBR), chillers, refrigeration and cold storage, air compressors, water treatment, ETP, DG sets and power distribution
 - Lead the annual pre-season overhaul and off-season shutdowns so lines are ready before the fruit season
 - Manage critical spares, consumables, AMCs and vendor services within the approved budget
 - Keep food-contact equipment, CIP systems, seals and gaskets in hygienic condition to support food safety (FSSAI, GMP, FSSC 22000 / ISO, Halal and certification audits)
 - Enforce safe work: lock-out/tag-out, permits to work, and statutory inspections
 - Analyse breakdowns and cut downtime, energy and water use; lead, schedule and train technicians across shifts; keep history cards and maintenance logsWhat we're looking for

- Diploma or B. E. /B. Tech in Mechanical, Electrical or related engineering
 - 5-10 years of hands-on maintenance experience in food or beverage manufacturing (fruit pulping or fruit processing preferred)
 - Practical knowledge of pulpers, finishers, evaporators, sterilisers, aseptic fillers, pumps, gearboxes, motors, VFDs, boilers and refrigeration
 - Hands-on PLC automation experience: troubleshooting PLC, HMI/SCADA and drive-based control systems (for example Siemens, Allen-Bradley or Delta) on processing and packing lines. Programming or modifying these systems is preferred
 - Able to lead technicians and contractors and solve problems under pressure
 - Comfortable with Excel and maintenance records; CMMS or SAP PM is an advantage
 - Working English and effective Hindi and/or Marathi
 - Full-time, on-site at Jejuri, with availability across shifts and during seasonal peaks
 - Reports to the Plant Head.

data.title: Lead Specialist, Solution Architect
data.description:
Job Description - Lead Specialist, Solution Architect

Role: Solution Architect

Division: Pearson Qualifications - Consumer Services

Location: Bangalore or Chennai, India (Hybrid)

About Pearson

Pearson's mission is to "add life to a lifetime of learning. " With more than 20, 000 employees worldwide, we deliver high-quality, digital-first educational experiences that empower learners and educators. Our teams are passionate about creating accessible, sustainable solutions that drive real-world impact. 

About Pearson Qualifications - Consumer Services

Consumer Services creates and operates digital products that help teachers teach and learners build the knowledge, confidence and skills needed to succeed in their qualifications. Our services bring together curriculum-aligned content, learning activities, practice assessment, progress insight and supporting administration for schools, teachers and learners. 

The portfolio includes modern cloud-based products alongside established applications that are being simplified, consolidated or retired over time. The architecture role is focused on evolving a coherent consumer product ecosystem, improving integration and operational quality, and supporting the controlled migration of users and capabilities to strategic platforms. This remit is distinct from systems used to administer and deliver qualifications, examinations, marking and certification. 

Role Summary

As a Solution Architect, you will shape and oversee solutions across Pearson Qualifications Consumer Services. You will work primarily with modern digital teaching and learning products in the UK Secondary Education market (K-12) and Post-16 Education, while also supporting the safe evolution, integration and retirement of applications across the wider consumer portfolio. 

You will translate content, product and business needs into secure, scalable and supportable solution designs, working closely with content, product, engineering, user experience, data, security, service management, and external partners. The role requires strong architecture judgement across customer-facing web applications, APIs, event-driven integration, data, identity, cloud infrastructure and operational readiness. 

You will balance strategic direction with pragmatic delivery, assessing reuse before new build, documenting trade-offs, estimating cost and effort, and ensuring functional and non-functional requirements are addressed. Clear communication, constructive challenge and the ability to guide delivery teams through change are essential. 

Key Responsibilities

- Solution Architecture Design: Lead end-to-end architecture for consumer-facing digital products and supporting services. Define application, integration, data and deployment views that meet functional and non-functional requirements, sometimes including sovereign data requirements in a highly regulated industry. 

- Product and Platform Evolution: Shape roadmaps that simplify the application estate, encourage reuse and support controlled migration from established products to strategic capabilities without disrupting customers. 

- Architecture Options and Trade-offs: Evaluate solution options across technology fit, customer impact, delivery effort, security, operability, scalability, time to market and total cost of ownership. 

- Integration Architecture: Design and govern APIs, events and integration patterns across internal products, enterprise platforms, third-party services and school or customer systems. 

- Technical Leadership and Governance: Act as a design authority through discovery, delivery and release. Maintain alignment with enterprise standards, architecture principles and agreed guardrails. 

- Delivery Team Support: Work closely with engineering leads, developers, testers, DevOps and SRE teams to turn architecture into implementable designs and resolve technical issues. 

- Customer and User Experience Alignment: Partner with product and UX teams to support accessible, coherent and responsive teacher, learner and administrator journeys. 

- Data and Insight: Define appropriate data ownership, contracts and flows for learning activity, assessment, content, subscription and insight use cases. 

- Security and Privacy by Design: Ensure solutions protect customer and learner data and follow Pearson security and privacy standards. 

- Reliability and Operability: Define availability, performance, resilience, observability, support and recovery requirements. 

- Vendor and Partner Oversight: Review third-party architectures and implementation approaches and hold partners accountable for quality and conformance. 

- Documentation and Decision Management: Maintain architecture blueprints, C4 views, interface and event specifications, data flows, non-functional requirements, decision records and transition roadmaps. 

- Cost and Sustainability: Assess infrastructure, platform, licensing and operational costs and promote efficient, maintainable cloud usage. 

- Innovation and Continuous Improvement: Evaluate relevant developments in digital learning, AI, analytics, software delivery and cloud technology. 

- Lifecycle Support: Support solutions from discovery through implementation and live operation, including technical debt reduction, consolidation and decommissioning planning. 

Working Relationships

The role works across product management, engineering, UX and accessibility, data and analytics, information security, SRE and operations, service management, enterprise architecture, commercial teams and external delivery partners. The successful candidate will be comfortable influencing across organisational boundaries without relying on formal authority. 

Essential Experience and Skills

- Extensive Solution Architecture Experience: A proven track record designing and guiding complex enterprise or digital product solutions from concept through implementation and operation. 

- Modern Cloud Architecture: Strong experience with AWS cloud services and cloud-native design, including compute, containers, serverless, networking, storage, managed data services, identity, monitoring and resilience. 

- Java and Web Application Architecture: Strong understanding of Java-based service architectures and modern web applications, including front-end applications, back-end services, APIs and distributed systems. 

- Architecture and Design Communication: Ability to create clear architecture blueprints, C4 diagrams, data flows, integration views, interface specifications and architecture decisions. 

- Integration and API Design: Practical experience with API-first and event-driven architectures, contract design, service boundaries and asynchronous messaging. 

- Data Architecture Awareness: Good understanding of transactional data, data modelling, analytics, reporting, ownership, privacy, retention and performance. 

- Security and Privacy: Strong knowledge of secure software design, identity and access management, data protection and application security. 

- Technical Leadership: Experience guiding multidisciplinary teams, reviewing implementation, mentoring colleagues and constructively challenging suppliers. 

- Solution Analysis and Cost Estimation: Ability to make evidence-based recommendations balancing customer value, quality, delivery effort, operational impact and cost. 

- Stakeholder Engagement: Clear communication with technical and non-technical stakeholders, including explaining trade-offs and gaining alignment. 

- Problem Solving and Adaptability: A pragmatic approach to ambiguity and change, moving between strategic architecture and detailed delivery issues. 

- Business and Customer Focus: Ability to connect architecture decisions to teaching, learning, customer experience, product outcomes and sustainable value. 

Desirable Skills

- AWS Delivery Tooling: Infrastructure as code and CI/CD experience, including Terraform, GitHub Actions or equivalent tooling. 

- Containers and Event Streaming: Experience with container platforms, microservices, Kafka or equivalent technologies. 

- Modern Front-End Architecture: Familiarity with React, micro-frontends, design systems and accessible user experiences. 

- Cloud Data Technologies: Experience with relational and NoSQL databases, data warehouses, search, caching and near-real-time analytics. 

- Education Technology: Experience with teaching and learning platforms, digital content, learning management, formative assessment or school-system integration. Knowledge of 1EdTech standards for rostering and LTI integration protocols is desirable. 

- Identity and Subscription Services: Understanding of SSO, roles, entitlements, onboarding, subscription management and digital access control. 

- Legacy Modernisation: Experience planning incremental migrations, coexistence, strangler patterns, user transition and decommissioning. 

- Operational Excellence: Understanding of SRE, observability, performance engineering, business continuity and disaster recovery. 

- AI and Emerging Technology: Awareness of responsible AI in content, teaching, learning, insight and software delivery. 

- Azure Awareness: Familiarity with Azure where consumer services integrate with wider Pearson platforms or enterprise capabilities. 

Education and Certification

A bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related field is desirable, or equivalent practical experience. Relevant architecture and cloud certifications, particularly AWS Solutions Architect, are highly regarded. 

Job Location and Hours

The role is aligned to our Bangalore or Chennai offices in India, working a 45-hour week, 9am to 6pm IST. All our roles are hybrid working; our current policy requires the team to work from their base office three times per week. 

There is a requirement to provide occasional out-of-hours support during business-critical periods. 

This job description describes the primary accountabilities of the role and may evolve as the Consumer Services portfolio and Pearson's technology strategy develop.

At Pearson, our purpose is simple: to help people realize the life they imagine through learning. We believe that every learning opportunity is a chance for a personal breakthrough. We are the world's lifelong learning company. For us, learning isn't just what we do. It's who we are. To learn more: We are Pearson.

NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now. 

We are currently seeking a Senior AWS Engineer to join our team in Bangalore, Karnātaka (IN-KA), India (IN). 

Key Responsibilities

- Cloud Infrastructure Design & Management o Architect, deploy, and manage AWS cloud solutions aligned with best practices for security, scalability, and reliability. 
 - Implement and optimize network architecture including VPCs, subnets, routing, VPNs, Direct Connect, Transit Gateway, and load balancers. 
 - Ensure high availability and disaster recovery strategies are in place.

 - Automate infrastructure provisioning using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) with CloudFormation, Terraform, or Ansible. o Manage container orchestration (EKS, ECS, Docker, Kubernetes).

 - Work closely with developers, QA, and operations teams to enable seamless application delivery. o Engage with third-party vendors/tools for integration and ensure smooth ecosystem interoperability. o Provide mentorship and guidance to junior engineers.

Soft Skills

data.title: Lead CQV Engineer
data.description:
At Jacobs, we're challenging today to reinvent tomorrow by solving the world's most critical problems for thriving cities, resilient environments, mission-critical outcomes, operational advancement, scientific discovery and cutting-edge manufacturing, turning abstract ideas into realities that transform the world for good. 

Your impact

Lead CQVENgineer is responsible for leading and delivering end-to-end commissioning, qualification, and validation (CQV) programs for pharmaceutical, biotechnology, and medical device projects. This role combines technical subject matter expertise with project leadership, ensuring compliance with global regulatory standards while meeting project timelines, quality, and budget targets. 

The role requires deep experience in GxP environments, risk-based validation, and facility/equipment qualification, along with strong stakeholder and team management skills. The role will require an experienced, energetic, and committed CQV person with broad experience in C&Q, particularly biopharmaceuticals and having experience of >15 years. The person should have experience of leading CQV engineers for big projects and managing the C&Q documentation and execution lifecycle, from SLIA generation through to OQ/ PQ completion. They will work closely with cross-functional teams, including engineering, quality assurance, and manufacturing, to support the successful delivery of projects. 

- Lead and execute CQV activities across multiple CQV projects, ensuring timely execution and compliance with industry regulations. 
 - Act as an SME for CQV having technical authority for systems such as process equipments, process utilities, automation, HVAC and controlled environments. 
 - Manage multi-disciplinary teams including CQV engineers, vendors, and contractors. 
 - Serve as the primary CQV interface with clients, design teams and Quality & regulatory teams. 
 - Track project deliverables, budgets, risks, and timelines and provide regular project updates and status reports to stakeholders. 
 - Drive decision-making and resolve escalations with engineering team and client. 
 - Involve in GMP review of layouts and systems and ensure CQV requirements are embedded early in the design lifecycle. 
 - Review P&IDs, layouts, URS, FS/DS, equipment specifications and vendor documentation. 
 - Mentor and guide CQV engineers and junior staff. 
 - Establish best practices, templates, and standard methodologies. 
 - Drive continuous improvement and knowledge sharing within the team. 
 - Prepare C&Q plans in line with the strategic goals of the client and manage timely and compliant delivery of the plan.

data.title: Senior Test Developer – Automotive Simulation Testing & Failure-Triage Lead
data.description:
Do you enjoy solving complex automotive software failures and leading high-impact validation activities in a fast-paced engineering environment? We are looking for an experienced SWQA Lead with strong automotive domain knowledge, hands-on simulation testing expertise, advanced Python skills, and a proven ability to identify regression-causing changelists (CL's) through systematic bisection. This role is central to Integration testing quality and simulation failure triage. You will lead daily testing activities, analyze various failures and artifacts, identify root causes, isolate culprit changelists (CLs), and coordinate resolution across software, simulation, validation, and infrastructure teams. As the Person in Charge (PIC), you will manage priorities, assign work, remove blockers, improve triage efficiency, and ensure release-impacting issues are driven to closure. You will also apply Agentic AI workflows to accelerate failure investigation, evidence correlation, classification, and reporting. 

What You'll Be Doing

- Lead daily pre-merge testing, simulation failure triage, task prioritization, team execution, and timely closure of critical issues. 
 - Perform root-cause and signal-level analysis using logs, traces, metrics, videos, and state transitions to isolate software, simulation, configuration, infrastructure, analyzer, or evaluator failures. 
 - Lead the bisections using source-control history, failure patterns, signal evidence, and code-impact analysis to identify culprit CLs and complex multi-change regressions. 
 - Develop Python-based tools and automation for log analysis, failure classification, regression isolation, automated bisection, and reporting. 
 - Apply Agentic AI workflows to correlate diagnostic evidence, identify patterns, summarize failures, recommend investigation paths, and improve triage efficiency. 
 - Collaborate with development, systems, simulation, validation, tools, and infrastructure teams; track quality metrics, communicate risks, mentor engineers, and establish consistent triage practices. 

What We Need To See

- B. Tech. or equivalent degree in CS, CE, ECE, EEE, Automotive Engineering, or a related field, with 8-12 years of relevant automotive software testing and validation experience. 
 - Strong expertise in HIL/SIL, simulation testing, automotive verification workflows, and root-cause analysis using signals, logs, traces, and system-level evidence. 
 - Hands-on validation experience with ADAS and automated-driving functions, including L2, L2PP, and L3/L4 features across perception, localization, prediction, planning, control, and vehicle interfaces. 
 - Advanced Python skills for automation, signal processing, data analysis, visualization, debugging, and validation-tool development. 
 - Proven expertise in bisection using Git, CI/CD pipelines, build artifacts, and change history to identify and validate culprit CLs. 
 - Demonstrated ability to apply Agentic AI workflows. 
 - Proven ability to lead small to mid-sized teams, work with diverse stakeholders, and drive process alignment and continuous improvement. 
 - Excellent communication, documentation, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to break down complex process topics into actionable steps. 

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd

- Experience applying AI agents or LLM-based workflows to log analysis, evidence correlation, failure classification, automated bisection, or root-cause investigation. 
 - Familiarity with GitLab CI, Jenkins, Linux, Docker, Kubernetes, cloud platforms, and large-scale simulation infrastructure. . 
 - Working knowledge of Automotive SPICE (ASPICE) processes and Functional Safety (ISO 26262) requirements, with their application in ADAS software verification and validation. 
 - Good understanding of ADAS regulatory standards and consumer safety assessment protocols, including Euro NCAP, UNECE DCAS, GSR, and applicable UNECE homologation regulations. 
 - Prior experience owning a validation, failure-triage, bisection, or pre-merge quality program and delivering continuous improvements end-to-end.

data.description:
About The Role

At Rocket India, we build technology that simplifies home financing and creates meaningful customer outcomes. As Assistant Vice President of Engineering, you will translate enterprise engineering strategy into effective execution across assigned products, platforms and engineering capabilities. You will lead engineering managers and senior technical leaders, improve delivery and operational performance, and ensure that portfolio outcomes align with enterprise standards. 

You will partner with Product, Quality Engineering, Architecture, Security, Data, Operations and Technology Leadership to deliver secure, scalable, resilient and customer-focused solutions while building accountable teams and sustainable engineering capabilities. 

Key Responsibilities

Portfolio Execution & Delivery

- Translate enterprise engineering strategy into roadmaps, execution plans and measurable outcomes for assigned products, platforms and engineering capabilities. 
 - Lead engineering managers, architects and technical leaders responsible for delivery, modernization and operational outcomes within the assigned portfolio. 
 - Balance delivery commitments with platform adoption, technical debt reduction, modernization, security improvements and keep-the-lights-on requirements. 
 - Improve delivery flow and predictability through disciplined work intake, capacity planning, dependency management, commitment management, review turnaround and release readiness. 
 - Escalate systemic constraints, investment needs and cross-portfolio dependencies with evidence and recommended actions. 

Product, Platform & Technology Execution

- Execute approved modernization strategies for applications, platforms, infrastructure, integrations and cloud-native capabilities within the assigned portfolio. 
 - Ensure architecture alignment and adoption of enterprise platforms, reusable APIs, frameworks, libraries, infrastructure modules and engineering patterns. 
 - Partner with architecture and platform teams to translate long-term technology direction into sequenced portfolio plans. 
 - Provide technical and operational recommendations for vendor, modernization, migration and build-versus-buy decisions. 

Reliability, Operations & Engineering Excellence

- Implement enterprise service-ownership practices across assigned products and platforms. 
 - Drive observability, monitoring, alerting, service-level objectives, incident management, problem management, resilience testing and operational readiness. 
 - Ensure accountable closure of corrective and preventive actions arising from incidents, reliability reviews and operational risks. 
 - Improve system reliability, performance, scalability, availability and operational efficiency. 
 - Ensure teams maintain current documentation, runbooks, operational procedures and recovery plans. 

Quality Engineering & Secure Delivery

- Operationalize enterprise quality standards, automated testing expectations, quality gates, release controls and evidence-based deployment decisions across assigned teams. 
 - Ensure appropriate unit, integration, regression, end-to-end, performance, resilience, accessibility and security testing strategies. 
 - Embed security, privacy, compliance, architecture and engineering controls throughout design, development, testing, deployment and operations. 
 - Ensure vulnerabilities, compliance findings and technology risks are prioritized, remediated and escalated appropriately. 

AI Adoption & Engineering Innovation

- Implement enterprise AI engineering standards across assigned engineering teams and products. 
 - Drive responsible adoption of AI-assisted development, engineering assistants, agents, automation, analytics and intelligent operational workflows. 
 - Operationalize AI governance through documented use-case intake, solution evaluation, release readiness, output validation, production monitoring, traceability, human escalation and fallback controls. 
 - Measure AI adoption, engineering productivity, quality, operational outcomes and business impact while protecting security, privacy, architectural integrity and customer trust. 
 - Promote responsible experimentation and scale proven practices within enterprise guardrails. 

Metrics, Data & Continuous Improvement

- Implement enterprise engineering measurement standards and use trusted portfolio-level metrics to drive performance, accountability and continuous improvement. 
 - Monitor delivery, flow, quality, reliability, security, operational, adoption, productivity and talent measures. 
 - Ensure portfolio data has clear definitions, accountable ownership, auditable sources, consistent aggregation and actionable insights. 
 - Identify bottlenecks, process inefficiencies and technology gaps within the assigned portfolio and lead measurable remediation plans. 

Leadership & Talent Development

- Build and lead high-performing engineering teams and leadership groups across the assigned portfolio. 
 - Develop engineering managers and senior technical leaders who independently own delivery, reliability, talent and operational outcomes. 
 - Execute performance management, career development, talent reviews, succession coverage and leadership-readiness activities in alignment with enterprise practices. 
 - Identify critical skill gaps and implement targeted capability-development plans. 
 - Foster accountability, ownership, inclusion, innovation, continuous learning and cross-functional collaboration. 
 - Recognize measurable engineering achievements, operational improvements, innovation and customer impact. 

Workforce & Resource Planning

- Translate enterprise workforce and capability strategies into staffing, succession, capacity and skill-development plans for the assigned portfolio. 
 - Manage resource allocation, leadership bench strength, critical-skill readiness and delivery capacity across assigned teams. 
 - Provide data and recommendations that inform enterprise organization-design, workforce-mix and hiring decisions. 
 - Support hiring and talent acquisition aligned with approved portfolio and future capability requirements. 

Vendor & Partner Delivery Management

- Manage delivery performance for vendors, technology partners and outsourced teams supporting the assigned portfolio. 
 - Ensure partner accountability for quality, security, delivery commitments, operational readiness, documentation, remediation and knowledge transfer. 
 - Monitor contract outcomes, delivery measures, cost effectiveness and risks, escalating strategic or commercial issues through the appropriate governance channels. 

About You

Minimum Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - 12+ years of software engineering, product engineering or platform engineering experience. 
 - 5+ years leading engineering managers, senior technical leaders or multiple engineering teams. 
 - Experience translating enterprise strategy into portfolio roadmaps, execution plans and measurable outcomes. 
 - Experience delivering complex products, platforms, modernization programs or enterprise technology solutions. 
 - Strong understanding of modern architecture, cloud platforms, distributed systems, APIs, data platforms, security, continuous delivery, automated quality engineering, observability and production operations. 
 - Experience improving delivery, quality, reliability, security and operational performance across multiple teams using outcome-based metrics. 
 - Experience leading cross-functional initiatives involving Product, Operations, Architecture, Security, Data and Engineering. 
 - Experience with workforce capacity, leadership development, succession planning and vendor delivery management. 
 - Excellent communication, stakeholder management and organizational leadership skills. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, Business Administration or a related field. 
 - Experience operating in a regulated, high-volume, customer-facing or large-scale enterprise technology environment. 
 - Experience modernizing legacy platforms and executing cloud transformation initiatives. 
 - Experience implementing SRE, service ownership, observability and reliability engineering practices. 
 - Experience implementing AI-enabled products, engineering automation, developer-productivity solutions, agents or intelligent operational capabilities. 
 - Familiarity with responsible AI, AI governance, traceability, security, evaluation, output validation, production monitoring and human oversight controls. 
 - Experience driving adoption of reusable enterprise platforms, APIs, frameworks and shared technology capabilities. 
 - Relevant certifications in cloud, architecture, security, AI, product engineering, agile delivery or engineering leadership.

Ensures projects meet quality standards, building codes, and specifications by developing, implementing, and monitoring project-specific QA/QC plans. Key roles include conducting site inspections (RCC, masonry, finishing), material testing, managing non-conformance reports (NCRs), coordinating with consultants, and overseeing final handover documentation.

- Quality Assurance & Planning
 - Review 'Good for Construction' (GFC) drawings, specifications, and project plans to prevent rework and dimensional errors. 
 - Assist in the implementation of the Project Quality Plan (PQP) and Inspection & Test Plans (ITPs). 
 - Prepare and implement checklists for various construction stages, such as formwork, steel reinforcement, concrete pouring, masonry, and plastering. 
 - Site Quality Control & Inspections
 - Conduct daily inspections of civil, structural, and finishing works (waterproofing, tiling, flooring, painting, etc. ). 
 - Establish QA/QC procedures, ITPs, checklists, and method statements specific to high-rise luxury construction. 
 - Oversee concrete works-monitor slump, prepare cube registers, and manage slump/cube testing results. 
 - Check and verify the quality of incoming materials against approved submittals before they are used on-site. 
 - Conduct regular site inspections, audits, and surveillance 
 - Raise Inspection Requests (IRs) and coordinate walkdowns with consultants, architects, and clients.

 - Maintain comprehensive quality documentation, including material testing checklists, calibration logs for testing equipment, and non-conformance reports.

 - Compile handover documents, red-line drawings, and as-built drawing verifications.

- Diploma/ Degree in Civil Engineering. 
 - 8-10 years of hands-on experience in residential or high-rise building projects. 
 - Deep knowledge of finishing works, structural QA/QC processes, Non-Conformance Management, and local building codes.

Your Role

Define and govern the software architecture for AUTOSAR BSW / ADAS and POSIX-based automotive platforms. Translate system and product requirements into scalable, reusable, safe, and high-performance technical solutions while guiding engineering teams through design, integration, validation, and production release. 

Key Responsibilities

- Define end-to-end software architecture, technical roadmaps, interfaces, and reusable platform strategies for AUTOSAR BSW / ADAS and POSIX-based automotive solutions.

 - Lead architecture and design reviews, evaluate technical trade-offs, and ensure alignment across software, systems, hardware, validation, safety, and cybersecurity teams. 
 - Guide development and integration teams, resolve complex technical issues, and provide hands-on direction for debugging, performance optimization, and platform stabilization. 
 - Govern architectural compliance, requirements traceability, technical debt, configuration consistency, and release readiness across programs and customer variants. 
 - Engage with customers, suppliers, semiconductor partners, and internal stakeholders to manage dependencies, risks, assumptions, and technical decisions. 

Technical & Domain Expectations

- Deep expertise in AUTOSAR Classic BSW / ADAS, including MCAL, OS, RTE, communication stacks, diagnostics, memory services, ECU state management, bootloader, and complex drivers. 
 - Strong POSIX platform knowledge covering Linux or QNX, BSPs, device drivers, middleware, IPC, process and thread management, networking, memory, and real-time behavior. 
 - Experience architecting embedded platforms on multicore SoCs, including startup, scheduling, resource allocation, hardware-software interfaces, performance, and fault handling. 
 - Strong understanding of service-oriented communication, SOME/IP, middleware, platform integration, and coexistence between AUTOSAR and non-AUTOSAR software components.

 - Working knowledge of C/C++, model-based or interface design, Git workflows, CI/CD, static analysis, test automation, and architecture documentation tools. 

Basic Qualifications - Required

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Electronics, Electrical Engineering, Embedded Systems, or a related discipline.

 - Strong understanding of embedded software lifecycle, requirements management, configuration, integration, verification, validation, and release processes.

 - Excellent analytical, problem-solving, communication, mentoring, decision-making, and stakeholder-management skills.

 - Experience supporting OEMs, Tier-1 suppliers, semiconductor partners, AUTOSAR stack vendors, or global automotive programs.

data.title: Senior Software Engineer (Java)
data.description:
About Reveleer

Reveleer delivers a unified platform spanning risk adjustment, quality improvement, clinical intelligence, and member management for health plans and provider organizations navigating the complexity of value-based care. Trusted by 80+ customer organizations nationwide, the platform integrates data, analytics, and intelligent workflow automation into one governed system designed to support traceable documentation across diagnoses, quality measures, and submissions. With regulatory expertise and transparent, human-in-the-loop AI at its core, Reveleer supports organizations working to advance care quality, strengthen documentation integrity, and sustain the operational readiness needed to navigate audits with confidence. 

Why this role is important

The Senior Software Engineer (Java) at Reveleer is a highly experienced individual contributor working on Reveleer's encounter data processing and CMS submission systems for Medicare Advantage. This role focuses on strong execution, sound technical decision making, and delivering high-quality software in a regulated, high-data-volume environment where submission accuracy and timeliness carry direct compliance and revenue impacts. Success means writing reliable, maintainable code, improving the throughput and stability of encounter processing, and owning customer outcomes. 

What Success Looks Like

- Data pipelines for CMS encounter data submission and response-file processing run reliably and at high throughput, with issues surfaced and
 - resolved before they reach CMS deadlines or customers. 
 - Features and services are well designed, implemented correctly, and operate reliably across a multi-tenant platform. 
 - Technical decisions balance delivery speed with maintainability, performance, security, and regulatory accuracy. 
 - Legacy components are modernized safely, reducing security exposure and long-term maintenance costs. 
 - Automated test coverage and delivery automation improve, reducing manual QA and operational toil for the team. 
 - AI-assisted development accelerates delivery (refactoring, test generation) without lowering the quality bar. 

What You'll Do

- Design, develop, and maintain Java services for health care encounter data processing and CMS submissions (EDI X12) within Reveleer's Medicare
 - Advantage member management platform, using Spring, Hibernate, MS SQL, and RabbitMQ. 
 - Build and optimize high-throughput batch and file-processing pipelines for large-volume EDI submission and response handling (837, 277CA, 999), improving throughput, latency, and reliability. 
 - Contribute to the high-scalability modernization goals of the platform: full infrastructure as code (IaC), session and authentication handling, and containerized deployment on AWS (EKS). \
 - Modernize legacy Java components safely, including version upgrades, dependency and security remediation, and migration behind tooling with rollback plans. 
 - Strengthen delivery quality by building automated tests and improving CI/CD pipelines, helping reduce manual QA and operational load across the team. 
 - Apply AI-assisted engineering tools (such as Claude Code) across the development lifecycle (scaffolding, refactoring, test generation, code review). Contribute to system reliability, performance, and security; troubleshoot data and software problems in a compliance-sensitive production environment and improve the systems so they require less manual intervention. 
 - Act as a technical subject matter expert within your domain, supporting other engineers through design input, problem-solving, and code review. Work with product managers, analysts, and stakeholders to translate business and regulatory requirements into technical solutions. 

What You Bring

- 8+ years of Core Java and J2EE enterprise web application development. 
 - Strong object-oriented coding practices and design patterns. 
 - Spring Boot experience highly preferred, along with Spring Batch or equivalent high-volume batch processing experience. 
 - Demonstrated experience building high-throughput data or file-processing systems, with measurable improvements in throughput or latency. 
 - Hands-on experience with EDI/X12 and CMS encounter data processing (EDPS/EDS), or comparable healthcare claims and submission systems. 
 - Advanced SQL, including database and query optimization (MS SQL preferred). 
 - Containerized, cloud-native development on AWS (Docker and Kubernetes/EKS), including multi-tenant SaaS architecture concerns such as tenant isolation and per-tenant configuration. 
 - API development experience. 
 - Experience modernizing legacy Java codebases: version upgrades, dependency and security remediation, and migration tooling. 
 - Experience with test automation frameworks, CI/CD pipelines, observability and application instrumentation, and the full software development lifecycle in an Agile environment.
