 - Select and integrate PLCs, motion components, sensors, drives, safety devices, and related electrical hardware.

 - Support build, testing, FAT/SAT, debugging, and commissioning activities at the Bengaluru site and customer locations as needed.

 - Prepare technical documentation, change records, and support engineering reviews throughout the project lifecycle.

- Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or a related discipline. 
 - 6+ years of experience in machine design, industrial automation, or capital equipment engineering. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with electrical schematics, control panels, and machine power systems. 
 - Good understanding of PLC-based systems, motion control, sensors, safety circuits, and industrial communication. 
 - Ability to troubleshoot complex machine issues during assembly and commissioning.

At TTEC Digital, we coach clients to ensure their employees feel valued, and fully supported, because an amazing customer experience is an employee first process. Our vision is the same, a place where employees know they can thrive. 

TTEC Digital seeks a Design System/UX Engineer to join our team. This role is a full-time and fully remote opportunity!

The work: 
We're an innovation group inside TTEC (NASDAQ: TTEC), building the next generation of AI CX tools - automated QA, conversational analytics, knowledge assist, and agentic automation - for the world's biggest brands and the millions of customers they serve. We move like an early-stage startup, backed by the scale, distribution, and enterprise client base of a company that's been obsessed with customer experience since 1982. 

This is the rare seat where getting in early actually matters at scale. TTEC is a public company at an AI inflection point. Ship the right products into thousands of live enterprise deployments and you don't just move a metric - you move the trajectory of the company and the value of the stock. The leverage is real, and the work compounds. 

Who we hire - the DNA: 

- Self-starters and do-ers with grit - hackers in the best sense, with a startup mentality and a show-me bias: working software over slides, prototypes over proposals. 
 - Want to learn, love new technology. This platform is built on the latest technology, and that technology changes and advances monthly. You adapt to change quickly - new tools, new models, new priorities - without drama. 
 - Master debuggers and problem solvers. You love solving complex problems, you think outside the box, and you multitask across domains without losing the thread. 
 - AI-native. You work with AI on all levels - you understand the technology around you (LLMs, SLMs, RAG, knowledge graphs, agents, training, eval) and you use AI tools daily to exponentially increase your velocity. 
 - Distributed-systems literate. High-efficiency, event-driven, low-latency systems are our world; you understand what that demands. 
 - Innovators who ship. You demonstrate ideas easily, fail fast, and move forward. You make committed timelines and hit them. 
 - You consider yourself exceptional - and you like winning. So do we. 
 - No one will have everything in this description. We're looking for well-rounded, smart people who move fast

What You Will Do: 
The role: 

- Own the design system in code and the UX of the wedge - the Agent UI shell, slide-out / pill, Control UI, and the per-module panels
 - UX here ships as code, not Figma hand-offs. This is not a look-pretty job: the UI renders live voice, desktop, and AI event streams in real time, and you have to understand the technology underneath - events, WebSocket state, latency, plugin loading - so what you design flows and works, not just looks good
 - Startup environment: 1-week sprints, Friday demos, fail fast, move forward. 

What you'll own: 

- The design system as a real component library - templates and patterns developers implement without friction
 - Agent UI / Control UI interaction patterns
 - Active Listening and Agent Handover UX
 - The graphics language of the product (iconography, motion, data visualization)
 - Accessibility (Lighthouse a11y > 90) and keyboard-first agent flows
 - Your committed timelines. 

Who you are: 

- A self-starter with taste and grit - a designer who ships
 - Show-me mentality: you demo working UI on Fridays like every other engineer
 - You think from the developer's seat: every component you design, you've already thought through how the squads will implement, extend, and theme it - your design system makes them faster, never slower
 - You love new technology, adapt fast when the product shifts weekly, use AI tools daily to multiply velocity, consider yourself exceptional, and like winning. 

What You Will Bring: 

- 7+ years of product design with real front-end engineering - you ship React + TypeScript, not just specs. 
 - Strong graphics experience - ++++ on visual craft: iconography, motion design, canvas/SVG data visualization, rendering dense live data beautifully and legibly. 
 - Has owned a design system as a living component library in a fast-shipping product - versioned, documented, themed, adopted. 
 - Strong templating discipline - reusable patterns and layout systems built for developer implementation; you understand component APIs, composition, and what makes a pattern cheap or expensive to build. 
 - Understands the tech underneath - WebSocket-driven state, event ordering, render performance, module federation/plugin loading - well enough that your designs never fight the architecture. 
 - Strong on dense, real-time, professional-tool UX (think trading terminals, not marketing sites) - an agent lives in this UI 8 hours a day. 
 - Accessibility and keyboard-first design as defaults, not afterthoughts. 
 - Perceived-performance craft - skeletons, optimistic updates, motion that masks latency; the UI must feel instant even when the network isn't. 
 - Design tokens as the theming backbone - enterprise customers will want branding; tokens make that config, not a rewrite. 
 - Overlay/extension constraints fluency - designing UI injected over a host page (pill, slide-out) with its size, z-index, and isolation realities. 
 - Usability evidence at startup speed - lightweight session recordings and agent feedback loops instead of month-long studies. 
 - A debugger in the browser - you profile the render, find the jank, and fix your own component.

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. data.title: Software Development Manager, AWS IoT Fleet Management
data.description:
Description

AWS Applied AI Solutions (AAIS) is building toward a future where every business innovates with Amazon AI teammates. To get there, we build AI solutions that improve human capabilities and transform entire business functions. We create end-to-end products that surprise and delight out-of-the-box, making complex things easy and hard things possible, with no cloud experience required. We start with customers who embrace the future and build bridges to meet the rest where they are. We pursue ambitious opportunities with conviction, and we are looking for builders who share that mindset. AWS IoT is building the infrastructure to deliver AI from the cloud to the physical world. The Physical AI team develops services that provision, deploy, monitor, and secure AI software across processors inside autonomous machines including robots, vehicles, drones, agricultural equipment, and industrial workcells operating in environments with limited or no cloud connectivity. We are looking for a Software Development Manager to build and lead the team behind edge-first fleet management for Physical AI. Your team owns software that runs on embedded processors inside autonomous machines and the cloud control plane that orchestrates them coordinating deployments across hierarchical heterogeneous processor topologies that often operate entirely offline. You will lead engineers writing production C++ and Rust for local artifact caching cryptographic verification peer discovery over link-local networks and coordinated over-the-air updates across nested processor hierarchies and you will own the cloud services that track fleet state when the fleet is not reachable. Physical AI is a new business for AWS so you will define the platform while you build it hire the team that builds it and decide what the team does not build. This is a rare chance to lead where cloud services meet physical machines shipping software that keeps autonomous systems running safely in the real world. The Physical AI team within AWS IoT is focused on delivering intelligence to every processor inside autonomous machines at scale. We build the services that provision, deploy, and secure AI software across robots, vehicles, drones, and industrial equipment worldwide. Our work sits at the intersection of cloud infrastructure and embedded systems and we partner closely with other AWS IoT teams to push what is possible in disconnected resource-constrained environments. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment where every engineer's voice matters and new ideas are welcomed. 

Key job responsibilities

- Lead a team of cloud and embedded engineers building the edge runtime and control plane for Physical AI fleet management including artifact caching peer discovery coordinated OTA across nested processor hierarchies and fleet state reconciliation after long disconnection. 
 - Hire develop and retain engineers from L4 through L6 and build a team where cloud engineers ramp on embedded systems and embedded engineers ramp on distributed systems. 
 - Own the roadmap from ambiguous problem statements through launch and scale the platform from early adopters to global fleets of autonomous machines across every AWS region. 
 - Drive deployment reliability on hardware that is physically accessible and routinely offline where a failed update reaches machines that move and rollback has to work without a network round trip. 
 - Own the security architecture for software and model distribution including signed artifacts secure OTA (TUF and Uptane) and hardware root of trust (TPM secure boot attestation) on devices an attacker can hold. 
 - Own operational excellence for physical fleets including oncall alarming release discipline and the version and security posture of every processor in the field. 
 - Partner with client teams across AWS IoT applied science and robotics and with silicon and OEM partners whose attestation and boot primitives the security model depends on. 
 - Set the technical bar through architecture and design review and hold decisions on state consistency and failure handling across tiers that cannot see each other. 
A day in the life

You might start your morning reviewing a design for coordinated OTA across nested processors and pushing back on how it handles a gateway that reconnects with stale state. After standup you could run a hiring loop debrief then meet a silicon partner to close an attestation dependency that gates the next release. In the afternoon you might sit with two engineers to cut the scope of a workstream that is trending late write the update that tells your leadership why and end the day with real autonomous hardware to see what the fleet actually reports. 

About The Team

Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn't followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don't let it stop you from applying. Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world's most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating - that's why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses. We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there's nothing we can't achieve in the cloud. Here at AWS, it's in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness. We're continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. That's why you'll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional. 

Internal Job Description

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

- 3+ years of engineering team management experience
 - 7+ years of engineering experience
 - 3+ years of designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
 - Knowledge of engineering practices and patterns for the full software/hardware/networks development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, certification, and livesite operations
 - Experience partnering with product or program management teams
 - * Experience with systems software, embedded Linux, or software that ships to devices

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience in communicating with users, other technical teams, and senior leadership to collect requirements, describe software product features, technical designs, and product strategy
 - Experience in recruiting, hiring, mentoring/coaching and managing teams of Software Engineers to improve their skills, and make them more effective, product software engineers
 - Experience managing teams that own both cloud services and embedded or on-device layers
 - Experience with edge AI and ML inference deployment, including model compatibility and versioning at fleet scale
 - Experience with secure OTA architecture (TUF, Uptane) and hardware root of trust (TPM, HSM, secure boot, attestation)

data.title: Sr Software Development Engineer , AWS IoT Fleet Management
data.description:
Description

AWS IoT is building the infrastructure to deliver AI from the cloud to the physical world. Our Physical AI team is developing services that provision, deploy, monitor, and secure AI software across every processor inside autonomous machines - including robots, vehicles, drones, agricultural equipment, and industrial workcells - operating in environments with limited or no cloud connectivity. 

We are looking for a Senior Software Development Engineer to define and drive the architecture of our edge-first fleet management platform for Physical AI. You will own the end-to-end system design spanning cloud control planes, edge gateways, and device-tier processors - reasoning deeply about state, consistency, partition tolerance, failure domains, recovery, and reconciliation across tiers that are routinely disconnected from each other. You will design APIs, platform abstractions, and SDKs that enable customers to manage heterogeneous machine fleets as coherent units, and architect secure software and model distribution pipelines with hardware attestation, cryptographic signing, and device-bound authorization. 

This role demands the ability to start from ambiguity and deliver production architecture. You will take large, loosely defined initiatives and decompose them into parallel workstreams that L4 and L5 engineers can execute against. You will write high-quality architecture and design documents that set the technical bar for the team, lead cross-team technical discussions, and drive alignment on decisions that affect adjacent services and organizations. You will own operational excellence for device fleets at scale - not just service availability, but the health, versioning, and security posture of tens of thousands of physical processors in the field. 

This is an opportunity to be a technical leader on a foundational new AWS platform - shaping how intelligence is delivered, protected, and maintained across the physical world at scale. 

Key job responsibilities

- Own the end-to-end architecture of an edge-first fleet management platform for Physical AI, spanning cloud control planes, edge gateways, and device-tier processors. 
 - Design for intermittent connectivity: reason about state, consistency, partition tolerance, failure domains, recovery, and reconciliation across tiers that are routinely disconnected from each other. 
 - Define APIs, platform abstractions, and SDKs that let customers manage heterogeneous machine fleets - robots, vehicles, drones, agricultural equipment, industrial workcells - as coherent units. 
 - Architect secure software and model distribution pipelines, including hardware attestation, cryptographic signing, and device-bound authorization. 
 - Take large, loosely defined initiatives and decompose them into parallel workstreams that L4 and L5 engineers can execute independently. 
 - Write high-quality architecture and design documents that set the technical bar and lead cross-team technical discussions to drive alignment on decisions affecting adjacent services and organizations. 
 - Model device topologies across gateways, subordinate processors, sensors, and controllers, and design edge AI/ML model deployment with compatibility and versioning at scale. 
 - Own operational excellence for device fleets at scale - the health, versioning, and security posture of tens of thousands of physical processors in the field, not just service availability. 
 - Establish hardware root-of-trust and secure OTA practices (TUF/Uptane, TPM/HSM, secure boot, attestation) in partnership with security, hardware, and adjacent platform teams. 
 - Mentor and raise the technical bar for L4 and L5 engineers through design review, code review, and direct technical guidance. 

A day in the life

ou might start your morning pairing with a senior engineer to trace a failed OTA update on an embedded processor then switch to writing and testing a new peer-discovery module for link-local networks. After standup you could review a teammate's Rust pull request join a design discussion on artifact-caching strategies for offline topologies or try a new concurrency pattern that could improve deployment coordination. You will pick up embedded and robotics concepts quickly as you work hands-on with real autonomous hardware.

Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

About Analog Devices

Analog Devices, Inc. (NASDAQ: ADI) is a global semiconductor leader that bridges the physical and digital worlds to enable breakthroughs at the Intelligent Edge. ADI combines analog, digital, AI, and software technologies into solutions that combat climate change, reliably connect humans and the world, and help drive advancements in automation and robotics, mobility, healthcare, energy and data centers. Job Description: Principal Digital DFT Engineer

Role Summary

The Principal Digital DFT Engineer is responsible for architecting, implementing, and verifying advanced DFT solutions for complex digital ASICs and SoCs. This position emphasizes direct technical execution, deep problem-solving, and ownership of DFT flows for robust testability and manufacturing yield. 

Key Responsibilities

- Own and drive all aspects of DFT architecture, definition, and implementation for digital chips, including scan insertion, ATPG, boundary scan, MBIST, logic BIST, JTAG and test compression techniques. 
 - Hands-on execution with EDA tools for scan synthesis, test pattern generation, fault simulation, and DFT rule checks. 
 - Create and validate test plans targeting high coverage for stuck-at, transition, and critical path faults. 
 - Integrate DFT with RTL and physical design teams; resolve complex trade-offs impacting fault coverage, PPA, or manufacturability. 
 - Optimize test modes, design for manufacturability, and debug silicon failures from bring-up through production ramp. 
 - Develop and implement low-overhead test structures and warranty schemes for new and legacy IP. 
 - Directly debug, analyze, and resolve DFT-related issues in simulation, emulation, and in the lab using standard test equipment. 
 - Deliver documented DFT architectures, test strategies, implementation scripts (TCL/Python/Perl), and design guidelines for engineering teams. 
 - Collaborate with ATE test engineers to implement production test solutions, reduce test costs, and improve coverage. 
 - Mentor engineers in DFT methodology, best practices, tool usage, and industry standards. 

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical/Electronics/VLSI Engineering or equivalent. 
 - 10+ years' proven hands-on experience in DFT for digital ASIC/SoC development, with multiple tapeouts for large designs. 
 - Expert skills in DFT flows: scan, ATPG, MBIST, BIST, JTAG, boundary scan, fault simulation. 
 - Strong command of EDA tools: Synopsys DFT Compiler, Tessent, Cadence Modus, or equivalent. 
 - Scripting abilities (TCL, Python, Perl) for DFT automation and reporting. 
 - Solid knowledge of RTL design, synthesis, timing, and SoC architecture constraints. 
 - Demonstrated ability to debug complex DFT and test-mode issues at lab and production level. 
 - Ability to create technical documentation, guides, and mentor junior engineers. 

Nice-to-Have Skills

- Experience with DFT for advanced nodes (≤ 7nm), 2. 5D/3D packaging, or high-speed IP. 
 - Production ATE pattern development and test data evaluation. 
 - Knowledge of safety (ISO 26262) or security-oriented DFT requirements. 
 - DFT for memory BIST (SRAM/DRAM), and custom macro testing.

data.title: Operations Team Lead (Night Shift)
data.description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career. 

About The Team

As Stripe's user base and global footprint grows dramatically, we have distinctly unique support problems resulting from both our type of scale and the type of businesses we partner with. The Stripe Delivery Center (SDC) strategy will provide operational leverage and expand Stripe's portfolio of operational capabilities to support the scaled needs for external users and internal Stripe teams. We strive to deliver frictionless experiences for all of our users, whether they are an Independent Business, Startup, SMB, or Enterprise and our mission is to provide all Stripe Users with the best support experience possible. 

What you'll do

You will manage a team of Seller Systems Operations Associates in a player-coach capacity. You'll be accountable for your team's operational performance, development, and engagement, while working closely with global operations specialists, business process owners, and cross-functional partners to improve workflows and user experiences. 

Responsibilities

- Lead the day-to-day operational performance of a team of Associates, including quality, productivity, service-level, and other team goals. 
 - Set clear expectations, priorities, and performance goals for individuals and the team. 
 - Manage team capacity, scheduling, and work allocation to ensure critical workflows are covered and work is completed accurately and on time. 
 - Coach Associates on troubleshooting, process knowledge, communication, and sound judgment in resolving user issues. 
 - Hold regular development conversations and provide timely, constructive feedback that supports growth and career progression. 
 - Complete performance reviews and address performance concerns in partnership with your manager and People team partners, as appropriate. 
 - Build a collaborative, inclusive team environment where Associates can raise risks, share ideas, and learn from one another. 
 - Serve as an escalation point for complex operational or user issues, using sound judgment to resolve issues or route them to the right partner. 
 - Partner with global operations specialists and business process owners to run critical Internal Systems workflows. 
 - Identify recurring issues, process gaps, and manual work. 
 - Lead or contribute to improvements that increase quality, reduce effort, and improve the user experience. 
 - Use operational data and team insights to surface trends, risks, and opportunities to relevant stakeholders. 
 - Work closely with cross-functional teams to improve product offerings, processes, tools, and user-facing communications. 
 - Support hiring, onboarding, training, and ramping of new team members. 
 - Help build the operating culture, team practices, and capabilities of Stripe Delivery Centers. 

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement. 

Minimum Requirements

- 3+ years of experience leading, supervising, or formally mentoring an operations, support, or user-facing team. 
 - 9+ years of experience in customer support, technical support, operations, or another internal or external user-facing environment. 
 - Experience managing operational work against defined quality, productivity, or service-level goals. 
 - Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to give clear, constructive feedback. 
 - Experience coaching others and supporting their professional development
 - Strong SQL skills and experience working with API integrations, including diagnosing implementation issues, interpreting technical documentation, and guiding teams through ambiguous customer or system problems. 
 - Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify root causes and make practical improvements. 
 - The ability to prioritize effectively and make sound decisions in a fast-moving, structured environment. 
 - A process-oriented mindset and a track record of improving workflows, reducing manual effort, or improving user experiences. 
 - Experience working effectively with cross-functional stakeholders. 
 - A user-first mindset and interest in learning technical products, systems, and processes. 
 - The ability to work from the Bengaluru office in night shift

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience using operational data to manage performance, identify trends, and prioritize improvements. 
 - Experience supporting hiring, onboarding, workforce planning, or scheduling for an operations team. 
 - Experience working with global teams across time zones. 

In-office expectations

Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Stripes on the Works in Progress team based in the London, UK office also work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible. 

Pay and benefits

Stripe does not yet include pay ranges in job postings in every country. Stripe strongly values pay transparency and is working toward pay transparency globally. 

We look forward to hearing from you. 

At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out-and set you apart-especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us. 

Apply now

As a global organisation spanning 70 countries and one rooted in a culture of growth, opportunity, diversity and innovation, LSEG is a place where everyone can grow, develop and fulfil your potential with meaningful careers. 

Role Profile

LSEG Post Trade Solutions division - Acadia is seeking a skilled, hands-on Technical DevOps Manager with a Linux system administration (SA) background

Responsibilities include: 

- Lead and inspire the local four-person team to become subject matter experts in service availability issues escalated from our Level 1 and 2 support desk. The team will operate across 2 shifts:

 - Remain hands-on: actively contribute to infrastructure code, automation, troubleshooting and releases alongside the team, rather than only managing it. 
 - Act as the technical lead and go-to resource for the team, providing mentoring, code and design reviews, and guidance on complex incidents. 
 - Define, promote and enforce engineering best practices across the team, including infrastructure as code, version control, peer review, CI/CD, automated testing, documentation and change management. 
 - Design, build and maintain automation using Ansible and Terraform, and support workloads on AWS cloud alongside the existing on-premises VMware and Windows/Linux estate. 
 - Partner with development teams on bug fixes and new releases, including reviewing deployment and configuration changes for Java and other bespoke applications. 

Key Responsibilities

The role may include automated provisioning, installation/configuration, operation, and maintenance of software defined infrastructure. 

This individual participates in technical research and development to enable continuing improvements in process and supporting the maximum available uptime. The best candidates are pro-active, self-led and are perceived as passionate about improving service for our clients. 

The Acadia environment consists of VMware vSphere, AWS cloud (with Ansible and Terraform for automation). Windows desktop, Windows Server, and Ubuntu Server. We use both relational and document data stores (SQL Server, PostgreSQL, and MongoDB). 

- Use of Prometheus, Datadog, Opensearch and CloudWatch. . 
 - Develop and maintain installation and configuration procedures as code (e. g. Ansible playbooks and Terraform modules) under version control. 
 - Contribute to and maintain system standards, and embed them in automation and documentation. 
 - Perform daily system monitoring, verifying the integrity and availability of all server resources, systems, and key processes, reviewing system and application logs, and verifying completion of scheduled jobs such as backups. 
 - Perform daily backup operations, ensuring all required file systems and system data are successfully backed up to the appropriate media, recovery tapes or disks are created, and media is recycled and sent off site as necessary. 
 - Systems Administration and Maintenance of a variety of bespoke systems. 
 - Apply OS patches and upgrades on a regular basis, and upgrade administrative tools and utilities. Configure / add new services as necessary. 
 - Staff oversight, including performance management, coaching and career development. 
 - Staff oversight of the entire PostTrade Solutions support team based in Bangalore in future once settled in the role 
 - No budget responsibility. 

Experience And Qualifications Required

- Bachelor (4-year) degree, with a technical major, such as engineering or computer science. 
 - Hands-on technical experience as a DevOps (Development Operations) engineer and in a technical lead role. 
 - Previous software development experience, ideally in Java, including writing, debugging and supporting application code. 
 - Working knowledge of Ansible and Terraform for configuration management and infrastructure provisioning. 
 - Hands-on experience with AWS cloud services (e. g. EC2, IAM, VPC, S3). 
 - Strong grounding in engineering best practices: Git, code review, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing and documentation. 
 - Experience with Linux and Windows Server administration, VMware vSphere, and enterprise monitoring tools (e. g. Prometheus, Datadog, Splunk). 
 - Ability to coach and develop engineers and to act as a technical resource for the team. 
 - Good communication skills 
 - Willing to adopt Hybrid working mode and work in Bangalore Office. 
 - Experience in Financial or an investment banking environment. 
 - Familiarity with financial products and financial terms. 
 - Excellent analytical skills, Attention to Detail and problem-solving abilities. 
 - Ability to communicate clearly and concisely to IT and business teams and to senior management. 
 - Strong negotiation / influencing skills able to overcome resistance and reach consensus and compromise in order to attain the required objective. 

Career Stage: 

Manager

LSEG unlocks the power of markets to create opportunities across the global economy. 

Through our connected network of market infrastructure, data and analytics, we help customers access capital, manage risk and make confident decisions. 

Our insights bring clarity to complex markets, and our trusted services ensure resilience and stability. With deep expertise and global scale, we partner with customers to drive innovation and shape the future of finance. 

Few organisations operate at the scale, complexity and reach of LSEG. Here, you'll work alongside experts, be inspired to deliver your best work and help shape what's next for our business and the global economy. 

Guided by our values of Integrity, Partnership, Excellence and Change, we bring together diverse perspectives, encourage fresh thinking, and create an environment where learning never stops. 

Join more than 26, 000 colleagues across 60 countries, supporting customers in over 170 countries. Alongside flexible ways of working, you'll have access to benefits that support your wellbeing and your future, including 26 weeks' parental leave, healthcare, retirement planning and a wellness allowance. Through the LSEG Foundation and two paid volunteering days each year, you'll also have opportunities to get involved in your local community and support causes that matter to you. 

We are proud to be an equal opportunities employer. This means that we do not discriminate on the basis of anyone's race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital status, veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. Conforming with applicable law, we can reasonably accommodate applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs.

You will work with Windows-based edge devices, cloud-connected applications, and device lifecycle management processes that support customers worldwide.

Delivery & Execution Excellence

 - Contribute to task breakdowns and effort estimates for assigned work. 
 - Proactively raise risks, blockers, or implementation issues to the team.

 - Participate in code reviews, incorporating feedback and learning from peers. 
 - Ensure individual contributions meet Definition of Ready (DoR) and Definition of Done (DoD) criteria. 
 - Follow established DevOps, security, and quality practices. 

Incident & Operational Support

- Assist in troubleshooting defects and issues in development and production environments. 
 - Support corrective (bug fixes) and evolutive (enhancements) maintenance of existing solutions. 

Collaboration & Growth

- Collaborate effectively with other developers, QA, Product Owners, and Tech Leads. 
 - Seek feedback and guidance to continuously improve technical skills. 
 - Actively learn the systems, tools, and technologies used by the team. 
 - Contribute positively to team culture and shared ownership of outcomes. 

Qualifications

- Bachelor or Master degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field
 - Proficiency in C# and the . NET platform
 - Working knowledge of Python or other scripting languages
 - Strong understanding of Test-Driven Development (TDD)
 - Hands-on experience with Azure DevOps, Git repositories, and CI/CD pipelines
 - Familiarity with DevSecOps concepts
 - Familiarity with device communication protocols such as MQTT, OPC-UA, or similar technologies
 - Experience using AI assisted coding tools (e. g. GitHub Copilot) responsibly, with full accountability for code quality, security, and compliance. 
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
 - Fluency in English, both written and spoken

Assets

- Hands-on experience with IoT, industrial automation, edge computing, or device lifecycle management
 - Experience with Azure IoTHub, DPS, Azure Functions, Azure Storage, or Azure Data Explorer
 - Experience supporting Windows based machines
 - Familiarity with OTA software and firmware update mechanisms

Why Husky?

- Regulated Working Hours: Enjoy a structured work schedule that promotes a healthy work-life balance, allowing you to excel professionally while maintaining personal well-being. 
 - Visible Impact: Experience the satisfaction of seeing the direct outcomes of your work, as you contribute to projects that visibly enhance our company's technological capabilities and efficiency. 
 - Strategic Influence: Participate in architectural and technical reviews, contributing to the strategic direction of our cloud initiatives and making a tangible impact on our company's technological landscape. 
 - Empowered Involvement: Take an active role in decision-making processes and architectural reviews, where your expertise helps shape the future of our cloud solutions and overall business strategy. 
 - Valued Contributions: Be more than just a number in a large organization; at our company, every individual's input is valued and can lead to significant, tangible improvements in our operations and services. 
 - Impactful Role: Play a crucial part in both developing new applications and maintaining existing systems, ensuring their optimal performance and reliability. 
 - Cutting-Edge Projects: Work on innovative cloud solutions that are transforming our and our customer's business, giving you the opportunity to be at the forefront of technological advancements. 
 - Supportive Community: Work in an environment that recognizes and celebrates individual achievements, fostering a sense of community and mutual respect among team members. 
 - Collaborative Environment: Join a global team of skilled professionals around the globe where your ideas are valued, and collaboration is encouraged to solve complex challenges and drive success. 

Husky TechnologiesTM offers a competitive compensation and benefits package and excellent opportunities for growth and advancement. We are committed to equal employment opportunity and respect, value and welcome diversity in our workplace. Husky TechnologiesTM also values being a great place to work and strives to maintain a safe workplace.  - Yield %

 - Line Efficiency

Team Management

Continuous Improvement

- Identify productivity improvement opportunities through automation and process optimization.

data.description:
About Us

Worley is a global company of energy, chemicals and resources experts headquartered in Australia. We partner with our customers to deliver projects and create value across the life of their assets. We specialize in consulting, engineering, procurement and construction across the project lifecycle, with services extending through to operations and decommissioning. Leveraging extensive experience and AI-enabled delivery, we support customers in navigating complexity as they meet today's needs and transition to more sustainable solutions. 

The Role

As a Manager II, Quality with Worley, you will work closely with our existing team to deliver projects for our clients while continuing to develop your skills and experience etc. 

- Review the 'Issued for Construction' drawings. Request for clarifications, if required, as per established procedure of the project site.

 - Assist in review/approval of the Quality Plan and Inspection Test Plan of the contractors.

 - Participate in site walk rounds and quality audits.

Additional Responsibilities

- Highlight deficiencies to the contractor through formal communications. 
 - Participate in review meetings with Contractors, if required. 
 - Review and certify the interim and final measurement records submitted by the contractors. 
 - Coordinate with the Contractors for submission of 'As Built' mark ups and review of the same. 

About You

To be considered for this role it is envisaged you will possess the following attributes: 

- Knowledge of quality control, safe ways of working, resource requirement, sequence of activities, and supervision of construction activities for the respective discipline. Aware of the requirements of various applicable standards (Indian Standards, ASME etc. ) for the respective discipline 
 - Industry Specific Experience: Minimum 7 years of experience for Graduate Engineers/10 years of experience for Diploma Engineers. Experience of working in Oil & Gas Sector and Chemicals 
 - Graduate in Engineering/Diploma in Engineering in respective discipline
 - HSE Capability: Knowledge
 - Proficient in MS Office 
 - Team Player, interpersonal skills
 - Adaptable, open towards learning and development, person of integrity of safe methods of execution of construction activities for the respective discipline

Moving forward together

We want our people to be energized and empowered to drive sustainable impact. So, our focus is on a values-inspired culture that unlocks brilliance through belonging, connection and innovation. We're building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace. Creating a space where everyone feels they belong, can be themselves, and are heard. 

And we're not just talking about it; we're doing it. We're reskilling our people, leveraging transferable skills, and supporting the transition of our workforce to become experts in today's low carbon energy infrastructure and technology. Whatever your ambition, there's a path for you here. 

And there's no barrier to your potential career success. Join us to broaden your horizons, explore diverse opportunities, and be part of delivering sustainable change.

data.title: Integration Test Automation Engineer (SAP Ecosystem)
data.description:
Dear Aspirant!

We empower our people to stay resilient and relevant in a constantly changing world. We're looking for people who are always searching for creative ways to grow and learn. We are looking for: Integration Test Automation Engineer (SAP Ecosystems)

The Test Manager is responsible for the overall planning, coordination, governance and reporting of testing activities within the SHERPA X environment. The role ensures effective validation of SAP S/4HANA and connected applications across functional, integration, end-to-end and non-functional testing, while driving risk-based testing, automation and the effective use of AI-supported testing capabilities. The Test Manager works closely with business, E2E process teams, development teams, the Testing Factory, Release Management and technical specialists to ensure transparency of quality, risks and release readiness. 

You'll make an impact by: 

- Define and manage the overall test strategy, scope and planning for SHERPA X releases. 
 - Lead and coordinate functional, integration, end-to-end, regression and non-functional testing across the SHERPA X landscape. 
 - Drive cross-system integration testing across SAP S/4HANA, APIs, EDI, middleware, interfaces and connected applications. 
 - Coordinate testing across Business, E2E Process Teams, Development Teams, Testing Factory, Release Management and technical specialists. 
 - Manage test execution, defects, risks, quality gates and test evidence, ensuring transparency of overall quality status. 
 - Ensure release readiness and provide clear quality and risk assessments as input for Go/No-Go decisions. 
 - Drive risk-based regression testing and test automation, focusing on business-critical processes and high-risk scenarios. 
 - Coordinate performance and non-functional testing with Performance Architects and Engineers, including load, endurance, performance regression, API/interface and batch testing. 
 - Ensure relevant performance requirements and KPIs are defined and validated, including response time, throughput, stability and error rates. 
 - Drive the adoption of AI-supported testing, including test-case generation and optimization, risk-based test selection, defect analysis and test-data support. 
 - Provide transparent test KPIs, quality status, risks and management reporting to support release decisions. 
 - Continuously improve testing through shift-left, automation, AI, standardization and lessons learned. 

You're excited to build on your existing expertise, including: 

- 7+ years of experience in test management, test leadership or comparable roles, ideally within complex SAP environments. 
 - Strong experience in test strategy, planning, governance and execution management across large-scale transformation programs. 
 - Good understanding of SAP S/4HANA, integration and end-to-end business process testing. 
 - Proven experience coordinating testing across business, process, development and technical teams. 
 - Experience with defect management, quality gates, release readiness and Go/No-Go preparation. 
 - Good understanding of risk-based regression testing and test automation. 
 - Practical understanding of performance and non-functional testing, including relevant performance KPIs and NFRs. 
 - Knowledge of integration technologies such as APIs, OData/REST, middleware and EDI. 
 - Practical experience or strong understanding of AI/GenAI applications in testing and test automation. 
 - Strong stakeholder management, communication and reporting skills in an international environment. 
 - Strong ownership mindset and ability to drive testing from strategy and planning through execution and continuous improvement. 

Create a better #TomorrowWithUs!

The Global Information Systems Group is dedicated to the success of Lam through providing best-in-class and innovative information system solutions and services. Together, we support users globally with data, information, and systems to achieve their business objectives. 

The impact you'll make

Role Overview

The QA Analyst Enterprise Applications is a fully hands-on performance testing role responsible for planning, scripting, executing, analyzing, and reporting performance tests for complex enterprise applications. The role requires deep, current expertise in OpenText LoadRunner, particularly Web HTTP/HTML, SAP, and TruClient 2. 0 protocols, together with strong knowledge of C-based scripting, correlation, parameterization, custom requests, and performance diagnostics. 

The analyst will work directly with product owners, development teams, functional teams, infrastructure and platform teams, database administrators, application support teams, and business stakeholders to translate non-functional requirements into realistic workload models and actionable performance evidence. The role requires agility in moving scripts across environments, maintaining scripts through frequent application and environment upgrades, and meeting demanding

What You'll Do

Key Responsibilities

- Own the end-to-end performance testing lifecycle: requirements, NFR validation, strategy, workload modelling, scripting, execution, monitoring, analysis, defect mgt, reporting. 
 - Develop, debug, maintain LoadRunner VuGen scripts (Web HTTP/HTML, SAP, TruClient 2. 0); independently resolve correlation, session, authentication, replay issues. 
 - Build stable, maintainable scripts using HTTP/HTTPS functions, C, parameterization, correlation, validations, error handling, reusable libraries. 
 - Design realistic load, stress, endurance, volume, scalability, spike, capacity scenarios in LoadRunner Controller/ Enterprise Engg/ Performance Center. 
 - Adapt scripts to changes in environments, endpoints, certificates, authentication, applications, applying modular design, naming standards, version control. 
 - Gather business volumes, concurrency, transaction mix, response-time targets; translate them into workload models, acceptance criteria. 
 - Monitor client- and server-side metrics, correlate user experience with application, web/API, database, middleware, infrastructure behavior
 - Analyze results, logs, percentiles, throughput, errors, and resource utilization to identify bottlenecks recommend improvements
 - Partner with product owners and technical teams on scope, environment readiness, dependencies, risks, timelines; escalate blockers
 - Document test plans, scripts, results, defects, findings, residual risks in approved platforms; support defect triage, tuning, retesting, release-readiness reviews. 

Role Requirements Performance Testing & LoadRunner

- Strong hands-on LoadRunner exp, including current or recent Web HTTP/HTML protocol exp. 
 - Hands-on expertise with Web HTTP/HTML, SAP, TruClient 2. 0; Web Services/API expdesirable. 
 - Advanced VuGen scripting manual correlation, parameterization, custom requests, dynamic values, tokens, C functions, reusable libraries, error handling. 
 - Strong knowledge of LoadRunner Controller and/or Enterprise Performance Engineering/Center. 
 - Ability to independently troubleshoot recording/replay failures, certificates/proxies, authentication, session handling, script instability. 
 - Experience designing load, stress, endurance, spike, volume, scalability, capacity tests based on business , release risk. 

Performance Analysis & Monitoring

- Strong ability to analyze client- and server-side metrics and correlate findings across application and infrastructure layers. 
 - Experience with AppDynamics, Splunk, SiteScope, PerfMon, Wily/Introscope, VisualVM. 
 - Knowledge of HTTP/HTTPS, TLS, load balancers, web/application servers, APIs, DB, OS metrics. 
 - Ability to interpret percentiles, throughput, error rates, , , GC, thread/connection pools, database waits. 

Planning, Collaboration & Delivery

- Ability to create practical test strategies, estimate effort, manage dependencies, deliver within release timelines. 
 - Strong collaboration across product, development, QA, architecture, infrastructure, security, business teams. 
 - Ability to challenge incomplete NFRs, align stakeholders on scope, workloads, success criteria. 
 - Ability to manage multiple assignments and changing priorities with minimal supervision. 

Who We're Looking For

Qualifications and Experience

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - Minimum 7 years of dedicated performance testing experience using LoadRunner, including substantial recent hands-on Web HTTP/HTML scripting. 
 - Experience testing enterprise SaaS and custom applications, integrated business processes, APIs, SAP solutions, and multi-tier application architectures. 
 - Experience working in Agile and DevOps delivery models and using Azure DevOps, Jira, or comparable platforms for backlog, defect, evidence, and release tracking. 
 - Experience using Git or another version-control system for performance-test scripts and supporting assets. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with JMeter, NeoLoad, or comparable performance testing tools in addition to LoadRunner. 
 - Experience with SAP GUI, web-based SAP applications, APIs, data-intensive applications, batch processes, or enterprise integrations. 
 - Experience with cloud-hosted applications and performance testing in Microsoft Azure or comparable cloud environments. 
 - Knowledge of CI/CD integration for performance tests, automated smoke or baseline execution, trend reporting, and quality gates. 
 - LoadRunner, performance engineering, Azure, ISTQB, or related technical certifications are beneficial. 

Our commitment

We believe it is important for every person to feel valued, included, and empowered to achieve their full potential. By bringing unique individuals and viewpoints together, we achieve extraordinary results. 

Lam Research ("Lam" or the "Company") is an equal opportunity employer. Lam is committed to and reaffirms support of equal opportunity in employment and non-discrimination in employment policies, practices and procedures on the basis of race, religious creed, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth and related medical conditions), gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, or military and veteran status or any other category protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws. It is the Company's intention to comply with all applicable laws and regulations. Company policy prohibits unlawful discrimination against applicants or employees. 

Lam offers a variety of work location models based on the needs of each role. Our hybrid roles combine the benefits of on-site collaboration with colleagues and the flexibility to work remotely and fall into two categories - On-site Flex and Virtual Flex. 'On-site Flex' you'll work 3+ days per week on-site at a Lam or customer/supplier location, with the opportunity to work remotely for the balance of the week. 'Virtual Flex' you'll work 1-2 days per week on-site at a Lam or customer/supplier location, and remotely the rest of the time.

Job Description

As a Test Automation Engineer, you will design and implement automation solutions that validate system behavior across UI, APIs, and integrations. You will contribute to building a robust quality engineering ecosystem by integrating automated testing into CI/CD pipelines and supporting continuous delivery. 

In this role, you will translate requirements into effective test strategies, combining automation with manual, exploratory, and integration testing to ensure comprehensive quality coverage across all application layers. 

This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys hands-on coding, solving complex validation challenges, and improving system quality at scale, while taking ownership of end-to-end quality outcomes and collaborating closely with cross-functional teams. 

Responsibilities

Automation Development & Framework Ownership

- Design, develop, and own scalable test automation frameworks and reusable components

 - UI (Web/Mobile)
 - API and integration layers

Test Strategy & Implementation

- Translate requirements into automation-ready test scenarios, test data, and validation strategies

 - Identify test gaps and proactively mitigate risks
 - Perform automation feasibility analysis to determine optimal test approach (manual vs automated)

Delivery & Execution Excellence

- Execute a balanced mix of automated and manual tests aligned with sprint goals, ensuring comprehensive validation across functional, integration, and edge-case scenarios. 
 - Contribute to task breakdown, estimation, and sprint commitments
 - Proactively raise risks, blockers, and testability concerns
 - Identify, log, prioritize, and track defects through resolution lifecycle
 - Perform root cause analysis and collaborate with development teams for fixes

Manual & Functional Testing

- Design, document, and execute detailed test cases and test scenarios
 - Perform functional, exploratory, and regression testing across features
 - Validate end-to-end workflows and business scenarios
 - Identify edge cases and usability issues through exploratory testing
 - Ensure test coverage for areas not suitable for automation

Quality, Standards & Engineering Practices

- Write clean, testable, and maintainable automation code
 - Participate in code reviews and continuous improvement of automation frameworks
 - Ensure adherence to Definition of Ready (DoR) and Definition of Done (DoD)
 - Take ownership of end-to-end quality outcomes across assigned areas
 - Follow established DevOps, security, and quality engineering practices

CI/CD & DevOps Integration

- Integrate automation into CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps preferred)
 - Enable continuous testing and shift-left quality practices
 - Monitor and improve pipeline stability, execution time, and reliability
 - Validate and troubleshoot system integrations, data flows, and error handling based on defined architectural designs and interfaces

Non-Functional Testing

- Contribute to performance, reliability, and resilience testing
 - Validate system behavior under load, stress, and failure scenarios

Observability & Debuggability

- Leverage logs, metrics, and traces to improve test reliability
 - Support root cause analysis of failures and improve system observability

Test Data & Environment Management

- Design and manage test data strategies and datasets
 - Ensure availability of stable, production-like test environments

Incident & Operational Support

- Assist in troubleshooting defects across environments
 - Support maintenance and continuous improvement of automation suites
 - Analyze and reduce flaky tests and unstable scenarios

Collaboration & Growth

- Collaborate with developers, QA, Product Owners, and Tech Leads
 - Actively learn and adopt new tools, frameworks, and best practices
 - Contribute to team knowledge sharing and a strong quality culture

Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, IT, or related field
 - 5+ years of experience in software testing with strong automation focus
 - Experience in designing and implementing test automation frameworks
 - Strong understanding of testing principles, SDLC, STLC, and Agile practices

Technical Skills

- Programming experience in one or more: C#, Java, Python, JavaScript, Swift
 - Experience with automation tools such as Selenium, Katalon, Playwright, Cypress
 - Experience with: 
 - API testing (REST, Postman, etc. )
 - Version control (Git)
 - CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps)
 - Familiarity with: 
 - Test data management
 - Test reporting and logging tools
 - Debugging and root cause analysis
 - Release Management
Assets

- Experience with: 
 - Performance testing tools (JMeter, k6)
 - Security testing (SAST, DAST, SCA)
 - Exposure to: 
 - Cloud platforms (Azure preferred)
 - DevSecOps practices
 - Experience using AI-assisted tools responsibly (e. g. , GitHub Copilot)
Key Expectations

- Drive an automation-first approach (target 60-80% regression automation), while ensuring critical flows and edge cases are validated through manual testing where automation is not feasible or cost-effective. 
 - Own and evolve automation frameworks and quality engineering practices
 - Ensure high reliability, scalability, and stability of automation pipelines
 - Take accountability for quality outcomes, not just test execution
 - Ensure alignment with organizational quality, security, and compliance standards

Why Husky?

- Regulated Working Hours: Enjoy a structured work schedule that promotes a healthy work-life balance, allowing you to excel professionally while maintaining personal well-being. 
 - Visible Impact: Experience the satisfaction of seeing the direct outcomes of your work, as you contribute to projects that visibly enhance our company's technological capabilities and efficiency. 
 - Strategic Influence: Participate in architectural and technical reviews, contributing to the strategic direction of our cloud initiatives and making a tangible impact on our company's technological landscape. 
 - Empowered Involvement: Take an active role in decision-making processes and architectural reviews, where your expertise helps shape the future of our cloud solutions and overall business strategy. 
 - Valued Contributions: Be more than just a number in a large organization; at our company, every individual's input is valued and can lead to significant, tangible improvements in our operations and services. 
 - Impactful Role: Play a crucial part in both developing new applications and maintaining existing systems, ensuring their optimal performance and reliability. 
 - Cutting-Edge Projects: Work on innovative cloud solutions that are transforming our and our customer's business, giving you the opportunity to be at the forefront of technological advancements. 
 - Supportive Community: Work in an environment that recognizes and celebrates individual achievements, fostering a sense of community and mutual respect among team members. 
 - Collaborative Environment: Join a global team of skilled professionals around the globe where your ideas are valued, and collaboration is encouraged to solve complex challenges and drive success. 

Husky TechnologiesTM offers a competitive compensation and benefits package and excellent opportunities for growth and advancement. We are committed to equal employment opportunity and respect, value and welcome diversity in our workplace. Husky TechnologiesTM also values being a great place to work and strives to maintain a safe workplace. The Software Test Engineer II will perform full-stack testing on modern web and backend applications. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!

We believe collaboration thrives in person. That's why most of our teams work from the office full time, with flexibility when it's needed. This model supports real-time problem-solving, stronger relationships, and the kind of precision that drives great outcomes. 

Job Summary

We are seeking an Engineering Manager to lead the team that builds and runs our connectors framework. In this role, you will be accountable for the team's delivery across several concurrent projects, from platform enhancements to large programs that need multiple teams to collaborate. You will lead by example as a hands-on technical manager, grow the engineers on your team, and remove roadblocks so the connector engineers who build on your platform can move fast. 

What You'll Do

- Own Team Delivery: Be accountable for delivering multiple framework projects and features at the same time. Make pragmatic trade-offs to deliver, and personally deliver features when the team needs it. 
 - Lead Technically: Stay hands-on and lead by example. Guide the team through large, complex projects that need several teams to complete, such as migrating on-premises connectivity to a cloud-managed agent or extracting the integrations code into its own service. Design features in the framework yourself when needed. 
 - Direct Quality and Reliability: Set the quality processes the team follows. Own framework reliability, including sync health, incident response, root cause analysis (RCA), and resolution of security findings. 
 - Develop Talent: Run 1: 1s, performance reviews, goal setting, and career guidance. Enable ownership on the team, resolve conflict, and grow engineers into their next level. 
 - Remove Roadblocks Across Teams: Work closely with the connector development team, other product teams, SRE, security, and PM to keep work clear and unblocked. 
 - Lead AI-First Engineering: Train the team on our tools and processes, including AI-assisted development workflows, and set the discipline for verifying AI-generated code. 
 - Drive Initiatives: Run initiatives within the team, such as cutting the time it takes to build a new connector or reducing sync failures. 
 - Keep Customers in Focus: Understand customer use cases and problems, and use them to set priorities with PM. 
 - Build the Team: Actively recruit, lead interviews, and make hiring decisions. 
 - Communicate Clearly: Present plans, progress, and risks to engineering and senior leadership. 

Nice to Have

- Identity & Access Security Domain: Direct experience with IAM, PAM, IGA, or Secrets Management platforms. 
 - Integration Platforms: Experience leading teams that build integration frameworks, data pipelines, or SDKs used by other engineers. 
 - Hybrid Connectivity: Experience with products that run agents inside customer networks. 
 - Multi-Site Teams: Experience leading engineers across more than one office location. 
 - DevOps & Observability Ecosystems: Practical experience with progressive delivery, CI/CD pipelines, feature flagging tools, and monitoring tools such as Datadog. 

Impact

As an Engineering Manager on the connectors framework, you will lead the team that every connector in our product depends on. Your impact will be measured by your team's delivery, the reliability of the framework in production, and the growth of the engineers you lead. Co-workers will look to you for clarity, technical judgment, and a steady path forward. 

Qualifications

- People Leadership: Experience managing software engineers, including 1: 1s, performance reviews, career development, and hiring. 
 - Technical Depth: Strong hands-on background with Node. js, TypeScript, MongoDB, and AWS, plus experience with data integration or distributed systems. Able to review designs and code with credibility. 
 - Delivery Track Record: Proven record of delivering large, complex projects that need collaboration across several teams. 
 - Operational Ownership: Experience running production services, leading incident response, and driving RCAs to durable fixes. 
 - AI Tooling Adoption: Experience leading a team's adoption of AI tools while keeping review rigor high. 
 - Conflict Resolution & Influence: Able to resolve conflict, remove roadblocks across teams, and build strong working relationships with ICs and managers. 
 - Communication: Excellent presentation skills, with the ability to explain complex technical topics to engineering and business audiences. 
 - Customer Understanding: Good understanding of customer use cases, problems, and considerations. 

Qualifications

Our Commitment

We're trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity's status quo. It's simple: we can't accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together. 

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at accommodations@paloaltonetworks. com. 

Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics. 

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

data.description:
The Company
PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy. 

We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers. 

We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade. 

Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do - and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities. 

Job Summary: 

What You Need To Know About The Role-
PayPal Marketing Technology team is dedicated to creating a best-in-class platform. As a Senior Software Engineer on our Marketing Technology Platform, you will be at the forefront of building and scaling Java/Spring, Node. js, React, and Python based services that move millions of customer profile attributes and events from PayPal source systems to downstream marketing and SaaS platforms. 

Meet our team

At PayPal Marketing Technology Platform, we are a supportive, forward-thinking community of customer-centric technologists. We celebrate our successes, learn from our challenges, and always keep pushing forward. Whether we're brainstorming the next big feature, tackling complex technical challenges, or sharing insights from our latest project, there's a shared sense of purpose and excitement for what we're building. 

Job Description: 

Essential Responsibilities: 

- Delivers complete solutions spanning all phases of the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) (design, implementation, testing, delivery and operations), based on definitions from more senior roles.

Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications: 

Your way to impact

Your work will directly contribute to PayPal's overarching mission of revolutionizing customer engagement globally. By building, enhancing, and scaling the back-end services that underpin our marketing technology experiences, you will be a key player in enabling seamless and innovative ways of engaging our customers worldwide. Your efforts in developing high-quality, secure, and performant software will improve customer experiences and drive the inclusion and flexibility that are critical in today's digital economy. Your role goes beyond coding; it's about making a tangible impact on the lives of millions. 

Your day to day

- Design, develop, test, and deploy robust, distributed software services using Java/Spring, Node. js, React, and Python in a Linux/Unix environment, ensuring high performance, security, and scalability. 
 - Build and scale services that sustain high throughput and low latency, identifying and solving performance and scalability bottlenecks. 
 - Automate builds, deployments, testing, and operational tasks to minimize manual effort and operational overhead. 
 - Build agentic services end to end, covering tool and API integration, orchestration, guardrails, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring, leveraging Google Gemini, Claude, and other AI platforms. 
 - Use AI-native development practices to accelerate design, coding, testing, and operations. 
 - Independently own multiple product features end to end, from requirements and design through production, proposing innovative solutions for new and existing functionality. 
 - Deliver complete solutions across all phases of the SDLC: design, implementation, testing, delivery, and operations. 
 - Operate with little day-to-day supervision, making sound technical decisions grounded in internal conventions and industry best practices. 
 - Advise management on project-level issues and risks. 
 - Apply strong problem-solving and debugging skills to troubleshoot production issues and drive root-cause fixes.

 - Guide junior engineers and share your knowledge to help new team members onboard quickly, fostering a culture of learning and continuous improvement. 

What Do You Need To Bring-

- A bachelor's degree in computer science or an equivalent combination of technical education and work experience. 
 - 6+ years of software development experience, with deep hands-on expertise in Java and the Spring Framework and/or a few of our core platform technologies: Node. js, React, and Python (with frameworks such as Django or Flask). Depth in these core platform technologies is a must. 
 - An AI-native mindset, with hands-on experience building agentic services end to end using Google Gemini, Claude, and other LLM platforms and agent frameworks. 
 - Solid grasp of core software fundamentals: data structures, algorithms, object-oriented design, and design patterns. 
 - Strong interest in, and experience building and operating, large-scale, high-performance, highly available distributed systems, with a track record of scaling services and driving high throughput. 
 - Experience designing and developing RESTful web services. 
 - Hands-on experience with databases, both SQL and NoSQL. 
 - Experience developing automated unit, integration, and functional tests using tools like JUnit, Mockito, or Spring Test. 
 - Proficiency with Maven and hands-on experience implementing CI/CD, automated testing, and observability to improve delivery quality and operational resilience. 
 - Fluency with version control (Git) and collaborative development workflows. 
 - Hands-on experience with event-driven architecture and messaging systems such as Kafka or Pulsar. 
 - Exposure to cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure and Infrastructure as Code (Terraform). Experience with SaaS platforms (Adobe, Braze) is a plus. 
 - Experience using Atlassian JIRA, ServiceNow, and Confluence. 

Experience delivering projects using Agile methodology

- We know the confidence gap and imposter syndrome can get in the way of meeting spectacular candidates. Please don't hesitate to apply.

PayPal

0

That's why we offer comprehensive, choice-based programs, to support all aspects of personal wellbeing-physical, emotional, and financial-delivering meaningful value where it matters most. data.title: Operations Engineer (Tier 3) nterprise AI
data.description:
Help keep enterprise AI applications reliable, secure and ready for the people who depend on them. This role combines Tier 2 and Tier 3 operational support with hands-on deployment participation, incident investigation and continuous improvement. 

Platform administration matters, but this is a broader engineering role. You'll look beyond the immediate symptom, trace issues across applications and integrations, and work with AI Engineers to resolve problems and prevent recurrence. It's an opportunity to bring established operational skills into an evolving enterprise AI environment. 

WHAT YOU'LL DO
* Investigate production incidents across applications, APIs, integrations, security, infrastructure and data. Use logs, alerts and dashboards to diagnose issues, collaborate with AI Engineers, and contribute to root-cause analysis and preventive improvements. 
* Support deployments across development, test and production. Execute and validate releases using Jenkins or equivalent CI/CD tooling, perform technical validation and smoke tests, troubleshoot deployment issues, and complete post-release checks within change and release governance. 
* Manage user access through provisioning, revocation, onboarding, offboarding and access reviews, keeping clear audit records. 
* Maintain incident, problem and support records, runbooks, knowledge articles and incident reports. Communicate progress clearly to stakeholders and identify practical improvements to monitoring and automation. 

WHAT YOU'LL BRING
Operational troubleshooting. Experience in technical application, production, cloud or infrastructure operations, including cloud-hosted enterprise applications. You can demonstrate how you diagnosed an operational issue, used evidence to narrow the cause and helped restore service. 
Practical deployment experience. Hands-on participation in releases, with a clear understanding of your own contribution, deployment steps, validation and troubleshooting. Familiarity with Microsoft Azure, Jenkins or equivalent CI/CD tooling, Git, and Python, PowerShell or similar scripting will support this work. 
Connected systems and service discipline. Working knowledge of APIs, REST/JSON, authentication and system integration, including OAuth/SSO; observability and monitoring/APM; Incident, Problem and Change processes; and ServiceNow or equivalent ITSM tooling. Experience supporting users and identities is also important. 
Clear communication and ownership. You write useful documentation, explain technical issues clearly and keep stakeholders informed. Typically, you'll bring 3-7 years of relevant experience; equivalent practical experience is welcome, and demonstrable capability matters more than a fixed range. 

HELPFUL EXPERIENCE
Practical exposure to AI agents or agentic workflows is strongly valued, particularly supporting or troubleshooting how they behave in operation. Familiarity with Azure OpenAI, RAG/vector databases, Azure AI Foundry, Azure Container Apps, Elasticsearch/Kibana, LangChain, Neo4j, Copilot, MLOps or AI governance would also be useful. You do not need experience with every tool. Enterprise Tier 2/3 support and regulated or business-critical environments are helpful backgrounds. 

WHY JOIN PROJECT FOUNDRY
Bring your operational strengths to enterprise AI, work alongside AI Engineers and help turn technical improvements into dependable services. Your contribution will span live support, releases and lasting improvements. 

APPLICATION INFORMATION
Please share your CV and briefly describe your personal contribution to a deployment and an incident investigation, including the steps, validation and diagnosis involved. Highlight any practical AI agent or agentic workflow experience too. These examples can guide the interview conversation; please avoid confidential client information.

You will also champion the adoption of AI-powered development and testing tools to accelerate engineering productivity and improve software quality.
