data.description:
Description

Amazon Music is an immersive audio entertainment service that deepens connections between fans, artists, and creators. From personalized music playlists to exclusive podcasts, concert livestreams to artist merch, Amazon Music is innovating at some of the most exciting intersections of music and culture. We offer experiences that serve all listeners with our different tiers of service: Prime members get access to all the music in shuffle mode, and top ad-free podcasts, included with their membership; customers can upgrade to Amazon Music Unlimited for unlimited, on-demand access to 100 million songs, including millions in HD, Ultra HD, and spatial audio; and anyone can listen for free by downloading the Amazon Music app or via Alexa-enabled devices. 

As a Software Development Manager (SDM) for Amazon Music International Tech, you will be managing a talented team of engineers building and scaling large scale systems allowing international customers to consume music and spoken word the way the want. You are expected to be a leader in technology, diving deep into problems you own, demonstrate excellent judgement skills in decision making, mentoring and growing talent. You inspire people, motivate the team, drive the culture of innovation, implement engineering best practices, and have commitment and grit to deliver results. 

You operate at the intersection of technology and business growth. Your systems directly impact how millions of international customers discover and engage with Amazon Music. You see the results of your team's work in real-time - every experiment launched, every feature shipped, every marketplace expanded into moves the needle on subscriber growth. 

Key job responsibilities

- Lead and manage a team of software engineers responsible for building and scaling large-scale distributed systems that power audio streaming in existing and future marketplaces
 - Define technical vision and architecture for systems serving millions of customers across Web, Mobile, Alexa, Kindle, and Fire TV. 
 - Drive Operational Excellence by establishing engineering best practices, defining on-call strategies, and ensuring high availability and reliability of services
 - Partner with product management and cross-functional engineering teams to translate business requirements into technical roadmaps and deliverables
 - Mentor, coach, and grow engineering talent through regular 1: 1s, career development planning, and performance management
 - Own end-to-end delivery of projects from design through deployment, ensuring quality, scalability, and customer impact
 - Influence organizational strategy by collaborating with senior leadership across Amazon Music to align on goals and priorities

 - Make sound technical and business judgement calls, balancing short-term delivery needs with long-term architectural investments
 - Recruit and hire top engineering talent to build a high-performing, diverse team

A day in the life

Making trade-off decisions between speed-to-market and long-term technical investment

Influencing peer SDMs and senior leadership on cross-org priorities

Removing blockers for your team so they can stay in flow

Thinking about how to measure and improve customer engagement, retention, and acquisition through technology

Balancing "keep the lights on" operational work with innovation and experimentation

The Amazon Music International Tech team is responsible for the E2E customer experience of our international customers. Job Description

Innovation Hub Overview

Jefferies is creating a Technology Innovation Hub in Pune, a greenfield opportunity to build the systems that power global markets. As our first India technology center, this hub brings together hands on builders who engineer the platforms behind Jefferies' growth across capital markets, investment banking, and institutional securities. We're scaling toward an elite team of 500 engineers while maintaining the agility, ownership, and meritocratic spirit that defines Jefferies. From cloud and data to AI, risk, and core business technologies, teams in Pune will lead high impact work with a global mandate IT Equities Technology

Jefferies' Equities Technology team builds and runs global, real-time trading and risk platforms across the full equities product spectrum-cash equities, portfolio/algo trading, central risk books, listed & OTC derivatives, convertibles, swaps, and ETF/basket trading. The team supports front-office workflows end-to-end, including order management, quantitative trading, real-time position and risk, AI/ML analytics, trade lifecycle processing, and regulatory/customer reporting. Operating in a 24x7 follow-the-sun model across major trading hubs, the India Technology Innovation Hub will be a core engineering center working closely with New York, London, Hong Kong, and other regions to build and enhance high-performance, scalable systems using technologies such as Python, Java, C++/C#, cloud, modern visualization, low-latency messaging, and in-memory data stores-often developing new platforms from the ground up with clear ownership and impact. Role Overview

The Connectivity team is seeking a Vice President to lead the regional FIX Order and Execution Systems team based in Pune. This is a hands-on team leadership role with responsibility for setting priorities, allocating work, developing engineers, and coordinating the team's delivery and production support. The team lead must bring proven experience leading technical teams, deep equities trading and FIX connectivity expertise, and a collaborative, accountable working style. The team's technical scope includes FIX configuration, sell-side broker connectivity, messaging and system-performance analytics, automated testing, and CI/CD implementation. 

Key Responsibilities

- Lead the local Pune regional team day to day: set priorities, allocate work, balance delivery and production-support demands, and maintain clear ownership and escalation paths within the team. 
 - Develop team capability through coaching, regular feedback, knowledge sharing, and delegation; build a supportive environment where engineers raise risks early and take ownership of outcomes. 
 - Represent the Pune team in global planning and incident coordination, communicating the local team's capacity, dependencies, risks, and commitments and coordinating handovers with peer teams in other regions. 
 - Lead the design, implementation, certification, and production support of FIX order and execution systems. 
 - Translate front-office trading requirements into FIX session configurations, message mappings, validation rules, and routing logic. 
 - Configure and support sell-side broker FIX connectivity, including new sessions, client migrations, and production changes. 
 - Analyze FIX messages and application behavior across the complete order lifecycle. 
 - Diagnose session management, sequence, validation, order-state, reject, routing, and downstream processing issues. 
 - Build or enhance tools for connectivity configuration, certification, monitoring, and operational support. 
 - Analyze message volumes, latency, throughput, burst patterns, queue behavior, and capacity. 
 - Develop AI-assisted models or tools for generating and prioritizing test scenarios for FIX order and execution systems. 
 - Implement CI/CD pipelines for configuration, code, testing, and deployment. 
 - Develop applications and automation using Java or Python. 
 - Define production-readiness criteria, monitoring requirements, support procedures, and rollback plans. 
 - Lead incident investigation and root-cause analysis for significant connectivity issues. 

Required Qualifications

- Generally, 10 years of FIX engineering experience, with a strong emphasis on hands-on engineering of FIX order and execution systems, together with demonstrated experience leading a technical team. 
 - Proven experience leading a local technical team, including work allocation, coaching, delivery oversight, and production-support coordination, while collaborating with peer teams in other locations. 
 - Demonstrated ability to achieve outcomes through others: delegate effectively, give constructive feedback, resolve competing priorities, and build team capability rather than rely on individual intervention. 
 - Extensive experience with electronic equities trading and front-office FIX order and execution systems. 
 - Strong knowledge of the FIX protocol, including session and application layers. 
 - Experience configuring and supporting sell-side broker FIX connectivity. 
 - Detailed understanding of equity order messages and order-state transitions. 
 - Experience diagnosing FIX rejects, session failures, sequence issues, mapping problems, and routing defects. 
 - Experience analyzing messaging performance, latency, throughput, and system behavior. 
 - Intermediate or stronger development skills in Java or Python. 
 - Experience with automated build, test, deployment, and CI/CD tooling. 
 - Strong production-support, incident-management, leadership, and communication skills. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Familiarity with FIX Orchestra, FIX dictionaries, custom tags, and venue-specific extensions. 
 - Experience with QuickFIX/J, proprietary FIX platforms, ULLINK product suite, or comparable FIX technology; experience with Verifix or other FIX simulation tools. 
 - Experience with Solace, Kafka, or equivalent messaging platforms. 
 - Experience applying AI or machine learning to test generation, failure analysis, or operational analytics. 
 - Experience with Splunk, Grafana, Prometheus, or Elastic. 

About Us

Jefferies is a leading global, full-service investment banking and capital markets firm that provides advisory, sales and trading, research, and wealth and asset management services. With more than 40 offices around the world, we offer insights and expertise to investors, companies, and governments. 

At Jefferies, we believe that diversity fosters creativity, innovation and thought leadership through the infusion of new ideas and perspectives. We have made a commitment to building a culture that provides opportunities for all employees regardless of our differences and supports a workforce that is reflective of the communities where we work and live. As a result, we are able to pool our collective insights and intelligence to provide fresh and innovative thinking for our clients.

As a Software Engineer at Spectro Cloud, you'll succeed by embracing adaptability, tackling complex challenges, and navigating dynamic environments with confidence. At Spectro Cloud, we champion innovation and collaboration, fostering a culture where shared ideas drive progress.

Description

Retail Business Services (RBS) supports Amazon's Retail business growth WW through three core tasks. These are (a) Selection, where RBS sources, creates and enrich ASINs to drive GMS growth; (b) Defect Elimination: where RBS resolves inbound supply chain defects and develops root cause fixes to improve free cash flow and (c) supports operational process for WW Retail teams where there is an air gap in the tech stack. The tech team in RBS develops automation that leverages Machine/Deep Learning to scale execution of these high complex tasks that currently require human cognitive skills. Our solutions ensure that information in Amazon's catalog is complete, correct and, comprehensive enough to give Amazon customers a great shopping experience every time. We are building solutions to move towards retail automation and are using latest technology like LLM to solve business problems. 

We believe in "Work Hard. Have Fun. Make History" value by having a strong focus on sharing learning experiences from the front line with the development teams. So, the options for people in the team are vast. If you like mastering a domain and going deep, we need you. If you can juggle three tasks and coordinate with multiple people in the heat of an incident, we need you. If you love the benefits of process and methodical improvement, you will love it here. If you want to keep your head down, headphones on, and bash out code to support the team, we have a spot for you too. 

At Amazon, we hire the best minds in technology to innovate and build on behalf of our customers. The focus we have on our customers is why we are one of the world's most beloved brands - customer obsession is part of our company DNA. 

We are seeking a Software Development Engineer who can design and develop systems for its businesses. As an SDE, you would have immense opportunity to explore avenues of how to model things, figure out right abstraction level, take judgement calls around multiple design trade offs at hand that influence a multi billion dollar business. 

We are looking for highly talented software development engineers who are passionate not only about architecting and developing large scale distributed technology solutions but also innovating new ideas and providing directions to our business. You will get to work on some of the key initiatives planned to support our rapid evolution and growth of our businesses. In this process you will drive best practices, mentor other engineers, drive continuous improvements in engineering and operational excellence. You will use technology to solve complex problems and get to see the impact of their work first-hand. The challenges SDEs solve for at Amazon are big and influence millions of customers, sellers, and products around the world. As a SDE with RBS team, you will work with talented peers of SDEs and Applied scientists to build robust engineering platforms to solve high impact issues. You will constantly stretch the boundaries of innovation to tackle the business challenges. 

If you enjoy designing and building highly distributed systems that can scale and solving challenging problems, come to join us!

Work/Life Balance

RBS Tech team puts a high value on work-life harmony. It isn't about how many hours you spend at home or at work; it's about the flow you establish that brings energy to both parts of your life. We believe striking the right balance between your personal and professional life is critical to life-long happiness and we encourage you to find your own balance between your work and personal lives. 

Mentorship & Career Growth

Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we're building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship. Our senior members enjoy one-on-one mentoring, detailed and constructive code reviews. We have casual coffee chats with Principal & Senior Engineers from RBS tech. You get an opportunity to network and have technical conversations around your work, technical challenges, suggestions, ideas and proposals. You can also seek advice and discuss about things outside work, like, life in general, your family, hobbies etc. We provide trainings to the employees through online learning platforms such as O'reilly and also encourage them to take up AWS/ML certifications. 

Key job responsibilities

We are looking for an experienced Software developer with a diverse skillset and background. As a SDE-2, your work is consistently of high quality. You solve difficult problems, applying appropriate technologies and best practices. You work with your team to invent, design and build software that is stable and performant. You are proficient in a broad range of design approaches and know when it is appropriate to use them (and when it is not). You limit the use of short-term workarounds. You create flexible software without over-engineering. You make appropriate trade-offs, re-use where possible, and are judicious about introducing dependencies. You are efficient with resource usage (e. g. , system hardware, database, memory/CPU, etc. ). You work on project ideas with customers, stakeholders, and peers. You help your team evolve by actively participating in the code review process, design discussions, team planning, and ticket/metric reviews. You focus on operational excellence, constructively identifying problems and proposing solutions. You work on software enhancements that improve team software and processes. You are able to train new members on how team's software is constructed, how it operates, how secure it is, and how it fits into the bigger picture.

 - 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience

data.title: Assistant Manager/Manager Airside Controls & Automation
data.description:
Role: Assistant Manager/Manager -Airside Controls

Location: Gurgaon, India

Full/ Part-time: Full time

Build a career with confidence

Carrier Global Corporation, global leader in intelligent climate and energy solutions is committed to creating solutions that matter for people and our planet for generations to come. From the beginning, we've led in inventing new technologies and entirely new industries. Today, we continue to lead because we have a world-class, diverse workforce that puts the customer at the center of everything we do. 

About The Role

This role involves in designing and developing electrical and control systems for AHU units. 

Job Responsibilities

- Design and develop electrical and control systems for Air Handling Units (AHUs) in accordance with project specifications, customer requirements, applicable codes, and engineering standards. 
 - Develop and design electrical control panels, including MCC/control panels, starter panels, VFD/VSD panels, DOL and star-delta starter systems, control transformers, power supplies, protection, switching, and control devices. 
 - Select, specify, and appropriately size electrical and control components, including motors, VFDs, contactors, overload relays, MCBs, MCCBs, fuses, relays, sensors, actuators, terminal blocks, and associated accessories. 
 - Prepare and review electrical schematics, control circuit diagrams, wiring diagrams, single-line diagrams (SLDs), panel layouts, and interconnection drawings. 
 - Develop AHU control philosophy and control logic for supply, return, and exhaust fans; fresh-air and return-air dampers; heating and cooling systems; chilled-water valves; electric heaters; humidifiers; filtration systems; and associated monitoring and protection functions. 
 - Develop, configure, program, and troubleshoot microprocessor-based controllers for HVAC and industrial automation applications. 
 - Configure, program, and troubleshoot temperature, pressure, humidity, airflow, and other process control systems used in HVAC applications. 
 - Select, configure, integrate, and troubleshoot field instrumentation and devices, including temperature, humidity, pressure, differential-pressure, airflow sensors, actuators, valves, and controllers. 
 - Develop and configure HMI/SCADA systems for equipment monitoring, control, alarm management, data visualization, and system diagnostics. 
 - Design and implement communication and interface requirements between AHU electrical/control systems and Building Management Systems (BMS) and other HVAC automation platforms. 
 - Perform system integration, functional testing, validation, troubleshooting, and commissioning of electrical and automation systems. 
 - Diagnose, debug, and optimize existing electrical, control, and automation systems to improve system performance, reliability, and operational efficiency. 
 - Prepare electrical control panel designs using AutoCAD, EPLAN, or equivalent electrical engineering design tools, with preference for hands-on experience in panel design documentation. 
 - Perform electrical engineering calculations, including connected load, operating load, cable sizing, protective device selection, breaker ratings, short-circuit ratings, control transformer sizing, and panel ratings. 
 - Ensure all electrical and automation designs comply with applicable IEC, IS, NFPA, NEC, and other relevant international/local standards, as well as customer and project-specific requirements. 
 - Review and interpret AHU mechanical drawings, equipment layouts, and technical specifications to ensure effective coordination and integration of electrical, mechanical, and control systems. 
 - Prepare and maintain Bills of Materials (BOMs), cable schedules, I/O lists, equipment/component specifications, terminal schedules, technical datasheets, and other engineering documentation. 
 - Review customer specifications, tender requirements, approved drawings, and technical submittals, and incorporate relevant requirements and engineering changes into the design. 
 - Coordinate closely with Mechanical Engineering, Controls/Automation, Production, Procurement, Quality, Project Management, and Service teams to ensure timely and successful project execution. 
 - Provide technical support to the manufacturing and assembly teams during control panel fabrication, panel wiring, component installation, AHU assembly, and inspection activities. 
 - Provide technical support to the Service and Commissioning teams during site installation, testing, commissioning, troubleshooting, and customer handover. 
 - Conduct design verification, functional testing, electrical testing, and system validation to ensure compliance with design requirements and expected equipment performance. 
 - Investigate electrical, instrumentation, control, and automation-related issues, perform root-cause analysis, and implement effective corrective and preventive actions. 
 - Maintain and control engineering drawings, software programs, technical documentation, revisions, and as-built records for current and future projects. 
 - Support the development and implementation of engineering standards, design guidelines, standard control philosophies, and reusable design solutions for AHU applications. 
 - Identify opportunities for cost optimization, component standardization, design simplification, and product improvement without compromising safety, quality, reliability, or performance. 
 - Support continuous improvement initiatives related to AHU electrical systems, automation architecture, control logic, panel design, manufacturing processes, and field performance. 

Education Preferred

Bachelors degree in Electrical Engineering / Electronics & Electrical engineering, having 7-11 years of work experience in Airside products

Experience Preferred

Design & development experience required as below: 

Ø Essential Competencies/ Primary Skill Set

- Electrical System & Control Panel Design: Strong knowledge and hands-on experience in designing electrical systems, control panels, starter panels, MCC panels, and associated control and protection circuits. 
 - AHU/HVAC Electrical & Automation Systems: Sound understanding of electrical, controls, and automation systems used in Air Handling Units (AHUs) and HVAC applications. 
 - Motor Control & Protection: Proficiency in motor starting, control, protection, interlocking, and selection of appropriate protective devices for HVAC and industrial applications. 
 - VFD/VSD Applications: Practical knowledge of Variable Frequency Drives/Variable Speed Drives, including selection, configuration, parameterization, integration, and troubleshooting. 
 - Microprocessor/PLC/DDC-Based Controllers: Knowledge and experience in configuring, programming, integrating, and troubleshooting microprocessor-based, PLC, and DDC controllers used in HVAC and industrial automation applications. 
 - HVAC Instrumentation & Field Devices: Good understanding of HVAC sensors, transmitters, actuators, control valves, dampers, and other field devices, including their selection, installation, configuration, and troubleshooting. 
 - HMI/SCADA Systems: Experience in configuring and troubleshooting HMI/SCADA systems for equipment monitoring, process visualization, alarm management, data acquisition, and operational control. 
 - BMS Integration & Communication Protocols: Understanding of BMS integration and industrial communication protocols for seamless communication between AHUs, controllers, field devices, and building automation systems. 
 - Electrical Load & Cable Sizing: Competence in electrical load calculations, cable sizing, voltage-drop calculations, protective device selection, short-circuit ratings, and control panel sizing. 
 - Electrical Schematics & Panel Documentation: Ability to develop and interpret electrical schematics, single-line diagrams, control circuit diagrams, wiring diagrams, panel layouts, terminal schedules, and interconnection drawings. 
 - AutoCAD/EPLAN: Proficiency in using AutoCAD, EPLAN, or equivalent electrical design software for developing and maintaining electrical drawings and control panel documentation. 
 - System Integration, Testing & Commissioning: Ability to integrate electrical, controls, instrumentation, and automation systems and conduct functional testing, validation, troubleshooting, and commissioning activities. 
 - Electrical & Automation Troubleshooting: Strong troubleshooting skills with the ability to diagnose electrical, instrumentation, control, communication, and automation-related issues and implement effective corrective actions. 
 - Electrical & HVAC Standards: Good working knowledge of relevant electrical and HVAC standards, including IEC, IS, NFPA, NEC, and applicable customer/project-specific standards and requirements. 
 - Ability to interpret customer specifications and deliver technically sound, compliant engineering solutions
 - Ability to drive cross-functional collaboration (Mechanical, Electrical, Controls, Manufacturing, Sourcing) for project execution
 - Good communication skills to manage customer interactions, technical clarifications, and submittal approvals

Ø Desirable Competencies/ Secondary Skill Set

- Experience in handling customer-facing engineering discussions and approvals during project execution
 - Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving mindset, and ability to work in a fast-paced ETO/project environment
 - Ability to adapt quickly to an existing, complex environment.

 - Self-starter who can work on his/her own initiative, balance demand load & prioritize

Benefits

We are committed to offering competitive benefits programs for all of our employees, and enhancing our programs when necessary. 

- Make yourself a priority with flexible schedules, parental leave
 - Drive forward your career through professional development opportunities
 - Achieve your personal goals with our Employee Assistance Programme

Our commitment to you

Our greatest assets are the expertise, creativity and passion of our employees. We strive to provide a great place to work that attracts, develops and retains the best talent, promotes employee engagement, fosters teamwork and ultimately drives innovation for the benefit of our customers. We strive to create an environment where you feel that you belong, with diversity and inclusion as the engine to growth and innovation. We develop and deploy best-in-class programs and practices, providing enriching career opportunities, listening to employee feedback and always challenging ourselves to do better. This is The Carrier Way. 

Join us and make a difference.

Team leadership and development

- Lead, coach, mentor Cyber Fusion Center analysts in Hyderabad that detect, investigate and coordinate the response to cyber threats across the enterprise. The role reports to the Global Head of Cyber Operations and owns the center's day-to-day delivery, quality and continuous improvement. 
 - Develop analysts across detection, threat intelligence, threat hunting and automation, setting clear objectives and running regular one-to-ones and performance reviews.

 - Build a pipeline of skills through structured training, certification support, tabletop exercises and rotations between analyst specialisms.

- Run the center's daily operations, integrating monitoring, threat intelligence, vulnerability data, fraud and physical security signals into a single operating picture.

Threat intelligence and hunting

Reporting and stakeholder management

Continuous improvement and governance

data.title: Revenue Accounting Engineering and Delivery Tech Lead
data.description:
Role Purpose

The Head of Engineering for Revenue Accounting India will provide senior technology and engineering leadership for the Revenue Accounting organization in India, building a world-class engineering capability and driving modernization, engineering excellence and predictable delivery across the Revenue Accounting technology estate. 

The role will establish India as a strategic engineering centre supporting end-to-end delivery, partnering with global Technology and Finance leadership to deliver critical Revenue Accounting capabilities and strategic transformation. 

The successful candidate will combine strong engineering and technology leadership with the ability to lead a large, complex organization, develop exceptional talent, modernize the technology estate and deliver consistently in a highly regulated environment. 

Key Responsibilities

Engineering Leadership & Strategy

- Lead the Revenue Accounting engineering organization in India, with accountability for engineering excellence, talent, technology and delivery outcomes. 
 - Define and execute the India engineering strategy, aligned to the global Revenue Accounting technology strategy and broader Finance transformation agenda. 
 - Provide strong technical leadership across the engineering organization, ensuring strategic technology decisions balance business outcomes, architecture, resilience, risk and long-term sustainability. 
 - Establish clear engineering standards across software design, architecture, development, testing, DevSecOps, observability, resilience and production engineering. 
 - Champion a culture of engineering ownership where teams are accountable for solutions throughout the technology lifecycle, from design and build through deployment and production. 

Technology Modernization

- Drive modernization of the Revenue Accounting technology estate, including MOTIF and the broader subledger ecosystem, simplifying legacy architecture and moving toward strategic target-state capabilities. 
 - Actively manage technical debt and drive simplification of applications, infrastructure, data flows and engineering processes. 
 - Promote modern architecture and engineering patterns including cloud, APIs, microservices, event-driven architecture, automation and modern data capabilities where appropriate. 
 - Ensure technology investment balances immediate business and regulatory requirements with the long-term strategic health of the platform. 

Delivery & Transformation

- Drive predictable execution of the Revenue Accounting engineering roadmap, aligning engineering capacity to the highest-value business, regulatory and strategic outcomes. 
 - Provide senior engineering leadership to major Finance transformation initiatives, ensuring Revenue Accounting capabilities integrate effectively with the target front-to-back accounting architecture. 
 - Establish transparent measures of engineering health, delivery effectiveness, quality, risk and productivity. 
 - Identify and proactively manage material technology dependencies, delivery risks and capacity constraints. 

Talent & Organizational Leadership

- Build and develop a high-performing engineering organization across India, strengthening both engineering leadership and deep technical capability. 
 - Attract, retain and develop outstanding engineering talent while creating clear career paths for technical specialists and engineering leaders. 
 - Build a strong succession pipeline across Director, VP, technical leadership and senior engineering roles. 
 - Strengthen institutional knowledge and reduce key-person or third-party dependencies through targeted insourcing, mobility, cross-training and capability development. 
 - Foster an inclusive, collaborative and high-performance engineering culture where teams are empowered to challenge, innovate and continuously improve. 

Innovation & AI

- Champion the responsible adoption of AI-enabled software engineering, intelligent automation and modern developer tooling across the engineering lifecycle. 
 - Identify opportunities to improve developer productivity, test automation, software quality and speed to market through AI and automation. 
 - Create an environment that encourages experimentation while ensuring innovation is governed appropriately for a regulated technology environment. 

Partnership & Stakeholder Leadership

- Act as a senior member of the global Revenue Accounting technology leadership team, ensuring India is fully integrated into global strategy and decision-making. 
 - Build trusted relationships with senior stakeholders across Finance, Product, Architecture, Operations, Risk, Controls and Technology. 
 - Influence enterprise technology and engineering decisions beyond the immediate Revenue Accounting organization. 
 - Represent Revenue Accounting within the broader India technology leadership community and strengthen India's position as a strategic engineering hub. 

Desirable Skills

The following would be advantageous: 

- Experience within financial accounting technology, including subledger, general ledger, financial control or regulatory reporting platforms. 
 - Understanding of front-to-back accounting flows, including transaction capture, accounting event generation, subledger processing, reconciliation, financial controls and general-ledger integration. 
 - Experience delivering large-scale Finance or enterprise transformation within a global financial institution. 
 - Experience with large-scale platform or cloud modernization. 
 - Knowledge of modern technologies and patterns including Java, APIs, microservices, event-driven architecture, AWS/cloud technologies, DevSecOps and modern data platforms. 
 - Experience implementing AI-assisted software engineering, developer productivity tooling or intelligent test automation at enterprise scale. 
 - Experience developing product-oriented and Agile engineering organizations. 
 - Experience implementing insourcing strategies and transferring critical technology or domain capability from third-party providers into permanent engineering teams. 
 - Experience leading globally distributed engineering organizations, particularly across India, the UK and US. 
 - Understanding of technology economics and experience optimizing engineering investment, infrastructure costs and third-party expenditure. 

Accountabilities

The Head of Engineering will have clear accountability across the following areas: 

Technology & Architecture

- Technical health and strategic evolution of the Revenue Accounting technology estate within the role's remit. 
 - Alignment to enterprise architecture, engineering and technology standards. 
 - Reduction of legacy complexity and technical debt. 
 - Creation of sustainable, resilient and scalable technology solutions. 

Engineering & Delivery

- Quality, predictability and effectiveness of engineering delivery. 
 - Engineering standards and controls throughout the software development lifecycle. 
 - Effective management of engineering capacity, dependencies and technology risks. 
 - Continuous improvement of engineering productivity, quality and time to market. 

Service, Resilience & Controls

- Stability, resilience, security and maintainability of technology platforms. 
 - Effective management of production risk, recurring incidents and systemic technology issues. 
 - Compliance with applicable technology, cyber, data, resilience and regulatory requirements. 
 - Timely identification, escalation and remediation of material technology risks and control weaknesses. 

People & Organization

- Organizational health and effectiveness of the India Revenue Accounting engineering function. 
 - Workforce strategy, organizational design and location strategy. 
 - Attraction, retention, development and succession of engineering talent. 
 - Development of strong engineering and technology leadership capability. 
 - Reduction of key-person risk and inappropriate dependency on external providers. 

Strategy & Transformation

- Translation of global Revenue Accounting strategy into an executable India engineering strategy and roadmap. 
 - Technology contribution to strategic Finance and accounting transformation. 
 - Modernization and simplification of the Revenue Accounting technology estate. 
 - Identification of opportunities to improve technology economics and engineering productivity through architecture, automation and AI. 

Purpose of the role

To lead and manage engineering teams, providing technical guidance, mentorship, and support to ensure the delivery of high-quality software solutions, driving technical excellence, fostering a culture of innovation, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to align technical decisions with business objectives. 

Accountabilities

- Lead engineering teams effectively, fostering a collaborative and high-performance culture to achieve project goals and meet organizational objectives. 
 - Oversee timelines, team allocation, risk management and task prioritization to ensure the successful delivery of solutions within scope, time, and budget. 
 - Mentor and support team members' professional growth, conduct performance reviews, provide actionable feedback, and identify opportunities for improvement. 
 - Evaluation and enhancement of engineering processes, tools, and methodologies to increase efficiency, streamline workflows, and optimize team productivity. 
 - Collaboration with business partners, product managers, designers, and other stakeholders to translate business requirements into technical solutions and ensure a cohesive approach to product development. 
 - Enforcement of technology standards, facilitate peer reviews, and implement robust testing practices to ensure the delivery of high-quality solutions. 

Director Expectations

- To manage a business function, providing significant input to function wide strategic initiatives. Contribute to and influence policy and procedures for the function and plan, manage and consult on multiple complex and critical strategic projects, which may be business wide. . 
 - They manage the direction of a large team or sub-function, leading other people managers and embedding a performance culture aligned to the values of the business. Or for an individual contributor, they lead organisation wide projects and act as deep technical expert and thought leader, identifying new ways of working and collaborating cross functionally. They will train, guide and coach less experienced specialists and provide information affecting long term profits, organisational risks and strategic decisions. . 
 - Provide expert advice to senior functional management and committees to influence decisions made outside of own function, offering significant input to function wide strategic initiatives. 
 - Manage, coordinate and enable resourcing, budgeting and policy creation for a significant sub-function. 
 - Escalates breaches of policies / procedure appropriately.

data.description:
Introduction

At IBM Software, we transform client challenges into solutions. Building the world's leading AI-powered, cloud-native products that shape the future of business and society. Our legacy of innovation creates endless opportunities for IBMers to learn, grow, and make an impact on a global scale. Working in Software means joining a team fueled by curiosity and collaboration. You'll work with diverse technologies, partners, and industries to design, develop, and deliver solutions that power digital transformation. With a culture that values innovation, growth, and continuous learning, IBM Software places you at the heart of IBM's product and technology landscape. Here, you'l have the tools and opportunities to advance your career while creating software that changes the world. 

Your Role And Responsibilities

AuthMind is a pioneering Identity SecOps provider that arms identity and cybersecurity teams with end-to-end, real-time identity security posture management and threat detection. AuthMind is designed to secure identity and access in any cloud (e. g. , AWS, Azure), as well as on-premises or data centres. In 2022, Gartner recognised AuthMind as a Cool Vendor in Identity-First Security. Read more at www. authmind. com. 

Product

AuthMind discovers and monitors any identity that enterprise employees use to connect to any asset, anywhere, anytime. The AuthMind Identity SecOps Platform enables SecOps to address the most dangerous enablers of identity-based attacks: blind spots, identity infrastructure security gaps, and misconfigurations caused by human error. It allows security orgs to become enablers for engineering and business teams to move faster as they adopt new cloud and SaaS tooling. 

The product is heavily driven by data analytics as well as AI/ML. The core idea is to analyse events & logs from enterprise systems & networks to enable the use cases we are trying to solve in the area of identity & access security. 

Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced Senior Software Development Engineer with 3 to 10 years of experience to join our dynamic and fast-paced engineering team. The ideal candidate is technically adept, thrives in a fast-paced environment, and has a proven track record of building and scaling backend services. You will play a critical role in designing and delivering high-performance, secure systems for solving some of the most challenging problems in identity security while mentoring others and driving engineering excellence. 

Responsibilities

- Architect, design, and implement backend services with a strong emphasis on scalability, performance, and reliability. 
 - Lead the development of distributed systems in cloud environments, ensuring robust and secure deployments. 
 - Leverage deep expertise in at least one programming language (Golang, Python, or C/C++) to solve complex technical challenges. 
 - Mentor and guide junior engineers, fostering a culture of knowledge sharing and continuous improvement. 
 - Analyze and optimize system interactions within the Linux environment, ensuring efficient resource utilization. 
 - Address large-scale data engineering challenges, implementing solutions for efficient data processing and transformation. 
 - Drive engineering best practices, including robust testing, clean code, documentation, and efficient deployment pipelines. 
 - Ensure efficient use of cloud resources to minimize costs while maintaining performance and reliability. 
 - Support customers via on-call rotations in engineering to ensure prompt issue resolution and system reliability. 
 - Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define technical requirements. 
 - Adapt quickly to shifting priorities and technologies, contributing to the success of a dynamic, high-growth company. 

Preferred Education

Master's Degree

Required Technical And Professional Expertise

Experience in software development with a proven track record of delivering high-quality backend systems. 

- [Mandatory - Programming Skills] Advanced proficiency in at least one of Golang, Python, or C/C++. 
 - [Mandatory - Systems Knowledge] Strong foundation in operating systems fundamentals, Linux, and distributed systems architecture. 
 - Extensive experience building and deploying scalable services in cloud environments. 
 - Exceptional analytical skills, capable of solving complex technical problems in high-scale systems. 
 - Commitment to providing exceptional support during on-call rotations and ensuring system reliability. 
 - Consistent emphasis on quality, testing, and documentation. 
 - Familiarity with version control tools (e. g. , Git) and collaborative coding workflows. Expertise in handling large-scale data processing and advanced data engineering workflows. 
 - Exposure to modern software architecture patterns, including microservices and event-driven systems. 
 - Familiarity with cybersecurity or identity security technologies and concepts is a plus. 
 - Hands-on experience with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes) and CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Ability to adapt quickly and deliver results in a fast-paced, high-growth company. 

Preferred Technical And Professional Experience

- Experience with multi-tenant architecture, rate limiting, and tenant isolation. 
 - Experience with event-driven design and data consistency patterns at scale. 
 - Familiarity with service meshes, feature flags, and progressive delivery. 
 - Contributions to open source projects. 
 - Experience with load and chaos testing.

data.title: Senior Principal Cloud Foundations Engineer – Full Stack
data.description:
Business Introduction

GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems. 

Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines. 

Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges. 

Job Purpose

The Principal Cloud Foundations Engineer - Full Stack builds and runs the Internal Hosting Portal that allows application teams across GSK to provision and manage Cloud resources in a self-service manner. The Hosting Portal is a custom-built web application using a modern TypeScript tech stack based on TypeScript. The full stack engineer sets the engineering standard within that platform, mentors the engineers around them, and treats the teams who consume the platform as customers. The role works through autoamted software deployment rather than manual configuration, uses AI-assisted engineering across code generation, review and testing, and engineers reliability in by defining SLOs, instrumenting for observability and automating away toil. 

This is the senior hands-on engineering role in the platform team, insourced at the grades covered by this description while engineering at G7b and below is delivered through managed service partners, so the role integrates and assures partner components as well as building. Engineering roadmap and direction sit with the Engineering Director, reference architecture and standards sit with the Platform Architect, backlog order sits with the Product Owner, and deep reliability engineering sits with the Site Reliability Engineer deployed from Reliability Engineering & Operations. 

Key Responsibilities

- Design, build and automate platform infrastructure using infrastructure-as-code and golden paths, so that provisioning is repeatable rather than reconstructed each time. 
 - Use AI-assisted engineering across code generation, review and testing to accelerate delivery and raise quality, reviewing AI-generated output before it is merged. 
 - Build self-service capabilities and paved roads that reduce friction for consuming teams, so adoption does not depend on the platform team's availability. 
 - Engineer for reliability by defining SLOs, instrumenting platforms for observability and automating to reduce toil, working with the Site Reliability Engineer on standards. 
 - Set and uphold engineering standards, secure-by-default practices and code quality within the platform, and hold them in code review. 
 - Contribute to incident response and drive permanent automated fixes with Reliability Engineering rather than repeating manual recovery. 
 - Mentor and technically lead other engineers, including partner engineers, linking engineering work to platform OKRs and outcomes. 
 - Integrate and assure supplier or managed-service components, holding partner-delivered engineering to the same standards and code quality as internal work. 
 - Work the platform's manual task and toil backlog, converting identified candidates into automation and evidencing the effort removed. 
 - Close observability coverage gaps for the platform, so that reliability can be measured rather than inferred. 
 - Contribute engineering-led items to the platform backlog held by the Product Owner, including technical debt, upgrade and automation work, with the cost of not doing them stated. 
 - Apply the reference architectures and patterns set by the Platform Architect, and raise a case for change rather than diverging locally. 

Professional Qualifications

- Degree in a technology or engineering discipline, or equivalent practical experience (e. g. , Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electronics). 
 - Relevant technical certifications desirable (e. g. , a recognised cloud certification for AWS, GCP or Azure, Certified Kubernetes Administrator, or a network vendor certification relevant to the platform). 

Area of Specialisation

- Hands-on platform engineering in cloud, network or digital workplace, covering infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD and containers where relevant. 
 - Automation-first and secure-by-default engineering, with an SRE mindset covering SLOs, observability and toil reduction. 

Experience Required

- Overall, 15 years and Typically 6-8 years in cloud, infrastructure or software engineering, including at least two years as the senior technical voice in a team. 
 - Excellent knowledge and hands on experience with HTML5, CSS3 (including preprocessors) and TypeScript (ES6+). 
 - Excellent knowledge and hands on experience with React and NextJS
 - Hands-on experience with GraphQL and relevant tooling such as Yoga, Prisma, and Apollo Client
 - undefined
 - Good understanding of bundlers and compilers such as Webpack, TS-Node, Rspack and Babel. 
 - undefined
 - Previous experience in developing a React-based UI Component library based on Mantine, Material UI, or Chakra UI. 
 - undefined
 - Familiar with popular patterns and libraries such as React Hooks, state management, and Redux. 
 - undefined
 - Previously developed schema-based forms either custom or based on a library such as react-hook-form or Formik, including data validator libraries such as Yup, Zod or JOI. 
 - undefined
 - Expertise with CSS grid systems, media queries, flex and other layout techniques and responsive user interface components. 
 - undefined
 - Knowledge of modern authentication and authorization mechanisms such as OAuth v2 or SAML and JSON Web Token and libraries such as MSAL. 
 - Strong experience with test automation (unit & integration) tools such as Jest and Cypress. 

Desirable: 

- Familiar with building React web applications based on a Micro Frontend using Module Federation or Single SPA. 
 - undefined
 - Developed REST APIs based on NodeJS (ExpressJS). 
 - undefined
 - Experience of building and deploying web applications through CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps. 
 - undefined
 - Knowledge of deploying, managing and monitoring web applications in a Cloud environment such as Microsoft Azure or Google Cloud. 
 - undefined
 - Previously worked in a central IT team within a regulated environment such as the Pharmaceutical or Finance industry. 

Skills/Background

- Automation-first instinct, treating a repeated manual task as a defect rather than as work. 
 - Code review discipline, holding quality without becoming a bottleneck. 
 - Mentoring ability with engineers of varying experience, including partner engineers outside the line. 
 - Judgement about when AI-generated code is fit to merge and when it is not. 
 - Customer mindset toward consuming teams, who can route around a platform that is hard to use. 
 - Willingness to make technical debt and its cost visible rather than absorbing it silently.

Why GSK?

Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. 

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2. 5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. data.title: Lead Production Support Engineer
data.description:
Konovo is a global healthcare intelligence company on a mission to transform research through technology-enabling faster, better, connected insights. 

Konovo provides healthcare organizations with access to over 2 million healthcare professionals and patients, the largest network of its kind globally. With a workforce of over 200 employees across 5 countries-India, Bosnia and Herzegovina, the United Kingdom, Mexico, and the United States-we support some of the most prominent names in healthcare. 

Our Whitefield-based India team is our innovation hub and center of excellence for building scalable platforms, AI-enabled capabilities, and next-generation healthcare technology. 

As a Lead Production Support Engineer at Konovo, you will be the frontline owner of production stability, operational excellence, and customer trust. You will work across Product, Engineering, QA, DevOps, and Business teams to ensure our platform remains reliable, scalable, and resilient for global healthcare customers. This is not a ticket-management role-it is an engineering ownership role for someone who thrives under pressure, enjoys debugging complex distributed systems, and takes accountability for resolving critical production issues end-to-end. 

How You'll Make an Impact

Production Incident Investigation & Debugging

- Own end-to-end investigation of production incidents across frontend, backend, APIs, databases, and distributed services. 
 - Debug issues across modern applications built with JavaScript, React, Next. js, Java, or Scala. 
 - Drive rapid incident resolution while balancing business impact, customer communication, and technical accuracy. 
 - Partner with engineering teams to identify root causes and deploy permanent fixes. 

Monitoring, Alerting & Root Cause Engineering

- Monitor application logs, service health, API behavior, infrastructure metrics, and business alerts. 
 - Use observability tools like Datadog, Amazon CloudWatch, or the ELK stack to proactively detect anomalies. 
 - Lead root cause analysis for critical incidents and publish executive-ready incident reports. 
 - Drive preventive actions to eliminate recurring production issues. 

Application & Database Support

- Investigate data inconsistencies, performance issues, API failures, and system behavior across production environments. 
 - Perform advanced troubleshooting using MySQL and NoSQL systems. 
 - Understand schema relationships, data integrity, and business workflows in healthcare market research systems. 
 - Support platform releases, hotfix validations, rollback decisions, and post-release monitoring. 

Bug Management & Operational Excellence

- Raise high-quality bugs with complete logs, traces, RCA, and reproduction steps in Jira. 
 - Coordinate issue lifecycle across engineering, QA, DevOps, and product stakeholders. 
 - Maintain incident dashboards, SLA metrics, and production quality trends. 
 - Build knowledge repositories, playbooks, and troubleshooting guides in Confluence. 

Automation & Process Improvement

- Identify opportunities to automate support workflows, alerting, health checks, log analysis, and recovery processes. 
 - Partner with Konovo's LITE team to explore AI-driven production support use cases such as anomaly detection, log summarization, and automated RCA. 
 - Continuously improve operational efficiency, incident response time, and platform reliability. 

Cross-Functional Leadership

- Act as the bridge between engineering teams and business stakeholders during production incidents. 
 - Provide calm, clear, and data-driven communication during outages or escalations. 
 - Mentor junior support engineers and help scale operational best practices across teams. 

What We're Looking For

- 7-12 years of experience in production support, site reliability, platform support, or application engineering under L-3 Support. 
 - Strong debugging experience across frontend, backend, APIs, and distributed systems. 
 - Hands-on experience with: 
 - JavaScript, Java, or Scala
 - React / Next. js applications
 - SQL / MySQL / NoSQL databases
 - Monitoring tools like Datadog, Grafana, CloudWatch, ELK
 - Cloud platforms such as Amazon Web Services
 - Strong understanding of microservices, distributed systems, API integrations, and SaaS platforms. 
 - Experience with Agile delivery, incident management, and cross-functional stakeholder communication. 
 - Comfortable leveraging AI-enabled tools to streamline workflows, improve response quality, and increase speed without compromising data integrity or customer experience. 
 - Healthcare, life sciences, or market research platform experience is a strong plus. 
 - Strong ownership mindset, calm under pressure, and bias toward action. 
Why Join Konovo?

- Be part of a mission-driven organisation that is empowering life science researchers and data scientists with the broadest ecosystem of healthcare audiences and an intelligent, AI-enabled platform - so insights aren't just collected, they're connected. 
 - Join a fast-growing global team with opportunities for professional growth and advancement. 
 - Enjoy a collaborative and hybrid work environment that fosters innovation and flexibility. 
 - Experience a workplace that puts employees first, offering a workplace designed for growth, well-being, and balance. 
 - Become a part of an organisation that prioritizes your well-being with comprehensive benefits, including group medical coverage, accident insurance, and a robust leave policy. Our employee-centric policies ensure a rewarding and fulfilling work experience. 
 - Make a real-world impact by helping healthcare organisations innovate faster. 

If you're eager to build a meaningful career in healthcare market research - and you're smart, nice, and driven to make an impact - we'd love to hear from you!

Apply now to be part of our journey.

data.title: Test & Validation Engineer
data.description:
Career Area

Engineering

Job Description

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc. 

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do - but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here - we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it. 

We Build What Matters

What matters most to you? Is it being part of a strong team? Supporting your family? Solving global problems? You can do these and more at Caterpillar; where your work enables progress around the globe and you contribute to meaningful work. Together, we can build what matters. Caterpillar's Industrial Power Systems Division (IPSD) is responsible for design, manufacture, marketing, and sales of industrial engines for both Cat and Perkins brands product engines. Our global facilities enable us to support our customers wherever they are located in the world. 

Caterpillar's IPSD Global Engine Performance & Emissions Development Team in Chennai, India, is looking for a person to serve as engine system development engineer. In this role, you will be responsible for delivery of diesel engine development programs for IPSD's 9-liter through 18-liter machine and commercial product offerings. This position is responsible for directing work through the engine test cells, using data analysis tools to process and summarize data, creating engine and aftertreatment calibrations based on both test data and modeling tools, and certifying the final engine calibration. This position collaborates with highly engaged and technically capable team members, as well as manages multiple projects and assignments simultaneously that are complex in nature which support and enhance Caterpillar product performance, durability, reliability, quality, and serviceability. 

Job Duties/Responsibilities May Include, But Are Not Limited To

- Work with a team of test engineers and lab support staff to plan & execute engine development and certification plans
 - Translate technical requirements into detailed plan test plans, instrumentation requirements, and mitigation plans for test cell work
 - Author test instructions and work orders to advance engine test cell plans to completion. Assist in troubleshooting data quality issues with test cell operations staff. 
 - Manage time and cost accounting of multiple test cells through VOEE and PMO tools
 - Optimize engine and aftertreatment calibration within requirements, hardware limits, and emissions regulations; populate corresponding maps to build calibration into software. 
 - Prepare and deliver technical project summaries and final test results
 - Contribute to multiple New Product Introduction (NPI) rating development projects, New Technology Integration (NTI) projects, and emissions certification projects
 - Support Built-In-Quality (BIQ) efforts to reduce inefficiency in design and test lab processes

Basic Qualifications

- Education - Bachelor's degree or higher in accredited Engineering field (i. e. Mechanical, Production, Automotive and others)
 - Experience - upto 6+ years of engine and/or aftertreatment performance and emissions development and testing
 - Strong communication skills - oral and written complemented by the ability to develop/deliver technical presentations

Top Candidates Will Also Have

- Master's degree (or equivalent) in an accredited Engineering field (i. e. Mechanical, Production, Automotive and others)
 - Experience with engine combustion & emissions performance, engine calibration, & lab testing
 - Experience of working with Indian National test laboratories like ARAI, iCAT and others
 - Self-starter with strong technical leadership skills
 - The ability to work in - and enjoy working in - a dynamic environment; adapting to and driving change
 - A willingness to work on a broad range of engine applications
 - A sense of urgency balanced with a strong commitment to quality
 - The ability to work/lead multiple projects simultaneously and to make sound priority decisions

Additional Information

- Work Arrangement: This is an office-based position requiring on-site presence five days per week. 
 - Travel Requirement: This position requires travel to test sites, up to 25% of the time, based on business and project needs. 

This Job Description is intended as a general guide to the job duties for this position and is intended for the purpose of establishing the specific salary grade. It is not designed to contain or be interpreted as an exhaustive summary of all responsibilities, duties and effort required of employees assigned to this job. At the discretion of management, this description may be changed at any time to address the evolving needs of the organization. It is expressly not intended to be a comprehensive list of "essential job functions" as that term is defined by the Americans with Disabilities Act. 

This position requires working onsite five days a week. 

Relocation is available for this position.

November 19, 2026 - December 3, 2026

Job Title: Vice President Platform Engineering & Consumer Direct Healthcare

Location: Hyderabad, India (on-site)

Reports to: Executive Vice President (EVP)

Employment type: Full-time

Team size: 40+ engineers and technical leaders

About NationsBenefits

NationsBenefits is a healthcare fintech and benefits company that partners with Medicare, Medicaid and commercial health plans. Its supplemental benefits, flex card and member engagement solutions help members get more from their benefits and help plans improve outcomes. Our platforms process high volumes of real-time benefit transactions for millions of members

Role Summary

We are looking for a hands-on technology leader to own two connected charters from Hyderabad: 

- Platform Engineering: the core, cloud-native . NET Customer platform that powers our payments, benefits adjudication and member-facing products. 
 - Consumer Direct Healthcare (CDH): the products and systems for consumer-directed accounts such as FSA, HSA and HRA. 

You will set the technical vision, build and grow a large engineering organization, and work closely with product, operations, compliance and business leaders in India and the US. This is not a purely managerial role. We expect you to stay close to architecture, code quality and delivery, and to step into the details when needed. 

Key Responsibilities

Platform Engineering: 

- Define and execute the platform strategy and roadmap: architecture, scalability, resilience, security and cost efficiency. 
 - Own the . NET microservices and API ecosystem, cloud infrastructure (Azure preferred), CI/CD, observability and developer tooling. 
 - Drive reliability through SLOs, incident management, disaster recovery and performance engineering. 
 - Plan and validate capacity ahead of demand, including open enrollment and other seasonal peaks, through load, stress, soak and failover testing. 
 - Design for horizontal scale using autoscaling, caching, asynchronous messaging and data partitioning, so growth in members and transactions doesn't require re-architecture. 
 - Modernize legacy systems (for example, migrating to modern . NET versions) and reduce technical debt without disrupting live operations. 
 - Champion engineering excellence: code reviews, testing automation, DevSecOps and documentation standards. 

Consumer Direct Healthcare

- Own the technology strategy and delivery for CDH products, including account administration, contributions, claims and reimbursements, card transactions, and eligibility and reconciliation. 
 - Partner with product and compliance teams to translate regulatory and plan requirements into scalable technical solutions. 
 - Oversee integrations with banks, card processors, payment networks, health plans, employers, retailers and third-party administrators. 
 - Ensure real-time card authorization and claims processing meet strict latency and accuracy requirements at peak volume. 
 - Identify opportunities to use data and AI to improve member experience, automation and fraud and risk controls. 

Leadership And Collaboration

- Lead, mentor and develop a 40+ person organization, including managers, architects and senior engineers. Build a strong leadership bench and succession plan. 
 - Hire, onboard and retain top engineering talent in Hyderabad. Build a culture of ownership, accountability and continuous learning. 
 - Work across time zones with US leadership, product, operations, security, compliance and vendor partners. 
 - Manage budgets, vendor relationships and delivery commitments, and report progress and risks clearly to the EVP and other executives. 
 - Ensure compliance with HIPAA, PCI-DSS, SOC 2 and other applicable security and privacy standards. 

Required

Qualifications : 

- 15+ years in software engineering, with 7+ years in senior leadership roles. 
 - Proven experience leading engineering organizations of 40+ people, including managers of managers. 
 - Strong hands-on technical background in the Microsoft . NET stack (C#, . NET Core / modern . NET, ASP. NET Core, Entity Framework), with experience in distributed systems, microservices and cloud-native architecture (Docker/Kubernetes, and Azure preferred). 
 - Experience building and operating high-volume, mission-critical platforms, preferably in fintech, payments, insurance or healthcare. 
 - Demonstrated experience setting and meeting scalability, performance and reliability targets (SLOs, SLAs, capacity planning, load testing). 
 - Track record of modernizing platforms, improving reliability and delivering large, complex programs. 
 - Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence senior business and technology leaders. 
 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field. A master's degree is a plus. 

Preferred

- Working knowledge of FSA, HSA and HRA administration, including contribution limits, eligible expenses, claims substantiation and IRS rules. 
 - Experience with Azure DevOps, Azure services (App Service, AKS, Service Bus, SQL), observability tools (for example, Application Insights, Grafana, Datadog) and front-end frameworks such as ReactJS. 
 - Experience with card issuing and processing, payment networks, adjudication engines or real-time authorization. 
 - Familiarity with healthcare data standards and integrations (EDI, HL7/FHIR, eligibility files) and regulatory frameworks such as HIPAA. 
 - Experience applying AI/ML or automation to operations, fraud detection or member experience. 
 - Experience working with US-based teams and stakeholders.

Roles & Responsibilities Quality Strategy & Leadership

- Own and define the overall QA and testing strategy across functional, automation, performance, security, and data-integrity testing. 
 - Establish quality gates, release criteria, testing standards, metrics, and reporting. 
 - Identify and prioritize testing efforts based on business and technical risk, especially data-correctness risks. 
 - Build and manage the quality function with minimal supervision. 
 - Mentor developers and QA engineers and promote a quality-first engineering culture.

Test Automation

 - Integrate automated testing into CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Build scalable regression suites that improve release velocity and confidence.

Functional & Migration Testing

Data Validation & Integrity

 - Data mappings 
 - Relationships and associations 
 - Transformations

data.description:
About Albertsons

As a leading food and drug retailer in the United States, Albertsons Companies, Inc. (ACI) operates over 2, 200 stores across 34 states and the District of Columbia. Our well-known global banners, including Albertsons, Safeway, Vons, Jewel-Osco and others. Our success is built upon a united team approach, driven by the desire to understand and enhance the customer experience. This customer-centric focus not only inspires innovation but has also led to remarkable achievements across our digital platforms and omnichannel strategies. By constantly pushing the boundaries of retail, we have transformed shopping into an experience that is not just easy and efficient, but also fun and engaging. Over the past year, we have taken bold, strategic steps to migrate and modernize our enterprise data hub on Google Cloud, revolutionizing our data capabilities, thus becoming the first fully cloud-based grocery tech company. 

About Tech Hub In India

Albertsons Companies India (ACI India) is part of Albertsons Companies Inc. global workforce. As Albertsons' first significant strategic investment in India, it serves as a collaborative hub, supporting Albertsons in driving innovation and efficiency across Technology, Digital, and other key business functions. The employees at the India GCC will play a pivotal role in enhancing the company's digital transformation, customer engagement, and operational excellence. 

We are excited to announce an opening for Sr. Manager, AIDLC at ACI. Please find below the details of the role and its responsibilities. 

Roles & Responsibilities

- Own the AIDLC (AI-driven development lifecycle) workstream end to end: roadmap, delivery and outcomes. You report to the AI First head. 
 - Lead a pod of engineers who build agents across the software development lifecycle: requirements and design, code review before merge, security-finding remediation, test generation, release and path to production, and SRE and incident support. 
 - Stay hands-on for roughly a quarter of your time. Write code, build prototypes and review agent pull requests, so you judge agent designs and eval results first hand. 
 - Build the organization: define roles and levels, hire and onboard engineers, coach them, and set engineering standards for AI-authored and AI-assisted code. 
 - Set the technical direction for agent architecture: orchestration, tool and function calling, MCP servers (including code knowledge graphs exposed over MCP), memory and state management, context engineering and RAG over engineering knowledge. 
 - Make evals a release gate. Every agent, prompt and model change passes golden datasets, LLM-as-judge scoring calibrated against human review, and regression suites before it ships. Require tracing and observability for agents in production. 
 - Define outcome metrics and measure them against the pre-agent baseline: delivery speed and cost, defects, security findings, cycle time and change failure rate. Report outcomes, not login counts or seat usage. 
 - Drive adoption and change management: run pilots with engineering teams, collect feedback, change how teams work, and retire agents that do not earn their place. 
 - Set governance and guardrails for agents that touch source control, CI/CD and cloud: least-privilege tool access, prompt-injection defence, human approval points, and an action trail that can be reviewed and reversed. 
 - Govern multi-agent systems: trust boundaries between agents, rules for delegation, an audit trail across agent handoffs, and the points where a human must approve. 
 - Govern token and compute cost: budgets, model routing, cost per successful outcome, and usage reporting to leadership. 
 - Run vendor and build-vs-buy evaluations for agent platforms, models and tooling, including multi-model support, with clear criteria. 
 - Use agentic coding tools every day (e. g. Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor) and set norms for how the pod and its partner teams use them. 
 - Partner with Security, Cloud, Data, Product, Enterprise Architecture and the AI governance group so agents fit existing toolchains and meet security, legal, risk and compliance standards. 
 - Run agents in production: reliability targets, observability, incident response and a named owner for every agent. 

Experience Required

- AI experience is a MUST. You have personally built and deployed an LLM agent or agentic workflow used by real users in the last 2 years, with evals and tracing in place. Describe it in your application or link a repo or demo. 
 - 12-15 years of software engineering experience, including 4+ years leading engineering teams: hiring, performance management and delivery accountability. 
 - Hands-on programming in Python, Java or TypeScript, used to build agents and the services around them. The agents work on Java/Spring and React/Angular codebases. 
 - Working depth in agent orchestration, tool/function calling, MCP, memory and state management, context engineering and RAG. You can review a multi-agent design and say where it will fail. Frameworks are examples only (e. g. LangGraph, LangChain/LangSmith, Claude Agent SDK, OpenAI Agents SDK, Google ADK). 
 - Experience running evals in practice: golden datasets, LLM-as-judge, regression testing, and using the results to block or approve a release. 
 - Experience with tracing and observability for LLM applications, and with guardrails, prompt-injection defence and human-in-the-loop design. 
 - Everyday use of agentic coding tools (e. g. Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor) in your own work, not only as a sponsor of them. 
 - Experience owning an adoption program with measured outcomes (cycle time, change failure rate, defects, cost) rather than usage counts. 
 - Experience managing LLM cost: token budgets, model selection and routing, and scaling agent workloads. 
 - Experience evaluating vendors and making build-vs-buy decisions for AI platforms. 
 - Cloud experience on Azure and/or Google Cloud Platform. 
 - Strong communication with senior leadership, engineering teams and risk partners. 
 - A plus: agent-to-agent (A2A) protocol, code knowledge graphs or GraphRAG, building internal developer platforms. 

Competencies

- Compassionate and kind, showing courtesy, dignity, and respect. They show sincere interest and empathy for all others. 
 - Foster innovation through creativity to get to a workable solution. Use analytical thinking through issues using logic and reason
 - Show integrity in what is done and how it is done - without sacrificing personal/business ethics. 
 - Embrace an inclusion-focused mindset, seeking input from others on their work and encouraging the open expression of diverse ideas and opinions
 - Team-oriented, positively contributing to team morale and willing to help. 
 - Learning-Focused, finding ways to improve in their field and use positive constructive feedback to grow personally and professionally
 - Think strategically and proactively anticipate future problems, needs or changes in the work
 - Delighting our customers and maintaining customer relationships are top priority and they work to always deliver solutions through this lens
 - Ability to learn newer technologies, methodologies, and solutions in the cloud technology space. 
 - Ability to collaborate across organizational boundaries, build relationships, and achieve broader organizational goals. 

Skills Required

- Agentic AI and Multi-Agent Systems: design review and governance
 - Agent Evals, Tracing and Observability
 - MCP, Memory and State Management, Context Engineering, RAG
 - Python / Java / TypeScript (hands-on)
 - Cloud Platform Experience (Azure and/or Google Cloud)
 - Engineering Leadership, Hiring and Change Management
 - AI Governance, Guardrails, Token and Compute Cost Management

Principal Engineer - Operations, Reliability & AI Platforms (R3)

About The Role

As a Principal Engineer - Operations, Reliability & AI Platforms, you will provide technical leadership for enterprise-scale production systems, cloud platforms, and AI-powered applications. You will drive reliability, operational excellence, observability, automation, and resiliency across multiple products and platforms while serving as a trusted engineering leader for critical business services. 

This role combines deep technical expertise, architectural leadership, operational ownership, and strategic thinking. You will partner with Engineering, Product, Platform, Security, and Operations teams to establish reliability standards, eliminate operational toil through automation, improve system resilience, and ensure mission-critical services operate securely and efficiently at scale. 

What You'll Be Doing

Technical Leadership & Strategy

- Define and drive the operational engineering strategy for enterprise applications, cloud-native platforms, and AI-enabled systems. 
 - Establish standards for reliability, scalability, availability, performance, security, and operational excellence. 
 - Lead architecture reviews with a focus on supportability, observability, resiliency, disaster recovery, and long-term sustainability.

Automation & Operational Excellence

 - Drive adoption of platform engineering principles to improve reliability, developer productivity, and operational efficiency. 

Collaboration & Mentorship

 - Communicate technical risks, operational health, and strategic recommendations to both technical and executive stakeholders. 
 - Lead cross-functional initiatives that improve reliability, resilience, supportability, and operational maturity across the organisation. 

How You Will Succeed
