data.description:
Tech Specialist, Cloud Engineering

Primary Skills

- AWS, CloudWatch

Job requirements

- We're looking for a Senior Site Reliability Engineer to take ownership of reliability, performance, and operational excellence across our cloud infrastructure and Kubernetes platforms. You'll lead the response to complex, high-severity incidents, raise the bar on automation and observability, and mentor other engineers as the team scales. 
 - Lead troubleshooting and resolution of complex, high-severity incidents across AWS infrastructure and Amazon EKS clusters, often serving as incident commander for major incidents. 
 - Design and build Python-based automation frameworks and tooling that eliminate manual toil and improve reliability at scale, not just one-off scripts. 
 - Architect and maintain Terraform-based infrastructure-as-code, establishing reusable, secure, and scalable patterns across AWS environments. 
 - Drive observability strategy - design Grafana dashboards and alerting frameworks that surface the right signals to the right teams at the right time. 
 - Use SQL and CloudWatch Logs Insights to perform deep root-cause analysis on complex, cross-service incidents. 
 - Own end-to-end ITSM processes - Incident Management and Problem Management - including root cause analysis, post-incident reviews, and long-term remediation plans. 
 - Mentor junior and mid-level SREs, reviewing their troubleshooting approach, automation, and incident handling. 
 - Partner with engineering, product, and leadership teams to communicate incident impact, risk, and remediation plans clearly and confidently. 
 - Design and build self-healing automation and runbooks that detect known failure patterns and trigger remediation automatically, reducing manual intervention and recovery time for recurring incidents. 
 - Implement and maintain monitoring across multiple regions to ensure consistent visibility into system health, latency, and failover readiness across all deployment zones. 
 - Proactively identify potential failure points and performance bottlenecks before they impact production and reduce operational workload by automating recurring manual tasks. 
 - Participate in and provide senior-level escalation support for on-call rotations. What We're Looking For
 - 8 to 10 years of experience in Site Reliability Engineering, DevOps, or Cloud Infrastructure roles, with a track record of owning reliability for production-critical systems. 
 - Deep, hands-on expertise with core and advanced AWS services (EC2, VPC, IAM, S3, RDS, CloudWatch, networking, etc. ). 
 - Proven expertise troubleshooting complex Amazon EKS issues - cluster-level failures, networking, autoscaling, performance bottlenecks, and upgrade-related issues. 
 - Strong proficiency in Python for building automation frameworks, internal tooling, and operational systems. 
 - Extensive experience designing and maintaining Terraform modules and infrastructure patterns at scale. 
 - Strong command of ITSM frameworks, with hands-on ownership of Incident and Problem Management for high-severity issues. 
 - Advanced skills querying and analyzing data via SQL and AWS CloudWatch Logs Insights to drive root-cause analysis. 
 - Proven experience designing Grafana dashboards and alerting strategies that scale across multiple teams and services. 
 - Exceptional verbal and written communication skills - able to clearly articulate technical issues, risk, and remediation plans to engineering leadership and non-technical stakeholders alike. 
 - Experience mentoring or leading other engineers and contributing to team-level reliability strategy. Mandatory Certifications
 - AWS Certification - required (e. g. , AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Professional, AWS Certified DevOps Engineer - Professional, or equivalent). 
 - Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA) or equivalent EKS/Kubernetes certification - required.

data.description:
Job Description

We have an exciting and rewarding opportunity for you to take your software engineering career to the next level. 

As a Software Engineer III at JPMorganChase within the Consumer & Community Banking , you serve as a seasoned member of an agile team to ensure trusted market-leading technology products are delivered with high quality in a secure, stable, and scalable way. You are responsible for driving quality engineering practices across multiple technical areas within various business functions in support of the firm's business objectives. 

Job Responsibilities

- Executes quality engineering solutions including API and data-side test design, automation development, and technical troubleshooting across public cloud and on-premises environments, with the ability to think beyond routine approaches to validate complex integrations and break down end-to-end defects
 - Creates secure and high-quality automated API and data validation tests, and maintains reliable test frameworks, utilities, and test data pipelines that run synchronously with appropriate systems (CI/CD, services, databases, and cloud/on-prem platforms)
 - Leverages enterprise-authorized AI coding assist tools within the work environment to improve code quality, delivery speed, and productivity across complex deliverables (e. g. , code generation/refactoring, unit test creation, documentation), while validating outputs through peer review, automated testing, and secure coding standards; contributes learnings and reusable patterns to improve broader team effectiveness. 
 - Applies knowledge of tools within the Software Development Life Cycle toolchain, including enterprise-authorized AI-assisted development and automation capabilities, to improve the value realized by automation. 
 - Produces test architecture and quality design artifacts for complex applications (e. g. , test strategy, automation architecture, service/API contract validation approach, environment and test data design) while being accountable for ensuring quality constraints and non-functional requirements are met through effective validation and automation
 - Gathers, analyzes, synthesizes, and develops visualizations and reporting from large, diverse quality and operational data sets (e. g. , test execution results, defect trends, coverage, performance metrics, production signals) in service of continuous improvement of software quality, reliability, and delivery outcomes
 - Proactively identifies hidden problems and patterns in defects, test results, and data flows and uses these insights to drive improvements to test coverage, automation stability, data integrity checks, and system architecture in partnership with engineering teams

Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills

- A. Formal training or certification on quality/software engineering concepts and 6+ years applied experience in Quality Engineering / Software Testing
 - Hands-on practical experience in test strategy and test automation for distributed systems, including API testing and data validation, with strong exposure to operational stability/production support across public cloud and on-premises environments
 - Experience developing, debugging, and maintaining test automation and supporting utilities in a large corporate environment using one or more modern programming languages and database querying languages (SQL)
 - Hands-on experience using enterprise-authorized AI-assisted software development tools within the work environment (e. g. , for coding, test creation, troubleshooting, or documentation) with demonstrated ability to critically evaluate, validate, and refine AI-generated outputs for correctness, performance, and security. 
 - Understanding of responsible AI use in engineering workflows, including data sensitivity considerations, secure handling of inputs/outputs, and adherence to resiliency and security expectations; ability to guide peers on safe and effective usage within team practices. 
 - Overall knowledge of the Software Development Life Cycle and Software Testing Life Cycle, with the ability to embed quality practices throughout design, build, test, and release phases

data.title: Senior Flight Platform Software Engineer
data.description:
ReOrbit is looking for a Senior Flight Platform Software Engineer to join the ReOrbit team and support the software campaigns for our current satellite product lines UKKO, SILTA and future missions. 

It's an exciting chance to join a dynamic start-up, with the opportunity to make a real impact, to reach our goal of pushing the boundaries of space data transfer. 

Responsibilities

- Perform the speciation, design, implementation, build and verification of Mission Critical Flight Platform Software aligned with ReOrbit's software‐defined satellite philosophy. 
 - Perform thorough code reviews and contribute to architectural and design decision‐making of software. 
 - Contribute and support tool and infrastructure development and the engineering process evolution of the software team. 
 - Support mentorship of junior engineers, enhancing technical growth and capability within the team. 
 - Be able to communicate effectively with systems and test teams to troubleshoot defects and accelerate software integration. 

Skills And Requirements

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a related field
 - Minimum of 10 years of professional experience in embedded systems, distributed systems, or mission‐critical software
 - Strong proficiency in C/C++ for embedded or real-time software, with solid software-design fundamentals including data structures, concurrency, and debugging
 - Demonstrated expertise in core software engineering practices, including system architecture, code reviews, static analysis, CI/CD pipelines, configuration management, and observability/logging
 - Solid knowledge of real-time systems, including scheduling, interrupts, concurrency, determinism, and efficient design for limited compute and memory resources
 - Experience with spacecraft software, satellite operations, or aerospace systems
 - Understanding of networking protocols, inter-process communication, or distributed autonomy
 - Experience with security-focused software development for mission-critical systems

Working at ReOrbit

At ReOrbit, we are focused on building a strong team as we believe nothing can be accomplished without innovative, humble and curious minds working together on a common goal. We're all about fostering an inclusive, dynamic environment where equality and diversity are our strength. 

We offer

- Challenging but rewarding environment you will thrive if you are always reflecting on how to make things better. Your ideas will be heard. 
 - Ambitious and supportive network of people, who are motivated to change the space industry, bringing expertise from both classic and new space. And most importantly a possibility to be a part of a unique and diverse team, connected by similar mindset and sense of humor. 

What does ReOrbit do?

ReOrbit builds the foundation for the next generation of space applications by transforming satellites into truly intelligent, interconnected platforms, defined by software. Our satellite design philosophy revolves around the idea that satellites must network, communicate with each other and thus improve mission efficiency. How can this be achieved? Thanks to a flexible software-first architecture, where all these aspects are dealt with upfront in the mission concept, as integrated functionalities. 

ReOrbit's top-notch team of software engineers and system architects develop in-house software, procure hardware from the best-in-class suppliers, and seamlessly integrate the components to create flexible and secure satellites. Today, we are a rapidly growing company building a very strong multidisciplinary team to support our activities. We are headquartered in Helsinki, Finland with a subsidiary in Bariloche, Argentina. 

Working at ReOrbit

At ReOrbit, we are focused on building a strong team as we believe nothing can be accomplished without innovative, humble and curious minds working together on a common goal. We're all about fostering an inclusive, dynamic environment where equality and diversity are our strength. 

We offer

 - Benefits such as lunch vouchers, events, parties, occupational health care and additional health insurance - but most importantly a possibility to be a part of a unique and diverse team, connected by similar mindset and sense of humor.

data.title: Staff Frontend Engineer (Product UI and Design)
data.description:
About Lexsi Labs

Lexsi Labs is a frontier AI lab working toward aligned, interpretable and safe superintelligent systems. Our near-term mission is to build safety-aware autonomous systems for mission-critical settings such as banking, insurance, government and healthcare. We believe the institutions that deploy AI should be able to audit, correct and own the risk of the models they rely on, and we build the research and the platform that make that possible. 

Our research spans AI alignment methodologies, interpretability-led system design, and foundation model research across language, structured and tabular data, and autonomous systems. We have published 25+ papers in the past 15 months across conferences including ICLR, ICML, WWW, IJCNN, MICCAI and EurIPS. Our labs are in India (Mumbai and remote), Paris and London. 

We operate with a flat structure, high autonomy, and a strong bias toward engineers who take full ownership of what they build, from architecture to production behaviour. 

About the Role

We are building the platform through which institutions own the AI they depend on. Post-training, alignment, evaluation, deployment and monitoring run inside the customer's own environment, on the methods our labs publish. 

The people using it vary widely. Post-training scientists and AI researchers run experiments at the edge of what current methods can do. AI and ML engineers take models and agents into production. Data scientists build and validate models on enterprise data. Platform and infrastructure teams operate the compute and services underneath. Inside banks, insurers and public institutions, model risk, validation and audit teams need to understand and sign off on results without writing code, and business owners need to see what is running and how it is performing. The same screen often has to serve a researcher and a risk reviewer. 

The interface decides whether frontier model science stays in research papers or becomes something every institution can operate. 

This is a hands-on individual contributor role. You will write production React and TypeScript most of the week, own the frontend architecture of the platform, and make the final call on its flows, information architecture and visual design. You will work with a product designer and one or two frontend engineers, setting the standard through code and review rather than management. Expect roughly 70% of your time on building and 30% on design decisions, review and direction. 

What you'll work on

- Own the frontend architecture of a large React and TypeScript application: routing and layout, code splitting, state boundaries, and the contracts between the UI and backend services. 
 - Own the component library and design tokens as a single system used across the application, evolving it incrementally in a live codebase without pausing feature work. 
 - Design and build data-dense interfaces: virtualised tables over large result sets, live metrics and log streams, trace and graph visualisations, side-by-side comparisons, and code and configuration editors. 
 - Build a real-time data layer over SSE and WebSockets with reconnection, backpressure and cache semantics that stay consistent with request-response queries. 
 - Build schema-driven form systems for deeply nested, conditional configuration, validated against backend schemas. 
 - Design interfaces that work for users with very different levels of technical depth, from researchers to risk reviewers, without splitting the product in two. 
 - Make the final call on information architecture, interaction and visual design, and take your decisions from Figma to production yourself. 
 - Set and enforce performance budgets: render profiling, bundle size, and interaction latency on locked-down enterprise machines. 
 - Ship builds that run in restricted and fully offline networks, with reproducible builds, self-hosted assets and no runtime dependence on external hosts. 
 - Meet enterprise requirements in the UI: SSO, role-aware interfaces, auditability, accessibility, and internationalisation including right-to-left layouts. 
 - Raise the engineering bar across the frontend: type safety, testing strategy, tooling and code review. 
 - Work directly with researchers and platform engineers to turn new methods into usable product, often before the method has settled. 

You may be a good fit if you have

- 8+ years building production web applications, including several years as the technical lead on a complex product UI. 
 - Expert-level TypeScript and React, including React 19 rendering and concurrency behaviour and hands-on performance profiling. 
 - Owned the architecture of a large frontend codebase and improved it materially while the team kept shipping. 
 - Led an incremental migration in a live application, such as a component library, state management approach, router or build system. 
 - Built interfaces where performance was the hard problem: tens of thousands of rows, high-frequency streaming updates, large JSON or log payloads, or complex interactive charts. 
 - Deep, practical experience with TanStack Query or equivalent, Tailwind CSS, React Hook Form with Zod, Vite and pnpm. 
 - Built or maintained a design system with tokens, theming, accessibility to WCAG standards and documentation in Storybook. 
 - Designed and shipped product yourself, with a portfolio that shows both the decisions you made and the code that implemented them. 
 - Built for multiple user types with different expertise in the same product, and made it work for each of them. 
 - A testing discipline built on Vitest or Jest, Playwright and API mocking. 
 - Worked without a product manager or a full spec, decided what to build, and defended the decision with evidence. 
 - Clear written and verbal communication of trade-offs to engineers, researchers and leadership. 

Strong candidates may also have

- Built developer tools or ML tooling, such as experiment tracking, training dashboards, evaluation or observability products. 
 - Visualisation depth with ECharts, D3, or canvas and WebGL rendering. 
 - Built graph or trace viewers (React Flow or similar) and embedded code editors (CodeMirror or Monaco). 
 - Shipped software into on-premise, regulated or air-gapped environments. 
 - Built right-to-left and multi-locale products. 
 - Used state machines such as XState for complex multi-step flows. 
 - Instrumented frontends with OpenTelemetry and web vitals. 
 - Shipped LLM-powered product features. 
 - Contributed to open-source frontend libraries. 

If you meet most of this but not all, we would still like to hear from you. 

What this role is not

- Not a people management role at the start. There are no direct reports, and influence comes through code, review and design decisions. 
 - Not a visual design role. You will design, but you will be measured on what ships to production. 
 - Not a ticket-implementation role. You will be expected to question specs and decide what should be built. 

What we expect in the first six months

- Own a set of redesigned core flows end to end, from information architecture through to production. 
 - Establish the component system and tokens as the single source of truth for the application. 
 - Set performance budgets for the heaviest views and bring them within budget. 
 - Put test coverage in place across the core flows. 

How we will evaluate

- A review of shipped work where you can show both the design decisions and the code. 
 - A build exercise on a data-dense screen, assessed on code quality, structure and performance. 
 - A design critique of a flow in our product, where you decide what changes and why. 
 - An architecture conversation on component systems, data and streaming layers, and offline deployment.

ReOrbit is looking for a Senior Ground Software Engineer to join the ReOrbit team and support the software campaigns for our current satellite product lines UKKO, SILTA and future missions. 

It's an exciting chance to join a dynamic start-up, with the opportunity to make a real impact, to reach our goal of pushing the boundaries of space data transfer. 

Responsibilities

- Design, develop, test and maintain robust ground software systems for satellite communications, spacecraft database and mission operations
 - Participate in the work of all stages in the software development process

 - Deliver technical documents and estimates for proposals and reviews

- Minimum of 10 years of professional experience in developing complex software tools

ReOrbit builds the foundation for the next generation of space applications by transforming satellites into truly intelligent, interconnected platforms, defined by software. Our satellite design philosophy revolves around the idea that satellites must network, communicate with each other and thus improve mission efficiency. How can this be achieved? Thanks to a flexible software-first architecture, where all these aspects are dealt with upfront in the mission concept, as integrated functionalities. 

ReOrbit's top-notch team of software engineers and system architects develop in-house software, procure hardware from the best-in-class suppliers, and seamlessly integrate the components to create flexible and secure satellites. Today, we are a rapidly growing company building a very strong multidisciplinary team to support our activities. We are headquartered in Helsinki, Finland with a subsidiaries in Bristol, UK and Bariloche, Argentina. 

Working at ReOrbit

At ReOrbit, we are focused on building a strong team as we believe nothing can be accomplished without innovative, humble and curious minds working together on a common goal. We're all about fostering an inclusive, dynamic environment where equality and diversity are our strength. 

We offer

- Challenging but rewarding environment - you will thrive if you are always reflecting on how to make things better. Your ideas will be heard.

data.title: Senior Principal - Platform Engineer LAN
data.description:
Business Introduction

GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems. 

Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines. 

Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges. 

Job Purpose

The Principal Engineer builds and runs GSK's local area network and campus switching platform as automated, secure, self-service infrastructure, sets the engineering standard within that platform, mentors the engineers around them, and treats the teams who consume the platform as customers. The role works through infrastructure-as-code and golden paths rather than manual configuration, uses AI-assisted engineering across code generation, review and testing, and engineers reliability in by defining SLOs, instrumenting for observability and automating away toil. 

This is the senior hands-on engineering role in the platform team, working across local area network and campus switching to integrate and assure delivery as well as building. Engineering roadmap and direction sit with the Engineering Director, reference architecture and standards sit with the Platform Architect, backlog order sits with the Product Owner, and deep reliability engineering sits with the Site Reliability Engineer deployed from Reliability Engineering & Operations. 

Key Responsibilities

- Design, build and automate platform infrastructure using infrastructure-as-code and golden paths, so that provisioning is repeatable rather than reconstructed each time. 
 - Use AI-assisted engineering across code generation, review and testing to accelerate delivery and raise quality, reviewing AI-generated output before it is merged. 
 - Build self-service capabilities and paved roads that reduce friction for consuming teams, so adoption does not depend on the platform team's availability. 
 - Engineer for reliability by defining SLOs, instrumenting platforms for observability and automating to reduce toil, working with the Site Reliability Engineer on standards. 
 - Set and uphold engineering standards, secure-by-default practices and code quality within the platform, and hold them in code review. 
 - Contribute to incident response and drive permanent automated fixes with Reliability Engineering rather than repeating manual recovery. 
 - Mentor and technically lead other engineers, including partner engineers, linking engineering work to platform OKRs and outcomes. 
 - Integrate and assure supplier or managed-service components, holding partner-delivered engineering to the same standards and code quality as internal work. 
 - Work the platform's manual task and toil backlog, converting identified candidates into automation and evidencing the effort removed. 
 - Close observability coverage gaps for the platform, so that reliability can be measured rather than inferred. 
 - Contribute engineering-led items to the platform backlog held by the Product Owner, including technical debt, upgrade and automation work, with the cost of not doing them stated. 
 - Apply the reference architectures and patterns set by the Platform Architect, and raise a case for change rather than diverging locally. 

Key Relationships/Customers

Business Stakeholders

- Internal GSK teams consuming the platform as customers of its self-service capability
 - Quality and compliance functions where the platform supports GxP activity

Tech Stakeholders

- Engineering Director as line manager and owner of the engineering roadmap
 - Platform Architect for reference architectures, patterns and standards
 - Product Owner for backlog order and acceptance of engineering-led items
 - Site Reliability Engineer and Reliability Engineering & Operations for SLOs, observability and incident prevention
 - Other Principal Engineers and platform engineers across the domain

Other

- Managed service partners contributing engineering capacity to the platform. 
 - Technology vendors during evaluation and proof of concept

Professional Qualifications

- Degree in a technology or engineering discipline, or equivalent practical experience (e. g. , Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electronics). 
 - Relevant technical certifications desirable (e. g. , a recognised cloud certification for AWS, GCP or Azure, Certified Kubernetes Administrator, or a network vendor certification relevant to the platform). 

Area of Specialisation

- Hands-on platform engineering in cloud, network or digital workplace, covering infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD and containers where relevant. 
 - Automation-first and secure-by-default engineering, with an SRE mindset covering SLOs, observability and toil reduction. 

Why is this level of Education Required?

- Deep engineering credentials are needed because the role sets the engineering standard other engineers and partner teams build to, and that standard has to hold under code review rather than by assertion. 

Experience Required

- Overall 15 years typically 6-8 years in platform, infrastructure or software engineering, including at least two years as the senior technical voice in a team. 
 - Deep hands-on depth in the relevant platform domain, whether cloud and hosting, network or digital workplace. 
 - Practical experience of infrastructure-as-code, for example Terraform, applied to production estates rather than proofs of concept. 
 - Experience with CI/CD pipelines, and with containers and Kubernetes where relevant to the platform. 
 - Track record building self-service capability that other teams adopted without hand-holding. 
 - Experience instrumenting for observability, defining SLOs and reducing toil through automation. 
 - Experience with AI-assisted engineering tooling, including judgement about when generated output is not fit to merge. 
 - Extensive experience engineering enterprise local area networks and campus switching services. 
 - Strong knowledge of routing, switching, segmentation, resilience and complex fault diagnosis. 
 - Evidence of applying standards and automation to improve deployment quality, reliability or supportability. 

Desirable Requirements

- Professional level enterprise networking certification, such as CCNP Enterprise or JNCIP Enterprise Routing and Switching. 
 - Experience with application programming interfaces, infrastructure as code or network assurance platforms. 
 - Experience supporting manufacturing, laboratory or operational technology networks. 

Skills/Background

- Automation-first instinct, treating a repeated manual task as a defect rather than as work. 
 - Code review discipline, holding quality without becoming a bottleneck. 
 - Mentoring ability with engineers of varying experience, including partner engineers outside the line. 
 - Judgement about when AI-generated code is fit to merge and when it is not. 
 - Customer mindset toward consuming teams, who can route around a platform that is hard to use. 
 - Willingness to make technical debt and its cost visible rather than absorbing it silently.

Enterprise Systems is the backbone of GSK's internal operations in Digital & Tech, enabling GSK Global Functions teams such as Finance, Procurement, HR, Legal, Compliance, WREF, CGA and Corporate Secretariat to run seamlessly. Partnering closely with HR business teams, we create solutions that simplify processes, enhance employee engagement, and enable strategic workforce planning. If you're passionate about technology that empowers people, this is where you can make an impact. 

Job Purpose: 

The QA & Release Senior Manager is responsible for supporting quality assurance practices and coordinating release management activities across the HR Digital & Technology product portfolio. Working across all HR products, the role ensures that changes are tested to a consistent standard, release readiness criteria are met, and releases are coordinated and communicated effectively across product teams and stakeholders. The role supports the delivery of reliable, secure, and compliant changes by embedding quality activities throughout the delivery lifecycle and maintaining visibility of upcoming releases across the portfolio. Working closely with Product Owners, delivery teams, and service teams, the QA & Release Senior Manager helps ensure that quality is designed-in from refinement through to post-go-live, while supporting a structured and well-governed release process that protects service stability and business outcomes. 

This role operates under GSK's "Performance with Choice" hybrid working approach, typically expecting 2-3 days per week in the office, with the specific pattern agreed between the successful candidate and their manager based on role and team needs. 

Key Responsibilities: 

Quality Assurance

- Support the implementation of QA standards and test approaches across the HR product portfolio, ensuring functional, regression, integration, and user acceptance testing is carried out consistently across product teams. 
 - Work with Product Owners and delivery teams to define acceptance criteria, test coverage expectations, and quality gates, ensuring requirements are testable and supported by clear pass/fail criteria. 
 - Execute and coordinate test activities across product teams, including functional testing, regression testing, integration testing, and supporting user acceptance testing, ensuring defects are clearly documented and triaged. 
 - Apply risk-based testing approaches to prioritise effort across critical services, high-transaction workflows, regulated processes, and cross-product integrations, escalating quality risks to senior stakeholders where required. 
 - Support the adoption and maintenance of test automation, contributing to automated regression, API testing, and data integrity checks, and ensuring test scripts are maintained and reusable across releases. 
 - Ensure non-functional requirements (performance, security, accessibility, operability) are clearly defined and tested prior to release, partnering with Security, Risk, and Compliance teams where required. 
 - Manage defect lifecycle processes, ensuring issues are logged, triaged, prioritised, and tracked through to resolution, and that defect trends are analysed to inform continuous improvement. 

Release Management

- Maintain and coordinate the release calendar across the HR product portfolio, ensuring all product teams have visibility of upcoming releases, dependencies, and sequencing. 
 - Support release readiness assessments by coordinating release checklists, confirming test completion, gathering signoffs, and ensuring documentation (release notes, runbooks, rollback plans) is complete and accurate prior to deployment. 
 - Coordinate release communications across product teams, business stakeholders, and Service Operations, ensuring impacted parties are informed of release scope, timing, and any known risks or workarounds. 
 - Support change control processes, ensuring releases follow required governance and approval workflows and that evidence of testing, risk assessment, and stakeholder sign-off is documented and auditable. 
 - Support go-live and hypercare activities, monitoring for release-related incidents, coordinating triage across product teams, and ensuring issues are escalated and resolved in a timely manner. 
 - Documents and tracks release outcomes and contribute to post-release reviews, capturing lessons learned, analysing release success rates, and identifying opportunities to improve release processes and reduce release-related incidents.

data.title: Site Reliability Engineer – GenAI / AI Platforms
data.description:
Who are we?

Equinix is the world's digital infrastructure company®, shortening the path to connectivity to enable the innovations that enrich our work, life and planet. 

A place where bold ideas are welcomed, human connection is valued, and everyone has the opportunity to shape their future. 

Help us challenge assumptions, uncover bias, and remove barriers-because progress starts with fresh ideas. You'll find belonging, purpose, and a team that welcomes you-because when you feel valued, you're empowered to do your best work. 

Job Summary

Keeps Equinix's GenAI products and platforms stable and reliable, and makes them more resilient over time. Writes the code and automation that prevents failures, rather than only responding to them. Defines service-level objectives, builds monitoring and alerting, hardens services against dependency and capacity failures, and tests failure and recovery before they happen in production. Leads incident response when issues occur and turns each incident into a lasting fix. Works in a team with senior engineers and with product, platform and security partners to keep AI products, agents, connectors and self-hosted models robust, secure, observable and performant. 

Knowledge and Application

Applies solid knowledge of software engineering and site reliability engineering (SRE) practice: service-level objectives (SLOs), error budgets, monitoring, alerting, incident response, CI/CD and infrastructure as code. Understands how distributed systems fail and how to contain those failures (timeouts, retries, circuit breakers, graceful degradation). Understands how GenAI products behave in production, including model latency, rate limits, quotas, streaming and token cost. Follows established standards and suggests improvements. 

Complexity and Problem Solving

Works on problems of defined scope where analysis requires evaluation of identifiable factors. Diagnoses failures across application, model, data, pipeline and infrastructure layers, and fixes the underlying cause rather than the symptom. Applies existing runbooks and approaches, and improves them. Escalates unusual or high-impact issues. Work is reviewed at defined checkpoints. 

Collaboration and Interaction

Works with AI engineers, product managers, platform and security teams. Reviews designs and releases for reliability risk before they ship. Explains status, incidents and results clearly to partners who are not familiar with the subject. Asks for guidance early and shares knowledge with the team. 

Responsibilities

Reliability and resilience engineering (primary focus)

- Write code and automation that makes GenAI products and platforms more resilient: retries, timeouts, circuit breakers, rate limiting, graceful degradation and fallback between models and providers
 - Run load tests, failure-injection tests and game days to find weak points before users do, and fix what they reveal
 - Harden services running on Kubernetes: health checks, autoscaling, disruption budgets, resource limits and multi-zone deployment
 - Plan capacity ahead of launches and growth, including model-provider quotas, GPU and inference capacity, and database headroom
 - Maintain backup, restore and disaster-recovery plans, and test recovery on a regular schedule
 - Automate repeated operational tasks, and reduce manual work each quarter

Monitoring and service levels

- Define and track service-level indicators and objectives with product owners: availability, latency, error rate, token cost and quality scores
 - Instrument services with logs, metrics and traces (e. g. , OpenTelemetry), from the user request through agent, tool and model calls
 - Build and tune dashboards and alerts for user-facing failures, and remove alerts that are noisy or not actionable

Release and deployment

- Support release readiness for GenAI products and platforms: checks for monitoring, alerts, runbooks, capacity, security review and rollback plan
 - Deploy through CI/CD and GitOps pipelines, using containers and infrastructure as code, with canary rollouts and fast rollback

Incident response

- Take part in the on-call rotation, respond to incidents, and write blameless post-incident reviews
 - Track post-incident actions to completion, so the same failure does not happen twice
 - Write and update runbooks, and turn recurring incidents into automation or fixes

GenAI and self-hosted models

- Support the reliability of self-hosted open-weight and small language models: serving, GPU usage, scaling, rollout and rollback
 - Monitor model and provider latency, errors, rate limits and cost, and flag capacity and cost risks
 - Apply security, patching, secrets and data-boundary requirements to every deployment

Qualifications

Required

- 2-4 years in site reliability, DevOps, platform or software engineering, with hands-on work on production systems
 - Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering or a related field, or equivalent experience
 - Proficiency in Python or Go, with solid software engineering habits: version control, testing, code review
 - Experience with Linux, containers, Kubernetes and a major cloud platform (Google Cloud preferred)
 - Experience with CI/CD and infrastructure as code (e. g. , Terraform)
 - Working knowledge of monitoring, logging, tracing and alerting
 - Understanding of how distributed systems fail and of common resilience patterns
 - Experience with on-call or incident response, and willingness to join an on-call rotation
 - Familiarity with LLM applications (model APIs, retrieval, agents, tool calls)
 - Clear written and verbal communication

Nice to have

- Experience running GenAI or ML systems in production, including managed model platforms (e. g. , Vertex AI) or model serving (e. g. , vLLM)
 - Experience with observability tools (e. g. , OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana) and incident tools (e. g. , PagerDuty)
 - Experience with GitOps (e. g. , Argo CD), Helm and canary deployments
 - Experience with load testing or chaos engineering
 - Experience with secrets management (e. g. , Vault) and security scanning
 - Experience building automation or AI agents that reduce operational work

What success looks like

- GenAI products and platforms meet their service-level objectives, and releases ship without avoidable incidents
 - Alerts catch failures before users report them, and each incident ends with a documented fix
 - The same incident does not happen twice
 - Load tests and recovery tests run on schedule, and launches scale without capacity issues
 - Manual operational work goes down each quarter
 - The engineer takes on larger, less defined work each quarter with decreasing guidance

data.description:
Job Description

You will be responsible for overseeing tester productivity, yield, and false call rate monitoring, while ensuring on-time resolution of KPI gaps. Supporting tester maintenance, fine-tuning, changeovers, and NPI/mass production validation, you will work with RF testers and test instruments, contributing to continuous improvement efforts and collaborating with local and global teams to address troubleshooting and installation issues. 

How You Will Contribute And What You Will Learn

- You will monitor tester productivity, yield, and false call rates, ensuring KPIs are met and gaps are resolved promptly. 
 - You will provide maintenance support for RF testers and instruments, focusing on 4G/5G technology and achieving optimal performance. 
 - Assist with tester changeovers, including IC programming, module and unit tester requirements, to meet customer demand. 
 - Contribute to spare maintenance and manage critical spare shortages to minimize downtime. 
 - Learn to fine-tune and maintain various RF test platforms, improving tester uptime and reducing false call rates. 
 - You will participate in NPI and mass production tester installations, validation, and production readiness, ensuring all test plans are followed. 
 - Gain hands-on experience in troubleshooting and improving RF tester calibration and performance. 
 - You will enhance teamwork and leadership skills through mentoring shift engineers, driving continuous improvement projects, and supporting global and local teams. 

Key Skills And Experience

You have: 

- Engineering or Diploma with 10 plus years of experience in manufacturing industry. 
 - Familiarity with handling structural equipment, including SPEA FPT, Keysight ICT, and Data IO PSV5000/7000. 
 - Experience in the asset transfer process, including physical inventory, tester validation, packing, and shipping. 
 - Hands-on experience supporting global teams for tester installation and breakdown issues at EMS sites. 
 - Expertise in troubleshooting tester issues, particularly RF filters, TRX PCBA, and radio unit testing. 

It would be nice if you also had: 

- Familiarity with managing and verifying test instrument calibration cycles to ensure proper functionality. 
 - Exposure to prepare weekly and monthly executive summary, MIS reports.

Konovo is a global healthcare intelligence company on a mission to transform research through technology- enabling faster, better, connected insights.

 - Join a fast-growing global team with opportunities for professional growth and advancement. 
 - Build technology that enables faster, smarter healthcare research and improves global patient outcomes. 
 - Enjoy a collaborative and hybrid work environment that fosters innovation and flexibility. 
 - Experience a workplace that puts employees first, offering a workplace designed for growth, well-being, and balance. 
 - Become a part of an organisation that prioritizes your well-being with comprehensive benefits, including group medical coverage, accident insurance, and a robust leave policy. Our employee-centric policies ensure a rewarding and fulfilling work experience. 
 - Make a real-world impact by helping healthcare organisations innovate faster. 

If you're eager to build a meaningful career in healthcare market research and you're smart, nice, and driven to make an impact we'd love to hear from you!

Apply now to be part of our journey.

data.title: Director Software Eng
data.description:
Job Description

The role operates at the intersection of technology strategy, product discovery, domain‐driven design, and engineering execution, driving rapid experimentation, applied innovation, and technical excellence while respecting real‐world operational, security, and regulatory constraints. Success is measured by validated learning, speed‐to‐insight, and successful transition of ideas into core product organizations. The role is expected to be hands-on with 40% time dedicated to Software Development and the rest on the remaining responsibilities. 

Responsibilities

- Own the end‐to‐end lifecycle of idea incubation from problem discovery and hypothesis framing to prototyping, validation, and graduation or termination. 
 - Establish repeatable incubation frameworks using design thinking, Lean Startup, and experiment‐driven development. 
 - Champion a culture of experimentation, learning velocity, and evidence‐based decision‐making in high‐ambiguity environments. 
 - Ensure early‐stage experimentation incorporates domain realities from Buildings, Security, and Industrial contexts, avoiding innovation that cannot transition to real deployments. 

Technical & Architectural Leadership

- Provide technical direction across incubated initiatives, ensuring solutions are scalable, secure, resilient, and production‐ready. 
 - Guide teams in selecting and applying emerging technologies including cloud‐native platforms, SaaS, AI/ML, GenAI, IoT, and edge computing. 
 - Ensure architectural decisions explicitly address non‐functional requirements such as availability, scalability, security, compliance, and operational resilience. 
 - Partner with Architecture and SRE leaders to ensure smooth transition of incubated solutions into enterprise‐scale delivery models and long‐lived product platforms. 

AI SDLC + SW Engineering Skills

End-to-End AI Lifecycle : Data → model → deployment → monitoring

MLOps / LLMOps + CI/CD : Pipelines, versioning, automated deploy & testing

Data & Model Engineering: Data pipelines + LLMs/RAG + model optimization

Software Engineering Fundamentals

- API design, microservices 
 - Clean code, testing 
 - System design

Cloud-native Architecture: Kubernetes, Docker, scalable AI services

Domain‐Driven Engineering Leadership

- Ensure engineering teams deeply understand and design for domain‐specific constraints and requirements, including: 
 - Buildings (commercial buildings, campuses, multi‐site operations, 24×7 uptime expectations) 
 - Security (cybersecurity, privacy, regulatory compliance, secure‐by‐design principles) 
 - Industrial / OT (manufacturing, process industries, legacy systems, safety‐critical environments) 
 - Drive domain‐driven design practices so incubated solutions reflect real operational workflows, asset models, and system boundaries. 
 - Validate that domain requirements are explicitly captured and tested during incubation, not deferred to later product teams. 
Buildings Domain Knowledge

- Has led engineering innovation for software platforms that integrate with Building Management Systems (BMS) such as HVAC, lighting, energy, fire, and life‐safety systems. 
 - Ensure incubated solutions support multi‐site and multi‐tenant building deployments and can scale reliably beyond pilot environments. 
 - Drive interoperability across heterogeneous OT devices, protocols, and vendor ecosystems common in building environments. 
 - Ensure experimentation and pilots account for continuous operations and minimal disruption expectations in live buildings. 

Security & Privacy Knowledge

- Own security‐by‐design and privacy‐by‐design accountability across all incubated software initiatives. 
 - Ensure security requirements align with industrial and OT security standards (e. g. , ANSI/ISA‐62443) and enterprise security policies. 
 - Require and oversee: 
 - Threat modeling and secure architecture reviews 
 - Strong authentication, authorization, and role‐based access control 
 - Secure handling of credentials, secrets, and certificates 
 - Audit logging and traceability for security‐relevant actions 
 - Ensure compliance with data protection and privacy regulations (e. g. , GDPR) and completion of required Privacy Impact Assessments (PIA) prior to graduation of incubated solutions. 
 - Partner closely with Security, Legal, and Compliance teams to ensure incubated ideas are viable in regulated environments. 
Industrial & OT Engineering Knowledge

- Led incubation of software solutions for industrial and OT‐centric environments, including manufacturing, energy, and process industries. 
 - Ensure platforms can integrate with industrial control systems (ICS) such as SCADA, PLCs, edge devices, and legacy systems. 
 - Drive architectures that support deterministic performance, high‐frequency telemetry, and near‐real‐time decision support where required. 
 - Balance innovation speed with production continuity, safety, and reliability expectations in live industrial environments. 
 - Ensure solutions are designed for long asset lifecycles, staged rollouts, and controlled upgrade windows typical of industrial customers. 

Organization & Talent Leadership

- Build, mentor, and retain high‐performing engineering leaders and senior technologists. 
 - Develop engineering managers and tech leads capable of balancing experimentation speed with technical rigor and domain responsibility. 
 - Foster an inclusive, high‐accountability culture emphasizing ownership, craftsmanship, and engineering judgment. 

Business & Stakeholder Partnership

- Collaborate with Product, UX, Data, OT, and Business leaders to align incubated ideas with strategic priorities and domain realities. 
 - Translate technical and domain insights into compelling narratives for senior leadership. 
 - Serve as a trusted advisor on innovation strategy, platform evolution, and technology investment decisions. 

Execution & Governance

- Define success metrics for incubation including validated learning, domain readiness, and transition viability. 
 - Ensure disciplined execution through lightweight governance, clear decision points, and risk transparency. 
 - Own budget, capacity planning, and vendor strategy for innovation initiatives. 

Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field. 
 - 15+ years of software engineering experience with 5+ years in senior engineering leadership roles. 
 - Proven track record leading innovation labs, incubators, or advanced development teams. 
 - Strong technical depth in modern software architectures and distributed systems. 
 - Demonstrated success moving ideas from concept to validated product or scaled platform in complex, real‐world domains. 

Preferred Experience & Skills

- Experience with Buildings, Industrial, SaaS, or platform‐based businesses. 
 - Exposure to OT environments, cybersecurity, or regulated systems. 
 - Experience with AI/ML, GenAI, data platforms, IoT, or edge ecosystems. 
 - Familiarity with Lean Startup and design thinking methodologies. 
 - Exceptional ability to operate under ambiguity and drive clarity through experimentation. 
 - Strong storytelling, influence, and executive communication skills. 

About Us

Honeywell Technologies is a global, pure-play automation company with a legacy of innovating to help solve the world's most mission-critical challenges, enhancing the quality of life for people and communities around the world. We serve the building, industrial and process sectors with a broad portfolio of services, solutions and products, underpinned by our Honeywell Technologies Accelerator operating system and Honeywell Technologies Forge intelligence layer. By combining the deep domain expertise of our more than 50, 000 employees with decades of data from our global installed base, we are uniquely positioned to lead the industrial sector's transition from automation to autonomy.

Hi All, 

Greetings from HCL Tech. 

We are Hiring: Senior STA Full Chip Lead.

We are seeking a highly experienced Clocking/Constraints/STA Lead to join our Physical Design team. Full Chip Static Timing Analysis (STA) Engineer verifies that an entire System-on-Chip (SoC) meets all speed and performance requirements across every operational condition without running full logical simulations

Responsibilities: 

· Lead the development and implementation of comprehensive clocking strategies for high-performance ICs. 

· Define and manage timing constraints throughout the design flow, ensuring accurate and consistent timing analysis. 

· Stay up-to-date with the Perform advanced Static Timing Analysis (STA) using industry-standard tools, identifying potential timing violations and bottlenecks. 

· Develop and maintain robust clock tree synthesis (CTS) methodologies for optimal clock distribution and skew control. 

· Drive the creation and execution of a comprehensive clock domain crossing (CDC) verification plan. 

· Collaborate with design engineers, layout engineers, and other physical design teams to address timing closure challenges. 

· Mentor and coach junior engineers, fostering their growth and expertise in clocking, constraints, and STA. 

· Latest advancements in clocking methodologies, timing analysis tools, and industry best practices. 

· Lead the evaluation and implementation of new tools and methodologies for improved timing closure efficiency. 

· Develop and maintain comprehensive documentation for clocking, constraints, and STA practices within the team. 

Qualifications: 

· Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field (preferred) or Bachelor's degree with extensive experience. 

· Minimum of 15+ years of experience in clocking, constraints, and STA for digital IC design. 

· Understanding of On-Chip Variation (OCV/POCV), clock tree architecture, parasitic extraction (SPEF), and gate-level netlists

· Proven leadership experience in managing and motivating a team of engineers. 

· In-depth knowledge of digital design principles, timing analysis methodologies, and clock tree synthesis techniques. 

· Expert-level proficiency in industry-standard STA tools (e. g. , Synopsys PrimeTime, Mentor Questa Timing Analyzer).

data.title: Team Lead Manager
data.description:
Company: Midson Estates Pvt. Ltd. 
Position: Team Lead Manager - Real Estate Brokerage
Location: Delhi NCR, with travel to project locations
Employment: Full-time
Reporting to: Business Head / Director
Team responsibility: Sales Advisors and assigned Calling / Lead Generation Executives

About Midson Estates

Midson Estates Pvt. Ltd. is developing a research-led real estate brokerage business, drawing on Midson's experience in financial services and real estate investments. Our focus is on identifying differentiated opportunities, understanding client requirements and supporting transactions through disciplined execution. 

Our initial focus includes plots and land, commercial and leased properties, and selected off-market opportunities across North India. 

Role purpose

Build and lead a productive sales team, taking ownership of the complete brokerage sales process-from lead allocation and client engagement to site visits, negotiations, closure and brokerage collection. 

This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who can manage daily sales operations independently, develop advisors and deliver results. The Director will participate in selected strategic relationships and important negotiations; routine execution and follow-through remain the Team Lead Manager's responsibility. 

Key responsibilities

1. Team building and leadership

- Support recruitment, selection and onboarding of sales advisors and callers. 
- Set clear individual targets, responsibilities and daily activity expectations. 
- Conduct daily sales huddles, weekly pipeline reviews and individual coaching. 
- Build a culture of accountability, collaboration, ethical selling and consistent follow-up. 
- Address underperformance through documented improvement plans and recommend retention or replacement decisions. 
- Develop a capable deputy and ensure continuity during absence or team changes. 

2. Lead management and business development

- Allocate leads according to advisor capability, client requirements and workload. 
- Ensure prompt contact, qualification and systematic follow-up of every assigned lead. 
- Develop business through referrals, personal networks, channel partners and approved social media activity. 
- Guide advisors in building their own prospecting pipelines. 
- Coordinate with digital marketing and calling teams on lead quality and conversion feedback. 
- Ensure client requirements, budgets, decision-makers and purchase timelines are recorded accurately. 

3. Client meetings and site visits

- Plan and supervise client meetings, property presentations and site visits. 
- Personally attend meetings and visits where leadership support can advance a transaction. 
- Ensure advisors understand the property, pricing, documentation status and client suitability before presenting it. 
- Coordinate with developers, property owners and channel partners for access, availability and commercial information. 
- Maintain clear next steps after every meeting and visit. 
- Organise field activity efficiently without relying on the Director for routine travel or coordination. 

4. Negotiations, closures and collections

- Take ownership of progressing qualified opportunities towards closure. 
- Support advisors in handling objections and negotiating within approved commercial limits. 
- Obtain approval for discounts, commitments or exceptions outside delegated authority. 
- Coordinate booking documentation and transaction milestones with the relevant teams. 
- Track brokerage eligibility, invoicing requirements, payment milestones and collection follow-ups. 
- Escalate stalled transactions with a clear issue summary and proposed action. 

5. Project and inventory coordination

- Work with research and sourcing teams to understand available opportunities. 
- Maintain current information on inventory, pricing, brokerage terms and project updates. 
- Match properties to the client's objectives rather than pushing unsuitable inventory. 
- Route legal, title, approval and documentation questions to designated specialists. 
- Ensure the sales team uses approved facts and materials and makes no unsupported promises. 

6. CRM, MIS and operating discipline

- Ensure all leads, calls, meetings, site visits, offers and next actions are captured in the company CRM. 
- Maintain accurate sales stages and evidence-based revenue forecasts. 
- Submit a weekly dashboard covering activity, conversion, closures, collections and bottlenecks. 
- Track lead ageing, missed follow-ups and reasons for lost deals. 
- Keep client records and transaction history accessible in company systems. 
- Follow agreed processes for lead ownership, handovers and resolution of internal disputes. 

7. Training and performance development

- Conduct regular product briefings, sales role-plays and objection-handling sessions. 
- Coach advisors on client qualification, investment conversations, follow-up and negotiation. 
- Review successful and lost transactions to improve team capability. 
- Run performance recognition and competitions linked to measurable results and service quality. 
- Help advisors become independently productive. 

8. Commercial and service accountability

- Monitor team revenue, collections and controllable sales expenses. 
- Work within approved budgets and expense policies. 
- Resolve client concerns promptly and coordinate post-booking support. 
- Protect confidential client and company information. 
- Maintain transparent communication and professional conduct throughout the transaction. 

Performance measures

Targets will be agreed based on team size, inventory and the operating plan. Performance will be assessed on: 

- Brokerage revenue generated and collected. 
- Conversion from qualified leads to meetings, site visits and closures. 
- Advisor productivity and time taken for new advisors to become productive. 
- Lead response time, follow-up completion and CRM accuracy. 
- Pipeline quality and forecasting reliability. 
- Sales expenses against approved budgets. 
- Client satisfaction, referrals and complaint resolution. 
- Ability to run the team without repeated intervention from the Director. 

Candidate profile

- Preferably 5-8 years of real estate sales or brokerage experience, including at least 2 years leading a sales team. 
- Demonstrated record of personally closing transactions and delivering team results. 
- Experience recruiting, coaching and managing advisors. 
- Strong client qualification, negotiation and relationship-management skills. 
- Working knowledge of Delhi NCR real estate; exposure to other North Indian markets is desirable. 
- Comfortable using CRM systems, spreadsheets and sales dashboards. 
- Able and willing to travel for client meetings and site visits. 
- Strong communication skills in Hindi and English. 
- Experience with investors, business owners or higher-value transactions will be an advantage. 
- Graduate preferred; proven sales and leadership performance will carry significant weight. 

Personal qualities

We are looking for someone who takes ownership, follows through consistently and communicates problems early. The successful candidate will combine commercial drive with integrity, sound judgment and the ability to develop others. 

First 90 days

Days 1-30: Understand inventory and processes, assess the existing pipeline and team, establish CRM discipline and agree targets. 

Days 31-60: Implement regular prospecting, coaching and site-visit routines; strengthen the qualified pipeline and address capability gaps. 

Days 61-90: Demonstrate measurable progress in conversions and collections, reliable reporting and independent management of daily team operations. 

Compensation and growth

Proposed structure: fixed remuneration plus performance-linked incentives, with final terms based on experience and agreed responsibilities. Travel and expense arrangements will be defined in the employment offer. 

The role offers an opportunity to build a team and progress towards broader branch or business leadership responsibilities as performance and business scale justify.

data.title: Software Architect
data.description:
About Aptiv

Aptiv is a global technology company that develops safer, greener and more connected solutions, which enable the future of mobility. Headquartered in Dublin, Ireland, Aptiv has 160, 000 employees and operates 14 technical centers, as well as manufacturing sites and customer support centers, in 44 countries. Visit aptiv. com

Today, our mission is to shape the world with more safer, greener and more connected solutions that's changing the world. We are dedicated to bring the next generation of autonomous vehicles, smart cities and connectivity to life. 

Help shape the future of mobility. 

Imagine a world with zero vehicle accidents, zero vehicle emissions, and wireless vehicle connectivity all around us. Every day, we move closer to making that world a reality. Aptiv's passionate team of engineers and developers creates advanced safety systems, high-performance electrification solutions and data connectivity solutions so that automakers can bring advanced capabilities to more people around the globe. This is how we enable sustainable mobility and help to prevent accidents caused by human error. 

Software Architect

The Software Architect is responsible for defining, governing, and evolving the software architecture of automotive products and platforms. This role leads to architectural decisions from concept through production, ensuring solutions are scalable, reusable, safe, secure, and aligned with customer, business, and technical requirements. The Software Architect provides technical leadership across cross-functional teams and serves as the key authority for software architecture, quality, and engineering best practices. 

Responsibilities

- Define, document, and maintain software architecture for products and platforms. 
 - Analyze customer, system, safety, cybersecurity, and business requirements and translate them into architectural solutions. 
 - Define software components, interfaces, design patterns, and non-functional requirements (performance, scalability, reliability, timing, and security). 
 - Drive architectural reviews, code reviews, technical assessments, and design decisions. 
 - Ensure compliance with software development standards, coding guidelines, and automotive processes. 
 - Collaborate with Functional Safety and Cybersecurity teams to develop safety and security concepts. 
 - Support software DFMEA, verification activities, and production release readiness. 
 - Work directly with customers, suppliers, and stakeholders to understand requirements and resolve technical issues. 
 - Support Agile development teams during implementation and ensure adherence to architectural intent. 
 - Participate in PI Planning, technical roadmap development, quotation activities, and Proof-of-Concept initiatives. 
 - Mentor engineers and provide technical leadership across globally distributed teams. 
 - Promote Built-In Quality, software reusability, and continuous improvement. 
 - Define and evolve common software platforms, architectural frameworks, runtime environments, and reusable technology building blocks enabling scalability across programs
 - Manage architectural risks and technical debts, support the long-term technology strategy
 - Adoption of AI-assisted architecture practices to improve engineering productivity

Requirements (required): 

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field. 
 - Extensive experience in software development, embedded systems, and software architecture, including the design and delivery of complex software products and platforms. 
 - Proven experience defining and implementing software architecture in complex product development environments. 
 - Experience with embedded systems, microcontrollers, multi-threaded software, and RTOS platforms (Linux, QNX, OSEK, or similar). 
 - Strong knowledge of software architecture, design patterns, software interfaces, and system integration. 
 - Experience with architectural modeling tools (e. g. , Enterprise Architect). 
 - Strong analytical, problem-solving, and technical leadership skills. 
 - Knowledge of automotive communication protocols (CAN, LIN, FlexRay, Ethernet). 
 - Experience in AUTOSAR and/or Service Oriented COM framework: Adaptive AUTOSAR/ROS/ROS2/DDS/SOMEIP
 - Experience in Embedded Software development on ARM Core (A53/A72) and Real time Core based SOC/MCU
 - Familiarity with GPU/NPU/DSP
 - Automotive Knowledge - ADAS / Perception / Parking
 - CICD knowledge and familiarity with Gerrit workflow
 - Experience with requirements management tools such as DOORS or Polarion. 
 - Familiarity with, ASPICE, MISRA, and automotive software development processes. 
 - Knowledge of Functional Safety (ISO 26262) and automotive cybersecurity principles. 
 - Experience with Git, static analysis tools, and software performance profiling. 
 - Understanding of open-source software governance and licensing. 
 - Experience working within Agile/SAFe environments. 
 - Experience working with global, cross-functional development teams. 
 - Strong communication / presentation skills and stakeholder management skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across organizational levels. 
 - Ability to lead technical activities, coordinate development tasks, and provide guidance to team members. 

Why join us?

You grow at Aptiv. 

Aptiv's winning culture is global by design. We bring together diverse perspectives, cultures, and business contexts to solve our customers' toughest challenges. In this environment, every individual can grow, lead, and make an impact, regardless of background, because inclusion fuels how we innovate and win. 

You make an impact at Aptiv. 

One of the strengths of humanity is our drive to progress, to improve, to achieve more tomorrow than we did yesterday. People need solutions they can trust when it matters most. At Aptiv, you are building those solutions every day. 

You have support at Aptiv. 

We ensure you have the resources and support you need to take care of your family, your physical health, and your mental health with a competitive benefits package.

Higher Education Opportunities (UDACITY, UDEMY, COURSERA are available for your continuous growth and development); 

Life and accident insurance; 

Sodexo cards for food and beverages

Well Being Program that includes regular workshops and networking events; 

EAP Employee Assistance;

Progress is never static. It is about reaching further, exploring new possibilities, and enabling mobility. Aptiv empowers customers to create solutions people rely on-advancing safety and autonomy in Automotive and Commercial Vehicles, enabling mission-critical performance in Aerospace & Defense, and powering intelligent systems across Energy, Enterprise, and Telecommunications. data.title: Senior Engineering Manager
data.description:
Join us as we work to create a thriving ecosystem that delivers accessible, high-quality, and sustainable healthcare for all. 

Join athenahealth as Senior Engineering Manager and lead the teams reimagining how healthcare reaches patients. Based in Bangalore, India, in a hybrid role, you will report to the Director of Engineering, Messaging. You'll drive delivery across multiple teams, run complex projects from plan to production, build and grow a high-performing team, and champion engineering excellence in everything we ship. 

Team Summary

athenahealth's messaging platform connects thousands of practices with their patients, delivering millions of messages every day across text, voice, email and the patient portal. We are reimagining it as an intelligent, outcome-driven platform. Instead of sending fixed reminders, it decides the best next step for each patient and measures whether each message actually helped. As a Senior Engineering Manager on this team, you will lead engineers who are building the platform at scale, moving today's experiences onto it, and using AI to make every patient touch count. Your leadership will shape a culture of quality, outcome, ownership and innovation in one of the most patient-facing parts of athenahealth. 

Essential Job Responsibilities

- Drive engineering excellence through strong design principles, code quality, automated testing, observability, incident management and clear service ownership. 
 - Build an inclusive, accountable and innovative engineering culture while maintaining a high bar for execution and technical craftsmanship. 
 - Own planning, hiring strategy, talent development, succession planning, performance management and the growth of engineers across multiple teams. 
 - Turn product roadmaps and architecture decisions into delivery plans, keep multiple pods moving in parallel, and make priority and trade-off decisions based on data. 
 - Own the production health of the team's services, including service levels, on-call, incident reviews, reliability and cost. 
 - Lead adoption of AI-assisted, specification-driven development and automated validation to help teams deliver faster without compromising quality. 

Additional Job Responsibilities

- Partner with product management, architecture, quality engineering and domain teams to align technical strategy with business outcomes. 
 - Collaborate effectively with geographically distributed leaders, peers and stakeholders. 
 - Facilitate knowledge sharing and spread best practices across engineering teams. 
 - Evaluate emerging technologies, including AI and machine learning, and recommend adopting those that improve outcomes or efficiency. 
 - Represent engineering in program and project planning to align technical strategy with organizational goals. 

Expected Education & Experience

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field. 
 - 12+ years of hands-on experience designing and building highly available distributed systems, microservices and data platforms. 
 - Strong hands-on background in Java and Spring Boot, building and running production services on AWS. 
 - At least 3 years of engineering leadership experience managing multiple teams and owning deliverables and outcomes. 
 - Experience leading system design reviews, driving technical discussions and resolving complex engineering escalations. 
 - Ability to make priority and trade-off decisions based on data. 
 - Experience with, or exposure to, building products using AI and machine learning technologies. 
 - Ability to communicate effectively and work collaboratively with geographically distributed leaders, peers and stakeholders. 
 - Excellent communication, leadership and presentation skills. 
 - Experience with high-volume messaging or notification platforms (text, voice, email) is highly desirable. 
 - Experience leading large platform modernizations or migrations is highly desirable. 
 - Familiarity with healthcare regulations, patient consent and communication compliance is a plus. 

About Athenahealth

Our vision: In an industry that becomes more complex by the day, we stand for simplicity. We offer IT solutions and expert services that eliminate the daily hurdles preventing healthcare providers from focusing entirely on their patients - powered by our vision to create a thriving ecosystem that delivers accessible, high-quality, and sustainable healthcare for all. 

Our company culture: Our talented employees - or athenistas, as we call ourselves - spark the innovation and passion needed to accomplish our vision. We are a diverse group of dreamers and do-ers with unique knowledge, expertise, backgrounds, and perspectives. We unite as mission-driven problem-solvers with a deep desire to achieve our vision and make our time here count. Our award-winning culture is built around shared values of inclusiveness, accountability, and support. 

Our DEI commitment: Our vision of accessible, high-quality, and sustainable healthcare for all requires addressing the inequities that stand in the way. That's one reason we prioritize diversity, equity, and inclusion in every aspect of our business, from attracting and sustaining a diverse workforce to maintaining an inclusive environment for athenistas, our partners, customers and the communities where we work and serve. 

What We Can Do For You

Along with health and financial benefits, athenistas enjoy perks specific to each location, including commuter support, employee assistance programs, tuition assistance, employee resource groups, and collaborative workspaces - some offices even welcome dogs. 

We also encourage a better work-life balance for athenistas with our flexibility. While we know in-office collaboration is critical to our vision, we recognize that not all work needs to be done within an office environment, full-time. With consistent communication and digital collaboration tools, athenahealth enables employees to find a balance that feels fulfilling and productive for each individual situation. 

In addition to our traditional benefits and perks, we sponsor events throughout the year, including book clubs, external speakers, and hackathons. We provide athenistas with a company culture based on learning, the support of an engaged team, and an inclusive environment where all employees are valued.
