data.description:
Overview

Microsoft is a company where passionate innovators come to collaborate, envision what can be and take their careers further. This is a world of more possibilities, more innovation, more openness, and the sky is the limit thinking in a cloud-enabled world. 

Microsoft's Azure Data engineering team is leading the transformation of analytics in the world of data with products like databases, data integration, big data analytics, messaging & real-time analytics, and business intelligence. The products our portfolio include Microsoft Fabric, Azure SQL DB, Azure Cosmos DB, Azure PostgreSQL, Azure Data Factory, Azure Synapse Analytics, Azure Service Bus, Azure Event Grid, and Power BI. Our mission is to build the data platform for the age of AI, powering a new class of data-first applications and driving a data culture. 

Within Microsoft Fabric, the Platform team builds and operates the unified foundation that brings together all Fabric workloads into a single, cohesive experience. The platform provides shared infrastructure, governance, security, and a unified data model that enables customers to manage their entire data estate in one place. This team is central to delivering Fabric as a complete, end-to-end intelligence platform. 

Within the Microsoft Fabric Platform team, we are hiring a Senior Software Engineer to build Fabric's next-generation software development lifecycle (SDLC) platform: the infrastructure that takes every change from a developer's local environment through validation and deployment to production. Agentic software development is changing the scale of software engineering: GitHub reports that developers and agents made more than five times as many commits in September 2026 as they did a year earlier, and we are planning for a 50 to 100 times increase in the number of features our teams ship. Today's SDLC infrastructure was never designed for that scale, so we are rebuilding it to match that vision. We build our SDLC platform as a product: agent-driven, cloud-native backend services on Azure that provide elastic development and validation environments, high-throughput processing of every code change, and safe, progressive deployment to production across Fabric's global, multi-region footprint, with AI agents increasingly taking on work across the lifecycle, from feature development to live-site recovery to compliance and security. Every team building features for Microsoft Fabric runs on this platform, so each improvement compounds across a very large engineering organization. We approach the SDLC as a large-scale distributed systems problem, which makes this a backend product development role: we are looking for engineers who love building distributed systems and cloud infrastructure at scale, and who want to apply that to reinventing how software is built and shipped in the agentic era. As a Senior Software Engineer, you will lead the design of major components of the platform, from architecture through production. 

We do not just value differences or different perspectives. We seek them out and invite them in so we can tap into the collective power of everyone in the company. As a result, our customers are better served. 

Responsibilities

Lead the design and development of cloud-native backend services for Fabric's next-generation software development lifecycle (SDLC) platform, spanning local development, validation, and deployment to production. 

Architect elastic, on-demand compute and environments on Azure that let engineers and AI agents develop and validate changes in isolated, production-like environments at very high concurrency. 

Build distributed, high-throughput services that scale gracefully with an order-of-magnitude growth in change volume driven by agentic development. 

Design deployment services that roll out changes safely and progressively across Fabric's global, multi-region footprint, with automated health analysis and rollback. 

Build AI agents into the platform itself, for example agents that recover live-site issues and keep changes compliant and secure, so the SDLC runs with minimal human toil and offers similar levels of SLA and reliability guarantees that customers of Fabric get, offered to the developers building on this platform. 

Partner with engineering teams across Fabric to understand their needs, identify dependencies, modernize existing infrastructure for scale, resilience, and cost efficiency, and drive adoption of the platform. 

Write extensible, well-tested, secure, and performant code, primarily in C#/. NET, and review designs and code to raise the engineering quality of the team. 

Embody our culture and values

Qualifications

Required/Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND 6+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, or Python OR equivalent experience. 

Job Requirements: Other & Additional

Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include, but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings: Microsoft Cloud Background Check: 

This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.

data.title: Sr. Principal Software Engineer, Shipping Tech & Services
data.description:
Description

Amazon Shipping is our externalized business providing small parcel transportation services to sellers and shippers. Amazon Shipping leverages many of the above foundational systems together with operations capabilities to pick up packages from shipper warehouses and inject them into the AFN outbound transportation network to provide an end-to-end parcel delivery product we can sell. 

The Sr. PE in this space will develop deep understanding of Amazon's end-to-end fulfilment and transportation operations in order to support small-parcel transportation for all Amazon marketplaces, its subsidiaries, merchants and off-Amazon shippers. 

This role will need to understand not only how a large set of technical services within Carrier Integration Services (CIS) and Amazon Shipping work together, but also how they interface and enable the adjacent functions, capabilities and programs across First Mile, Middle Mile and Last Mile as we transition to being an end-to-end carrier. 

The Sr. PE will establish the strategy and execution plan to achieve convergence of multiple legacy systems in the carrier space, gracefully manage this transition while both legacy and new systems coexist in production, and strike the right balance between feature velocity and not blocking business launches yet also avoiding accrual of technical debt and throwaway work. 

To do this effectively requires setting a strategy that provides value in both the near and long-term, and aligning 5 to 6 VP stakeholders on the vision and plan. The Sr. PE must possess a broad and deep understanding of the transportation architecture and operations, and create scalable solutions to support heterogeneous functions at scale, such as FC package labeling and sorting, sort center processing, line haul, air and last mile delivery as well as an ever-growing number of programs (e. g. , Sub-Same Day, AmazonDay, Roar, Pharmacy) and advanced capabilities (disruption management, replanning, problem solve, Redirect to Locker). 

The Sr. PE will need to understand not just the technical and product capabilities but the nuances of the businesses they are supporting, and helps to understand and balance conflicting stakeholder objectives, while simultaneously building trust and demonstrating empathy with their customers' needs

Key job responsibilities

- You lead the definition, design, architecture quality, implementation, and delivery of the most advanced, most difficult, most cross-cutting, and/or most ambiguous challenges spanning across ATS. You may own one or more critical components. 
 - You ensure that the teams within ATS and teams in related organizations are aligned to a coherent technical vision and delivering systems that fit well together. 
 - You exert influence over multiple teams, increasing their productivity and effectiveness. You hold peers and teams to a high bar. 
 - You are considered to be an authority on technical issues by both the technical and business community and are frequently consulted for making difficult trade-off decisions. You are respected for your technical expertise and have credibility with others based on your accomplishments. You drive awareness about the impact and consequences of technical decisions on the business. 
 - You relentlessly simplify. You demonstrate significant innovation, creativity, and judgement when solving challenging problems. 
 - You identify future skills needed across your organization and advocate for the development and/or acquisition of those skills to senior leaders. You scout top talent and recruit them to Amazon. 
 - You actively mentor senior and Principal engineers. You develop and institutionalize best practices

Basic Qualifications

- 10+ years of professional software development experience
 - 8+ years of programming experience with at least one modern language such as Java, C++
 - 8+ years contributing to the architecture and design (architecture, design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and current systems

Preferred Qualifications

- Advanced degree in Computer Science or a related field
 - 2+ years hands-on experience as a senior Principal Engineer leading multiple software engineering
 - Experience shipping successful large-scale supply chain projects
 - Experience partnering with Research Science or Machine Learning experts to drive optimizations using the latest techniques.

Business Unit: 

Cubic Transportation Systems

Company Details: 

When you join Cubic, you become part of a company that creates and delivers technology solutions in transportation to make people's lives easier by simplifying their daily journeys, and defense capabilities to help promote mission success and safety for those who serve their nation. Led by our talented teams around the world, Cubic is committed to solving global issues through innovation and service to our customers and partners. 

We have a top-tier portfolio of businesses, including Cubic Transportation Systems (CTS) and Cubic Defense (CD). Explore more on Cubic. com. 

Job Details: 

Principal Technical Operations Engineer

Position Summary

The Principal Technical Operations Engineer is a hands-on senior technical leader responsible for the stability, reliability, performance, and supportability of Cubic's production systems. The role involves leading the diagnosis and resolution of the most complex software defects, customer-reported issues, configuration problems, data anomalies related challenges across live, interconnected environments. 

As a technical authority across assigned programs, this engineer influences architecture, design, configuration, production readiness, and lifecycle decisions. The role converts production insights into sustainable engineering improvements, drives the elimination of recurring failure patterns, strengthens observability and automation, and guides cross-functional teams in maintaining operational excellence across mission-critical transportation systems. 

Key Responsibilities

Production Support & Issue Resolution

- Understand the enterprise architecture end to end and own troubleshooting across multiple interconnected and complex software systems. 
 - Lead the investigation and resolution of high-impact software defects, configuration issues, integration failures, data anomalies for complex issues. 
 - Provide technical direction during the most complex cross-system production incidents, coordinating diagnosis across application, integration, database, messaging, and external interface layers. 
 - Perform deep-dive root cause and pattern analysis, converting findings into permanent corrective actions, preventive controls, and prioritized engineering improvements. 
 - Maintain system stability through proactive monitoring, configuration management, capacity awareness, and early identification of operational risks.

data.description:
Do you enjoy building reliable cloud platforms using Azure, Kubernetes, and infrastructure automation?

Would you like to help create secure, scalable systems while collaborating with software engineering and security teams?

About The Business

LexisNexis Risk Solutions is the essential partner in the assessment of risk. Within our Business Services vertical, we offer a multitude of solutions focused on helping businesses of all sizes drive higher revenue growth, maximize operational efficiencies, and improve customer experience. Our solutions help our customers solve difficult problems in the areas of Anti-Money Laundering/Counter Terrorist Financing, Identity Authentication & Verification, Fraud and Credit Risk mitigation and Customer Data Management. You can learn more about LexisNexis Risk at https: //risk. lexisnexis. com/

About Our Team

Our DevOps/SRE team supports a regulated identity and risk platform running on Microsoft Azure across multiple regions, including FedRAMP and UK environments. We own the infrastructure, deployment pipelines, observability and security posture for a portfolio of Java-based services and data pipelines. We are currently modernizing our platform by moving workloads from Kubernetes (AKS) to Azure Container Apps, so it's a great time to join and help shape how our services are built and run. 

About The Role

The Senior DevOps/Site Reliability Engineer is responsible for the reliability, scalability, security and operational maturity of our Azure-hosted platform. The role combines infrastructure-as-code, platform engineering, release engineering and operational support. You will work closely with development, QA, security, release management and central platform teams to deliver automation, observability, compliance and platform modernization initiatives. 

Responsibilities

- Support highly available production services across multiple environments and participate in on-call and major incident response and operational side of databases, caches, file storage, scheduled jobs and ETL pipelines, and the test automation infrastructure used in our pipelines. 
 - Investigate incidents and service degradation, lead recovery, and produce Root Cause Analyses (RCAs) with corrective actions and lead the migration of workloads from AKS to Azure Container Apps (ACA), including environment design, networking, secrets, scaling and observability. 
 - Design, build and operate Azure infrastructure using Terraform, and maintain Kubernetes (AKS) clusters and Helm-based deployments to build and improve CI/CD pipelines in GitHub Actions, including image promotion, GitOps (ArgoCD) and blue/green releases. 
 - Drive container and supply chain security: hardened/FIPS-compliant images, vulnerability scanning and remediation, and FedRAMP compliance controls, in partnership with InfoSec and improve observability through monitoring, logging, tracing, synthetic checks, dashboards, alerting and SLOs. 
 - Manage secrets, identities and TLS certificates, including automated rotation and renewal, cloud networking, including VNet peering, private endpoints, DNS and firewall rules as code. 
 - Track and report on vulnerabilities and compliance, and keep container registries, artifacts and Terraform state well maintained. 
 - Participate in release coordination, change management, disaster recovery, blue/green failover and capacity planning and identify recurring issues and automate operational toil to improve reliability and developer productivity. 
 - Partner with development, QA, database, security and operations teams to promote operational excellence and continuous improvement. 

Requirements

- Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure, including AKS, Azure Container Apps, ACR, Key Vault, VNets/private networking, Entra ID and managed identities. 
 - Strong knowledge of containers, Kubernetes, Helm, cloud networking, IAM/RBAC and distributed systems. 
 - Proficiency with Terraform and Infrastructure-as-Code practices across multiple environments. 
 - Experience with GitHub Actions or equivalent CI/CD tooling, including GitOps and progressive delivery (ArgoCD, Argo Rollouts). 
 - Experience securing container workloads, including image hardening, vulnerability remediation (e. g. , Wiz, Defender, Xray), secrets management (HashiCorp Vault, Akeyless) and compliance controls; FedRAMP experience is a plus. 
 - Experience with observability tools such as Elastic, Grafana, Prometheus and Open Telemetry. 
 - Strong incident management skills, including technical recovery, RCA facilitation and corrective actions. 
 - Experience with Linux administration and scripting in Bash, Python or PowerShell. 

Our Tech Stack

- Cloud: Microsoft Azure: Container Apps (ACA), AKS, ACR, Key Vault, Azure Firewall, VNets/Private Endpoints, Azure Files, Azure Managed Redis, Azure OpenAI, Azure Monitor
 - Infrastructure as Code: Terraform, tflint, Trivy
 - Containers & Orchestration: Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, ArgoCD, Argo Rollouts, KEDA
 - CI/CD & Release: GitHub Actions, JFrog Artifactory, ServiceNow DevOps, Jira
 - Observability: Elastic (APM, logs, synthetics), OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana
 - Security & Compliance: Wiz, Microsoft Defender for Containers, Prisma Cloud, JFrog Xray, Mend, Checkmarx, OpenSCAP, FedRAMP
 - Secrets & Identity: HashiCorp Vault, Akeyless, Entra ID, Managed/Workload Identity
 - Applications & Data: Java/Spring Boot, Tomcat, Apache Hop (ETL), MySQL, Redis
 - Scripting: Bash, Python, PowerShell

Our Commitment to Inclusion

We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds, including underrepresented groups, people with disabilities, career changers, and candidates with non-traditional education or experience. If you require accommodations at any stage of the recruitment process, please let us know. We are committed to supporting your success.

data.description:
About Amgen

Amgen harnesses the best of biology and technology to fight the world's toughest diseases and make people's lives easier, fuller, and longer. We discover, develop, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help millions of patients. Amgen helped establish the biotechnology industry more than 40 years ago and remains at the cutting edge of innovation, using technology and human genetic data to push beyond what is known today. 

Role Description

We are seeking an Associate IS Engineer to support the delivery, operation, maintenance, and continuous improvement of enterprise applications and digital solutions. 

This is a blended application engineering role combining IT application support, application lifecycle management, technical troubleshooting, integration support, and software development. The successful candidate will work across both run/support activities and change/development initiatives, helping ensure applications remain reliable, secure, compliant, and fit for business needs. 

Working under the guidance of senior engineers, the Associate IS Engineer will investigate and resolve application and integration issues, support application releases and upgrades, participate in incident and problem management, maintain application documentation and configurations, and work with business, infrastructure, platform, security, and vendor teams. 

The role will also contribute to full-stack development and application enhancements, including front-end development, API integration, back-end development, testing, and deployment where required. 

Roles And Responsibilities

- Provide day-to-day technical and operational support for enterprise applications and associated integrations which could be either of these SaaS, COTS and Custom-built application 
 - Monitor application health, availability, interfaces, scheduled jobs, and other operational components, and proactively identify potential issues. 
 - Investigate, troubleshoot, and resolve application incidents, defects, integration failures, data issues, and performance problems. 
 - Perform technical root-cause analysis and support implementation of corrective and preventive measures for recurring problems. 
 - Support incident, problem, request, and change-management processes in accordance with established IT service-management practices. 
 - Work with business users, application owners, infrastructure teams, security teams, integration teams, and external vendors to resolve technical issues. 
 - Support application configuration, upgrades, patches, releases, environment changes, and production deployments. 
 - Support application integrations with enterprise platforms, databases, APIs, identity and access-management solutions, and cloud services. 
 - Maintain application documentation including architecture and interface details, configuration information, operational procedures, troubleshooting guides, and support knowledge articles. 
 - Contribute to application lifecycle activities including technical assessments, upgrades, modernization, remediation, and application retirement where applicable. 
 - Participate in periodic operational, security, compliance, and application health activities as required. 

Software Development & Enhancement

- Contribute to the design, development, testing, deployment, and maintenance of application enhancements and software solutions. 
 - Manage the application SDLC and supporting ITIL Lifecyle completely 
 - Translate business and technical requirements into maintainable and user-friendly application functionality. 
 - Develop or enhance front-end applications using technologies such as React, Vite, TypeScript/JavaScript, HTML5, and CSS3. 
 - Build reusable, responsive, accessible user-interface components following enterprise design standards. 
 - Integrate applications with RESTful APIs, enterprise services, databases, and third-party platforms. 
 - Contribute to back-end development using Python and FastAPI, or comparable technologies, under the guidance of senior engineers. 
 - Participate in technical design discussions, peer code reviews, troubleshooting sessions, and technical walkthroughs. 
 - Follow coding standards, secure-development practices, reusable software-design patterns, and established engineering practices. 
 - Develop and maintain appropriate unit, integration, regression, and end-to-end automated tests. 
 - Support CI/CD processes for automated builds, testing, security scanning, and deployment. 
 - Analyse and remediate application vulnerabilities, software dependency issues, and technical debt in collaboration with senior engineers. 

Testing, Release & Operational Readiness

- Create and execute functional, integration, regression, smoke, and end-to-end tests for application changes and releases. 
 - Support user acceptance testing and resolution of defects identified during testing. 
 - Validate APIs and system integrations using tools such as Postman or equivalent. 
 - Support release planning, deployment validation, and post-production verification. 
 - Ensure appropriate technical and support documentation is available before solutions transition into production. 
 - Work with support teams to ensure operational readiness for new applications, enhancements, integrations, and releases. 

Collaboration & Continuous Improvement

- Collaborate with product managers, business stakeholders, application owners, developers, QA professionals, DevOps teams, infrastructure teams, cybersecurity teams, and external vendors. 
 - Participate in Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, backlog refinement, daily stand-ups, demonstrations, and retrospectives. 
 - Identify opportunities to improve application reliability, automate repetitive operational activities, and reduce recurring support issues. 
 - Stay current with emerging technologies and practices across application development, cloud, DevOps, API integration, observability, cybersecurity, automation, and AI. 

Basic Qualifications And Experience

- Master's / Bachelor's degree with 3-5 years of relevant experience in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, Engineering, or a related field. 
 - Experience may include a combination of application development, application engineering, production/application support, system integration, testing, or IT operations. 

Must-Have Skills

- Good understanding of information systems, application architecture, software-development lifecycle, and application-support lifecycle. 
 - Experience supporting business or enterprise applications in development, test, and/or production environments. 
 - Strong analytical, troubleshooting, debugging, and problem-solving skills. 
 - Ability to investigate application incidents, software defects, integration failures, and data-related issues. 
 - Understanding of incident, problem, change, and release-management processes. 
 - Working knowledge of REST APIs and application integrations. 
 - Understanding of relational databases, SQL, and basic data-access concepts. 
 - Hands-on experience with HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript and/or TypeScript. 
 - Familiarity with React and Vite, Angular, Vue. js, or another modern front-end framework. 
 - Basic knowledge of Python and FastAPI, or a comparable back-end technology. 
 - Experience developing, testing, debugging, supporting, and deploying software applications. 
 - Understanding of software-testing methodologies including functional, integration, regression, smoke, end-to-end, and user acceptance testing. 
 - Experience creating and executing test cases and documenting test results. 
 - Familiarity with unit and UI testing frameworks such as Jest, React Testing Library, Cypress, Playwright, Selenium, or equivalent tools. 
 - Familiarity with API testing using Postman or equivalent tools. 
 - Familiarity with defect and work-management platforms such as Jira or Azure DevOps. 
 - Familiarity with Git-based version control, branching, pull requests, and code reviews. 
 - Understanding of Agile and Scrum delivery methodologies. 
 - Basic understanding of CI/CD pipelines and automated deployment. 
 - Understanding of secure coding principles, OWASP guidance, authentication, authorization, dependency management, and application security. 
 - Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to work effectively with business users, technical teams, and external vendors. 

Good-to-Have Skills

- Exposure to GxP or regulated systems and associated validation/compliance activities. 
 - Experience supporting enterprise applications in a production environment. 
 - Familiarity with IT service-management processes and tools such as ServiceNow. 
 - Experience working with SaaS and/or vendor-managed enterprise applications. 
 - Understanding of cloud platforms and cloud-hosted application architectures. 
 - Exposure to monitoring, logging, alerting, or application observability tools. 
 - Experience supporting API-based or middleware-based system integrations. 
 - Exposure to application lifecycle management, vulnerability remediation, upgrades, patching, and technical-debt remediation. 
 - Experience working in cross-functional teams involving business stakeholders, vendors, infrastructure, security, and application-development teams.

#VOIS #BeUnrivalled #CreateTheFuture

About This Role

We are seeking a AWS DevOps & Performance Engineer with 6-8 years of experience in CI/CD, Chaos Engineering, cloud infrastructure, automation and performance engineering. You will work with AWS cloud-native environments, containerised platforms and automation frameworks, with responsibility for building reliable CI/CD capabilities and supporting scalable distributed systems. 

The role requires hands-on experience with AWS, Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform, Jenkins, GitHub, python/Shell scripting, alongside an understanding of infrastructure, networking, security and Chaos Engineering. You will work across multiple projects and collaborate with stakeholders with varying levels of technical expertise and seniority. 

What You'll Do

- Design, develop, maintain and enhance AWS resilience and performance test automation frameworks 
 - Execute resilience and performance testing for multi-AZ, microservices-based AWS applications, covering VPC, networking, Security Groups, IAM, S3, EC2, EKS, RDS/Aurora and MSK/Kafka 
 - Design and execute AWS FIS/Chaos Engineering scenarios, including pod/microservice failures, Kafka broker failures, AZ failures and database failover, validating RTO, RPO, availability and recovery 
 - Build and maintain automation using AWS Step Functions, GitHub Actions, Terraform, Bash/Shell and Python 
 - Maintain JMeter scripts, test configurations, test data, sanity checks and automated reporting 
 - Monitor test executions and provide BAU troubleshooting for framework, AWS infrastructure, IAM, CI/CD, performance and resilience issues 
 - Support resilience automation onboarding, rollout, KT and execution for application teams 
 - Continuously improve automation, CI/CD and Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) capabilities for resilience and performance engineering

Who You Are

- You have 6-8 years of relevant experience, including hands-on experience with AWS cloud, Performance and resilience, DevOps and CI/CD pipeline 
 - You understand cloud migration, servers, storage, backup and restore, networking and security 
 - You have experience designing, building and testing CI/CD pipelines 
 - You have scripting experience using Shell scripting or Python, with Bash or Groovy also relevant 
 - You are familiar with tools such as Jira, GitHub, GitHub Actions, Docker, Terraform and Grafana 
 - You have experience delivering automation solutions and working with automation frameworks 
 - You understand Agile and Scrum ways of working 
 - You have strong analytical, problem-solving and troubleshooting capabilities 
 - You can manage multiple priorities and take ownership of deliverables 
 - You communicate effectively with clients, stakeholders and colleagues 
 - You collaborate well within a team and actively share knowledge 
 - You hold a graduate or postgraduate qualification, preferably in a technical discipline such as Engineering 
 - You have in-depth knowledge of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) 
 - Experience or knowledge of Chaos Engineering, including AWS FIS, Litmus, Chaos Monkey or comparable open-source tools 
 - Knowledge of technologies including Kafka, Couchbase and RDS databases such as MySQL, Oracle or PostgreSQL 
 - AWS certifications are desirable

Not a perfect fit?

Concerned you may not meet every requirement? Vodafone is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. If you are excited about this role but your experience does not align exactly with every aspect of the job description, you are encouraged to apply. You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best. 

What's In It For You

Opportunity to deepen your experience in AWS cloud-native engineering, DevOps and infrastructure automation. Exposure to large-scale, containerised environments using resilence, performance automation. Opportunities to work across CI/CD automation, cloud platforms distributed applications, observability and Chaos Engineering. Experience collaborating across multiple projects and with stakeholders with diverse technical expertise. Opportunity to contribute knowledge and support the development of DevOps and AWS Cloud capabilities across the team. 

What Skills You Will Learn

Advanced approaches to AWS cloud infrastructure automation and deployment. Designing resilient cloud-native distributed systems and applying Chaos Engineering practices. Building and improving automated CI/CD pipelines using modern DevOps practices. Managing and scaling Kubernetes-based containerised environments. Applying Terraform and scripting to infrastructure automation. Using Datadog and Grafana within cloud observability practices. Strengthening stakeholder management, troubleshooting and cross-team technical collaboration.

Join Us

At Vodafone, we're working hard to build a better future. A more connected, inclusive and sustainable world. As a dynamic global community, it's our human spirit, together with technology, that empowers us to achieve this. 

We challenge and innovate in order to connect people, businesses, and communities across the world. Delighting our customers and earning their loyalty drive us, and we experiment, learn fast and get it done, together.

data.title: Principal Software Engineer, Secure Boot & Debug Security
data.description:
Description

Invent the future with us. 

Ampere is a semiconductor design company for a new era, leading the future of computing by developing SoCs and platform solutions focused on high-performance, energy efficient AI compute. As a pioneer in the new frontier of energy efficient high-performance computing, Ampere is part of the Softbank Group of companies driving sustainable AI compute for cloud, edge, and physical applications. 

AI is showing up in essentially every part of the technology landscape, and we're focused on delivering the performance, efficiency, and reliability those workloads require. Ampere is building compute silicon and platforms for AI applications spanning a broad range of industries. We focus on solving exciting challenges in areas such as robotics and automotive, among others, but the core of our work is enabling efficient AI at scale and across multiple application domains. 

About the role: 

We are seeking a hands-on Principal Engineer to lead secure boot, debug security, device lifecycle, and platform-security firmware for Arm-based SoCs. 

The role owns the firmware security architecture from Boot ROM and hardware root of trust through bootloaders, trusted firmware, secure update, production lifecycle, debug access, and operating-system handoff. The candidate will work with SoC architecture, DV, post-silicon validation, firmware, security, manufacturing, and customer teams. 

This is a technical leadership role requiring architecture ownership, low-level firmware development, silicon bring-up, root-cause analysis, and mentorship. 

What you'll achieve: 

- Define secure boot chain-of-trust architecture: 
 - Boot ROM, root of trust, OTP/eFuse/secure NVM, device identity, key hierarchy, authenticated image loading, anti-rollback, recovery boot, and trusted firmware handoff. 
 - Lead secure firmware update design: 
 - signed images, version policy, updates, rollback prevention, interrupted-update recovery, key rotation, and revocation. 
 - Define secure debug and lifecycle architecture: 
 - JTAG/SWD lockdown, authenticated debug unlock, debug certificates/tokens, manufacturing/service/production policies, and lifecycle transitions. 
 - Drive Arm platform security configuration: 
 - TrustZone, MPU/MMU, privilege separation, secure memory partitioning, DMA/IOMMU isolation, bus firewalls, reset/power behavior, and secure peripheral access. 
 - Integrate HSM/TPM, cryptographic accelerators, RNG, key storage, and provisioning services. 
 - Establish secure key-management practices, including key derivation, usage policy, rotation, revocation, and zeroization. 
 - Lead pre-silicon and post-silicon firmware for secure boot, debug security, lifecycle, recovery, and security fault scenarios. 
 - Debug complex hardware/firmware issues using register traces, boot logs, JTAG, simulation/waveform evidence, and other lab tools. 
 - Identify security-related silicon limitations and define firmware workarounds, errata guidance, and validation coverage. 
 - Lead threat modeling, security architecture reviews, negative testing, and secure firmware design reviews. 
 - Define reusable platform security APIs, reference implementations, test frameworks, integration guides, and technical roadmaps. 
 - Mentor engineers and provide technical leadership across firmware, security, hardware, DV, validation, and customer teams. 

About you: 

- Bachelor's degree with 8 years or Master's degree with 6 years of experience in embedded firmware, low-level platform software, SoC firmware, silicon bring-up, or product security. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with secure boot, boot ROM/bootloaders, image authentication, anti-rollback, secure firmware update, and recovery boot. 
 - Experience with hardware root of trust, OTP/eFuse, secure NVM, key provisioning, device lifecycle, and secure debug. 
 - Experience integrating HSM, TPM, secure element, cryptographic accelerator, or hardware key-management solutions. 
 - Strong Arm architecture knowledge: Cortex-M/R/A, TrustZone, MPU/MMU, exception handling, privilege levels, caches, barriers, and memory protection. 
 - Strong SoC knowledge: AXI/AHB/APB, DMA, IOMMU/SMMU, bus firewalls, interrupt controllers, clock/reset domains, and power states. 
 - Expert embedded C/C++ and low-level register programming skills. 
 - Strong debugging experience with JTAG/SWD, GDB, trace, register dumps, crash analysis, and hardware bring-up. 
 - Experience with threat modeling, secure coding, static analysis, code reviews, security testing, and root-cause analysis. 
 - Demonstrated technical leadership and ability to influence cross-functional teams. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with Arm Trusted Firmware, TF-M, OP-TEE, U-Boot, UEFI, EDK II, Linux secure boot, or Android Verified Boot. 
 - Experience with DICE, measured boot, remote attestation, secure provisioning, or certificate lifecycle management. 
 - Experience working with RTL, DV, emulation/FPGA, and post-silicon validation teams. 
 - Familiarity with ISO/SAE 21434, ISO 26262, NIST guidance, PSA Certified, SESIP, or Common Criteria concepts. 
 - Experience in semiconductor, automotive, industrial, IoT, or safety/security-critical platforms. 
 - Python or scripting experience for image tools, automation, log analysis, and security regression. 

What we'll offer: 

At Ampere we believe in taking care of our employees and providing a competitive total rewards package that includes base pay, cash long-term incentive, and comprehensive benefits. 

Benefits highlights include: 

- Premium medical, dental, vision insurance, parental benefits includingcrechereimbursement, as well as a retirement plan, so thatyou can feel secure in your health, financial futureand child care during work. 
 - Generous paid time off policy so that you can embrace a healthy work-life balance
 - Fully catered lunch in our office along with a variety of healthy snacks, energizing coffee or tea, and refreshing drinks to keep you fueled and focused throughout the day. 

And thereismuch more than compensation and benefits. At Ampere, we foster an inclusive culture that empowers our employees to do more and grow more. We are excited to share more about our career opportunities with you through the interview process. 

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us. 

Ampere is an inclusive and equal opportunity employer and welcomes applicants from all backgrounds. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, citizenship, religion, age, veteran and/or military status, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, physical or mental disability, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law.

This is how we enable sustainable mobility and help to prevent accidents caused by human error. 

Technical Lead Engineer - Testing

The Technical Lead Engineer - Testing is a senior technical leader responsible for leading the Validation of complex software products and solutions. The Technical Lead Testing Engineer serves as the primary technical authority for assigned projects, The role drives technical decision-making, coordinates engineering activities across teams, mentors' engineers, and collaborates closely with Architects, Development teams, Product Owners, Program Managers, and other stakeholders to ensure successful execution of Testing initiatives. 

Working on complex assignments requiring advanced technical judgment, the Technical Lead Testing Engineer influences engineering practices and technical direction across multiple teams while contributing to the continuous improvement of products, processes, and testing methodologies.

 - CICD knowledge and familiarity with Gerrit workflow
 - Experience with requirements management tools such as DOORS or Polarion. 
 - Familiarity with, ASPICE, MISRA, and automotive software development processes. 
 - Experience with AI-enabled solutions. 
 - Experience working within Agile/SAFe environments. 
 - Experience working with global, cross-functional development teams. 
 - Strong communication / presentation skills and stakeholder management skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across organizational levels. 
 - Ability to lead technical activities, coordinate Testing tasks, and provide guidance to team members. 

Why join us?

You grow at Aptiv. 

Aptiv's winning culture is global by design. We bring together diverse perspectives, cultures, and business contexts to solve our customers' toughest challenges. In this environment, every individual can grow, lead, and make an impact, regardless of background, because inclusion fuels how we innovate and win. 

You make an impact at Aptiv. 

One of the strengths of humanity is our drive to progress, to improve, to achieve more tomorrow than we did yesterday. People need solutions they can trust when it matters most. At Aptiv, you are building those solutions every day. 

You have support at Aptiv. 

We ensure you have the resources and support you need to take care of your family, your physical health, and your mental health with a competitive benefits package. 

Your Benefits at Aptiv: 

Higher Education Opportunities (UDACITY, UDEMY, COURSERA are available for your continuous growth and development); 

Life and accident insurance; 

Sodexo cards for food and beverages

Well Being Program that includes regular workshops and networking events; 

EAP Employee Assistance;

Creche facility for working parents

Meet the Next-Generation Aptiv

At Aptiv, we deliver innovative solutions that people trust when it matters most. 

Progress is never static. It is about reaching further, exploring new possibilities, and enabling mobility. Aptiv empowers customers to create solutions people rely on-advancing safety and autonomy in Automotive and Commercial Vehicles, enabling mission-critical performance in Aerospace & Defense, and powering intelligent systems across Energy, Enterprise, and Telecommunications. We also drive precision and efficiency in Industrials & Robotics and support life-critical innovation in Medical technologies. 

Guided by our winning culture and values to Think & Act Like Owners, as One Team, and Play to Win, we turn commitment into results and achieve more together.

data.title: Principal Software Engineer, Secure Boot & Debug Security
data.description:
Description

Invent the future with us. 

Ampere is a semiconductor design company for a new era, leading the future of computing by developing SoCs and platform solutions focused on high-performance, energy efficient AI compute. As a pioneer in the new frontier of energy efficient high-performance computing, Ampere is part of the Softbank Group of companies driving sustainable AI compute for cloud, edge, and physical applications. 

AI is showing up in essentially every part of the technology landscape, and we're focused on delivering the performance, efficiency, and reliability those workloads require. Ampere is building compute silicon and platforms for AI applications spanning a broad range of industries. We focus on solving exciting challenges in areas such as robotics and automotive, among others, but the core of our work is enabling efficient AI at scale and across multiple application domains. 

About the role: 

We are seeking a hands-on Principal Engineer to lead secure boot, debug security, device lifecycle, and platform-security firmware for Arm-based SoCs. 

The role owns the firmware security architecture from Boot ROM and hardware root of trust through bootloaders, trusted firmware, secure update, production lifecycle, debug access, and operating-system handoff. The candidate will work with SoC architecture, DV, post-silicon validation, firmware, security, manufacturing, and customer teams. 

This is a technical leadership role requiring architecture ownership, low-level firmware development, silicon bring-up, root-cause analysis, and mentorship. 

What you'll achieve: 

- Define secure boot chain-of-trust architecture: 
 - Boot ROM, root of trust, OTP/eFuse/secure NVM, device identity, key hierarchy, authenticated image loading, anti-rollback, recovery boot, and trusted firmware handoff. 
 - Lead secure firmware update design: 
 - signed images, version policy, updates, rollback prevention, interrupted-update recovery, key rotation, and revocation. 
 - Define secure debug and lifecycle architecture: 
 - JTAG/SWD lockdown, authenticated debug unlock, debug certificates/tokens, manufacturing/service/production policies, and lifecycle transitions. 
 - Drive Arm platform security configuration: 
 - TrustZone, MPU/MMU, privilege separation, secure memory partitioning, DMA/IOMMU isolation, bus firewalls, reset/power behavior, and secure peripheral access. 
 - Integrate HSM/TPM, cryptographic accelerators, RNG, key storage, and provisioning services. 
 - Establish secure key-management practices, including key derivation, usage policy, rotation, revocation, and zeroization. 
 - Lead pre-silicon and post-silicon firmware for secure boot, debug security, lifecycle, recovery, and security fault scenarios. 
 - Debug complex hardware/firmware issues using register traces, boot logs, JTAG, simulation/waveform evidence, and other lab tools. 
 - Identify security-related silicon limitations and define firmware workarounds, errata guidance, and validation coverage. 
 - Lead threat modeling, security architecture reviews, negative testing, and secure firmware design reviews. 
 - Define reusable platform security APIs, reference implementations, test frameworks, integration guides, and technical roadmaps. 
 - Mentor engineers and provide technical leadership across firmware, security, hardware, DV, validation, and customer teams. 

About you: 

- Bachelor's degree with 8 years or Master's degree with 6 years of experience in embedded firmware, low-level platform software, SoC firmware, silicon bring-up, or product security. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with secure boot, boot ROM/bootloaders, image authentication, anti-rollback, secure firmware update, and recovery boot. 
 - Experience with hardware root of trust, OTP/eFuse, secure NVM, key provisioning, device lifecycle, and secure debug. 
 - Experience integrating HSM, TPM, secure element, cryptographic accelerator, or hardware key-management solutions. 
 - Strong Arm architecture knowledge: Cortex-M/R/A, TrustZone, MPU/MMU, exception handling, privilege levels, caches, barriers, and memory protection. 
 - Strong SoC knowledge: AXI/AHB/APB, DMA, IOMMU/SMMU, bus firewalls, interrupt controllers, clock/reset domains, and power states. 
 - Expert embedded C/C++ and low-level register programming skills. 
 - Strong debugging experience with JTAG/SWD, GDB, trace, register dumps, crash analysis, and hardware bring-up. 
 - Experience with threat modeling, secure coding, static analysis, code reviews, security testing, and root-cause analysis. 
 - Demonstrated technical leadership and ability to influence cross-functional teams. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with Arm Trusted Firmware, TF-M, OP-TEE, U-Boot, UEFI, EDK II, Linux secure boot, or Android Verified Boot. 
 - Experience with DICE, measured boot, remote attestation, secure provisioning, or certificate lifecycle management. 
 - Experience working with RTL, DV, emulation/FPGA, and post-silicon validation teams. 
 - Familiarity with ISO/SAE 21434, ISO 26262, NIST guidance, PSA Certified, SESIP, or Common Criteria concepts. 
 - Experience in semiconductor, automotive, industrial, IoT, or safety/security-critical platforms. 
 - Python or scripting experience for image tools, automation, log analysis, and security regression. 

What we'll offer: 

At Ampere we believe in taking care of our employees and providing a competitive total rewards package that includes base pay, cash long-term incentive, and comprehensive benefits. 

Benefits highlights include: 

- Premium medical, dental, vision insurance, parental benefits includingcrechereimbursement, as well as a retirement plan, so thatyou can feel secure in your health, financial futureand child care during work. 
 - Generous paid time off policy so that you can embrace a healthy work-life balance
 - Fully catered lunch in our office along with a variety of healthy snacks, energizing coffee or tea, and refreshing drinks to keep you fueled and focused throughout the day. 

And thereismuch more than compensation and benefits. At Ampere, we foster an inclusive culture that empowers our employees to do more and grow more. We are excited to share more about our career opportunities with you through the interview process. 

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us. 

Ampere is an inclusive and equal opportunity employer and welcomes applicants from all backgrounds. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, citizenship, religion, age, veteran and/or military status, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, physical or mental disability, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law.

data.title: Principal Engineer, Biocompatibility & Toxicology
data.description:
This is where  your work makes a difference. 

At Baxter, we believe every person-regardless of who they are or where they are from-deserves a chance to live a healthy life. It was our founding belief in 1931 and continues to be our guiding principle. We are redefining healthcare delivery to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond. 

Our Baxter colleagues are united by our Mission to Save and Sustain Lives. Together, our community is driven by a culture of courage, trust, and collaboration. Every individual is empowered to take ownership and make a meaningful impact. We strive for efficient and effective operations, and we hold each other accountable for delivering exceptional results. 

Here, you will find more than just a job-you will find purpose and pride.   

Your Role at Baxter

Baxter's Front Line Care business unit develops innovative solutions that help clinicians monitor and manage chronic and acute respiratory and cardiac conditions, improving patient outcomes and quality of life. The Principal Engineer, Toxicology & Biocompatibility serves as the subject matter expert for biocompatibility and toxicological safety across the Front-Line Care portfolio, including patient monitors, cardiology devices, vision care products, respiratory systems, non-invasive ventilation (NIV) devices, masks, breathing circuits, tubing, humidification systems, and accessories. 

This role is responsible for developing toxicology strategies, conducting risk assessments, supporting regulatory submissions, and partnering with cross-functional teams throughout the product lifecycle. The position is based in Bangalore and reports to the Manager, Systems Front-Line Care. 

What you'll be doing

- Lead biocompatibility and toxicology activities across Front Line Care products in accordance with global regulatory and quality requirements. 
 - Independently develop and execute Biological Evaluation Plans (BEPs) and Biological Evaluation Reports (BERs) in compliance with ISO 10993-1. 
 - Author, review, and approve Toxicological Risk Assessments (TRAs) in accordance with ISO 10993-17. 
 - Evaluate chemical safety risks associated with device materials, manufacturing processes, and intended use conditions. 
 - Collaborate with laboratory partners and cross-functional stakeholders on material characterization programs per ISO 10993-18. 
 - Serve as the toxicology lead for respiratory and non-invasive ventilation products, including masks, breathing circuits, tubing, connectors, and humidification systems. 
 - Assess inhalation exposure risks and evaluate the impact of heat, moisture, airflow, volatile compounds, and long-term off-gassing in respiratory devices in accordance with ISO 18562. 
 - Assess risks associated with cleaning, disinfection, and reprocessing residues on medical devices. 
 - Support material selection decisions and supplier qualification activities from a toxicological and biocompatibility perspective. 
 - Provide toxicology expertise for FDA submissions, EU MDR Technical Documentation, and global regulatory filings. 
 - Act as the primary toxicology representative during regulatory interactions and audits. 
 - Ensure compliance with applicable standards including ISO 10993, ISO 14971, and relevant global regulatory requirements. 
 - Partner with R&D, Regulatory Affairs, Quality Assurance, Manufacturing, and Materials Engineering teams to guide product development decisions. 
 - Evaluate the toxicological impact of design, process, material, and supplier changes throughout the product lifecycle. 
 - Drive risk-based decision making and provide scientifically sound recommendations to support product safety and regulatory compliance. 

What you'll bring

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Toxicology, Chemistry, Biology, Biomedical Engineering, or a related scientific discipline. Advanced degree preferred. 
 - 10+ years of experience in toxicology, biocompatibility, or biological safety assessments within the medical device industry. 
 - Strong hands-on experience performing biocompatibility evaluations in accordance with ISO 10993 standards. 
 - Direct experience with respiratory device evaluations and requirements outlined in ISO 18562. 
 - Demonstrated expertise in assessing inhalation and respiratory exposure risks. 
 - Experience supporting FDA, EU MDR, and global regulatory submissions. 
 - Proven ability to independently develop biological safety strategies and execute complex toxicological assessments. 
 - Strong understanding of risk management principles and application of ISO 14971. 
 - Experience identifying toxicological risks early in product development and implementing appropriate mitigation strategies. 
 - Ability to develop efficient, scientifically justified, and regulatory-defensible testing strategies. 
 - Demonstrated success in supporting regulatory approvals without biocompatibility-related delays. 
 - Strong technical influence and collaboration skills with cross-functional teams. 
 - Experience working with suppliers, external laboratories, and third-party partners. 
 - Working knowledge of FDA regulations, international medical device standards, and product development processes. 
 - Understanding of the design, development, and manufacturing of electromechanical medical devices and systems. 
 - Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills. 
 - Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver high-quality results within project timelines. 
 - Self-motivated professional with excellent interpersonal, communication, and stakeholder management skills. 
 - Proven ability to drive results in a fast-paced, quality-focused medical device environment. 

Equal Employment Opportunity

Baxter is an equal opportunity employer. Baxter evaluates qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, protected veteran status, disability/handicap status or any other legally protected characteristic.

What You Will Do

- Investigate complex and ambiguous software failures and performance problems. 
 - Perform deep root-cause analysis across application, system, network, database, and infrastructure layers. 
 - Analyze application logs, system logs, stack traces, thread dumps, heap dumps, metrics, traces, and profiling data. 
 - Analyze network traffic and protocols to identify latency, connectivity, retransmission, timeout, and communication issues. 
 - Investigate issues that occur only under specific workloads, concurrency levels, configurations, environments, or long-running conditions.

 - Perform exploratory testing and deliberately challenge system assumptions to discover weaknesses and failure modes. 
 - Investigate performance degradation, scalability limitations, resource exhaustion, latency spikes, and throughput bottlenecks. 
 - Create meaningful Performance Test Cases based on product architecture, customer workflows, expected load patterns, scalability goals, and known risk areas. 
 - Review Performance Test Cases created by other engineers to ensure coverage, clarity, workload relevance, data validity, and alignment with product behavior. 
 - Execute Performance Test Cases, analyze results, identify bottlenecks or regressions, and communicate findings with clear evidence and recommended actions. 
 - Correlate evidence across multiple components of distributed systems. 
 - Work with developers to identify the actual root cause rather than simply identifying the component where the symptom appeared.

 - Experience diagnosing concurrency, latency, resource contention, or scalability issues.

 - Exceptional curiosity about how software systems work.

data.title: Princ Software Engineer - Mobile
data.description:
About Gen

Gen is a global company dedicated to powering Digital Freedom through its trusted consumer brands including Norton, Avast, LifeLock, MoneyLion and more. Our combined heritage is rooted in financial empowerment and cyber safety for the first digital generations, and today we deliver award-winning cybersecurity, online privacy, identity protection and financial wellness solutions to nearly 500 million users in more than 150 countries. 

Together, we share a collective passion and vision to protect consumers and help them grow, manage and secure their digital and financial lives. We're always looking for smart, fearless and high-impact talent who see AI as a teammate - leveraging it to move faster and deliver meaningful results. 

When you're part of Gen, you'll have the flexibility, tools and support to do your best work and grow your career - from flexible working options and time off to competitive pay, benefits and well-being programs. 

At Gen, we are scrappy and relentlessly customer driven. We create room for healthy debate, experimentation and continuous learning, and we seek out people with different experiences, identities and ideas to join our team. You'll work with people who back each other, respect each other and understand that our differences are a competitive advantage. 

About The Role

AI is already part of every stage of how we build products, from ideation and design to coding, testing and release. The next step is agentic: AI agents that plan, write, test and ship real mobile code, with engineers designing, directing and reviewing them. We want engineers who build those agents, not just use them. 

As an AI-First Mobile Engineer, you will build across the whole mobile stack of Norton, Avast, AVG and Avira apps used by tens of millions of people: the screens and flows users touch every day, and the shared code underneath them. You will work across: 

- App UI and features: user-facing screens and flows in Jetpack Compose (Android) and SwiftUI/UIKit (iOS), from onboarding and purchase flows to scam protection, VPN, identity and AI-assistant experiences. 
 - Compose Multiplatform (CMP): shared UI across Android and iOS where it makes sense, native UI where it doesn't. 
 - Kotlin Multiplatform (KMP) SDKs: shared Kotlin code for business logic, networking and storage, compiled for Android and iOS. 
 - Native SDKs: the Kotlin (Android) and Swift (iOS) libraries apps use today, and the platform-specific parts of shared SDKs. 

You will be strongest on one platform, work across both, and be comfortable anywhere in the stack, from pixel-level UI to SDK internals. This is a principal-level, hands-on individual contributor role. You write production app and library code, and much of it will be written by agents you set up, direct and review. You will design the agentic workflows the rest of the team relies on, and work alongside engineers in Asia, Europe and North America. 

Key Responsibilities

- Build user-facing features in Jetpack Compose and SwiftUI, from spec to app-store release, including the most complex and highest-risk parts of the apps. 
 - Improve app performance, stability, crash-free rates, startup time, battery use and app size. 
 - Fix critical production issues: crashes, performance regressions and security findings. 
 - Design, build and maintain SDKs used by multiple product teams, in shared Kotlin and in native Android or iOS code. 
 - Own features end to end: API design, implementation, tests, release and support for consuming apps. Keep public APIs stable and migrations short. 
 - Improve how we build, package and release SDKs for both platforms, and measure what our SDKs cost the host app (startup, memory, battery, app size). 
 - Build and run agents that do real engineering work on our apps and SDKs: implementing features from specs, building UI from designs, writing and fixing tests, triaging crashes, upgrading dependencies and moving native code to KMP. 
 - Make our codebases agent-ready: clear architecture docs, agent instruction files (AGENTS. md, CLAUDE. md and similar), fast and reliable tests, and module boundaries an agent can reason about. 
 - Work closely with product, design, backend and QA to achieve the best possible experience for our customers. 
 - Review code from engineers and agents alike, with the judgment to catch what AI gets wrong. Leave the codebase better than you found it. 
 - Write clear specs and design proposals in English that both engineers and agents can build from, and explain trade-offs to engineers, managers and business partners. 

About You

- Agents are how you work. Coding agents such as Claude Code, Cursor, Codex or GitHub Copilot agent mode are your daily tools, and you regularly run several at once on real production work. 
 - You know how agents work under the hood: context engineering, tool design, planning and sub-agents, memory, evals, and where they fail - hallucinated APIs, drift on long tasks, prompt injection. 
 - You have sharp judgment. You know when to trust agent output and when to step in, and you keep AI-written code secure, tested and maintainable. 
 - You can show us. A repo, demo or write-up of an agent or workflow you built, and the measurable difference it made. 
 - 8+ t0 15+ years of professional mobile development, with deep expertise in at least one of Android or iOS and at least one app or library shipped at scale. 
 - Strong command of your primary platform's language, concurrency model and architecture (for example Kotlin and coroutines, or Swift and Swift Concurrency)
 - Readiness to work on the other platform regularly. Some hands-on experience with it is a strong plus. 
 - Hands-on experience with Kotlin Multiplatform: sharing business logic between Android and iOS, structuring shared modules, handling Swift interop and multiplatform Gradle builds. Production experience is preferred, but substantial side projects you can show us also count. 
 - Modern mobile UI: production experience with Jetpack Compose and/or SwiftUI where needed. You care about UX, accessibility, animation and how the app feels in the hand. 
 - Experience with automated testing (including UI tests), CI/CD, app-store release processes and production monitoring. 
 - Good judgement on API design, compatibility and the cost of breaking changes. 
 - Growth attitude: eager to learn, experiment and push boundaries. You get up to speed on a new product, codebase and business in weeks, not months. 
 - Collaboration: at home in a fast-paced, global team across time zones. You mentor other engineers and work easily with product, design and business partners. 
 - Clear written and spoken English. You can explain a technical trade-off to a non-engineer. 
 - Experience with Compose Multiplatform, ideally in production. If you have built CMP side projects and can show them, we want to talk to you. 
 - Built agents that drive mobile apps end to end: UI automation on emulators and simulators with tools such as Maestro, XCUITest or Espresso, and screenshot-based verification. 
 - Building SDKs or libraries consumed by other teams or third parties. 

What's Next

- TA Call
 - Technical Screening
 - Technical Screening Focused on Design and AI
 - Final Interview with Hiring Manager 
 - Meet and Greet with Leadership

data.title: Senior Software Engineer
data.description:
Senior Software Engineer - QA Automation

Location : Pune, India

Experience: 4-8+ Years

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer with a passion for quality and a curiosity for AI. You'll build and evolve automated test solutions, own our QA frameworks, and help validate AI-native product features - including LLM workflows and RAG systems. No prior AI testing experience required; just the drive to learn and explore. 

This role will also support quality engineering for AI-native product features, including LLM workflows and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems. Prior experience is not mandatory, but curiosity and willingness to learn AI-driven testing approaches is important. 

What Makes This Role Unique

- Engineer-first mindset - you design systems that test software, not just run test cases
 - AI-enabled quality - explore and apply AI/LLM tools to improve test coverage, reduce manual effort, and enhance product quality
 - Full-stack ownership - own the automation framework end-to-end, from architecture to CI/CD integration
 - Mentorship & influence - shape testing culture and upskill a growing QA team

Roles & Responsibilities

- Author test strategy, test plans, and detailed test cases; review peer test cases and automate the full test cycle
 - Apply advanced programming skills to build and maintain automation systems integrated with CI/CD pipelines and databases
 - Demonstrate hands-on experience across SDLC, STLC, and Defect Life Cycle; drive all phases of testing with precision
 - Exercise strong attention to detail and sharp analytical skills to identify edge cases and systemic quality risks
 - Utilise defect management and test management tools (e. g. Jira, TestRail) to maintain full traceability
 - Troubleshoot and debug complex failures spanning UI, API, and backend layers
 - Champion Agile methodology and cross-functional collaboration; embed quality into every sprint
 - Train and mentor junior teammates; promote engineering best practices within the QA team
 - Explore and integrate AI/ML capabilities into the testing workflow - including intelligent test generation, flaky test detection, and anomaly-based test prioritisation
 - AI Feature Validation - validate AI-powered product features including LLM workflows, prompt-driven functionality, and RAG-based outputs
 - AI Regression Testing - build and maintain test scenarios, benchmark datasets, and regression suites for AI-enabled workflows
 - Learn & Adopt AI Tools - explore and adopt emerging AI testing tools/frameworks (e. g. RAGAS or similar) to improve quality assurance practices

Required Skills & Experience

- 4-8 years of experience in Mobile and Web application testing across diverse platforms and tech stacks
 - Proficiency in automation testing using Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, or Ranorex; strong API testing skills (REST / GraphQL)
 - Proven experience designing and setting up automation frameworks from scratch (POM, keyword-driven, data-driven, or hybrid)
 - Hands-on experience with performance and load testing tools such as JMeter, Gatling, or k6
 - Familiarity with ready-made automation frameworks and ability to evaluate, extend, or replace them as needed
 - Experience with mobile automation testing tools (Appium, XCUITest, Espresso)
 - Excellent verbal and written communication skills; ability to present quality metrics and risks to senior stakeholders
 - Strong programming skills in Python preferred
 - Familiarity with testing APIs, data pipelines, and backend services
 - Exposure to AI/LLM-based applications is a plus
 - BE / ME / BCA / MCA / B. Tech or an equivalent degree in Computer Science or a related field

AI Interest - Strongly Preferred

We are actively seeking engineers excited about the intersection of AI and software quality. Experience or curiosity in any of the following areas is highly valued: 

- Using LLMs (e. g. Claude, GPT) to auto-generate, review, or optimise test cases
 - Applying ML models to predict defect-prone areas or prioritise regression suites
 - Building AI-assisted observability and anomaly detection pipelines for test infrastructure
 - Experimenting with agentic testing approaches - autonomous agents that explore and validate application behaviour
 - Familiarity with prompt engineering or fine-tuning models for domain-specific QA tasks
 - Curiosity about testing LLM-based or AI-enabled applications
 - Exposure to prompt-based systems, chatbots, or GenAI products
 - Interest in learning emerging evaluation tools such as RAGAS, LangSmith, or similar

Nice to Have

- Experience with BDD frameworks (Cucumber, SpecFlow)
 - Knowledge of containerised test environments (Docker, Kubernetes)
 - Contributions to open-source testing tools or frameworks
 - Cloud testing experience (AWS Device Farm, BrowserStack, Sauce Labs)
 - Prior experience in a software engineering role transitioning into QA or quality-focused engineering
 - Experience testing AI/ML or data-driven applications
 - Exposure to cloud-native platforms (Azure / AWS)

At Smart Working, we believe your job should not only look right on paper but also feel right every day.
