Description

Job Location

The primary work location for this role is [insert location] with a hybrid work model. 

About Envestnet

Envestnet is an adaptive WealthTech company that is redefining the future of wealth management by helping advisors meet the moment with its comprehensive technology, actionable insights, and industry leading support. Backed by over 25 years of experience and approximately $7. 0 trillion in platform assets, Envestnet is trusted by over one third of financial advisors across leading banks, wealth managers, brokerages, and RIAs. 

For a deeper look at how Envestnet is shaping the future of financial advice, visit www. envestnet. com. 

The Team You'll Join

You will join Envestnet's Technology team, where we design, build, and maintain scalable, secure, and robust WealthTech solutions that power the future of financial advice. The team collaborates closely with product, operations, and business stakeholders to drive innovation, enhance efficiency, and enable sustainable growth. Guided by modern engineering practices and a commitment to domain excellence, technical rigor, and collaboration, the Technology team ensures our platforms remain resilient, adaptable, and aligned with evolving business needs making it a core driver of Envestnet's long‐term success. 

How You'll Contribute

Provides leadership and oversight to the Software Development Engineering group. Oversees team efforts to build scalable, secure platforms in support of Envestnet business operations, including wealth management, financial data aggregation and advisor-driven technology solutions. Works across cloud-based architectures, integrating complex data sources and APIs to deliver reliable, high-performance systems. Collaborates with product managers, data scientists and compliance stakeholders to meet both business and regulatory requirements. 

- Define engineering strategy and the execution model for the enterprise CRM integration domain across Tamarac, Envestnet UMP, and MoneyGuide. 
 - Own end-to-end delivery across multiple teams, including the phased rollout: Tamarac engagement inbound, MoneyGuide relationship read, and UMP relationship plus control. 
 - Set domain architecture direction with senior technical leaders: the canonical data model, per-field direction and write authority, echo suppression, entity crosswalk and resolution, and the versioned API and event contract. 
 - Consolidate overlapping canonical-modeling efforts across separate backlogs into one owned contract, and take a stated position on the Envestnet-wide party/Holders framework. 
 - Own Envestnet's data-plane relationship with customer CRM orgs (Salesforce, Dynamics, Redtail, Wealthbox, Advyzon). That means one integration identity and one change-capture subscription per org, schema versioning under Envestnet's control, and per-tenant mapping and entitlement configuration. 
 - Drive compliance and data governance: SOX-relevant audit of reads and writes with dual actor identity, per-firm ingestion scope, redaction of unstructured advisor content, tenant isolation, and advisor-level entitlement extended to delegated agent access. 
 - Manage budget, headcount, and org design, including build-versus-buy decisions on CRM adapters, mapping layers, and per-org licensing. 
 - Implement KPIs: per-object sync freshness, availability, latency, write success and rejection rates, cost efficiency, and quality trends. 
 - Influence prioritization across engineering, product, AI/agent engineering, and partners, including repositioning partner overlays from independent extractors to consumers of the service. 
 - Lead the transformation: retire point-to-point integrations and migrate onto shared streaming, canonical, and observability infrastructure. 
 - Build leadership bench strength through structured succession planning. 
 - Drive adoption of agentic coding practices across the SDLC to increase productivity and cut time-to-delivery. 

What You'll Need To Bring

- 10+ years of software engineering experience, including leading managers, technical leads, or multiple teams across a major domain. 
 - Proven ability to define engineering strategy, translate business objectives into multi-quarter plans, and deliver measurable customer and business outcomes. 
 - Experience setting domain-level architecture direction, including platform consolidation, integration modernization, and replacing point-to-point integrations with a canonical shared service. 
 - Deep enterprise CRM integration experience: 
 - Salesforce: managed packages, Change Data Capture, Pub/Sub API and platform events, replay and gap/overflow handling, field-level security, and Financial Services Cloud. 
 - Microsoft Dynamics 365/Dataverse: change tracking and delta tokens, service endpoints, Entra ID service principals, and least-privilege Graph scopes. 
 - Experience designing canonical or master data models and persistent entity crosswalks: per-field direction control, write authority, echo suppression in bi-directional sync, conflict policy, and pre-write constraint validation. 
 - Event-driven architecture background: Kafka/Amazon MSK, the transactional outbox pattern, Debezium CDC, and Kafka Connect sinks. 
 - PostgreSQL at scale (row-level security, partitioning, logical replication) with Flyway migrations. 
 - . NET, xUnit, Reqnroll, RESTful API design and versioning, and consumer-driven contract testing. 
 - AWS (EC2, S3, API Gateway, Lambda, RDS, EKS, CloudWatch, SQS), Kubernetes, Docker, and IaC (CloudFormation, CDK, Terraform). 
 - Identity and access management: OAuth 2. 0, OIDC, Keycloak, RFC 8693 token exchange for delegated and agent identities, and entitlement models finer than tenant scope. 
 - Experience driving compliance, data governance, and security: SOX audit trails, PII and tax-ID tokenization, data classification, redaction of unstructured content, and retention policy. 
 - Experience with engineering KPIs, OKRs, MBRs, budgeting, headcount planning, org design, hiring, performance management, and succession planning. 
 - Experience with vendor evaluation and build-versus-buy decisions, including security review of vendors needing write access to customer systems of record. 
 - Strong stakeholder management across engineering, product, AI/agent engineering, partners, and business leaders, including commercially sensitive partner conversations. 
 - Experience building leadership bench strength and inspiring high-performing teams through coaching, development, and accountability. 
 - Experience with DevOps, automation, agile/Scrum, and test-driven development. 
 - Experience driving adoption of agentic coding or AI-enabled engineering workflows across the SDLC. 
Nice-to-Haves

- Wealth management or financial services domain experience, including advisor workflows, household and account structures, and portfolio accounting or custodial data. 
 - Familiarity with Redtail, Wealthbox, and Advyzon integration models. 
 - Experience with RabbitMQ and with bridging or consolidating multiple event buses. 
 - SQL Server, Redis, and ElastiCache experience. 
 - Apigee or similar API management experience. 
 - Experience delivering data to a warehouse or lakehouse across a curated medallion boundary (Snowflake sinks, Silver-layer contracts). 
 - Familiarity with MCP-backed agent access patterns. 

Why You'll Enjoy Working at Envestnet

Help shape the future of WealthTech. At Envestnet you'll gain hands-on experience and collaborate with some of the industry's brightest minds to deliver meaningful, innovative solutions that make a real difference. 

We value flexibility in how and where work gets done, and we recognize strong performance with meaningful rewards-because your contributions should drive both business success and your own personal growth. If you're looking for a place where your work has impact, your development is supported, and your contributions are truly valued, Envestnet is where you can build your future. 

The opportunity is now!

Our Investment in You

At Envestnet, our total rewards philosophy is designed to attract, motivate, and grow exceptional talent. We offer competitive, market-aligned compensation complemented with performance-linked incentives and rewards programs that recognize and reward impact. 

In addition, we provide a comprehensive suite of benefits - subject to Envestnet's plan eligibility rules - that support your overall well-being, including medical insurance for you and your family, annual health check-ups, free online doctor consultations and telemedicine services, subsidized health club memberships, and an employee assistance program. Our investment in you means supporting you professionally, financially, and personally at every stage of your journey with us. 

Our Commitment to Inclusion & Belonging

Envestnet is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer and does not discriminate in employment on the basis of religion, race, color, caste, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, pregnancy, age, disability, medical condition, nationality, ethnic origin, marital status, or any other status protected under applicable Indian law. data.title: Director of Engineering
data.description:
Job Description: Director of Engineering - Backend

Experience: 12-16 Years

Location: Gurgaon, Haryana

Compensation: Earning potential up to INR 1. 40 Cr per annum

Role Overview

We are looking for a highly experienced and technically strong Director of Engineering with deep expertise in Backend Engineering, particularly Java-based distributed systems, microservices architecture, and large-scale backend platform development. 

The ideal candidate should have a strong engineering foundation with extensive experience designing, architecting, and scaling high-performance backend systems using Java, Spring Boot, microservices, event-driven architecture, and cloud technologies. 

The role will primarily focus on Backend Engineering leadership and architecture, while also overseeing Mobile Engineering teams responsible for Android and iOS application development. 

We are looking for a technology leader who can drive backend architecture decisions, lead complex engineering initiatives, manage multiple engineering teams, and build scalable, reliable, and high-performance technology platforms. The candidate must possess the technical depth to challenge architectural decisions, drive engineering standards, and provide strategic direction across the engineering organization. 

Key Responsibilities

1. Backend Engineering & Architecture - Primary Responsibility

- Own the overall backend engineering strategy, architecture, design, and technology roadmap. 
 - Lead the development of highly scalable, distributed, and fault-tolerant backend systems using Java, Spring Boot, and microservices. 
 - Drive architectural decisions around distributed computing, service communication, API design, event-driven systems, and asynchronous processing. 
 - Design and scale high-throughput, low-latency backend applications capable of handling significant transaction volumes and concurrent requests. 
 - Drive system design, database architecture, caching strategies, concurrency management, and performance optimization. 
 - Provide technical direction on JVM tuning, multithreading, memory management, and application performance. 
 - Establish best practices around clean architecture, design patterns, coding standards, code reviews, and engineering quality. 
 - Drive backend platform reliability, high availability, fault tolerance, security, and production stability. 
 - Evaluate architectural trade-offs involving scalability, performance, maintainability, and infrastructure costs. 
 - Lead initiatives around monolith-to-microservices transformation, platform modernization, and backend technology evolution. 2. Mobile Application Engineering

- Provide engineering leadership and strategic direction to Android and iOS development teams. 
 - Oversee mobile application architecture, development standards, engineering delivery, and release management. 
 - Ensure seamless integration between mobile applications and backend services through scalable API architecture. 
 - Drive improvements in mobile application performance, security, reliability, and user experience. 
 - Work closely with Mobile Engineering Managers and Technical Leads to ensure efficient execution and delivery. 
 - Ensure alignment between backend and mobile engineering roadmaps. 3. Engineering Leadership & Organization Building

- Lead multiple engineering teams across Backend, Mobile, and Platform Engineering. 
 - Manage and mentor Engineering Managers, Architects, Principal Engineers, and Technical Leads. 
 - Build a high-performing engineering organization with strong technical ownership and accountability. 
 - Drive engineering productivity, delivery excellence, and continuous improvement. 
 - Establish engineering KPIs covering system performance, code quality, release velocity, availability, and productivity. 
 - Drive technical talent development, leadership succession, and organizational scalability. 4. Cloud, Platform & Infrastructure Engineering

- Drive cloud-native backend architecture across AWS, GCP, or Azure. 
 - Oversee containerization, orchestration, and deployment strategies using Docker and Kubernetes. 
 - Drive CI/CD automation, infrastructure scalability, observability, and production engineering. 
 - Establish robust monitoring, logging, alerting, and incident management practices. 
 - Ensure backend infrastructure is secure, resilient, scalable, and cost-efficient. 5. Product & Business Collaboration

- Partner with Product, Business, and Design leadership to translate business requirements into scalable technology solutions. 
 - Own end-to-end engineering delivery and ensure alignment between technology strategy and business priorities. 
 - Participate in strategic product architecture and technology investment decisions. 
 - Balance engineering velocity with long-term platform scalability, reliability, and maintainability. Technical Skills & Expertise

Backend Technologies - Must Have

- Deep expertise in Java, J2EE, Spring Boot, and Spring Framework. 
 - Strong experience in microservices architecture and distributed systems. 
 - Expertise in RESTful APIs, API Gateway, event-driven architecture, and asynchronous processing. 
 - Strong understanding of multithreading, concurrency, JVM internals, garbage collection, and performance tuning. 
 - Hands-on architectural experience with Kafka, RabbitMQ, Redis, and messaging systems. 
 - Strong understanding of system design, scalability, fault tolerance, and high-availability architecture. 
 - Experience with SQL and NoSQL databases, database optimization, indexing, and caching strategies. Mobile Engineering

- Experience leading Android and iOS engineering teams. 
 - Understanding of Kotlin, Java, Swift, and modern mobile application architectures. 
 - Experience managing mobile application development, releases, performance, and production support. 
 - Strong understanding of backend and mobile application integration. Cloud & DevOps

- Experience with AWS, GCP, or Azure. 
 - Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines, and containerized applications. 
 - Cloud-native architecture, infrastructure scalability, and observability. 
 - Experience with production systems, monitoring, incident management, and reliability engineering. Desired Candidate Profile

- 12-16 years of overall experience in software engineering and technology leadership. 
 - Extensive experience in Java-based backend engineering and architecture. 
 - Strong track record of designing and scaling large-scale distributed backend systems. 
 - Must have managed both Backend Engineering and Mobile Application Development teams. 
 - Experience leading multiple engineering teams through Engineering Managers and Technical Leads. 
 - Strong architectural experience in microservices, event-driven systems, API platforms, and cloud-native applications. 
 - Experience working in product-led organizations, e-commerce, consumer internet, fintech, or high-growth technology companies. 
 - Ability to drive complex technical discussions and independently evaluate architectural decisions. 
 - Strong organizational leadership, stakeholder management, and strategic decision-making capabilities. Critical Requirements

- Backend-First Engineering Leader: Deep technical expertise in Java, Spring Boot, microservices, and distributed systems is essential. 
 - Architecture Ownership: Must have designed and scaled large-scale backend platforms and driven complex system architecture decisions. 
 - Backend Team Leadership: Must have led sizeable backend engineering teams and senior technical leaders. 
 - Mobile Leadership: Must have managed Android and iOS engineering teams, with an understanding of mobile architecture and delivery. 
 - Technical Depth: Should be capable of challenging Principal Engineers and Architects on complex system design, scalability, performance, and technology choices. 
 - Product Engineering Experience: Experience building and scaling customer-facing digital platforms in product companies is preferred. Important: This is a backend-heavy engineering leadership position. Candidates with predominantly mobile, frontend, or people-management backgrounds without strong Java backend architecture experience will not be suitable. Backend engineering and architecture will be the primary evaluation criteria.

data.title: Principal Data Engineer
data.description:
We are building the Data Hub, a centralized data platform responsible for consolidating legacy data infrastructure, establishing enterprise-grade data foundations, and enabling advanced analytics and AI capabilities across Precision AQ. 

The Principal Data Engineer is a senior technical leader and hands-on contributor responsible for the design, implementation, optimization, and operation of the Data Hub's core platform capabilities. This role sits at the intersection of data engineering, platform engineering, DevOps, architecture, and data governance. You will help define the technical direction of the platform while remaining actively involved in designing solutions, building infrastructure, reviewing code, troubleshooting production issues, and improving engineering practices. 

This is not a management role. While you will mentor and guide junior engineers, analytics engineers, and platform contributors, you will not have direct reports. We are looking for an experienced practitioner who enjoys solving complex technical challenges, setting high engineering standards, and leading through expertise and influence rather than organizational hierarchy. 

As a member of the Data Hub leadership team, you will contribute to technology strategy, roadmap prioritization, architecture governance, vendor evaluation, and executive reporting while remaining deeply engaged in day-to-day engineering activities. 

Main Duties And Responsibilities

Infrastructure and Platform Engineering

- Design, build, and maintain scalable, secure, and reliable cloud-native data platform infrastructure. 
 - Develop infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD pipelines, deployment automation, and environment management processes. 
 - Partner with Corporate IT, Security, and platform vendors to ensure compliance, reliability, and operational excellence. 
 - Improve platform observability through monitoring, alerting, logging, and performance tracking. 

Data Architecture and Modelling

- Design scalable data models supporting analytics, reporting, AI/ML, and operational use cases. 
 - Define and evolve data architecture standards, patterns, and best practices across the Data Hub ecosystem. 
 - Ensure data solutions align with governance, lineage, security, and regulatory requirements. 
 - Guide engineering teams in implementing maintainable and extensible data structures. 

Data Engineering and Solution Delivery

- Build and optimize data ingestion, transformation, and delivery pipelines across multiple business domains. 
 - Lead technical design reviews and contribute directly to implementation of complex data engineering initiatives. 
 - Collaborate with Product, Analytics, AI/ML, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into scalable technical solutions. 
 - Provide hands-on support for critical platform initiatives, migrations, and modernization programs. 

DevOps and Engineering Excellence

- Establish and enforce software engineering, GitOps, DevOps, testing, and deployment standards. 
 - Drive automation across development, deployment, monitoring, and operational processes. 
 - Promote best practices for code quality, documentation, technical debt management, and release management. 
 - Conduct architecture reviews and code reviews to ensure consistency and maintainability. 

Quality, Performance, and Reliability Optimization

- Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks across pipelines, databases, and infrastructure. 
 - Define and implement data quality frameworks, automated validation processes, and operational controls. 
 - Optimize platform cost, scalability, reliability, and processing efficiency. 
 - Lead root-cause analysis and remediation efforts for production incidents and operational challenges. 

Technical Leadership and Mentorship

- Mentor Data Engineers, Analytics Engineers, and other technical contributors through coaching, code reviews, pair programming, and design guidance. 
 - Act as a trusted technical advisor across multiple teams and business units. 
 - Share knowledge, develop engineering standards, and promote continuous improvement across the Data Hub organization. 
 - Help elevate the technical capabilities of the broader engineering team. 

Strategic Planning and Cross-Functional Collaboration

- Participate in Data Hub leadership activities, including roadmap planning, prioritization discussions, technology evaluations, and executive reporting. 
 - Provide technical recommendations on platform investments, vendor selection, architecture direction, and engineering standards. 
 - Collaborate closely with Data Product Management, AI/ML teams, business stakeholders, and Corporate IT to ensure alignment between business priorities and technical execution. 

Education And Experience

Education: Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, Information Systems, or related field. Equivalent experience considered. Advance degree preferred but not required. 

Required

- 8+ years of experience in Data Engineering, Platform Engineering, Infrastructure Engineering, or related technical disciplines. 
 - Demonstrated expertise designing and implementing modern cloud-based data platforms. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with data warehousing, orchestration, transformation, and DevOps technologies. 
 - Experience building and optimizing large-scale data pipelines and data models. 
 - Deep understanding of software engineering principles, infrastructure automation, and production operations. 
 - Experience operating in highly regulated, compliance-sensitive, or enterprise environments. 
 - Proven track record of leading technical initiatives through influence rather than direct authority. 

Preferred

- Experience within healthcare, life sciences, pharmaceutical, or analytics organizations. 
 - Experience supporting AI/ML platforms, MLOps capabilities, feature stores, or model deployment frameworks. 
 - Familiarity with claims, formulary, commercial, or real-world evidence datasets. 
 - Experience leading enterprise-scale data migrations, modernization programs, or platform consolidations. 
 - Exposure to global engineering teams and distributed delivery models. 

Knowledge, Skills And Competencies

Technical Expertise

- Advanced knowledge of cloud data platforms, modern data architecture, and platform engineering. 
 - Deep expertise in data modelling, query optimization, and analytical data design. 
 - Ability to evaluate and select appropriate technologies, frameworks, and architectural approaches. 
 - Expert-level SQL and strong Python skills. 

Infrastructure and DevOps

- Strong understanding of CI/CD, GitOps, Infrastructure-as-Code, containerization, and deployment automation. 
 - Experience implementing operational monitoring, incident management, alerting, and observability solutions. 
 - Knowledge of security, access management, and platform governance best practices. 
 - Strong understanding of scalability, resilience, and performance engineering. 

Leadership and Influence

- Leads through credibility, expertise, and collaboration rather than formal authority. Strong mentoring and coaching capabilities. 
 - Comfortable facilitating technical discussions and driving consensus among diverse stakeholders and ability to influence architecture and technology decisions across teams. 

Communication and Collaboration

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills and able to communicate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences. 
 - Effective stakeholder management across engineering, product, business, and executive teams. Strong decision-making and prioritization skills in ambiguous environments. 

Technical Environment

You will work across a modern data and AI ecosystem that may include: 

- Data Platforms: Snowflake, AWS Redshift, S3
 - Transformation: dbt, Matillion
 - Orchestration: Airflow, Dagster
 - Data Governance: Snowflake Horizon
 - Data Quality: dbt tests, Elementary
 - Infrastructure & DevOps: Terraform, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps
 - AI/ML: Snowpark ML, MLflow, Snowflake Feature Store, LangChain
 - Languages: SQL, Python

About The Role

Key Accountabilities

- Define and execute the AWS platform engineering strategy and roadmap, translating enterprise technology priorities and business requirements into a clear, multi-year plan for AWS platform capabilities, modernization, automation, resilience, security, compliance, and financial efficiency. Lead the end-to-end engineering and lifecycle management of AWS cloud platforms, ensuring services are securely designed, consistently engineered, scalable, highly available, resilient, observable, supportable, and fit for use across business-critical and regulated workloads.

The Software Engineering team delivers next-generation software application enhancements and new products for a changing world. Join us as a Software Principal Engineer on our Networking team in Chennai/Bangalore to do the best work of your career and make a profound social impact

What you'll achieve: 

As a Principal Software Engineer, you will lead the end-to-end engineering of Dell networking products and solutions for data center and AI fabric environments, driving innovation in a fast-paced development environment from requirements definition and architecture through development, validation, release, and customer deployment. 

You will collaborate with platform, silicon, software, validation, solutions, and customer-facing teams to deliver next-generation Dell Enterprise SONiC capabilities for the high-performance network fabrics powering the Dell AI Factory. You will also apply AI-assisted engineering tools throughout the development lifecycle to accelerate delivery, improve quality, and enhance engineering productivity. 

You will: 

- Own complex networking features end to end, including requirements analysis, architecture, functional specifications, implementation, validation, and the delivery of production-quality Dell Enterprise SONiC software. 
 - Architect and deliver large-scale data center networks and AI fabric capabilities on Dell PowerSwitch (800GbE/1. 6TbE) platforms including DLC platforms. This includes RoCEv2, PFC/ECN-based congestion management, adaptive routing, MRC, SRv6 and dynamic load balancing for large-scale GPU clusters. 
 - Troubleshoot complex system, scalability, performance, and customer issues across the control plane, data plane, SAI, and switch ASIC layers. Apply Dell-provided AI tools for software development, test generation, log analysis, debugging, and documentation, while championing AI-enabled engineering and automation practices across the team. 
 - Drive automation for fabric deployment, configuration, observability, and lifecycle management using REST APIs, gNMI/OpenConfig, YANG, Python, Ansible, ONIE, and ZTP. Lead architecture, design, and code reviews; mentor engineers; and clearly communicate technical status, dependencies, and risks to stakeholders. 
 - Collaborate with global hardware, silicon, quality engineering, product management, solutions, and customer-facing teams to deliver reliable, high-quality releases through continuous integration and delivery. 

Take the first step towards your dream career

Every Dell Technologies team member brings something unique to the table. Here's what we are looking for with this role

Essential Requirements

- Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, computer engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience, with 10 to 15 years of experience developing networking software for enterprise, cloud, AI, and high-performance data center environments. 
 - Strong programming skills in C/C++ and Python on Linux, with hands-on experience in SONiC or an equivalent network operating system, including containerized NOS architecture and the Switch Abstraction Interface (SAI). 
 - Deep understanding of NPU architecture, packet processing pipeline, ACLs, QoS / buffer management, forwarding and ASIC programming through SAI/SDK and In-depth knowledge of data center networking technologies, including OSPF, IS-IS, BGP EVPN, VxLAN, SRv6, multicast, and leaf-spine architectures. 
 - Expertise in AI/HPC Ethernet fabrics, including RDMA/RoCEv2, PFC, ECN/DCQCN, DCB, adaptive routing, dynamic load balancing, and fabric telemetry on merchant-silicon-based 800GbE/1. 6TbE platforms and understanding of interoperability among GPUs, SmartNICs, and NCCL-based collective communication workloads and experience with network automation and programmability using REST APIs, gNMI/OpenConfig, YANG, Python, Ansible, ONIE/ZTP, and CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Proven ability to use AI coding assistants, LLM-based agents, and AI-assisted testing and analysis tools throughout the software development lifecycle and strong debugging and validation skills using packet captures, traffic generators such as Ixia or Spirent, switch telemetry, and diagnostic tools and demonstrated technical leadership, mentoring, and communication skills, with the ability to lead complex initiatives across multiple teams

Desirable Requirements

- Experience with open-source networking projects, AI/ML tools, or the broader AI infrastructure ecosystem and familiarity with Dell AI Factory solutions, PowerEdge AI servers, NVMe/TCP storage fabrics, and Kubernetes- or Slurm-based AI/HPC clusters. 
 - Experience validating large-scale AI fabrics for performance, congestion management, resiliency, scalability, and interoperability and ability to manage multiple complex initiatives effectively in a global, cross-functional engineering environment

data.title: Staff Site Reliability Engineer
data.description:
Location Details: Remote, India

This is a remote position, so you'll be working remotely from your home. You may occasionally visit a GoDaddy office to meet with your team for events or meetings. 

Join Our Team. . . 

The Enablement team builds and operates the Linux Patching Automation (LPA) platform - a multi-cluster AWX automation system that patches every Linux host across GoDaddy's fleet. What started as a single-DC patching tool is now a multi-cluster, AI-integrated remediation system spanning multiple data centers. The team owns observability tooling (Loki, Mimir, Grafana, Alloy), ServiceNow integrations, and a system designed to identify and address vulnerabilities!

We need a Staff Engineer whose scope matches the platform's. This role owns the Automation Mesh multi-DC architecture, takes the AI-assisted vulnerability remediation pipeline from MVP to production, and establishes LPA's first service-level objectives and error budget framework. At this level you determine your own methods and procedures, shape the roadmap, and are the recognized technical voice for LPA across partner teams!

What You'll Get To Do. . . 

- Own the Automation Mesh multi-DC architecture - failure domain reasoning, distributed locking, graceful degradation, and concurrency with LB-aware draining across data centers. 
 - Take the AI-assisted vulnerability triage and remediation pipeline from MVP to production: define triage accuracy SLOs, implement guard rails against mis-classified CI types, and expand coverage beyond the initial OS vulnerability scope. 
 - Own and drive down LPA onboarding lead time - establish cluster provisioning patterns, self-service runbooks, and a clear onboarding contract so what currently takes weeks completes in days. Define and own the platform's testing strategy - unit tests, molecule tests, and Execution Environment smoke-test contracts; close the open architectural decision on integration testing and build the foundation that lets the platform scale without quality regressions. 
 - Evolve LPA dashboards to fully replace legacy compliance reporting tooling; build alerting that surfaces patching SLA risk before it becomes a vulnerability ticket. Define LPA's first service-level objectives - patch delivery latency, automation success rate, alert-to-remediation lead time - and instrument them against an error budget, transforming LPA from a best-effort automation tool into a reliability-accountable platform. 
 - Mentor engineers on the team, lead cross-functional program delivery, and communicate architectural decisions to platform consumers and partner teams. Lead the team's AI tooling practice - co-authoring commits with LLMs is the team norm; the Staff Engineer sets the standard for how it's done. 

Your Experience Should Include. . . 

- 10+ years of hands-on SRE, platform engineering, or infrastructure engineering experience, including Staff or Principal-level scope. 
 - Ansible at scale - roles, collections, Execution Environment container builds, and lint pipelines; designing reusable role libraries, not just running playbooks. 
 - AWX / Ansible Automation Platform - Automation Mesh, Execution Environments, RBAC, and credential types; must have owned the platform at the architecture level, not just consumed it. 
 - Terraform / IaC - full infra-as-code lifecycle: cluster provisioning via tfvars-driven modules on OpenStack or comparable private cloud. 
 - Kubernetes / K3s operations - cordon/drain, etcd quorum, K8s-aware patching coordination; not just Helm deploys. 
 - ServiceNow integration - CMDB as dynamic inventory, Change Order workflows, VIT/vulnerability tracking; direct REST/API experience required. 
 - Systems architecture and distributed design - fault-tolerant, redundant systems at division scope: concurrency, locking, failure domains. 
 - AI / LLM integration in operations - LLM API integration in workflows; architecture-level AI application, not just prompt writing. 
 - Grafana / Prometheus / Mimir / Loki - building dashboards and alerting rules, not just reading them. 
 - Python scripting - owns and extends the AI vulnerability pipeline, Slack automation tooling, and utility scripts; not optional at Staff level. 
 - SLI / SLO / error budget - must have defined and instrumented service-level objectives and used error budgets to drive reliability trade-offs. 
 - Incident commander experience - on-call rotation ownership, postmortem facilitation; at Staff level you set the incident culture, not just participate in it. 
 - Technical mentorship - documented history of leveling up engineers through code review, pairing, architectural walkthroughs, or formal mentorship. 
 - Cross-functional program leadership - shipped projects requiring alignment across multiple teams without direct authority. 

You might also have. . . 

- HashiCorp Vault - AppRole, PKI, IAM key rotation; our secrets model is Vault-first. 
 - HAProxy or other LB-aware patching / drain logic experience. 
 - Open source community participation - contributions, maintainership, or advocacy. 
 - cPanel / shared hosting fleet context - one of our larger customer segments. 
 - Formal technical decision documentation (ADR, RFC) at a prior employer. 
 - Database awareness - MySQL replica detection, Postgres-backed locking patterns. 

We encourage you to apply even if your experience or skillset doesn't align perfectly with every requirement. We value a wide range of backgrounds and transferable skills, and we are excited to support learning and growth. 

We've got your back. . . We offer a range of total rewards that may include paid time off, retirement savings (e. g. , 401k, pension schemes), bonus/incentive eligibility, equity grants, participation in our employee stock purchase plan, competitive health benefits, and other family-friendly benefits including parental leave. GoDaddy's benefits vary based on individual role and location and can be reviewed in more detail during the interview process. 

About us. . . GoDaddy is empowering everyday entrepreneurs around the world by providing the help and tools to succeed online, making opportunity more inclusive for all. GoDaddy is the place people come to name their idea, build a professional website, attract customers, sell their products and services, and manage their work. Our mission is to give our customers the tools, insights, and people to transform their ideas and personal initiative into success. To learn more about the company, visit About Us. 

At GoDaddy, we know diverse teams build better products-period. Our people and culture reflect and celebrate that sense of diversity and inclusion in ideas, experiences and perspectives. But we also know that's not enough to build true equity and belonging in our communities. That's why we prioritize integrating diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging principles into the core of how we work every day-focusing not only on our employee experience, but also our customer experience and operations. It's the best way to serve our mission of empowering entrepreneurs everywhere, and making opportunity more inclusive for all. To read more about these commitments, as well as our representation and pay equity data, check out our Diversity and Pay Parity annual report which can be found on our Diversity Careers page. 

We also embrace our diverse culture and offer a range of Employee Resource Groups (Culture). Have a side hustle? No problem. We love entrepreneurs! Most importantly, come as you are and make your own way. 

GoDaddy is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. GoDaddy will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with local and federal requirements. Refer to our full EEO policy. 

Our recruiting team is available to assist you in completing your application. If they could be helpful, please reach out to myrecruiter@godaddy. com. 

GoDaddy doesn't accept unsolicited resumes from recruiters or employment agencies.

About This Opportunity

Job Title: Software Engineer II - SRE

Location: Bangalore

Job Description

The SRE RunOps Engineer 2 is responsible for ensuring the reliability, availability, and performance of the 7NOW delivery platform and associated services through proactive monitoring, incident response, and continuous improvement initiatives. This role combines software engineering principles with operations expertise to maintain high-availability systems that support 7-Eleven's digital delivery business. The SRE RunOps Engineer 2 collaborates closely with development teams, product managers, and infrastructure engineers to implement automation, optimize system performance, and drive operational excellence. This position plays a critical role in maintaining service level objectives (SLOs) and enhancing the customer experience for 7NOW users. 

Responsibilities

- Monitor, troubleshoot, and resolve production incidents for 7NOW platform services, ensuring minimal downtime and rapid restoration of service
 - Design and implement automation solutions to reduce manual operational tasks and improve system reliability using scripting languages and infrastructure-as-code tools
 - Participate in on-call rotation to provide 24/7 support for critical production systems and respond to s and incidents
 - Collaborate with software engineering teams to improve application observability, implement monitoring solutions, and establish meaningful service level indicators (SLIs)
 - Conduct post-incident reviews and root cause analysis to identify systemic issues and implement preventive measures
 - Develop and maintain runbooks, operational documentation, and standard operating procedures for common operational scenarios
 - Optimize cloud infrastructure costs and resource utilization across AWS or Azure environments supporting the 7NOW platform
 - Implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines to enable safe and efficient deployment of application updates
 - Perform capacity planning and performance tuning to ensure systems can handle current and projected traffic loads
 - Work with security teams to implement and maintain security best practices, vulnerability remediation, and compliance requirements
 - Contribute to disaster recovery planning and execute regular testing of backup and recovery procedures
 - Mentor junior team members and share knowledge through documentation, training sessions, and code reviews

Technical Skills Required

- Proficiency in at least one programming or scripting language such as Python, Go, Bash, or PowerShell for automation and tooling development
 - Strong understanding of cloud infrastructure services including compute, storage, networking, and managed services in AWS or Azure
 - Experience with monitoring and observability tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, New Relic, or Splunk
 - Knowledge of configuration management and infrastructure-as-code tools including Terraform, Ansible, or CloudFormation
 - Solid understanding of Linux/Unix system administration, networking concepts, and distributed systems architecture
 - Experience with CI/CD tools and practices including Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, or similar platforms
 - Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills with ability to diagnose complex issues across multiple system layers
 - Excellent communication skills with ability to clearly document technical processes and explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders
 - Understanding of database technologies including SQL and NoSQL databases, performance tuning, and backup strategies
 - Knowledge of containerization, microservices architecture, and API design principles
 - Ability to work effectively in fast-paced environments with changing priorities and manage multiple concurrent initiatives
 - Experience utilizing AI to improve Observability, troubleshooting and resolution of production issues. 
 - Strong customer service orientation with focus on minimizing impact to end users and maintaining high service quality

Education & Experience

Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience

YEARS OF RELEVANT WORK EXPERIENCE: 4+

CERTIFICATIONS / LICENSES: AWS or Azure cloud certifications (Solutions Architect Associate, SysOps Administrator, or equivalent) preferred

Privileges & Perquisites

7-Eleven Global Solution Center offers a comprehensive benefits plan tailored to meet the needs and improve the overall experience of our employees, aiding in the management of both their professional and personal aspects. 

Work-Life Balance: Encouraging employees to unwind, recharge, and find balance, we offer flexible and hybrid work schedules along with diverse leave options. Supplementary allowances and compensatory days off are provided for specific work demands. 

Well-Being & Family Protection: Comprehensive medical coverage for spouses, children, and parents/in-laws, with voluntary top-up plans, OPD coverage, day care services, and access to health coaches. Additionally, an Employee Assistance Program with free, unbiased and confidential expert consultations for personal and professional issues. 

Top of Form

Wheels and Meals: Free transportation and cafeteria facilities with diverse menu options including breakfast, lunch, snacks, and beverages, customizable and health-conscious choices. 

Certification & Training Program: Sponsored training for specialized certifications. Investment in employee development through labs and learning platforms. 

Hassel free Relocation: Support and reimbursement for newly hired employees relocating to Bangalore, India.

data.title: FBS-Agile Dev Team Member III- Java Full Stack Developer
data.description:
Agile Dev Team Members have collective responsibility for the design, development, testing and/or deployment of system functionality. Agile Dev Team Member III with primarily a development discipline provides technical feasibility using a range of coding methods and adheres to coding standards to ensure consistent style and format. Ensures systems are high in code and component quality, and are easily modified to support future requirements with support and limited guidance of more senior developers or architects. Agile Dev Team Member III with primarily a testing discipline ensures the end product meets the business acceptance criteria and non -functional requirements. Defines and executes tests early, often, and at multiple levels depending on their level of experience. Based on their business products, processes and system knowledge, they provide broad level of thinking for exceptions and other unexpected ways users may interact with systems. Utilizes intermediate testing techniques and tools. 

Requirements

Exp- 4 to 6 years

Skill- Java Angular, Node. js, Rest API, GCP, GECX, 

- Demonstrates understanding to customer needs by interpreting customer needs into viable solutions, providing input into system design. 
 - Effectively writes and refines user stories, including clear and accurate acceptance criteria. Performs broad and detailed impact assessments relating people, processes and/or technology, and estimates user stories using relative sizing of story points. 
 - Supports implementation activities, troubleshooting user/system environmental issues, and training as required. Effectively supports business in building a Lean Business Case and breaking epics into features
 - Identifies and raises issues and risks with functional design. Partners with the Product Owner to confirm code and acceptance tests reflect the desired functionality. 
 - Executes Test-Driven Development (TDD) and Behavior-Driven Development (BDD) to build in quality. Agile Dev Team Member III with primarily a development discipline: Codes instructions for computer programs/objects/components; configures packaged software. 
 - Provides input into the solution design and functionality of business applications. Reviews and validates application technical design of team members. 
 - Documents and implements programs according to standards and conventions. 
 - Analyzes and makes recommendations on the need for system backup, security, restart/recovery, balancing & controls and recommends approaches for meeting such needs. 
 - Analyzes and documents the requirements and approaches to data conversion and data modeling. 
 - Quality checks program code, related objects and documentation
 - Delivers working code each sprint. 
 - Demonstrates ability to read and write simple code. 
 - Modifies code in an existing file
 - Executes basic data creation tools and reads automation test results
 - Demonstrates understanding of the fundamentals of automation tools and framework
 - Agile Dev Team Member III with primarily a testing discipline: Analyzes system and business requirements for testability. Identifies complex errors that occur in standard application testing. Develops, documents, executes, and maintains test cases and test data. 
 - Reports status of test plan execution through defect logs and defect tracking system. Defines comprehensive test plans needed to achieve appropriate level of coverage
 - Analyzes test results and assists with trouble-shooting and root cause analysis. Utilizes standard testing tools such as data creation, run batch processes and test automation tools. 
 - Provides guidance to others as needed. 
 - Applies Risk Based Testing techniques to planning and execution
 - Writes test cases describing business behavior to facilitate automation. 
 - Mentors junior team members in test planning and execution techniques. 
 - Contributes to the overall test strategy with limited ability. 
 - Assists with resolution of environmental issues. 
 - Supports application development, implementation, and user training activities, as required
 - Participates in key ceremonies to drive execution, improve flow and ensure transparency. 
 - May provide limited guidance to junior team members, when needed. 
 - Plans work via the preparation for and participation in Program Increment (PI) Planning and Sprint Planning, which includes developing and committing to Team PI Objectives and Sprint goals. 
 - Demonstrates working code to Product and Business Owners and supports the Product Owner in the execution of the iteration and PI System Demos. 
 - Actively participates in the Sprint Retrospectives and Inspect & Adapt to timely discuss opportunities for improvement and are responsible for carrying out the execution of improvement stories. 
 - Participates in Daily Stands-ups to assess progress toward sprint goals and raise impediments. 
 - Participates in on-going and scheduled Backlog Refinement sessions. Demonstrates ongoing desire for continuous improvement and building knowledge in area of expertise
 - Actively seeks out development opportunities to further develop T-shaped skills and become a more cross-functional contributor. 
 - Practices continuous exploration, continuous integration and continuous deployment necessary for building the Continuous Delivery Pipeline and implementing DevOps. 
 - Offers innovative ideas within area of focus to improve processes. Conducts ongoing assessment of current state and seeks out opportunities for improvement
 - Conducts research, design, prototyping and other exploration activities which fosters innovation and builds alignment between the customer need and what is delivered. 
 - Implements innovative ideas within area of focus. Actively participates in Agile Dev Team Member Community of Practice (CoP) and elicits contributions from group members. 
 - Plans and conducts CoP sessions. Effectively manages the communications and action items resulting from the sessions. Performs other functions as assigned

Benefits

Competitive compensation and benefits package: 

- Competitive salary and performance-based bonuses
 - Comprehensive benefits package
 - Career development and training opportunities
 - Flexible work arrangements (remote and/or office-based)
 - Dynamic and inclusive work culture within a globally renowned group
 - Private Health Insurance
 - Pension Plan
 - Paid Time Off
 - Training & Development

Note: Benefits differ based on employee level.

data.title: Senior Automation Engineer
data.description:
Department: Engineering

Location: Ahmedabad/GiftCity

Description

We are looking for a hands-on Senior Automation engineer to continuously modernize, strengthen and accelerate our test automation frameworks. This is a senior individual-contributor role for an engineer who writes excellent production-quality Python code, can diagnose complex technical problems, and turns that expertise into reliable, maintainable and fast automation infrastructure. Our automation stack includes a Python-based backend for Clear Flow in house framework and Playwright with TypeScript for frontend end-to-end testing. The successful candidate will lead framework design and evolution, improve test reliability and execution speed, strengthen CI integration, and mentor other engineers. Experience testing financial technology or trading systems is highly desirable. 

What You'll Be Doing

- Lead continuous framework modernization: Own the technical direction and ongoing improvement of our automation frameworks, libraries, utilities and test architecture. 
 - Write high-quality Python: Develop and review robust, readable, efficient Python code for backend automation, framework services, test utilities and integrations. 
 - Improve performance and scalability: Profile and reduce test execution time; identify bottlenecks in setup, data handling, environment interaction and parallel execution; improve resource use without sacrificing reliability. 
 - Increase test reliability: Reduce flaky tests, improve diagnostics and failure reporting, strengthen logging and debugging support, and make failures easier to reproduce and resolve. 
 - Develop end-to-end automation: Maintain and improve Playwright/TypeScript UI automation and ensure effective integration with Python-based backend testing. 
 - Improve CI/CD integration: Make automated suites easier to run and troubleshoot in CI pipelines; improve test selection, reporting, repeatability and feedback time. 
 - Design for maintainability: Apply sound object-oriented design, modular architecture, reusable abstractions, clear interfaces and appropriate design patterns-avoiding unnecessary complexity. 
 - Work across teams: Partner with software engineers, quality engineers and infrastructure teams to investigate failures, improve testability and prevent defects earlier. 
 - Provide technical leadership: Mentor engineers through code reviews, design discussions, partnership and practical guidance; establish coding standards and framework-development practices. 
 - Measure impact: Use meaningful metrics such as execution duration, flakiness, failure diagnosis time, framework adoption and regression coverage to prioritize improvements. 
 - Support quality strategy: help with product testing when needed as well help determine where automation provides the greatest value, while retaining sound test design and appropriate exploration or manual testing where needed. 

Essential Skills

- Strong, hands-on Python programming skills. You should be comfortable designing, implementing, debugging, profiling and refactoring non-trivial code-not just writing test scripts. 
 - Typically, 8+ years of relevant software engineering, test automation or framework-development experience, including substantial ownership of automation frameworks. 
 - Demonstrated experience designing and evolving reusable automation frameworks, test libraries or developer tooling used by multiple engineers or teams. 
 - Strong software engineering fundamentals: data structures, algorithms, object-oriented design, modularity, error handling, testing, debugging and clean-code practices. 
 - Experience building and maintaining integration-level, API or backend automated tests. 
 - Practical experience with Playwright and TypeScript for front end-end end-to-end automation, or the ability to demonstrate equivalent depth and quickly contribute to this stack. 
 - Experience with Git, code reviews, CI/CD pipelines and collaborative Agile software development. 
 - Ability to investigate complex failures across application code, test code, test data, environments and infrastructure. 
 - Strong communication and mentoring skills, with the ability to explain design trade-offs and raise engineering quality across a team. 

Desired Skills

data.title: Global IT Software Engineer Senior Manager & Chapter Lead
data.description:
Who We Are

Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact. 

To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures-and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive. 

What You'll Do

As a Global IT Software Engineer Senior Manager and Chapter Lead within BCG's Global Services organization, you will lead a team of software engineers responsible for designing, developing, and delivering secure, scalable, and reliable technology solutions. You will provide technical direction across custom software development, cloud-native applications, data platforms, and enterprise integrations, helping teams translate business needs into high-quality engineering outcomes. 

You will combine deep technical expertise with strong people leadership to establish engineering standards, guide architectural decisions, and oversee the delivery of complex technology initiatives. As a Chapter Lead, you will build engineering capabilities, develop talent, and foster a collaborative, inclusive environment that encourages innovation, continuous learning, and technical excellence across global teams. 

Key Responsibilities

- Lead engineering architecture and technical direction: Guide solution design and architectural decisions across custom applications, AWS cloud-native technologies, Snowflake, Python, and MuleSoft, ensuring scalability, maintainability, and alignment with enterprise architecture principles. 
 - Drive software engineering excellence: Establish and promote engineering standards, design patterns, code quality practices, testing approaches, and modern development methodologies to deliver secure, reliable, and maintainable solutions. 
 - Oversee technology delivery: Lead the planning and execution of complex software engineering initiatives, managing delivery priorities, technical dependencies, resources, risks, and quality to achieve agreed business outcomes. 
 - Advance cloud-native development and integration: Guide teams in building and modernizing applications, data solutions, APIs, and enterprise integrations using AWS, Snowflake, Python, and MuleSoft, with an emphasis on performance, interoperability, and operational resilience. 
 - Embed security into engineering practices: Partner with security and architecture teams to incorporate application security, cloud security, access controls, data protection, and risk management principles throughout the software development lifecycle. 
 - Lead and develop engineering talent: Manage and mentor software engineers through regular coaching, performance feedback, career development, and capability-building initiatives, creating opportunities for individual and team growth. 
 - Strengthen global collaboration: Partner with technology leaders, product teams, architects, security specialists, and business colleagues across regions to align engineering priorities, resolve complex technical challenges, and support successful delivery. 
 - Drive continuous improvement: Evaluate emerging technologies, improve engineering processes, encourage knowledge sharing, and introduce practical improvements that strengthen development productivity, solution quality, and long-term engineering capabilities. 

What You'll Bring

- 10+ years of software engineering experience, including custom application development, architecture, and technical leadership. 
 - Strong expertise in cloud-native engineering and AWS, with proficiency in Python and modern development practices. 
 - Working knowledge across Snowflake, MuleSoft, API development, and enterprise integration technologies. 
 - Solid understanding of application security, cloud security, data protection, and secure software development principles. 
 - Demonstrated experience managing complex engineering projects, technical dependencies, delivery risks, and solution quality. 
 - Proven people leadership skills, including managing engineers, coaching, performance management, and developing technical capabilities. 
 - Strong problem-solving, communication, and influencing skills, with experience collaborating across global, cross-functional teams. 

Who You'll Work With

You will be part of BCG's Global IT organization within Global Services, working with a global community of software engineering and development professionals. You will collaborate closely with enterprise and solution architects, cybersecurity and cloud infrastructure teams, product owners, and business technology teams to deliver secure, scalable, and reliable technology solutions. As a Chapter Lead, you will foster an inclusive and collaborative engineering environment, encouraging knowledge sharing, technical excellence, and continuous development across globally distributed teams.

Its SaaS and payments platform supports ongoing investment in platform modernization, API-first integration, real-time data access, and AI-enabled automation. 

Role summary

Alegeus is seeking an experienced, hands-on Technical Lead to guide software projects from discovery through production support. You will translate business needs into sound technical designs, lead implementation, and take responsibility for delivery, quality, and operational readiness. The role calls for strong . NET and SQL Server expertise, practical Azure experience, and event-driven integration experience. You will work with product, business, architecture, QA, DevOps, and operations partners, mentor engineers, and keep stakeholders informed of progress, decisions, and risks. 

Key responsibilities

Technical leadership and delivery

- Lead technical delivery from requirements analysis and design through development, testing, deployment, and production support. 
 - Translate business needs into clear technical designs, identify options and trade-offs, and guide the team toward maintainable solutions. 
 - Break work into deliverable components, coordinate dependencies, track progress, communicate decisions, and raise risks early. 
 - Partner with product managers, product owners, and business stakeholders to understand customer needs and the purpose behind requested features. 
 - Collaborate across architecture, QA, infrastructure, DevOps, and operations to deliver reliable end-to-end solutions. 
 - Mentor engineers through design discussions, code reviews, debugging, and knowledge sharing; promote strong engineering practices. 

Platform modernization and engineering

- Maintain, troubleshoot, and enhance the existing ASP. NET/C# and SQL Server platform, including stored procedures and T-SQL code. 
 - Design and deliver C#/. NET services and REST APIs using microservices and event-driven patterns. 
 - Contribute to domain decomposition, domain modeling, and domain-driven design (DDD) as the platform evolves. 
 - Use Azure services such as App Service, Service Bus, and Azure SQL Database; support integration with messaging platforms such as Kafka, RabbitMQ, Azure Service Bus, or Event Hubs. 
 - Ensure interoperability and data consistency between legacy applications and new services during modernization. 
 - Use source control and CI/CD pipelines to support dependable builds, deployments, and releases. 

Quality, security, and operations

- Champion test-driven development and maintain automated unit, integration, and regression tests. 
 - Lead code reviews, static analysis, refactoring, and test automation to improve maintainability and prevent regressions. 
 - Apply secure SDLC practices, use OWASP guidance to identify and address vulnerabilities, and design appropriate authentication and authorization controls such as OAuth 2. 0, OpenID Connect, SSO, and RBAC. 
 - Protect APIs through token validation, input validation, rate limiting, and safeguards against injection and related attacks. 
 - Troubleshoot production issues, support incident resolution, and improve application reliability and performance. 
 - Document system behavior and technical decisions to support maintenance and future upgrades. 

Product mindset and continuous improvement

- Consider customer and business outcomes when evaluating technical approaches, and explain trade-offs clearly to technical and non-technical partners. 
 - Identify opportunities to improve architecture, engineering processes, performance, and operational support. 
 - Stay current with cloud engineering, microservices, event-driven architecture, and responsible use of AI-assisted software development tools. 

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - 12 or more years of professional software engineering experience at a software product company, including substantial experience building and supporting enterprise applications with Microsoft technologies. Candidates from services or consulting backgrounds should have product-engineering experience in healthcare payments or a similar domain. 
 - At least 2 years leading technical delivery for projects or teams, with demonstrated ownership from requirements through production. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with C#, . NET Framework, and . NET Core or modern . NET; experience designing REST APIs and service-oriented or microservice applications. 
 - Strong database skills, particularly Microsoft SQL Server, including T-SQL, stored procedures, schema design, indexing, query optimization, and performance troubleshooting; experience with PL/SQL is also required. 
 - Experience with microservices and asynchronous messaging, using one or more of Kafka, RabbitMQ, Azure Service Bus, or Azure Event Hubs. Kafka experience is preferred. 
 - Practical experience deploying or supporting solutions on Microsoft Azure or another cloud platform, along with modern DevOps practices such as CI/CD, containerization, and infrastructure as code. 
 - Experience across the software development lifecycle and Agile practices, including analysis, design, testing, code review, debugging, deployment, and production support. 
 - Demonstrated ability to understand and troubleshoot legacy C#, SQL, PL/SQL, and stored procedure code using source, tests, and appropriate discovery tools. 
 - Strong communication and presentation skills, including the ability to explain technical topics and decisions in business terms. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience modernizing monolithic applications into domain-oriented microservices using DDD. 
 - Experience in healthcare, consumer benefits, or payment processing; familiarity with claims, eligibility, or EHR workflows is useful. 
 - Familiarity with HIPAA requirements and security considerations for healthcare or payment data. 
 - Experience with container orchestration, such as Kubernetes or AKS. 
 - Experience using generative AI tools for code, tests, or documentation. 
 - Working knowledge of HTML and JavaScript. 

What success looks like

The Technical Lead makes sound technical decisions, keeps delivery predictable, and surfaces issues early. Projects move from clear requirements to production with maintainable code, reliable integrations, effective testing, and operational readiness. Engineers understand the goals, take ownership of their work, and deliver features that create customer and business value. 

Why join Alegeus

Join a team modernizing a large-scale consumer-directed healthcare platform that supports Alegeus' mission to simplify healthcare payments. Be technically responsible for all products.

data.description:
To make electronics, you need chips, wafers, transistors, reticles, and. . . To make these, you must see, test and manufacture them at scale-faster and better than ever before. That's where KLA comes in. Whether you're early in your career or an experienced professional, you'll solve complex challenges, work alongside brilliant minds and help shape the future of technology. 

Group/Division

The KLA Services team consists of Service Sales, Marketing, Spares Supply Chain Management, Field Operations, Engineering, Product Training, Digital Solutions and Analytics, and Technical Product Support. Our services organization maximizes the value of our customers' KLA assets - with highly trained service and product support engineers providing installation services and 24/7 technical support and parts delivery through our extensive supply chain network. 

What You'll Do

In this role, you will play a key part in advancing business priorities by delivering high-impact work across your area of expertise. 

KLA is a global leader in diversified electronics for the semiconductor manufacturing ecosystem. Virtually every electronic device in the world is produced using our technologies. No laptop, smartphone, wearable device, voice-controlled gadget, flexible screen, VR device or smart car would have made it into your hands without us. KLA invents systems and solutions for the manufacturing of wafers and reticles, integrated circuits, packaging, printed circuit boards and flat panel displays. 

The innovative ideas and devices that are advancing humanity all begin with inspiration, research and development. KLA focuses more than average on innovation and in 2019 we invested 15% of sales back into R&D. Our expert teams of physicists, engineers, data scientists and problem-solvers work together with the world's leading technology providers to accelerate the delivery of tomorrow's electronic devices. Life here is exciting and our teams thrive on tackling really hard problems. There is never a dull moment with us. 

The Global Service Support Organization (GSS) team headquartered in Milpitas, CA, is our service organization that consists of Service Sales and Marketing, Spares Supply Chain management, Field Operations, Engineering, Product Training, and Technical Support. The GSS organization partners with our field teams and customers in all business sectors to maintain the high performance and productivity of our products through a flexible portfolio of services. Our comprehensive services include: proactive management of tools to identify and improve performance; expertise in optics, image processing and motion control with worldwide service engineers, 24/7 technical support teams and knowledge management systems; and an extensive parts network to ensure worldwide availability of parts. 

The GSS organization's Engineering group develops data systems for improved diagnostics and predictive maintenance. The data systems monitor the performance of fleets of KLA test and measurement equipment in semiconductor fabrication plant environments. They collect, transform, and store data. They provide visualizations, recommendations based on analytics, and alerts. This exciting position will enable you to interact with a wide variety of engineers and KLA system data. 

Responsibilities: 

Do you have a passion for coding, data exploration, and UI design? Are you looking for a role where you can develop reactive, modern user interfaces working with highly collaborative teams?

As a Software engineer, you will work with our team of software, data and algorithm engineers on the design and development of web applications using real-time data visualization tools. Collaborating with domain experts and software engineers, you will gather requirements, translate user needs to design and develop software specifications, select software components, follow best coding practices, and develop User Interfaces that help our engineers to more effectively monitor, diagnose and optimize KLA semiconductor inspection and metrology equipment.

- Strong computer science fundamentals (data structures and algorithms)
 - Proficiency in web technologies such as HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and libraries/frameworks such as Angular, React, Vue, etc. 
 - Proficiency in one or more backend languages such as C#, C++, Java, Python etc. 
 - Experience developing clean, efficient, and performant user interfaces
 - Full stack development experience
 - Strong communication skills

Desired qualifications: 

- Familiarity with Human Centered Design, and interest in working with users to understand their needs and building interfaces to meet them
 - Experience using charting libraries such as D3, Chart. js
 - Experience with REST interfaces
 - Ability to structure and build complex client-side applications
 - Familiarity with NodeJS, ASP. NET Core, Django or similar back end frameworks
 - Experience working in a service-oriented or microservice architecture
 - Experience with modern software engineering practices (XP)
 - Experience using artificial intelligence in software engineering
 - Experience working in a service-oriented or microservice architecture

Minimum Qualifications

Master's Level Degree and 0 years related work experience; Bachelor's Level Degree and related work experience of 2 years

About KLA

We provide advanced inspection tools, metrology systems, process solutions, and computational analytics that make electronics possible, tackling complex challenges. From electron and photon optics to machine learning and data analytics, we seek perfection at the most fundamental level of matter in the universe. If you want to make electronics that push industries forward and make the world a better place, join us.

data.title: Head Quality_Power Systems Substation 400KV
data.description:
Company Description HARTEK, established in 1991, is a leading Engineering, Procurement, and Construction (EPC) company operating across the energy value chain in India. The organization works through three strategic business units: Power Systems, Renewables, and Power Distribution Products. Its Power Systems business has delivered more than 400 EHV and HV substations up to 765 kV, while the Renewables division has connected over 10 GW of solar capacity to the national grid, placing HARTEK among India's top solar EPC players. The company also manufactures smart electrical switchboard panels for industries, buildings, and data centers. As a seven-time Great Place to Work certified organization, HARTEK focuses on strengthening India's energy backbone and building a brighter future for its stakeholders. 
Role Description The Head Quality - Power Systems Substation 400 kV is a full-time, on-site role based in the Mohali district. This role oversees end-to-end quality assurance and quality control activities for 400 kV substation projects, ensuring compliance with internal standards, client specifications, and regulatory requirements. Day-to-day responsibilities include defining and implementing quality management plans, supervising inspections and testing, monitoring contractor and vendor performance, and conducting root cause analyses for non-conformities. The role also involves leading quality audits, maintaining documentation, and driving continuous improvement initiatives across design, procurement, construction, and commissioning stages. The Head Quality collaborates closely with engineering, project management, and site teams to ensure safe, reliable, and timely project delivery.

- Candidates should possess strong Quality Assurance and Quality Control skills, with experience in setting and enforcing standards for high-voltage substation projects. 
 - Candidates should possess Quality Auditing skills, including planning and executing internal and external audits and managing corrective and preventive actions. 
 - Candidates should possess well-developed Analytical Skills for interpreting technical data, identifying trends in quality performance, and supporting root cause analysis. 
 - Candidates should possess effective Communication skills for coordinating with cross-functional teams, vendors, and clients, and for preparing clear reports and documentation. 
 - Relevant experience in power systems, EHV/HV substations (preferably 220 kV and above, with strong exposure to 400 kV), and EPC project environments. 
 - Bachelor's degree or higher in Electrical Engineering or a related discipline; professional certifications in quality management (e. g. , ISO, Six Sigma) are an advantage. 
 - Proven ability to lead quality teams, manage multiple projects, and work on-site at substations and project locations as required. 
 - Familiarity with national and international standards for power systems, safety regulations, and utility/client specifications.
