data.title: Senior Platform Quality and Observability Engineer
data.description:
- Experience: 9+ years in software or quality engineering, including 6+ years building test automation, performance testing or observability for production distributed systems, with ownership of the results. Experience limited to manual testing or tool administration does not meet this requirement. 
 - Observability: OpenTelemetry instrumentation, collectors, context propagation and the GenAI semantic conventions. Structured logging and metrics. Cloud monitoring platforms such as Azure Monitor and Application Insights, with log query languages such as KQL at depth, dashboards and alert design. LLM observability platforms such as Langfuse or LangSmith, including SDK integrations and management APIs. 
 - Performance engineering: Load, soak and stress test design, workload modeling, percentiles rather than averages, bottleneck analysis across CPU, memory, connection pools and rate limits, capacity statements, and tooling such as Locust, k6, JMeter or Azure Load Testing. 
 - Benchmarking and measurement: Experimental design with controls, labeled datasets with expected results, precision, recall, F1 and confusion matrices, the limits of small samples, reproducibility, and controlled comparison of detectors, models or prompts. 
 - Test engineering: Unit, integration, contract and end-to-end suites designed from requirements, mocking and test data strategy, integration into CI, and the discipline to keep suites deterministic. 
 - LLM evaluation and agent fluency: LLM API mechanics, tokens and cost, agent loops and tool calls as they appear in a trace, retrieval, evaluation with golden datasets and judge rubrics using tools such as promptfoo, DeepEval or RAGAS, and the role of an AI gateway and guardrails such as PII detection. 
 - Technical specification and writing: Writing technical specifications, acceptance criteria and test plans from product requirements, maintaining traceability between them, and producing design documents, findings and runbooks that are accurate, concise, state numbers with their limits, and are usable by engineers, reviewers and AI coding tools. 
 - Python engineering: Typed, asynchronous Python with production HTTP clients, package design and publishing, pytest with fixtures and mocks, command-line tooling, and data analysis libraries such as pandas. Ability to work productively in other languages when the work requires it, using AI coding tools to accelerate the transition while holding the same engineering standard. 
 - Distributed systems literacy: Working knowledge of the request lifecycle across gateway, service and store, including retries, timeouts and idempotency, queues and caches, sufficient to instrument services correctly, interpret traces and contribute to design discussions. 
 - Identity and access: OAuth 2. 0, OpenID Connect and JWT, managed identities and workload identity, sufficient to authenticate test clients, scheduled jobs and dashboards, and to diagnose authentication and authorization failures. 
 - Data and storage: SQL, log and time-series stores, the backing stores of observability tooling, such as PostgreSQL, ClickHouse, Redis and object storage, at an operational level, and immutable storage and retention concepts. 
 - Cloud and delivery: Docker, Kubernetes including scheduled jobs with workload identity, CI/CD pipelines such as Azure DevOps, working proficiency in Terraform or comparable infrastructure-as-code tooling, and working inside private networks with no internet egress. 
 - AI-native delivery: Fluent use of AI coding agents to accelerate harness and tooling development, with every output reviewed, tested and understood before it is submitted. 
 - Communication: Professional command of spoken and written English, with the ability to explain designs, problems and trade-offs clearly to technical and non-technical audiences, give and receive feedback articulately, restate technical direction accurately, and raise risks early and in writing. 

PREFERRED

- LLM observability platforms: Self-hosting, scaling and upgrading an LLM observability platform such as Langfuse, including its scoring and dataset APIs. 
 - Evaluation tooling: Extending an evaluation framework such as promptfoo with custom providers and assertions, and deploying its self-hosted or enterprise edition with pipeline integration. 
 - Guardrail evaluation: Benchmarking PII detection or content safety services on labeled data. 
 - Cost attribution: Chargeback or showback reporting for a shared platform service. 
 - Reliability engineering: Service level objectives, error budgets and alert tuning for a shared platform. 
 - Regulated industry: Financial services or another regulated industry, including audit and record-keeping obligations.

Job Description

As a Test Automation Engineer, you will design and implement automation solutions that validate system behavior across UI, APIs, and integrations. You will contribute to building a robust quality engineering ecosystem by integrating automated testing into CI/CD pipelines and supporting continuous delivery. 

In this role, you will translate requirements into effective test strategies, combining automation with manual, exploratory, and integration testing to ensure comprehensive quality coverage across all application layers. 

This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys hands-on coding, solving complex validation challenges, and improving system quality at scale, while taking ownership of end-to-end quality outcomes and collaborating closely with cross-functional teams. 

Responsibilities

Automation Development & Framework Ownership

- Design, develop, and own scalable test automation frameworks and reusable components

 - UI (Web/Mobile)
 - API and integration layers
 - Ensure automation solutions are maintainable, reliable, and extensible across teams

Test Strategy & Implementation

- Translate requirements into automation-ready test scenarios, test data, and validation strategies
 - Contribute to test strategy, coverage planning, and quality goals
 - Identify test gaps and proactively mitigate risks
 - Perform automation feasibility analysis to determine optimal test approach (manual vs automated)

Delivery & Execution Excellence

- Execute a balanced mix of automated and manual tests aligned with sprint goals, ensuring comprehensive validation across functional, integration, and edge-case scenarios. 
 - Contribute to task breakdown, estimation, and sprint commitments
 - Proactively raise risks, blockers, and testability concerns

Manual & Functional Testing

- Design, document, and execute detailed test cases and test scenarios

 - Validate end-to-end workflows and business scenarios
 - Identify edge cases and usability issues through exploratory testing
 - Ensure test coverage for areas not suitable for automation

Quality, Standards & Engineering Practices

- Write clean, testable, and maintainable automation code
 - Participate in code reviews and continuous improvement of automation frameworks
 - Ensure adherence to Definition of Ready (DoR) and Definition of Done (DoD)
 - Take ownership of end-to-end quality outcomes across assigned areas

CI/CD & DevOps Integration

 - Enable continuous testing and shift-left quality practices

Non-Functional Testing

- Contribute to performance, reliability, and resilience testing

Observability & Debuggability

- Leverage logs, metrics, and traces to improve test reliability

Test Data & Environment Management

- Design and manage test data strategies and datasets

Incident & Operational Support

Collaboration & Growth

Qualifications

Technical Skills

The Solution Architect provides technical leadership and designs complex solution architectures that support business strategy and streamline technology-enabled workflows. This role partners closely with business owners, product, data, and engineering teams to document current-state systems and design scalable, resilient, and secure cloud-based solutions. This position focuses on emerging technologies, including AI, Generative AI, and machine learning, and guides solutions from research and analysis through architecture, delivery support, and operational readiness. 

What You Will Do

- Lead discovery with business and technology partners to understand objectives, constraints, current-state systems, and integration points. 
 - Document current-state architecture and define target-state designs including system context diagrams, component designs, integration patterns, and data flows. 
 - Design and modernize applications into cloud-compatible or cloud-native architectures using microservices, serverless, and event-driven patterns where appropriate. 
 - Create strategies, roadmaps, and migration designs for transitioning applications and data workloads to cloud platforms. 
 - Design AI and ML-enabled solutions, including model integration into products and business processes, and patterns for scalable inference and low-latency serving where needed. 
 - Design Generative AI solution patterns, such as retrieval-augmented generation, tool and API integration, prompt and context management, and evaluation approaches. 
 - Define reference architectures for AI platforms and enabling capabilities, such as data pipelines, feature and embedding generation, vector storage, model endpoints, and integration with enterprise APIs. 
 - Define integration patterns for agent toolchains using standards and common approaches such as Model Context Protocol (MCP), skills and plugin manifest standards, function calling with JSON Schema tool definitions, OpenAPI-based tool specifications, and event-driven or message-based tool execution patterns. Ensure integrations address authentication and authorization, data minimization, auditability, and isolation boundaries. 
 - Incorporate security-by-design practices into architectures, including identity and access controls, encryption, secrets management, secure networking, and audit logging. 
 - Partner with governance and risk stakeholders to ensure responsible AI considerations are incorporated, including privacy, explainability, safety, compliance, and model risk controls as applicable. 
 - Drive alignment and adoption of proposed solutions by clearly communicating tradeoffs, risks, and value and obtaining stakeholder alignment and governance approvals. Selling means internal alignment and decision support, not external pre-sales. 
 - Support teams responsible for testing and validation and help triage and resolve design-related issues found during development, UAT, or production. 
 - Perform other duties as assigned

What You Will Bring

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Mathematics, Business, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - 5+ years of experience in agile software delivery environments with increasing architecture and design responsibility. 
 - Demonstrated experience designing distributed systems using microservices and or serverless patterns. 
 - Experience designing and integrating AI and ML capabilities into applications, including model serving considerations and data dependencies. 
 - Experience with one or more languages such as Java, Python, Node. js, or Scala. 
 - Experience with data persistence technologies across SQL and NoSQL. 
 - Experience with at least one major cloud provider, AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud, and core cloud design patterns. 
 - Working knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices, including automated testing and deployment automation. 
 - Strong communication skills and ability to translate business needs into clear technical direction. 

What Will Set You Apart

- Hands-on experience with GenAI and LLM solutions, including retrieval-augmented generation, embeddings, evaluation, and production monitoring. 
 - Experience with AI and ML platforms or services, such as AWS SageMaker, Amazon Bedrock, Azure AI, Azure OpenAI, or Google Vertex AI. 
 - Familiarity with MCP-based integrations and related agent tool standards, including skills and plugin manifests, function calling schemas, and OpenAPI-defined tools, plus secure enterprise integration patterns. 
 - Container and orchestration experience, such as Docker and Kubernetes, and cloud container platforms like ECS or EKS. 
 - Experience with vector databases and search technologies and associated indexing and retrieval patterns. 
 - Experience with enterprise observability, including centralized logging, tracing, metrics, alerting, and operational readiness. 
 - Database and procedural development experience, including PL/SQL, and strong data modeling concepts. 
 - Familiarity with responsible AI practices, governance controls, and security considerations specific to AI systems.

data.description:
About Us

As a Fortune 50 company with more than 400, 000 team members worldwide, Target is an iconic brand and one of America's leading retailers. At Target, we have a timeless purpose and a proven strategy and that hasn't happened by accident. Some of the best minds from diverse backgrounds come together at Target to redefine retail in an inclusive learning environment that values people and delivers world-class outcomes. That winning formula is especially apparent in Bengaluru, where Target in India operates as a fully integrated part of Target's global team and has more than 4, 000 team members supporting the company's global strategy and operations. 

Target Tech Overview

Every time a guest enters a Target store or browses Target. com, they experience the impact of Target's investments in technology and innovation. We're the technologists behind one of the most loved retail brands, delivering joy to millions of our guests, team members, and communities. 

Our global in-house technology team of more than 5, 000 of engineers, data scientists, architects, coaches and product managers strive to make Target the most convenient, safe and joyful place to shop. We use agile practices and leverage open-source software to adapt and build best-in-class technology for our team members and guests-and we do so with a focus on diversity and inclusion, experimentation and continuous learning. 

Pyramid Overview

The Cloud Enablement team builds and operates the foundational public cloud platform that engineering teams across Target rely on to deliver at enterprise scale. Working primarily on Google Cloud Platform (GCP), the team owns a hardened, standardized cloud foundation spanning compute, Kubernetes, storage, networking, and identity - the core building blocks that power Target's digital and data-driven experiences. Our mission is to make cloud simple, secure, and cost-effective to consume: we design the opinionated patterns, policies, and guardrails that keep workloads safe and reliable, and we build the APIs, automation, and self-service tooling that let teams adopt and scale cloud services with confidence. Following an infrastructure-as-code philosophy, we treat repeatability, resilience, and security as first-class engineering outcomes rather than afterthoughts. We partner closely with platform and product teams to onboard new workloads, drive cloud cost stewardship, and continuously raise the bar on operational excellence, availability, and readiness for our highest-traffic events. As a lead engineer on this team, you'll help shape cloud strategy, architect platform capabilities and tooling, and set technical direction that multiplies the productivity of engineers across the company - a high-impact role at the center of how Target builds in the cloud. 

As a Senior Engineer on the Cloud Enablement team, you'll contribute: 

What You'll Do

 - Establish and evolve engineering standards and best practices for monitoring, testing, automation, security, and maintenance of cloud platform components, infrastructure services, and shared engineering capabilities. 
 - Maintain a strong understanding of the organization's technical capabilities, cloud infrastructure, platform services, and broader technology environment. 

Required Qualifications

 - 6+ years of experience in software development (Golang), cloud engineering (Google Cloud), platform engineering, DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), or infrastructure engineering, with a focus on cloud services.

Risk, controls and governance

 - Make sure business logic extracted by AI is checked by subject-matter experts and confirmed through reconciliation before go-live. 

People and capability

- Hire, coach and grow a permanent full-stack engineering team, and build AI fluency across the team. 
 - Manage vendor and temporary capacity and make sure knowledge transfers to permanent staff. 

Required Experience And Skills

- 15+ years in software engineering, still actively coding, with 5+ years leading engineering teams on modernization or cloud migration programmes. 
 - Java: expert in Java 17+, Spring Boot, JPA, REST API design, Kafka/IBM MQ messaging and performance tuning. 
 - DevOps: practical experience with CI/CD (Harness, Jenkins or GitHub Actions), Terraform, Docker, Kubernetes/ECS/EKS, Git workflows, automated testing and quality gates. 
 - AWS: compute, networking, IAM and managed services, and how to design for HA/DR. 
 - Databases: strong SQL; experience with Oracle and with migrating from Sybase or SQL Server. 
 - AI: proven hands-on use of AI coding assistants and agents in delivery, with measurable results. 
 - Comfort reading and reverse-engineering legacy code (COBOL, C/C++, PowerBuilder). 
 - Experience delivering in a regulated financial services environment. 

Preferred

- Knowledge of investment servicing or middle-office areas: trade capture, confirmation, settlement, collateral, reconciliation, investment accounting. 
 - Experience building MCP servers, knowledge graphs or retrieval-augmented context for engineering agents. 
 - AWS Professional-level or equivalent certification. 

Success measures (first 12-18 months)

- Personally delivered production code and reference implementations across the front end, back end and pipelines. 
 - An AI-augmented delivery model running across the programme, with productivity gains measured against a baseline.

 - A permanent full-stack team in place, able to run and evolve the new platform.

data.title: Quality Assurance Engineer, Prime Video Sports
data.description:
Description

Love sports? Want to change the world? Prime Video is re-inventing the live sports experience by merging high-quality live streaming, immersive interactive features, and exclusive access to some of the world's most loved sports properties - including the NFL, NBA, English Premier League and UEFA Champions League soccer, Rolland-Garros (French Open), the US Open and more. Every day we face the challenges of a fast-paced market and expanding technology set. And we're building at a scale only Amazon is capable of. The Prime Video Sports team is a single-threaded-owner, uniquely positioned to execute our vision across the entire Prime Video stack to deliver the most compelling new experiences to our customers. If this sounds like the type of experience you'd like to help build - apply here and let's chat!

Who We Are

We are deeply connected with the idea that live sports events are fundamentally different: there is only one shot at delivering the moment until it is forever lost. Our mission is to make sure that our customers never miss a single moment of the sports they love. To do this we need to deliver best-in-class live sports infrastructure, testing, monitoring, and operations to optimize the delivery of live sports experiences at scale. Our team engineers for speed, quality, availability, and scale. As Prime Video has grown, we've increased the depth and breadth of video products we support, with a corresponding increase in the associated size and complexity of our engineering activity and the load on our services. Our goal is to adapt our architecture to maintain and improve our velocity of delivery for customers in the face of these changes, and for our services to be on and error-free 24/7, especially for high-profile, exclusive content. With AI as a transformative force, we're at an inflection point that enables us to unlock new opportunities in predictive analytics, automated defect analysis and mitigation, and automated operations that were previously beyond our reach. 

What We're Looking For

We are looking for an experienced QA engineer to drive manual and automated testing within Prime Video Sports across a broad technology stack. This role involves deep involvement on projects from design to development & deployment. In this role, you will have the opportunity to contribute significantly to the future of the Prime Video Sports customer experience. Successful candidates for this position demonstrate ability to multi-task, quickly adapt to new development environments and changing business requirements, learn new systems, create reliable/maintainable automated tests, find creative and scalable solutions to difficult problems, and ability to communicate clearly and concisely both written and orally. If you are the one that's excited about entrepreneurial thinking, creating technology solutions for complex problems we want to hear from you. 

What You Will Do Here

You will work with groups such as Product Management, UX designers to understand customer usage models and develop test plans and suites that approximate real-world environments and regression tests driving the software development process toward quality-centric methodologies. You will also work with Software Development Engineers to understand features and technical implementation. In this role, you will be responsible to deliver manual/automated solutions to test customer facing features. You will be empowered to choose the right highly scalable and available technology to solve complex problems in software quality assurance. 

What You Will Get From Us

A great team to work with and the chance to build at a proven top tier company. You will get a startup like culture with the stability of an established industry leader. You will get support and resources from some of the smartest people in the industry to continue learning. 

Key job responsibilities

- Test Planning and Execution: Develop and execute comprehensive test plans for new features and product releases. 
 - Bug Identification and Resolution: Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify, document, and resolve software defects. 
 - Automation tooling: Develop, extend, and maintain automated tests on iOS, Android, Web, and Living Room Clients to enhance efficiency and effectiveness. 
 - Collaboration: Work closely with developers, product managers, and other stakeholders to ensure a seamless integration of quality throughout the development lifecycle. 
 - Continuous Improvement: Actively participate in retrospectives and contribute to process improvements to enhance overall product quality. 

Basic Qualifications

- 4+ years of quality assurance engineering experience
 - Experience in manual testing
 - Experience in automation testing
 - Experience scripting or coding
 - Experience as QA lead on medium to large sized projects

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with at least one automated test framework like Selenium or Appium
 - Experience in gathering test requirements to create detailed test plans and defining quality metrics to measure product quality

Hydro Prokav Pumps India Pvt Ltd

Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu

About Us

Hydro Prokav Pumps, part of Ingersoll Rand, a leading progressive cavity pump (PCP) manufacturer and exporter headquartered in Coimbatore, India. Hydro Prokav core expertise lies in PCP solutions, the perfect choice for handling tough, viscous, abrasive, and high consistency mediums. Equipped with state-of-the-art machinery and testing facilities, our integrated plant ensures precision manufacturing and rigorous quality control for every pump produced. 

Job Summary

Responsible for ensuring product quality and process compliance throughout the pump manufacturing process from raw material inspection to final product testing and dispatch. Experience in implementing quality control procedures, conducting inspections, monitoring production processes and ensuring that the pumps meet customer specification and applicable industry standards. This role focuses on Quality control activities aligning with organization business goals. 

Responsibilities

Implementing Quality Management System requirements aligned with business objectives and ensuring compliance

Preparation of Quality Plan & testing procedures for Pump & associated components to meet customer / Code requirements

Monitoring production activities (Machining, Welding, Assembly, Testing) Performing incoming / in-process / Assembly check / Visual & Dimension / Painting / Packing inspections, Witnessing Hydrostatic test, FAT, NPSH etc. and preparation of test records

Reviewing test certificates and Performing NDE (PT, UT, RT, MPI) on the components

Preparation, Analysis, resolution and implementation of NC using structured quality tools

Handling instruments like vernier caliper, micrometer, bore gauges, Height gauges, CMM and Calibration control

Coordinating with TPIA / Customer and managing inspection release documentation

Performing Vendor expediting and inspections

Supporting 5S, Kaizen, Lean initiatives in shop

Drive improvements in FPY, RFT, Process capability and customer satisfaction

Drive reduction in rejection, rework and customer complaints

Coordinating with Design, Production, SCM and Sales to improve product quality and delivery performance

Basic Qualification

Bachelor's or Diploma in Mechanical Engineering with 5 - 7 years of experience in Pump manufacturing industry

NDE Level 2 (RT, UT, MPI, PT, LT), 

Internal Auditor certification in ISO 9001 (optional)

Key Competencies

Knowledge in API, ASME, ASTM, VDMA & Indian standards

Hands-on experience in inspection of Casting, Machining, fabricated components; Pump performance testing, Painting and Packing process

Good communication and documentation skills, with proficiency in reporting. 

Ability to work on the shop floor

What We Offer

data.title: Manager, Core Infrastructure Engineering
data.description:
Job Description

Oracle Cloud Infrastructure is looking for a seasoned engineering leader to own the vision, execution, and operational excellence of its cryptography, Public Key Infrastructure (PKI), and certificate services. These Tier 0 platforms form a critical layer of trust for OCI-enabling secure identities, encrypted communications, and certificate lifecycle management for cloud services and customer workloads at scale. 

As Manager, you will lead a high-performing organization responsible for building and running these security-critical services. You will combine deep technical judgment with strong people leadership: setting a bold platform strategy, guiding the evolution of highly available distributed systems, and developing leaders who can consistently deliver in a fast-paced, high-accountability cloud environment. 

Do you thrive on leading teams that operate critical cloud infrastructure at global scale? Oracle Cloud Infrastructure is seeking an accomplished engineering leader to lead a high-performing organization responsible for core cryptographic services, Public Key Infrastructure (PKI), and certificate lifecycle capabilities that secure OCI resources and customer workloads. 

These are Tier 0 cloud services: foundational systems that establish trust, protect communications and identities, and enable secure operation across the Oracle Cloud. You will set the technical and organizational direction for this strategic service portfolio, balancing long-term platform vision with the operational rigor required of highly available, security-sensitive distributed systems. 

You will lead and grow a team of senior engineers, serving as both a technical authority and people leader. You will guide the design, delivery, and operation of resilient, scalable, and secure cryptographic platforms; raise the bar for engineering excellence; and translate an evolving PKI and certificate-management strategy into measurable execution. 

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

System Design & Architecture - System Scalability: 

- Provides oversight to the team on the development of components of distributed systems, including the use of distributed state management tools. 
 - Monitors and enables optimization of code and/or systems for large-scale data processing. 
 - Guides team to implement scalability requirements for assigned components. 
 - Coaches team to leverage data plane platforms to effectively handle large-scale data retrieval, storage, and processing. 
 - Ensures team accurately implements and executes performance and load testing. 

System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Design: 

- Provides guidance to the team in building fault-tolerant systems capable of withstanding in-service updates by leading the implementation of redundancy, replication, and automatic failover mechanisms. 
 - Guides the design of components to effectively handle service disruptions. 
 - Coaches team on various approaches to handle network unreliability, including retry mechanisms, circuit breakers, and timeouts. 

System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Performance: 

- Guides team to implement testing and alarming configurations for detecting and addressing issues/failures. 
 - Ensures team effectively supports recovery efforts by reviewing and aligning on runbooks and operational procedures. 
 - Coaches team on building and customizing dashboards, telemetry systems, and alerting mechanisms to monitor component health. 

System Design & Architecture - Correctness / Availability: 

- Manages the implementation and design of functional requirements and testing for features within an existing system. 
 - Coaches team on implementing test scenarios (e. g. , fault-injection, brown-out) to evaluate system correctness. 
 - Guides the implementation of data replication and synchronization techniques within the team to maintain data integrity and availability. 

Operational Troubleshooting & Incident Management: 

- Leads team efforts in diagnosing, debugging, and resolving issues in system components to support ongoing operation. 
 - Ensures teams are following protocols for preventing interruptions, ensuring no maintenance windows are required for customers and users when resolving issues. 
 - Manages team in effectively implementing automation scripts and tooling when troubleshooting operational issues. 
 - Creates schedules and manages operational support rotations. 

Compliance & Security: 

- Manages team implementation of robust security measures to protect data and applications in multi-tenant environments, overseeing encryption techniques and access controls. 
 - Manages execution of remediation plans to address identified security gaps, ensuring continuous improvement of security measures. 
 - Reviews documentation and ensures cloud infrastructure compliance with industry standards and regulations. 

Automation & Change Management: 

- Leads the maintenance of automation scripts and tools (e. g. , Infrastructure as Code (IaC)) to manage cloud infrastructure. 
 - Coaches team on change management plans for patching, updating, and rolling back applications. 

Core Responsibilities

Planning & Execution: 

- Creates and owns the execution plan for the team's work and multiple projects or initiatives, monitoring timelines and budgets (when applicable) to ensure projects are completed on time and in adherence with requirements. 
 - Delegates work across the team and helps them prioritize their work. 
 - Identifies resource needs and adapts plans based on changing priorities and business needs. 

Collaboration & Partnership: 

- Strengthens collaborative partnerships across teams to align on expectations and shared objectives. 
 - Guides team members to build relationships with business leaders, stakeholders, and/or customers to ensure effective collaboration. 
 - Practices active listening and asks insightful questions to promote an inclusive culture. 

Problem Solving: 

- Leads team to identify and address moderately complex operational and/or technical issues in accordance with standard practices, providing guidance as appropriate. 
 - Directs team to analyze data and/or information from multiple sources to troubleshoot moderately complex errors. 

Continuous Learning: 

- Actively seeks learning opportunities for self and team to enhance knowledge and skills in key areas and remain current with industry advancements. 
 - Uses feedback and training to elevate personal and team skills, modeling a commitment to learning. 
 - Identifies skill gaps within the team and supports team members in learning opportunities by providing resources and fostering an environment that encourages knowledge-sharing. 

Continuous Improvement: 

- Identifies and recommends improvements and encourages the team to share ideas to increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows within a team. 
 - Reviews and provides feedback on team members' ideas and seeks input from others on alternative approaches and methods for improving work. 

Performance and Development: 

- Coaches and provides direction to team members in alignment with performance management processes, guidelines, and expectations. 
 - Facilitates goal-setting discussions with team members, ensuring individual goals are aligned with broader team goals. 
 - Identifies development opportunities to help team members improve performance. 
 - Contributes to the talent acquisition pipeline by leading candidate interviews, assessing promotion eligibility, and managing talent resources. 

About Us

Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives. 

True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That's why we're committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs. 

We're committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing accommodation-request_mb@oracle. com or by calling 1-888-404-2494 in the United States. 

Oracle is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans' status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Oracle will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law.

Title: Tech Lead - Azure Integration Services- Husky (Guindy, Chennai)

Type: FullTime

We are dedicated to offering our customers the highest quality products and services and are looking for people with the inspiration and talent to develop with us as we pursue our ambitious growth strategy. We are a leader in developing state-of-the-art technology and it is this technology base that uniquely positions us to serve customers who seek differentiation through solutions that provide speed, flexibility and maximum productivity. This capability is at the core of our mission and competitive strategy. 

Husky TechnologiesTM offers a wealth of opportunity for personal growth and development. Most importantly, Husky Technologies TM offers an opportunity to work with - and be challenged by - a team of great people. Our success is possible because of the creativity, intelligence and passion of our people around the world and their desire to lead change. At the same time, we are not afraid to expect a lot and strive for leadership in all of our key markets. We are a company taking on new challenges and for the right people this means exceptional career development opportunities, the chance to be part of a team that is the best in the world at what we do and the experience that comes from working in an environment that demands constant transformation and innovation. 

Husky TechnologiesTM is an exciting company with tremendous potential. We have a great team and great expectations. If you are attracted to bold goals, believe in uncompromising honesty, support mutual respect, care about environmental responsibility, have a passion for excellence and a desire to make a positive contribution - then we want you to join the Husky TechnologiesTM team!

Job Description

Do you want to lead the integration backbone that connects systems, data, and business processes across the enterprise?

As Tech Lead for our API & Integration team, you'll drive the technical direction of a critical integration landscape built on the Azure integration stack. You'll shape integration architectures, set engineering standards, and lead by example in code-balancing new integration development with the stabilization and evolution of existing interfaces to ensure reliability, scalability, and security. 

This is a hands-on technical leadership role for someone who enjoys designing clean APIs, building resilient event and message-driven integrations, and guiding teams through complex system landscapes-turning connectivity challenges into robust, well-governed Azure solutions. 

Responsibilities

Technical Leadership

- Understand the E2E high level architecture (big picture)
 - Translate the HLD (high level design) into the LLD (low level design) in collaboration with architects and own the LLD. 
 - Technical direction for the product area. 
 - Contribute to coordinating cross team dependencies and integration points. 

Delivery & Execution Excellence

- Contribute to the feature definition and review. 
 - Generate concepts and facilitate concept selection. 
 - Breaking down complex features into actionable tasks. 
 - Helping with estimation and sprint planning. 
 - Addressing technical impediments. 
 - Own production readiness (incl. non-functional requirements). 

Quality, Governance & Security

- Ensuring code quality. 
 - Conducting meaningful code reviews and ensuring adherence to DoR (Definition of Ready) / DoD (Definition of Done) criteria. 
 - Ensure adherence to applicable standards, policies, and practices (e. g. DevSecOps). 

Incident Response

- Leading incident response, root cause analysis (RCA), and post-mortems. 

Mentorship & Team Growth

- Mentoring team members. 
 - Documenting key design decisions. 
 - Participate in interviews and hiring decisions. 
 - Promoting engineering best practices and driving continuous improvement. 

Collaboration & Communication

- Act as the primary technical point of contact across Product, Architecture, and Platform teams. 
 - Clearly communicate technical decisions and trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders. 

Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, IT, or related field. 
 - Minimum of 10+ years of experience in software development, with at least 5 years focused on integration solutions. 
 - Solid understanding of integration patterns and practices. 
 - Experience with microservices and hybrid integration (On‐Prem/Cloud). 
 - Strong proficiency and hands-on experience in Azure Integration Services (including Azure API Management, Logic Apps, Function Apps, Service Bus, Event Grid, Azure Data Factory). 
 - Familiarity with RESTful API design, development and lifecycle management. 
 - Experience with programming languages such as C#, PowerShell, Python, or others relevant to Azure development. 
 - Experience using Microsoft . NET framework. 
 - Designing integrations with security-by-design principles. 
 - Experience with: Entra ID, Network security (Private Endpoints, VNET integration), Role-based access control (RBAC). 
 - Awareness of compliance and data protection requirements (e. g. , GDPR). 
 - Clean Code Development and working experience with Unit Testing, and Test-driven Development. 
 - Familiarity with source code version control, branching strategies, CI/CD pipelines and other DevOps practices. 
 - Working knowledge of Agile development practices. 
 - Excellent communication and collaboration skills. 
 - Fluency in English (spoken and written). 
 - Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to work in a fast-paced environment. 

Assets

- Experience using AI assisted coding tools (e. g. GitHub Copilot) responsibly, with full accountability for code quality, security, and compliance. 
 - Experience with BizTalk Server. 
 - Experience with MuleSoft.

You will set technical direction for the team, mentor other engineers and shape standards adopted across Engineering.

- Design, build and maintain secure, multi-tenant SaaS infrastructure and CI/CD pipelines for multiple NeoXam products
 - Provision and manage AWS infrastructure as code (Terraform preferred; CloudFormation or equivalent) across multiple accounts and environments
 - Deploy, operate and scale containerised workloads on Kubernetes (Amazon EKS) in production using Helm and GitOps (Argo CD or Flux), and support Docker-based internal Engineering workloads
 - Design for resilience: Multi-AZ and cross-region architectures, backup and restore, and regular disaster recovery exercises, including failback, against contractual RTO/RPO
 - Build observability (metrics, logs, traces and alerting) with OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, CloudWatch or equivalent, giving SaaS, Support and clients real visibility into production health
 - Define and enforce DevSecOps practices: least-privilege IAM, secrets management, SSO integration (Keycloak, SAML 2. 0/OIDC), container image scanning, SBOM generation and SAST/SCA in the pipeline
 - Keep operating systems, Kubernetes and open-source components patched and supported, and remediate vulnerabilities within agreed SLAs
 - Automate configuration management, change management and routine operational tasks to reduce manual toil
 - Lead incident response and blameless postmortems, define SLOs/SLIs, and drive reliability improvements based on real usage and incidents
 - Optimize cloud costs through monitoring, rightsizing and commitment planning (Savings Plans, Reserved Instances)
 - Produce evidence for security and compliance audits (ISO/IEC 27001) and provide technical input to client security questionnaires and due-diligence reviews
 - Mentor engineers, lead design reviews, and write the runbooks, standards and architecture decision records the team works from

What We Are Looking For

- 6-9 years of DevOps, SRE or infrastructure engineering experience, including running production SaaS workloads
 - Experience in designing scalable, secure and cost-effective cloud architectures for production environments. 
 - Strong hands-on AWS experience (EKS, EC2, VPC, IAM, RDS for PostgreSQL, EFS, S3, Secrets Manager, CloudWatch) and multi-account setups with AWS Organizations; Azure or GCP experience is a plus

 - Strong scripting ability in Python, Bash or Go for automation
 - Hands-on experience with observability tooling (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, ELK/Loki, CloudWatch or equivalent)
 - Solid Linux system administration and networking fundamentals: DNS, load balancing, VPCs, firewalls, gateways and WAFs
 - Practical DevSecOps experience: identity and access management, secrets management, vulnerability scanning and remediation
 - Experience designing and testing backup and disaster recovery solutions
 - A track record of leading production incidents and mentoring other engineers
 - Comfortable working end-to-end and autonomously, from design to production operations
 - Experience working with global teams across Asia, Europe and the US
 - Clear written and spoken English

Nice to Have

- Familiarity with the AWS Foundational Technical Review (FTR) and AWS Well-Architected Framework Review (WAFR)
 - Experience in regulated environments (ISO/IEC 27001, SOC 2, DORA)
 - Experience with Keycloak and SSO federation across multiple identity providers
 - AWS certifications (Solutions Architect - Professional, DevOps Engineer - Professional) or CKA/CKS
 - Experience with financial services software
 - French language skills

Who You Are

- A builder: energised by improving systems that other teams depend on
 - Pragmatic: you pick the right tool, not the flashiest one
 - Autonomous: you drive towards outcomes without waiting to be told what to do next
 - Detail-oriented: you take reliability and security seriously
 - A mentor: you raise the bar for the engineers around you
 - A clear communicator: you explain technical trade-offs to engineers, Support and clients

Why Join

 - A path to growing scope and influence as the initiative matures

data.title: Infrastructure engineer, SRE
data.description:
Join us as an Infrastructure Engineer

- You'll engineer infrastructure technology for public and private cloud environments, complying with security, resilience, sustainability, and operational requirements with observability and guardrails built in
 - You'll also use automation to provide testing and a route to live for the product, working with customers to help them use our products appropriately through a users' CI or CD pipeline
 - This is a chance to work with colleagues across the bank to share engineering best practices, allowing you to expand your network and gain exposure for you and your work
 - We're offering this role at associate level

What you'll do

As an Infrastructure Engineer, you'll contribute to and manage the selection, creation and maintenance of technologies required to meet the needs of our customers, strategic targets and architecture outcomes, along with developing products using modern engineering practices and tools. 

We'll look to you to collaborate with stakeholders to inform product roadmaps, detailing lifecycles of the technology from new products through to end of support and retirement. You'll also support engineered products and respond to user feedback, new feature requests and resolve production issues wanted by the Product Owner. 

Additionally, You'll

- Develop technical skills through continuous learning and development
 - Work within a team to design intuitive, self-service infrastructure products
 - Contribute to the delivery of infrastructure as code solutions
 - Work with users to help use our products and gain feedback
 - Provide operational support for pattern or product related issues
 - Generate innovative ideas and drive the delivery of those through product features

The skills you'll need

To thrive in this role, you'll have experience in software development or automation scripting such as Python or Shell, with an understanding of the software development lifecycle. You'll also have experience in utilizing modern infrastructure as code via tooling. 

We'll expect you to bring a good understanding of Agile working practices and toolsets with the ability to relate everyday work to the vision of the feature team, platform and domain. 

Furthermore, You'll Need

- Minimum four years of experience in Platform Engineering, Infrastructure Engineering, or related cloud platform roles
 - Minimum three years of strong experience in AWS products & services, with strong focus on security, and controls
 - Extensive automation experience with demonstrable skills in IaC using Terraform, and Python
 - Practical experience of designing, and using CI/CD pipelines in GitLab, automated testing and deployments
 - Software development or scripting skills, with experience of the SDLC along with good understanding of Agile methodologies and toolsets such as Jira
 - Drive to make sure that solutions have security considered from the outset
 - excellent collaboration and stakeholder management skills
 - Capacity to focus on the customer, empathise with them

data.title: Automation Tester
data.description:
As an Automation Tester, you will design, develop, and execute automated testing solutions to ensure the quality, stability, and performance of enterprise applications. You will work closely with development and business teams to identify defects, improve test coverage, and support continuous delivery through automation and performance testing. 

What You'll Do and How You'll Succeed

Automation Testing

- Design, develop, and maintain automated test scripts using Playwright. 
 - Execute automated testing across application releases and enhancements. 
 - Identify opportunities to increase test coverage and reduce manual testing effort. 
 - Support continuous improvement of test automation frameworks and practices. 

Performance Testing

- Design and execute performance and load testing scenarios. 
 - Analyse test results and identify performance bottlenecks. 
 - Support optimisation efforts by working closely with development teams. 
 - Ensure applications meet performance and scalability requirements. 

Defect Management & Quality Assurance

- Identify, log, track, and validate defects throughout the testing lifecycle. 
 - Collaborate with developers and stakeholders to resolve issues effectively. 
 - Support quality assurance activities and ensure testing deliverables meet project requirements. 
 - Maintain accurate testing documentation and test execution records. 

We'd Love to Hear From You If. . . 

Experience

- You have 3-6 years of experience in automation testing. 
 - You have hands‐on experience using Playwright for test automation. 
 - You have experience in performance testing. 
 - You have experience in defect management. 

Technical Expertise

- You have strong experience with Playwright automation testing. 
 - You have proficiency in Java and/or Python for test automation development. 
 - You have experience using JMeter for performance and load testing. 
 - You have knowledge of test automation frameworks, test execution, and defect tracking processes. 

Ways of Working

- You communicate effectively with technical and non‐technical stakeholders. 
 - You collaborate closely with development and testing teams to ensure quality outcomes. 
 - You demonstrate strong analytical and problem‐solving skills. 
 - You maintain attention to detail while working within project timelines. 
 - You are proactive in identifying quality improvements and automation opportunities. 

Assignment Details

- Working Hours: 9: 00 AM to 6: 00 PM IST. 

---

Who We Are

Thakral One is a consulting and technology services company headquartered in Singapore, with a pan-Asian presence. We focus primarily around technology-driven consulting, adoption of value-added bespoke solutions, enabling enhanced decision support through data analytics, and embracing possibilities in the cloud. We are heavily inclined towards building capabilities collaboratively with clients and believe strongly in improving grounded and practical outcomes. 

This approach is possible through our partnership with leading global technology providers and internal R&D teams. Our clients come from Financial Services, Banking, Telco, Government, Healthcare, and Consumer-oriented organisations.

data.description:
Job Description

Title: Supplier Quality Analyst - Electrical - Husky, Chennai (India)

Id: 21642

Type: FullTime

Location: Chennai, India

At Husky TechnologiesTM, our success is based on your success. Our ability to keep our customers in the lead is based on building the strongest team possible. 

Husky TechnologiesTM has a strong foundation built on innovation, close customer relationships and a unique culture and values. We are dedicated to offering our customers the highest quality products and services and are looking for people with the inspiration and talent to develop with us as we pursue our ambitious growth strategy. We are a leader in developing state-of-the-art technology and it is this technology base that uniquely positions us to serve customers who seek differentiation through solutions that provide speed, flexibility and maximum productivity. This capability is at the core of our mission and competitive strategy. 

Husky TechnologiesTM offers a wealth of opportunity for personal growth and development. Most importantly, Husky Technologies TM offers an opportunity to work with - and be challenged by - a team of great people. Our success is possible because of the creativity, intelligence and passion of our people around the world and their desire to lead change. At the same time, we are not afraid to expect a lot and strive for leadership in all of our key markets. We are a company taking on new challenges and for the right people this means exceptional career development opportunities, the chance to be part of a team that is the best in the world at what we do and the experience that comes from working in an environment that demands constant transformation and innovation. 

Husky TechnologiesTM is an exciting company with tremendous potential. We have a great team and great expectations. If you are attracted to bold goals, believe in uncompromising honesty, support mutual respect, care about environmental responsibility, have a passion for excellence and a desire to make a positive contribution - then we want you to join the Husky TechnologiesTM team!

Job Description

Reporting to the Supplier Quality Manager, the Supplier Quality Analyst (SQA) executes activities aiming to ensure that all supplied components within their portfolio of suppliers are ready to use when reaching internal or external customers. The SQA is the primary quality contact for assigned suppliers and is responsible for supplier qualification, audits, performance monitoring, corrective actions, and continuous improvement initiatives. 

Key Responsibilities

- Qualify and audit new and existing suppliers to Husky standards. 
 - Monitor supplier performance and drive improvement actions. 
 - Manage supplier part qualification activities. 
 - Support containment actions, root cause analysis, and corrective action implementation. 
 - Participate in Andon and Clinic activities related to supplier quality issues. 
 - Conduct quality risk assessments for localization and dual-sourcing initiatives. 
 - Contribute to the continuous improvement of the Supply Chain Quality Management System. 

Critical Capabilities

- Strong knowledge of quality systems, supplier quality management, and auditing. 
 - Excellent problem-solving skills using structured methodologies (8D, 5 Why, RCA). 
 - Ability to influence suppliers and drive corrective actions to closure. 
 - Understanding of manufacturing, assembly, and logistics processes. 
 - Strong analytical, project management, and decision-making skills. 
 - Effective communication and cross-functional collaboration. 
 - Willingness to travel domestically as required. 

Education, Experience & Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Manufacturing, Industrial, Electrical Engineering, or a related field. 
 - Minimum 5 years of experience in Supplier Quality, Manufacturing Quality, or Quality Engineering. 
 - Experience with electrical and electronic components such as PCBs, drives, motors, sensors, wiring harnesses, connectors, and control systems. 
 - Ability to read Electrical Schematics and cabinet layout drawings. 
 - Knowledge of IPC-A-610, IPC/WHMA-A-620, and UL standards are an asset. 
 - Working knowledge of APQP, PPAP, FMEA, Control Plans, MSA, and SPC. 
 - Experience with ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems. 
 - Fluent in written and spoken English. 

Husky TechnologiesTM offers a competitive compensation and benefits package and excellent opportunities for growth and advancement. We are committed to equal employment opportunity and respect, value and welcome diversity in our workplace. Husky TechnologiesTM also values being a great place to work and strives to maintain a safe workplace. Accordingly, Husky TechnologiesTM conditions all offers of employment on satisfactory completion of background checks. No agency or telephone inquiries please.

data.title: Full Stack Automation Test Engineer - Assistant Vice President
data.description:
The Testing Sr Analyst is a seasoned professional role. Applies in-depth disciplinary knowledge, contributing to the development of new techniques and the improvement of processes and work-flow for the area or function. Integrates subject matter and industry expertise within a defined area. Requires in-depth understanding of how areas collectively integrate within the sub-function as well as coordinate and contribute to the objectives of the function and overall business. Evaluates moderately complex and variable issues with substantial potential impact, where development of an approach/taking of an action involves weighing various alternatives and balancing potentially conflicting situations using multiple sources of information. Requires good analytical skills in order to filter, prioritize and validate potentially complex and dynamic material from multiple sources. Strong communication and diplomacy skills are required. Regularly assumes informal/formal leadership role within teams. Involved in coaching and training of new recruits Significant impact in terms of project size, geography, etc. by influencing decisions through advice, counsel and/or facilitating services to others in area of specialization. Work and performance of all teams in the area are directly affected by the performance of the individual. 

Responsibilities:

Job Description

As a Test Automation Engineer, you will design and implement automation solutions that validate system behavior across UI, APIs, and integrations. In this role, you will translate requirements into effective test strategies, combining automation with manual, exploratory, and integration testing to ensure comprehensive quality coverage across all application layers. 

This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys hands-on coding, solving complex validation challenges, and improving system quality at scale, while taking ownership of end-to-end quality outcomes and collaborating closely with cross-functional teams. 

Responsibilities

Automation Development & Framework Ownership

 - UI (Web/Mobile)

Test Strategy & Implementation

- Translate requirements into automation-ready test scenarios, test data, and validation strategies

 - Perform automation feasibility analysis to determine optimal test approach (manual vs automated)

Delivery & Execution Excellence

- Execute a balanced mix of automated and manual tests aligned with sprint goals, ensuring comprehensive validation across functional, integration, and edge-case scenarios. 
 - Contribute to task breakdown, estimation, and sprint commitments
 - Proactively raise risks, blockers, and testability concerns
 - Identify, log, prioritize, and track defects through resolution lifecycle
 - Perform root cause analysis and collaborate with development teams for fixes

Manual & Functional Testing

- Design, document, and execute detailed test cases and test scenarios
 - Perform functional, exploratory, and regression testing across features
 - Validate end-to-end workflows and business scenarios
 - Identify edge cases and usability issues through exploratory testing
 - Ensure test coverage for areas not suitable for automation

Quality, Standards & Engineering Practices

- Write clean, testable, and maintainable automation code
 - Participate in code reviews and continuous improvement of automation frameworks
 - Ensure adherence to Definition of Ready (DoR) and Definition of Done (DoD)
 - Take ownership of end-to-end quality outcomes across assigned areas

CI/CD & DevOps Integration

 - Enable continuous testing and shift-left quality practices
 - Monitor and improve pipeline stability, execution time, and reliability
 - Validate and troubleshoot system integrations, data flows, and error handling based on defined architectural designs and interfaces

Non-Functional Testing

- Contribute to performance, reliability, and resilience testing
 - Validate system behavior under load, stress, and failure scenarios

Observability & Debuggability

- Leverage logs, metrics, and traces to improve test reliability
 - Support root cause analysis of failures and improve system observability

Test Data & Environment Management

- Design and manage test data strategies and datasets

data.title: SDE I - SDET
data.description:
Hiring for Swiggy - via Flexiple, the recruiting partner on this role. 

About Company

Swiggy is a leading consumer internet and food-commerce platform operating at high transaction scale across India. This Full Stack SDET role supports product-quality work across Java services, APIs, web/mobile automation, data validation, and debugging workflows that protect customer and partner experience.

data.title: Senior Manager Engineering - AI/Agentic [T500-30271]
data.description:
About Albertsons

As a leading food and drug retailer in the United States, Albertsons Companies, Inc. (ACI) operates over 2, 200 stores across 34 states and the District of Columbia. Our well-known global banners, including Albertsons, Safeway, Vons, Jewel-Osco and others. Our success is built upon a united team approach, driven by the desire to understand and enhance the customer experience. This customer-centric focus not only inspires innovation but has also led to remarkable achievements across our digital platforms and omnichannel strategies. By constantly pushing the boundaries of retail, we have transformed shopping into an experience that is not just easy and efficient, but also fun and engaging. Over the past year, we have taken bold, strategic steps to migrate and modernize our enterprise data hub on Google Cloud, revolutionizing our data capabilities, thus becoming the first fully cloud-based grocery tech company. 

About Tech Hub In India

Albertsons Companies India (ACI India) is part of Albertsons Companies Inc. global workforce. As Albertsons' first significant strategic investment in India, it serves as a collaborative hub, supporting Albertsons in driving innovation and efficiency across Technology, Digital, and other key business functions. The employees at the India GCC will play a pivotal role in enhancing the company's digital transformation, customer engagement, and operational excellence. 

We are excited to announce an opening for Sr. Manager, AIDLC at ACI. Please find below the details of the role and its responsibilities. 

Roles & Responsibilities

- Own the AIDLC (AI-driven development lifecycle) workstream end to end: roadmap, delivery and outcomes. You report to the AI First head. 
 - Lead a pod of engineers who build agents across the software development lifecycle: requirements and design, code review before merge, security-finding remediation, test generation, release and path to production, and SRE and incident support. 
 - Stay hands-on for roughly a quarter of your time. Write code, build prototypes and review agent pull requests, so you judge agent designs and eval results first hand. 
 - Build the organization: define roles and levels, hire and onboard engineers, coach them, and set engineering standards for AI-authored and AI-assisted code. 
 - Set the technical direction for agent architecture: orchestration, tool and function calling, MCP servers (including code knowledge graphs exposed over MCP), memory and state management, context engineering and RAG over engineering knowledge. 
 - Make evals a release gate. Every agent, prompt and model change passes golden datasets, LLM-as-judge scoring calibrated against human review, and regression suites before it ships. Require tracing and observability for agents in production. 
 - Define outcome metrics and measure them against the pre-agent baseline: delivery speed and cost, defects, security findings, cycle time and change failure rate. Report outcomes, not login counts or seat usage. 
 - Drive adoption and change management: run pilots with engineering teams, collect feedback, change how teams work, and retire agents that do not earn their place. 
 - Set governance and guardrails for agents that touch source control, CI/CD and cloud: least-privilege tool access, prompt-injection defence, human approval points, and an action trail that can be reviewed and reversed. 
 - Govern multi-agent systems: trust boundaries between agents, rules for delegation, an audit trail across agent handoffs, and the points where a human must approve. 
 - Govern token and compute cost: budgets, model routing, cost per successful outcome, and usage reporting to leadership. 
 - Run vendor and build-vs-buy evaluations for agent platforms, models and tooling, including multi-model support, with clear criteria. 
 - Use agentic coding tools every day (e. g. Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor) and set norms for how the pod and its partner teams use them. 
 - Partner with Security, Cloud, Data, Product, Enterprise Architecture and the AI governance group so agents fit existing toolchains and meet security, legal, risk and compliance standards. 
 - Run agents in production: reliability targets, observability, incident response and a named owner for every agent. 

Experience Required

- AI experience is a MUST. You have personally built and deployed an LLM agent or agentic workflow used by real users in the last 2 years, with evals and tracing in place. Describe it in your application or link a repo or demo. 
 - 12-15 years of software engineering experience, including 4+ years leading engineering teams: hiring, performance management and delivery accountability. 
 - Hands-on programming in Python, Java or TypeScript, used to build agents and the services around them. The agents work on Java/Spring and React/Angular codebases. 
 - Working depth in agent orchestration, tool/function calling, MCP, memory and state management, context engineering and RAG. You can review a multi-agent design and say where it will fail. Frameworks are examples only (e. g. LangGraph, LangChain/LangSmith, Claude Agent SDK, OpenAI Agents SDK, Google ADK). 
 - Experience running evals in practice: golden datasets, LLM-as-judge, regression testing, and using the results to block or approve a release. 
 - Experience with tracing and observability for LLM applications, and with guardrails, prompt-injection defence and human-in-the-loop design. 
 - Everyday use of agentic coding tools (e. g. Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor) in your own work, not only as a sponsor of them. 
 - Experience owning an adoption program with measured outcomes (cycle time, change failure rate, defects, cost) rather than usage counts. 
 - Experience managing LLM cost: token budgets, model selection and routing, and scaling agent workloads. 
 - Experience evaluating vendors and making build-vs-buy decisions for AI platforms. 
 - Cloud experience on Azure and/or Google Cloud Platform. 
 - Strong communication with senior leadership, engineering teams and risk partners. 
 - A plus: agent-to-agent (A2A) protocol, code knowledge graphs or GraphRAG, building internal developer platforms. 

Competencies

- Compassionate and kind, showing courtesy, dignity, and respect. They show sincere interest and empathy for all others. 
 - Foster innovation through creativity to get to a workable solution. Use analytical thinking through issues using logic and reason
 - Show integrity in what is done and how it is done - without sacrificing personal/business ethics. 
 - Embrace an inclusion-focused mindset, seeking input from others on their work and encouraging the open expression of diverse ideas and opinions
 - Team-oriented, positively contributing to team morale and willing to help. 
 - Learning-Focused, finding ways to improve in their field and use positive constructive feedback to grow personally and professionally
 - Think strategically and proactively anticipate future problems, needs or changes in the work
 - Delighting our customers and maintaining customer relationships are top priority and they work to always deliver solutions through this lens
 - Ability to learn newer technologies, methodologies, and solutions in the cloud technology space. 
 - Ability to collaborate across organizational boundaries, build relationships, and achieve broader organizational goals. 

Skills Required

- Agentic AI and Multi-Agent Systems: design review and governance
 - Agent Evals, Tracing and Observability
 - MCP, Memory and State Management, Context Engineering, RAG
 - Python / Java / TypeScript (hands-on)
 - Cloud Platform Experience (Azure and/or Google Cloud)
 - Engineering Leadership, Hiring and Change Management
 - AI Governance, Guardrails, Token and Compute Cost Management

data.title: Java GenAI Developer – Spring Boot, Microservices, RAG & LLMs

The role will combine strong Java-based backend development with hands-on experience in Large Language Models, AI frameworks, cloud technologies, prompt engineering, Retrieval-Augmented Generation, embeddings, and vector databases. 

The position will contribute to business objectives by delivering scalable AI-enabled applications, intelligent automation, chatbots, copilots, search solutions, and secure enterprise technology services. 

Software Requirements

Required Software Skills

- Java: Strong professional experience in Java application development. 
 - Spring Boot: Hands-on experience developing scalable backend applications and services. 
 - Microservices: Experience designing, developing, integrating, and supporting microservices. 
 - REST APIs: Proficiency in designing, developing, integrating, and securing RESTful APIs. 
 - Distributed systems: Understanding of distributed-system principles, service communication, scalability, reliability, and fault handling. 
 - Generative AI and LLMs: Hands-on experience developing or integrating solutions using Large Language Models. 
 - AI platforms: Experience with OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Gemini, Anthropic Claude, or equivalent AI platforms. 
 - AI orchestration frameworks: Experience with LangChain, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, or similar frameworks. 
 - Prompt engineering: Knowledge of prompt design, testing, optimization, grounding, and response evaluation. 
 - RAG: Experience designing or implementing Retrieval-Augmented Generation architectures. 
 - Embeddings and vector databases: Knowledge of embeddings, semantic search, indexing, retrieval, and vector databases such as Pinecone, ChromaDB, FAISS, Weaviate, or equivalent technologies.

 - Exposure to MLOps and AI deployment frameworks. 
 - Experience building enterprise-grade Generative AI solutions. 
 - Familiarity with AI observability, monitoring, logging, and performance evaluation tools.

 - Candidates should be able to assess compatibility, manage upgrades, document changes, and support production lifecycle activities. 
 - The role requires 5-7 years of overall professional experience, including practical Generative AI and LLM integration experience. 

Overall Responsibilities

- Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain scalable Java-based applications.

 - Develop AI-powered chatbots, copilots, intelligent search, and automation solutions. 
 - Implement RAG architectures using embeddings, semantic search, retrieval pipelines, and vector databases.

 - Collaborate with business stakeholders and cross-functional teams to gather requirements and deliver practical solutions.

 - Apply AI governance, data protection, responsible AI, and secure development practices. 
 - Identify opportunities to improve automation, resource efficiency, application reliability, and sustainable technology operations. 
 - Contribute to measurable outcomes such as timely feature delivery, improved response quality, reduced defects, reliable releases, and successful adoption of AI-enabled solutions. 

Technical Skills (By Category)

Programming Languages

Essential

- Strong Java development experience. 
 - Strong understanding of object-oriented programming, design principles, exception handling, testing, and maintainable code. 
 - Experience developing Java-based APIs, microservices, integrations, and backend services. 
 - Ability to write modular, scalable, testable, secure, and production-ready code. 

Preferred

- Python for AI/ML integrations, data preparation, automation, and model interaction.

Databases/Data Management

Your Key Responsibilities

 - Design and deliver automation for areas such as landing-zone provisioning, infrastructure-as-code, environment setup, CI/CD, policy/control automation, application onboarding and operational readiness.

 - Establish reusable approaches for dependency and software lifecycle management, enabling security and OSS fixes to be propagated consistently across application portfolios. 
 - Provide hands-on engineering leadership for complex cloud onboarding, remediation and migration activities involving GCP, container platforms, databases, CI/CD and infrastructure automation. 
 - Identify opportunities for developer self-service and engineering productivity improvement, using automation to remove repetitive manual activities and operational toil. 

Tribe Passport

- Provide senior technical ownership for Tribe Passport, including solution architecture, engineering standards, code quality, release readiness, resilience and production stability. 
 - Evaluate engineering requirements and translate them into architectural designs, delivery plans, epics and technical work packages, identifying dependencies and trade-offs early. 
 - Lead the continued evolution of Tribe Passport across the UI, APIs and backend services, data ingestion, data stores and reporting capabilities using relevant Google Cloud services. 
 - Define scalable integration patterns with enterprise sources including GitHub/Bitbucket, Jira, ServiceNow, Waltz, SonarQube and organizational / workforce data.

 - Ensure Tribe Passport remains maintainable, supportable and aligned with appropriate security, data privacy, resilience and operational controls. 
 - Provide solution architecture leadership for complex technical initiatives, balancing security, resilience, observability, operability, cost, performance and regulatory requirements.

Expected outcomes

- Reusable cloud engineering and automation capabilities reduce manual effort, onboarding time and delivery lead time across multiple ATO teams and applications. 
 - Cloud provisioning, deployment and operational workflows become increasingly automated, repeatable, secure and self-service. 
 - Common Terraform, CI/CD and platform patterns achieve adoption across multiple workloads rather than remaining application-specific solutions. 
 - Tribe Passport remains a secure, resilient, maintainable and strategically relevant engineering-insight platform. 
 - Complex platform and application engineering problems move efficiently from architecture to production, with clear ownership and measurable acceptance criteria. 
 - Engineering controls covering security, OSS, deployment and operational readiness are embedded in engineering workflows rather than evidenced manually afterwards. 
 - Cloud and platform capabilities are designed for reuse and scale, reducing duplication and reliance on platform-specific implementation knowledge. 
 - Engineering teams benefit from clear technical standards, mentoring and reusable patterns that allow them to deliver more independently. 

Your Skills And Experience

- Extensive hands-on software and/or platform engineering experience, with demonstrated technical leadership of complex enterprise applications, cloud platforms or engineering capabilities. 
 - Strong development capability in Java and/or Python, with the ability to review code and designs, troubleshoot complex issues and contribute directly when required. 
 - Deep practical Google Cloud experience, ideally across GKE, Cloud Run, Cloud SQL/PostgreSQL, Secret Manager, IAM/service accounts, networking, load balancing and observability. 
 - Strong infrastructure-as-code and automation experience, particularly with Terraform, including the development of reusable modules, templates and engineering patterns. 
 - Strong DevOps and platform engineering expertise across CI/CD technologies such as GitHub Actions, Jenkins and TeamCity, including reusable pipeline and workflow design. 
 - Experience designing automation and self-service engineering capabilities for use across multiple applications and engineering teams. 
 - Good understanding of containerized workloads, APIs, distributed systems, event-driven integration, messaging, caching and resilient cloud design patterns. 
 - Practical SRE and observability knowledge, including SLI/SLO design, logging, monitoring, alerting, operational dashboards, capacity and production-support practices. 
 - Working knowledge of software quality and security controls, including OSS vulnerability management, SonarQube or equivalent tooling, secrets management, IAM/entitlements, data privacy and audit evidence. 
 - Experience with engineering and operational technologies such as Liquibase, Kafka and New Relic, or comparable technologies. 
 - Ability to integrate with enterprise platforms such as Jira, ServiceNow, GitHub/Bitbucket and organizational data sources to enable automation and reliable engineering insights. 
 - Proven delivery leadership covering architecture, backlog and dependency management, estimation, technical risk, stakeholder alignment and transition to production.

data.description:
