These tools must not be used to record, assist with, or enhance responses in any way. Our interviews are designed to evaluate your individual experience, thought process, and communication skills in real time. Use of AI tools without prior instruction from the interviewer will result in disqualification from the hiring process. 

This position may require access to technology and/or software subject to U. S. export control laws and regulations, including the Export Administration Regulations (EAR). As such, applicants must be eligible to access export-controlled information as defined under applicable law. Marvell may be required to obtain export licensing approval from the U. S. Department of Commerce and/or the U. S. Department of State. Except for U. S. citizens, lawful permanent residents, or protected individuals as defined by 8 U. S. C. 1324b(a)(3), all applicants may be subject to an export license review process prior to employment.

data.title: Senior Principal Firmware Test Architect
data.description:
NFC‐based platforms are at the heart of secure connected experiences across mobile, wearables, automotive, and IoT ecosystems. They span domains such as wireless power transfer, secure NFC transactions, digital wallets, infrastructure services, and platform enablement. As a Senior Firmware Test Architect in the NFC Firmware organization, you will play a critical role in defining, shaping, and delivering robust, scalable firmware architectures including test capabilities that operate close to silicon and enable product differentiation across multiple NFC use cases. 

This role is intentionally broad and technology‐agnostic, allowing the architect to contribute across Wireless Charging (WLC), Wallet, Infrastructure, platform firmware, core libraries, validation, or system‐level enablement, depending on business needs and project priorities. 

We are seeking a Senior Firmware Test Architect to lead the definition and execution of end-to-end validation strategy, test architecture, and automation frameworks for next-generation NFC platforms. This role is pivotal in ensuring product quality, scalability, and performance across complex embedded systems. 

Your Responsibilities

- He/She should work as NFC Firmware Test architect and drive end to end firmware validation strategy for new product development, debugging and maintenance of NXP's flagship embedded software for NFC products. 
 - Define test methodology, coverage and quality metrics for unit, integration testing and compliance levels for firmware based on RISC V/ARM platform. 
 - Define test requirements and test specifications. 
 - Drive test driven development across Firmware teams. 
 - Architect and design scalable test frameworks, automation infrastructure, and validation environments. 
 - Review, approve code submitted by validation engineers and maintain overall quality of deliverables. 
 - Closely interact with Hardware Development team, system architects and other component technical experts with aim of improving SOC test capabilities. 
 - Effectively collaborate with partner companies and ensure product considers partner requirements and constraints. 
 - Build and enhance automated test setups, validation labs, and tooling ecosystems
 - Mentor and guide validation engineers; establish best practices, processes, and standards

Your Profile

- Mandatory: 
 - 10-15 years of Embedded Firmware validation experience preferably in mobile or RTOS based embedded systems. 
 - Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Electronics & Communication, Power Electronics, Computer Science from reputed institute with strong academic records. 
 - Experience of bare metal validation on embedded platform(8, 16, 32 bit platforms, preferably RISC V & ARM architecture)
 - Excellent C programming skills and Python scripting for automation. 
 - Experience in debugging HW/FW/Silicon interfaces and failure analysis using Debuggers. (TRAC32/J-LINK/LPC-LINK)
 - Must have experience in low level firmware programming embedded systems / low level Drivers such as boot loaders, SPI/I2C drivers, UART drivers, RF, embedded RTOS, etc. 
 - Must have exposure to RTL, FPGA, and silicon bring up experience. 
 - Hands-on knowledge of RTOS, its concepts and usage.

 - Exposure to IDEs like LPCXpresso, Keil, Eclipse
 - Exposure to change management / configuration management, bug tracking tools. 
 - Hands-on with AI based efficiency gaining tools. 
 - Experience in building test frameworks, automation platforms, and validation infrastructure
 - Must have knowledge of at least one RF connectivity technology like NFC, WiFi, UWB, Zigbee, LoRa, BLE, etc. 
 - Optional
 - Exposure to Jenkins is an added advantage
 - Good understanding of NFC technology. 
 - Personality
 - Excellent analytical, problem solving, debugging skills & influencing skills with go-to attitude
 - Self-motivated, Proactive, good verbal and written communication. 
 - Sufficiently mobile and flexible, work location based out of Bangalore
 - Experienced in requirements derivation, proposing Low level / High level design (besides coding) in the above-mentioned domains
 - Empathic communicator, able to see things from the other person's point of view and a good team player with cross functional, cross cultural & Global teams
Desired Skill Set

- Knowledge of software development life cycle (SDLC) for embedded firmware development

Introduction

IBM System Z (IBM Z) mainframes are engineered for the highest levels of reliability, availability, and serviceability (RAS). Hardware validation ensures every subsystem of the platform meets IBM's strict quality standards before it is shipped to customers. 

Looking for a Hardware Engineer to work on our EST squad executing and automating test scenarios. This job role provides a wide range of technical experiences, from hardware handling to running programs on a variety of operating systems. It also offers a lot of troubleshooting, investigation and problem resolution. This encompasses several sub-roles including: machine configuration, operation, maintenance, error handling and investigation, troubleshooting bugs, defect reporting, operating system knowledge, and workload execution. In addition, there is a strong desire to transform traditional test methods to a more automated approach which will require a significant amount of programming & scripting. We need someone with the drive to find machine bugs and work with our development team until the issue has been resolved. A team player is a must! In order to ensure success, the candidate will need a willingness to continuously seek education to build their skills. This, along with a strong desire to replace traditional manually initiated workload/testing with automated execution techniques will be a big plus. 

Your Role And Responsibilities

This role is critical in validating enterprise‐class workloads on System Z platforms that support mission‐critical business operations worldwide. The scope includes testing and certification of complex System Z configurations, with emphasis on: 

- Design, develop, and execute IBM Z channel subsystem test plans for enterprise hardware platforms. 
 - Identifying existing manual test scenarios and workloads and design programmatic automation to replace them. 
 - Validate channel path configuration, I/O routing, adapter connectivity, and subsystem functionality. 
 - Perform high-availability and redundancy validation, including path failover and recovery testing. 
 - Investigate and debug I/O recovery failures through log analysis, diagnostics, and root-cause determination
 - Participate in test strategy, test planning, and customer-focused validation to ensure robust and reliable I/O recovery capabilities. 
 - Working with firmware development to understand the technical details of new firmware features in order to design appropriate test scenarios and workloads to validate them
 - Growing knowledge of physical server design and logical constructs behind its operation
 - Hardware handling, maintenance, changes and manipulation
 - Working with multiple Z mainframe operating systems to execute workloads that are used to verify the latest hardware and firmware deliveries
 - Large amount of troubleshooting, investigation and problem resolution. 

Preferred Education

Master's Degree

Required Technical And Professional Expertise

Required Technical and Professional Expertise with relevant experience of 8 to 10 years

- Hardware system testing and validation. 
 - I/O subsystem, networking, and storage technologies. 
 - Error injection and fault tolerance testing. 
 - Performance and stress testing methodologies. 
 - Test automation using Python, Shell scripting, or similar technologies. 
 - Debugging, log analysis, and root cause analysis. 
 - Knowledge of IBM Z, Linux, virtualization, or enterprise server environments is highly desirable. 
 - Strong understanding of computer architecture (CPU, memory hierarchy, buses, I/O subsystems). 
 - Familiarity with PCIe, USB, Ethernet, SAS/SATA, NVMe, DDR, or similar protocols. 
 - Good knowledge of firmware/BIOS, drivers, and low-level debugging. 
 - Gather and analyze hardware requirements to create detailed test plans, test matrices, and test strategies. 
 - Identify coverage gaps and ensure test completeness across hardware components. 
 - Proficiency in scripting (Python/Shell/Bash) for automation, tooling, and operational efficiency. 
 - Demonstrated experience in automation of deployments, monitoring, and operational workflows using scripting or orchestration tools. 
 - Strong team player with good communication and interpersonal skills. 
 - Proven ability to work effectively in a global team environment. 

Optional (Nice to Have)

Experience with CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure automation tools (e. g. , Ansible, Jenkins). 

Exposure to cloud-native architectures and container security best practices

Preferred Technical And Professional Experience

2+ of experience working with Z mainframe systems in some capacity Experience with one or more mainframe operating systems. Experience with practical applications of the mainframe Experience writing and executing test plans with the ability to ensure proper coverage based on customer requirements and workloads, and perform regression testing Hardware troubleshooting skills Knowledge of Agile practices Ability to handle testing and debugging tasks independently.

data.title: Senior System Performance Engineer
data.description:
System Performance Engineer - Ethernet Hardware & Software

Job Summary

We are seeking a highly motivated System Performance Engineer to drive end-to-end performance characterization, and optimization of Ethernet processing solutions across hardware, firmware, software, and system-level architectures. The role requires expertise in Ethernet networking, packet processing, performance benchmarking, and root-cause analysis to ensure industry-leading throughput, latency, and scalability. 

The engineer will work closely with architects, hardware designers, firmware developers, driver teams, and performance architects to identify performance bottlenecks, develop optimization strategies, and deliver high-performance Ethernet solutions for data center, and edge networking applications. 

Key Qualification & Responsibilities

Bachelors or masters in computer science or electronics with at least 2+ years of industry or research experience. 

Performance Analysis & Optimization

- Define and execute performance validation strategies for Ethernet hardware and software subsystems. 
 - Characterize system performance including: 
 - Throughput
 - Packet processing rate (PPS)
 - Latency and jitter
 - Buffer utilization
 - CPU and memory efficiency
 - Analyze packet processing pipelines and identify performance bottlenecks in hardware, drivers, and software stacks. 
 - Develop methodologies to optimize Ethernet datapath performance across varying traffic patterns and workloads. 

Hardware Performance Engineering

- Evaluate performance of Ethernet MAC, PHY, switch, NIC, and packet processing hardware. 
 - Analyze bus utilization, DMA performance, memory bandwidth, cache efficiency, and hardware acceleration engines. 

Performance characterization of pre-silicon and post-silicon platforms.

data.title: Senior Silicon Performance Verification Engineer
data.description:
ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD. 

At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world's most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future. 

Whether you're designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or bringing leading edge products to market, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger - technology that moves the world forward. Join us and, together, we'll advance your career. 

SENIOR SILICON PERFORMANCE VERIFICATION ENGINEER

The Role

The successful candidate will join AMD's Computing and Graphics Performance Verification team. The team's mandate is to analyze AMD's next generation SOC architecture and performance through modeling and RTL simulation. This role will involve working with SOC and IP architects to evaluate and improve performance and collaborating with design and verification teams to execute performance verification plans. 

The Person

The ideal candidate has a passion for modern, complex processor architecture, performance, digital design, and verification. The candidate must have excellent communication skills and experience working with and leading teams in different sites and time zones. The candidate must have strong analytical and problem-solving skills, be willing to learn, and be ready to take on new challenges. 

Key Responsibilities

- Work in the Computing and Graphics Performance Verification team
 - Develop simulation infrastructure and methodology advances that are required to model specific customer requirements
 - Work with architects and designers to debug functional and performance issues
 - Develop, track, and communicate project plans internally and with AMD customers
 - Utilize customer feedback to improve performance testing and enhance deliverables
 - Contribute to a global team that will execute to a high standard of quality
 - Engage in multi-discipline interactions with IP and SoC architect and verification teams, SW/FW developers, tool owners, logic designers, and verification engineers
 - Identify, resolve, and document architectural performance issues

Preferred Experience

- 8-12 years of professional experience in the industry with a proven track record of successfully building and delivering complex SOC computing devices
 - Experience with computer system simulation and performance evaluation
 - Demonstrated success working in global development teams
 - Experience mentoring colleagues to develop technical capabilities within the team
 - Experience working with cross-functional teams from multiple departments
 - Experience with ASIC hardware design and verification languages/tools (Verilog, System Verilog, System C, UVM/UVC)
 - Proficiency in debugging RTL code using simulation tools
 - Proficiency with programming and scripting languages (C/C++, Perl, Python, etc. )
 - Experience analyzing system bottlenecks and optimizing computing systems for performance
 - Detailed microarchitecture knowledge in one or more of the following: CPU, GPU, DSP, NPU, PCIe, multimedia co-processor, I/O subsystem, DRAM controller
 - Strong verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills with both technical and non-technical audiences

Academic Credentials

Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering / Electrical Engineering plus 12 years full-time experience in IP hardware design, or Masters degree plus 8 years' experience in same

AMD does not accept unsolicited resumes from headhunters, recruitment agencies, or fee-based recruitment services. AMD and its subsidiaries are equal opportunity, inclusive employers and will consider all applicants without regard to age, ancestry, color, marital status, medical condition, mental or physical disability, national origin, race, religion, political and/or third-party affiliation, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We encourage applications from all qualified candidates and will accommodate applicants' needs under the respective laws throughout all stages of the recruitment and selection process.

 - Experience in one or more NFR testing areas such as Security, Load and Performance using tools like JMeter, Load Runner and OWASP. 
 - Experience in integrating QA automation / NFR scripts with DevOps tools such as Jenkins / Teamcity. 
 - Experience using CMS systems such as AEM & Contentful as part of the technology solution - either in a Traditional or Headless implementation. 
 - Experience using QA Cloud / SaaS platforms such as Applitools / Saucelabs / BrowserStack

 - Experience in creating detailed test plans and test cases based on functional and non-functional requirements.

QUALITIES AND CHARACTERISTICS

- Versatile and able to adapt to frequently changing schedules and priorities in a fast-paced, agile environment.

AKQA is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company - powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. data.title: Assistant Manager - Process Quality
data.description:
Position Summary

This position will be responsible for working in tandem with other colleagues in the Quality function and be responsible for implementing and improving systems in the processes and assure compliance with customer technical expectations and internal Quality targets along with quality-related statutory & regulatory requirements. In addition, the incumbent will identify and lead Zero defect concept, multi-functional six sigma and Kaizen projects focused on improving quality systems. 

Responsibilities

- Studies, interprets & communicates customer, regulatory and organizational requirements to assure product quality, and customer satisfaction through the standard work of preparing, maintaining & updating PFMEA's, Process flow diagrams, Control plans, Inspection plans & Check sheets. 
 - Performs process capability studies and identifies OFI and develops improvement methodologies in coordination with Process Engineering and product design Engineering. 
 - Evaluates customer & warranty claims and develops improvement measures through the CFT approach and communicates to the customer on a timely basis in customer specific formats. 
 - Communicates & coordinates with CFT for customers and third-party quality inspection / audits. 
 - Works with other Quality engineers and CFT's in the preparation and submission of APQP & PPAP documents for new products and engineering changes. 
 - Prepares MRM documentation for process Quality and presents effectively during the review meetings. 
 - Acquires customer metrics relating to quality performance, trends and corrective action and defines improvement measures. 
 - Participates and contributes actively in Kaizen events, SbD & deflation workshops. 
 - Continuously improves professional and technical knowledge by attending focused training programs & educational workshops. 

Qualifications

Qualifications

- BE / B Tech Mechanical Engineering Graduate with 8 years Exp or Diploma with 12 years' experience. 
 - Experience in the Quality function with demonstrated ability to perform independently with a clear track record of shouldering increased responsibility
 - Hands on expertise in using 10 step problem solving process, 7 QC tools, process capability evaluation, conducting FMEA studies and usage of software tools such as Minitab, IQFMEA, Q-DAS Etc. 
 - Familiarity and alignment with QMS standards : Specifically ISO 9001 and IATF 16949. 

Key Competencies

- Should have strong experience in the process quality and capable of thinking innovative ideas / suggestion to ensure the quality both at in process and customer end. 
 - Candidates should have strong analytical skill and capable of initiating corrective measures at all stages of processes. 
 - Possess strong hands on expertise in using measuring instruments such as Vernier calipers, micrometers, profile projectors, roughness testers, contour testers, roundness testers Etc. 
 - Have the basic knowledge of GD & T and be able to design simple inspection jigs and fixtures. 
 - Should have Participated in HPT, Kaizen and completed a six sigma GB project. 
 - Possess good interpersonal skills coupled with Verbal & Written skills required to be successful in this role.

data.title: AI Platform Senior Engineer, QA
data.description:
About Accrete

Accrete is an agentic managed services company: an AI workforce that does high-stakes, judgement-heavy work for government and enterprise clients - at the economics of software, not labor. 

At the core is Accrete's Knowledge Engine, a dynamic context graph that captures an organization's tacit knowledge, resolves data across silos, and builds a living, auditable ground truth. Expert agents reason against that ground truth to act on complex, high-stakes decisions - not just answer questions about them. 

From national security to commercial operations, Accrete delivers the work on one platform, with unlimited expert agents and expert judgement. 

About The Role

We are seeking an AI Platform Senior Engineer, QA - Agentic AI & Automation to lead quality assurance for our agent-driven platforms and AI models. This role focuses on validating intelligent agents, non-deterministic AI outputs, and cross-product workflows using advanced automation and AI evaluation techniques. 

You will play a key role in building our Enterprise AI Trust & Validation Framework, ensuring reliability, transparency, and scalability of AI systems. 

Key Responsibilities

Agentic AI & System Testing

- Test multi-agent workflows, orchestration layers, and cross-domain intelligence systems
 - Validate AI-generated narratives, themes, and analytical outputs. 
 - Perform groundedness, coherence, hallucination, and stability testing. 
 - Test conversational AI and chat-based agent systems. 
 - Evaluate consistency across multiple runs and detect output drift. 

Automation & Framework Development

- Design and maintain automation frameworks using Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Pytest, and Playwright. 
 - Build E2E automation for UI, APIs, and agent pipelines. 
 - Develop reusable test utilities for AI validation and regression testing. 
 - Integrate automation with CI/CD pipelines. 

AI Model & Evaluation Testing

- Validate in-house AI/ML models and inference pipelines. 
 - Implement LLM-as-Judge and semantic similarity-based validation. 
 - Perform statistical and comparative testing for model outputs. 
 - Support testing of models deployed on AWS. 

API & Performance Engineering

- Perform API testing using Postman and automated scripts. 
 - Design and execute load and stress testing. 
 - Monitor system performance under AI-heavy workloads. 
 - Identify bottlenecks and scalability risks. 

Quality Strategy & Collaboration

- Analyze business requirements, user stories, and AI specifications. 
 - Design test strategies for agentic and AI-driven systems. 
 - Work closely with Engineering, Product, and Data Science teams. 
 - Track defects, quality metrics, and release readiness. 
 - Drive continuous improvement in QA processes

Required Qualifications

- 6-8+ years of experience in QA, Automation, or Quality Engineering. 
 - Strong proficiency in Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Pytest, and Playwright. 
 - Experience testing AI systems, chatbots, or LLM-based platforms. 
 - Strong understanding of non-deterministic system testing. 
 - Experience with API testing (Postman, REST frameworks). 
 - Hands-on experience with performance testing. (K6 familiarity is a plus). 
 - Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments. 
 - Strong analytical and debugging skills. 
 - Excellent communication and documentation abilities. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with agent frameworks (LangChain, AutoGen, CrewAI, etc. ). 
 - Knowledge of RAG systems and vector databases. 
 - Exposure to MLOps and AI observability tools. 
 - Experience with cloud platforms (AWS preferred). 
 - Familiarity with statistical validation and NLP evaluation. 
 - CI/CD experience (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab). 
 - Familiarity with containerization technologies such as Docker/Kubernetes

Core Competencies

- AI Quality Engineering
 - Agent Workflow Validation
 - Automation Architecture
 - Model Evaluation & Monitoring
 - Performance Engineering
 - Risk Assessment
 - Cross-team Collaboration
 - Ownership Mindset

Career Growth

This Role Offers Growth Into Positions Such As

- Principal AI QA Engineer
 - AI Systems Quality Architect
 - QA Engineering Lead
 - AI QA Engineering Manager

Cultural Fit & Values

At Accrete, Success Goes Beyond Technical Expertise. We Value

- Ownership & Accountability: Drive initiatives to completion with high standards and proactive problem-solving. 
 - Transparency & Communication: Share information openly and give and receive constructive feedback. 
 - Strategic Thinking & Problem-Solving: Analyze challenges critically and develop effective, scalable solutions. 
 - Collaboration & Professionalism: Work effectively across teams and contribute to a culture of mutual respect. 
 - Passion for AI & Innovation: Stay curious, continuously learn, and push the boundaries of AI. 
 - Going Beyond the Job Description: Look for opportunities to create impact beyond your immediate responsibilities. These principles shape our culture, performance expectations, and growth opportunities. 

Company Benefits

- Competitive Compensation: Aligned with experience and market standards. 
 - Mediclaim: ₹10 lakh coverage for you and your family. 
 - Flexible PTO & Hybrid Work: Take time off when needed and enjoy remote flexibility in accordance with company guidelines. 
 - Growth & Development: Access to professional learning opportunities and career advancement support. 
 - Onsite Perks: Catered lunches and snacks. 
 - Team Bonding: Company-sponsored social events and team activities.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law.

This job assesses business requirements, completes research and analysis to determine solutions and makes recommendations for enhancements. data.title: Vice President of Software Engineering
data.description:
Overview

Haptiq is an AI-native enterprise solutions company with purpose-built technology for public and private companies, governments, institutions, asset managers, and family offices. With headquarters in New York City and global offices in India, Poland, and Canada, Haptiq is supported by more than 100 engineers and delivery professionals across the globe. By centralizing and unifying data, automating workflows, and surfacing predictive insights, Haptiq enables organizations to scale operational excellence and generate alpha across complex enterprise environments. 

Our ecosystem spans the Core Platform (PaaS), an AI-native foundation for enterprise operations; our SaaS products for performance and decision support; and our Solutions & Consulting suite, which

delivers enterprise-grade custom implementations for clients and their portfolio companies. 

The Opportunity

Haptiq is looking for a VP of Engineering to lead our global client engineering organization of around 80 people from our India office, reporting to the CEO. You will own how we build and deliver software across our client engagements, in close partnership with our Platform and Olympus product teams, and you will shape what engineering at Haptiq looks like as we scale. 

Your organization spans Software Engineering, QA, and DevOps across India, the US, and Canada. You will lead through Directors and Engineering Managers, set the technical and delivery standards they work to, and partner closely with our clients, Product, Project Management, Client Partners, Data, and the executive team in the USA. 

This role suits a leader who is equally comfortable in an architecture review, a client steering meeting, and a hiring debrief. It is a chance to build an AI-first engineering culture at a company where engineering is the product. 

Responsibilities and Duties

Engineering Strategy & Technical Leadership

- Set the technical vision and architecture direction for our client solutions, built on Haptiq's Core Platform and aligned with company strategy. 
 - Lead an AI-first approach to how we build, test, and deliver software, including AI-assisted development, QA automation, and AI capabilities inside our products. 
 - Establish engineering standards for code quality, architecture, security, and observability, and make sure they are followed across every team and location. 
 - Guide key architecture decisions for scalable, composable, API-first systems primarily on AWS. 

Organization & People Leadership

- Lead, grow, and retain a global organization of around 80 people through Directors, Engineering Managers, and functional leads. 
 - Design the org structure, career frameworks, and hiring plans needed to scale the team, including building strong leadership depth in India. 
 - Shape the leadership layer into a clear, scalable span of control as the organization grows. 
 - Coach and develop leaders, run performance and growth conversations, and build a succession pipeline for critical roles. 
 - Build an inclusive culture of ownership, accountability, and continuous learning where people of every background do their best work. 

Delivery & Operational Excellence

- Own engineering delivery across product and client programs: on time, on budget, and to a high quality bar. 
 - Define and track KPIs for delivery predictability, quality, team health, utilization, client satisfaction, client retention, and account growth, and report them to the executive team. 
 - Manage the engineering budget, resource allocation, and capacity planning across projects and locations. 
 - Run mature agile, DevOps, and distributed delivery practices that work well across time zones. 
 - Own production support and service levels across client environments, including release management, QA sign-off, cloud cost optimization, security patching, and consistent code review. 

Client Leadership & Cross-Functional Partnership

- Own the executive relationship for our largest client accounts, serving as the engineering counterpart to client CTOs, CIOs, COOs, and CFOs, and helping them shape roadmaps and make technology decisions. 
 - Contributes to steering committees and quarterly business reviews. Translate technical decisions into business terms: cost, risk, timeline, revenue impact and ROI. 
 - Be the escalation point when delivery is at risk, and lead difficult conversations about scope, budget, and timeline with candor. 
 - Be comfortable with the finance side of client systems (GL postings, reconciliations, revenue share, reporting) and able to discuss it credibly with a CFO or controller. 
 - Drive client retention and account growth by spotting new opportunities and shaping follow-on work with Client Partners and Sales. 
 - Partner with Sales and pre-sales on solutioning, estimates, technical proposals, and RFP responses. 
 - Work closely with Product, Client Partners, and Solutions Architects to turn business needs into scalable solutions. 
 - Present to client leadership teams and, where relevant, their private equity sponsors, and represent Haptiq engineering in the wider tech community. 

Innovation & Continuous Improvement

- Track emerging technologies in software, cloud, data, and AI/ML, and bring the relevant ones into our products and delivery. 
 - Lead modernization of tooling, platforms, and processes to raise productivity and reduce cost to deliver. 
 - Ensure our products and solutions meet data security and privacy and regulatory requirements our clients expect, including protection of PII, payment, and client data. 

Requirements

- 12+ years in software engineering, product engineering, or digital consulting, including 5+ years leading engineering leaders (Directors or Managers). 
 - A proven record of owning C-level client relationships (CTO, COO, CFO) in a services or consulting setting, including steering committees, escalations, and account expansion, with the presence to present to client leadership teams and PE sponsors. 
 - Proven experience leading a global, multi-disciplinary engineering organization of 50+ people across engineering, QA, DevOps, and delivery. 
 - A track record of delivering complex software at scale in a product company, an IT services or consulting firm, or both. 
 - Strong technical depth across modern stacks, with the credibility to guide architecture decisions: 
 - Front-end (React, Next. js) and back-end (Ruby on Rails, Node. js/NestJS, TypeScript, Python, or similar)
 - Distributed systems and API-first, composable architectures
 - Data architectures, both relational and document databases
 - Cloud infrastructure design on AWS (Azure a plus), with infrastructure as code such as Terraform
 - Event-driven systems and integrations such as Kafka, API gateways, and third-party SaaS connectors
 - Has rolled out AI coding agents (e. g. , Claude Code, Copilot) across multiple teams with measured gains in speed and quality, and set the guardrails for using AI with client data and IP. Experience building AI and ML features into products is a plus. 
 - Deep experience with agile, DevOps, CI/CD, and distributed delivery models across time zones. 
 - Experience owning engineering budgets, capacity planning, and delivery KPIs. 
 - Excellent written and verbal communication, and the presence to work with senior executives and clients in the US and globally. 
 - Able to work with significant overlap with US Eastern time and to travel to the US regularly for client and leadership meetings. 
 - Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. We know great leaders come from many paths. If you meet most of these requirements and are excited about the role, we encourage you to apply. 

Nice to Have

- Experience delivering for mid-market and PE-backed companies across industries; financial services, asset management, or fintech a plus. 
 - Experience building SaaS or platform products, including APIs, SDKs, and integrations. 
 - Familiarity with headless CMS and eCommerce platforms (e. g. , Storyblok, Shopify). 
 - Knowledge of authentication and identity standards (OAuth, OpenID Connect, Okta). 
 - Experience scaling an India-based engineering center as part of a global organization. 

Why Join Us?

We value creative problem solvers who learn fast, work well in an open and diverse environment, and enjoy pushing the bar for success ever higher. We do work hard, but we also choose to have fun while doing it. 

As VP of Engineering, you will have real influence over our technology, our culture, and the careers of the people you lead, with the backing of a leadership team that sees engineering as the heart of the business. 

Haptiq is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of every gender, age, religion, caste, ethnicity, nationality, disability, sexual orientation, and background. If you need any adjustments during the hiring process, please let us know.

Join us in building the future of personal devices at Amazon!

Are you ready to shape the future of how people experience technology in their everyday lives? Join us in building the next generation of personal devices - where hardware, software, and AI converge to create experiences that feel like magic. 

The Emerging Devices Software (EDS) organization is pioneering intelligent software solutions that power Amazon's Personal Devices, including Smart Eyewear and other emerging wearable categories. Our mission is to create seamless, AI-driven experiences that live at the intersection of hardware, software, and artificial intelligence - redefining how customers interact with technology in their daily lives. We're building the future of personal devices while maintaining Amazon's highest standards for quality, reliability, and customer obsession. 

The personal devices challenge is a fascinating blend of real-world complexity and technological innovation. We're tackling multidimensional problems that span mobile applications, cloud services, on-device intelligence, and hardware integration - all while delivering best-in-class user experiences to customers around the world. From optimizing low-latency interactions on constrained wearable hardware to building scalable cloud backends and integrating ML/AI capabilities, every problem we solve pushes the boundaries of what's possible. 

We are looking for a seasoned Software Development Manager to lead an engineering team within EDS, solving these intricate challenges. You'll work on software that span the mobile-cloud stack, own end-to-end delivery of features and experiences, and help shape the long-term technical direction of our products. 

Key job responsibilities

- Lead, mentor, and grow a team of Software Development Engineers working across the mobile-cloud stack, fostering a culture of technical excellence, ownership, and continuous improvement

A day in the life

About The Team

And all this happens under the strong leadership of talented SDMs like you!

data.title: Principal Engineer - MCP/ACP Layer(API & AI Orchestration)
data.description:
Join ABC Fitness and become part of a culture that's as ambitious as it is authentic. Let's transform the future of fitness-together!

Our Values

Best Life

We believe great work begins with great people. That's why our culture is built on respect, trust, and belonging. We create an inclusive environment where every team member can bring their authentic self to work-because diverse perspectives drive innovation and meaningful impact. 

Growth Mindset

We are doers, thinkers, and dreamers. At ABC Fitness, your growth is our investment. Through continuous learning, mentorship, and professional development opportunities, we empower you to reach new heights-personally and professionally. 

One Team

From day one, you'll be part of a team that collaborates, celebrates, and cares. We move fast, support one another, and have fun along the way. Because when you thrive, we all thrive. 

What You'll Do

- Architect, build, and evolve the MCP / ACP ecosystem that exposes ABC Fitness capabilities as standardized, agent-consumable tools. 
 - Design schemas, tool definitions, and abstraction layers that shield AI agents from the complexity and inconsistency of underlying systems while providing clean, structured, hallucination-resistant interfaces. 
 - Define and implement reusable orchestration patterns for multi-step AI workflows, including tool use, validation, retries, state management, fallback handling, and long-running execution flows. 
 - Build for deterministic execution by ensuring AI-driven tool interactions are predictable, safe, observable, auditable, and reversible where necessary. 
 - Establish company-wide standards for AI interaction patterns, structured outputs, input/output validation, schema governance, and agent orchestration workflows. 
 - Design and implement security, permissions, and access control patterns specifically for non-human actors and autonomous systems, including auditability, rate controls, and operational boundaries. 
 - Build instrumentation and observability capabilities that trace agent interactions, identify schema friction, measure execution quality, and improve orchestration success rates over time. 
 - Partner closely with API modernization, platform engineering, infrastructure, security, and SRE teams to define AI-ready integration patterns and ensure scalable production operations. 
 - Lead technical design reviews and influence architecture decisions across teams building AI-native systems on the platform. 
 - Define and document reusable patterns, reference implementations, SDKs, and paved paths that accelerate safe AI adoption across ABC Fitness. 

What You'll Need

- Typically 10+ years of software engineering experience, including deep expertise building distributed backend systems, APIs, orchestration layers, or platform infrastructure; experience in the broader 8-14 year principal range is most aligned for this level. 
 - Proven experience designing and operating high-scale backend systems with strong understanding of state management, concurrency, reliability, and distributed execution patterns. 
 - Strong understanding of how LLMs interact with tools and workflows, including schema design, structured outputs, predictable execution patterns, and orchestration reliability. 
 - Deep expertise in abstraction design and wrapping legacy or complex systems with clean, scalable, and reusable interfaces. 
 - Experience building workflow orchestration systems handling retries, failure states, long-running processes, and multi-step execution logic. 
 - Demonstrated ability to define technical standards and influence engineering direction across multiple teams through architecture, design review, and strong engineering judgment. 
 - Strong production mindset, including experience designing for observability, operational resilience, auditability, scalability, and performance optimization. 
 - Excellent cross-functional collaboration skills and the ability to work effectively with Engineering, Product, Platform, Infrastructure, Security, and SRE teams. 
 - A growth mindset and strong learning agility in a rapidly evolving AI and platform engineering landscape. 
 - A One Team orientation: able to enable other engineering teams, establish scalable paved paths, and create reusable platform capabilities rather than isolated solutions. 

And It's Great to Have

- Experience with Model Context Protocol (MCP), ACP patterns, LangChain, LangGraph, or similar AI orchestration frameworks. 
 - Experience with middleware platforms, API gateways, service mesh architectures, or distributed control planes. 
 - Experience building internal developer platforms, SDKs, or shared engineering tooling. 
 - Experience implementing AI observability, tracing, prompt tracking, model evaluation, or orchestration telemetry systems. 
 - Familiarity with policy enforcement, safe model execution, permissioning systems, and AI governance patterns in production environments. 
 - Experience helping engineering organizations adopt new technical standards through documentation, mentoring, and reference implementations. 

What Success Looks Like

- The MCP / ACP layer becomes the standardized paved path for how AI agents interact with ABC business systems. 
 - Product and platform teams can integrate new AI agents and workflows with core systems quickly, safely, and consistently. 
 - AI workflows are reliable, observable, auditable, and secure in production environments. 
 - Agent actions are fully permissioned, rate-limited, and operationally controlled to prevent unsafe or unintended behavior. 
 - Platform standards reduce integration complexity and accelerate adoption of AI-native development patterns across engineering teams. 
 - The connectivity layer directly enables new AI-powered product capabilities, intelligent services, and operational automation initiatives. 

Why This Matters

ABC Fitness is building toward an AI-native future by developing agentic experiences, intelligent workflow automation, and platform-level capabilities that turn data and models into action. The work spans recommendation systems, orchestration, embedded intelligence, and scalable AI-powered product experiences that directly influence how customers acquire, serve, retain, and grow their members. 

If the API is the "data, " and the Agent is the "brain, " the MCP/ACP Layer is the "hands. " Without you, our AI can think but it cannot act. By building this layer, you enable ABC Fitness to move from "AI as a feature" to "AI as an employee

WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU: 

- Purpose led company with a Values focused culture - Best Life, One Team, Growth Mindset
 - Time Off - competitive PTO plans with 15 Earned accrued leave, 12 days Sick leave, and 12 days Casual leave per year
 - 11 Holidays plus 4 Days of Disconnect - once a quarter, we take a collective breather and enjoy a day off together around the globe. #oneteam
 - Group Mediclaim insurance coverage of INR 500, 000 for employee + spouse, 2 kids, and parents or parent-in-laws, and including EAP counseling

Description

The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes when using the AWS Cloud. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud computing initiatives. Our team provides assistance through a collection of offerings which help customers achieve specific outcomes related to enterprise cloud adoption. We also deliver focused guidance through our global specialty practices, which cover a variety of solutions, technologies, and industries. 

We are looking for a Senior Application Architect to design and deliver modern, cloud-native applications for AWS Professional Services (ProServe) India customers. In this role, you will own the technical architecture of complex customer engagements, from application assessment and modernization strategy through design, build, and production go-live. You will advise senior customer engineering leaders on how to re-architect, migrate, and modernize their application portfolios on AWS. 

The ideal candidate is a hands-on architect with deep software engineering and IT consulting experience and a proven track record of delivering large-scale distributed applications for enterprise customers. You can work through ambiguous problems with limited guidance and make sound architectural trade-offs across cost, performance, security, and resilience. You thrive in a fast-paced, growth environment, insist on the highest standards, and enjoy mentoring engineers and turning proven patterns into reusable assets for the wider team. 

You will lead technical workstreams made up of AWS consultants, partners, and customer developers, and set the architecture direction across microservices, containers, serverless, APIs, data integration, and DevOps practices. You are expected to write and review code, produce architecture artifacts, run design reviews, and resolve technical risks before they affect delivery. You will also support pre-sales by shaping solution designs and estimates, earn customer trust through technical credibility, and use AI/GenAI (including AI-assisted development tools) to speed up how applications are designed and built. 

In this capacity you will be based in India and are expected to travel occasionally (30-40%). You will report into the India ProServe Application Architecture Delivery Practice Manager.

We are looking for hands-on architects/developers who are passionate about:

Job Description

Job Title: Senior AI/ML Engineer

The Purpose of This Role

As a Lead GenAI Engineer, you will design and build the core building blocks of this platform: a provider-agnostic LLM gateway, guardrails and governance, retrieval and agentic infrastructure, evaluation harnesses, and the observability and cost-attribution systems that make GenAI viable at enterprise scale. You will work alongside a team of platform engineers, set technical direction, and raise the engineering bar through hands-on work and mentorship. 

This is a platform and infrastructure role, not an applied / prompt-engineering role. Your users are internal engineering teams and business teams; your product is the platform they build on. 

The Value You Deliver

- You will collaborate with partners, iterate on requirements, follow Fidelity best practices / methodologies, have thorough understanding of the technology roadmap, advancement to design / development process. 
 - Engineering excellence is a collective set of choices we make as technologists, whether to increase code coverage or ship a product, investing in developer productivity vs saving $$$. You will consistently make culture choices that positively impact all of engineering. 
 - You do not compromise for the sake of social acceptance and demonstrate conviction and drive to operate in highly ambiguous situations thriving in uncertainty while keeping your eyes on the long-term vision. 
 - You lead by example and by your code - set engineering standards, review designs and PRs, and grow the capability of the wider team. 
 - You will drive technical discussions, arbitrate, and recommend optimal path forward in a room of highly opinionated engineers and work towards ensuring platform offerings are scalable, resilient, and secure. 

Key Responsibilities

The Skills that are Key to this role

- Own foundational platform capabilities - design, build, and operate core services such as an LLM gateway / router, a normalized multi-provider API contract, and shared SDKs that abstract away provider differences (OpenAI, Anthropic, AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex, Azure OpenAI, and self-hosted / open models). 
 - Build guardrails and governance - implement per-tenant policies, rate limiting, PII / data-leakage controls, content safety filters, and prompt-injection defenses as reusable platform primitives. 
 - Design retrieval and agentic infrastructure - build shared RAG components (embedding pipelines, vector store integrations, chunking / indexing services) and tool-calling / agent-orchestration infrastructure (function calling, MCP, multi-agent frameworks). 
 - Deliver observability and cost management - instrument the platform for latency, token usage, and quality metrics; build chargeback / showback and usage-attribution so teams see and own their consumption. 
 - Establish evaluation frameworks - create automated, repeatable evals for quality, safety, and regression, so model and prompt changes can be shipped with confidence. 
 - Drive architecture and technical direction - make build-vs-buy decisions, define the API contracts other teams depend on, and ensure the platform is scalable, resilient, and secure. 
 - Lead through code and mentorship - set engineering standards, review designs and PRs, and grow the capability of the wider team. 
 - Partner with stakeholders - translate the needs of platform consumers, security, and leadership into a clear roadmap and well-specified deliverables. 
 - Establish best practices for token optimization, context window management, prompt compression, caching strategies, and cost-efficient AI inference. 

Preferred Qualifications

Platform Engineering experience with a strong foundation in building and operating production backend / distributed systems (not just notebooks or POCs). Knowledge of AI governance, security, responsible AI, and compliance requirements. Demonstrated ability to proliferate GenAI capabilities at scale in a safe, secure and integrable way. 

Must Have

- Deep proficiency in Python (and comfort with at least one of Go / Java / TypeScript for services and tooling). 
 - Hands-on experience building LLM-powered systems in production - integrating LLM APIs, RAG pipelines, prompt orchestration, and / or agentic workflows. 
 - Solid API and platform design skills: designing clean, versioned, provider-agnostic interfaces that other teams consume. 
 - Practical experience with cloud platforms (AWS / GCP / Azure), containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and CI/ CD. 
 - Working knowledge of the GenAI ecosystem - vector databases (pgvector, Pinecone, Milvus, Weaviate), orchestration frameworks (LangGraph, LangChain, CrewAI, LlamaIndex), and evaluation tooling. 
 - Strong grasp of LLMOps / MLOps concerns: observability, cost control, versioning, rollout strategies, and reliability. 
 - A security- and reliability-first mindset - you think about guardrails, data governance, failure modes, and blast radius by default. 
 - Strong understanding of Model parameters and tuning , Prompt strategies , Cost, latency, and quality optimization , Model selection and benchmarking methodologies
 - Demonstrated technical leadership: driving architecture and delivering complex systems end-to-end. 

Nice-to-Haves

- Experience building internal developer platforms, API gateways, or multi-tenant infrastructure. 
 - Exposure to model serving / inference optimization (vLLM, TGI, quantization, GPU scheduling) or selfhosting open-weight models. 
 - Familiarity with fine-tuning / adapters (LoRA), embeddings model selection, and evaluation methodology. 
 - Experience with cost governance, chargeback / showback, or FinOps for AI workloads. 
 - Contributions to open-source GenAI tooling or frameworks. 
 - Domain experience in a regulated industry (fintech, healthcare) where data governance is critical. 

How Your Work Impacts the Organization

- The Technology Foundations (TF) group provides ready-to-use solutions composed of a standard technology stack, development frameworks, reusable software components and services. The ideal candidate must be a solid team player with a strong understanding of the application delivery cycle: design, development, build, and deployment. The candidate will play an important role in developing integrable, cohesive GenAI platform capabilities working on one of our Technology Foundations Products, Opinionated Deployment Pipelines, Gen AI Foundation and Services. 

BU Overview -

Asset Management Technology (AMT) supports the Information Technology needs of several investment management organizations within Fidelity Investments, including FMRCo, FIL Investment Management, Pyramis, and Strategic Advisors. There are several technology teams in US / India which work together as a delivery team in providing solutions to the business. ATF (Architecture Technology Foundation) is a technology horizontal for AMT that provides shared technology solution and services by working closely with the IT partner teams and understanding their business requirements. 

Location: Bangalore - Manyata

Shift timings: 11: 00 pm - 8: 00pm

data.title: CS&D Technical Lead Architect - CTI MD Tech (LRL)
data.description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50, 000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work-but it's work worth doing. If you're driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us. 

LRL takes potential marketable products from Research through product registration and approval, enabling MDU's business needs of the future through information and technology solutions. Within this portfolio, Clinical Supply & Delivery (CS&D) owns the systems and platforms that move investigational drug product - from packaging and labeling through distribution and fulfillment - to clinical trial sites, reliably, compliantly, and on time for trial execution. The CS&D Technical Lead Architect owns end-to-end technical architecture for these platforms - moving CS&D from point-solution delivery to a coherent, agentic-AI-enabled architecture, and from reactive engineering support to proactive, roadmapped portfolio transformation. 

Path/Level: R5 (CS&D Technical Lead Architect)

This role is split roughly 70% hands-on technical execution - building agentic architecture, integration patterns, and platform capability directly - and 30% strategy, roadmap ownership, and portfolio-level transformation planning. The CS&D Technical Lead Architect shapes the future technology landscape for CS&D's clinical supply and trial-material delivery platforms, aligning business strategy with technology investment, AI/agentic innovation, and architecture to drive operational excellence, compliance, and scalable transformation. 

Key Responsibilities

- Portfolio Architecture Ownership (Hands-On) - design, build, and directly implement the technical architecture for CS&D's critical platforms - containerized services, CI/CD pipelines, cloud infrastructure, data pipelines, and integration layers; own architecture roadmaps and standards for the platforms in scope, preparing decisions ahead of delivery rather than resolving them reactively. (placeholder - confirm scope: demand/supply forecasting, packaging & labeling, distribution and site-level fulfillment, trial-material tracking)
 - Agentic AI & Portfolio Transformation - drive a portfolio-wide exploration of AI/agentic opportunities across CS&D's platforms; evaluate build-vs-buy for each opportunity; own and evolve a staged, roadmapped vision for shifting CS&D's architecture toward agentic-based patterns wherever viable, sequencing the transformation gradually rather than as a single cutover; convert validated proofs-of-concept into production-grade, reusable agentic architecture. 
 - Governance, Risk & GxP/GCP Compliance - embed audit-readiness, security and change-control thinking into architecture patterns; ensure designs meet FDA/EMA and internal IT/quality policy requirements, including GMP, GCP considerations relevant to clinical trial material handling; maintain architecture documentation supporting audit, inspection, and CSV readiness across the platforms owned. 
 - Technology Evaluation & Platform Modernization - evaluate emerging cloud, data, and AI/agentic technologies for CS&D applicability; run staged proofs-of-concept before adoption; identify and retire technical debt, consolidating and simplifying the platform footprint. 
 - Business & Product Partnership - partner with product managers and business stakeholders to translate business goals, capabilities, and value-streams into technical solutions; lead architectural discussions and decision-making, facilitate knowledge-sharing, and manage expectations through clear communication. 
 - Decision-Making (Platform-Scoped) - hold design and integration decision authority within the CS&D platforms owned end-to-end; approve implementation-level architecture and integration patterns; escalate - rather than unilaterally resolve - enterprise-architecture, investment-level, or cross-portfolio GxP risks that sit outside platform scope. 
 - India-Led Global Ownership - represent CS&D Tech in relevant architecture forums; build shared ownership and accountability between the India team and global stakeholders; grow India as the technical decision-making center for the platforms owned, not just a delivery location. 
 - Talent Development & Technical Leadership - conduct code reviews and provide hands-on guidance to development teams; mentor engineers toward stronger architecture and agentic-design capability; contribute to hiring and technical talent planning. 

Technical & Strategic Expertise Areas

Enterprise & Solution Architecture

- Agentic AI & Multi-Agent Architecture
 - Generative AI
 - Architecture Design Patterns (N-tier, Microservices, Event-Driven/Reactive, Batch/Micro-Batch/Real-Time)
 - Containerization & Orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes)
 - CI/CD & DevOps (GitHub Actions, AWS CodePipeline/Copilot)
 - Cloud Platforms (AWS: EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda, Glue, Redshift/Redshift Spectrum, Athena)
 - Event-Driven Architecture (Kafka, RabbitMQ, SNS/SQS)
 - API & Integration Architecture
 - Data Architecture (RDBMS, NoSQL, Data Pipelines, Search Engines)
 - Spark/PySpark, Hadoop
 - Caching & CDN (Redis, CloudFront)
 - Front-End & Back-End Development (React, Node. js, Python, Django/Flask)
 - Cloud/Platform Migration
 - Security & Compliance Architecture (GxP, GCP, CSV)
 - Platform Engineering
 - Portfolio-Level Problem Breakdown

Basic Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or related field (Master's preferred). 
 - 12+ years in solution/enterprise architecture or senior technical leadership, with direct, ongoing coding/build involvement - not oversight-only experience. 
 - Proven experience designing, building, and deploying agentic/AI architecture, including evaluating build-vs-buy for AI/agentic capability; experience implementing AI/ML tech stacks within production programs. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes), CI/CD pipelines, and DevOps practices. 
 - Strong grasp of architecture design patterns - N-tier, microservices, stateful vs. stateless, request-response vs. loose-coupling vs. reactive, batch/micro-batch/real-time processing. 
 - Advanced proficiency in Python and JavaScript, with fullstack experience (React, Node. js). 
 - Solid experience with relational and NoSQL databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, DynamoDB), search engines, and AWS ETL services (Glue, Data Pipeline, Redshift Spectrum). 
 - Experience with event-driven architecture (Kafka, RabbitMQ, AWS SNS/SQS). 
 - Ability to design, build, and unit test applications on the Spark framework in Python, including PySpark for batch and streaming workloads. 
 - Experience operating in regulated (GxP/GCP) environments, including computer system validation (CSV) and inspection-readiness practices. 
 - Experience with clinical trial data - its structure, sourcing, and use in supply chain / trial execution contexts. 
 - Track record translating business goals and value-streams into technical architecture decisions. 
 - Demonstrated ability to mentor engineers and lead architectural discussions without requiring a formal people-manager structure. 

Additional Qualifications / Competencies

- Strategic and analytical thinking - sequencing a multi-year agentic transformation roadmap rather than one-off point solutions. 
 - Experience representing India-based technical teams in global architecture or governance forums. 
 - Comfort operating in ambiguity, driving clarity around architecture dependencies and transformation sequencing. 
 - Experience leading platform or data migration initiatives.

data.title: Senior QA Engineer - Vehicle Networks and Telematics
data.description:
Netradyne harnesses the power of Computer Vision and Edge Computing to revolutionize the modern-day transportation ecosystem. We are a leader in fleet safety solutions. With growth exceeding 4x year over year, our solution is quickly being recognized as a significant disruptive technology. Our team is growing, and we need forward-thinking, uncompromising, competitive team members to continue to facilitate our growth. 

Senior QA Engineer - Vehicle Networks and Telematics

Role Overview

As a Senior QA Engineer in the CAN QA team, you will own validation of how our devices read, interpret and report vehicle data, from the CAN bus through the device to the cloud. You will develop test strategies for J1939 and OBD-II integrations, automate protocol and signal-level testing, investigate complex field issues, and provide evidence-based release-readiness recommendations. 

This is a hands-on role for someone equally at home with a CAN trace, a bench power supply and a truck cab, and who can convert requirements, DBCs, logs and field evidence into reliable qualification coverage. 

What You Will Own

- Validation strategy and release qualification for CAN-based vehicle features, new vehicle onboarding and customer configurations. 
 - Requirement-to-test coverage for vehicle signals, diagnostics, power modes and end-to-end telematics workflows. 
 - Root-cause investigation of signal mismatches, intermittent CAN failures and vehicle-specific field issues. 
 - Reusable CAN simulation, trace replay, fault-injection and automated regression capabilities. 
 - Technical guidance through test-design reviews, automation reviews and structured defect triage. 

Key Responsibilities

Vehicle Networks and Diagnostics

- Validate SAE J1939 PGN/SPN decoding for vehicle speed, odometer, engine hours, fuel, DM1/DM2 faults and other supported signals. 
 - Validate OBD-II modes, PIDs, DTCs and VIN handling using SAE J1979 and ISO 15765-4. 
 - Verify scaling, offsets, units, ranges, rollover, timeouts, stale data, source-address handling and not-available values. 
 - Test J1939 transport protocol (BAM and RTS/CTS), request messages, address claim and bus-off recovery. 
 - Correlate device-decoded values with trusted CAN tools and OEM or dealer diagnostic systems. 

Power Modes and CAN Wake-up

- Validate wake-up on CAN traffic and ignition, sleep after bus silence, shutdown and recovery across supported configurations. 
 - Measure quiescent current and verify that the device causes no unwanted wake-ups, excessive bus traffic or vehicle battery drain. 
 - Validate ignition (KL15) and battery (KL30) scenarios, brownouts, power interruptions and repeated ignition cycles. 

Bench, HIL and Vehicle Testing

- Set up and execute bench, HIL and in-vehicle tests using CAN interfaces, programmable power supplies, ignition control and harnesses. 
 - Simulate ECUs, replay recorded traces, inject protocol and signal faults, and reproduce field scenarios in the lab. 
 - Validate integrations across commercial and passenger vehicles, makes, models and model years, including in fleet yards and at customer sites. 

End-to-End Feature Validation

- Validate CAN-derived data from vehicle bus to cloud for fleet features such as fuel consumption, fuel-level trends, idle fuel, refueling and suspected fuel theft. 
 - Validate CAN-derived inputs supporting ELD/HOS workflows, including engine power state, vehicle motion, distance, engine hours and malfunction scenarios, against product requirements and the FMCSA ELD rule. 
 - Support validation of EV signals (state of charge, charging state, energy usage) and OTA/firmware regression for vehicle-specific releases. 

Test Design, Automation and Debugging

- Translate product requirements, protocol specifications, DBC files and field use cases into risk-based, traceable test plans. 
 - Build maintainable Python, CAPL or equivalent automation for CAN simulation, trace replay, signal verification, negative testing and regression. 
 - Analyze CAN traces, device and application logs, power measurements and cloud telemetry to isolate failures across the vehicle, harness, firmware, configuration and cloud layers. 
 - Create clear defect reports with reproducible steps, trace evidence, expected versus actual behavior and impact. 
 - Work with development teams to close gaps in testability, diagnostics and observability. 

Required Qualifications

- 3+ years of experience in QA or validation of embedded, automotive, telematics or IoT products, with substantial hands-on CAN work and a track record of owning test strategy, traceability and release-readiness decisions. 
 - Strong CAN 2. 0A/B fundamentals, including 11-bit and 29-bit identifiers, arbitration, error handling and bus-off behavior. 
 - Hands-on expertise in SAE J1939, with working knowledge of OBD-II. 
 - Experience interpreting DBC files and validating raw frames, decoded signals, scaling, timing and invalid-data behavior. 
 - Hands-on experience with one or more CAN analysis and simulation platforms, such as Vector CANalyzer/CANoe, Intrepid Vehicle Spy, PEAK PCAN or Kvaser, and scripting in Python, CAPL or an equivalent language. 
 - Strong embedded-system debugging and root-cause analysis skills across hardware, firmware, network and backend boundaries, with the ability to explain technical risks and evidence clearly to cross-functional stakeholders. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Understanding of CAN wake-up and sleep behavior, ignition concepts, power-state transitions and sleep-current measurement. 
 - Comfort working with vehicle harnesses, multimeters, programmable power supplies and bench equipment. 
 - Working knowledge of UDS (ISO 14229) and ISO-TP, including diagnostic sessions, reading and clearing DTCs, and reading data identifiers. 
 - Awareness of CAN FD and experience with HIL systems or ECU/network simulation. 
 - Exposure to J1708/J1587 on older heavy-duty vehicles. 
 - Python experience with libraries and frameworks such as python-can and pytest, including data-driven and parameterized testing. 
 - Experience with Linux-based environments, SocketCAN and can-utils (candump, cansend), shell tools, log analysis, Git and code-review workflows. 
 - Experience in fuel management, ELD/HOS (FMCSA), vehicle diagnostics, EV telemetry or other CAN-based fleet features. 
 - Experience using AI-assisted tools for test design, log triage or trace analysis. 
 - Experience with Jira, Confluence and CI-based automated testing for traceability, defect management and qualification reporting.

data.title: Software Development Manager
data.description:
Description

Ask any Customer Service Associate what slows them down and they'll show you: the field that doesn't autofill, the extra click on every third contact, the lookup that opens in another tab. None of these earns a spot on a roadmap by itself. Together they cost tens of thousands of associates minutes every day, and well over a thousand such requests reach us every year from the people on the front line. 

Your team fixes them. Based in Hyderabad, it has a mandate no other team has: go into any codebase across the associate workspace, ship the fix through the owning team's pipelines and review process, and move to the next one. Each month a scored list of associate-raised problems arrives. Your team sizes them, embeds with the teams that own the code, and ships. Every fix credits the associate who raised it. 

What sets this role apart is that you run a mechanism, not just a team. The monthly intake with product leaders, the capacity math, the working relationships with a dozen engineering managers whose code your engineers touch, and the quarterly story to senior leadership about what got better are all yours. You'll also be the one who can say, with evidence, where the workspace's architecture makes small fixes hard. That feeds directly into the 2027 effort to rebuild it as one AI-assisted experience. 

You'll lead seven engineers directly and work as a peer with a senior program manager who runs intake and a senior engineer who sets the technical bar, with evenings that overlap partner teams in Seattle, Toronto, and Austin. If you like shipping every week and reading the thank-you notes, this is the job. 

Key job responsibilities

Own the fix-it mechanism end to end: monthly intake with product and senior leadership, engineer-led estimation, sequencing against capacity, delivery, and a readiness check before each fix reaches associates. 

Deliver through embedded execution. Your engineers join the team that owns the affected code as temporary members, follow its design and review norms, use its pipelines and tests, and leave the codebase better than they found it. You make that model work across teams in three cities. 

Hire, grow, and retain a team of software engineers spanning early-career to senior. Set and hold the bar on design, code, testing, and documentation, and coach engineers through promotion. 

Build and keep trust with every engineering manager whose codebase your team touches. Negotiate access, review bandwidth, and release windows; resolve design disputes through principal engineers rather than around them. 

Measure what matters: fixes shipped, associate impact per fix, and mechanism health, reported quarterly to senior leadership. 

Deliver through others: remove blockers, make scope calls, and keep stakeholders informed without surprises. 

Make the team AI-native: use AI tooling to raise velocity and quality across unfamiliar codebases. 

A day in the life

Your main job is keeping fixes flowing from associates' complaints to production. Mornings in Hyderabad start with the month's intake list alongside your program manager and a product leader: which problems made the cut and what each will take. Then a design review for a fix in another team's component, checking it follows their patterns, and a 1: 1. Late afternoon you unblock an engineer waiting on a Seattle team's review; your evening overlaps North America for a call with that team's manager about release windows. Beyond the usual: quarterly, you tell senior leadership, with numbers, what got better for associates. 

About The Team

Your main job is keeping fixes flowing from associates' complaints to production. You start your day with the month's intake list alongside your program manager and a product leader: which problems made the cut and what each will take. Then a design review for a fix in another team's component, checking it follows their patterns, then a 1: 1. You unblock an engineer waiting on a Seattle team's review, and when North America comes online you take a call with that team's manager about release windows. Beyond the usual: quarterly, you tell senior leadership, with numbers, what got better for associates. 

Basic Qualifications

- 7+ years of engineering experience
 - 3+ years of engineering team management experience
 - 8+ years of leading the definition and development of multi tier web services experience
 - Knowledge of engineering practices and patterns for the full software/hardware/networks development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, certification, and livesite operations
 - Experience partnering with product or program management teams
 - Experience designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience in communicating with users, other technical teams, and senior leadership to collect requirements, describe software product features, technical designs, and product strategy
 - Experience in recruiting, hiring, mentoring/coaching and managing teams of Software Engineers to improve their skills, and make them more effective, product software engineers
