data.title: Senior Engineering Manager - Benefits
data.description:
About Rippling

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system. 

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365-all within 90 seconds. 

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1. 85B+ from the world's top investors-including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock-and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes. 

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling. com addresses. 

About The Benefits Marketplace Team

- Benefits is one of the most complex and critical parts of managing a workforce. Employers must navigate insurance carriers, brokers, plan configurations, eligibility rules, enrollment processes, and regulatory requirements, often across fragmented systems. 
 - Rippling's Benefits Marketplace is transforming this experience by bringing benefits discovery, enrollment, administration, and carrier integrations into a unified platform. 
 - We're building highly scalable systems that connect employers, employees, insurance carriers, and benefits providers while automating complex workflows across the employee lifecycle. 
 - The team operates at the intersection of product engineering, distributed systems, marketplace infrastructure, and complex integrations, solving challenging problems around data consistency, scalability, reliability, and automation. 

About The Role

- We're looking for a Senior Engineering Manager to lead and scale a high-performing engineering team within Benefits Marketplace. 
 - This is a high-ownership role combining deep technical leadership, product development, and people management. You'll drive the architecture and execution of critical systems, influence product direction, and help shape the future of Rippling's Benefits platform. 
 - You'll work on complex engineering challenges involving distributed systems, carrier integrations, asynchronous workflows, and business-critical transactions. 
 - We're looking for someone with a strong product-building mindset, exceptional technical judgment, and a proven ability to develop engineers and deliver complex products at scale. 
 - You'll be expected to remain close to the technology, challenge architectural decisions, drive execution, and build a culture of engineering excellence. 

What You Will Do

- Lead and grow a high-performing engineering team, attracting, mentoring, and developing exceptional engineering talent. 
 - Own the technical strategy, architecture, and execution of critical Benefits Marketplace products and services. 
 - Build scalable, reliable backend systems supporting benefits enrollment, eligibility, carrier integrations, and complex business workflows. 
 - Drive architectural decisions involving distributed systems, APIs, asynchronous processing, data consistency, and fault tolerance. 
 - Partner with Product, Design, Platform, and senior engineering leaders to define roadmaps and translate ambiguous business problems into scalable solutions. 
 - Stay technically engaged through system design reviews, architectural discussions, critical code reviews, and production troubleshooting. 
 - Lead end-to-end product development, balancing execution velocity, engineering quality, and long-term scalability. 
 - Build a culture of strong ownership, accountability, technical excellence, and continuous improvement. 

What You Will Need

- 12-17 years of software engineering experience, including 5+ years of engineering management experience. 
 - Strong technical foundation in backend engineering, distributed systems, system design, and scalable architecture. 
 - Proven experience building and scaling complex, customer-facing products from conception to production. 
 - Strong coding and architectural expertise in languages such as Java, Python, Go, C++, Scala, or equivalent. 
 - Demonstrated ability to lead high-performing engineering teams, develop senior engineers, and maintain a high technical bar. 
 - Strong product mindset with the ability to translate customer and business needs into technical strategy and execution. 
 - Experience driving engineering roadmaps, setting priorities, managing dependencies, and delivering complex initiatives. 
 - Ability to operate in ambiguous environments, make sound technical trade-offs, and influence decisions across teams. 
 - Strong collaboration and communication skills, with experience working across global engineering and product organizations. 
 - Experience building marketplace platforms, enterprise SaaS, fintech, or integration-heavy products is a plus.

data.title: Staff, Full Stack Engineer
data.description:
Job Purpose: 

- Enterprise AI (EAI) builds AI products that combine real modelling work with user-facing applications, and ships them to production. Full Stack Engineers move across data, models, platforms, APIs and interfaces in a single workflow. In our operating model, digital workers do much of the hands-on build. They generate services, APIs, interface components and tests, run evaluations and monitor what is in production. Our engineers set the architecture and standards that work is built to, and own the quality of what ships. 
 - EAI products and agents draw on a governed context layer that makes data, meaning, permissions and history retrievable at the moment they are needed. Full Stack Engineers build the products and agents that consume it, and decide how that context reaches users. 
 - The Full Stack Engineer II independently builds and ships AI-integrated features, working closely with GSK business teams to prototype against real data and workflows at a days-to-weeks cadence. The role owns the quality of what digital workers deliver in those features, makes evidence-based calls on what to continue or stop, and contributes reusable components others adopt. 

Responsibilities: 

- Own use cases from problem framing through working prototype and first production version, at a days-to-weeks cadence and without close supervision. 
 - Qualify incoming asks: challenge underspecified problems, assess feasibility and define scope before committing to work. At the end of each piece of work, form and defend an evidence-based recommendation to continue or stop, presented clearly to business and EAI leadership. 
 - Work closely with business teams, prototyping against real data and workflows and building trusted relationships with product owners and engineering leads. 

Required skills: 

- 16+ years of overall professional experience & 10+ years of full-stack or AI/ML engineering experience, including production deployments. 
 - Demonstrated ability to take ideas from sketch to working software at speed, independently and under time pressure. A startup, lab or innovation-team background is an advantage. 
 - Strong proficiency in Python and at least one of TypeScript, JavaScript, Go or similar, with experience designing and shipping backend services and complete UI features. 
 - Hands-on experience with GenAI patterns: agents, multi-agent orchestration, RAG, tool use, prompt engineering and evaluation, including evaluation pipelines and LLM-specific monitoring in production. 
 - Daily use of AI coding agents as the primary mode of development, with sound judgement on what to accept, change or reject. 
 - A track record of raising team standards through code review and documentation, and of contributing reusable engineering patterns that others adopted. 

Education : 

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Applied Mathematics or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 

Preferred skills: 

- Prior experience as a Full Stack Engineer, Customer Engineer or Solutions Architect, ideally at an AI-native company or hyperscaler. 
 - Experience in regulated industries, such as life sciences, healthcare or financial services, and familiarity with GxP, GDPR and SOX. 
 - Working knowledge of fine-tuning fundamentals and Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations. 

Skills

AI Platforms, AI Systems, Data Analysis, Full Stack Development, Machine Learning (ML), ML Platforms, Model Evaluation, Performance Analysis, Product Delivery, Product Design, Roadmap Development, Statistical Analysis

Modulr is backed by PayPal, FIS, General Atlantic, Blenheim Chalcot, Frog Capital and Highland Europe, with over 400 employees across London, Edinburgh, Amsterdam, Mumbai and Pune.

a particular growth area. Each squad is small and cross-functional. We have big ambitions and have many interesting challenges ahead.

In this role you will design, build, and evolve the next generation of Modulr's event-driven payments platform. You'll work across the full engineering lifecycle-from shaping technical approaches to delivering production-grade software-within a squad that values ownership, excellence, and continuous improvement. 

Specific duties

Distributed Systems & Reliability

data.title: Manager / Senior Manager – Operational Excellence & Quality Management
data.description:
Manager / Senior Manager - Operational Excellence & Quality Management

Industry: Flexible Packaging Manufacturing

Experience: 7-10 Years

Company: Nexibles

1. Role Overview

Responsible for improving manufacturing productivity, operational efficiency, product quality and profitability through Six Sigma, TQM, Lean Manufacturing and continuous improvement. 

Must have strong factory-floor experience, preferably in flexible packaging manufacturing, including printing, lamination, slitting and pouch making. 

2. Key Responsibilities

1. Operational Excellence: Improve plant productivity, OEE, throughput, machine utilization, capacity utilization and production efficiency. Reduce downtime, setup time, changeover losses and process bottlenecks. 

2. Quality Management (TQM): Strengthen quality systems across incoming materials, in-process production and finished goods. Improve quality parameters, reduce defects, rejection, rework and customer complaints. 

3. Six Sigma & Lean Manufacturing: Implement DMAIC, SPC, FMEA, RCA, Kaizen, 5S and process standardization projects to improve quality, productivity and efficiency. 

4. Flexible Packaging Process Optimization: Optimize printing, lamination, slitting and pouch-making processes. Reduce registration errors, colour variations, delamination, sealing defects and material wastage. 

5. Quality Systems & CAPA: Conduct root cause analysis, manage corrective and preventive actions, strengthen inspections, internal audits and process controls. Ensure customer quality requirements are met. 

6. Cost Optimization & Waste Reduction: Reduce film, ink, adhesive, solvent and other raw material losses. Improve first-pass yield, material utilization, conversion costs and manufacturing margins. 

7. MIS & Performance Monitoring: Develop operational dashboards, monitor KPIs, track improvement projects and present weekly/monthly performance reports to Plant Management and senior leadership. 

8. Training & Team Development: Train production, quality and shop-floor teams in Lean, Six Sigma, TQM, SOPs, problem-solving and continuous improvement. Drive quality ownership and process discipline. 

3. Required Qualifications & Experience

- B. E. / B. Tech in Mechanical, Production, Industrial, Polymer, Chemical Engineering or related discipline. 
 - 7-10 years of experience in manufacturing operations, quality management or operational excellence. 
 - Strong preference for flexible packaging manufacturing experience. 
 - Practical knowledge of printing, lamination, slitting and pouch making. 
 - Proven experience in Six Sigma, TQM, Lean Manufacturing and continuous improvement. 
 - Demonstrated results in productivity improvement, rejection reduction and cost savings. 
 - Strong knowledge of OEE, SPC, FMEA, DMAIC, Kaizen, 5S and Root Cause Analysis. 
 - Experience working with Production, Quality, Maintenance and Plant Management teams. 

4. Preferred Skills & Certifications

- Six Sigma Green Belt / Black Belt. 
 - Lean Manufacturing and TQM. 
 - ISO 9001, ISO 22000 and BRCGS Packaging Materials. 
 - Knowledge of printing, lamination, films, adhesives and packaging quality parameters. 
 - Minitab or equivalent statistical tools. 
 - ERP systems, Excel, MIS and operational dashboards. 
 - Experience leading cross-functional factory improvement projects. 

5. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

The candidate will be evaluated on the following performance areas: 

1. Manufacturing Efficiency : - Improve OEE, production output (throughput) and capacity utilization. 

2. Quality Improvement : - Reduce product defects, rejection and rework. 

3. Material Utilization : - Reduce wastage of film, ink, adhesives and other raw materials. 

4. Cost Reduction : - Achieve measurable annual cost savings through process improvements. 

5. Production Yield : - Improve first-pass yield (producing good-quality products without rework). 

6. Process Stability : - Reduce variations and inconsistencies in manufacturing processes. 

7. Equipment Performance : -Reduce machine downtime, setup time and changeover time. 

8. Customer Satisfaction : -Reduce customer complaints and recurring quality issues. 

9. Continuous Improvement : -Successfully implement Lean, Six Sigma and TQM projects. 

10. Process Standardization : -Ensure proper implementation of SOPs and process controls. 

6. Ideal Candidate Profile

An experienced manufacturing professional with 7-10 years of experience, preferably in flexible packaging, who can: 

- Work directly on the factory floor. 
 - Understand manufacturing processes, machines and quality parameters. 
 - Analyze production data and identify root causes. 
 - Implement sustainable process improvements. 
 - Reduce wastage, rejection and manufacturing costs. 
 - Lead cross-functional teams. 
 - Present measurable business improvements to senior management. 

Most important expectation

Success will be measured through tangible and sustainable improvements in manufacturing productivity, quality consistency, operational efficiency, waste reduction and profitability. 

Interested candidates can share their updated CV at: Email: sneha. singh@perusalglobal. com

data.title: Solutions Architect
data.description:
Who we're looking for

A Client-Facing Builder-Architect: someone who can talk trade-offs with a client in the morning and be deep in the logs with the dev team by the afternoon. You bridge business goals and technical execution, and you stay close enough to the code to know what you're advising on. 

As a Solution Architect, you own the end-to-end technical solution. You're the person a client's leadership trusts to turn a business goal into a design, and the person engineers trust to make that design work in practice. Your mantra: design, validate and deliver the right end-to-end solution. 

Here's what you look like: 

- A trusted advisor. You're a technical sounding board for client technology and business leaders, and you translate dense tech into business value, risk and cost. 
 - A zero-ego builder. No ivory tower. You write proofs of concept, review critical code and dig through logs alongside the developers. 
 - Calm when it counts. When production breaks or an escalation lands, you get methodical and steady, and the room settles with you. 
 - Diplomatic with pushback. You handle client trade-offs and disagreements with confidence and good grace. 
 - Commercially pragmatic. You pick business outcomes and delivery speed over a perfect, over-engineered stack. 
 - Globally minded. You lead distributed teams and bridge US client expectations with India-based delivery pods. 
 - Full-stack engineering mindset: Demonstrate a full-stack engineering mindset, with the ability to understand and work across the complete application stack, including frontend, backend, APIs, databases, integrations, cloud infrastructure, deployment, security, performance, and observability, as relevant to the solution. 
 - AI-forward. You use generative AI and AI-assisted engineering tools (LLMs, GitHub Copilot, Claude) in solutions and delivery workflows, with human oversight, security, privacy and governance. 
 - At home in digital learning. You're comfortable with frameworks like LTI, Ed-Fi, QTI and CEDS in enterprise platform ecosystems. About the role

We're hiring a Solution Architect: a client-facing technical leader who turns business objectives into end-to-end solutions, then drives them from presales all the way through implementation and production. 

You'll blend client advisory, solution architecture, hands-on problem-solving and delivery leadership. You'll be comfortable in a room with senior client stakeholders, and close enough to engineering to validate decisions and untangle complex technical challenges yourself. 

Location: Mumbai

Level: Solution Architect

What you'll do

- Sit down with client technology and business leaders to understand their strategic goals, business challenges and technical constraints. 
 - Lead discovery, solution definition, architecture design, technology selection and technical planning for complex applications and enterprise solutions. 
 - Lay out solution alternatives, build-versus-buy assessments, modernization strategies and technology roadmaps in terms of business value, risk, cost and delivery impact. 
 - Define the end-to-end architecture across application, integration, data, cloud, security and infrastructure, as the solution needs.

data.title: Site Reliability Engineer - Azure Infrastructure
data.description:
Job Title: Site Reliability Engineer

Location: Hybrid

Job Type: Full-time

ServiceChannel is the leading cloud-based service automation platform for facility management. We offer a single platform to source, procure, manage and pay for repair and maintenance services from commercial contractors. ServiceChannel is well established, but even after almost 20 years we still retain the spirit of a startup. We are primed for success and we are currently on a high growth trajectory. We are committed to creating a great product for our customers and a great work environment for our employees to succeed professionally and personally. 

ServiceChannel's DevOps team is looking for a Site Reliability Engineer to join our expanding Infrastructure team. As an SRE you will own the monitoring and reliability of the ServiceChannel platform. You will run incidents, set up and tune alerts, and trace problems to their root cause across the application and the infrastructure. You will bring deep and broad Azure knowledge, strong Elastic Cloud skills, and enough . NET to read the code and see why it is failing, and you will use what you learn to improve our systems. 

Key Responsibilities

- Running incidents from detection through resolution, keeping stakeholders updated, and driving each one to a confirmed root cause. 
 - Owning monitoring and alerting: setting up, tuning and maintaining alerts for the platform. 
 - Investigating and troubleshooting to find what is broken and which part of the infrastructure is causing it, based on how the ServiceChannel platform maps to that infrastructure. 
 - Root cause analysis using data to identify the scope and scale of impact, and writing the RCA with follow-up actions to prevent recurrence. 
 - Writing and maintaining runbooks, and updating them after each incident. 
 - Operating and maintaining the Azure, Windows Server and Elastic Cloud environments day to day and keeping them highly available, including patching, disks and server rotation. 
 - Handling DevOps support requests for access, provisioning and environment changes across Azure, Elastic and Service Bus. 
 - Managing DNS, private endpoints, traffic routing, VPN, SSL/TLS certificates and Key Vault secrets, including renewals and expiry alerts. 
 - Responding to security and compliance items, such as CVEs and audit requests. 
 - Improving and automating systems based on what incidents and investigations reveal. 
 - Measuring and optimizing the service: defining and tracking SLIs and SLOs, right-sizing capacity, reviewing Azure cost, and finding availability, performance and security improvements. 
 - Working closely with Engineering, Customer Support and the US team to bridge gaps in code, infrastructure and knowledge, with clear handoffs at the end of each shift. 
 - Participating in a weekly on-call rotation covering 12: 00 AM ET to 12: 00 PM ET to troubleshoot production issues. 

Skills & Experience

- Deep and broad knowledge of Azure infrastructure and how its features and services work, including the following. 
 - Compute and apps: App Services, Functions, Container Apps, Virtual Machines
 - Integration and messaging: API Management, Service Bus, Event Grid
 - Traffic and networking: Front Door, Application Gateway, load balancers, virtual networks, private endpoints, VPN gateways
 - Data: Storage accounts, Redis, and working familiarity with Azure SQL and SQL Server
 - Identity and access: Entra ID, RBAC, SSO (SAML)
 - Monitoring and security: Azure Monitor, Application Insights, Log Analytics, Key Vault
 - AI: working familiarity with Azure AI Foundry
 - Strong written and verbal communication, with the ability to explain technical problems and their impact clearly to engineers, Customer Support and non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Hands-on experience running Elastic Cloud in production: search, cluster management, Logstash and Kibana. 
 - Comfortable with Docker containers. 
 - Working knowledge of . NET and C#: reading code and stack traces to tell whether a failure comes from the code, its configuration or the infrastructure. 
 - Proven ability to lead incidents and troubleshoot production issues down to root cause. 
 - Skilled at building and tuning monitoring and alerting systems, using Azure Application Insights, incident. io, distributed tracing and anomaly detection. 
 - Solid understanding of SRE practices: SLIs, SLOs, error budgets and blameless postmortems. 
 - 3+ years of relevant experience focused on service reliability: DevOps, systems administration, application development, build, release, and deployment. 
 - Broad Windows Server knowledge: managing VMs, domain controllers and Group Policy (GPO), adding and managing disks, troubleshooting Windows DNS, IIS and services, and working over RDP. 
 - Working experience with configuration management and automation tools (Ansible preferred, or similar). 
 - Solid grounding in networking and security, including DNS, load balancing, firewalls, VPNs and private connectivity. 
 - Experience managing SSL/TLS certificates and secrets, including renewals, rotation and expiry alerts, and controlling Key Vault access with RBAC. 
 - Experience supporting complex distributed systems that must stay up 24x7. 
 - Familiar with CI/CD pipelines and tooling (GitHub, TeamCity, Azure DevOps, Octopus), and Git workflows. 
 - Strong track record of writing clear runbooks, RCAs and technical documentation. 
 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related technical field. 
 - Nice to have: PowerShell and Bash scripting, Azure DSC, Terraform, Kubernetes, AWS, and experience using AI assistants to script, troubleshoot and automate faster. 
Why Work for Us?

Our work environment is dynamic, collaborative, and entrepreneurial. We are firm believers in working to live and not living to work. Don't get us wrong, we work hard and do what it takes to get the job done, but we value a healthy work/life balance and have a lot of fun along the way. Our company is filled with foodies, music lovers, travelers, and sports nuts. 

We are looking for energetic, positive, creative problem solvers who don't mind digging in and getting their proverbial hands dirty. Our greatest benefit is our amazing ServiceChannel team!

Fortive Corporation Overview

Fortive's essential technology makes the world safer and more productive. We accelerate transformation in high-impact fields like workplace safety, build environments, and healthcare.

Our forward-looking companies lead the way in healthcare sterilization, industrial safety, predictive maintenance, and other mission-critical solutions. With a diverse and talented team spread across the world, we are committed to driving innovation and pushing the boundaries of what's possible in our field.

In this role, you will contribute to designing, developing, and maintaining scalable applications that power Meltwater's data and analytics platforms. You will work across frontend, backend, databases, and cloud infrastructure to deliver reliable, high-performing, and user-friendly solutions. The ideal candidate should have strong hands-on experience in ReactJS, backend development expertise in Python or Java, and solid database experience with PostgreSQL/MySQL and MongoDB. Experience with CI/CD pipelines, Docker, cloud platforms, and modern DevOps practices is highly preferred

What You'll Do: 

- Design, develop, and maintain highly scalable backend services and APIs using Python. 
 - Build and optimize microservices that power core platform and product capabilities. 
 - Design and implement RESTful APIs and backend services to support customer-facing features and internal platforms. 
 - Develop and maintain event-driven systems using technologies such as Kafka or RabbitMQ. 
 - Build and maintain large-scale data processing pipelines and backend workflows. 
 - Design solutions for high availability, reliability, scalability, and observability. 
 - Work with databases such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, and Redis to support high-performance applications.

 - Collaborate with Product Managers, Engineers, Data Scientists, and other stakeholders to deliver high-quality solutions. 
 - Drive architectural decisions and contribute to the evolution of backend platforms and engineering standards. 
 - Mentor engineers through code reviews, design reviews, and technical guidance. 
 - Troubleshoot complex production issues and continuously improve system performance, reliability, and operational excellence. 
 - Write clean, maintainable, and testable code while following engineering best practices.

 - Expert-level proficiency in Python and a strong foundation in software engineering principles, design patterns, and best practices. 
 - Extensive experience designing, building, and operating large-scale backend systems in production environments. 
 - Strong experience with RESTful API design, microservices architecture, and distributed systems. 
 - Deep understanding of scalability, performance optimization, fault tolerance, and reliability engineering. 
 - Experience with messaging and streaming platforms such as Kafka or RabbitMQ.

data.title: Software Engineer - ADM
data.description:
Who We Are

Addepar is a global data and AI platform empowering investment professionals to turn complex financial information into actionable intelligence. Addepar unifies portfolio, market and client data in a total portfolio view and delivers AI-powered insights within investment and client workflows. More than 1, 500 firms in 60 countries use Addepar to manage and advise on nearly $10 trillion in assets. Its open platform integrates with 650 software, data and consulting partners to power end-to-end investment operations across firms of all sizes and levels of complexity. Addepar supports clients worldwide with offices in New York City, Salt Lake City, São Paulo, London, Edinburgh, Geneva, Warsaw, Dubai, Pune and Singapore. 

The Role

Did you know? Alternative investing has the potential to generate higher returns compared to traditional investments over the long term. AI and Machine Learning are revolutionizing the way alternative investments are managed and analyzed. Investors are using these technologies to gain insights, see opportunities, and optimize their investment strategies. 

Addepar is building solutions to support our clients' alternatives investment strategies. The alternatives data management product is a serverless, modular and terraformed stack. We're hiring a Senior Software Engineer to design, implement and deliver modern software solutions that ingest and process ML-extracted data. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams including data scientists and product managers to build intuitive solutions that revolutionize how clients experience alternatives operations. 

You will work closely with operations engineering on document-based workflow automation and peer engineering teams to define the tech stack. You will iterate quickly through cycles of testing a new product offering on Addepar. If you've crafted scalable systems, or worked with phenomenal teams on hard problems in financial data, or are just interested in solving really hard technical, critically important problems, come join us!

Applicants must have legal authorization to work in the country where this role is based on the first day of employment. Visa sponsorship is not available for this position. 

What You'll Do

- Architect, implement, and maintain engineering solutions to solve complex problems; write well-designed, testable code. 
 - Lead individual project priorities, achievements, and software releases. 
 - Collaborate with machine learning engineers to bring ML-extracted data into the backend stack of the application in Python or other languages. 
 - Collaborate with product managers and client teams on product requirements iterations, design feasibility and user feedback. 
 - Document software functionality, system design, and project plans; this includes clean, readable code with comments. 
 - Learn and promote engineering standard methodologies and principles. 

Who You Are

- At least 3 years of Backend development experience
 - In-depth knowledge of Python or Java similar
 - Experience with NoSQL databases
 - Experience with serverless architecture
 - IaC (infrastructure as code), preferably terraform
 - Solutions-oriented, with exceptional analytical and problem solving skills
 - Experience with AWS is a strong plus. 
 - Experience with DynamoDB, OpenSearch/Elasticsearch
 - Familiarity with writing, debugging, and optimizing SQL queries
 - Knowledge of front end development is a plus. 
 - Experience in fintech (wealth/portfolio management domain) is a plus. 

Our Values

- Act Like an Owner - Think and operate with intention, purpose and care. Own outcomes. 
 - Build Together - Collaborate to unlock the best solutions. Deliver lasting value. 
 - Champion Our Clients - Exceed client expectations. Our clients' success is our success. 
 - Drive Innovation - Be bold and unconstrained in problem solving. Transform the industry. 
 - Embrace Learning - Engage our community to broaden our perspective. Bring a growth mindset. 

In addition to our core values, Addepar is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We seek to bring together diverse ideas, experiences, skill sets, perspectives, backgrounds and identities to drive innovative solutions. We commit to promoting a welcoming environment where inclusion and belonging are held as a shared responsibility. 

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

Reasons You'll Love It Here: 

Our benefits may vary slightly by location, but at our Trivandrum office you can expect a comprehensive package including group health insurance for you and your family, Provident Fund (PF) and gratuity contributions, generous paid time off including earned leave, casual leave, sick leave, and public holidays, and paid parental leave. We also strongly encourage and provide opportunities for learning and professional development. Our Learning & Development team has put together in-house training on subjects like front-line supervisor essentials, technical leadership, how to manage conflict in the workplace, and many others. 

What to Do Next: 

Now that you've had a chance to learn more about us, what are you waiting for! Apply today and allow us the opportunity to learn more about you and the value you can bring to our team. Once you apply, be sure to create a profile, and sign up for job alerts, so you can be the first to know when new opportunities become available. 

Our Commitment to You: 

We're proud of the fact that we are strongly rooted in being an inclusive, people-focused organization. Our company culture reflects values like integrity, ownership, and authenticity. We take these to heart, and if you do as well, you'll fit right in. Leggett & Platt Inc. is committed to the full inclusion of all qualified individuals and welcomes applications from candidates of all backgrounds.

Today our growing company consists of more than 23, 000 employee-partners in 120 manufacturing facilities located in 23 countries, including our engineering Development Center in Trivandrum, India. - End-to-End Full Life Cycle Execution: Design, develop, test, deploy, and operate reliable, scalable microservices and cloud-native features end-to-end without downstream QA, SDET, or Technical Writing handoffs.

Koch Technology is seeking a hands-on Lead Cloud Solution Engineer who can design, build, and ship production-grade custom software in AWS.  - Business Partnership: Work directly with business, product, and platform teams to understand problems, define outcomes, validate solutions, and continuously improve them after go-live. 
 - Engineering Excellence & Mentorship: Conduct code and design reviews, establish reusable engineering patterns, mentor developers and BSAs, and escalate technical or platform risks with clear recommendations.

 - Exposure to legal, compliance, EHS, facilities, or another regulated or process-heavy business domain.

data.title: Principal, Design for Safety & Reliability
data.description:
Job Description

Principal, Design for Safety & Reliability

Engineering CoE

- Product safety and reliability
 - India

Reports to

Head of Engineering - Education Segment

Business

Schneider Electric

- Education Equipment and Services

Location

Bangalore, India, with travel to plants, partners and customer sites across the segment's markets

Scope

Global: product safety and reliability for the full training-solutions portfolio - Smart Energy, Smart Buildings, Smart Factory, Digital Blocks, Data Centers and Fundamental Learning - across design, industrialisation and the installed base

About The Education Segment

Schneider Electric's Education Segment provides technical training solutions that close the skills gap in energy, automation and digital technologies. We equip technical and vocational institutes, universities, government skilling programmes and industry academies with hands-on training labs, curricula, digital learning, train-the-trainer programmes and certification. 

Demand is rising fast. Governments are investing heavily in workforce skilling, industry faces acute technician shortages, and the energy transition and smart manufacturing need new skills at scale. The segment has already helped more than 200, 000 young people gain job-ready skills. 

We are now building a dedicated, multi-country organisation to grow the business across six markets, with its own business development, engineering and delivery teams. Engineering is at the heart of what we offer: training solutions built on real industrial technology. 

Purpose of the role

Make every Education Segment training solution safe for learners and trainers, and reliable over years of daily classroom use. Our labs put students in direct contact with real industrial equipment: LV and MV electrical systems, batteries, solar, motors and drives, robots and connected devices. Safety and reliability must be designed in from the start. 

As the single technical authority for product safety and reliability in the Engineering CoE, you will set the design rules, risk-assessment methods and reliability standards that every Product Architect works to. You will review and approve designs before release, lead reliability testing and field-failure analysis, and work with the Principal, Conformity Assessment so products can be certified in every target market. 

Market overview

Institutions are buying more advanced training equipment, with higher voltages and power, battery storage, robotics and connected systems, often used by beginners. Governments, accreditation bodies and customers expect equipment that is safe by design, meets local standards and keeps working through heavy use. 

A single safety incident or poor field reliability can damage trust with institutions and governments across a whole market. Strong design for safety and reliability is therefore a core part of the segment's competitive position and of Schneider Electric's reputation. 

Key responsibilities

Safety and reliability framework

- Define the Education Segment's product safety and reliability policy, design rules, checklists and standards library, aligned with Schneider Electric's product safety governance. 
 - Set safety requirements specific to training use: protection against electric shock, touch-safe connections, safe access to live parts during exercises, fault simulation, emergency stops, and safe use by beginners. 
 - Set reliability targets and design-margin rules for each product family, covering expected lifetime, duty cycles and classroom handling. 

Design for safety

- Lead hazard analysis and risk assessment (for example FMEA, HAZOP and fault-tree analysis) for new and upgraded products, with the Product Architects. 
 - Apply relevant safety standards, such as IEC 61010 (laboratory equipment), IEC 61439 (LV assemblies), IEC 62271 (MV switchgear), IEC 60204-1 (machinery), IEC 62368, ISO 10218 (robots) and battery safety standards. 
 - Cover the hazards specific to the portfolio: LV and MV electrical risk, arc flash, battery storage and thermal runaway, PV DC circuits, rotating machinery, robots and cobots, and the safety effects of cybersecurity weaknesses in connected equipment. 
 - Review and approve safety design at each release gate, and define safe-use instructions, labelling, guarding and personal protective equipment requirements. 

Design for reliability

- Lead reliability engineering: component derating, design reviews, reliability prediction (for example MTBF) and design-for-maintainability rules. 
 - Define and run reliability and durability testing, including accelerated life, thermal, vibration, transport and repeated wiring-cycle tests for classroom use. 
 - Assess the reliability of suppliers and locally procured items with Quality and Global Supply Chain. 

Industrialisation and quality

- Define safety-critical characteristics and routine production tests, such as insulation, earth continuity, dielectric and functional safety checks, with the Industrialization Leader and plants. 
 - Approve first-article and pilot builds for safety and reliability before volume production. 
 - Make sure safety requirements carry through to local assembly, partner production and country localisation. 

Field safety and reliability

- Set up incident reporting and field-failure analysis across the installed base with the operations centres, Technical Specialists and service partners. 
 - Lead root-cause analysis of safety incidents and reliability failures, and drive corrective and preventive actions, including field notices or recalls when needed. 
 - Track field reliability data and feed lessons back into design rules and the product roadmap. 

Certification support

- Work with the Principal, Conformity Assessment to prepare safety and reliability evidence, risk assessments and test reports for certification in each target country. 
 - Monitor changes in safety standards and regulations, and assess their impact on the portfolio. 

Capability building

- Train Product Architects, engineers, delivery teams and partners on safety and reliability design, safe installation and safe lab operation. 
 - Contribute safety content to train-the-trainer programmes, so institutions run labs safely. 
 - Build a strong safety culture in the Engineering CoE and grow the safety and reliability capability as the organisation scales. 

Success measures

Measure

Target

Safety performance

Zero serious safety incidents involving Education Segment equipment

Design governance

Every new and upgraded product passes safety and reliability review before release

Field reliability

Field failure rate falling and meeting targets for each product family

Certification readiness

Safety evidence ready on time for certification in all target countries

Corrective action

Root-cause analysis and corrective actions closed on time

Framework

Safety and reliability policy, design rules and test methods defined and in use

Capability

Engineers, delivery teams and trainers trained on safety and reliability

Key relationships

- Internal: Head of Engineering; Principal, Conformity Assessment; Product Architects and Senior Engineers (Smart Energy, Smart Buildings, Digital/IIoT, Data Centers); Industrialization Leader; Operations Head, Technical Specialists and the operations centres; Schneider Electric product safety, quality and Global Supply Chain teams. 
 - External: test laboratories, certification and standards bodies; manufacturing partners and suppliers; institutions, trainers and accreditation bodies; insurers and safety regulators where relevant. 

Candidate profile

- 12+ years in product safety, reliability engineering, compliance or design engineering for electrical, automation or industrial equipment. 
 - Critical: deep expertise in electrical product safety and risk assessment, with hands-on use of IEC safety standards such as IEC 61010, IEC 61439, IEC 60204-1 and IEC 62368. 
 - Proven reliability engineering skills: FMEA, derating, reliability prediction, accelerated life and environmental testing, and field-failure analysis. 
 - Knowledge of battery, MV and machinery or robot safety is a strong advantage. 
 - Experience taking products from design through industrialisation, with safety-critical production tests and supplier quality. 
 - Experience with training or educational equipment, or other products used by non-experts, is a strong plus. 
 - Able to influence engineering teams and make firm safety decisions without relying on hierarchical authority. 
 - Degree in Electrical, Electrical & Electronics or Mechanical Engineering; master's or a recognised safety or reliability certification (for example CRE or functional safety) preferred. Willing to travel across India and the segment's markets.

data.title: Principal Test Engineer
data.description:
For more than 30 years, SonicWall  has delivered a partner-first unified cybersecurity portfolio that helps SMBs, MSPs, and IT teams consolidate network security, endpoint security, security service edge (SSE), and threat response across hybrid environments. By bringing connected technology, real-time threat intelligence, automation, and expert services together, SonicWall helps organizations simplify security operations, achieve better security outcomes, and lower total cost of ownership. Backed by a global ecosystem of more than 17, 000 partners, SonicWall delivers enterprise-grade protection built for SMB and mid-market realities.   

For more information, visit www. sonicwall. com or follow us on X, LinkedIn, Facebook, and Instagram.   

  

  

Role Overview

We are seeking a Principal Test Engineer (Test PE) / QA Lead to partner directly with the Sonicwall Firewall development team. In this high-impact technical role, you will lead feature testing, complex defect reproduction, test plan architecture, and automation development across critical Sonicwall Firewall networking and security components. 

Roles & Responsibilities

- Dev Partnership & Defect Triage: Work closely with firmware and software developers to reproduce intricate customer and field issues, isolate root causes, and verify bug fixes. 
 - Test Strategy & Planning: Architect end-to-end test strategies, author detailed test plans, and design comprehensive functional, system, and regression test suites. 
 - STLC & Quality Governance: Drive the complete Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC)-identifying, filing, prioritizing, and tracking defects to closure in an Agile environment. 
 - Test Automation Engineering: Develop, execute, and maintain automated test suites (functional, regression, and system) using Python to integrate into continuous testing pipelines. 
 - Component & Feature Qualification: Deep-dive into Sonicwall Firewall   subsystems to validate new feature requirements, performance limits, and edge-case handling. 
 - Technical QA Mentorship: Guide and mentor team members on test methodologies, test tool development, and network security validation.   

  

Core Skills & Requirements

- Domain & SQA Experience: 10+ years of software quality assurance experience in the networking and network security domain for enterprise network products, appliances, or firewalls. 
 - Domain & Network Security Expertise: 
 - Deep understanding of L2-L7 networking concepts: TCP/IP, IP routing, NAT, VLANs, and stateful packet filtering. 
 - Strong expertise in Network Security and Next-Generation Firewalling: Deep Packet Inspection (DPI), SSL/TLS, IPSec/SSL VPN, and access rules. 
 - Test Automation & Scripting: 
 - Strong hands-on programming/scripting proficiency in Python (OOP principles, test framework development, and REST API automation). 
 - Experience utilizing traffic generators and test tools (e. g. , IXIA, Spirent, Scapy, tcpreplay). 
 - Troubleshooting & Issue Reproduction: 
 - Advanced problem-solving skills with proven ability to capture and analyze network packets (Wireshark, tcpdump). 
 - Experience analyzing system logs, core dumps, and device diagnostics to triage complex system/firmware behaviors. 
 - Methodologies & Processes: 
 - Thorough mastery of SDLC, STLC, defect lifecycles, and Agile/Scrum practices. 
 - Experience designing system testbeds simulating enterprise network topologies. 
 - Professional Experience: 
 - 8+ years of test engineering and automation experience in the networking/network security domain (with a track record of driving test execution at a senior/lead/PE level). Key Competencies

- Strong analytical mindset with high ownership of product quality and reliability. 
 - Excellent cross-functional collaboration and communication skills to interface effectively with development, product management, and sustaining teams. 
 - Proven ability to work effectively across geographically distributed teams.   

  

SonicWall is an equal opportunity employer.     

We are committed to creating a diverse environment and are an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, ethnicity, religion, sex, gender, gender identity and expression, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, age, marital status, veteran status, pregnancy, or any other basis prohibited by applicable law. 

At SonicWall, we pride ourselves on recruiting a diverse mix of talented people and providing active security solutions in 100+ countries.

data.title: QA Engineer - Automation and Cloud
data.description:
About The Role

We are looking for a smart, analytical and technically strong QA Engineer who is passionate about product quality and enjoys solving complex technical problems. 

The ideal candidate should have strong hands-on experience in both manual and automation testing, along with good programming fundamentals and a solid understanding of APIs, backend systems, databases and cloud environments. 

We are not looking for someone who simply executes predefined test cases or raises defects. We want an engineer who thinks critically, understands how applications work internally, investigates issues independently and takes complete ownership of product quality. 

The individual will be responsible for owning the quality of assigned features/modules end-to-end, from understanding requirements and designing test scenarios to automation, debugging, defect investigation and release validation. 

Key Responsibilities

- Manual Testing & Quality Assurance
 - Analyse business requirements, functional specifications and acceptance criteria to develop comprehensive test scenarios. 
 - Design and execute functional, integration, regression, exploratory and end-to-end test cases. 
 - Identify edge cases, negative scenarios and potential failure points that may not be explicitly covered in requirements. 
 - Independently own testing activities for assigned features/modules. 
 - Validate complex business workflows, application behaviour and data integrity. 
 - Identify, reproduce, document and investigate defects with clear technical details. 
 - Collaborate with developers and product managers to ensure issues are understood and resolved. 
 - Participate in release validation and provide quality sign-off for assigned modules. 
 - Automation Testing
 - Develop and maintain automated test scripts using suitable automation technologies. 
 - Build reusable automation components, utilities and test scripts. 
 - Perform UI automation as well as API automation. 
 - Demonstrate good programming fundamentals, including OOP concepts, functions, data structures, exception handling and scripting. 
 - Maintain automation suites and troubleshoot flaky or inconsistent test cases. 
 - Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Identify opportunities to improve automation coverage, reliability and execution efficiency. 

Preferred technologies: Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, Pytest, JavaScript/TypeScript, Python or Java. 

Candidates with strong automation fundamentals in one technology should be comfortable transitioning to another. 

- API & Backend Testing
 - Perform comprehensive API testing, including positive, negative, integration and edge-case scenarios. 
 - Validate request/response payloads, headers, authentication, status codes and business logic. 
 - Understand REST APIs, JSON, HTTP/HTTPS and basic authentication mechanisms. 
 - Investigate issues across frontend, backend and service integration layers. 
 - Understand backend execution flows and dependencies between services. 
 - Read and interpret application code to identify potential root causes of defects. 
 - Database & Data Validation
 - Write SQL queries involving joins, subqueries, aggregations and other data-validation operations. 
 - Validate data consistency and integrity across application layers. 
 - Investigate database-level issues and discrepancies. 
 - Possess a good understanding of relational databases and basic NoSQL concepts. 
 - Independently validate backend data against expected business outcomes. 
 - Cloud & Infrastructure Understanding
 - Possess a good understanding of cloud computing fundamentals, preferably AWS and/or Azure. 
 - Understand how applications are deployed and operate in cloud environments. 
 - Analyse application logs, cloud logs and monitoring information to investigate issues. 
 - Understand environment configurations, environment variables, service dependencies and application connectivity. 
 - Possess basic networking knowledge, including DNS, ports, HTTP/HTTPS, timeouts and connectivity. 
 - Have working knowledge of Linux commands and command-line troubleshooting. 
 - Understand Docker fundamentals and container-based application deployment. 
 - Have basic familiarity with Kubernetes concepts. 

The ability to independently investigate application and environment-related failures using logs, configurations and other diagnostic information will be a significant advantage. 

- CI/CD & Engineering Collaboration
 - Understand Git, version control and basic branching workflows. 
 - Understand CI/CD pipelines and investigate automation or pipeline failures. 
 - Collaborate closely with developers, product managers and DevOps teams. 
 - Independently investigate technical issues before escalating them. 
 - Communicate defects, investigation findings and root-cause observations clearly. 
 - Production & Performance Testing Exposure
 - Participate in investigating production issues by analysing logs and helping identify potential causes. 
 - Understand the importance of application stability, reliability and performance. 
 - Exposure to performance testing tools such as JMeter or k6 will be an advantage. 
 - Basic understanding of security testing, authentication, authorization and role-based access control is desirable. 

Mandatory Skills & Qualifications

- 2-4 years of hands-on experience in software quality assurance. 
 - Strong fundamentals in manual testing and test case design. 
 - Practical experience in automation testing. 
 - Good programming fundamentals and scripting capabilities in at least one programming language.

data.title: Senior Technical Lead
data.description:
As a Senior Tech Lead, you will play a pivotal role in driving the technical direction of projects and ensuring high-quality software delivery. You will be responsible for providing deep technical expertise, defining architecture and design frameworks, and ensuring coding excellence across the development team. 

The role involves mapping business and domain requirements to robust technical solutions, guiding the team through complex problem-solving, and maintaining alignment with industry best practices and emerging technologies. In addition to hands-on technical contributions, you will serve as a mentor, fostering talent development, promoting collaboration, and upholding coding standards within the team. 

Responsibilities: 

Architecture & Design: 

- Define application architecture, ensuring scalability, performance, and security. 
 - Select appropriate frameworks, libraries, and tools (Spring Boot, Hibernate, microservices, etc. ). 
 - Ensure integration with databases, APIs, and third-party systems follows best practices. Core Technical Leadership: 

- Provide hands-on guidance in coding, debugging, performance tuning, and reviewing critical components. 
 - Establish and enforce coding standards, design patterns, and secure coding practices. 
 - Drive adoption of DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and cloud readiness.   Domain and Technical Alignment

- Translate domain requirements into robust technical solutions. 
 - Collaborate with the Application Development Lead to ensure business logic is implemented correctly in technical design. 
 - Perform technical validation of solutions before customer delivery. Quality & Compliance

- Ensure unit testing, automated integration testing, and SonarQube compliance are achieved. 
 - Address performance bottlenecks, optimize database queries, and ensure high availability. 
 - Conduct technical reviews and walkthroughs with stakeholders. Mentoring & Knowledge Sharing

- Mentor developers on advanced Java, architecture, and problem-solving. 
 - Conduct technical workshops, proof-of-concepts, and knowledge transfer sessions. 
 - Keep the team updated on emerging trends in Java, microservices, and cloud-native architectures. 

Skills Required: 

·              Strong expertise in Java, Spring Boot, Hibernate/JPA, and Microservices Architecture

·              Experience in designing scalable, secure, and high-performance enterprise applications

·              Strong knowledge of REST APIs, API integrations, and third-party system integrations

·              Hands-on experience with SQL/NoSQL databases and database performance optimization

·              Proficiency in design patterns, software architecture, and secure coding practices

·              Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines, and DevOps methodologies

·              Knowledge of cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP

·              Expertise in unit testing, integration testing, SonarQube, and quality assurance practices

·              Strong troubleshooting, debugging, and performance tuning skills

·              Familiarity with Agile/Scrum development methodologies

Qualification: 

·              Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related field. 

·              7+ years of experience in software development with strong expertise in Java-based enterprise application development. 

·              Proven experience in application architecture, microservices, Spring Boot, Hibernate, and API development. 

·              Experience in technical leadership, code reviews, solution design, and mentoring development teams. 

·              Hands-on experience with DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, Docker, Kubernetes, and cloud technologies (AWS/Azure/GCP). 

·              Strong experience in database design, performance optimization, and system integration. 

·              Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments. 

·              Relevant certifications in Java, Cloud Technologies, Kubernetes, or DevOps will be an added advantage.

data.title: AEM Tech Lead
data.description:
At EY, you'll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we're counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all. 

Opening paragraph

AEM Tech Lead is a key member of the EY Digital Experience Platform's delivery team in GDS. This resource will use technology components from both Adobe, Microsoft and other platform components to bring to bear innovative solutions to business problems. 

The opportunity

This opportunity within the EY Digital Experience Platform's delivery team will help in the growth of your career. You will have the opportunity to work with the Adobe cloud suites and will collaborate with the broader team. Lead a team of delivery team members to provide deep technical development expertise, guidance and best practices and coding standards. 

Your Key Responsibilities

- Partner with wider technology teams and business to understand functional and non-functional requirements from a business and from a platform perspective
 - Lead a team of AEM developers & other delivery team members to provide deep technical development expertise, guidance and best practices and coding standards
 - Carry out necessary AEM development work - components, templates, services, necessary configurations
 - Conduct code reviews and technical design reviews. 
 - Estimate efforts and identify technical risks and propose mitigation plan. 
 - Trouble shoot production issues and provide technical guidance during critical incidents. 
 - Optimize performance, dispatcher, caching strategy. 
 - Document findings, learnings and recommendations
 - Share knowledge on new AEM features, capabilities, technologies, architecture methodologies, standards, leading practices. 

Skills And Attributes For Success

How your skills and experience will make an impact, followed by sub-headings: 

To qualify for the role, you must have

- 8 to 10 years in IT environment
 - 5+ years of hands-on experience of working with AEM
 - Hands-on development experience with AEM 6. x onwards including AEM as Cloud Service. 
 - Adobe Experience Manager - components, templates, workflows, MSM and Rollout, translations and workflows, UI customisations, reporting, 
 - Deep knowledge of Java, Maven, JCR, OSGI, Sling Framework, HTL (Sightly), AEM dispatchers, Restful APIs. 
 - HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React, jQuery, AJAX
 - Knowledge of Cloud Manager CI/CD pipelines, GitHub
 - Code Quality Tool/Framework: SonarQube, Junit, Mockito
 - Adobe certifications such as AEM Sites Developer and or AEM Cloud Service required

Ideally, you'll also have

- Excellent communication skills, facilitation and influencing. 
 - Understanding of the Adobe Experience Cloud suite of products. 
 - Experience of Adobe's Project Firefly highly desirable. 
 - Experience of additional Adobe solutions such as a Target, Analytics beneficial. 

What We Look For

- Loves creative use of technology, likes experimentation, is not afraid to try, fail fast and learn. 
 - Analytical, logical approach to problem solving. 
 - Action oriented. 

What Working At EY Offers

Reward statement plus an outline of the culture and environment in this part of the firm. If not covered elsewhere, this may include language about the interesting, varied and important work; the freedom and autonomy you'll have in the role; the feedback you will receive that you can learn from to achieve mastery at something; opportunities for personal growth and career advancement; or who and how you will be connected to others. 

EY | Building a better working world

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets. 

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate. 

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

data.title: Engineering Manager
data.description:
Recruitment Scam Notice: Beware of recruitment scams. Legitimate Cvent recruiting communications will come from accounts formatted as "name@cvent. com" email address. Cvent will never request payment or ask for sensitive personal or financial information through chat or social media platforms. Cvent is not responsible for losses or damages arising from communications, payments, or disclosures made to third parties impersonating Cvent. 

If you believe a communication may be fraudulent, we strongly recommend that you don't respond and report the incident at recruitingindia@cvent. com. 

For more information, visit Cvent's Recruitment Fraud Notice. https: //www. cvent. com/en/notice-recruitment-fraud. 

About Cvent: 

www. cvent. com

Cvent is a leading meetings, events, and hospitality technology provider with more than 6, 000+ employees and ~34, 000+ customers worldwide, including 60% of the Fortune 500. Founded in 1999, Cvent delivers a comprehensive event marketing and management platform for marketers and event professionals and offers software solutions to hotels, special event venues and destinations to help them grow their group/MICE and corporate travel business. Our technology brings millions of people together at events around the world. In short, we're transforming the meetings and events industry through innovative technology that powers human connection. 

Headquartered in Tysons Corner, Virginia, Cvent (formerly NYSE: CVT) was acquired by Blackstone and Vista for $4. 6B in 2023. 

Cvent's strength lies in its people, fostering a culture where everyone is encouraged to think like entrepreneurs, taking risks and making decisions confidently. We value diverse perspectives and celebrate differences, working together with colleagues and clients to build strong connections. 

Cvent is redefining the meetings and events industry through technology that advances human connection. 

AI at Cvent: Leading the Future

Are you ready to shape the future of work at the intersection of human expertise and AI innovation? At Cvent, we're committed to continuous learning and adaptation-AI isn't just a tool for us, it's part of our DNA. We're looking for candidates who are eager to evolve alongside technology. If you love to experiment boldly, share your discoveries, and help define best practices for AI-augmented work, you'll thrive here. Our team values professionals who thoughtfully integrate AI into their daily work, delivering exceptional results while relying on the human judgment and creativity that drive real innovation. 

Throughout our interview process, you'll have the chance to demonstrate how you use AI to learn, iterate, and amplify your impact. If you're excited to be part of a team that's leading the way in AI-powered collaboration, we'd love to meet you. 

Role Overview

Splash is Cvent's event marketing platform. We are standing up a new engineering team in Bengaluru with a single charter: build the AI-powered features that will define the next generation of Splash. You will build this team from zero, then lead it as a peer to the established Splash engineering and product teams in Bengaluru, North America, and Spain, who own adjacent parts of the platform and with whom you will plan, design, and ship. 

This is an AI-first role in two senses. The team ships AI into the product, and the team builds software with AI: agentic coding tools, spec-driven development, and disciplined review of AI-generated output are the default way of working here, not an experiment. We are looking for a manager whose value comes from engineering judgment and a high quality bar rather than from the volume of code they personally write. You will decide what gets built and how, set the standard for what is good enough to ship, and hold the team to it. 

Reporting line: Director of Engineering, Splash India. Team size: 4-5 engineers by the end of the first year, hired by you. 

In This Role, You Will: 

Build the team (your main job in year one)

- Hire the founding team from 0 to 4-5: define the roles and levels, run the hiring loop end to end, close candidates, and onboard them to be productive quickly. 
 - Establish the team's engineering standards, operating rhythm, and ways of working from day one, including how AI tools are used, reviewed, and measured. 
 - Create a culture where engineers own outcomes, learn fast, and hold a high bar for quality. 

Lead delivery of AI features for Splash

- Own execution of the AI feature roadmap for Splash in partnership with Product, Design, and the Splash teams in Bangalore, North America, and Spain. 
 - Make architecture and technology decisions for the team's services and front ends; ensure what ships meets non-functional requirements (security, scalability, resiliency, accessibility, performance) and responsible-AI expectations. 
 - Run the team across time zones: coordinate dependencies, manage production issues and incidents, and keep stakeholders informed with clear, honest status. 

Set the engineering bar in an AI-native workflow

- Define how the team works with agentic coding tools and spec-driven development: what a good spec looks like, when to delegate to an agent, and what must be verified by a human. 
 - Be the quality gate. Review designs, AI-generated code, tests, and evaluations for correctness, security, and maintainability, and teach the team to do the same. 
 - Keep the team's tooling and practices current as the AI development landscape changes, and share what works with the wider Splash organization. 

Grow people

- Coach engineers, set goals, give direct and timely feedback, and run performance reviews and career development. 

Here's What You Need: 

These are requirements, not nice-to-haves. We expect candidates to meet all of them. 

- People management and hiring. 12+ years of software engineering experience, with depth in backend systems and 3+ years managing software engineers, with a track record of hiring, onboarding, and growing strong engineers, and the appetite to do that here from the ground up. 
 - Depth in our stack. Java with Spring Boot for backend services; React or Next. js with TypeScript on the front end; GraphQL APIs; relational and NoSQL databases; event-driven microservices on AWS. 
 - Hands-on fluency with AI-assisted and agentic software development. You use tools such as Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, or GitHub Copilot agents in your own work: writing specs an agent can execute, reviewing and correcting its output, and knowing where these tools fail. This must be lived experience, not familiarity with the concepts. 
 - Strong engineering judgment. You can evaluate a design or a change for correctness, security, scalability, and maintainability without having written it yourself, and you have a track record of owning non-functional requirements for production systems. 
 - Experience shipping AI product features. You have taken LLM-powered functionality to production (for example retrieval, agents, or structured generation) and understand evaluation, prompt and model lifecycle, cost, latency, and failure modes. 
 - Cross-geography collaboration. Proven ability to work as a peer with engineering, product, design, and SRE teams in other regions and time zones, including in a matrixed or distributed organization. 
 - Clear communication. You write specs, decisions, and status updates that people in other time zones can act on without a meeting, and you can explain technical trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Education. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience. 

Nice to Have: 

- Experience forming a team from scratch (0 to N): defining roles and levels, standing up the hiring loop, and establishing norms rather than inheriting an existing team. 
 - Experience in event, marketing, or martech products, or other B2B SaaS with high-volume customer-facing workflows. 
 - Experience building evaluation frameworks or observability for LLM features in production.

data.title: Lead Architect, Financial Markets
data.description:
Job Summary

- About Standard Chartered: We are a leading international bank focused on helping people and companies prosper across Asia, Africa and the Middle East. 
 - To us, good performance is about much more than turning a profit. It's about showing how you embody our valued behaviours - do the right thing, better together and never settle - as well as our brand promise, Here for good. 
 - We're committed to promoting equality in the workplace and creating an inclusive and flexible culture - one where everyone can realize their` full potential and make a positive contribution to our organization. This in turn helps us to provide better support to our broad client base. 
 - Background: SCB is undergoing major payments transformation journey to replace legacy apps with modern tech infra to provide solid foundation for business
 - SCB aspires to uplift the payments technology estate to modern architecture to provide solid foundation for business. This role is pivotal to meet these outcomes. During the definition phase, as a seasoned architecture professional, Cash architect will be responsible for leading the "to-be" architecture definition in partnership with business, ops and technology teams. During the implementation phase he/she will lead solution effort to ensure that solution not only meets functional / non-functional requirements but also architecture strategy/standards/patterns and engineering principles. Candidate will also influence enterprise tech/architecture standards as Domain architect and contribute actively to group-wide initiatives. 

Minimum Qualifications

- Bachelor's in computer science, software engineering or related technical field. Masters in any field is an added advantage. 
 - 15+ years of total experience with 7+ years in an architecture role for multi-country, multi-product large payments transformation(s) / legacy replacement program(s) in a large tier 1 bank. 
 - Demonstrated experience in defining target technology state vision, architectural roadmap, and engineering/integration standards
 - Domain knowledge across two or more - payments (domestic & cross border), ISO20022, collections, liquidity, Trade finance, Escrow and digital channels
 - Demonstrated proficiency across key technologies - Cloud-native technologies, APIs, spring boot microservices, Devops, application security, DLTs, SaaS, data (real time, data lakes), SRE Infra, event sourcing, Caching strategies, REST/ GRPC/ Protobuf/JSON / Solace / KAFKA / Oracle/ PostgreSQL
 - Expertise/background in Payments -as -a service model - Ability to design / drive domain APIs
 - Expertise in interoperability and integration within / outside the bank
 - Proven experience in vendor selection, RFP process
 - Proven experience in defining solutions that deliver stability, resilience, recoverability, availability , performance, scale, Disaster recovery (DR) and security
 - TOGAF or similar certification. Cash management certification is a plus
 - Education Graduate in computer science or related courses
 - Certifications Architecture related

Key Responsibilities

- Collaborate with business, product, tech, delivery, and others to define the target, roadmap and periodically refresh the same
 - Drive standardization of applications, elimination of duplication and reduction of costs within domain from technology / architecture perspective
 - Define architecture principles, reusable patterns, integration standards and guardrails for the domain and work closely with the development teams to implement the same
 - Drive domain APIs design and adoption
 - Evaluate different solution options for business requirements and recommend best option to move forward
 - Keeping track of industry developments, conducting R&D to incorporate best in class practices and methodologies and sharing the same with team and stakeholders. 
 - Chair and run governance forums - Architecture review forum, tech design authority to provide guidance and govern that investment dollars actually move towards target state
 - Align architecture across different domains within bank from integration standard perspectives, to eliminate frictions and enable teams move forward
 - Create / Review solution intent documents from perspectives including stability, resilience, performance, recoverability, availability, scale, DR and security. 
 - Lead domain architecture in group wide initiatives
 - Evaluate vendor solutions during RFP process and propose the best fit approach
 - Guide and coach development teams and junior architects to meet architecture outcomes. 
 - Eliminate decision stall by aligning solutions / strategy with different domains
 - Participate in code reviews, assist & mentor team on technical aspects. 
 - Act as an SME on cash management technologies

Key Expertise

- Ability to define the future and explain for various initiatives - what are the outcomes, how it should work , who will do what, how will systems interact and how will the process, systems and data coherently align to meet the goals
 - Functional skills - Ability to create e2e functional architecture for products and services in cash management domain - Channels, Payments, Collections , Compliance, Funding, Liquidity and others
 - Engineering skills - Microservices architecture, experience in platform as a service , Cloud, Devops, SRE , Observability, Security , API management , Integration technologies. Leverage the technologies to design architect solutions - Includes Cloud-native technologies, APIs, spring boot microservices, Devops, application security, DLTs, SaaS, data (real time , data lakes) , SRE Infra, event sourcing, Caching strategies, REST/ GRPC/ Protobuf/JSON / Solace / KAFKA / Oracle/ PostgreSQL
 - Process skills - Ability to drive process and operational standardization
 - Strategy - Ability to straddle both big picture and the low level developer concerns
 - Communication - Skilled in presenting complex ideas in simple fashion. 
 - Ability to influence, negotiate and collaborate to meet the outcomes at different levels in the bank
 - Listening skills and ability to empathize with others outcomes / concerns
 - Documentation - Ability to create good quality documents, diagrams and ability to review various documents
 - Excellent executive presence, written and oral communication skills with ability to manage upwards and downwards. 
 - Strong leadership skills and outcome oriented to drive forward looking momentum /conversations

Key stakeholders

- Cash Business/Programs
 - Enterprise Architects
 - Development Managers/leads across Cash CIO
 - CIO Cash Management

Other Responsibilities

- Ability to make decisions and guide team to deliver things on time
 - Guide and coach junior developers. 

Skills And Competencies

- Knowledge of Cash management
 - Architectural experience in large payments transformation
 - Domain architecture, target state, roadmaps , Domain APIs
 - Payments as a service experience (PaaS)
 - Architecture patterns and engineering principles
 - Data strategy
 - Integration / interoperability
 - Communication Skills
 - Demonstrated proficiency across key technologies
 - Excellent executive presence and leadership
 - Strong conviction and ability to drive to the right target not necessarily the easy one

About Standard Chartered

We're a global bank connecting clients to our differentiated network, offering growth opportunities in the world's most dynamic markets. Our strategy, which combines cross-border capabilities and leading wealth management expertise, helps us deliver our purpose - to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity. 

Over our 170-year history, and across a unique geographical footprint connecting Asia, Africa and the Middle East to each other and the world, we've built a bank like no other, with diverse capabilities and partnerships that set us apart. 

What We Offer

- Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions, and geographies. 
 - In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing. 
 - Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations. 
 - Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum. 
 - Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns. 
 - Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global employee assistance programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and self-help toolkits. 
 - A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual, and digital learning. 

Visit our careers website to learn more about us: www. sc. com/careers.

 - Passion for emerging technologies, especially AI, cloud platforms, and automation

To Qualify for the Role, You Must Have

What Working At EY Offers
