data.title: Senior Software Architect - IAM
data.description:
Join our Team

About this opportunity: 

Join Ericsson as a Senior Software Architect with deep experience in Identity and Access Management (IAM) and strong knowledge of Java security. You will lead the architecture of cloud-native, microservices-based solutions that deliver robust, scalable, and high-quality software products. 

You will work closely with product managers, QA engineers, DevOps teams, and developers to turn requirements into reliable, production-grade software. Your technical depth, problem-solving ability, and commitment to engineering excellence will make you a trusted expert across the team. 

What you will do: 

- Define and lead the architecture of production-ready, multithreaded, cloud-native microservices for our IAM platform. 
 - Design secure, scalable services using Java security, OAuth, Okta, and OpenID Connect (OIDC). 
 - Set standards for RESTful APIs, messaging interfaces, and event-driven components. 
 - Lead solution design and requirement analysis, and guide technical decisions during planning and design. 
 - Review designs and code to ensure adherence to coding standards and architectural guidelines. 
 - Lead troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and debugging of complex issues across development and production environments. 
 - Define quality expectations for unit, functional, and integration testing. 
 - Guide CI/CD pipeline design, including build automation, artifact management, and deployment workflows. 
 - Oversee containerized deployments using Docker, Kubernetes, and Helm. 
 - Guide the development of automation and installation scripts using Shell and Python. 
 - Drive adoption of AI-assisted development tools, such as GitHub Copilot, to improve productivity and code quality. 
 - Mentor engineers and promote current cloud-native development practices. 

The skills you bring: 

- Strong experience in multithreaded Java development for distributed systems. 
 - Expertise in Java security, OAuth, and IAM concepts. Experience with Okta and OpenID Connect (OIDC) is a plus. 
 - Proficiency in the Java stack, including Spring, Spring Boot, JSF, and Hibernate. 
 - Experience in web development and JavaScript, with Oracle database knowledge. 
 - Skills in Shell and Python scripting for automation, tooling, and installation tasks. 
 - Understanding of sockets, HTTP/HTTPS, and RESTful APIs. 
 - Experience with message queuing and event streaming platforms such as Kafka and ActiveMQ. 
 - Knowledge of testing frameworks, including JUnit, Cucumber, PowerMock, and Mockito, and test automation. 
 - Familiarity with CI/CD toolchains such as GitLab, Jenkins, and JFrog, and DevOps principles in agile delivery. 
 - Knowledge of containerization and orchestration with Kubernetes, Docker, and Helm. 
 - Working knowledge of Linux environments. 
 - Deep understanding of microservices architecture and cloud-native design principles. 
 - 15+ years of experience in senior software product development roles.

About BNP Paribas India Solutions

Established in 2005, BNP Paribas India Solutions is a wholly owned subsidiary of BNP Paribas SA, European Union's leading bank with an international reach. With delivery centers located in Bengaluru, Chennai and Mumbai, we are a 24x7 global delivery center. India Solutions services three business lines: Corporate and Institutional Banking, Investment Solutions and Retail Banking for BNP Paribas across the Group. Driving innovation and growth, we are harnessing the potential of over 10000 employees, to provide support and develop best-in-class solutions. 

Position Purpose

Design, develop, and maintain robust, scalable Java-based backend services and middle business layer components within enterprise full-stack applications. Own backend architecture decisions, API design, data access patterns, and integration with upstream and downstream systems. Work competently across the existing frontend layer using Angular/TypeScript/React. Bring the depth of an experienced backend engineer with the breadth to contribute across the full stack. Leverage AI-assisted development tools as a standard part of day-to-day engineering practice. 

Direct Responsibilities

- Design and Develop scalable full-stack solutions using Java, Spring Boot, and modern frontend frameworks (React/Angular). 
 - Design and optimize high-performance APIs with security, caching, and fault tolerance. 
 - Design and Develop robust backend services with efficient database interactions. 
 - Build responsive UI with seamless backend integration. 
 - Automate CI/CD pipelines for rapid, reliable software delivery. 
 - Lead cloud-native deployments with containerization, auto-scaling, and cost optimization. 
 - Enforce Quality-first engineering: Unit, integration, and ensure high code quality with SonarQube. 
 - Mentor junior developers, conduct code reviews, and drive technical excellence across the team. 
 - Collaborate with stakeholders to translate business needs into robust, compliant technical solutions. 

Contributing Responsibilities

- Contribute to technical design discussions and architecture decisions, particularly around API design, data layer, and system integration
 - Participate in code reviews and enforce clean code and quality gate standards
 - Support knowledge transfer and capability building within the India Solutions team
 - Collaborate with cross-functional teams (frontend, QA, infrastructure) on integration and delivery
 - Improving DevSecOps maturity and SDLC practices within the team

Technical & Behavioral Competencies

- Autonomy & Ownership: Ability to work autonomously and take end-to-end ownership of backend components
 - Industry Expertise: Experience in large-scale regulated enterprise environments (banking/financial services preferred)
 - Collaboration & Communication: Strong collaborative and communication skills to work in a global team

Specific Qualifications

Experience Level: 8+ years

- 7+ years with Java backend development at enterprise scale
 - 5+ years with Spring Boot/Spring MVC in production environments
 - Demonstrated good experience across the listed Technical skills. 
 - Familiarity with frontend integration using Angular/TypeScript/React
 - Experience with legacy system refactoring to target architecture
 - Active use of AI coding assistants in daily workflow

Domain Experience

- Banking, financial services, or similarly regulated enterprise environments preferred
 - Experience in GCC or offshore delivery models advantageous
 - Exposure to high-volume, high-availability backend systems

Technical Skills

Required

Skill Group

Details

Core Java & JDK 21+

- Modern language features - records, sealed classes, pattern‐matching, text blocks, and functional APIs (streams, Optional). 
 - Concurrency & Parallelism - virtual threads (Project Loom), Completable Future, Executor Service, Fork/Join, and basic lock/atomic primitives. 
 - JVM & GC tuning - G1/ZGC behaviour, heap‐dump analysis, JFR profiling, and module‐system (JPMS) usage. 
 - Logging / Instrumentation / Error Handling
 - Build & Unit‐test foundation - Maven/Gradle multi‐module builds, JUnit 5 + AssertJ, static code checks (SpotBugs), and basic GraalVM native‐image awareness. 

Spring Ecosystem

- Spring Boot 3. x - create micro‐service skeletons, auto‐configuration, actuator health‐checks, and simple security (JWT/OAuth2). , 
 - Spring Data (JPA/R2DBC) - entity mapping, query‐hint optimisation, reactive repositories, and transaction demarcation. 
 - Spring Cloud basics - service discovery (Eureka), API‐gateway pattern, externalized config (Config Server), and circuit‐breaker (Resilience4j). 
 - Either Spring Batch OR Spring MVC OR Spring Integration
 - Spring Security- CSRF protection, OAuth2 resource‐server setup, basic role‐based access control, and token validation, zero trust, MTLS. 

Database & Data Access Engineering

- SQL & query optimisation - complex CTEs, window functions, indexing strategies, and execution‐plan analysis (PostgreSQL/Oracle/MySQL). 
 - Database optimisation - (indexing, query plans). Understanding of partitioning
 - ORM performance - JPA/Hibernate mapping, N+1 detection, second‐level cache, batch inserts/updates, and @QueryHints. 
 - NoSQL & caching - when to use MongoDB, GraphDB, Redis (session/Cache‐aside), basic data‐modeling, and TTL/eviction policies. 
 - Migrations & transactions - Flyway/Liquibase versioning, multi‐DB transaction handling (JTA), and isolation‐level choices. 

Design & Architecture

- Clean / Hexagonal architecture - ports‐and‐adapters, dependency‐inversion, and keeping frameworks at the outer ring. 
 - Domain‐Driven Design basics - bounded contexts, aggregates, domain events, and idempotent processing. 
 - API‐first & contract - OpenAPI/Swagger spec authoring, versioning strategy, and consumer‐driven contract testing (Pact). 
 - Event‐driven patterns - Kafka or RabbitMQ producers/consumers, out‐box pattern, and basic saga (choreography) implementation. 
 - Security: Public Keys / Hash Concepts. Design around Access Control, Role Based security. 
 - Microservices design Pattern ex: SAGA Design pattern

Concepts like -Circuit breaker, load balancer, Reverse Proxy

- Integration Patterns, Enterprise Patterns, Application scalability (stateful & stateless), Microservices Patterns, Distributed Transactions
 - Caching Strategies (Redis, CDN)

DevOps

- Containerisation & K8s - Docker multi‐stage builds, Helm chart basics, pod liveness/readiness probes. 
 - CI/CD pipeline - Jenkins/Argo CD job that runs unit, integration, and static‐analysis steps; artefact publishing. Pipeline-as-code (Jenkinsfile/YAML)
 - Observability starter - expose Prometheus metrics, configure a basic Grafana dashboard, and ship structured logs to ELK. 
 - Runtime security, secret‐management (CyberArk / Hashicorp / equivalent)
 - Canary/blue‐green release patterns

Testing & Quality Engineering

- Test‐pyramid implementation - unit (JUnit 5/Mockito), integration (Testcontainers), contract (Pact). 
 - Performance & load testing - JMeter script creation, baseline latency/SLO definition, simple analysis of results. 
 - Static analysis & coverage - SonarQube quality gate, JaCoCo coverage threshold, SpotBugs rule set. 

Frontend

Proficient working within existing Angular/TypeScript/NodeJS/NPM frameworks. 

AI Tools

Daily use of AI DevAssistants (e. g. , Claude, GitHub Copilot) to accelerate implementation across all skill areas

Understanding of MCP and Agentic concepts and able to develop and design. 

Experience with Prompt Engineering, codebase context and constraints of AI assistants

Behavioral Skills

- Sets technical direction for multiple squads and aligns it with business objectives
 - Cross-functional collaboration across frontend, QA, DecvSecOps and infrastructure teams
 - Balances speed, quality, and regulatory constraints in a fast-moving environment and is results oriented
 - Ensures that security, data‐privacy, and regulatory requirements are baked in. 
 - Structured communication of technical decisions to non-technical stakeholders
 - Adaptability to legacy and greenfield environments delivering modern, cloud‐native solutions. 
 - Leverages generative AI to boost productivity and foster a culture of experimentation

Education Level: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent professional experience

data.title: Senior Platform Owner - Risk & Compliance
data.description:
Job Description

Own and drive the strategy, delivery, operational health and continuous improvement of the assigned Risk and Compliance platform portfolio, with primary responsibility for AML transaction monitoring and regulatory compliance applications. 

The Senior Platform Owner is accountable for translating business priorities and regulatory requirements into an integrated platform roadmap and delivering initiatives within agreed scope, timelines, budgets and quality standards. The role balances change delivery with platform stability, ensuring that both vendor-provided solutions and in-house applications remain secure, resilient, supportable and aligned with the Bank's technology strategy. 

Acting as the principal technology partner to Compliance stakeholders, the role coordinates cross-functional delivery and support teams, manages strategic vendor relationships and drives measurable improvements in platform capability, service performance and total cost of ownership. 

This position owns technology delivery and platform performance. Compliance policy, risk acceptance, monitoring methodology and regulatory interpretation remain with the designated business and control owners. 

Responsibilities

- Own the platform strategy and roadmap: Define and maintain a prioritised, multi-year roadmap aligned with Risk and Compliance objectives, regulatory commitments, enterprise architecture and technology modernization priorities. 
 - Lead end-to-end delivery: Oversee the initiation, planning, design, development or configuration, integration, testing, deployment and stabilization of initiatives across COTS products and in-house applications. 
 - Translate requirements into executable outcomes: Partner with Compliance and business owners to establish clear requirements, acceptance criteria, delivery milestones and measurable success indicators. 
 - Deliver AML transaction monitoring capabilities: Lead technology changes supporting transaction data ingestion, monitoring scenarios, alert generation, case management and reporting, with appropriate business approval and validation. 
 - Manage delivery execution: Coordinate engineering teams, vendors and shared technology services; manage dependencies, resources, budgets, risks and issues; and escalate threats to committed outcomes promptly. 
 - Embed quality and control requirements: Ensure delivery incorporates security, data quality, traceability, testing, change governance and operational readiness, including appropriate validation of upgrades, configuration changes and data migrations. 
 - Drive value realization: Track delivery performance and post-implementation outcomes, ensuring solutions achieve agreed business benefits and transition effectively into production support. Own platform service health: Establish and monitor service-level objectives and performance indicators covering availability, reliability, capacity, processing timeliness and recovery capability. 
 - Protect monitoring continuity and data integrity: Ensure controls identify incomplete, inaccurate or delayed data feeds, failed processing and integration issues that could affect transaction monitoring coverage or downstream compliance processes. 
 - Oversee incident and problem management: Coordinate timely service restoration, stakeholder communications, root-cause analysis and sustainable corrective actions, working with support teams and vendors. 
 - Maintain lifecycle currency: Own plans for patching, upgrades, license management, technical debt reduction and remediation of unsupported or end-of-life components. 
 - Strengthening security and recoverability: Work with relevant technology and control teams to maintain access controls, vulnerability remediation, audit logging, backup arrangements and tested disaster recovery capabilities. 
 - Maintain operational readiness and evidence: Ensure platform documentation, application inventories, support procedures, monitoring dashboards and control evidence remain complete and current. 
 - Drive continuous improvement: Use service trends, incidents, user feedback and cost analysis to improve performance, supportability, automation and operational efficiency. 
 - Serve as the primary technology counterpart: Build trusted relationships with Compliance, Financial Crime, Risk, Operations and other business stakeholders, maintaining a shared understanding of priorities and platform capabilities. 
 - Establish clear ownership and decision-making: Agree responsibilities across platform teams, business owners, data owners, technology services and vendors, including escalation routes and approval authorities. 
 - Manage competing priorities: Balance regulatory deadlines, business enhancements, platform resilience and technical debt through transparent, risk-based prioritisation. 
 - Provide effective governance and reporting: Present clear updates on roadmap progress, delivery commitments, financial performance, service health, dependencies and emerging risks to relevant governance forums. 
 - Support assurance and remediation: Coordinate technology input, evidence and remediation delivery for audits, compliance reviews and regulatory engagements, in partnership with the accountable control functions. 
 - Enable adoption and business readiness: Ensure stakeholders are prepared for platform changes through effective communication, training coordination, support arrangements and post-implementation feedback. Develop strategic vendor relationships: Build partnerships with product vendors and implementation partners that support the Bank's long-term Risk and Compliance technology objectives. 
 - Align product and platform roadmaps: Engage vendors on product direction, capability gaps, upgrade paths, scalability and support commitments, ensuring these inform the Bank's investment decisions. 
 - Manage vendor performance: Establish and review service levels, delivery milestones, support responsiveness, defect resolution and contractual obligations; drive corrective action where performance falls short. 
 - Support sourcing and commercial decisions: Partner with Procurement, Legal and relevant control teams on product evaluations, statements of work, licensing, renewals and commercial negotiations. 
 - Optimise build-versus-buy choices: Assess vendor solutions and in-house development options against functional fit, integration complexity, delivery risk, supportability and total cost of ownership. 
 - Manage dependency and exit risk: Maintain appropriate knowledge transfer, documentation, continuity arrangements and transition plans to reduce vendor concentration and lock-in. 
 - Promote practical innovation: Evaluate emerging capabilities with business and control stakeholders, ensuring adoption is supported by clear value, appropriate governance and sustainable operating arrangements. 

Qualifications

- Masters in computer / information Technology
 - 10-15 years in enterprise technology, preferably banking or financial services
 - Experience in Middle East and Indian Banks
 - Strong experience implementing, integrating, or managing transaction monitoring solution
 - Proven leadership of engineering squads and ownership of end-to-end technology delivery
 - Demonstrated custom in-house application development and automation of legacy manual regulatory processes
 - Technical knowledge of Java/Python, APIs, microservices, databases, workflow engines, and enterprise integrations
 - Experience with Agile, SDLC, DevOps, CI/CD, production support, and technology governance
 - Strong stakeholder and vendor management across business, compliance, technology, and geographically distributed teams
 - FCRM, Solytics, Oracle or comparable financial crime platforms
 - Exposure to AI/ML and Gen AI use case implementation in compliance technology
 - Exposure to latest development frameworks such as ReactJs and NodeJs
 - In-depth knowledge and experience of compliance data requirements and governance RPA, rule-based automation, intelligent document processing, and AI/ML-enabled compliance capabilities
 - Large-scale banking modernization and regulated-environment data governance
 - Decision-making and problem-solving
 - Excellent communication and delivery leadership

data.description:
Job Description: 

Director, Data Engineering

Data Experience (DEx)

- Decisioning
 - Dentsu Global Services (DGS)

Team: Data Experience (DEx) - Data Engineering

Reports to: Practice Lead / Group Lead, Data Engineering

Level: Director (DGS)

Location: Offshore (DGS, India)

Employment: Dentsu Global Services

About The Role

The Data Experience (DEx) practice builds the data foundations, pipelines, and products that power Dentsu's media and marketing effectiveness work across Carat, iProspect, and Dentsu X. We are seeking a Director, Data Engineering to lead our offshore (DGS) engineering capability - owning the architecture, quality, and delivery of the data platform that everything downstream depends on. 

This is a senior leadership and hands-on engineering role. You will set the standard for how DEx ingests, models, and serves media and marketing data on Databricks, and you will do it as a modern practitioner - using AI-assisted data development (Databricks Genie, Copilot, Claude Code) to move faster and raise quality. You will lead and mentor a team of DGS engineers while staying close enough to the code to set the bar yourself. This role demands deep Databricks expertise and a genuine understanding of what media data means, not just how to move it. 

What You'll Do

- Lead the offshore (DGS) Data Engineering team - setting architecture and delivery standards, reviewing code and design, mentoring engineers, and owning quality across the portfolio. 
 - Own the Databricks Lakehouse end to end: ingestion, Medallion (bronze/silver/gold) modeling, Unity Catalog governance, Lakeflow pipelines, and performance. 
 - Design and build robust, scalable pipelines that bring together media and marketing data from many platforms into governed, analytics-ready datasets. 
 - Drive adoption of AI-assisted data development across the team - using Databricks Genie, Copilot, and Claude Code to accelerate pipeline build, transformation, and debugging without sacrificing rigor. 
 - Establish and enforce data taxonomies, schema standards, data quality checks, and a single source of truth for core media data. 
 - Partner with visualization, data science, and ad ops teams to source data correctly, validate it, and resolve discrepancies between platform truth and downstream reporting. 
 - Contribute to the productization of the data platform - moving from bespoke, client-by-client pipelines toward reusable, standardized, semi-automated data products. 
 - Manage capacity, utilization, and delivery health for the DGS engineering team, coordinating closely with onshore leadership on staffing and priorities. 

Core Skills & Requirements

Databricks & Data Engineering

- Deep, hands-on Databricks expertise: Spark, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Lakeflow / Delta Live Tables, Medallion architecture, and performance tuning. 
 - Expert-level SQL and strong Python for data engineering; production experience building and operating pipelines at scale. 
 - Solid grasp of data modeling, orchestration, data quality, and governance - building for reuse and maintainability, not one-off delivery. 
 - Experience with the surrounding ecosystem (Azure, lightweight ETL / data-prep tooling such as Trifacta or dbt) is a strong plus. 

AI-Assisted Data Development

- Hands-on experience developing data solutions with AI tooling - Databricks Genie, GitHub / Databricks Copilot, Claude Code, or comparable AI coding agents. 
 - Able to use AI assistants to accelerate pipeline build, transformation logic, and debugging while maintaining correctness, governance, and quality. 
 - A builder's mindset: comfortable pairing with AI tools as a force multiplier for the team, not a novelty. 

Media & Marketing Data Fluency

You must understand not just how to engineer the data, but what the data means. 

- Strong command of media and marketing data: what impressions, spend, clicks, and conversions represent, and how they relate. 
 - Understanding of how reach and frequency work - served vs. viewable impressions, de-duplicated reach, and frequency capping - and the implications for how data must be modeled. 
 - Familiarity with conversion tracking and attribution mechanics - pixels, tags, post-click vs. post-view, and lookback windows. 
 - Knowledge of how media data connects across campaigns, placements, creatives, and channels, and how spend flows through to outcomes. 
 - Practical experience with media taxonomies and naming conventions as the foundation of trustworthy, joinable data. 

Leadership

- Proven experience leading and developing an engineering team, ideally in an offshore / DGS or global delivery model. 
 - Ability to set architecture and code standards, review work critically, and raise the quality bar across a team. 
 - Strong communication across time zones with onshore leads and stakeholders. 

Preferred / Nice To Have

- Experience with streaming / near-real-time ingestion patterns. 
 - Familiarity with trafficking / ad ops platforms (CM360, Prisma, DV360, TTD) and how their data lands in the platform. 
 - Exposure to semantic / metrics layers and how engineering choices affect downstream reporting (Power BI, dbt metrics). 
 - Experience in an agency, ad tech, or marketing analytics environment. 
 - CI/CD, testing, and DataOps practices for data pipelines. 

Qualifications

- 10+ years in data engineering, with several years in a leadership or director-level capacity. 
 - Demonstrated deep Databricks / Lakehouse expertise in production. 
 - Demonstrated domain knowledge of media and/or marketing data (hard requirement). 
 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. 

Dentsu is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Contract Type:

data.title: Senior Software Engineer
data.description:
At R1, we're transforming how healthcare works by combining nearly two decades of revenue cycle expertise with advanced technology, including analytics, AI, intelligent automation and workflow orchestration. We pair that technology with the irreplaceable expertise of our people to help hospitals, health systems and medical groups improve financial performance, simplify administrative complexity and create better experiences for patients and providers. 

All Together Better defines our culture and the way we work. We're a diverse, global team united by a shared mission to make healthcare work better for all. Across technology, operations and support functions, our people bring deep expertise, empathy and ingenuity to the work we do. Here, collaboration fuels progress, adaptability sparks innovation and every voice can help shape what's next for R1 and the future of healthcare. 

About R1 RCM

R1 RCM is a leading provider of technology-driven solutions that improve the patient experience and financial performance of healthcare providers. In India, our teams work across Delhi NCR, Hyderabad, Bangalore, and Chennai to make healthcare simpler through technology, operational expertise, and innovation. Our inclusive culture values different perspectives, continuous learning, accountability, and high-quality outcomes for customers and patients. 

Role Overview

We are seeking a Senior R&D Engineer to join our India-based R&D team. This is an individual-contributor role for an engineer who combines strong software engineering fundamentals with applied AI/ML, cloud-native architecture, and rapid experimentation. You will take ambiguous business or healthcare problems from discovery through proof of concept and production-ready implementation, while raising the technical, quality, and engineering standards of the team. 

You will serve as an in-house technical and functional expert for the team's problem space, understand how services and data flows interact, and work with product, engineering, security, architecture, and business stakeholders to build reusable, secure, observable, and scalable solutions. 

What You Will Do

- Own the end-to-end delivery of R&D initiatives, from problem framing, feasibility analysis, experimentation, and architecture through implementation, demonstration, transition, and measurable outcome tracking. 
 - Design and build production-grade AI-enabled and enterprise applications using Python and/or C#/. NET, modern APIs, microservices, event-driven patterns, and suitable frontend technologies such as React or Angular. 
 - Apply machine learning, deep learning, NLP, computer vision, generative AI, retrieval-augmented generation, agents, and intelligent workflow patterns where they create demonstrable business value. 
 - Architect cloud-native solutions on Azure and/or GCP using containers, Kubernetes, managed data services, messaging, secure identity, infrastructure automation, and CI/CD. 
 - Decompose complex, ambiguous problems into small, testable, and independently deliverable components; select pragmatic approaches based on value, risk, cost, latency, accuracy, and operability. 
 - Design secure integration patterns and APIs for enterprise systems, relational and NoSQL data stores, model services, and high-volume or asynchronous workloads. 
 - Write production-ready, testable, maintainable code; lead meaningful refactoring; review pull requests; and eliminate recurring classes of defects through improved design and engineering practices. 
 - Drive automated testing, observability, performance measurement, security-by-design, model evaluation, and operational readiness across team solutions. 
 - Proactively identify execution gaps, technical risks, dependencies, and scaling constraints, then propose and implement practical mitigations with minimal guidance. 
 - Build reusable accelerators, reference implementations, design patterns, technical documentation, and implementation guides that improve delivery across the R&D and broader engineering organization. 
 - Coach engineers, share knowledge, support technical hiring, and influence adoption of engineering-wide standards and initiatives without relying on formal authority. 
 - Communicate findings, trade-offs, outcomes, and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. 

Required Qualifications

- Typically 10+ years of relevant software engineering experience, including substantial hands-on ownership of complex solutions; experience leading technical delivery within a team is expected. 
 - Strong programming skills in Python, C#, or both, with sound knowledge of object-oriented design, design patterns, clean architecture, data structures, and software engineering fundamentals. 
 - Hands-on experience delivering AI/ML solutions using frameworks or services such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, Keras, scikit-learn, Azure OpenAI, OpenAI APIs, or equivalent platforms. 
 - Practical experience with generative AI and LLM-based systems, including prompt and context design, embeddings, retrieval, evaluation, grounding, safety, latency, and cost considerations. 
 - Experience with NLP and unstructured data processing. Exposure to document intelligence, computer vision, conversational AI, or intelligent workflow automation is strongly relevant. 
 - Experience designing and consuming REST APIs and building distributed, microservices-based, or event-driven applications. 
 - Cloud engineering experience on Azure and/or GCP, including cloud-native design, containerization with Docker, orchestration with Kubernetes, CI/CD, and DevOps practices. 
 - Strong working knowledge of SQL and data modeling, plus experience with at least one NoSQL, search, vector, cache, or messaging technology. 
 - Demonstrated use of automated testing, code review, logging, monitoring, tracing, performance optimization, and secure software development practices. 
 - Ability to operate independently, learn unfamiliar domains quickly, manage shifting R&D priorities, and convert experiments into reliable engineering outcomes. 
 - Clear written and verbal communication, strong stakeholder collaboration, and the ability to explain complex technical decisions in business terms. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with enterprise SaaS platforms, healthcare technology, revenue cycle management, clinical or insurance documents, EHR integrations, or high-volume transaction systems. 
 - Familiarity with healthcare privacy, security, and regulatory practices, including HIPAA and applicable data-protection requirements. 
 - Full-stack development experience . 
 - Experience with broker/message-bus patterns, CQRS, ports-and-adapters, hexagonal or onion architecture, service-oriented architecture, and resilient distributed-system design. 
 - Exposure to additional cloud platforms such as AWS and to infrastructure-as-code practices such as Terraform. 
 - Experience with MLOps or LLMOps, model and prompt evaluation, experiment tracking, model monitoring, human-in-the-loop workflows, and responsible AI controls. 
 - Experience with analytics or visualization tools such as Power BI or Tableau. 

Success in This Role

- R&D ideas are converted into validated, reusable capabilities with clear evidence of technical feasibility and business value. 
 - Solutions are secure, observable, testable, cost-aware, and designed for a credible path from proof of concept to production. 
 - The team executes with greater clarity and fewer recurring defects because of stronger architecture, reusable components, automation, and technical coaching. 
 - Stakeholders receive honest, concise, and evidence-based communication about risks, options, progress, and outcomes. 
 - The engineer becomes a trusted domain expert who anticipates change, identifies opportunities, and improves outcomes for customers and patients. 

Level Expectations

- Independence: Proactively solves complex problems and drives delivery with minimal guidance. 
 - Scope: Influences the team's services, architecture, delivery practices, and adjacent technical domains. 
 - Impact: Improves business outcomes, solution reliability, engineering effectiveness, and the team's ability to execute. 
 - Leadership: Coaches peers, leads project groups through influence, creates space for diverse input, and helps the team adopt broader engineering initiatives. 
 - Quality and security: Owns a team-level quality mindset and actively partners with security and platform stakeholders on standards and upcoming changes. 

How We Work

At R1, we anticipate change, identify better ways to serve customers and patients, and hold ourselves accountable for high-quality outcomes. We build connections across teams, value different perspectives, share what we learn, act with integrity, and proactively solve problems for ourselves and others. 

Working in an evolving healthcare setting, we use our shared expertise to deliver innovative solutions. Our fast-growing team has opportunities to learn and grow through rewarding interactions, collaboration and the freedom to explore professional interests. 

Our associates are given valuable opportunities to contribute, to innovate and create meaningful work that makes an impact in the communities we serve around the world. We also offer a culture of excellence that drives customer success and improves patient care. We believe in giving back to the community and offer a competitive benefits package. To learn more, visit: r1rcm. com

Visit us on Facebook

data.title: Sr Technical Consultant - Azure Cloud, DevOps, Sql & Site Reliability Engineering(SRE)
data.description:
Overview

- The BYX Platform provides shared cloud provisioning, compute, storage, observability and runtime capabilities for enterprise applications and implementation teams. 
 - We are seeking an astute Cloud Platform with a strong technical foundation and hands-on experience in Microsoft Azure, Kubernetes, containers, observability, networking and production automation. 

Our Current Technical Environment

- Cloud and Compute: Microsoft Azure, Kubernetes, node pools, container workloads, Azure Container Registry, KEDA, Dask, autoscaling, CPU, memory and GPU capacity. 
 - Observability: Logs, metrics and traces; collectors and exporters; Elastic/Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana, dashboards, alerts and correlation identifiers. 
 - Data and Storage: MongoDB/Atlas, SQL, Redis, NFS, managed storage, replicas, regional capacity and service quotas. 
 - Networking and Security: DNS, CIDR, private endpoints, firewall rules, allowlists, TLS/certificates, SPNs, API keys, tokens, image-pull credentials and Git-hosted secrets. 
 - Operations and Automation: Linux, Git, CI/CD deployment workflows, infrastructure automation and scripting using Bash, Python or PowerShell. 

What You'll Do

- Review and act on incidents, service requests, infrastructure requests and provisioning failures logged by implementation teams and platform users. 
 - Own L2/L3 cloud-platform issues from initial triage through recovery, validation, communication, root-cause analysis and closure. 
 - Troubleshoot Kubernetes pods, deployments, replicas, services, events, health checks, node pools, scheduling and resource constraints. 
 - Diagnose container image-pull, startup, shutdown, registry-authentication, rollout and workload-reconciliation failures. 
 - Investigate CPU, memory, GPU, quota, region, placement and capacity issues affecting platform workloads. 
 - Troubleshoot workload and event-driven autoscaling using Kubernetes metrics and technologies such as KEDA. 
 - Support Azure resource provisioning, provider operations, resource lifecycle workflows and reconciliation between desired and actual state. 
 - Diagnose ACR, private endpoint, firewall, allowlist, CIDR, DNS, TLS and runtime-connectivity problems. 
 - Trace logs, metrics and distributed telemetry from the workload through collectors, exporters and observability ingestion pipelines. 
 - Support Elastic/Logstash/Kibana ingestion, index mappings, access, dashboards, alerts and environment filters. 
 - Investigate operational issues involving MongoDB/Atlas, SQL, Redis, NFS and related managed data or storage services. 
 - Support certificates, service principals, API keys, image-pull credentials and infrastructure credential rotation. 
 - Support regional releases, environment configuration, disaster-recovery workflows and post-deployment validation. 
 - Develop automation to improve platform reliability, reduce manual provisioning and shorten incident recovery time. 
 - Maintain runbooks, dashboards, alerts, known-error records and diagnostic procedures for use by platform support teams. 
 - Participate in capacity planning, incident reviews, change reviews, release readiness and an agreed production on-call rotation. 

What We Are Looking For

- Minimum 5-10 years of relevant work experience in Azure cloud infrastructure, DevOps, site reliability engineering or platform operations. 
 - This role includes Rotational Shifts(Night shifts of 2 months in Year)
 - Hands-on production experience with Microsoft Azure services and operational troubleshooting
 - Strong Kubernetes troubleshooting skills covering workloads, events, services, networking, scheduling, scaling and resource management. 
 - Experience with a container registry; Azure Container Registry experience is highly relevant. 
 - Practical observability experience across logs, metrics, traces, dashboards and alerts. 
 - Experience with Elastic Stack components-Elasticsearch, Logstash and Kibana-or a closely comparable platform. 
 - Working knowledge of DNS, TLS/certificates, CIDR, firewalls, proxies, load balancing and private networking. 
 - Strong Linux administration, application log analysis and production incident-troubleshooting skills. 
 - Scripting experience with Bash, Python or PowerShell for diagnostics and operational automation. 
 - Experience troubleshooting CI/CD deployments, configuration changes and failed rollouts. 
 - Working knowledge of Git, service identities and secrets-management fundamentals. 
 - Working knowledge of MongoDB/Atlas, Redis, SQL or NFS operations is preferred. 
 - Experience with infrastructure as code such as Terraform, Bicep or ARM templates and Kubernetes packaging such as Helm is preferred. 
 - Experience with incident response, Root Cause Analysis, post-incident reviews and controlled production changes. 
 - Strong collaboration and communication skills with the ability to work across application, security, networking and vendor teams. 
 - Willingness to participate in a scheduled production on-call rotation and planned out-of-hours changes when required. 

Our Values

If you want to know the heart of a company, take a look at their values. Ours unite us. They are what drive our success - and the success of our customers. Does your heart beat like ours? Find out here: Core Values

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status.

data.title: Site Reliability Engineering Professional
data.description:
Introduction

At IBM Infrastructure & Technology, we design and operate the systems that keep the world running. From high-resiliency mainframes and hybrid cloud platforms to networking, automation, and site reliability. Our teams ensure the performance, security, and scalability that clients and industries depend on every day. Working in Infrastructure & Technology means tackling complex challenges with curiosity and collaboration. You'll work with diverse technologies and colleagues worldwide to deliver resilient, future-ready solutions that power innovation. With continuous learning, career growth, and a supportive culture, IBM provides the opportunities to build expertise and shape the infrastructure that drives progress. 

Your Role And Responsibilities

- Monitoring the health of the IKS control plane and ensuring reliable operations
 - Responding promptly to production issues and alerts
 - Executing changes in the production environment through advanced automation
 - Partnering with other SRE teams and program managers to deliver mission-critical services
 - Supporting the development and enhancement of Platform-as-a-Service services
 - Implementing and automating solutions that support IBM Cloud products
 - Ensuring compliance and security integrity of the environment
 - Collaborating with Engineering to troubleshoot and resolve production issues

Bachelor's Degree

 - Ability to implement robust incident management strategies and frameworks
 - Experience in performance optimization of Kubernetes clusters
 - Understanding of disaster recovery planning and high availability setups in Kubernetes environments
 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a willingness to take on call-out responsibilities
 - Experience establishing and improving procedures within a mission-critical environment

Preferred Technical And Professional Experience

- Hands-on experience with any one of cloud infrastructures (IKS, AWS, Azure, GCP) and integrating cloud services for storage, security, and databases
 - Knowledge of Slack bot automations for infra/cloud maintenance and SRE-based automations
 - Active participation in Kubernetes communities and forums
 - Vendor management skills to ensure optimal service levels and cost control
 - Ability to mentor and train teams on Kubernetes best practices and operational strategies

You will take on a technical leadership role within the Test Development Engineering team, responsible for architecting, developing, and deploying Automated Test Equipment (ATE) solutions for cutting-edge, highly complex ASICs and SoCs. You will own the end-to-end test development lifecycle from pre-silicon DFT engagement to post-silicon bring-up and high-volume manufacturing (HVM) release. 

As a Senior Technical Driver, Your Responsibilities Will Include

- Test Architecture & Development: Architect, write, and debug complex ATE test programs for wafer sort and final test
 - Silicon Bring-Up: Lead first-silicon ATE bring-up, characterization, and validation of complex networking processors and multi-die packages. 
 - DFT Collaboration: Partner closely with Design for Test (DFT) and ASIC design teams during the pre-silicon phase to define testability requirements, evaluate test coverage, and simulate test vectors (SCAN, MBIST, JTAG, High-Speed I/O). 
 - Yield & Test Time Optimization: Drive pivotal initiatives for Test Time Reduction (TTR) and yield optimization without compromising test coverage or product quality. 
 - Manufacturing Deployment: Lead the seamless transfer and release of robust test programs to offshore assembly and test (OSAT) partners. Resolve complex test-related issues in high-volume manufacturing. 
 - Mentorship & Leadership: Serve as a domain expert and technical escalation point. Mentor junior engineers and drive continuous improvement in test methodologies and automation.

You will collaborate with ASIC design / DFT teams in the Central Hardware Group, peer Product Development Engineers & Test Engineers in Silicon Operations and with Project Managements, Test engineering, Quality & Reliability, Supply Chain Planning. data.title: Sr. Engineer – Incoming & Supplier Quality
data.description:
Job Purpose

This Job Position is required for Incoming quality & supplier quality assurance. To ensure defect free supply of parts to production line and continuous development of vendors to improve part quality, also to support new/alternate vendor development for various new/existing products. 

Job Context

This position reports directly to Manager QA. 

All incoming inspection & supplier quality team will report to this position. 

Job Dimensions

- Conduct Daily rejection Meeting & decide action with CFT. 
 - Release of rejection data to all concern(weekly)
 - Conduct Forthrightly NCR review meeting. 
 - Participate in daily production meeting, various CFT meetings to understand priorities of business and accordingly delegate tasks to team members. 
 - Prepare monthly report for Quality. 

Key Accountabilities

- Ensure defect free supply of parts/assemblies to production line. 
 - To ensure consistency in quality through Green/Red flag system. 
 - Conduct regular supplier audit with respect to annual calendar for continuous improvement and development of suppliers. 
 - Monitor supplier PPM and identify route cause for high PPM suppliers to take proper actions against them, along with preventive actions to avoid such kind of failure in future. 
 - Analyse line rejection & in-coming rejections to track repeated issues and address the same with proper CAPA and monitor few batches to check effectiveness of CAPA. 
 - Maintain tracker for submitted parts for new product development and ensure to get it approved though proper channel along with proper documentation within given time frame. 
 - To maintain tracker for submitted part for development of new/alternate vendor and ensure its approval through proper out-sourcing request and full documentation. 
 - Conduct internal quality management system audits and prepare internal audit reports and do follow up closer of reported non-conformance if any. 
 - Analyse supplier NCR register and discuss with supplier for identified actions for the reported issue and timely closer of the same. 
 - To conduct case-based audits/visits at supplier end to identify route cause of the reported issue and prepare detailed audit report along with all necessary supporting evident & documents. 
 - Active participation in continuous improvement meetings to hit on part specific issues and resolve the same from route. 
 - Raise engineering change request as and when required for continuous improvement. 
 - Guide and motivate team members on continuous basis as and when required for routine work as well as in heavy workload situations to maximize their efforts and productivity. 
 - Carry out calibration of measuring Instrument and maintain valid calibration status. 

Education

Qualifications, Experience & Skills

- BE/B Tech mechanical

Required Skills

- Problem solving, 
 - 8D, 
 - FMEA. 
 - ISO Auditor, Supplier Audit. 

Experience

- Min 5 years of relevant experience in field of quality assurance (preferred Switch Gear)
 - Hands-on experience in ISO Standards for ISO 9001 & Material standards. 
 - Knowledge in various manufacturing processes like sheet metal fabrication, Powder coating, machining, Electrical/Electronic part assemblies. etc.

data.title: TEAM LEAD - HARDWARE
data.description:
Rockwell Automation is a global technology leader focused on helping the world's manufacturers be more productive, sustainable, and agile. With more than 28, 000 employees who make the world better every day, we know we have something special. Behind our customers - amazing companies that help feed the world, provide life-saving medicine on a global scale, and focus on clean water and green mobility - our people are energized problem solvers that take pride in how the work we do changes the world for the better. 

We welcome all makers, forward thinkers, and problem solvers who are looking for a place to do their best work. And if that's you we would love to have you join us!

Job Description

Job Purpose: 

- Lead & drives functional excellence in engineering solution and provide knowledge base, services and technical understanding for the "Hardware Engineering" applications following the industry standards and its regulatory requirements. 
 - Manage all aspect of project life cycle from pre-sale proposal support and Engineering support as per the scope. 
 - You will be reporting to the Engineering Manager. 
 - Can work independent and handle technical tasks and activity on HW and any 3rd party interfaces as applicable in the projects. 
 - This may include travel for short or long-term work assignments within India or overseas for customer meetings, project training and site support. 
 - Organize and schedule job tasks with your team. 
 - Provide leadership to the assigned team and Improve Productivity. 
 - Manage team regarding people development and issue resolution
 - Manage Global partner including the regional solution teams and Global Programme Managers

Your Responsibilities

- Deliver and build the assigned projects on time with good quality/ cost effectiveness and customer satisfaction
 - Take on challenging tasks and be a solution provider to internal and external partners & industry team on solutions
 - Keep improving self-engineering capabilities and exchange best practice with other team members to improve team's capabilities
 - Lead technical implementation in whole life-cycle of project delivery
 - Collaborate and work with Technical Lead / SMEs to clarify technical issues and share workloads
 - Present solution to the partners and coordinate development tasks with team members
 - Work with PM for scope management, deliver execution plans & monitor the execution with good quality, cost effectiveness, customer acceptance and customer satisfaction
 - Work with Global Programme Managers and PM for WBS development
 - Develop quality process and ensure strict adherence
 - Work closely & guide the proposal team for support on estimation and proposal delivery
 - Ensure project implementation follows the procedure of SSB standard. 
 - Promote project cost reduction through continuous process improvement, by applying and maximizing reusable engineering standards in project delivery
 - Drive business growth & strengthen foot print of GEBS as technology CoE
 - Work for the optimization of procurement processes and identify process improvement opportunities
 - Support in AOP planning
 - Ensure that all audits (internal/external) are adequately documented and significant risk are dealt in a timely manner
 - Engage with various stakeholders to identify opportunities for increased engagement, seek feedback on deliverables and to improve overall engagement
 - Ensures deliverables provided by the GEBS are delivered within exceptional good quality on time and on budget with high levels of Internal Customer Satisfaction. 
 - Manage utilization of all resources and ensure accurate capacity planning. 
 - Responsible to manage resources appropriately and to assign right skills to the work. 

Job Related Competencies

- Good understanding on AutoCAD, ACAD-Electrical / ePlan / CEWS / CREO / RA Advisor. 
 - Good understanding on DOL, S/D, VFDs, Soft-Starters, Servo, PLC, MCC & Safety System Designing. 
 - Good Knowledge of Product Selections and their applications. 
 - Good understanding of design calculations like Heat, Load, cable sizing, Cable Duct etc. 
 - Good understanding of mechanical design of different types of enclosures (GA/Layout design). 
 - Good understanding of developing a control circuit based on the process and application requirements. 
 - Must be aware of electrical design standards e. g. IEC, JIC/NEMA, UL, ATEX, CE codes etc. 
 - High level of expertise in RA products/Hardware such as Control Logix, VFDs etc. 
 - Good understanding of Server Client architecture. 
 - Experience with at least one third-party PLC systems migration. 
 - Knowledge of IT software platforms, prior hands-on experience with migrations, awareness of latest updates on upcoming automation technologies (Cloud solutions, IIoT) would be an added advantage either
 - Conduct research into systems issues and products
 - Record of managing multiple and complex customer projects and a good understanding about Project Management. 
 - Major Commissioning Know-How experience and troubleshooting methods. 
 - Is flexible / responsive to manage global needs & expectations about GEBS engineering deliveries
 - Manage team performance to develop team capability and motivate the team. Create developmental plans for any identified gaps. 
 - Support best practice sharing and knowledge transfer among teams to improve competency of whole team. 
 - Assess and develop competency and capabilities among the team. Encourage multi-skilling within the team to ensure better use. 

Desired temperament -

- Creates an optimal work environment by establishing and maintaining positive and respectful work relationships. 
 - Understand the importance of collaboration and aligning the organization to drive the necessary objectives. 
 - Holds self and team accountable for keeping commitments, maintaining standards, and achieving goals. 
 - Leads with ethics and integrity; and flexible while also seeking initiatives
 - Help create and influence a culture that Inspires individuals and teams to stretch beyond what they thought they could do. 
 - Addresses Conflict and other barriers to Collaboration effectively & constructively, adapting to cultural norms and expectations
 - Maintain transparency in communication with all stakeholders. 
 - Understand and manage complexity at various levels in the organization

Benefits

- We provide a working environment with a creative company, paired with a great compensation package, great benefits, and a supportive atmosphere where you can sharpen with new challenges and development opportunities. 
 - Hybrid work-from-home and at a determined Rockwell Automation facility. 
 - Corporate Social Responsibility opportunities, 
 - Support from our 24/7 employee assistance program. 

We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. 

At Rockwell Automation we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right person for this or other roles. 

Rockwell Automation's hybrid policy aligns that employees are expected to work at a Rockwell location at least Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays unless they have a business obligation out of the office.

We are seeking an experienced Mechanical Commissioning Technical Team Leader to lead the commissioning delivery team of hyperscale and colocation AI data-centre projects. 

The role will provide technical leadership, people management and client-facing governance across the complete commissioning lifecycle from L0-L6, with a strong focus on L4 Functional Performance Testing (FPT) and L5 Integrated Systems Testing (IST).

- Lead commissioning of HSD/fuel systems, including bulk/day tanks, transfer systems, filtration, leak detection and generator auto-fuelling interfaces. 

- Oversee fire protection and life-safety systems, including fire pumps, wet/dry/pre-action systems, clean-agent systems, VESDA, dampers and smoke-control systems. 

- Oversee plumbing and utility systems, including water storage, makeup water, drainage, sump systems, leak detection and associated utilities. 

- Review P&IDs, equipment submittals, control sequences, Sequence of Operations (SOO), cause & effect and commissioning test scripts. 

- Lead TAB/hydronic balancing, equipment performance testing, controls/BMS integration and functional testing. 

- Validate mechanical integration with BMS, EPMS, electrical systems, fire/life-safety and data-center controls. 

- Manage commissioning issues, RCA, risk registers, punch lists and technical close-out. 

- Act as senior technical interface with hyperscale clients, CxA teams, MEP contractors, consultants and OEMs. 

- Drive commissioning quality, safety and readiness for operational handover. 

Requirements

- 15+ years overall mechanical engineering, testing and commissioning experience. 

- 8+ years data-center or mission-critical mechanical commissioning experience. 

- Proven leadership of at least 2 complete L2 to L5 commissioning cycles. 

- Proven experience of leading at least 2 ISTs of hyperscale datacenter projects. 

- Experience managing 15-20+ Cx engineers. 

- Strong hands-on knowledge of HVAC, chilled-water systems, cooling towers, CRAH/CRAC, BMS/controls, fuel systems, fire protection and utilities. 

- Experience with high-density/liquid cooling is highly desirable. 

- Strong understanding of Uptime Institute, ASHRAE, NFPA and applicable local codes/standards. 

- Strong knowledge of Sequence of Operations, controls integration, TAB, hydronic balancing and failure-mode testing. 

- Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering or equivalent. 

- Strong client-facing communication and technical leadership skills.

CxA/CBCP | CDCP/CDCS | Uptime Institute ATD | ASHRAE-related credentials

data.title: Assistant Vice President – Quality Assurance (AML)
data.description:
Job Title: Assistant Vice President - Quality Assurance (AML)

Department: ISPL CEFS AML Operations

About Business Line/Function

CEFS team is leveraging an integrated model; the Team delivers a comprehensive range of solutions to various business lines of the Group across the globe. The services include referential data management, Know Your Customer (KYC), Due Diligence preparation (client recertification and onboarding), credit administration and post-trade client services, AML transaction monitoring and Actimize support Projects. 

Position Purpose

An Assistant Vice President (AVP) for Quality Assurance (QA) within the Anti-Money Laundering (AML) domain occupies a middle-management role. They act as a critical line of defense, ensuring that the processes used to detect, prevent, and report money laun dering and terrorist financing are effective, compliant, and operating according to regulatory standards. 

Responsibilities

- Alert Disposition & Investigation Validation
 - Decision Accuracy Review: Auditing a sample of "Closed/No Suspicion" alerts to ensure that investigators have provided sufficient rationale and that the activity truly does not warrant an escalation. 
 - Investigation Quality Assessment: Evaluating the depth of the "investigative trail"-ensuring investigators have looked beyond the single alert to review the client's historical behavior, source of wealth, and related party transactions. 
 - Narrative & Documentation Audit: Verifying that the written rationales in the Case Management System (CMS) are clear, logical, and would stand up to scrutiny from a regulator or internal auditor. 
 - Red Flag Identification: Ensuring that specific typologies (e. g. , structuring, smurfing, rapid movement of funds, or unusual geographic activity) were correctly identified and addressed during the investigation. 
 - Detection Logic & System Effectiveness (The "Second Line" view)
 - Threshold & Scenario Testing: Partnering with the TM Tuning team to validate whether current detection scenarios (rules) are effective or if they are producing excessive false positives/missed true positives. 
 - False Positive Analysis: Analyzing trends in "false positives" to identify if specific rules require recalibration or if they are no longer capturing relevant risk. 
 - Model Validation Support: Providing QA insights during the periodic review of the Transaction Monitoring System (TMS) to ensure the mathematical logic of the alerts aligns with the bank's risk appetite. 
 - Regulatory Reporting (SAR/STR) Oversight
 - Reporting Quality Assurance: Performing a final check on Suspicious Activity Reports (SARs) or Suspicious Transaction Reports (STRs) to ensure the "Who, What, Where, When, and Why" is clearly articulated. 
 - Timeliness Monitoring: Ensuring that the time elapsed from the initial alert trigger to the final regulatory filing meets the statutory deadlines (e. g. , the "30-day rule"). 
 - Escalation Integrity: Verifying that all alerts that met the threshold for "suspicion" were actually escalated to the SAR filing stage and not inappropriately dismissed. 
 - Risk-Based QA Strategy & Metrics
 - Risk-Based Sampling Design: Instead of random sampling, designing a QA program that prioritizes high-risk segments (e. g. , PEPs, high-risk jurisdictions, or correspondent banking) for deeper scrutiny. 
 - Error Trend Analysis: Categorizing errors (e. g. , "failure to identify source of funds, " "insufficient profile review, " or "incorrect data entry") to identify systemic training gaps. 
 - KPI/KRI Development: Defining and tracking specific Key Quality Indicators (KQIs) such as: 
 - Error Rate per Investigator. 
 - Percentage of overturned decisions (where QA disagrees with the Investigator). 
 - Average age of open alerts (Backlog Management). 
 - Stakeholder & Remediation Management
 - Feedback Loop Management: Implementing a formal process to provide "Return to Investigator" (RTI) feedback, ensuring that errors are corrected and lessons are learned. 
 - Remediation Oversight: Leading the QA effort during "look-back" projects (remediation exercises) where a systemic failure requires the re-review of months or years of transaction data. 
 - Audit Liaison: Acting as the subject matter expert (SME) for Transaction Monitoring when interviewed by Internal Audit or external regulators regarding the effectiveness of the monitoring program. 
 - People 
 - Provide leadership and direction to the CEFS department and its employees, set conditions and manage its resources in order to optimize departmental services for maximum fulfillment of (internal and external) client needs within determined strategy and budget. 
 - Work with ISPL CLM Operations sub-departments to develop a strong expertise & knowledge on end to end process / delivery. Coach & mentor top talent and define clear career path for them
 - Promote, within ISPL Client Engagement Operations department, a mindset around accountability, continuous improvement, client focus, change management & innovation
 - Proven aptitude to lead and manage high performing teams
 - Team Attrition & Engagement: Maintaining high employee morale and managing turnover within the monitoring team. 

Technical & Behavioral Competencies

- Proficiency in MS Office and VBA Macros. 
 - Rapid adaptability to new systems. 
 - Strong technical aptitude. 
 - Commitment to continuous technological learning. 
 - Logical problem-solving capabilities. 
 - Ability to work autonomously and collaborate with global teams. 
 - Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills. 
 - Decisive leadership on complex business and technical issues. 
 - Preferred experience in banking, payments, or compliance. 

Specific Qualifications

- Minimum 10-14 years of experience along with Bachelor's Degree - in management, finance, science, economics, related field or equivalent experience. 
 - Prior experience in similar domain. 

Skills Referential (Required Knowledge, Skills And Abilities)

- Collaborative teamwork. 
 - Strong oral and written communication. 
 - Ability to synthesize and simplify information. 
 - Strong organizational skills. 

Transversal Skills

- Strong analytical skills. 
 - Process development and adaptation. 
 - Project management proficiency. 
 - Meeting, seminar, committee, and training facilitation. 

Key Performance Indicators & Collaboration For The Role

- Departmental SLA Compliance: The percentage of total team alerts and investigations completed within regulatory or internal timelines. 
 - Resource Utilization & Capacity Planning: Efficiency in managing headcount against alert volumes (ensuring the team is neither over-burdened nor under-utilized). 
 - Backlog Management: Ability to control and reduce the volume of aged/overdue alerts to prevent regulatory breaches. 
 - Cost Per Alert/Investigation: Managing the operational budget by optimizing the cost of processing a single alert (balancing headcount vs. automation). 
 - Talent Development: Success in upskilling Associates into Seniors and Seniors into Leads (succession planning). 
 - Audit & Regulatory Exam Performance: The ability to defend the department's processes and findings during internal audits or external regulatory examinations. 
 - IT & Product Management: Partnering with technical teams to drive system upgrades, rule tuning, and the implementation of automation/AI tools. 
 - Cross-Functional Project Leadership: Leading multi-departmental task forces for large-scale system migrations or regulatory remediation projects. 
 - Representing CEFS ISPL locally and globally in all required forums, decision making and execution at ground level. 

Direct Report to: Vice President (VP)

Education Level: Bachelor Degree or equivalent

Location: Mumbai

About BNP Paribas Group

Job Description

In This Role, Your Responsibilities Will Be: 

- Develop, qualify, and maintain Welding Procedure Specifications (WPS), Procedure Qualification Records (PQR), and related welding documentation for hardfacing, overlay welding, and valve fabrication applications. 
 - Define welding parameters, consumables, preheat requirements, interpass controls, and process specifications to achieve consistent, high-quality results. 
 - Drive welding process improvements that enhance quality, productivity, efficiency, and cost performance. 
 - Provide technical support for the fabrication of Triple Offset Valves, Ball Valves, pressure-containing components, and critical valve assemblies. 
 - Prepare weld maps and provide guidance on welding sequences, distortion control, and fabrication best practices. 
 - Investigate welding-related issues, identify root causes, and implement corrective and preventive actions. 
 - Ensure compliance with applicable industry codes, standards, customer requirements, and internal quality expectations, including ASME, API, ISO, and related specifications. 
 - Support non-destructive examination (NDE) activities, including PT, RT, UT, and MPI, and verify conformance to acceptance criteria. 
 - Perform metallurgical assessments for hardfacing, overlay applications, repair welding, and critical weldments. 
 - Maintain accurate records related to welding procedures, qualifications, traceability, consumables, heat treatment activities, repairs, and process audits. 
 - Review and support quality documentation, including Quality Assurance Plans (QAP), Inspection and Test Plans (ITP), and fabrication records. 
 - Conduct welder qualification tests and skill assessments in accordance with applicable standards. 
 - Coach and train welding personnel on TIG, MIG, PTA hardfacing, and advanced welding practices.

 - Identify opportunities to improve weld quality, reduce waste, optimize consumable usage, and increase operational efficiency.

 - Experience managing welder qualification programs, training initiatives, and workforce capability development.

data.title: Quality and Project Platforms Lead
data.description:
Opella is the self-care challenger with the purest and third-largest portfolio in the Over-The-Counter (OTC) & Vitamins, Minerals & Supplements (VMS) market globally. 

Our mission is to bring health in people's hands by making self-care as simple as it should be. For half a billion consumers worldwide - and counting. 

At the core of this mission is our 100 loved brands, our 11, 000-strong global team, our 13 best-in-class manufacturing sites and 4 specialized science and innovation development centers. Headquartered in France, Opella is the proud maker of many of the world's most loved brands, including Allegra, Buscopan, Doliprane, Dulcolax, Enterogermina, Essentiale and Mucosolvan. 

B Corp certified in multiple markets, we are active players in the journey towards healthier people and planet. Find out more about our mission at www. opella. com. 

About You

You will lead a team of 5 to 10 experts and platform owners covering three connected areas: 

Digital Quality, meaning GxP processes, computer system validation, and the Digital Control Framework. 

Testing and quality engineering, including test strategy, test management and automation on Xray and Tricentis Tosca. 

The Atlassian platform, where Jira and Confluence on Atlassian Cloud carry project delivery, documentation and compliance evidence for Opella Digital. 

The role is both platform owner and people manager. There is no intermediate management layer, so you lead senior specialists directly and stay close enough to the work to challenge a validation rationale, review a test automation approach, or settle a Jira workflow design. 

We are looking for someone with 12 to 15 years of experience who owns the outcome rather than the task, simplifies processes that have grown complicated, and works comfortably across Digital, Quality and the business functions. 

What you will do

Lead the team

Line manage 5 to 10 experts and platform owners, including internal staff and partner resources. Set direction and priorities across three areas at once. Give each platform owner clear accountability, decision rights and a roadmap they own, then hold them to it. Run objective setting, performance and development conversations, coaching, and skills, backup and succession planning. Shape resourcing, capacity and the balance between insourced and partner-delivered work. Own the budget and vendor relationships for the platforms in scope. Build one team culture across quality, testing and platform engineering rather than three separate groups. 

Digital Quality, policy and validation governance

You are the global owner for GxP-relevant Digital Quality policies, standards, SOPs and work instructions, and for making them usable in practice. You own the Digital Control Framework: control design, control ownership, testing of control effectiveness, evidence retention and remediation tracking. 

The role covers controlled document management for CSV and CSA, data integrity under ALCOA+, cloud and SaaS governance, and electronic records and electronic signatures under 21 CFR Part 11. Digital solutions must meet GxP, ICH, HIPAA and 21 CFR Part 11 requirements, including how protected health and personal data is handled across regulated and commercial systems. 

You provide quality oversight for computer system validation using GAMP 5 and CSA principles, take risk-based decisions and document the reasoning. You govern validation plans, risk assessments and test strategies, and you review and approve URS, functional specifications, UAT reports, validation summaries and Authorization for Use. You manage validation deviations and CAPAs, oversee change controls for validation impact, and run GxP periodic reviews. You also govern digital supplier management: vendor inventories, assessments, quality agreements and performance monitoring. 

Testing, strategy, tooling and delivery assurance

Own the global test strategy and testing standards for Opella Digital across functional, integration, regression, performance and user acceptance testing, in both GxP and non-GxP systems. You are accountable for Xray as the test management layer in Jira and for Tricentis Tosca as the automation platform, covering roadmap, licensing, environments, upgrades, integrations and adoption, working through the platform owners in your team. 

Grow automation coverage on the systems that matter most, such as ERP, supply chain, commercial and web, and make automated evidence usable for validation where the regulations allow it. Keep traceability intact from requirement to test case to execution to defect, which serves delivery quality and inspection readiness at the same time. Set testing metrics such as coverage, defect leakage, automation rate and cycle time, and use them to change how the teams work. Get involved early enough with project and product teams that testing is planned in from the start rather than added at the end. 

Atlassian platform

Own Jira and Confluence on Atlassian Cloud, along with Jira Service Management, the Marketplace app portfolio and the integrations with the rest of the digital toolchain. Define and govern project templates, workflows, schemes, permissions and space structures so that they support agile delivery and the traceability a regulated environment needs. 

Cloud releases arrive continuously, so the platform roadmap has to cover release and change management, app rationalization, performance, cost and license optimization. Work with Cybersecurity, Identity and Internal Audit on security, privacy, access management, data residency and audit requirements, including the controls needed for Jira and Confluence to hold GxP-relevant records. Drive adoption and standardization across Digital and the business so the standard way is also the easy way, and run platform operations to agreed service levels with a clear support model and incident and problem management. 

Collaboration, audit and inspection readiness

Partner with Digital, Manufacturing, R&D, Quality and Supply Chain teams to give GxP and testing guidance during system modernization. Work with Cybersecurity, Data Privacy and Internal Audit specialists so requirements are managed in one central framework rather than several. Build and deliver global training on digital and GxP policies, data integrity, validation, testing and Atlassian practices. 

Keep evidence packages and stakeholder coordination ready for audit at any time, not only when one is announced. Act as the subject matter expert during Health Authority inspections (FDA, EMA, MHRA and others) and internal or external audits covering digital systems, validation and data integrity, and lead CAPA development and effectiveness checks for findings related to digital quality governance. 

About You

We look at potential, character and culture fit alongside experience. 

You have 12 to 15 years of experience across digital quality and compliance, software testing and platform ownership in a regulated industry such as pharma, healthcare or life sciences. 

You have managed people for at least 3 to 5 years, ideally senior specialists and platform owners in a flat structure, including hiring, coaching, performance management and leading work delivered through partners. 

You have owned an enterprise SaaS platform yourself, including its roadmap, budget, vendors, lifecycle, adoption and service levels. 

You know test strategy, test management, automation and the validation lifecycle for GxP digital systems. 

On tooling, you have worked hands on with Jira and Xray for test plans, executions, traceability matrices and dashboards. You understand how Tricentis Tosca automation is designed, maintained and scaled in a large system landscape. You can configure and govern Jira and Confluence Cloud, including workflows, permissions, apps and admin and security controls. You are familiar with ServiceNow, Veeva Vault or equivalent document management systems. 

On regulation, you know GxP, ICH guidelines, HIPAA and 21 CFR Part 11 for electronic records and signatures, together with GAMP 5, CSA, IT general controls and ALCOA+ data integrity principles. You have run GxP supplier qualification activities. 

You are fluent in English and comfortable working with stakeholders across a global matrix organization. 

The Opella leadership behaviors we are looking for

We assess every candidate against our four behaviors. 

Behavior What it looks like in this role All in. Together. You lead one team across quality, testing and platforms, and you partner across Digital, R&D, Manufacturing and Supply Chain, asking for help and giving it freely. Courageous You challenge how validation and testing are done today, take considered risks on automation and platform change, and speak up during inspections. Outcome-Obsessed You own the compliance and delivery result, not only the task, and follow through with integrity and speed. Radically Simple You make GxP frameworks and platform configurations simple enough for teams to understand and apply. 

Opella is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment where every candidate feels respected.
