We are seeking a highly experienced Senior Staff/Principal Engineer - Mechanical Testing, Verification & Validation (V&V) to lead the development and execution of comprehensive verification strategies for innovative orthopedic and medical device products. This role will serve as the technical authority for mechanical, biomechanical, fluidic, and system-level testing, ensuring products meet performance, safety, reliability, regulatory, and commercialization requirements for global markets including the United States and Europe. 

The ideal candidate combines deep expertise in medical device testing, biomechanics, statistics, failure analysis, test method development, regulatory submissions, and scientific experimentation. This individual will define verification strategies, develop novel test methodologies, lead cadaveric and animal tissue studies, support regulatory submissions, and represent the organization during regulatory audits. 

What You will do: 

- Lead end-to-end V&V strategy for complex orthopedic and medical device programs from concept through commercialization. 
 - Serve as the technical authority for biomechanics and orthopedic device testing, including mechanical, structural, fluid, fatigue, and durability performance. 
 - Develop scientifically robust test methods, including novel methodologies, test method validation, measurement system analysis, and appropriate acceptance criteria. Design and analyze experiments using DOE, applied statistics, reliability engineering, and risk-based approaches. 
 - Lead failure investigation and root-cause analysis, translating findings into design improvements and risk mitigations. 
 - Ensure compliance with medical device design controls and risk management, including ISO 14971, ISO 13485, FDA QMSR/21 CFR Part 820, and applicable ASTM/ISO standards. 
 - Lead Regulatory testing strategy, face regulatory audits, provide verification evidence for global regulatory submissions, including FDA 510(k), De Novo, PMA-supporting activities, and EU MDR. 
 - Direct advanced preclinical and engineering evaluations, including cadaveric/animal testing and interpretation of FEA/CFD analyses where applicable. 
 - Provide cross-functional technical leadership, influencing R&D, Clinical, Regulatory, Quality, and product-development strategies across multiple franchises. 
 - Build organizational capability and innovation, mentoring engineers, strengthening laboratory/testing competencies, and advancing biomechanical and verification sciences. 

What You Need: 

Education

- Master's or Ph. D. in: Mechanical Engineering Biomechanical Engineering Biomedical Engineering Medical Device Engineering Related technical discipline

Experience

- 7-12 years of medical device/ highly regulated product development and verification experience. Extensive experience supporting orthopedic or musculoskeletal products. Demonstrated success leading complex verification programs through commercialization. Experience supporting FDA and global regulatory submissions. 

Required Technical Expertise

Core Technical Competencies

- Verification & Validation (V&V). Medical Device Design Controls. Biomechanics. Orthopedic Device Testing. Mechanical Engineering. Fluid Mechanics. Structural Mechanics. Fatigue & Durability
 - Failure Analysis. Reliability Engineering. Design of Experiments (DOE). Applied Statistics. Measurement Systems Analysis. Test Method Validation. Risk Management (ISO 14971)

Regulatory Knowledge

- FDA 21 CFR Part 820 / QMSR. FDA 510(k). De Novo. PMA support testing. EU MDR
 - ISO 13485. ASTM Standards. ISO Device-Specific Standards. GHTF/IMDRF Guidance

Preferred Skills

- Cadaveric and animal model testing. FEA and CFD interpretation. Six Sigma Black Belt or Advanced Statistics training
 - Scientific publication or patent experience. Laboratory accreditation experience (ISO 17025)

The Engineer will develop Agentic AI-driven automation across Microsoft Entra ID, Agent ID, M365, workload identities, federated credentials, session and token protection, and secrets and certificate-based authentication. This includes integrating AI agents with IAM platforms, APIs, security controls and enterprise workflows while establishing reusable patterns and guardrails for security, auditability, reliability and operational control. 

Working with Architecture, Product, Operations, application teams, Security and vendors, the Engineer will translate complex requirements into secure, supportable solutions aligned with IAM standards and EY's global technology and security strategies. The individual will provide technical leadership from design through production and operational handover, mentor engineers, and promote engineering quality and leading practices. 

Your Key Responsibilities

- Lead the design and development of complex IAM automation and Agentic AI solutions using Azure Automation, Logic Apps, Functions, Power Platform, Ansible, Azure CLI, ARM templates, Copilot Studio and Foundry, together with PowerShell, Python, NodeJS, ReactJS and . NET. 
 - Architect AI-augmented IAM capabilities, including multi-agent workflows, orchestration patterns, adaptive access control, predictive threat detection, identity analytics and intelligent workflow automation. 
 - Establish reusable frameworks, engineering standards and guardrails for scalable, resilient, maintainable, observable, secure and operationally supportable IAM automation and AI capabilities. 
 - Provide technical leadership across Microsoft Entra ID, M365, workload identities, federated credentials, authentication, authorization, session management, token protection, certificates and secrets management. 
 - Design secure integrations using REST APIs, Microsoft Graph API, Model Context Protocol (MCP) and related standards, with appropriate identity, authorization and security controls for AI agents, applications and workloads. 
 - Apply Zero Trust and least-privilege principles to machine-to-machine and agent-to-service interactions, including secure credential, certificate and secrets management. 
 - Automate IAM security, compliance and audit controls and establish logging, monitoring, alerting and incident-response integrations using Azure Monitor, Microsoft Sentinel or comparable platforms. 
 - Design and maintain secure CI/CD, DevSecOps and Infrastructure as Code patterns using Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Terraform, ARM templates or equivalent technologies, with appropriate testing and deployment controls. 
 - Conduct architecture, technical design and code reviews; guide engineers on IAM, automation, software engineering, DevSecOps and Agentic AI implementation practices. 
 - Serve as the technical escalation point for complex IAM automation and AI issues, leading root-cause analysis and working with engineering, architecture and vendors such as Microsoft, Ping and Auth0 to resolve systemic problems. 
 - Advise internal clients on applying Agentic AI to IAM processes to improve automation, security, user experience and operational efficiency while reducing risk. 
 - Evaluate emerging AI, identity and automation technologies through prototypes and reusable patterns, assessing design alternatives, technical trade-offs and architectural, security or operational risks. 
 - Plan and lead delivery across development, testing and production, ensuring appropriate documentation, monitoring, support models, operational readiness and successful transition to operations. 
 - Build trusted stakeholder relationships, translate business and security requirements into practical solutions, identify dependencies and risks early, and mentor engineers through knowledge sharing, technical standards and leading practices. 

Skills And Attributes For Success

- Strong IAM engineering expertise across authentication, authorization, federation, MFA, SSO, identity lifecycle management, OAuth 2. 0, OpenID Connect, SAML and Zero Trust. 
 - Advanced hands-on experience with Microsoft Entra ID, including application, workload and non-human identities, federated credentials, service principals, managed identities, least privilege and credential management. 
 - Advanced enterprise automation experience using Azure Automation, Logic Apps, Azure Functions, Power Platform, Ansible and Azure CLI, with the ability to create scalable, reusable automation solutions. 
 - Strong knowledge and hands-on experience with Agentic AI architectures and AI/ML solutions, including multi-agent systems, LLM orchestration, tool-enabled agents, human-in-the-loop patterns, AI security and applications within IAM, cybersecurity or enterprise automation. 
 - Experience designing integrations using Model Context Protocol (MCP), REST APIs, JSON, OAuth/OIDC and Microsoft Graph API or equivalent orchestration and tool-integration standards. 
 - Strong software engineering and scripting skills in one or more technologies such as Python, PowerShell, NodeJS, ReactJS, . NET, Bash or Ruby. 
 - Experience securing secrets, keys and certificates with Azure Key Vault, CyberArk or comparable platforms, combined with observability, threat detection, monitoring and incident-response integration using Microsoft Sentinel or similar services. 
 - Advanced experience with Infrastructure as Code, DevSecOps and CI/CD using Terraform, ARM templates, CloudFormation, Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Jenkins or GitLab CI, including secure code, credential and deployment controls. 
 - Ability to design secure, scalable, available, resilient, maintainable and supportable solutions, with strong troubleshooting and root-cause-analysis skills across IAM, cloud, automation, containers and application integrations. 
 - Strong technical leadership, mentoring, documentation and stakeholder-management skills, with knowledge of secure SDLC, ITSM, Change Management, production support and operational readiness while remaining a hands-on engineer. 

To qualify for the role, you must have

- Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - 7+ years of relevant technology experience, including substantial experience in IAM, authentication engineering, access management, security engineering or enterprise identity platforms. 
 - 4+ years of hands-on cloud automation or software engineering experience using scripting, APIs, DevOps and Infrastructure as Code, including enterprise-scale IAM automation across cloud, hybrid or distributed environments. 
 - Around 2 years of hands-on experience developing, integrating or deploying AI/ML, Generative AI or Agentic AI solutions, preferably within IAM, cybersecurity, cloud or enterprise automation. 
 - Demonstrated experience with enterprise authentication, authorization, identity protocols and access management solutions. 
 - Experience leading technical design and implementation through development, testing, production deployment and operational transition, including architecture documentation and resolution of complex cross-technology issues. 
 - Ability to assess technical trade-offs, translate security, architecture and business requirements into practical solutions, and work effectively both independently and through technical leadership within globally distributed, multidisciplinary and multicultural teams. 

Ideally, you'll also have

- Deep hands-on experience with the Microsoft Entra ID and Azure ecosystem, including Azure DevOps, Microsoft Graph, CI/CD and infrastructure automation. 
 - Hands-on experience with Agentic AI frameworks such as Semantic Kernel, LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, Copilot Studio or Foundry, including MCP servers, clients or equivalent patterns for securely exposing enterprise tools to AI agents. 
 - Experience implementing secure identity and authorization patterns for AI agents and workload identities, including AI governance, security and responsible-AI considerations for production solutions. 
 - Experience designing reusable automation platforms, frameworks, APIs and shared engineering capabilities rather than only individual scripts. 
 - Strong knowledge of OAuth 2. 0, OpenID Connect, SAML, SCIM and related identity protocols, together with identity threat detection, Conditional Access, identity analytics and Zero Trust architectures. 
 - Experience with CyberArk, Azure Key Vault or comparable secrets and privileged-access-management platforms in large-scale, globally distributed IAM environments.

What We Look For

We seek a hands-on engineer who combines sound IAM fundamentals with automation and AI / ML experience and curiosity about emerging technologies. What We Offer

data.title: Staff IT Software Engineer
data.description:
Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks®, we're united by a shared mission-to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real-world problems with cutting-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you're ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you're in the right place. 

Who We Are

In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!

We believe collaboration thrives in person. That's why most of our teams work from the office full time, with flexibility when it's needed. This model supports real-time problem-solving, stronger relationships, and the kind of precision that drives great outcomes. 

Job Summary

About the Role

We are looking for a Staff AI Engineer to be the technical anchor for Agentic AI in IT Quality Engineering - setting the architecture, standards and roadmap for custom Agentic AI applications across an Enterprise IT landscape spanning Salesforce, SAP, custom Licensing and Entitlement management applications, and AI Custom Quoting, Provisioning and ITSM platforms. You will decide how agents plan, act, retrieve context and hand back to a human across these systems; how they are evaluated, governed and operated in production; and how the wider engineering team builds them well. This is a hands-on role: you will still design and write the hardest parts yourself. 

At Palo Alto Networks we are moving towards an AI-First engineering culture. You will shape the direction of our own internal AI platform tools for test generation, automation scripting, execution and quality reporting, and lead the engineers who build on them. 

Key Responsibilities

Architecture & Technical Direction

Agentic Architecture: Define the reference architecture for agentic systems across the landscape - planner-executor orchestration, multi-agent coordination, state, memory and recovery - and choose frameworks such as LangGraph, ADK, LangChain, LlamaIndex, AutoGen or CrewAI on evidence rather than fashion. 

Event-Driven Enterprise Integration: Architect event-driven pipelines that connect Salesforce (Platform Events, Change Data Capture, Apex, Flows), SAP (OData/BAPI services and business-object events) and custom Licensing, Entitlement, AI Custom Quoting, Provisioning and ITSM applications to AI processing with production OAuth2 lifecycle, least-privilege access and idempotent writes to systems of record. 

Context & Knowledge Architecture: Set the retrieval strategy across the estate - vector and graph stores (pgvector, Pinecone, Weaviate or Milvus; Apache AGE or Neo4j), advanced topologies (Graph RAG, Corrective RAG, HyDE, agentic retrieval), and the ingestion, freshness and access-control rules that keep context correct. 

Tool & Protocol Standards: Own the standards for tool definitions, JSON function schemas and MCP servers across teams, so that agent tool calls are schema-validated, auditable and traceable back to Jira. 

Model Strategy: Decide when prompting and retrieval are enough and when model customisation is justified - and lead resource-efficient fine-tuning (LoRA) where it is. 

Quality, Safety & Governance at Scale

Evaluation Strategy & Release Gates: Define how AI agents - ours and the ones other teams build that the business depends on - are evaluated before release: golden sets, calibrated LLM-as-judge, adversarial testing, and risk-tiered release gates that block what should be blocked. 

Autonomy & HITL Governance: Set the autonomy model - which decisions an agent may take alone, which need human approval, and how that changes as evidence accumulates - and make sure it is enforced in code, especially where agents write to systems of record. 

LLMOps & Platform Reliability: Architect secure AI gateways, token-budget and rate-limit controls, model deployment pipelines, drift monitoring and automated rollback; own service levels, cost and incident response for production agents. 

Responsible AI & Data Governance: Partner with security and data-governance owners to define guardrails on intellectual property and data privacy - managed secrets, explicit opt-in for any step that sends content to an external service, and an audit trail a reviewer can follow. 

Leadership & Influence

Design & Review Board: Lead design reviews for agentic and AI-integrated systems across Salesforce, SAP and custom platforms, and set the code and design standards for both human-written and AI-generated code. 

Roadmap & Strategy: Partner with engineering leadership, QE leads, product managers and enterprise architects to turn quality and business goals into a sequenced AI engineering roadmap - and say plainly what will not work. 

Mentorship & Capability Building: Mentor Senior AI Engineers and AI Engineers, grow the next AI Architects, and shape the reference implementations and training that move engineers up our AI capability ladder. 

Cross-Organisation Influence: Represent IT Quality Engineering in enterprise architecture and AI governance forums, and drive adoption of AI-native engineering practice beyond your own team. 

Qualifications

Required Skills & Experience

Experience: 7-10 years of professional software engineering experience, including 3+ years in applied AI/ML, of which at least 2 years building LLM-based or agentic systems that reached production. 

Leadership Track Record: 2+ years as a technical lead, staff engineer or architect driving architectural decisions and leading cross-functional technical initiatives to production. 

Programming Mastery: Expert proficiency in Python and strong proficiency in Java or TypeScript/Node. js; excellent software design is a given. 

Agentic Systems Architecture: You have designed and led production agentic systems - planner-executor orchestration, multi-agent coordination, state and memory, HITL control - and can explain the trade-offs you made and what you would change. 

Distributed & Event-Driven Systems: Deep experience with microservices, event-driven architecture and message queues (e. g. , Kafka, Pub/Sub), including idempotency, ordering, back-pressure and failure recovery. 

Retrieval at Scale: You have designed production RAG systems over vector and/or graph stores, including access-controlled ingestion and measured retrieval quality. 

Evaluation & Governance: You have established evaluation and release-gating practice for LLM systems - golden sets, LLM-as-judge calibration, adversarial and prompt-injection testing - that was adopted beyond your own team. 

Enterprise Integration: Deep experience integrating with enterprise platforms - Salesforce, SAP or comparable CRM, ERP or ITSM systems - including OAuth2 lifecycle, safe write patterns and data-governance constraints. 

Cloud, LLMOps & CI/CD: Strong experience with GCP/AWS/Azure, Docker and Kubernetes, CI/CD at enterprise scale, and operating AI services with observability, cost controls and rollback. 

AI-Assisted Development: Deep fluency with tools such as Cursor, Claude Code or GitHub Copilot, and a track record of setting team practice for reviewing what they produce. 

Education: B. E. /B. Tech/M. Tech in Computer Science, Computer Engineering or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience). 

Preferred Qualifications

Model Customisation: Hands-on fine-tuning with resource-efficient methods (LoRA/QLoRA), including data preparation and evaluation of the tuned model against its base. 

Integration Platforms: Event-driven enterprise integration in practice - SAP business-object events and workflow triggers, Salesforce Platform Events or Change Data Capture, and middleware such as SnapLogic or MuleSoft. 

Model Context Protocol: Designing MCP server estates used across teams - tools, resources and prompts, with versioning and access control. 

Managed AI Platforms: Production experience with Vertex AI or an equivalent managed AI platform. 

AI Security: Threat modelling for agentic systems - prompt injection, tool misuse, data exfiltration and red-teaming practice. 

Quality Engineering at Scale: Architecting test automation or quality platforms (Playwright, REST Assured, Selenium or PyTest), including AI-assisted test generation or self-healing automation. 

Domain Expertise: Deep grounding in B2B sales, Partner Relationship Management (PRM), the Quote-to-Cash lifecycle, or licensing, entitlement and provisioning flows. 

Industry Contribution: Publications, conference talks or significant open-source contributions in agentic AI, retrieval or LLM evaluation. 

WAYS OF WORKING

Evidence over Assertion: You measure before and after, you publish the number with its method attached, you say plainly when a result is inconclusive - and you hold the team's claims to the same standard. 

Curiosity with Rigour: You enjoy new tooling but you test it before you trust it, and you know the difference between a demo and a system. 

Strategic Influence: You change direction with evidence and clear writing rather than authority, with technical and non-technical stakeholders alike. 

High Autonomy: You take ambiguous, cross-system problems and turn them into a plan a team can execute, and you raise risks early rather than late. 

Builder's Bias: You would rather ship a narrow capability that works and is trusted than a broad one that only demos well - and you set that standard for the team. 

GROWTH PATH

This role sits at the AI Architect tier of our internal AI capability ladder (AI User → AI Engineer → AI Architect), and you will operate there from the start: planner-executor orchestration at scale, multi-agent systems with human-in-the-loop control, event-driven integration across the enterprise IT landscape, and model customisation. From here the role grows in scope from a single programme to the AI engineering direction of IT Quality Engineering - and in the number of engineers you bring up the same ladder. 

THE TEAM

You will be part of a growing, passionate and dynamic team, with the opportunity to work on challenging and exciting projects centred on what we believe is one of the most significant mission statements in the world. We also strive to be the most people-centric company ever - that means we are constantly working to make your experience amazing, and you are part of the team breaking the boundaries of what the workplace can be. 

Our Commitment

We're trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity's status quo. It's simple: we can't accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together. 

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at accommodations@paloaltonetworks. com. 

Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics. 

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines. 

Is role eligible for Immigration Sponsorship? No. Please note that we will not sponsor applicants for work visas for this position.

data.title: Sr. Engineer Reliability Engineering XI
data.description:
Job Summary

JOB DESCRIPTION

The Sr. Engineer - Reliability Engineering will be responsible for managing and executing product reliability testing and validation activities within the Reliability Lab. The role will ensure that products, components, and systems meet defined reliability, durability, performance, and quality requirements through structured testing, data analysis, failure investigation, and continuous improvement. 

The role will work closely with Product Design, Engineering, Quality, Manufacturing, and other cross-functional teams to plan and execute reliability tests, identify failure modes, determine root causes, and recommend design or process improvements. 

Key Responsibilities

- Plan, coordinate, and execute reliability, durability, life-cycle, and qualification testing in the Reliability Lab. 
 - Develop test plans, test procedures, test setups, and test schedules based on product and customer requirements. 
 - Operate and ensure proper utilization of reliability laboratory equipment, test rigs, instrumentation, and data-acquisition systems. 
 - Conduct reliability testing under thermal, mechanical, electrical, environmental, and other relevant stress conditions. 
 - Monitor tests, capture test data, identify abnormalities, and ensure timely escalation of test failures. 
 - Perform detailed analysis of test failures and support Root Cause Analysis (RCA), FMEA, 8D, and corrective actions. 
 - Work with Design Engineering to investigate failures and recommend design improvements to enhance product reliability. 
 - Ensure proper documentation of test results, observations, failures, corrective actions, and final conclusions. 
 - Prepare test reports, reliability reports, qualification reports, and technical presentations for engineering and leadership teams. 
 - Support new product development by providing reliability inputs during design verification and validation (DV/PV) activities. 
 - Support qualification and validation of design changes, components, materials, and suppliers. 
 - Ensure calibration and preventive maintenance of laboratory equipment and test infrastructure. 
 - Maintain laboratory standards, safety requirements, testing protocols, and documentation. 
 - Coordinate with external laboratories and testing agencies whenever specialized testing is required.

At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting. 

Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, Germany and France. 

Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love.

 - Over 2 million members globally and rapidly growing

 - 3, 000 Tideans globally
 - We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg

About The Role

Here at Tide, we are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Team Leader to oversee our Acquiring Transaction Monitoring team in our first line of defence with experience in transaction monitoring within the card acquiring space or merchant banking, with a deep understanding of fraud detection, compliance, and risk management. This role requires strong leadership skills, along with a deep understanding of fraud prevention, risk management, and compliance within the payments ecosystem. 

Your team will be responsible for the monitoring of the transaction and behaviours across our customer base, ensuring we put our genuine members first, whilst spotting and investigating potentially suspicious activity. This role is a key element of our team, so we're looking for someone who is a passionate investigator, possesses good knowledge on merchant payments, who will help reduce risk to tide, and let our members get back to doing what they love. 

- Lead, manage, and mentor a team of Transaction Monitoring Analysts, ensuring they meet performance metrics, including transaction reviews, case resolution times, and fraud detection accuracy.

Job Description

Lead Software Engineer

Location: Remote

As Chegg Skills engineers, our software empowers students to move from "learning" to "earning. " We build the applications and systems that help students make life-changing career transitions into high-growth job opportunities. We take pride in making education accessible to motivated career switchers, and we build the technology that helps them achieve mastery and success. 

In this role, you will play a leading role in a fully remote team of diverse, motivated engineers who are rethinking what education can look like. We serve thousands of students and educators every year, and your work will directly shape how those students learn and succeed. 

Chegg Skills is a growing division of Chegg focused on post-collegiate learners. We are continuing to grow our engineering team to support business expansion as more students take the next step in their careers with Chegg. Join us and help scale the engineering foundation for our next phase of growth. 

About The Role

We're hiring a Lead Software Engineer, Backend to own the delivery execution of a team building backend services, APIs, and distributed systems for learner-facing and operational experiences. This is a backend-first role with full-stack reach - and the team you lead has that same full-stack reach, not backend-only depth. You need enough fluency across the stack to review a frontend PR, unblock a stuck UI engineer, or make a cross-stack architecture call, not just depth in backend. 

This role sits above individual technical ownership: you are accountable for the team's delivery rhythm, you proactively coach engineers before they get stuck, and you act as the technical filter between Product and the team - refining ambiguous asks before they ever reach an engineer's backlog. 

What You'll Do

About the Role: 

GSK's Enterprise AI team builds AI solutions that prove value fast and scale to production. The Director, Forward Deployed Engineering leads the FDE function - the front of the Enterprise AI delivery pipeline that proves AI ideas with the business through PoCs, PoVs, MVPs and (where appropriate) first production versions, before handing proven solutions off to the Solutions Engineer for scale-up. The pattern is proven by AI-native companies - Anthropic, Palantir, OpenAI - and this role brings that model to GSK. 

This Staff role leads the Forward Deployed Engineering function with direct line management of the FDE team (Lead, Senior, and Forward Deployed Engineers, flat reporting structure). The Staff sets FDE strategy and engagement priorities, owns Director-level BU sponsor relationships, and represents Enterprise AI on FDE matters to GSK leadership. The role continues to contribute technically at the frontier of AI-augmented engineering - humans steer, agents execute. 

Why This Role Exists: 

Enterprise AI's ability to build credibility with the business depends on engineers who can land inside BU problems, prove value quickly, and hand off cleanly. The Director, Forward Deployed Engineering builds and leads the function that makes this happen. 

- Leads the FDE function - setting strategy, building the team, and owning the standards that determine whether the function delivers credibly. 
 - Owns the BU senior relationships that bring AI use cases to Enterprise AI and sustain engagement through the delivery cycle. 
 - Continues to contribute technically on the most strategic FDE engagements - keeping the Director's judgement grounded in current AI engineering reality. 

Key Responsibilities: 

FDE Function Leadership: 

- Lead the Forward Deployed Engineering function - strategy, structure, hiring, development, and standards. 
 - Hire, mentor, and develop the FDE team - creating development paths from G8 through to G5. 
 - Set the standards for AI-native engineering practice within the function - agent workflows, prompt and pattern libraries, handoff hygiene. 

BU Engagement & Strategic Delivery: 

- Own relationships with Director and Senior Director-level BU sponsors across business units that bring AI use cases to Enterprise AI. 
 - Take on the most strategic FDE engagements personally - the ones that set precedents for the function. 
 - Make and defend portfolio-level kill/continue decisions across FDE engagements with BU and Enterprise AI leadership. 

Cross-Functional Leadership: 

- Coordinate with the Solutions Engineering and Operations Engineering functions on the delivery pipeline; represent FDE in Enterprise AI leadership forums. 
 - Influence vendor strategy and tooling choices for AI-native engineering practice within Enterprise AI. 

Governance & Reporting: 

- Ensure the FDE function operates within Code Orange, Responsible AI, and Accountability Report governance from the prototype stage onward. 
 - Provide regular reporting to Enterprise AI leadership on FDE function performance - engagement pipeline, outcomes, team development, and capacity. 

Required Functional Experience: 

- At least 18+ years of experience in software engineering and AI/ML engineering, with significant time leading senior engineering teams or functions. 
 - Demonstrated experience taking AI ideas from sketch to working software at speed, in customer-facing engineering roles. 
 - Strong technical depth in GenAI patterns: agents, multi-agent orchestration, RAG, and evaluation. 
 - Daily use of AI coding agents (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Databricks AI Assistant) as the primary mode of development. 
 - Experience hiring, mentoring, and developing senior engineering talent. 
 - Track record of representing engineering functions to senior business stakeholders. 

Preferred Experience: 

- Prior leadership experience at an AI-native company (Anthropic, Palantir, OpenAI, or similar) - Head of Forward Deployed Engineering, Director of Solutions, or equivalent. 
 - Experience in regulated industries (pharma, healthcare, financial services). 
 - Experience setting AI engineering standards at organisational scale. 

Education: 

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. Master's degree/ Ph D in Computer Science, Mathematics or statistics or related field is advantageous. 

Skills

Artificial Intelligence (AI), Artificial Intelligence Ethics, Artificial Neural Networks (ANNS), Classification Models, Deep Learning, Intelligent Automation (IA), Machine Learning (ML), Model Evaluation, Predictive Modeling, Python (Programming Language), Test Documentation

Why GSK?

Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. 

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2. 5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases - to impact health at scale. 

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we're committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people. 

Inclusion at GSK: 

As an employer committed to Inclusion, we encourage you to reach out if you need any adjustments during the recruitment process. 

Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN. recruitment-adjustments@gsk. com to discuss your needs. 

Important notice to Employment businesses/ Agencies

GSK does not accept referrals from employment businesses and/or employment agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. All employment businesses/agencies are required to contact GSK's commercial and general procurement/human resources department to obtain prior written authorization before referring any candidates to GSK. The obtaining of prior written authorization is a condition precedent to any agreement (verbal or written) between the employment business/ agency and GSK. In the absence of such written authorization being obtained any actions undertaken by the employment business/agency shall be deemed to have been performed without the consent or contractual agreement of GSK. GSK shall therefore not be liable for any fees arising from such actions or any fees arising from any referrals by employment businesses/agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. 

It has come to our attention that the names of GlaxoSmithKline or GSK or our group companies are being used in connection with bogus job advertisements or through unsolicited emails asking candidates to make some payments for recruitment opportunities and interview. data.title: GenAI Platform Engineer – LLM Gateway
data.description:
Role Summary

The GenAI Platform Engineering team builds and runs the shared platform that lets Pfizer colleagues and applications use generative AI safely and at scale. At its core is the enterprise GenAI Gateway: a single, governed entry point to large language models from multiple providers, with self-service access, routing, usage and cost transparency, and observability built in. Around it, we deliver evaluation, observability and agentic tooling - MCP integrations, agent registries and reusable agent skills - for teams across the company. 

We run the platform as a product: self-service over tickets, automation over manual approvals, small and frequent releases, and reliability we can measure. We are looking for a hands-on engineer to help evolve the Gateway and its ecosystem. You will keep it secure, fast and current in a fast-moving open-source landscape. You will work closely with a globally distributed team and with the teams that build on the platform. 

This is an individual contributor role. 

Role Responsibilities

Platform engineering

- Design, build and operate features of the enterprise LLM gateway, mainly in Python: 
 - multi-provider model access
 - routing and failover
 - API key and access management
 - budgets, usage metering and chargeback
 - Integrate agentic capabilities into the platform with the right security controls. Examples include Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, tool calling across providers, and agent-to-agent connectivity. 
 - Keep the platform's open-source foundations current. Assess upstream releases, maintain and retire Pfizer-specific extensions, and deliver upgrades without regressions. 
 - Contribute to the platform's admin and self-service experiences, including web UI, portals and developer documentation. 

Quality, reliability and security

- Build and maintain automated quality gates in CI/CD. These include unit, integration, contract and performance/load tests that protect every release. 
 - Instrument services with metrics, traces and logs (e. g. , OpenTelemetry, Langfuse). Use them to find and fix latency, error and cost issues. 
 - Take part in the support/on-call rotation. Lead root-cause analysis of production incidents, and turn the findings into lasting fixes and blameless postmortems. 
 - Apply secure-by-default engineering: 
 - identity and access controls (SSO, OAuth 2. 0/OIDC, RBAC)
 - secret handling
 - dependency pinning and supply-chain hygiene
Enablement and collaboration

- Evaluate emerging GenAI capabilities hands-on, such as model routing, guardrails and agent registries. Turn the results into clear recommendations on whether to adopt them. 
 - Help consuming teams onboard and succeed. Write guides and runbooks, and create reusable assets such as code samples and AI agent skills. 
 - Work in the open. Make InnerSource contributions, review code, and engage with open-source communities and vendors by reporting issues and proposing fixes upstream. 

Basic Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Applications, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - 9+ years of professional software engineering experience, including 3+ years building GenAI/LLM-based applications or platforms used in production. 
 - Strong Python skills for backend services: async programming, FastAPI or similar, REST APIs and streaming responses. 
 - Hands-on experience with LLM provider APIs (e. g. , OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock), including tool/function calling and integrating multiple providers. 
 - Experience delivering and running services on AWS with containers and CI/CD pipelines (e. g. , Docker, GitHub Actions), with automated testing built into the workflow. 
 - Proven ability to troubleshoot complex production issues and perform root-cause analysis. 
 - Clear written and verbal communication in English, and comfort working with distributed, cross-functional teams. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with an AI/LLM gateway or API gateway, including routing, key management and cost tracking. 
 - Experience running and extending open-source software in production, including patches, upgrades, regression testing and upstream contributions. 
 - Knowledge of agentic AI patterns and tooling: 
 - MCP
 - LangGraph/LangChain or similar frameworks
 - multi-agent orchestration
 - RAG and vector search
 - Experience with performance/load testing and observability tooling (e. g. , OpenTelemetry, Langfuse, Prometheus/Grafana). 
 - Experience with Kubernetes and Infrastructure as Code (Terraform). 
 - Frontend skills (React, TypeScript) for internal tools and portals. 
 - Daily use of AI-assisted development tools (e. g. , GitHub Copilot, Claude Code) and interest in building reusable agent skills. 
 - Experience in pharmaceutical, healthcare or other regulated environments. 
 - Experience mentoring engineers or delivering technical enablement, such as workshops, documentation and onboarding. 
 - AWS certification. 

WORK SCHEDULE

- Regular collaboration with colleagues in European time zones. 
 - Participation in the team's support rotation. 

Pfizer is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable equal employment opportunity legislation in each jurisdiction in which it operates. 

To learn more about acceptable and prohibited uses of AI during the recruitment process, please review our candidate AI-use guidelines available on Pfizer Careers.

data.title: Software Engineer I
data.description:
Job Description

Role Type

Hands-on AI / Agentic AI Engineering

Primary Mission

Build, test, deploy, and continuously improve AI-enabled applications that solve real business problems and deliver measurable business value. 

Team Context

Regional AI Team (AI Platforms / Delivery Team)

Role Purpose

The AI Engineer partners with business stakeholders, solution leads, architects, data specialists, and engineering teams to transform business requirements into scalable AI-powered solutions. This role requires strong software engineering and AI development expertise, a delivery-focused mindset, and the ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical audiences. 

The successful candidate will contribute across the entire AI application lifecycle, from requirement gathering and rapid prototyping to production deployment, monitoring, and ongoing optimization. 

Key Responsibilities

Requirements & Solution Development

- Collaborate with business stakeholders to understand and clarify requirements, assumptions, constraints, and success criteria. 
 - Translate business challenges into practical technical solutions and implementation plans. 
 - Support backlog refinement, effort estimation, and prioritization activities. 

AI Application Development

- Design, develop, and maintain AI-enabled applications, intelligent agents, and enterprise automation solutions. 
 - Build proof of concepts (POCs), prototypes, MVPs, and production-grade AI products. 
 - Develop Python-based services, APIs, orchestration workflows, data processing pipelines, and integration layers. 
 - Implement prompt engineering, context management, retrieval mechanisms, and agent orchestration patterns. 

Cloud & Platform Engineering

- Build and deploy AI workloads on cloud platforms, with a preference for Microsoft Azure. 
 - Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines, automated deployment processes, and infrastructure configurations. 
 - Package and deploy applications using containerization technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes. 

Quality, Testing & Evaluation

- Define and implement automated testing strategies, evaluation frameworks, benchmark datasets, and success metrics for AI solutions. 
 - Conduct performance analysis, error investigation, model evaluation, and solution optimization. 
 - Ensure maintainable, secure, and reliable code through code reviews, testing, and engineering best practices. 

Governance, Security & Compliance

- Design and deliver solutions aligned with Responsible AI principles, security standards, privacy requirements, auditability needs, and enterprise governance frameworks. 
 - Ensure compliance with organizational data handling and security policies. 

Agile Delivery & Collaboration

- Actively participate in sprint planning, daily standups, backlog grooming, demos, and retrospectives. 
 - Collaborate with architecture, security, cloud, operations, and data teams to ensure successful project delivery. 
 - Contribute to technical documentation, operational runbooks, deployment guides, and knowledge-sharing initiatives. 

Operational Support

- Support application monitoring, troubleshooting, incident resolution, and continuous improvement activities. 
 - Assist with production deployments, environment management, and operational readiness. 

Required Technical Skills

AI & Agentic AI Development

- Hands-on experience with frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, Microsoft Agent Framework (MAF), or similar AI orchestration platforms. 
 - Strong understanding of Agentic AI concepts, multi-agent systems, tool integration, and workflow orchestration. 
 - Experience with Model Context Protocol (MCP) and Agent-to-Agent (A2A) communication patterns. 

Programming & Software Engineering

- Strong proficiency in Python for backend development, AI solution development, automation, and data processing. 
 - Experience building and consuming REST APIs and microservices. 
 - Solid understanding of modern software engineering principles and development methodologies. 

Large Language Models (LLMs)

- Practical experience with prompt engineering, context engineering, retrieval patterns, and enterprise LLM implementation. 
 - Knowledge of model evaluation, hallucination mitigation, response quality assessment, and AI observability. 
 - Understanding of token optimization, model selection, latency management, scalability, and cost optimization. 

Cloud & DevOps

- Experience developing and deploying solutions on Microsoft Azure, AWS, GCP, or similar cloud environments. 
 - Hands-on experience with GitHub Enterprise, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, or equivalent DevOps platforms. 
 - Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure automation, and cloud-native deployment practices. 

Data Engineering

- Strong understanding of: 
 - Data pipelines
 - Structured and unstructured data processing
 - Data validation and transformation
 - API integrations
 - Data quality and governance principles
Containerization & Deployment

- Experience with Docker and foundational knowledge of Kubernetes. 
 - Ability to troubleshoot deployment, configuration, and runtime issues in cloud environments. 

Testing & Quality Assurance

- Experience implementing: 
 - Unit testing
 - Integration testing
 - Regression testing
 - Automated validation frameworks
 - Secure coding practices
Product & Delivery Mindset

- Ability to define MVP scope, prioritize features, validate assumptions, and create roadmaps from prototype through production deployment. 

Required Soft Skills

- Excellent verbal and written communication skills. 
 - Ability to proactively communicate progress, dependencies, risks, and blockers. 
 - Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving capabilities. 
 - Curiosity and willingness to explore both business and technical challenges. 
 - Effective collaboration with cross-functional and geographically distributed teams. 
 - Fast learner with the ability to quickly adopt emerging AI technologies, frameworks, and enterprise standards. 
 - Strong ownership mindset with a focus on quality, maintainability, and operational excellence. 
 - Ability to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders in a clear and concise manner. 

Core Capability Areas

Requirements Support

- Clarify business needs, assumptions, constraints, acceptance criteria, and user journeys. 
 - Bridge communication between business and technical teams. 

Engineering Delivery

- Design and develop reliable AI, cloud, and software solutions using modern engineering practices. 
 - Deliver scalable and maintainable production-ready components. 

Agile Collaboration

- Participate actively in sprint planning, estimation, backlog refinement, demos, and continuous improvement activities. 

Operational Readiness

- Support deployment, monitoring, troubleshooting, documentation, handover, and production support activities. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience in Insurance, Financial Services, Banking, Customer Service, Contact Centers, Underwriting, Claims, Producer Support, or Policy Administration domains. 
 - Experience working with global and remote teams across multiple geographies. 
 - Japanese business communication skills are advantageous for supporting Japan-based stakeholders. 
 - Experience with: 
 - Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
 - Vector databases and semantic search
 - Knowledge ingestion pipelines
 - Conversation analytics
 - AI evaluation and observability frameworks
Success Measures

The AI Engineer Will Be Successful When They

- Deliver high-quality, scalable, and well-documented AI solutions. 
 - Accurately translate business requirements into working software and AI capabilities. 
 - Establish reliable testing, deployment, and CI/CD practices that reduce manual effort and delivery risk. 
 - Proactively contribute to problem-solving, innovation, team knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement initiatives. 
 - Build secure, compliant, and maintainable AI products that provide measurable business value.

This role matters because customers depend on well-defined, well-tested solutions to bring innovations to market, and strong requirements and quality work is what makes that possible.

data.description:
In this hourly, remote contractor role, you will work as a Life & Environmental Sciences Quality Assurance Lead (QAL) to oversee quality, consistency, and trainer performance across biology, ecology, environmental science, and life science AI training projects. You will review AI-generated life/environmental science content and trainer/QA work, evaluate output quality against project guidelines, provide precise written feedback, and ensure that all contributors follow the expected quality standards. 

You will assess work for scientific accuracy, biological reasoning, ecological context, environmental systems thinking, terminology quality, data interpretation, safety awareness, clarity, formatting, instruction-following, and adherence to project-specific rubrics. You will spot recurring quality issues, communicate updates to trainers and QAs, support onboarding, maintain documentation, and help activate contributors who are not working consistently. This role requires strong life/environmental science expertise, strong English communication skills, excellent attention to detail, structured communication, and the ability to manage quality workflows across remote science-focused teams. 

This role is with SME Careers, a fast-growing AI Data Services company and subsidiary of SuperAnnotate, delivering training data for many of the world's largest AI companies and foundation-model labs. Your life and environmental sciences quality leadership will directly help improve the world's premier AI models by ensuring that science training data is accurate, evidence-aware, environmentally contextualized, clearly explained, and aligned with client expectations. 

Key Responsibilities

- Quality monitoring: Spot-check life and environmental science items, identify quality issues, provide ongoing feedback through DMs, and escalate recurring or critical issues. 
 - Scientific review: Evaluate AI-generated biology, ecology, environmental science, sustainability, conservation, climate, and life science explanations for accuracy, clarity, and scientific rigor. 
 - Trainer and QA communication: Update trainers and QAs on Discord about new item guidelines, project changes, workflow updates, quality expectations, and life/environmental-science-specific review standards. 
 - Question handling: Respond to trainer/QA questions clearly and promptly, especially around biological concepts, ecosystems, environmental systems, data interpretation, sustainability claims, safety, and rubric interpretation. 
 - Trainer/QA activation management: DM contributors who are inactive or not working, encourage activation, track follow-ups, and flag availability issues when needed. 
 - Documentation: Create and maintain life/environmental sciences project documentation, including style guides, trackers, FAQs, quality notes, examples, honeypots, calibration tasks, and onboarding materials. 
 - Onboarding and training: Schedule and run onboarding/training calls with trainers and QAs to explain project expectations, workflows, rubrics, quality standards, and scientific review requirements. 
 - Quality alignment: Ensure all trainers and QAs apply life and environmental science guidelines consistently and understand updates as projects evolve. 
 - Risk review: Flag misleading environmental claims, unsupported health/ecology statements, unsafe experiment or field recommendations, flawed data interpretation, or overconfident scientific claims. 
 - Process improvement: Identify recurring quality gaps, propose workflow improvements, and help build scalable QA processes for life and environmental science AI training projects. 
 - Native fluency in Punjabi

Your Profile

- Bachelor's, Master's, PhD, or equivalent professional experience in Biology, Environmental Science, Ecology, Conservation Biology, Earth Science, Public Health, Agriculture, Marine Science, Sustainability, Life Sciences, or a related field. 
 - Strong grasp of the English language to follow project guidelines, communicate with teams, and provide clear written feedback. 
 - 3+ years of experience in life science research, environmental science, teaching, fieldwork, lab work, conservation, sustainability, science communication, academic review, or related scientific workflows. 
 - Strong understanding of biology, ecology, ecosystems, biodiversity, evolution, genetics, physiology, environmental systems, climate change, pollution, conservation, sustainability, and scientific methods. 
 - Ability to evaluate life/environmental science content against detailed rubrics and identify issues such as incorrect biological claims, oversimplified ecological relationships, unsupported environmental claims, flawed causal reasoning, unsafe recommendations, or misleading data interpretation. 
 - Familiarity with tools or methods such as field sampling, lab methods, ecological surveys, environmental impact assessment, GIS, statistics, climate/environmental datasets, literature review, or scientific visualization is preferred. 
 - Experience leading or supporting remote teams of researchers, educators, reviewers, environmental specialists, annotators, trainers, or QAs is strongly preferred. 
 - Comfortable working in fast-moving remote environments using tools such as Discord, Google Sheets, Google Docs, trackers, dashboards, and project management systems. 
 - Highly detail-oriented and organized, with the ability to maintain style guides, FAQs, trackers, onboarding materials, honeypots, calibration tasks, and documentation. 
 - Experience with AI training, data annotation, LLM evaluation, scientific QA, environmental content review, academic review, or rubric-based review is a strong plus.

Description and Requirements

"At BMC trust is not just a word - it's a way of life!" Description And Requirements

CareerArc Code

CA-SW

Hybrid

BMC empowers nearly 80% of the Forbes Global 100 to accelerate business value, faster than humanly possible. Our industry-leading portfolio unlocks human and machine potential to drive business growth, innovation, and sustainable success. BMC does this in a simple and optimized way by connecting people, systems, and data that power the world's largest organizations so they can seize a competitive advantage. 

The IZOT product line includes BMC's Intelligent Z Optimization & Transformation products, which help the world's largest companies to monitor and manage their mainframe systems. The modernization of mainframe is the beating heart of our product line, and we achieve this goal by developing products that improve the developer experience, the mainframe integration, the speed of application development, the quality of the code and the applications' security, while reducing operational costs and risks. We acquired several companies along the way, and we continue to grow, innovate, and perfect our solutions on an ongoing basis. 

About The Role

You build the systems that tell us whether our agentic AI is good enough to ship: evaluation frameworks, golden datasets, and rubrics; automated eval harnesses in CI; and drive down failure modes such as hallucination, drift, and unsafe or non-repeatable output. You are the reason customers can trust what our agents produce. 

At this level you independently own well-scoped work from definition through delivery. 

Scope at this level: Independently owns well-scoped eval work for a feature/team from definition through delivery. 

Organizational impact expected: Improves outcomes for one team or project. 

Key Responsibilities

Core responsibilities for this role: 

- Define and implement evaluation strategies and frameworks for Generative AI, RAG, and agentic AI applications. 
 - Create golden datasets, rubrics, and scoring methods (including LLM-as-a-judge) so quality is measured consistently. 
 - Apply statistical sampling, repeated trials, judge calibration, dataset versioning, and anti-contamination practices. 
 - Stand up automated evaluation harnesses in CI so model/prompt/agent changes are re-scored before ship. 
 - Define quality metrics and release gates for customer-ready vs prototype. 
 - Design testing strategies for multi-agent workflows and AI systems using tools, APIs, MCP, and enterprise apps; Playwright where relevant. 
 - Evaluate end-to-end agent behaviour (planning, tool use, response generation, task completion). 
 - Identify failure modes using observability/tracing; recommend reliability improvements.

 - Align day to day activities with the organization mission by ensuring that reliable insurance systems enable customers to access protection products and services without disruption.

- Possess professional experience of eight to twelve years in quality engineering with a clear focus on automation and end to end validation of complex enterprise applications. 
 - Demonstrate strong hands on expertise in designing developing and maintaining Playwright based automation frameworks using TypeScript for user interface testing. 
 - Exhibit proven experience in building RestAssured based test automation for validating application programming interfaces data contracts and integration flows. 
 - Show deep domain understanding of property and casualty insurance including policy underwriting endorsements claims processing and billing workflows. 
 - Apply solid knowledge of software testing principles including different levels of testing test design techniques and risk based testing strategies. 
 - Utilize practical experience with continuous integration tools and version control systems to integrate and manage automated suites as part of the delivery pipeline. 
 - Display strong analytical and problem solving abilities with a focus on root cause analysis and sustainable corrective actions for recurring defects. 
 - Communicate clearly with technical and non technical stakeholders providing concise explanations of risks coverage and test outcomes. 
 - Adapt effectively to a hybrid work model demonstrating self discipline collaboration skills and proactive communication across remote and onsite contexts. 
 - Leverage familiarity with agile methodologies such as scrum or kanban to plan execute and report on testing activities within iterative delivery cycles. 
 - Maintain awareness of security performance and reliability considerations in testing strategies particularly for customer facing insurance applications.

Certified Software Quality Engineer CSQE or ISTQB Advanced Test Automation Engineer or equivalent quality engineering certification.

data.title: QA Engineer - Automation and Cloud
data.description:
About The Role

We are looking for a smart, analytical and technically strong QA Engineer who is passionate about product quality and enjoys solving complex technical problems. 

The ideal candidate should have strong hands-on experience in both manual and automation testing, along with good programming fundamentals and a solid understanding of APIs, backend systems, databases and cloud environments. 

We are not looking for someone who simply executes predefined test cases or raises defects. We want an engineer who thinks critically, understands how applications work internally, investigates issues independently and takes complete ownership of product quality. 

The individual will be responsible for owning the quality of assigned features/modules end-to-end, from understanding requirements and designing test scenarios to automation, debugging, defect investigation and release validation. 

Key Responsibilities

- Manual Testing & Quality Assurance
 - Analyse business requirements, functional specifications and acceptance criteria to develop comprehensive test scenarios. 
 - Design and execute functional, integration, regression, exploratory and end-to-end test cases. 
 - Identify edge cases, negative scenarios and potential failure points that may not be explicitly covered in requirements. 
 - Independently own testing activities for assigned features/modules. 
 - Validate complex business workflows, application behaviour and data integrity. 
 - Identify, reproduce, document and investigate defects with clear technical details. 
 - Collaborate with developers and product managers to ensure issues are understood and resolved. 
 - Participate in release validation and provide quality sign-off for assigned modules. 
 - Automation Testing
 - Develop and maintain automated test scripts using suitable automation technologies. 
 - Build reusable automation components, utilities and test scripts. 
 - Perform UI automation as well as API automation. 
 - Demonstrate good programming fundamentals, including OOP concepts, functions, data structures, exception handling and scripting. 
 - Maintain automation suites and troubleshoot flaky or inconsistent test cases. 
 - Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Identify opportunities to improve automation coverage, reliability and execution efficiency. 

Preferred technologies: Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, Pytest, JavaScript/TypeScript, Python or Java. 

Candidates with strong automation fundamentals in one technology should be comfortable transitioning to another. 

- API & Backend Testing
 - Perform comprehensive API testing, including positive, negative, integration and edge-case scenarios. 
 - Validate request/response payloads, headers, authentication, status codes and business logic. 
 - Understand REST APIs, JSON, HTTP/HTTPS and basic authentication mechanisms. 
 - Investigate issues across frontend, backend and service integration layers. 
 - Understand backend execution flows and dependencies between services. 
 - Read and interpret application code to identify potential root causes of defects. 
 - Database & Data Validation
 - Write SQL queries involving joins, subqueries, aggregations and other data-validation operations. 
 - Validate data consistency and integrity across application layers. 
 - Investigate database-level issues and discrepancies. 
 - Possess a good understanding of relational databases and basic NoSQL concepts. 
 - Independently validate backend data against expected business outcomes. 
 - Cloud & Infrastructure Understanding
 - Possess a good understanding of cloud computing fundamentals, preferably AWS and/or Azure. 
 - Understand how applications are deployed and operate in cloud environments. 
 - Analyse application logs, cloud logs and monitoring information to investigate issues. 
 - Understand environment configurations, environment variables, service dependencies and application connectivity. 
 - Possess basic networking knowledge, including DNS, ports, HTTP/HTTPS, timeouts and connectivity. 
 - Have working knowledge of Linux commands and command-line troubleshooting. 
 - Understand Docker fundamentals and container-based application deployment. 
 - Have basic familiarity with Kubernetes concepts. 

The ability to independently investigate application and environment-related failures using logs, configurations and other diagnostic information will be a significant advantage. 

- CI/CD & Engineering Collaboration
 - Understand Git, version control and basic branching workflows. 
 - Understand CI/CD pipelines and investigate automation or pipeline failures. 
 - Collaborate closely with developers, product managers and DevOps teams. 
 - Independently investigate technical issues before escalating them. 
 - Communicate defects, investigation findings and root-cause observations clearly. 
 - Production & Performance Testing Exposure
 - Participate in investigating production issues by analysing logs and helping identify potential causes. 
 - Understand the importance of application stability, reliability and performance. 
 - Exposure to performance testing tools such as JMeter or k6 will be an advantage. 
 - Basic understanding of security testing, authentication, authorization and role-based access control is desirable. 

Mandatory Skills & Qualifications

- 2-4 years of hands-on experience in software quality assurance. 
 - Strong fundamentals in manual testing and test case design. 
 - Practical experience in automation testing. 
 - Good programming fundamentals and scripting capabilities in at least one programming language. 
 - Experience with UI and API testing. 
 - Strong understanding of REST APIs, JSON and HTTP protocols. 
 - Good SQL proficiency and understanding of relational and NoSQL databases. 
 - Ability to analyse application logs and troubleshoot issues. 
 - Good understanding of backend systems and application architecture. 
 - Working knowledge of cloud environments, preferably AWS or Azure. 
 - Familiarity with Linux, Git, networking and CI/CD fundamentals. 
 - Ability to read application code and independently identify or narrow down potential root causes. 
 - Strong analytical, logical reasoning and problem-solving abilities. 

Good to Have

- Hands-on exposure to both AWS and Azure. 
 - Experience with Playwright or Cypress. 
 - Exposure to microservices-based architectures. 
 - Docker and Kubernetes troubleshooting experience. 
 - Experience with performance testing tools such as JMeter or k6. 
 - Familiarity with monitoring and observability tools. 
 - Exposure to production issue investigation. 
 - Experience improving existing automation frameworks. 

What We Are Looking For

- Someone who is naturally curious, analytical and inquisitive. 
 - Someone who thinks beyond predefined test cases and proactively identifies potential problems. 
 - A debugging-first mindset rather than a ticket-closing mindset. 
 - Strong ownership and accountability for assigned features/modules. 
 - Someone who can investigate problems independently instead of relying on developers for every technical clarification. 
 - An individual who is comfortable reading code, understanding application behaviour and working with backend systems. 
 - Someone who can quickly learn unfamiliar technologies and tools. 
 - A proactive team player with clear communication and collaboration skills. 

About Company

Hi there! We are Auriga IT. We power businesses across the globe through digital experiences, data and insights. From the apps we design to the platforms we engineer, we're driven by an ambition to create world-class digital solutions and make an impact. Our team has been part of building the solutions for the likes of Zomato, Yes Bank, Tata Motors, Amazon, Snapdeal, Ola, Practo, Vodafone, Meesho, Volkswagen, Droom and many more.

data.description:
Role: Assistant Manager/Manager -Airside Controls

Location: Gurgaon, India

Full/ Part-time: Full time

Build a career with confidence

Carrier Global Corporation, global leader in intelligent climate and energy solutions is committed to creating solutions that matter for people and our planet for generations to come. From the beginning, we've led in inventing new technologies and entirely new industries. Today, we continue to lead because we have a world-class, diverse workforce that puts the customer at the center of everything we do. 

About The Role

This role involves in designing and developing electrical and control systems for AHU units. 

Job Responsibilities

- Design and develop electrical and control systems for Air Handling Units (AHUs) in accordance with project specifications, customer requirements, applicable codes, and engineering standards. 
 - Develop and design electrical control panels, including MCC/control panels, starter panels, VFD/VSD panels, DOL and star-delta starter systems, control transformers, power supplies, protection, switching, and control devices. 
 - Select, specify, and appropriately size electrical and control components, including motors, VFDs, contactors, overload relays, MCBs, MCCBs, fuses, relays, sensors, actuators, terminal blocks, and associated accessories. 
 - Prepare and review electrical schematics, control circuit diagrams, wiring diagrams, single-line diagrams (SLDs), panel layouts, and interconnection drawings. 
 - Develop AHU control philosophy and control logic for supply, return, and exhaust fans; fresh-air and return-air dampers; heating and cooling systems; chilled-water valves; electric heaters; humidifiers; filtration systems; and associated monitoring and protection functions. 
 - Develop, configure, program, and troubleshoot microprocessor-based controllers for HVAC and industrial automation applications. 
 - Configure, program, and troubleshoot temperature, pressure, humidity, airflow, and other process control systems used in HVAC applications. 
 - Select, configure, integrate, and troubleshoot field instrumentation and devices, including temperature, humidity, pressure, differential-pressure, airflow sensors, actuators, valves, and controllers. 
 - Develop and configure HMI/SCADA systems for equipment monitoring, control, alarm management, data visualization, and system diagnostics. 
 - Design and implement communication and interface requirements between AHU electrical/control systems and Building Management Systems (BMS) and other HVAC automation platforms. 
 - Perform system integration, functional testing, validation, troubleshooting, and commissioning of electrical and automation systems. 
 - Diagnose, debug, and optimize existing electrical, control, and automation systems to improve system performance, reliability, and operational efficiency. 
 - Prepare electrical control panel designs using AutoCAD, EPLAN, or equivalent electrical engineering design tools, with preference for hands-on experience in panel design documentation. 
 - Perform electrical engineering calculations, including connected load, operating load, cable sizing, protective device selection, breaker ratings, short-circuit ratings, control transformer sizing, and panel ratings. 
 - Ensure all electrical and automation designs comply with applicable IEC, IS, NFPA, NEC, and other relevant international/local standards, as well as customer and project-specific requirements. 
 - Review and interpret AHU mechanical drawings, equipment layouts, and technical specifications to ensure effective coordination and integration of electrical, mechanical, and control systems. 
 - Prepare and maintain Bills of Materials (BOMs), cable schedules, I/O lists, equipment/component specifications, terminal schedules, technical datasheets, and other engineering documentation. 
 - Review customer specifications, tender requirements, approved drawings, and technical submittals, and incorporate relevant requirements and engineering changes into the design. 
 - Coordinate closely with Mechanical Engineering, Controls/Automation, Production, Procurement, Quality, Project Management, and Service teams to ensure timely and successful project execution. 
 - Provide technical support to the manufacturing and assembly teams during control panel fabrication, panel wiring, component installation, AHU assembly, and inspection activities. 
 - Provide technical support to the Service and Commissioning teams during site installation, testing, commissioning, troubleshooting, and customer handover. 
 - Conduct design verification, functional testing, electrical testing, and system validation to ensure compliance with design requirements and expected equipment performance. 
 - Investigate electrical, instrumentation, control, and automation-related issues, perform root-cause analysis, and implement effective corrective and preventive actions. 
 - Maintain and control engineering drawings, software programs, technical documentation, revisions, and as-built records for current and future projects. 
 - Support the development and implementation of engineering standards, design guidelines, standard control philosophies, and reusable design solutions for AHU applications. 
 - Identify opportunities for cost optimization, component standardization, design simplification, and product improvement without compromising safety, quality, reliability, or performance. 
 - Support continuous improvement initiatives related to AHU electrical systems, automation architecture, control logic, panel design, manufacturing processes, and field performance. 

Education Preferred

Bachelors degree in Electrical Engineering / Electronics & Electrical engineering, having 7-11 years of work experience in Airside products

Experience Preferred

Design & development experience required as below: 

Ø Essential Competencies/ Primary Skill Set

- Electrical System & Control Panel Design: Strong knowledge and hands-on experience in designing electrical systems, control panels, starter panels, MCC panels, and associated control and protection circuits. 
 - AHU/HVAC Electrical & Automation Systems: Sound understanding of electrical, controls, and automation systems used in Air Handling Units (AHUs) and HVAC applications. 
 - Motor Control & Protection: Proficiency in motor starting, control, protection, interlocking, and selection of appropriate protective devices for HVAC and industrial applications. 
 - VFD/VSD Applications: Practical knowledge of Variable Frequency Drives/Variable Speed Drives, including selection, configuration, parameterization, integration, and troubleshooting. 
 - Microprocessor/PLC/DDC-Based Controllers: Knowledge and experience in configuring, programming, integrating, and troubleshooting microprocessor-based, PLC, and DDC controllers used in HVAC and industrial automation applications. 
 - HVAC Instrumentation & Field Devices: Good understanding of HVAC sensors, transmitters, actuators, control valves, dampers, and other field devices, including their selection, installation, configuration, and troubleshooting. 
 - HMI/SCADA Systems: Experience in configuring and troubleshooting HMI/SCADA systems for equipment monitoring, process visualization, alarm management, data acquisition, and operational control. 
 - BMS Integration & Communication Protocols: Understanding of BMS integration and industrial communication protocols for seamless communication between AHUs, controllers, field devices, and building automation systems. 
 - Electrical Load & Cable Sizing: Competence in electrical load calculations, cable sizing, voltage-drop calculations, protective device selection, short-circuit ratings, and control panel sizing. 
 - Electrical Schematics & Panel Documentation: Ability to develop and interpret electrical schematics, single-line diagrams, control circuit diagrams, wiring diagrams, panel layouts, terminal schedules, and interconnection drawings. 
 - AutoCAD/EPLAN: Proficiency in using AutoCAD, EPLAN, or equivalent electrical design software for developing and maintaining electrical drawings and control panel documentation. 
 - System Integration, Testing & Commissioning: Ability to integrate electrical, controls, instrumentation, and automation systems and conduct functional testing, validation, troubleshooting, and commissioning activities. 
 - Electrical & Automation Troubleshooting: Strong troubleshooting skills with the ability to diagnose electrical, instrumentation, control, communication, and automation-related issues and implement effective corrective actions. 
 - Electrical & HVAC Standards: Good working knowledge of relevant electrical and HVAC standards, including IEC, IS, NFPA, NEC, and applicable customer/project-specific standards and requirements. 
 - Ability to interpret customer specifications and deliver technically sound, compliant engineering solutions
 - Ability to drive cross-functional collaboration (Mechanical, Electrical, Controls, Manufacturing, Sourcing) for project execution
 - Good communication skills to manage customer interactions, technical clarifications, and submittal approvals

Ø Desirable Competencies/ Secondary Skill Set

- Experience in handling customer-facing engineering discussions and approvals during project execution
